// ============================================================================
// SPAN AND TOKEN STRUCTURES
// ============================================================================

struct Span {
    start: i64,
    end: i64,
}

fn span_new(start: i64, end: i64) -> Span {
    Span { start: start, end: end }
}

struct Token {
    kind: i32,
    span: Span,
    text: [i8; 256],
    text_len: i64,
}

fn token_new() -> Token {
    Token {
        kind: TK_EOF(),
        span: span_new(0, 0),
        text: [0; 256],
        text_len: 0,
    }
}

fn token_simple(kind: i32, start: i64, end: i64) -> Token {
    Token {
        kind: kind,
        span: span_new(start, end),
        text: [0; 256],
        text_len: 0,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// LEXER STATE
// ============================================================================

struct Lexer {
    source: [i8; 1048576],
    source_len: i64,
    pos: i64,
    line: i64,
    column: i64,
    current: i8,
}

fn lexer_new() -> Lexer {
    Lexer {
        source: [0; 1048576],
        source_len: 0,
        pos: 0,
        line: 1,
        column: 1,
        current: 0,
    }
}

fn lexer_init(source: [i8; 1048576], len: i64) -> Lexer with Mut, Panic {
    var lex = lexer_new();
    lex.source = source;
    lex.source_len = len;
    if len > 0 {
        lex.current = source[0];
    }
    lex
}

fn lexer_at_end(lex: Lexer) -> bool {
    lex.pos >= lex.source_len
}

fn lexer_peek(lex: Lexer) -> i8 with Panic {
    if lex.pos + 1 < lex.source_len {
        lex.source[(lex.pos + 1) as usize]
    } else {
        0
    }
}

fn lexer_peek_n(lex: Lexer, n: i64) -> i8 with Panic {
    if lex.pos + n < lex.source_len {
        lex.source[(lex.pos + n) as usize]
    } else {
        0
    }
}

fn lexer_advance(lex: Lexer) -> Lexer with Mut, Panic {
    var new_lex = lex;
    if new_lex.pos < new_lex.source_len {
        if new_lex.current == 10 {
            new_lex.line = new_lex.line + 1;
            new_lex.column = 1;
        } else {
            new_lex.column = new_lex.column + 1;
        }
        new_lex.pos = new_lex.pos + 1;
        if new_lex.pos < new_lex.source_len {
            new_lex.current = new_lex.source[new_lex.pos as usize];
        } else {
            new_lex.current = 0;
        }
    }
    new_lex
}

fn lexer_advance_n(lex: Lexer, n: i64) -> Lexer with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var l = lex;
    var i: i64 = 0;
    while i < n {
        l = lexer_advance(l);
        i = i + 1;
    }
    l
}

// ============================================================================
// CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION
// ============================================================================

fn is_whitespace(c: i8) -> bool {
    c == 32 || c == 9 || c == 13 || c == 10
}

fn is_digit(c: i8) -> bool {
    c >= 48 && c <= 57
}

fn is_hex_digit(c: i8) -> bool {
    is_digit(c) || (c >= 97 && c <= 102) || (c >= 65 && c <= 70)
}

fn is_bin_digit(c: i8) -> bool {
    c == 48 || c == 49
}

fn is_oct_digit(c: i8) -> bool {
    c >= 48 && c <= 55
}

fn is_alpha(c: i8) -> bool {
    (c >= 65 && c <= 90) || (c >= 97 && c <= 122)
}

fn is_ident_start(c: i8) -> bool {
    is_alpha(c) || c == 95
}

fn is_ident_continue(c: i8) -> bool {
    is_alpha(c) || is_digit(c) || c == 95
}

// ============================================================================
// SCAN RESULT
// ============================================================================

struct ScanResult {
    lexer: Lexer,
    token: Token,
}

fn scan_result_new(lex: Lexer, tok: Token) -> ScanResult {
    ScanResult { lexer: lex, token: tok }
}

// ============================================================================
// WHITESPACE AND COMMENT HANDLING
// ============================================================================

fn skip_whitespace(lex: Lexer) -> Lexer with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var l = lex;
    while !lexer_at_end(l) && is_whitespace(l.current) {
        l = lexer_advance(l);
    }
    l
}

fn skip_line_comment(lex: Lexer) -> Lexer with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var l = lex;
    while !lexer_at_end(l) && l.current != 10 {
        l = lexer_advance(l);
    }
    l
}

fn skip_block_comment(lex: Lexer) -> Lexer with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var l = lexer_advance_n(lex, 2);
    var depth: i64 = 1;
    while !lexer_at_end(l) && depth > 0 {
        if l.current == 42 && lexer_peek(l) == 47 {
            l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2);
            depth = depth - 1;
        } else if l.current == 47 && lexer_peek(l) == 42 {
            l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2);
            depth = depth + 1;
        } else {
            l = lexer_advance(l);
        }
    }
    l
}

// ============================================================================
// KEYWORD LOOKUP (simplified - full version in keywords.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn lookup_keyword(text: [i8; 256], len: i64) -> i32 with Panic {
    // 2-char keywords
    if len == 2 {
        if text[0] == 102 && text[1] == 110 { return 14 }  // fn
        if text[0] == 105 && text[1] == 102 { return 24 }  // if
        if text[0] == 105 && text[1] == 110 { return 33 }  // in
        if text[0] == 97 && text[1] == 115 { return 34 }   // as
    }
    // 3-char keywords
    if len == 3 {
        if text[0] == 108 && text[1] == 101 && text[2] == 116 { return 15 }  // let
        if text[0] == 118 && text[1] == 97 && text[2] == 114 { return 16 }   // var
        if text[0] == 102 && text[1] == 111 && text[2] == 114 { return 27 }  // for
        if text[0] == 109 && text[1] == 117 && text[2] == 116 { return 17 }  // mut
        if text[0] == 117 && text[1] == 115 && text[2] == 101 { return 12 }  // use
        if text[0] == 112 && text[1] == 117 && text[2] == 98 { return 36 }   // pub
    }
    // 4-char keywords
    if len == 4 {
        if text[0] == 101 && text[1] == 108 && text[2] == 115 && text[3] == 101 { return 25 }  // else
        if text[0] == 108 && text[1] == 111 && text[2] == 111 && text[3] == 112 { return 29 }  // loop
        if text[0] == 116 && text[1] == 114 && text[2] == 117 && text[3] == 101 { return 39 }  // true
        if text[0] == 101 && text[1] == 110 && text[2] == 117 && text[3] == 109 { return 21 }  // enum
        if text[0] == 105 && text[1] == 109 && text[2] == 112 && text[3] == 108 { return 23 }  // impl
        if text[0] == 116 && text[1] == 121 && text[2] == 112 && text[3] == 101 { return 19 }  // type
        if text[0] == 83 && text[1] == 101 && text[2] == 108 && text[3] == 102 { return 38 }   // Self
        if text[0] == 115 && text[1] == 101 && text[2] == 108 && text[3] == 102 { return 37 }  // self
        if text[0] == 119 && text[1] == 105 && text[2] == 116 && text[3] == 104 { return 53 }  // with
    }
    // 5-char keywords
    if len == 5 {
        if text[0] == 119 && text[1] == 104 && text[2] == 105 && text[3] == 108 && text[4] == 101 { return 28 }  // while
        if text[0] == 98 && text[1] == 114 && text[2] == 101 && text[3] == 97 && text[4] == 107 { return 30 }   // break
        if text[0] == 102 && text[1] == 97 && text[2] == 108 && text[3] == 115 && text[4] == 101 { return 40 }  // false
        if text[0] == 116 && text[1] == 114 && text[2] == 97 && text[3] == 105 && text[4] == 116 { return 22 }  // trait
        if text[0] == 99 && text[1] == 111 && text[2] == 110 && text[3] == 115 && text[4] == 116 { return 18 }  // const
        if text[0] == 109 && text[1] == 97 && text[2] == 116 && text[3] == 99 && text[4] == 104 { return 26 }   // match
        if text[0] == 119 && text[1] == 104 && text[2] == 101 && text[3] == 114 && text[4] == 101 { return 35 } // where
    }
    // 6-char keywords
    if len == 6 {
        if text[0] == 114 && text[1] == 101 && text[2] == 116 && text[3] == 117 && text[4] == 114 && text[5] == 110 { return 32 }  // return
        if text[0] == 115 && text[1] == 116 && text[2] == 114 && text[3] == 117 && text[4] == 99 && text[5] == 116 { return 20 }   // struct
        if text[0] == 105 && text[1] == 109 && text[2] == 112 && text[3] == 111 && text[4] == 114 && text[5] == 116 { return 11 }  // import
        if text[0] == 109 && text[1] == 111 && text[2] == 100 && text[3] == 117 && text[4] == 108 && text[5] == 101 { return 10 }  // module
        if text[0] == 101 && text[1] == 120 && text[2] == 112 && text[3] == 111 && text[4] == 114 && text[5] == 116 { return 13 }  // export
        if text[0] == 107 && text[1] == 101 && text[2] == 114 && text[3] == 110 && text[4] == 101 && text[5] == 108 { return 70 }  // kernel
        if text[0] == 117 && text[1] == 110 && text[2] == 115 && text[3] == 97 && text[4] == 102 && text[5] == 101 { return 41 }   // unsafe
        if text[0] == 101 && text[1] == 120 && text[2] == 116 && text[3] == 101 && text[4] == 114 && text[5] == 110 { return 42 }  // extern
        if text[0] == 115 && text[1] == 116 && text[2] == 97 && text[3] == 116 && text[4] == 105 && text[5] == 99 { return 43 }    // static
    }
    // 8-char keywords
    if len == 8 {
        if text[0] == 99 && text[1] == 111 && text[2] == 110 && text[3] == 116 &&
           text[4] == 105 && text[5] == 110 && text[6] == 117 && text[7] == 101 { return 31 }  // continue
    }
    TK_IDENT()
}

// ============================================================================
// SCANNING FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

// Scan an identifier or keyword
fn scan_identifier(lex: Lexer) -> ScanResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let start = lex.pos;
    var l = lex;
    var tok = token_new();
    var text_len: i64 = 0;

    while !lexer_at_end(l) && is_ident_continue(l.current) && text_len < 255 {
        tok.text[text_len as usize] = l.current;
        text_len = text_len + 1;
        l = lexer_advance(l);
    }

    tok.text_len = text_len;
    tok.span = span_new(start, l.pos);

    // Check if it's a keyword
    tok.kind = lookup_keyword(tok.text, text_len);

    // Check for underscore-only identifier (special token)
    if text_len == 1 && tok.text[0] == 95 {
        tok.kind = TK_UNDERSCORE();
    }

    scan_result_new(l, tok)
}

// Scan a number literal (int, float, hex, bin, oct, with optional unit)
fn scan_number(lex: Lexer) -> ScanResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let start = lex.pos;
    var l = lex;
    var tok = token_new();
    var text_len: i64 = 0;
    var is_float = false;
    var is_hex = false;
    var is_bin = false;
    var is_oct = false;

    // Check for hex/bin/oct prefix
    if l.current == 48 {  // '0'
        let next = lexer_peek(l);
        if next == 120 || next == 88 {  // 'x' or 'X'
            is_hex = true;
            tok.text[0] = l.current;
            l = lexer_advance(l);
            tok.text[1] = l.current;
            l = lexer_advance(l);
            text_len = 2;
            while !lexer_at_end(l) && (is_hex_digit(l.current) || l.current == 95) && text_len < 255 {
                if l.current != 95 {
                    tok.text[text_len as usize] = l.current;
                    text_len = text_len + 1;
                }
                l = lexer_advance(l);
            }
            tok.text_len = text_len;
            tok.span = span_new(start, l.pos);
            tok.kind = TK_HEX_LIT();
            return scan_result_new(l, tok)
        }
        if next == 98 || next == 66 {  // 'b' or 'B'
            is_bin = true;
            tok.text[0] = l.current;
            l = lexer_advance(l);
            tok.text[1] = l.current;
            l = lexer_advance(l);
            text_len = 2;
            while !lexer_at_end(l) && (is_bin_digit(l.current) || l.current == 95) && text_len < 255 {
                if l.current != 95 {
                    tok.text[text_len as usize] = l.current;
                    text_len = text_len + 1;
                }
                l = lexer_advance(l);
            }
            tok.text_len = text_len;
            tok.span = span_new(start, l.pos);
            tok.kind = TK_BIN_LIT();
            return scan_result_new(l, tok)
        }
        if next == 111 || next == 79 {  // 'o' or 'O'
            is_oct = true;
            tok.text[0] = l.current;
            l = lexer_advance(l);
            tok.text[1] = l.current;
            l = lexer_advance(l);
            text_len = 2;
            while !lexer_at_end(l) && (is_oct_digit(l.current) || l.current == 95) && text_len < 255 {
                if l.current != 95 {
                    tok.text[text_len as usize] = l.current;
                    text_len = text_len + 1;
                }
                l = lexer_advance(l);
            }
            tok.text_len = text_len;
            tok.span = span_new(start, l.pos);
            tok.kind = TK_OCT_LIT();
            return scan_result_new(l, tok)
        }
    }

    // Decimal integer part
    while !lexer_at_end(l) && (is_digit(l.current) || l.current == 95) && text_len < 255 {
        if l.current != 95 {
            tok.text[text_len as usize] = l.current;
            text_len = text_len + 1;
        }
        l = lexer_advance(l);
    }

    // Check for decimal point
    if l.current == 46 && is_digit(lexer_peek(l)) {
        is_float = true;
        tok.text[text_len as usize] = 46;
        text_len = text_len + 1;
        l = lexer_advance(l);

        // Fractional part
        while !lexer_at_end(l) && (is_digit(l.current) || l.current == 95) && text_len < 255 {
            if l.current != 95 {
                tok.text[text_len as usize] = l.current;
                text_len = text_len + 1;
            }
            l = lexer_advance(l);
        }
    }

    // Check for exponent
    if l.current == 101 || l.current == 69 {  // 'e' or 'E'
        is_float = true;
        tok.text[text_len as usize] = l.current;
        text_len = text_len + 1;
        l = lexer_advance(l);

        // Optional sign
        if l.current == 43 || l.current == 45 {
            tok.text[text_len as usize] = l.current;
            text_len = text_len + 1;
            l = lexer_advance(l);
        }

        // Exponent digits
        while !lexer_at_end(l) && is_digit(l.current) && text_len < 255 {
            tok.text[text_len as usize] = l.current;
            text_len = text_len + 1;
            l = lexer_advance(l);
        }
    }

    // Check for unit suffix (e.g., 500_mg)
    if l.current == 95 && is_alpha(lexer_peek(l)) {
        l = lexer_advance(l);  // skip underscore
        while !lexer_at_end(l) && (is_ident_continue(l.current) || l.current == 47) && text_len < 255 {
            tok.text[text_len as usize] = l.current;
            text_len = text_len + 1;
            l = lexer_advance(l);
        }
        tok.text_len = text_len;
        tok.span = span_new(start, l.pos);
        if is_float {
            tok.kind = TK_FLOAT_UNIT_LIT();
        } else {
            tok.kind = TK_INT_UNIT_LIT();
        }
        return scan_result_new(l, tok)
    }

    tok.text_len = text_len;
    tok.span = span_new(start, l.pos);
    if is_float {
        tok.kind = TK_FLOAT_LIT();
    } else {
        tok.kind = TK_INT_LIT();
    }
    scan_result_new(l, tok)
}

// Scan a string literal
fn scan_string(lex: Lexer) -> ScanResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let start = lex.pos;
    let quote = lex.current;
    var l = lexer_advance(lex);  // skip opening quote
    var tok = token_new();
    var text_len: i64 = 0;

    while !lexer_at_end(l) && l.current != quote && text_len < 255 {
        if l.current == 92 {  // backslash - escape sequence
            l = lexer_advance(l);
            if !lexer_at_end(l) {
                let escaped = l.current;
                if escaped == 110 {  // \n
                    tok.text[text_len as usize] = 10;
                } else if escaped == 116 {  // \t
                    tok.text[text_len as usize] = 9;
                } else if escaped == 114 {  // \r
                    tok.text[text_len as usize] = 13;
                } else if escaped == 92 {  // \\
                    tok.text[text_len as usize] = 92;
                } else if escaped == 34 {  // \"
                    tok.text[text_len as usize] = 34;
                } else if escaped == 39 {  // \'
                    tok.text[text_len as usize] = 39;
                } else if escaped == 48 {  // \0
                    tok.text[text_len as usize] = 0;
                } else {
                    tok.text[text_len as usize] = escaped;
                }
                text_len = text_len + 1;
                l = lexer_advance(l);
            }
        } else {
            tok.text[text_len as usize] = l.current;
            text_len = text_len + 1;
            l = lexer_advance(l);
        }
    }

    if l.current == quote {
        l = lexer_advance(l);  // skip closing quote
    }

    tok.text_len = text_len;
    tok.span = span_new(start, l.pos);
    tok.kind = TK_STRING_LIT();
    scan_result_new(l, tok)
}

// Scan a character literal
fn scan_char(lex: Lexer) -> ScanResult with Mut, Panic {
    let start = lex.pos;
    var l = lexer_advance(lex);  // skip opening quote
    var tok = token_new();

    if l.current == 92 {  // backslash
        l = lexer_advance(l);
        if !lexer_at_end(l) {
            let escaped = l.current;
            if escaped == 110 { tok.text[0] = 10; }
            else if escaped == 116 { tok.text[0] = 9; }
            else if escaped == 114 { tok.text[0] = 13; }
            else if escaped == 92 { tok.text[0] = 92; }
            else if escaped == 39 { tok.text[0] = 39; }
            else if escaped == 48 { tok.text[0] = 0; }
            else { tok.text[0] = escaped; }
            l = lexer_advance(l);
        }
    } else {
        tok.text[0] = l.current;
        l = lexer_advance(l);
    }

    tok.text_len = 1;

    if l.current == 39 {  // closing quote
        l = lexer_advance(l);
    }

    tok.span = span_new(start, l.pos);
    tok.kind = TK_CHAR_LIT();
    scan_result_new(l, tok)
}

// Scan a doc comment (/// or //!)
fn scan_doc_comment(lex: Lexer, is_inner: bool) -> ScanResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let start = lex.pos;
    var l = lexer_advance_n(lex, 3);  // skip /// or //!
    var tok = token_new();
    var text_len: i64 = 0;

    while !lexer_at_end(l) && l.current != 10 && text_len < 255 {
        tok.text[text_len as usize] = l.current;
        text_len = text_len + 1;
        l = lexer_advance(l);
    }

    tok.text_len = text_len;
    tok.span = span_new(start, l.pos);
    if is_inner {
        tok.kind = TK_DOC_COMMENT_INNER();
    } else {
        tok.kind = TK_DOC_COMMENT_OUTER();
    }
    scan_result_new(l, tok)
}

// Scan a block doc comment (/** or /*!)
fn scan_doc_block(lex: Lexer, is_inner: bool) -> ScanResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let start = lex.pos;
    var l = lexer_advance_n(lex, 3);  // skip /** or /*!
    var tok = token_new();
    var text_len: i64 = 0;

    while !lexer_at_end(l) && text_len < 255 {
        if l.current == 42 && lexer_peek(l) == 47 {  // */
            l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2);
            break
        }
        tok.text[text_len as usize] = l.current;
        text_len = text_len + 1;
        l = lexer_advance(l);
    }

    tok.text_len = text_len;
    tok.span = span_new(start, l.pos);
    if is_inner {
        tok.kind = TK_DOC_BLOCK_INNER();
    } else {
        tok.kind = TK_DOC_BLOCK_OUTER();
    }
    scan_result_new(l, tok)
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN TOKENIZATION
// ============================================================================

// Get the next token from the lexer
fn next_token(lex: Lexer) -> ScanResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var l = skip_whitespace(lex);

    if lexer_at_end(l) {
        let tok = token_simple(TK_EOF(), l.pos, l.pos);
        return scan_result_new(l, tok)
    }

    let c = l.current;
    let start = l.pos;

    // Single-character tokens
    if c == 40 {  // (
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_LPAREN(), start, start + 1))
    }
    if c == 41 {  // )
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_RPAREN(), start, start + 1))
    }
    if c == 91 {  // [
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_LBRACKET(), start, start + 1))
    }
    if c == 93 {  // ]
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_RBRACKET(), start, start + 1))
    }
    if c == 123 {  // {
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_LBRACE(), start, start + 1))
    }
    if c == 125 {  // }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_RBRACE(), start, start + 1))
    }
    if c == 44 {  // ,
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_COMMA(), start, start + 1))
    }
    if c == 59 {  // ;
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_SEMI(), start, start + 1))
    }
    if c == 64 {  // @
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_AT(), start, start + 1))
    }
    if c == 35 {  // #
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_HASH(), start, start + 1))
    }
    if c == 36 {  // $
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_DOLLAR(), start, start + 1))
    }
    if c == 63 {  // ?
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_QUESTION(), start, start + 1))
    }
    if c == 126 {  // ~
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_TILDE(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // Colon and ::
    if c == 58 {  // :
        if lexer_peek(l) == 58 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_COLON_COLON(), start, start + 2))
        }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_COLON(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // Dot, .., ..., ..=
    if c == 46 {  // .
        let p1 = lexer_peek(l);
        if p1 == 46 {
            let p2 = lexer_peek_n(l, 2);
            if p2 == 46 {
                return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 3), token_simple(TK_DOT_DOT_DOT(), start, start + 3))
            }
            if p2 == 61 {
                return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 3), token_simple(TK_DOT_DOT_EQ(), start, start + 3))
            }
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_DOT_DOT(), start, start + 2))
        }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_DOT(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // Plus, ++, +=, +-
    if c == 43 {  // +
        let p = lexer_peek(l);
        if p == 43 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_PLUS_PLUS(), start, start + 2))
        }
        if p == 61 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_PLUS_EQ(), start, start + 2))
        }
        if p == 45 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_PLUS_MINUS(), start, start + 2))
        }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_PLUS(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // Minus, ->, -=
    if c == 45 {  // -
        let p = lexer_peek(l);
        if p == 62 {  // >
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_ARROW(), start, start + 2))
        }
        if p == 61 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_MINUS_EQ(), start, start + 2))
        }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_MINUS(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // Star, *=
    if c == 42 {  // *
        if lexer_peek(l) == 61 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_STAR_EQ(), start, start + 2))
        }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_STAR(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // Slash, /=, comments
    if c == 47 {  // /
        let p = lexer_peek(l);
        if p == 47 {  // //
            let p2 = lexer_peek_n(l, 2);
            if p2 == 47 {  // ///
                return scan_doc_comment(l, false)
            }
            if p2 == 33 {  // //!
                return scan_doc_comment(l, true)
            }
            // Regular line comment - skip and get next token
            l = skip_line_comment(lexer_advance_n(l, 2));
            return next_token(l)
        }
        if p == 42 {  // /*
            let p2 = lexer_peek_n(l, 2);
            if p2 == 42 {  // /**
                return scan_doc_block(l, false)
            }
            if p2 == 33 {  // /*!
                return scan_doc_block(l, true)
            }
            // Regular block comment - skip and get next token
            l = skip_block_comment(l);
            return next_token(l)
        }
        if p == 61 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_SLASH_EQ(), start, start + 2))
        }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_SLASH(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // Percent, %=
    if c == 37 {  // %
        if lexer_peek(l) == 61 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_PERCENT_EQ(), start, start + 2))
        }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_PERCENT(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // Caret, ^=
    if c == 94 {  // ^
        if lexer_peek(l) == 61 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_CARET_EQ(), start, start + 2))
        }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_CARET(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // Ampersand, &&, &=
    if c == 38 {  // &
        let p = lexer_peek(l);
        if p == 38 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_AMP_AMP(), start, start + 2))
        }
        if p == 61 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_AMP_EQ(), start, start + 2))
        }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_AMP(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // Pipe, ||, |=
    if c == 124 {  // |
        let p = lexer_peek(l);
        if p == 124 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_PIPE_PIPE(), start, start + 2))
        }
        if p == 61 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_PIPE_EQ(), start, start + 2))
        }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_PIPE(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // Bang, !=
    if c == 33 {  // !
        if lexer_peek(l) == 61 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_NE(), start, start + 2))
        }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_BANG(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // Equals, ==, =>
    if c == 61 {  // =
        let p = lexer_peek(l);
        if p == 61 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_EQ_EQ(), start, start + 2))
        }
        if p == 62 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_FAT_ARROW(), start, start + 2))
        }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_EQ(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // Less than, <=, <<, <<=, <-
    if c == 60 {  // <
        let p = lexer_peek(l);
        if p == 61 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_LE(), start, start + 2))
        }
        if p == 60 {
            if lexer_peek_n(l, 2) == 61 {
                return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 3), token_simple(TK_SHL_EQ(), start, start + 3))
            }
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_SHL(), start, start + 2))
        }
        if p == 45 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_LEFT_ARROW(), start, start + 2))
        }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_LT(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // Greater than, >=, >>, >>=
    if c == 62 {  // >
        let p = lexer_peek(l);
        if p == 61 {
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_GE(), start, start + 2))
        }
        if p == 62 {
            if lexer_peek_n(l, 2) == 61 {
                return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 3), token_simple(TK_SHR_EQ(), start, start + 3))
            }
            return scan_result_new(lexer_advance_n(l, 2), token_simple(TK_SHR(), start, start + 2))
        }
        return scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), token_simple(TK_GT(), start, start + 1))
    }

    // String literal
    if c == 34 {  // "
        return scan_string(l)
    }

    // Character literal
    if c == 39 {  // '
        return scan_char(l)
    }

    // Number literal
    if is_digit(c) {
        return scan_number(l)
    }

    // Identifier or keyword
    if is_ident_start(c) {
        return scan_identifier(l)
    }

    // Unknown character - error token
    let tok = token_simple(TK_ERROR(), start, start + 1);
    scan_result_new(lexer_advance(l), tok)
}

// ============================================================================
// TOKEN STREAM
// ============================================================================

// Token stream for parser consumption
struct TokenStream {
    tokens: [Token; 16384],
    n_tokens: i64,
    pos: i64,
}

fn token_stream_new() -> TokenStream {
    TokenStream {
        tokens: [token_new(); 16384],
        n_tokens: 0,
        pos: 0,
    }
}

// Tokenize source code into a token stream
fn tokenize(source: [i8; 1048576], source_len: i64) -> TokenStream with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var stream = token_stream_new();
    var lex = lexer_init(source, source_len);

    while stream.n_tokens < 16384 {
        let result = next_token(lex);
        lex = result.lexer;
        let tok = result.token;

        stream.tokens[stream.n_tokens as usize] = tok;
        stream.n_tokens = stream.n_tokens + 1;

        if tok.kind == TK_EOF() || tok.kind == TK_ERROR() {
            break
        }
    }

    stream
}

// Get current token from stream
fn stream_current(stream: TokenStream) -> Token with Panic {
    if stream.pos < stream.n_tokens {
        stream.tokens[stream.pos as usize]
    } else {
        token_simple(TK_EOF(), 0, 0)
    }
}

// Advance stream position
fn stream_advance(stream: TokenStream) -> TokenStream with Mut {
    var s = stream;
    if s.pos < s.n_tokens {
        s.pos = s.pos + 1;
    }
    s
}

// Check if current token matches kind
fn stream_check(stream: TokenStream, kind: i32) -> bool with Panic {
    stream.pos < stream.n_tokens && stream.tokens[stream.pos as usize].kind == kind
}

// Peek at token n positions ahead
fn stream_peek(stream: TokenStream, n: i64) -> Token with Panic {
    let idx = stream.pos + n;
    if idx < stream.n_tokens {
        stream.tokens[idx as usize]
    } else {
        token_simple(TK_EOF(), 0, 0)
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// TESTS
// ============================================================================

fn test_lexer_simple() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var source: [i8; 1048576] = [0; 1048576];
    // "fn main() { }"
    source[0] = 102; source[1] = 110;  // fn
    source[2] = 32;   // space
    source[3] = 109; source[4] = 97; source[5] = 105; source[6] = 110;  // main
    source[7] = 40;   // (
    source[8] = 41;   // )
    source[9] = 32;   // space
    source[10] = 123; // {
    source[11] = 32;  // space
    source[12] = 125; // }

    let stream = tokenize(source, 13);

    // Should have: fn, main, (, ), {, }, EOF
    if stream.n_tokens != 7 { return false }
    if stream.tokens[0].kind != 14 { return false }  // TK_FN
    if stream.tokens[1].kind != TK_IDENT() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[2].kind != TK_LPAREN() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[3].kind != TK_RPAREN() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[4].kind != TK_LBRACE() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[5].kind != TK_RBRACE() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[6].kind != TK_EOF() { return false }

    true
}

fn test_lexer_numbers() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var source: [i8; 1048576] = [0; 1048576];
    // "42 3.14 0xFF 0b101"
    source[0] = 52; source[1] = 50;  // 42
    source[2] = 32;  // space
    source[3] = 51; source[4] = 46; source[5] = 49; source[6] = 52;  // 3.14
    source[7] = 32;  // space
    source[8] = 48; source[9] = 120; source[10] = 70; source[11] = 70;  // 0xFF
    source[12] = 32;  // space
    source[13] = 48; source[14] = 98; source[15] = 49; source[16] = 48; source[17] = 49;  // 0b101

    let stream = tokenize(source, 18);

    if stream.n_tokens < 5 { return false }
    if stream.tokens[0].kind != TK_INT_LIT() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[1].kind != TK_FLOAT_LIT() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[2].kind != TK_HEX_LIT() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[3].kind != TK_BIN_LIT() { return false }

    true
}

fn test_lexer_operators() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var source: [i8; 1048576] = [0; 1048576];
    // "+ - * / == != <= >= && || -> =>"
    source[0] = 43;   // +
    source[1] = 32;   // space
    source[2] = 45;   // -
    source[3] = 32;   // space
    source[4] = 42;   // *
    source[5] = 32;   // space
    source[6] = 47;   // /
    source[7] = 32;   // space
    source[8] = 61; source[9] = 61;   // ==
    source[10] = 32;  // space
    source[11] = 33; source[12] = 61; // !=
    source[13] = 32;  // space
    source[14] = 60; source[15] = 61; // <=
    source[16] = 32;  // space
    source[17] = 62; source[18] = 61; // >=
    source[19] = 32;  // space
    source[20] = 38; source[21] = 38; // &&
    source[22] = 32;  // space
    source[23] = 124; source[24] = 124; // ||
    source[25] = 32;  // space
    source[26] = 45; source[27] = 62; // ->
    source[28] = 32;  // space
    source[29] = 61; source[30] = 62; // =>

    let stream = tokenize(source, 31);

    if stream.n_tokens < 13 { return false }
    if stream.tokens[0].kind != TK_PLUS() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[1].kind != TK_MINUS() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[2].kind != TK_STAR() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[3].kind != TK_SLASH() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[4].kind != TK_EQ_EQ() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[5].kind != TK_NE() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[6].kind != TK_LE() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[7].kind != TK_GE() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[8].kind != TK_AMP_AMP() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[9].kind != TK_PIPE_PIPE() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[10].kind != TK_ARROW() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[11].kind != TK_FAT_ARROW() { return false }

    true
}

fn test_lexer_keywords() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var source: [i8; 1048576] = [0; 1048576];
    // "let var if else while for return struct"
    // l e t   v a r   i f   e l s e   w h i l e   f o r   r e t u r n   s t r u c t
    source[0] = 108; source[1] = 101; source[2] = 116;  // let
    source[3] = 32;
    source[4] = 118; source[5] = 97; source[6] = 114;   // var
    source[7] = 32;
    source[8] = 105; source[9] = 102;  // if
    source[10] = 32;
    source[11] = 101; source[12] = 108; source[13] = 115; source[14] = 101;  // else
    source[15] = 32;
    source[16] = 119; source[17] = 104; source[18] = 105; source[19] = 108; source[20] = 101;  // while
    source[21] = 32;
    source[22] = 102; source[23] = 111; source[24] = 114;  // for
    source[25] = 32;
    source[26] = 114; source[27] = 101; source[28] = 116; source[29] = 117; source[30] = 114; source[31] = 110;  // return
    source[32] = 32;
    source[33] = 115; source[34] = 116; source[35] = 114; source[36] = 117; source[37] = 99; source[38] = 116;  // struct

    let stream = tokenize(source, 39);

    if stream.n_tokens < 9 { return false }
    if stream.tokens[0].kind != 15 { return false }  // TK_LET
    if stream.tokens[1].kind != 16 { return false }  // TK_VAR
    if stream.tokens[2].kind != 24 { return false }  // TK_IF
    if stream.tokens[3].kind != 25 { return false }  // TK_ELSE
    if stream.tokens[4].kind != 28 { return false }  // TK_WHILE
    if stream.tokens[5].kind != 27 { return false }  // TK_FOR
    if stream.tokens[6].kind != 32 { return false }  // TK_RETURN
    if stream.tokens[7].kind != 20 { return false }  // TK_STRUCT

    true
}

fn test_lexer_comments() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var source: [i8; 1048576] = [0; 1048576];
    // "x // comment\ny"
    source[0] = 120;  // x
    source[1] = 32;   // space
    source[2] = 47; source[3] = 47;  // //
    source[4] = 32;   // space
    source[5] = 99; source[6] = 111; source[7] = 109; source[8] = 109; source[9] = 101; source[10] = 110; source[11] = 116;  // comment
    source[12] = 10;  // newline
    source[13] = 121; // y

    let stream = tokenize(source, 14);

    // Should have: x, y, EOF (comment skipped)
    if stream.n_tokens != 3 { return false }
    if stream.tokens[0].kind != TK_IDENT() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[1].kind != TK_IDENT() { return false }
    if stream.tokens[2].kind != TK_EOF() { return false }

    true
}


// === FILE: stdlib/compiler/lexer/scanner.sio ===
// compiler::lexer::scanner — Character scanning and lexer state
//
// This module provides the core scanning functionality for the Sounio lexer.
// It handles character-by-character traversal of source code.

// ============================================================================
// LEXER STATE
// ============================================================================

// Lexer state for scanning source code
struct Lexer {
    // Source code as byte array (max 1MB)
    source: [i8; 1048576],
    source_len: i64,
    // Current position in source
    pos: i64,
    // Line and column tracking for error messages
    line: i64,
    column: i64,
    // Current character (0 if at end)
    current: i8,
}

fn lexer_new() -> Lexer {
    Lexer {
        source: [0; 1048576],
        source_len: 0,
        pos: 0,
        line: 1,
        column: 1,
        current: 0,
    }
}

// Initialize lexer with source code
fn lexer_init(source: [i8; 1048576], len: i64) -> Lexer with Mut, Panic {
    var lex = lexer_new();
    lex.source = source;
    lex.source_len = len;
    if len > 0 {
        lex.current = source[0];
    }
    lex
}

// Check if lexer is at end of source
fn lexer_at_end(lex: Lexer) -> bool {
    lex.pos >= lex.source_len
}

// Peek at next character without advancing
fn lexer_peek(lex: Lexer) -> i8 with Panic {
    if lex.pos + 1 < lex.source_len {
        lex.source[(lex.pos + 1) as usize]
    } else {
        0
    }
}

// Peek at character n positions ahead
fn lexer_peek_n(lex: Lexer, n: i64) -> i8 with Panic {
    if lex.pos + n < lex.source_len {
        lex.source[(lex.pos + n) as usize]
    } else {
        0
    }
}

// Advance lexer by one character, returning new state
fn lexer_advance(lex: Lexer) -> Lexer with Mut, Panic {
    var new_lex = lex;
    if new_lex.pos < new_lex.source_len {
        // Track newlines for line/column
        if new_lex.current == 10 {  // '\n'
            new_lex.line = new_lex.line + 1;
            new_lex.column = 1;
        } else {
            new_lex.column = new_lex.column + 1;
        }
        new_lex.pos = new_lex.pos + 1;
        if new_lex.pos < new_lex.source_len {
            new_lex.current = new_lex.source[new_lex.pos as usize];
        } else {
            new_lex.current = 0;
        }
    }
    new_lex
}

// Advance lexer by n characters
fn lexer_advance_n(lex: Lexer, n: i64) -> Lexer with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var l = lex;
    var i: i64 = 0;
    while i < n {
        l = lexer_advance(l);
        i = i + 1;
    }
    l
}

// ============================================================================
// CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION
// ============================================================================

// Check if character is whitespace (space, tab, CR, LF)
fn is_whitespace(c: i8) -> bool {
    c == 32 || c == 9 || c == 13 || c == 10
}

// Check if character is a digit (0-9)
fn is_digit(c: i8) -> bool {
    c >= 48 && c <= 57
}

// Check if character is a hex digit (0-9, a-f, A-F)
fn is_hex_digit(c: i8) -> bool {
    is_digit(c) || (c >= 97 && c <= 102) || (c >= 65 && c <= 70)
}

// Check if character is a binary digit (0-1)
fn is_bin_digit(c: i8) -> bool {
    c == 48 || c == 49
}

// Check if character is an octal digit (0-7)
fn is_oct_digit(c: i8) -> bool {
    c >= 48 && c <= 55
}

// Check if character is alphabetic (a-z, A-Z)
fn is_alpha(c: i8) -> bool {
    (c >= 65 && c <= 90) || (c >= 97 && c <= 122)
}

// Check if character can start an identifier (a-z, A-Z, _)
fn is_ident_start(c: i8) -> bool {
    is_alpha(c) || c == 95
}

// Check if character can continue an identifier (a-z, A-Z, 0-9, _)
fn is_ident_continue(c: i8) -> bool {
    is_alpha(c) || is_digit(c) || c == 95
}

// ============================================================================
// WHITESPACE AND COMMENT HANDLING
// ============================================================================

// Skip whitespace characters (but not newlines for line tracking)
fn skip_whitespace(lex: Lexer) -> Lexer with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var l = lex;
    while !lexer_at_end(l) && is_whitespace(l.current) {
        l = lexer_advance(l);
    }
    l
}

// Skip a line comment (// ...)
fn skip_line_comment(lex: Lexer) -> Lexer with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var l = lex;
    while !lexer_at_end(l) && l.current != 10 {  // until newline
        l = lexer_advance(l);
    }
    l
}

// Skip a block comment (/* ... */)
// Returns the lexer positioned after the closing */
fn skip_block_comment(lex: Lexer) -> Lexer with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var l = lexer_advance_n(lex, 2);  // skip /*
    var depth: i64 = 1;
    while !lexer_at_end(l) && depth > 0 {
        if l.current == 42 && lexer_peek(l) == 47 {  // */
            l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2);
            depth = depth - 1;
        } else if l.current == 47 && lexer_peek(l) == 42 {  // /* (nested)
            l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2);
            depth = depth + 1;
        } else {
            l = lexer_advance(l);
        }
    }
    l
}

// ============================================================================
// SCAN RESULT - Tuple replacement for returning lexer + token
// ============================================================================

struct ScanResult {
    lexer: Lexer,
    kind: i32,
    start: i64,
    end: i64,
    // For identifiers/strings, store the text
    text: [i8; 256],
    text_len: i64,
}

fn scan_result_new(lex: Lexer, kind: i32, start: i64, end: i64) -> ScanResult {
    ScanResult {
        lexer: lex,
        kind: kind,
        start: start,
        end: end,
        text: [0; 256],
        text_len: 0,
    }
}

fn scan_result_with_text(lex: Lexer, kind: i32, start: i64, end: i64, text: [i8; 256], text_len: i64) -> ScanResult {
    ScanResult {
        lexer: lex,
        kind: kind,
        start: start,
        end: end,
        text: text,
        text_len: text_len,
    }
}

// Match keyword text and return token kind or TOKEN_IDENT
fn keyword_lookup(text: [i8; 256], len: i64) -> i32 {
    // Length 2 keywords
    if len == 2 {
        if text[0] == 105 && text[1] == 102 { return TOKEN_IF }      // "if"
        if text[0] == 105 && text[1] == 110 { return TOKEN_IN }      // "in"
        if text[0] == 97 && text[1] == 115 { return TOKEN_AS }       // "as"
        if text[0] == 102 && text[1] == 110 { return TOKEN_FN }      // "fn"
    }
    // Length 3 keywords
    if len == 3 {
        if text[0] == 108 && text[1] == 101 && text[2] == 116 { return TOKEN_LET }     // "let"
        if text[0] == 118 && text[1] == 97 && text[2] == 114 { return TOKEN_VAR }      // "var"
        if text[0] == 109 && text[1] == 117 && text[2] == 116 { return TOKEN_MUT }     // "mut"

        if text[0] == 97 && text[1] == 115 && text[2] == 115 && text[3] == 101 && text[4] == 114 && text[5] == 116 { return TOKEN_ASSERT }  // "assert"
        if text[0] == 97 && text[1] == 115 && text[2] == 115 && text[3] == 117 && text[4] == 109 && text[5] == 101 { return TOKEN_ASSUME }  // "assume"
        if text[0] == 117 && text[1] == 110 && text[2] == 115 && text[3] == 97 && text[4] == 102 && text[5] == 101 { return TOKEN_UNSAFE }  // "unsafe"
        if text[0] == 101 && text[1] == 120 && text[2] == 116 && text[3] == 101 && text[4] == 114 && text[5] == 110 { return TOKEN_EXTERN }  // "extern"
        if text[0] == 115 && text[1] == 116 && text[2] == 97 && text[3] == 116 && text[4] == 105 && text[5] == 99 { return TOKEN_STATIC }  // "static"
        if text[0] == 102 && text[1] == 111 && text[2] == 114 && text[3] == 97 && text[4] == 108 && text[5] == 108 { return TOKEN_FORALL }  // "forall"
        if text[0] == 114 && text[1] == 101 && text[2] == 115 && text[3] == 117 && text[4] == 109 && text[5] == 101 { return TOKEN_RESUME }  // "resume"
    }
    // Length 7 keywords
    if len == 7 {
        if text[0] == 104 && text[1] == 97 && text[2] == 110 && text[3] == 100 && text[4] == 108 && text[5] == 101 && text[6] == 114 { return TOKEN_HANDLER }  // "handler"
        if text[0] == 112 && text[1] == 101 && text[2] == 114 && text[3] == 102 && text[4] == 111 && text[5] == 114 && text[6] == 109 { return TOKEN_PERFORM }  // "perform"
        if text[0] == 111 && text[1] == 98 && text[2] == 115 && text[3] == 101 && text[4] == 114 && text[5] == 118 && text[6] == 101 { return TOKEN_OBSERVE }  // "observe"
        if text[0] == 101 && text[1] == 110 && text[2] == 115 && text[3] == 117 && text[4] == 114 && text[5] == 101 && text[6] == 115 { return TOKEN_ENSURES }  // "ensures"
    }
    // Length 8 keywords
    if len == 8 {
        if text[0] == 114 && text[1] == 101 && text[2] == 108 && text[3] == 101 && text[4] == 118 && text[5] == 97 && text[6] == 110 && text[7] == 116 { return TOKEN_RELEVANT }  // "relevant"
        if text[0] == 114 && text[1] == 101 && text[2] == 113 && text[3] == 117 && text[4] == 105 && text[5] == 114 && text[6] == 101 && text[7] == 115 { return TOKEN_REQUIRES }  // "requires"
        if text[0] == 99 && text[1] == 111 && text[2] == 110 && text[3] == 116 && text[4] == 105 && text[5] == 110 && text[6] == 117 && text[7] == 101 { return TOKEN_CONTINUE }  // "continue"
    }
    // Length 9 keywords
    if len == 9 {
        if text[0] == 105 && text[1] == 110 && text[2] == 118 && text[3] == 97 && text[4] == 114 && text[5] == 105 && text[6] == 97 && text[7] == 110 && text[8] == 116 { return TOKEN_INVARIANT }  // "invariant"
    }

    TOKEN_IDENT
}

// ============================================================================
// IDENTIFIER AND KEYWORD SCANNING
// ============================================================================

fn scan_identifier(lex: Lexer) -> ScanResult with Mut, Panic {
    var l = lex
    let start = l.pos
    var text: [i8; 256] = [0; 256]
    var text_idx: i64 = 0

    // Collect identifier characters
    while !lexer_at_end(l) && is_ident_continue(l.current) && text_idx < 256 {
        text[text_idx] = l.current
        text_idx = text_idx + 1
        l = lexer_advance(l)
    }

    let end = l.pos

    // Try keyword lookup
    let kind = keyword_lookup(text, text_idx)

    scan_result_with_text(l, kind, start, end, text, text_idx)
}

// ============================================================================
// INTEGER SCANNING
// ============================================================================

fn scan_integer_digits(lex: Lexer) -> Lexer with Mut, Panic {
    var l = lex
    while !lexer_at_end(l) && is_digit(l.current) {
        l = lexer_advance(l)
    }
    l
}

fn scan_integer(lex: Lexer) -> ScanResult with Mut, Panic {
    var l = lex
    let start = l.pos
    var kind = TOKEN_INT_LIT

    // Check for hex, binary, octal
    if l.current == 48 {  // '0'
        if lexer_peek(l) == 120 {  // 'x'
            l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
            while !lexer_at_end(l) && is_hex_digit(l.current) {
                l = lexer_advance(l)
            }
            kind = TOKEN_HEX_LIT
        } else if lexer_peek(l) == 98 {  // 'b'
            l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
            while !lexer_at_end(l) && is_bin_digit(l.current) {
                l = lexer_advance(l)
            }
            kind = TOKEN_BIN_LIT
        } else if lexer_peek(l) == 111 {  // 'o'
            l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
            while !lexer_at_end(l) && is_oct_digit(l.current) {
                l = lexer_advance(l)
            }
            kind = TOKEN_OCT_LIT
        } else {
            l = scan_integer_digits(l)
        }
    } else {
        l = scan_integer_digits(l)
    }

    let end = l.pos
    scan_result_new(l, kind, start, end)
}

// ============================================================================
// FLOAT SCANNING
// ============================================================================

fn scan_float_after_dot(lex: Lexer) -> ScanResult with Mut, Panic {
    var l = lex
    let start = l.pos

    // Skip digits before decimal
    while !lexer_at_end(l) && is_digit(l.current) {
        l = lexer_advance(l)
    }

    // Decimal point
    if !lexer_at_end(l) && l.current == 46 {  // '.'
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        while !lexer_at_end(l) && is_digit(l.current) {
            l = lexer_advance(l)
        }
    }

    // Exponent (e or E)
    if !lexer_at_end(l) && (l.current == 101 || l.current == 69) {  // 'e' or 'E'
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        if !lexer_at_end(l) && (l.current == 43 || l.current == 45) {  // '+' or '-'
            l = lexer_advance(l)
        }
        while !lexer_at_end(l) && is_digit(l.current) {
            l = lexer_advance(l)
        }
    }

    let end = l.pos
    scan_result_new(l, TOKEN_FLOAT_LIT, start, end)
}

// ============================================================================
// STRING SCANNING
// ============================================================================

fn scan_string(lex: Lexer) -> ScanResult with Mut, Panic {
    var l = lex
    let start = l.pos
    var text: [i8; 256] = [0; 256]
    var text_idx: i64 = 0

    l = lexer_advance(l)  // skip opening quote

    while !lexer_at_end(l) && l.current != 34 && text_idx < 256 {  // '"'
        if l.current == 92 {  // backslash
            text[text_idx] = l.current
            text_idx = text_idx + 1
            l = lexer_advance(l)
            if !lexer_at_end(l) {
                text[text_idx] = l.current
                text_idx = text_idx + 1
                l = lexer_advance(l)
            }
        } else {
            text[text_idx] = l.current
            text_idx = text_idx + 1
            l = lexer_advance(l)
        }
    }

    if !lexer_at_end(l) {
        l = lexer_advance(l)  // skip closing quote
    }

    let end = l.pos
    scan_result_with_text(l, TOKEN_STRING_LIT, start, end, text, text_idx)
}

// ============================================================================
// OPERATOR SCANNING (Longest Match)
// ============================================================================

fn scan_operator(lex: Lexer) -> ScanResult with Mut, Panic {
    var l = lex
    let start = l.pos
    var kind = 0i32

    let c = l.current
    let c2 = lexer_peek(l)
    let c3 = lexer_peek_n(l, 2)

    // Three-character operators (highest priority)
    if c == 46 && c2 == 46 && c3 == 46 {  // "..."
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 3)
        kind = TOKEN_DOT_DOT_DOT
    } else if c == 60 && c2 == 60 && c3 == 61 {  // "<<="
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 3)
        kind = TOKEN_SHL_EQ
    } else if c == 62 && c2 == 62 && c3 == 61 {  // ">>="
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 3)
        kind = TOKEN_SHR_EQ
    }
    // Two-character operators
    else if c == 61 && c2 == 61 {  // "=="
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_EQ_EQ
    } else if c == 33 && c2 == 61 {  // "!="
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_NE
    } else if c == 60 && c2 == 61 {  // "<="
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_LE
    } else if c == 62 && c2 == 61 {  // ">="
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_GE
    } else if c == 38 && c2 == 38 {  // "&&"
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_AMP_AMP
    } else if c == 124 && c2 == 124 {  // "||"
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_PIPE_PIPE
    } else if c == 43 && c2 == 43 {  // "++"
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_PLUS_PLUS
    } else if c == 43 && c2 == 61 {  // "+="
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_PLUS_EQ
    } else if c == 45 && c2 == 61 {  // "-="
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_MINUS_EQ
    } else if c == 45 && c2 == 62 {  // "->"
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_ARROW
    } else if c == 61 && c2 == 62 {  // "=>"
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_FAT_ARROW
    } else if c == 60 && c2 == 45 {  // "<-"
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_LEFT_ARROW
    } else if c == 60 && c2 == 60 {  // "<<"
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_SHL
    } else if c == 62 && c2 == 62 {  // ">>"
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_SHR
    } else if c == 38 && c2 == 33 {  // "&!"
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_AMP_BANG
    } else if c == 58 && c2 == 58 {  // "::"
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_COLON_COLON
    } else if c == 46 && c2 == 46 {  // ".."
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_DOT_DOT
    } else if c == 43 && c2 == 45 {  // "+-"
        l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
        kind = TOKEN_PLUS_EQ  // Reusing as placeholder
    }
    // Single-character operators
    else if c == 43 {  // "+"
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        kind = TOKEN_PLUS
    } else if c == 45 {  // "-"
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        kind = TOKEN_MINUS
    } else if c == 42 {  // "*"
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        kind = TOKEN_STAR
    } else if c == 47 {  // "/"
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        kind = TOKEN_SLASH
    } else if c == 37 {  // "%"
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        kind = TOKEN_PERCENT
    } else if c == 94 {  // "^"
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        kind = TOKEN_CARET
    } else if c == 38 {  // "&"
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        kind = TOKEN_AMP
    } else if c == 124 {  // "|"
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        kind = TOKEN_PIPE
    } else if c == 126 {  // "~"
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        kind = TOKEN_TILDE
    } else if c == 33 {  // "!"
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        kind = TOKEN_BANG
    } else if c == 61 {  // "="
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        kind = TOKEN_EQ
    } else if c == 60 {  // "<"
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        kind = TOKEN_LT
    } else if c == 62 {  // ">"
        l = lexer_advance(l)
        kind = TOKEN_GT
    }

    let end = l.pos
    scan_result_new(l, kind, start, end)
}

// ============================================================================
// CHARACTER LITERAL SCANNING
// ============================================================================

fn scan_char_literal(lex: Lexer) -> ScanResult with Mut, Panic {
    var l = lex
    let start = l.pos

    l = lexer_advance(l)  // skip opening quote

    // Handle escape sequences
    if !lexer_at_end(l) && l.current == 92 {  // backslash
        l = lexer_advance(l)  // skip backslash
        if !lexer_at_end(l) {
            l = lexer_advance(l)  // skip escaped char
        }
    } else if !lexer_at_end(l) {
        l = lexer_advance(l)  // regular char
    }

    if !lexer_at_end(l) && l.current == 39 {  // closing quote
        l = lexer_advance(l)
    }

    let end = l.pos
    scan_result_new(l, TOKEN_CHAR_LIT, start, end)
}

// ============================================================================
// DOC COMMENT SCANNING
// ============================================================================

fn scan_doc_comment_line(lex: Lexer) -> ScanResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var l = lex
    let start = l.pos
    var text: [i8; 256] = [0; 256]
    var text_idx: i64 = 0
    var kind = TOKEN_DOC_COMMENT_OUTER

    // Skip ///
    l = lexer_advance_n(l, 3)

    // Check for inner comment //!
    if l.pos > start + 2 && lex.source[start + 2] == 33 {  // '!'
        kind = TOKEN_DOC_COMMENT_INNER
    }

    // Collect comment text until newline
    while !lexer_at_end(l) && l.current != 10 && text_idx < 256 {  // '\n'
        text[text_idx] = l.current
        text_idx = text_idx + 1
        l = lexer_advance(l)
    }

    let end = l.pos
    scan_result_with_text(l, kind, start, end, text, text_idx)
}

fn scan_doc_comment_block(lex: Lexer) -> ScanResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var l = lex
    let start = l.pos
    var text: [i8; 256] = [0; 256]
    var text_idx: i64 = 0
    var kind = TOKEN_DOC_BLOCK_OUTER

    // Skip /**
    l = lexer_advance_n(l, 3)

    // Check for inner comment /*!
    if l.pos > start + 2 && lex.source[start + 2] == 33 {  // '!'
        kind = TOKEN_DOC_BLOCK_INNER
    }

    // Collect until */
    while !lexer_at_end(l) && text_idx < 256 {
        if l.current == 42 && lexer_peek(l) == 47 {  // */
            l = lexer_advance_n(l, 2)
            break
        }
        text[text_idx] = l.current
        text_idx = text_idx + 1
        l = lexer_advance(l)
    }

    let end = l.pos
    scan_result_with_text(l, kind, start, end, text, text_idx)
}

// ============================================================================
// DELIMITER SCANNING
// ============================================================================

fn scan_delimiter(lex: Lexer) -> ScanResult with Mut, Panic {
    var l = lex
    let start = l.pos
    var kind = 0i32

    let c = l.current

    if c == 40 {  // "("
        kind = TOKEN_LPAREN
    } else if c == 41 {  // ")"
        kind = TOKEN_RPAREN
    } else if c == 91 {  // "["
        kind = TOKEN_LBRACKET
    } else if c == 93 {  // "]"
        kind = TOKEN_RBRACKET
    } else if c == 123 {  // "{"
        kind = TOKEN_LBRACE
    } else if c == 125 {  // "}"
        kind = TOKEN_RBRACE
    } else if c == 44 {  // ","
        kind = TOKEN_COMMA
    } else if c == 59 {  // ";"
        kind = TOKEN_SEMI
    } else if c == 58 {  // ":"
        kind = TOKEN_COLON
    } else if c == 46 {  // "."
        kind = TOKEN_DOT
    } else if c == 64 {  // "@"
        kind = TOKEN_AT
    } else if c == 35 {  // "#"
        kind = TOKEN_HASH
    } else if c == 36 {  // "$"
        kind = TOKEN_DOLLAR
    } else if c == 63 {  // "?"
        kind = TOKEN_QUESTION
    }

    if kind != 0i32 {
        l = lexer_advance(l)
    }

    let end = l.pos
    scan_result_new(l, kind, start, end)
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN LEXER ENTRY POINT (STUB)
// ============================================================================

// Note: Full implementation of lex() would dispatch to all scanning functions
// This is a placeholder showing the overall structure

// Main lexer dispatcher - tokenizes source code
// Returns total number of tokens produced
fn lex(source: [i8; 1048576], len: i64) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    var lex = lexer_init(source, len)
    var token_count = 0i32

    // Main tokenization loop
    while !lexer_at_end(lex) {
        let c = lex.current

        // Skip whitespace (space, tab, newline, carriage return)
        if c == 32 || c == 9 || c == 10 || c == 13 {
            lex = lexer_advance(lex)
            continue
        }

        // Line comment: //
        if c == 47 && lexer_peek(lex) == 47 {
            lex = skip_line_comment(lex)
            continue
        }

        // Block comment: /* (may be nested)
        if c == 47 && lexer_peek(lex) == 42 {
            let result = skip_block_comment(lex)
            lex = result
            continue
        }

        // Doc comment: /// or //!
        if c == 47 && lexer_peek(lex) == 47 {
            if lexer_peek_n(lex, 2) == 47 || lexer_peek_n(lex, 2) == 33 {
                let result = scan_doc_comment_line(lex)
                lex = result.lexer
                token_count = token_count + 1
                continue
            }
        }

        // Block doc comment: /** or /*!
        if c == 47 && lexer_peek(lex) == 42 {
            if lexer_peek_n(lex, 2) == 42 || lexer_peek_n(lex, 2) == 33 {
                let result = scan_doc_comment_block(lex)
                lex = result.lexer
                token_count = token_count + 1
                continue
            }
        }

        // String literals
        if c == 34 {  // "
            let result = scan_string(lex)
            lex = result.lexer
            token_count = token_count + 1
            continue
        }

        // Character literals
        if c == 39 {  // '
            let result = scan_char_literal(lex)
            lex = result.lexer
            token_count = token_count + 1
            continue
        }

        // Numeric literals
        if is_digit(c) {
            let result = scan_integer(lex)
            lex = result.lexer
            token_count = token_count + 1
            continue
        }

        // Identifiers and keywords
        if is_alpha(c) || c == 95 {  // 95 = '_'
            let result = scan_identifier(lex)
            lex = result.lexer
            token_count = token_count + 1
            continue
        }

        // Delimiters
        if is_delimiter(c) {
            let result = scan_delimiter(lex)
            lex = result.lexer
            token_count = token_count + 1
            continue
        }

        // Operators (longest-match priority)
        if is_operator_start(c) {
            let result = scan_operator(lex)
            lex = result.lexer
            token_count = token_count + 1
            continue
        }

        // Unknown character - skip it
        lex = lexer_advance(lex)
    }

    token_count
}

// Helper: Check if character starts an operator
fn is_operator_start(c: i8) -> bool {
    // Operators: + - * / % = < > ! & | : ? @ # $ ^ ~ ++  -- == != <= >= && || :: => +- ± &! << >> etc.
    c == 43 || c == 45 || c == 42 || c == 47 || c == 37 || c == 61 || c == 60 || c == 62 ||
    c == 33 || c == 38 || c == 124 || c == 58 || c == 63 || c == 64 || c == 35 || c == 36 ||
    c == 94 || c == 126
}

// Helper: Check if character is a delimiter
fn is_delimiter(c: i8) -> bool {
    c == 40 || c == 41 || c == 91 || c == 93 || c == 123 || c == 125 || c == 44 || c == 46 || c == 59
}



// === FILE: stdlib/compiler/lexer/tokens.sio ===
// compiler::lexer::tokens — Token definitions for the Sounio self-hosted compiler
//
// This module defines all token types recognized by the Sounio lexer.
// Equivalent to compiler/src/lexer/tokens.rs in the Rust implementation.

// ============================================================================
// SPAN - Source location tracking
// ============================================================================

// Span represents a range in the source code (byte offsets)
struct Span {
    start: i64,
    end: i64,
}

fn span_new(start: i64, end: i64) -> Span {
    Span { start: start, end: end }
}

fn span_empty() -> Span {
    Span { start: 0, end: 0 }
}

fn span_len(s: Span) -> i64 {
    s.end - s.start
}

// ============================================================================
// TOKEN STRUCTURE
// ============================================================================

// Token with kind, span, and text content
struct Token {
    kind: i32,
    span: Span,
    // Text stored as fixed-size array (max 256 chars for identifiers/strings)
    text: [i8; 256],
    text_len: i64,
}

fn token_new() -> Token {
    Token {
        kind: TK_EOF(),
        span: span_empty(),
        text: [0; 256],
        text_len: 0,
    }
}

fn token_with_kind(kind: i32, start: i64, end: i64) -> Token {
    Token {
        kind: kind,
        span: span_new(start, end),
        text: [0; 256],
        text_len: 0,
    }
}

fn token_eof(pos: i64) -> Token {
    Token {
        kind: TK_EOF(),
        span: span_new(pos, pos),
        text: [0; 256],
        text_len: 0,
    }
}

fn token_error(pos: i64) -> Token {
    Token {
        kind: TK_ERROR(),
        span: span_new(pos, pos + 1),
        text: [0; 256],
        text_len: 0,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// TOKEN KIND CLASSIFICATION
// ============================================================================

// Check if token kind is a keyword (10-179)
fn is_keyword(kind: i32) -> bool {
    kind >= 10 && kind < 180
}

// Check if token kind is a literal (200-209)
fn is_literal(kind: i32) -> bool {
    kind >= 200 && kind < 220
}

// Check if token kind is an operator (220-279)
fn is_operator(kind: i32) -> bool {
    kind >= 220 && kind < 280
}

// Check if token kind is a delimiter (280-289)
fn is_delimiter(kind: i32) -> bool {
    kind >= 280 && kind < 290
}

// Check if token kind is punctuation (290-309)
fn is_punctuation(kind: i32) -> bool {
    kind >= 290 && kind < 310
}

// Check if token kind is a doc comment (310-319)
fn is_doc_comment(kind: i32) -> bool {
    kind >= 310 && kind < 320
}

// Linear type system - minimal bootstrap stub

fn MODALITY_UNRESTRICTED() -> i32 { 0 }
fn MODALITY_AFFINE() -> i32 { 2 }
fn MODALITY_LINEAR() -> i32 { 3 }

struct LinearType {
    modality: i32,
    base_type: i64,
}

fn create_unrestricted(base: i64) -> LinearType {
    LinearType { modality: MODALITY_UNRESTRICTED(), base_type: base }
}

    LinearType { modality: MODALITY_LINEAR(), base_type: base }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/compiler/ontology/cache.sio ===
// stdlib/compiler/ontology/cache.sio
//
// Phase 1 cache surface. The persistent on-disk implementation is provided in
// the Python/Jupyter integration, while the compiler source owns the config
// contract and negative-result sentinel behavior.

fn ontology_default_home() -> string { "data/ontology/bundles" }
fn ontology_default_mode() -> string { "hybrid" }
fn ontology_default_cache_dir() -> string { "data/ontology/cache" }

fn ontology_cache_config() -> OntologyConfig {
    OntologyConfig {
        home: ontology_default_home(),
        mode: ontology_default_mode(),
        cache_dir: ontology_default_cache_dir(),
        bioportal_api_key: "",
        ols4_base_url: "",
    }
}

fn ontology_cache_negative(curie: string) -> ResolvedOntologyTerm {
    let t = ontology_term_empty()
    t
}


// === FILE: stdlib/compiler/ontology/federation.sio ===
// stdlib/compiler/ontology/federation.sio
//
// Conservative Phase 1 federation hook. The live network-backed federation is
// implemented in sounio-py and reused from Jupyter. The compiler source keeps
// the contract explicit and fail-closed.

fn ontology_mode_allows_federation(mode: string) -> bool {
    mode == "hybrid" || mode == "federated"
}

fn ontology_federated_resolve(curie: string, config: OntologyConfig) -> ResolvedOntologyTerm {
    let _curie = curie
    let _config = config
    ontology_term_empty()
}

fn ontology_federated_search(query: string, config: OntologyConfig) -> ResolvedOntologyTermList {
    let _query = query
    let _config = config
    ontology_term_list_new()
}

fn ontology_mapping_make(
    subject_id: string,

) -> OntologyMapping {
    OntologyMapping {
        subject_id: subject_id,

        object_id: object_id,
        confidence: confidence,
        justification: justification,
    }
}

fn ontology_map_term_local(source_curie: string, to_ontology: string) -> OntologyMappingList {
    var out = ontology_mapping_list_new()
    if source_curie == "SNOMED:44054006" && to_ontology == "HPO" {
        return ontology_mapping_list_push(
            out,
            ontology_mapping_make(
                "SNOMED:44054006",
                "closeMatch",
                "HPO:0005978",
                0.72,
                "Clinical diagnosis aligns with glucose homeostasis abnormality."
            )
        )
    }
    if source_curie == "HPO:0003074" && to_ontology == "GO" {
        return ontology_mapping_list_push(
            out,
            ontology_mapping_make(
                "HPO:0003074",
                "exactMatch",
                "GO:0042593",
                0.91,
                "Hyperglycemia maps to glucose homeostasis."
            )
        )
    }
    if source_curie == "HPO:0003074" && to_ontology == "CHEBI" {
        return ontology_mapping_list_push(
            out,
            ontology_mapping_make(
                "HPO:0003074",
                "relatedMatch",
                "CHEBI:17234",
                0.66,
                "Hyperglycemia concerns excess blood glucose."
            )
        )
    }
    if source_curie == "LOINC:4548-4" && to_ontology == "HPO" {
        return ontology_mapping_list_push(
            out,
            ontology_mapping_make(
                "LOINC:4548-4",
                "closeMatch",
                "HPO:0005978",
                0.61,
                "HbA1c observes glucose homeostasis."
            )
        )
    }
    if source_curie == "SNOMED:44054006" && to_ontology == "CHEBI" {
        return ontology_mapping_list_push(
            out,
            ontology_mapping_make(
                "SNOMED:44054006",
                "relatedMatch",
                "CHEBI:6801",
                0.70,
                "Metformin is a canonical therapeutic agent for type 2 diabetes."
            )
        )
    }
    out
}


// === FILE: stdlib/compiler/ontology/model.sio ===
// stdlib/compiler/ontology/model.sio
//
// Canonical ontology model for compiler-facing resolution.

struct ResolvedOntologyTerm {
    curie: string,
    label: string,
    definition: string,
    parents: [string; 8],
    parents_len: i64,
    synonyms: [string; 8],
    synonyms_len: i64,
    source_layer: string,
    iri: string,
    mapping_confidence: f64,
    provenance: string,
}

struct ResolvedOntologyTermList {
    items: [ResolvedOntologyTerm; 16],
    len: i64,
}

struct OntologyMapping {
    subject_id: string,
    predicate: string,
    object_id: string,
    confidence: f64,
    justification: string,
}

struct OntologyMappingList {
    items: [OntologyMapping; 16],
    len: i64,
}

struct OntologyConfig {
    home: string,
    mode: string,
    cache_dir: string,
    bioportal_api_key: string,
    ols4_base_url: string,
}

fn ontology_term_empty() -> ResolvedOntologyTerm {
    ResolvedOntologyTerm {
        curie: "",
        label: "",
        definition: "",
        parents: [""; 8],
        parents_len: 0,
        synonyms: [""; 8],
        synonyms_len: 0,
        source_layer: "",
        iri: "",
        mapping_confidence: 0.0,
        provenance: "",
    }
}

fn ontology_term_list_new() -> ResolvedOntologyTermList {
    ResolvedOntologyTermList {
        items: [ontology_term_empty(); 16],
        len: 0,
    }
}

fn ontology_mapping_empty() -> OntologyMapping {
    OntologyMapping {
        subject_id: "",
        predicate: "",
        object_id: "",
        confidence: 0.0,
        justification: "",
    }
}

fn ontology_mapping_list_new() -> OntologyMappingList {
    OntologyMappingList {
        items: [ontology_mapping_empty(); 16],
        len: 0,
    }
}

fn ontology_term_found(term: ResolvedOntologyTerm) -> bool {
    str_len(term.curie) > 0
}

fn ontology_term_add_parent(term: ResolvedOntologyTerm, parent: string) -> ResolvedOntologyTerm {
    var out = term
    if out.parents_len < 8 {
        out.parents[out.parents_len as usize] = parent
        out.parents_len = out.parents_len + 1
    }
    out
}

fn ontology_term_add_synonym(term: ResolvedOntologyTerm, synonym: string) -> ResolvedOntologyTerm {
    var out = term
    if out.synonyms_len < 8 {
        out.synonyms[out.synonyms_len as usize] = synonym
        out.synonyms_len = out.synonyms_len + 1
    }
    out
}

fn ontology_term_list_push(lst: ResolvedOntologyTermList, term: ResolvedOntologyTerm) -> ResolvedOntologyTermList {
    var out = lst
    if out.len < 16 {
        out.items[out.len as usize] = term
        out.len = out.len + 1
    }
    out
}

fn ontology_mapping_list_push(lst: OntologyMappingList, mapping: OntologyMapping) -> OntologyMappingList {
    var out = lst
    if out.len < 16 {
        out.items[out.len as usize] = mapping
        out.len = out.len + 1
    }
    out
}

fn ontology_config_default() -> OntologyConfig {
    OntologyConfig {
        home: "data/ontology/bundles",
        mode: "hybrid",
        cache_dir: "data/ontology/cache",
        bioportal_api_key: "",
        ols4_base_url: "",
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/compiler/ontology/mod.sio ===
// stdlib/compiler/ontology/mod.sio
//
// Public compiler-facing ontology facade.

module ontology

fn ontology_is_supported_prefix(raw: string) -> bool {
    starts_with(raw, "SNOMED:") ||
    starts_with(raw, "LOINC:") ||
    starts_with(raw, "HPO:") ||
    starts_with(raw, "GO:") ||
    starts_with(raw, "CHEBI:")
}

fn ontology_curie_literal_valid(raw: string) -> bool {
    if !ontology_is_supported_prefix(raw) {
        return false
    }
    let len = str_len(raw)
    len > 4
}

fn ontology_resolve_curie(curie: string) -> ResolvedOntologyTerm {
    ontology_resolve(curie)
}

fn ontology_search_text(query: string) -> ResolvedOntologyTermList {
    ontology_search(query)
}

fn ontology_ancestor_terms(curie: string) -> ResolvedOntologyTermList {
    ontology_ancestors(curie)
}

fn ontology_is_subclass_of(child: string, parent: string) -> bool {
    ontology_is_subclass(child, parent)
}

fn ontology_map_to(source_curie: string, target_ontology: string) -> OntologyMappingList {
    ontology_map_term(source_curie, target_ontology)
}

fn ontology_print_term(term: ResolvedOntologyTerm) with IO {
    if !ontology_term_found(term) {
        println("unresolved")
        return
    }
    println("curie=" + term.curie)
    println("label=" + term.label)
    println("definition=" + term.definition)
    println("source_layer=" + term.source_layer)
    println("iri=" + term.iri)
    println("provenance=" + term.provenance)
}

fn ontology_print_search_results(results: ResolvedOntologyTermList) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < results.len {
        let term = results.items[i as usize]
        println(term.curie + " | " + term.label + " | " + term.provenance)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn ontology_print_mappings(mappings: OntologyMappingList) with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < mappings.len {
        let item = mappings.items[i as usize]
        println(item.subject_id + " -> " + item.object_id + " | " + item.predicate)
        i = i + 1
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/compiler/ontology/resolver.sio ===
// stdlib/compiler/ontology/resolver.sio
//
// Local-first ontology resolution for the compiler surface.

fn ontology_resolve(curie: string) -> ResolvedOntologyTerm {
    let config = ontology_cache_config()
    ontology_resolve_with_config(curie, config)
}

fn ontology_resolve_with_config(curie: string, config: OntologyConfig) -> ResolvedOntologyTerm {
    let local = ontology_store_resolve_local(curie)
    if ontology_term_found(local) {
        return local
    }
    if ontology_mode_allows_federation(config.mode) {
        let remote = ontology_federated_resolve(curie, config)
        if ontology_term_found(remote) {
            return remote
        }
    }
    ontology_cache_negative(curie)
}

fn ontology_search(query: string) -> ResolvedOntologyTermList {
    let config = ontology_cache_config()
    let local = ontology_store_search_local(query)
    if local.len > 0 {
        return local
    }
    if ontology_mode_allows_federation(config.mode) {
        return ontology_federated_search(query, config)
    }
    ontology_term_list_new()
}

fn ontology_ancestors(curie: string) -> ResolvedOntologyTermList {
    var out = ontology_term_list_new()
    let term = ontology_resolve(curie)
    if !ontology_term_found(term) {
        return out
    }

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < term.parents_len {
        let parent_curie = term.parents[i as usize]
        let parent = ontology_resolve(parent_curie)
        if ontology_term_found(parent) {
            out = ontology_term_list_push(out, parent)
            let nested = ontology_ancestors(parent_curie)
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < nested.len {
                out = ontology_term_list_push(out, nested.items[j as usize])
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    out
}

fn ontology_is_subclass(child: string, parent: string) -> bool {
    if child == parent {
        return true
    }
    let ancestors = ontology_ancestors(child)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < ancestors.len {
        if ancestors.items[i as usize].curie == parent {
            return true
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    false
}

fn ontology_map_term(source_curie: string, to_ontology: string) -> OntologyMappingList {
    ontology_map_term_local(source_curie, to_ontology)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/compiler/ontology/store.sio ===

    curie: string,
    label: string,
    definition: string,

        curie: curie,

        synonyms_len: 0,

        iri: iri,
        mapping_confidence: 1.0,
        provenance: provenance,
    }
}

        return ontology_term_add_synonym(t1, "T2DM")
    }
