// Create a patient profile with basic demographics
fn create_patient(age: f64, weight: f64@kg, sex: bool) -> PatientData {
    let height: f64;
    
    // Estimate height based on sex and typical BMI
    if sex {
        height = 175.0;  // Default male height (cm)
    } else {
        height = 162.0;  // Default female height (cm)
    }
    
    return PatientData {
        age: age,
        weight: weight,
        height: height,
        sex: sex,
        disease_state: HEALTHY,
    };
}

// Validate PBPK parameters for physiological plausibility
fn validate_pbpk_params(params: PBPKParams) -> bool {
    // Check organ volumes are positive
    if params.v_blood <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.v_liver <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.v_kidney <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.v_brain <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.v_heart <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.v_lung <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.v_muscle <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.v_adipose <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.v_gut <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.v_skin <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.v_bone <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.v_spleen <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.v_pancreas <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.v_rest <= 0.0 { return false; }

    // Check blood flows are positive
    if params.q_blood <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.q_liver <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.q_kidney <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.q_brain <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.q_heart <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.q_lung <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.q_muscle <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.q_adipose <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.q_gut <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.q_skin <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.q_bone <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.q_spleen <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.q_pancreas <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.q_rest <= 0.0 { return false; }

    // Check clearances are non-negative
    if params.clearance_hepatic < 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.clearance_renal < 0.0 { return false; }

    // Check partition coefficients are positive
    if params.kp_blood <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.kp_liver <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.kp_kidney <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.kp_brain <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.kp_heart <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.kp_lung <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.kp_muscle <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.kp_adipose <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.kp_gut <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.kp_skin <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.kp_bone <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.kp_spleen <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.kp_pancreas <= 0.0 { return false; }
    if params.kp_rest <= 0.0 { return false; }

    // Check fu_plasma is between 0 and 1
    if params.fu_plasma < 0.0 || params.fu_plasma > 1.0 { return false; }

    // Check hematocrit is between 0 and 1
    if params.hematocrit < 0.0 || params.hematocrit > 1.0 { return false; }

    // Check bp_ratio is positive
    if params.bp_ratio <= 0.0 { return false; }

    return true;
}

// Calculate total body volume from organ volumes
fn calculate_total_volume(params: PBPKParams) -> f64@L {
    return params.v_blood + params.v_liver + params.v_kidney + 
           params.v_brain + params.v_heart + params.v_lung + 
           params.v_muscle + params.v_adipose + params.v_gut + 
           params.v_skin + params.v_bone + params.v_spleen + 
           params.v_pancreas + params.v_rest;
}

// Calculate cardiac output from blood flows (excluding lung which is series)
fn calculate_cardiac_output(params: PBPKParams) -> f64@L_per_h {
    return params.q_liver + params.q_kidney + params.q_brain + 
           params.q_heart + params.q_muscle + params.q_adipose + 
           params.q_gut + params.q_skin + params.q_bone + 
           params.q_spleen + params.q_pancreas + params.q_rest;
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/core/rodgers_rowland.sio ===
// rodgers_rowland.sio — Rodgers-Rowland tissue:plasma partition coefficient model
// Reference: Rodgers & Rowland (2006-2007) J Pharm Sci

fn rr_pow(base: f64, exp_int: i64) -> f64 {
    if exp_int == 0 { return 1.0 }
    var result = 1.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < exp_int { result = result * base; i = i + 1 }
    result
}

fn rr_log10(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var v = x
    var scale = 0.0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.718281828; scale = scale + 1.0 }
    while v < 0.5 { v = v * 2.718281828; scale = scale - 1.0 }
    let y = (v - 1.0) / (v + 1.0)
    let y2 = y * y
    let ln_val = 2.0 * y * (1.0 + y2 / 3.0 + y2 * y2 / 5.0 + y2 * y2 * y2 / 7.0) + scale
    ln_val / 2.302585093
}

struct TissueComposition {
    f_water: f64,
    f_ew: f64,
    f_iw: f64,
    f_neutral_lipid: f64,
    f_phospholipid: f64,
    f_acidic_phospholipid: f64,
    f_protein: f64,
    pH_iw: f64,
}

fn tissue_liver() -> TissueComposition {
    TissueComposition { f_water: 0.751, f_ew: 0.161, f_iw: 0.573, f_neutral_lipid: 0.014, f_phospholipid: 0.024, f_acidic_phospholipid: 0.005, f_protein: 0.157, pH_iw: 7.0 }
}

fn tissue_brain() -> TissueComposition {
    TissueComposition { f_water: 0.770, f_ew: 0.092, f_iw: 0.678, f_neutral_lipid: 0.039, f_phospholipid: 0.036, f_acidic_phospholipid: 0.0059, f_protein: 0.048, pH_iw: 7.0 }
}

fn tissue_kidney() -> TissueComposition {
    TissueComposition { f_water: 0.783, f_ew: 0.209, f_iw: 0.483, f_neutral_lipid: 0.012, f_phospholipid: 0.024, f_acidic_phospholipid: 0.005, f_protein: 0.127, pH_iw: 7.0 }
}

struct DrugPropertiesRR {
    logP: f64,
    pKa: f64,
    fu_plasma: f64,
    is_acid: bool,
    blood_plasma_ratio: f64,
}

// Ionization fraction for acids/bases
fn fraction_ionized(pKa: f64, pH: f64, is_acid: bool) -> f64 {
    let delta = if is_acid { pH - pKa } else { pKa - pH }
    let pow10 = rr_pow(10.0, if delta > 0.0 { (delta * 10.0) as i64 } else { 0 })
    let ratio = (pow10 as f64) / rr_pow(10.0, ((delta * 10.0) as i64) - (delta * 10.0) as i64)
    1.0 / (1.0 + ratio)
}

// Rodgers-Rowland Kp for moderate-to-strong bases
fn kp_rodgers_rowland(tissue: TissueComposition, drug: DrugPropertiesRR) -> f64 with Div, Panic, Mut {
    let P = rr_pow(10.0, (drug.logP * 10.0) as i64) // approximate
    let fi = fraction_ionized(drug.pKa, tissue.pH_iw, drug.is_acid)
    let fu = drug.fu_plasma

    // Simplified Kp prediction
    let kp_uw = tissue.f_ew + (1.0 + fi) * tissue.f_iw
    let kp_nl = tissue.f_neutral_lipid * (P as f64) * 0.3
    let kp_pl = tissue.f_phospholipid * (P as f64) * 0.7 * (1.0 + fi)

    let kp = (kp_uw + kp_nl + kp_pl) / fu
    if kp < 0.01 { 0.01 } else { kp }
}

fn test_kp_liver_basic() -> bool with Div, Panic, Mut {
    let liver = tissue_liver()
    let drug = DrugPropertiesRR { logP: 2.0, pKa: 8.0, fu_plasma: 0.1, is_acid: false, blood_plasma_ratio: 1.0 }
    let kp = kp_rodgers_rowland(liver, drug)
    kp > 0.0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/ddi/mechanistic_ddi.sio ===
// mechanistic_ddi.sio — Darwin PBPK mechanistic_ddi module
// Rewritten in Sounio syntax

fn dpbpk_mechanistic_ddi_exp(x: f64) -> f64 {
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); result = result + term; i = i + 1 }
    result
}

fn dpbpk_mechanistic_ddi_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn dpbpk_mechanistic_ddi_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn dpbpk_mechanistic_ddi_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn dpbpk_mechanistic_ddi_clamp(x: f64, lo: f64, hi: f64) -> f64 { if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x } }

struct Mechanistic_ddi_State {
    concentration: f64,
    flow_in: f64,
    flow_out: f64,
    volume: f64,
    kp: f64,
}

fn mechanistic_ddi_state_new(vol: f64, kp: f64) -> Mechanistic_ddi_State {
    Mechanistic_ddi_State { concentration: 0.0, flow_in: 0.0, flow_out: 0.0, volume: vol, kp: kp }
}

fn mechanistic_ddi_compute_flux(c_arterial: f64, c_tissue: f64, kp: f64, blood_flow: f64) -> f64 {
    blood_flow * (c_arterial - c_tissue / kp)
}

fn mechanistic_ddi_update(state: Mechanistic_ddi_State, c_arterial: f64, blood_flow: f64, dt: f64) -> Mechanistic_ddi_State with Div, Panic, Mut {
    let flux = mechanistic_ddi_compute_flux(c_arterial, state.concentration, state.kp, blood_flow)
    var new_state = state
    new_state.concentration = state.concentration + dt * flux / state.volume
    if new_state.concentration < 0.0 { new_state.concentration = 0.0 }
    new_state.flow_in = dpbpk_mechanistic_ddi_max(flux, 0.0)
    new_state.flow_out = dpbpk_mechanistic_ddi_abs(dpbpk_mechanistic_ddi_min(flux, 0.0))
    new_state
}

fn test_mechanistic_ddi_flux_positive() -> bool with Div, Panic, Mut {
    let flux = mechanistic_ddi_compute_flux(10.0, 5.0, 2.0, 90.0)
    flux > 0.0
}

fn test_mechanistic_ddi_zero_init() -> bool {
    let s = mechanistic_ddi_state_new(1.5, 5.0)
    s.concentration == 0.0 && s.volume == 1.5
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/drugs/rapamycin.sio ===
// darwin_pbpk/drugs/rapamycin.sio — Rapamycin (Sirolimus) PBPK Parameters
//
// Epistemic priors for sirolimus based on published pharmacokinetic literature.
//
// Key pharmacological identity:
//   - mTOR inhibitor, immunosuppressant (Wyeth/Pfizer, 1999)
//   - CYP3A4/P-gp substrate: high CYP3A4 inter-individual variability (CV~60%)
//   - Very low oral bioavailability (~15%): significant first-pass effect
//   - P-gp efflux at BBB: extremely low CNS penetration (kp_brain~0.07-0.12)
//   - Strong protein binding (92%): fu_plasma = 0.08
//
// Literature sources:
//   - Ferron GM et al. (1997) Clin Pharmacol Ther: CL=12.4 L/h, CV=58%
//   - Kahan BD et al. (2001) J Clin Pharmacol: Vd=12 L/kg
//   - Schreiber SL et al. (1991) JACS: fu_plasma=0.08 (in vitro)
//   - Lampen A et al. (1998) Biochem Pharmacol: P-gp substrate, brain/plasma~0.07-0.12
//   - MacDonald A et al. (2000) Transplantation: ka=1.1/h (oral absorption)
//
// Epistemic note on confidence scores:
//   Confidence values [0,1] represent evidence quality, NOT a Beta posterior.
//   Beta is appropriate for fraction-bounded quantities (fu, Kp); for CL (0,∞)
//   and Ka (0,∞) we use a normalized evidence score based on:
//     - number of independent studies (n), consistency across populations,
//     - whether data are from in vivo (higher) or in vitro (lower)
//
//   Confidence scoring heuristic:
//     0.4-0.5: single in vitro study, small n
//     0.5-0.65: single in vivo study, moderate n (10-30 patients)
//     0.65-0.80: replicated in vivo, n>30, consistent
//     0.80-0.95: meta-analysis or regulatory submission-grade data

use tsit5_pbpk14::*;

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS (local, to avoid relying on import availability)
// ============================================================================

fn rapa_sqrt_drug(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 10 {
        y = (y + x / y) * 0.5
        i = i + 1
    }
    return y
}

// ============================================================================
// RAPAMYCIN MEAN PARAMETERS
// ============================================================================
// Returns a PBPKParams14 tuned for rapamycin mean pharmacokinetics.
//
// Note on peripheral volume:
//   Real rapamycin Vd ~ 12 L/kg = 840 L (70 kg adult), driven by deep adipose
//   sequestration (kp_adipose ~ 15). For a 48h simulation this gives t1/2 ~300h
//   (only 15% eliminated), making CL insensitive in this window.
//
//   This module uses a "distribution-capped" model (kp_periph=0.5, v_periph=50 L)
//   representing rapidly equilibrating tissues only, giving t1/2 ~ 21h.
//   The BBB-limited brain compartment (kp_brain=0.08) is preserved accurately.
//   Deep adipose distribution is OUT OF SCOPE for a 48h BBB focus study.
//   For multi-day deep-tissue studies, use the full 14-compartment tsit5 model.

fn rapamycin_mean_params() -> PBPKParams14 {
    var prm = default_pbpk_params()

    // Clearance: CYP3A4-dominated, fu_plasma=0.08 unbound cleared
    prm.cl_hepatic = 12.4    // L/h (Ferron 1997)
    prm.cl_renal = 0.3       // L/h (minimal — rapamycin not renally cleared)

    // Binding: strong plasma protein binding
    prm.fu_plasma = 0.08     // Schreiber 1991
    prm.rb_ratio = 0.58      // Blood:plasma (modest RBC binding)

    // Brain: P-gp efflux limits CNS penetration significantly
    prm.kp_brain = 0.08      // Lampen 1998 (P-gp substrate)

    // Other key compartments (literature-based estimates)
    prm.kp_liver = 8.0       // High hepatic uptake (site of CYP3A4 metabolism)
    prm.kp_lung = 10.0       // Moderate lung accumulation (known)
    prm.kp_kidney = 4.0      // Moderate
    prm.kp_heart = 3.5

    // Peripheral: capped at v_other=50L for 48h BBB-focus model
    // (represents fast-equilibrating muscle, skin, bone only)
    prm.kp_other = 0.5       // Distribution cap for short simulation

    // Gut, spleen, pancreas: moderate distribution
    prm.kp_gut = 5.0
    prm.kp_spleen = 6.0
    prm.kp_pancreas = 4.0
    prm.kp_muscle = 3.5
    prm.kp_adipose = 0.3     // Adipose capped (deep compartment excluded)
    prm.kp_skin = 2.0
    prm.kp_bone = 1.5

    return prm
}

// ============================================================================
// EPISTEMIC VARIANCE PRIORS
// ============================================================================
// Each uncertain parameter has: mean, variance (SD^2), confidence [0,1]
//
// Confidence is NOT a Beta distribution for unbounded parameters (CL, Ka).
// It is an evidence-quality score normalized to [0,1] (see header).

struct RapamycinEpParam {
    mean: f64,
    variance: f64,     // SD^2 — quantifies epistemic spread (GUM Var)
    confidence: f64,   // Evidence quality score [0,1]
}

fn rapa_ep_param(mean: f64, variance: f64, confidence: f64) -> RapamycinEpParam {
    RapamycinEpParam {
        mean: mean,
        variance: variance,
        confidence: confidence,
    }
}

fn rapa_ep_cv(ep: &RapamycinEpParam) -> f64 {
    let sig = rapa_sqrt_drug(ep.variance)
    if ep.mean > 1.0e-12 || ep.mean < 0.0 - 1.0e-12 {
        let abs_mean = if ep.mean < 0.0 { 0.0 - ep.mean } else { ep.mean }
        return sig / abs_mean
    }
    return 0.0
}

struct RapamycinPriors {
    // CL_hepatic: CYP3A4-dominated clearance
    // Large variance (SD=7.4, CV=60%) from CYP3A4 polymorphism
    // Source: Ferron 1997, population PK n=24
    cl_hepatic: RapamycinEpParam,

    // kp_brain: brain:plasma partition coefficient
    // Uncertainty from limited in vivo CNS measurement data
    // Source: Lampen 1998 (in vitro P-gp assay), range 0.07-0.12 in vivo
    kp_brain: RapamycinEpParam,

    // fu_plasma: unbound fraction in plasma
    // Well-characterized in vitro, but in vivo may differ (disease states)
    // Source: Schreiber 1991 (in vitro equilibrium dialysis)
    fu_plasma: RapamycinEpParam,
}

fn rapamycin_priors() -> RapamycinPriors {
    // CL: SD = 7.4 L/h (CV = 7.4/12.4 = 60%), evidence score 0.65
    let cl_prior = rapa_ep_param(12.4, 54.76, 0.65)

    // kp_brain: mean=0.08, SD=0.025 (range 0.07-0.12 in literature)
    // Low confidence: only indirect evidence from P-gp efflux ratios
    let kp_brain_prior = rapa_ep_param(0.08, 0.000625, 0.55)

    // fu_plasma: mean=0.08, SD=0.02 (well-characterized in vitro)
    // Good confidence: multiple replicated in vitro studies
    let fu_prior = rapa_ep_param(0.08, 0.0004, 0.72)

    RapamycinPriors {
        cl_hepatic: cl_prior,
        kp_brain: kp_brain_prior,
        fu_plasma: fu_prior,
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/epistemic_sim.sio ===
// darwin_pbpk/epistemic_sim.sio — 4-Compartment Epistemic PBPK Simulation
//
// Self-contained 4-compartment oral PBPK model (gut, central, peripheral,
// eliminated) with GUM uncertainty propagation via RK4 integration.
//
// Compartment ODE system:
//   d(gut)/dt        = -ka * gut
//   d(central)/dt    = ka * gut - (ke + k12) * central + k21 * peripheral
//   d(peripheral)/dt = k12 * central - k21 * peripheral
//   d(eliminated)/dt = ke * central
//
// Uncertainty propagated analytically via GUM linearization at each RK4 step.
// AUC computed by trapezoidal rule; Cmax/Tmax tracked over integration window.
//
// Reference: JCGM 100:2008 (GUM), §13.3 — linearized uncertainty propagation.

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS (self-contained)
// ============================================================================

fn sim_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 {
        y = (y + x / y) * 0.5
        i = i + 1
    }
    return y
}

fn sim_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn sim_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { return a }
    return b
}

fn sim_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { return a }
    return b
}

// ln(2) — used for half-life = ln(2)/ke
fn ln2() -> f64 { 0.6931471805599453 }

// ============================================================================
// GUM BUILDING BLOCKS (inlined — no cross-module dependency required)
// ============================================================================

pub struct GUMResult {
    pub value: f64,
    pub std_uncertainty: f64,
    pub degrees_of_freedom: f64,
    pub coverage_factor_95: f64,
    pub expanded_uncertainty_95: f64,
}

fn gum_k95() -> f64 { 1.96 }

fn sim_gum_simple(value: f64, std_u: f64) -> GUMResult {
    let u = sim_abs(std_u)
    let k = gum_k95()
    GUMResult {
        value: value,
        std_uncertainty: u,
        degrees_of_freedom: 1.0e9,
        coverage_factor_95: k,
        expanded_uncertainty_95: k * u,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PBPK PARAMETER STRUCT
// ============================================================================

pub struct PBPKParams {
    pub dose: f64,               // mg — administered dose
    pub dose_unc: f64,           // mg — standard uncertainty on dose
    pub ka: f64,                 // 1/h — absorption rate constant
    pub ka_unc: f64,
    pub ke: f64,                 // 1/h — elimination rate constant
    pub ke_unc: f64,
    pub vd: f64,                 // L — volume of distribution (central)
    pub vd_unc: f64,
    pub k12: f64,                // 1/h — central→peripheral transfer rate
    pub k12_unc: f64,
    pub k21: f64,                // 1/h — peripheral→central transfer rate
    pub k21_unc: f64,
    pub bioavailability: f64,    // F — oral bioavailability [0,1]
    pub bioavailability_unc: f64,
}

// ============================================================================
// PBPK STATE STRUCT
// ============================================================================

pub struct PBPKState {
    pub gut: f64,
    pub central: f64,
    pub peripheral: f64,
    pub eliminated: f64,
    pub gut_unc: f64,
    pub central_unc: f64,
    pub peripheral_unc: f64,
    pub eliminated_unc: f64,
    pub time: f64,
}

// ============================================================================
// PBPK RESULT STRUCT
// ============================================================================

pub struct PBPKResult {
    pub cmax: GUMResult,
    pub tmax: f64,
    pub auc: GUMResult,
    pub half_life: GUMResult,
    pub clearance: GUMResult,
    pub final_state: PBPKState,
    pub time_points: [f64; 256],
    pub concentrations: [f64; 256],
    pub conc_uncertainties: [f64; 256],
    pub n_points: i32,
}

// ============================================================================
// DEFAULT PARAMETERS — Typical small-molecule oral drug
// dose=100mg±5, ka=1.0±0.1/h, ke=0.1±0.01/h, Vd=50L±5
// k12=0.3±0.03/h, k21=0.2±0.02/h, F=0.8±0.05
// ============================================================================

pub fn pbpk_params_default() -> PBPKParams {
    PBPKParams {
        dose: 100.0,
        dose_unc: 5.0,
        ka: 1.0,
        ka_unc: 0.1,
        ke: 0.1,
        ke_unc: 0.01,
        vd: 50.0,
        vd_unc: 5.0,
        k12: 0.3,
        k12_unc: 0.03,
        k21: 0.2,
        k21_unc: 0.02,
        bioavailability: 0.8,
        bioavailability_unc: 0.05,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// INITIAL STATE — dose * F in gut, rest zero
// u(gut₀)² = (F * u_dose)² + (dose * u_F)²
// ============================================================================

pub fn pbpk_state_initial(params: &PBPKParams) -> PBPKState {
    let gut0 = params.dose * params.bioavailability
    let u_gut0 = sim_sqrt(
        params.bioavailability * params.bioavailability * params.dose_unc * params.dose_unc
      + params.dose * params.dose * params.bioavailability_unc * params.bioavailability_unc
    )
    PBPKState {
        gut: gut0,
        central: 0.0,
        peripheral: 0.0,
        eliminated: 0.0,
        gut_unc: u_gut0,
        central_unc: 0.0,
        peripheral_unc: 0.0,
        eliminated_unc: 0.0,
        time: 0.0,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// DERIVATIVE HELPERS — each compartment value + GUM uncertainty
// ============================================================================

fn dgut_val(gut: f64, ka: f64) -> f64 {
    return 0.0 - ka * gut
}

fn dgut_unc(gut: f64, gut_unc: f64, ka: f64, ka_unc: f64) -> f64 {
    let t1 = ka * gut_unc
    let t2 = gut * ka_unc
    return sim_sqrt(t1 * t1 + t2 * t2)
}

fn dcentral_val(gut: f64, central: f64, peripheral: f64,
                ka: f64, ke: f64, k12: f64, k21: f64) -> f64 {
    return ka * gut - (ke + k12) * central + k21 * peripheral
}

fn dcentral_unc(gut: f64, gut_unc: f64, central: f64, central_unc: f64,
                peripheral: f64, peripheral_unc: f64,
                ka: f64, ka_unc: f64, ke: f64, ke_unc: f64,
                k12: f64, k12_unc: f64, k21: f64, k21_unc: f64) -> f64 {
    let u_kag = sim_sqrt((ka * gut_unc) * (ka * gut_unc) + (gut * ka_unc) * (gut * ka_unc))
    let kk = ke + k12
    let u_kkc = sim_sqrt(
        (central * ke_unc) * (central * ke_unc)
      + (central * k12_unc) * (central * k12_unc)
      + (kk * central_unc) * (kk * central_unc)
    )
    let u_k21p = sim_sqrt(
        (k21 * peripheral_unc) * (k21 * peripheral_unc)
      + (peripheral * k21_unc) * (peripheral * k21_unc)
    )
    return sim_sqrt(u_kag * u_kag + u_kkc * u_kkc + u_k21p * u_k21p)
}

fn dperipheral_val(central: f64, peripheral: f64, k12: f64, k21: f64) -> f64 {
    return k12 * central - k21 * peripheral
}

fn dperipheral_unc(central: f64, central_unc: f64, peripheral: f64, peripheral_unc: f64,
                   k12: f64, k12_unc: f64, k21: f64, k21_unc: f64) -> f64 {
    let u_k12c = sim_sqrt(
        (k12 * central_unc) * (k12 * central_unc)
      + (central * k12_unc) * (central * k12_unc)
    )
    let u_k21p = sim_sqrt(
        (k21 * peripheral_unc) * (k21 * peripheral_unc)
      + (peripheral * k21_unc) * (peripheral * k21_unc)
    )
    return sim_sqrt(u_k12c * u_k12c + u_k21p * u_k21p)
}

fn delim_val(central: f64, ke: f64) -> f64 {
    return ke * central
}

fn delim_unc(central: f64, central_unc: f64, ke: f64, ke_unc: f64) -> f64 {
    let t1 = ke * central_unc
    let t2 = central * ke_unc
    return sim_sqrt(t1 * t1 + t2 * t2)
}

// Build derivative state at the given state/params
fn deriv_at(st: PBPKState, params: &PBPKParams) -> PBPKState {
    let dg = dgut_val(st.gut, params.ka)
    let dc = dcentral_val(st.gut, st.central, st.peripheral,
                           params.ka, params.ke, params.k12, params.k21)
    let dp = dperipheral_val(st.central, st.peripheral, params.k12, params.k21)
    let de = delim_val(st.central, params.ke)

    let ug = dgut_unc(st.gut, st.gut_unc, params.ka, params.ka_unc)
    let uc = dcentral_unc(
        st.gut, st.gut_unc, st.central, st.central_unc,
        st.peripheral, st.peripheral_unc,
        params.ka, params.ka_unc, params.ke, params.ke_unc,
        params.k12, params.k12_unc, params.k21, params.k21_unc
    )
    let up = dperipheral_unc(
        st.central, st.central_unc, st.peripheral, st.peripheral_unc,
        params.k12, params.k12_unc, params.k21, params.k21_unc
    )
    let ue = delim_unc(st.central, st.central_unc, params.ke, params.ke_unc)

    PBPKState {
        gut: dg, central: dc, peripheral: dp, eliminated: de,
        gut_unc: ug, central_unc: uc, peripheral_unc: up, eliminated_unc: ue,
        time: 0.0,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// RK4 STEP WITH GUM UNCERTAINTY PROPAGATION
//
// State: y_{n+1} = y_n + dt/6 * (k1 + 2*k2 + 2*k3 + k4)
//
// Uncertainty: u(y_{n+1})² ≈ u(y_n)² + (dt/6)² * (u_k1² + 4*u_k2² + 4*u_k3² + u_k4²)
// (uncorrelated derivative uncertainties — standard GUM assumption)
// ============================================================================

fn rk4_step_pbpk(st: PBPKState, dt: f64, params: &PBPKParams) -> PBPKState with Div, Panic {
    let k1 = deriv_at(st, params)

    let h = dt * 0.5
    let st2 = PBPKState {
        gut:            st.gut            + h * k1.gut,
        central:        st.central        + h * k1.central,
        peripheral:     st.peripheral     + h * k1.peripheral,
        eliminated:     st.eliminated     + h * k1.eliminated,
        gut_unc:        st.gut_unc,
        central_unc:    st.central_unc,
        peripheral_unc: st.peripheral_unc,
        eliminated_unc: st.eliminated_unc,
        time:           st.time + h,
    }
    let k2 = deriv_at(st2, params)

    let st3 = PBPKState {
        gut:            st.gut            + h * k2.gut,
        central:        st.central        + h * k2.central,
        peripheral:     st.peripheral     + h * k2.peripheral,
        eliminated:     st.eliminated     + h * k2.eliminated,
        gut_unc:        st.gut_unc,
        central_unc:    st.central_unc,
        peripheral_unc: st.peripheral_unc,
        eliminated_unc: st.eliminated_unc,
        time:           st.time + h,
    }
    let k3 = deriv_at(st3, params)

    let st4 = PBPKState {
        gut:            st.gut            + dt * k3.gut,
        central:        st.central        + dt * k3.central,
        peripheral:     st.peripheral     + dt * k3.peripheral,
        eliminated:     st.eliminated     + dt * k3.eliminated,
        gut_unc:        st.gut_unc,
        central_unc:    st.central_unc,
        peripheral_unc: st.peripheral_unc,
        eliminated_unc: st.eliminated_unc,
        time:           st.time + dt,
    }
    let k4 = deriv_at(st4, params)

    let sixth = dt / 6.0
    let s2    = sixth * sixth

    let gut_new        = st.gut        + sixth * (k1.gut        + 2.0 * k2.gut        + 2.0 * k3.gut        + k4.gut)
    let central_new    = st.central    + sixth * (k1.central    + 2.0 * k2.central    + 2.0 * k3.central    + k4.central)
    let peripheral_new = st.peripheral + sixth * (k1.peripheral + 2.0 * k2.peripheral + 2.0 * k3.peripheral + k4.peripheral)
    let eliminated_new = st.eliminated + sixth * (k1.eliminated + 2.0 * k2.eliminated + 2.0 * k3.eliminated + k4.eliminated)

    let gut_uvar = st.gut_unc * st.gut_unc + s2 * (
        k1.gut_unc * k1.gut_unc + 4.0 * k2.gut_unc * k2.gut_unc
      + 4.0 * k3.gut_unc * k3.gut_unc + k4.gut_unc * k4.gut_unc
    )
    let central_uvar = st.central_unc * st.central_unc + s2 * (
        k1.central_unc * k1.central_unc + 4.0 * k2.central_unc * k2.central_unc
      + 4.0 * k3.central_unc * k3.central_unc + k4.central_unc * k4.central_unc
    )
    let periph_uvar = st.peripheral_unc * st.peripheral_unc + s2 * (
        k1.peripheral_unc * k1.peripheral_unc + 4.0 * k2.peripheral_unc * k2.peripheral_unc
      + 4.0 * k3.peripheral_unc * k3.peripheral_unc + k4.peripheral_unc * k4.peripheral_unc
    )
    let elim_uvar = st.eliminated_unc * st.eliminated_unc + s2 * (
        k1.eliminated_unc * k1.eliminated_unc + 4.0 * k2.eliminated_unc * k2.eliminated_unc
      + 4.0 * k3.eliminated_unc * k3.eliminated_unc + k4.eliminated_unc * k4.eliminated_unc
    )

    PBPKState {
        gut:            gut_new,
        central:        central_new,
        peripheral:     peripheral_new,
        eliminated:     eliminated_new,
        gut_unc:        sim_sqrt(gut_uvar),
        central_unc:    sim_sqrt(central_uvar),
        peripheral_unc: sim_sqrt(periph_uvar),
        eliminated_unc: sim_sqrt(elim_uvar),
        time:           st.time + dt,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN SIMULATION FUNCTION
// ============================================================================

pub fn pbpk_simulate(params: &PBPKParams, t_end: f64, n_steps: i32) -> PBPKResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let max_pts = 256
    let steps = if n_steps > max_pts { max_pts } else { n_steps }
    let steps_f = steps as f64
    let dt = t_end / steps_f

    var st = pbpk_state_initial(params)
    let vd = params.vd

    var time_pts: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var conc_pts: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var unc_pts:  [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]

    // t=0: concentration = central/Vd = 0 (all drug in gut initially)
    let conc0 = 0.0
    let unc0  = 0.0
    time_pts[0] = 0.0
    conc_pts[0] = conc0
    unc_pts[0]  = unc0

    var cmax     = conc0
    var cmax_unc = unc0
    var tmax     = 0.0
    var auc      = 0.0
    var auc_var  = 0.0
    var prev_c   = conc0
    var prev_u   = unc0

    var i = 1
    while i <= steps {
        st = rk4_step_pbpk(st, dt, params)

        let conc = st.central / vd
        // u(C) = u(central/Vd): GUM division by uncertain Vd
        let u_conc = sim_sqrt(
            (st.central_unc / vd) * (st.central_unc / vd)
          + (st.central * params.vd_unc / (vd * vd)) * (st.central * params.vd_unc / (vd * vd))
        )

        if i < max_pts {
            time_pts[i] = st.time
            conc_pts[i] = conc
            unc_pts[i]  = u_conc
        }

        if conc > cmax {
            cmax     = conc
            cmax_unc = u_conc
            tmax     = st.time
        }

        // Trapezoidal AUC
        let trap = (prev_c + conc) * 0.5 * dt
        let trap_var = (dt * 0.5) * (dt * 0.5) * (prev_u * prev_u + u_conc * u_conc)
        auc     = auc     + trap
        auc_var = auc_var + trap_var

        prev_c = conc
        prev_u = u_conc
        i = i + 1
    }

    let auc_result  = sim_gum_simple(auc, sim_sqrt(auc_var))
    let cmax_result = sim_gum_simple(cmax, cmax_unc)

    // Half-life = ln(2)/ke; u(t½) = ln(2) * u_ke / ke²
    let ke    = params.ke
    let hl    = ln2() / ke
    let hl_u  = ln2() * params.ke_unc / (ke * ke)
    let hl_result = sim_gum_simple(hl, hl_u)

    // Clearance = dose*F / AUC
    let dose_f   = params.dose * params.bioavailability
    let u_dose_f = sim_sqrt(
        (params.bioavailability * params.dose_unc) * (params.bioavailability * params.dose_unc)
      + (params.dose * params.bioavailability_unc) * (params.dose * params.bioavailability_unc)
    )
    let cl_result = if auc > 1.0e-15 {
        let cl_val = dose_f / auc
        let cl_unc = sim_sqrt(
            (u_dose_f / auc) * (u_dose_f / auc)
          + (dose_f * sim_sqrt(auc_var) / (auc * auc)) * (dose_f * sim_sqrt(auc_var) / (auc * auc))
        )
        sim_gum_simple(cl_val, cl_unc)
    } else {
        sim_gum_simple(0.0, 0.0)
    }

    let n_pts = if steps + 1 < max_pts { steps + 1 } else { max_pts }

    PBPKResult {
        cmax: cmax_result,
        tmax: tmax,
        auc: auc_result,
        half_life: hl_result,
        clearance: cl_result,
        final_state: st,
        time_points: time_pts,
        concentrations: conc_pts,
        conc_uncertainties: unc_pts,
        n_points: n_pts,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// THERAPEUTIC WINDOW ANALYSIS
//
// effective_conc_low  = conc - 1.96 * u_conc  (lower 95% CI bound)
// effective_conc_high = conc + 1.96 * u_conc  (upper 95% CI bound)
//
// time_above_mec: duration where lower bound > mec (drug certainly therapeutic)
// time_below_mtc: duration where upper bound < mtc (drug certainly safe)
// ============================================================================

pub fn pbpk_therapeutic_window(result: &PBPKResult, mec: f64, mtc: f64) -> (f64, f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = result.n_points
    if n < 2 {
        return (0.0, 0.0)
    }

    var time_above_mec = 0.0
    var time_below_mtc = 0.0

    var idx = 1
    while idx < n {
        let t0 = result.time_points[idx - 1]
        let t1 = result.time_points[idx]
        let dt_seg = t1 - t0
        if dt_seg < 1.0e-15 {
            idx = idx + 1
            continue
        }

        let c0    = result.concentrations[idx - 1]
        let u0    = result.conc_uncertainties[idx - 1]
        let c1    = result.concentrations[idx]
        let u1    = result.conc_uncertainties[idx]
        let c_mid = (c0 + c1) * 0.5
        let u_mid = (u0 + u1) * 0.5

        let c_low  = c_mid - 1.96 * u_mid
        let c_high = c_mid + 1.96 * u_mid

        if c_low > mec {
            time_above_mec = time_above_mec + dt_seg
        }
        if c_high < mtc {
            time_below_mtc = time_below_mtc + dt_seg
        }

        idx = idx + 1
    }

    return (time_above_mec, time_below_mtc)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/lib.sio ===
//! stdlib/darwin_pbpk/lib.sio — Darwin PBPK module entry point
//!
//! Physiologically Based PharmacoKinetic (PBPK) modeling for epistemic computing.
//!
//! ## Core ODE solver
//!
//!   tsit5_pbpk14       — Tsitouras5 adaptive solver, 14-compartment flow-limited model
//!                        Exports: PBPKState14, PBPKParams14, tsit5_step_pbpk,
//!                                 default_pbpk_params, pbpk_state_zero
//!
//! ## Reference simulations
//!
//!   simulation         — deterministic simulation pipeline (multiple-dose ODE loop)
//!   simulation_real    — reference-case pipeline with invariant checking
//!                        Exports: SimulationResult, PbpkInvariantReport,
//!                                 run_pbpk_reference_case, pbpk_invariant_report
//!
//! ## Epistemic uncertainty propagation
//!
//!   epistemic_sim      — GUM linearization over PBPKParams14
//!                        Integrates darwin_pbpk with evidence-quality uncertainty.
//!                        Exports: EpistemicPBPKParams, EpistemicPKResult,
//!                                 simulate_epistemic_pbpk
//!                        Method: 1 reference ODE + N finite-difference perturbations
//!                                Var(y) = Σ_i (∂y/∂θ_i)² * Var(θ_i)  [GUM §13.3]
//!                        Step:   h = max(1e-6 * |μ|, 1e-2 * σ)  [GUM-robust]
//!
//! ## Drug-specific parameter modules (drugs/)
//!
//!   drugs/rapamycin    — Sirolimus (rapamycin) PBPK parameters and epistemic priors
//!                        Exports: rapamycin_mean_params, rapamycin_priors,
//!                                 RapamycinPriors, RapamycinEpParam
//!                        Sources: Ferron 1997 (CL), Lampen 1998 (BBB/P-gp),
//!                                 Schreiber 1991 (fu_plasma)
//!                        Note:   distribution-capped model (kp_periph=0.5, v_periph=50L)
//!                                gives t1/2~21h for tractable 48h CNS simulations.
//!                                Full adipose sequestration (kp_adipose~15) excluded
//!                                by design — use multi-week simulation for deep tissue.
//!
//! ## Confidence representation
//!
//!   Confidence in all *_priors() functions is an evidence-quality SCORE in [0,1],
//!   NOT a Beta posterior. Beta is appropriate only for fraction-bounded quantities
//!   such as fu_plasma or occupancy; for CL ∈ (0,∞) and Ka ∈ (0,∞) it is ill-defined.
//!
//!   Score heuristic:
//!     0.40-0.50 — single in vitro study, small n
//!     0.50-0.65 — single in vivo study, moderate n (10–30)
//!     0.65-0.80 — replicated in vivo, n > 30, consistent
//!     0.80-0.95 — meta-analysis or regulatory-submission-grade data
//!
//! ## Validation test
//!
//!   tests/run-pass/rapamycin_epistemic_pbpk.sio
//!     — 6-test self-contained suite (3-compartment inline model)
//!     — Validates: BBB P-gp efflux (bpr < 0.15), CV(AUC) > 30% (CYP3A4),
//!                  causal monotonicity (AUC(CL/2) > AUC(ref)),
//!                  CL dominance of AUC uncertainty (s_cl > 0.5)


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/simulation_real.sio ===
// darwin_pbpk::simulation_real — executable PBPK reference-case pipeline.
//
// This module provides a deterministic real-execution wrapper on the active
// tsit5 PBPK surface for fail-closed science gating.

use tsit5_pbpk14::*;

struct SimulationResult {
    cmax: f64,
    auc: f64,
    half_life: f64,
    clearance: f64,
    vdss: f64,
    final_state: PBPKState14,
    success: bool,
}

fn simulation_result_empty() -> SimulationResult {
    SimulationResult {
        cmax: 0.0,
        auc: 0.0,
        half_life: 0.0,
        clearance: 0.0,
        vdss: 0.0,
        final_state: pbpk_state_zero(),
        success: false,
    }
}

struct PbpkInvariantReport {
    non_negative_state: bool,
    finite_outputs: bool,
    route_constraints_ok: bool,
    success: bool,
}

fn pbpk_invariant_report_empty() -> PbpkInvariantReport {
    PbpkInvariantReport {
        non_negative_state: false,
        finite_outputs: false,
        route_constraints_ok: false,
        success: false,
    }
}

fn pbpk_total_volume(prm: PBPKParams14) -> f64 {
    prm.v_blood + prm.v_liver + prm.v_kidney + prm.v_brain + prm.v_heart + prm.v_lung +
    prm.v_muscle + prm.v_adipose + prm.v_gut + prm.v_skin + prm.v_bone + prm.v_spleen +
    prm.v_pancreas + prm.v_other
}

fn finite_like(x: f64) -> bool {
    // NaN check: NaN is the only value not equal to itself.
    if x != x {
        return false
    }
    let ax = abs_f64(x)
    ax < 1e12
}

fn state_non_negative(st: PBPKState14) -> bool {
    st.blood >= 0.0 && st.liver >= 0.0 && st.kidney >= 0.0 && st.brain >= 0.0 &&
    st.heart >= 0.0 && st.lung >= 0.0 && st.muscle >= 0.0 && st.adipose >= 0.0 &&
    st.gut >= 0.0 && st.skin >= 0.0 && st.bone >= 0.0 && st.spleen >= 0.0 &&
    st.pancreas >= 0.0 && st.other >= 0.0
}

fn state_finite(st: PBPKState14) -> bool {
    finite_like(st.blood) && finite_like(st.liver) && finite_like(st.kidney) && finite_like(st.brain) &&
    finite_like(st.heart) && finite_like(st.lung) && finite_like(st.muscle) && finite_like(st.adipose) &&
    finite_like(st.gut) && finite_like(st.skin) && finite_like(st.bone) && finite_like(st.spleen) &&
    finite_like(st.pancreas) && finite_like(st.other)
}

fn run_pbpk_reference_case(case_id: i32) -> SimulationResult with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if case_id != 1 {
        return simulation_result_empty()
    }

    let prm = default_pbpk_params()
    let t_end = 24.0
    let dose = 500.0
    let dt = 0.05

    var st = pbpk_state_zero()
    st.blood = dose / prm.v_blood

    var t = 0.0
    var cmax = st.blood
    var auc = 0.0
    var c_prev = st.blood

    while t < t_end {
        let dt_use = if t + dt > t_end { t_end - t } else { dt }
        let step = tsit5_step_pbpk(st, t, dt_use, prm)
        let st_next = step.state_new
        let c_now = st_next.blood

        if c_now > cmax {
            cmax = c_now
        }

        auc = auc + ((c_prev + c_now) / 2.0) * dt_use
        c_prev = c_now

        st = st_next
        t = t + dt_use
    }

    let clearance = if auc > 1e-12 { dose / auc } else { 0.0 }
    let vdss = pbpk_total_volume(prm)
    let half_life = if clearance > 1e-12 {
        0.693 * vdss / clearance
    } else {
        0.0
    }

    SimulationResult {
        cmax: cmax,
        auc: auc,
        half_life: half_life,
        clearance: clearance,
        vdss: vdss,
        final_state: st,
        success: cmax > 0.0 && auc > 0.0 && clearance > 0.0,
    }
}

fn pbpk_invariant_report(result: SimulationResult) -> PbpkInvariantReport {
    var out = pbpk_invariant_report_empty()

    out.non_negative_state = state_non_negative(result.final_state)
    out.finite_outputs =
        finite_like(result.cmax) && finite_like(result.auc) && finite_like(result.half_life) &&
        finite_like(result.clearance) && finite_like(result.vdss) && state_finite(result.final_state)

    // Reference case 1 is IV bolus: concentration should not increase above Cmax at end.
    out.route_constraints_ok = result.cmax >= result.final_state.blood && result.final_state.blood >= 0.0

    out.success = result.success && out.non_negative_state && out.finite_outputs && out.route_constraints_ok
    out
}


// === FILE: stdlib/darwin_pbpk/simulation.sio ===
// simulation.sio — Darwin PBPK simulation module
// Rewritten in Sounio syntax

fn dpbpk_simulation_exp(x: f64) -> f64 {
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 20 { term = term * x / (i as f64); result = result + term; i = i + 1 }
    result
}

fn dpbpk_simulation_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn dpbpk_simulation_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn dpbpk_simulation_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn dpbpk_simulation_clamp(x: f64, lo: f64, hi: f64) -> f64 { if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x } }

struct Simulation_State {
    concentration: f64,
    flow_in: f64,
    flow_out: f64,
    volume: f64,
    kp: f64,
}

fn simulation_state_new(vol: f64, kp: f64) -> Simulation_State {
    Simulation_State { concentration: 0.0, flow_in: 0.0, flow_out: 0.0, volume: vol, kp: kp }
}

fn simulation_compute_flux(c_arterial: f64, c_tissue: f64, kp: f64, blood_flow: f64) -> f64 {
    blood_flow * (c_arterial - c_tissue / kp)
}

fn simulation_update(state: Simulation_State, c_arterial: f64, blood_flow: f64, dt: f64) -> Simulation_State with Div, Panic, Mut {
    let flux = simulation_compute_flux(c_arterial, state.concentration, state.kp, blood_flow)
    var new_state = state
    new_state.concentration = state.concentration + dt * flux / state.volume
    if new_state.concentration < 0.0 { new_state.concentration = 0.0 }
    new_state.flow_in = dpbpk_simulation_max(flux, 0.0)
    new_state.flow_out = dpbpk_simulation_abs(dpbpk_simulation_min(flux, 0.0))
    new_state
}

fn test_simulation_flux_positive() -> bool with Div, Panic, Mut {
    let flux = simulation_compute_flux(10.0, 5.0, 2.0, 90.0)
    flux > 0.0
}

fn test_simulation_zero_init() -> bool {
    let s = simulation_state_new(1.5, 5.0)
    s.concentration == 0.0 && s.volume == 1.5
}

// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn max_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { return a }
    return b
}

fn min_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { return a }
    return b
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    return y
}

fn fifth_root(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = 1.0
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    y = y - (y * y * y * y * y - x) / (5.0 * y * y * y * y)
    return y
}

// ============================================================================
// 14-COMPARTMENT STATE VECTOR
// ============================================================================
// Indices: 0=blood, 1=liver, 2=kidney, 3=brain, 4=heart, 5=lung,
//          6=muscle, 7=adipose, 8=gut, 9=skin, 10=bone, 11=spleen,
//          12=pancreas, 13=other

struct PBPKState14 {
    blood: f64,
    liver: f64,
    kidney: f64,
    brain: f64,
    heart: f64,
    lung: f64,
    muscle: f64,
    adipose: f64,
    gut: f64,
    skin: f64,
    bone: f64,
    spleen: f64,
    pancreas: f64,
    other: f64
}

fn pbpk_state_zero() -> PBPKState14 {
    return PBPKState14 {
        blood: 0.0, liver: 0.0, kidney: 0.0, brain: 0.0, heart: 0.0,
        lung: 0.0, muscle: 0.0, adipose: 0.0, gut: 0.0, skin: 0.0,
        bone: 0.0, spleen: 0.0, pancreas: 0.0, other: 0.0
    }
}

fn pbpk_state_add(a: PBPKState14, b: PBPKState14) -> PBPKState14 {
    return PBPKState14 {
        blood: a.blood + b.blood, liver: a.liver + b.liver,
        kidney: a.kidney + b.kidney, brain: a.brain + b.brain,
        heart: a.heart + b.heart, lung: a.lung + b.lung,
        muscle: a.muscle + b.muscle, adipose: a.adipose + b.adipose,
        gut: a.gut + b.gut, skin: a.skin + b.skin,
        bone: a.bone + b.bone, spleen: a.spleen + b.spleen,
        pancreas: a.pancreas + b.pancreas, other: a.other + b.other
    }
}

fn pbpk_state_scale(s: PBPKState14, factor: f64) -> PBPKState14 {
    return PBPKState14 {
        blood: s.blood * factor, liver: s.liver * factor,
        kidney: s.kidney * factor, brain: s.brain * factor,
        heart: s.heart * factor, lung: s.lung * factor,
        muscle: s.muscle * factor, adipose: s.adipose * factor,
        gut: s.gut * factor, skin: s.skin * factor,
        bone: s.bone * factor, spleen: s.spleen * factor,
        pancreas: s.pancreas * factor, other: s.other * factor
    }
}

fn pbpk_state_total_mass(s: PBPKState14, prm: PBPKParams14) -> f64 {
    return s.blood * prm.v_blood + s.liver * prm.v_liver + s.kidney * prm.v_kidney
         + s.brain * prm.v_brain + s.heart * prm.v_heart + s.lung * prm.v_lung
         + s.muscle * prm.v_muscle + s.adipose * prm.v_adipose + s.gut * prm.v_gut
         + s.skin * prm.v_skin + s.bone * prm.v_bone + s.spleen * prm.v_spleen
         + s.pancreas * prm.v_pancreas + s.other * prm.v_other
}

// ============================================================================
// PBPK PARAMETERS
// ============================================================================

struct PBPKParams14 {
    // Volumes (L) - 70kg adult reference
    v_blood: f64,
    v_liver: f64,
    v_kidney: f64,
    v_brain: f64,
    v_heart: f64,
    v_lung: f64,
    v_muscle: f64,
    v_adipose: f64,
    v_gut: f64,
    v_skin: f64,
    v_bone: f64,
    v_spleen: f64,
    v_pancreas: f64,
    v_other: f64,

    // Blood flows (L/h)
    q_liver: f64,
    q_kidney: f64,
    q_brain: f64,
    q_heart: f64,
    q_lung: f64,
    q_muscle: f64,
    q_adipose: f64,
    q_gut: f64,
    q_skin: f64,
    q_bone: f64,
    q_spleen: f64,
    q_pancreas: f64,
    q_other: f64,

    // Partition coefficients (Kp)
    kp_liver: f64,
    kp_kidney: f64,
    kp_brain: f64,
    kp_heart: f64,
    kp_lung: f64,
    kp_muscle: f64,
    kp_adipose: f64,
    kp_gut: f64,
    kp_skin: f64,
    kp_bone: f64,
    kp_spleen: f64,
    kp_pancreas: f64,
    kp_other: f64,

    // Clearance (L/h)
    cl_hepatic: f64,
    cl_renal: f64,

    // Blood binding
    fu_plasma: f64,
    rb_ratio: f64
}

// Default parameters for 70kg adult
fn default_pbpk_params() -> PBPKParams14 {
    return PBPKParams14 {
        // Volumes (L)
        v_blood: 5.0,
        v_liver: 1.8,
        v_kidney: 0.31,
        v_brain: 1.4,
        v_heart: 0.33,
        v_lung: 0.5,
        v_muscle: 30.0,
        v_adipose: 15.0,
        v_gut: 1.1,
        v_skin: 3.3,
        v_bone: 10.0,
        v_spleen: 0.18,
        v_pancreas: 0.1,
        v_other: 5.0,

        // Blood flows (L/h)
        q_liver: 90.0,
        q_kidney: 60.0,
        q_brain: 50.0,
        q_heart: 20.0,
        q_lung: 300.0,
        q_muscle: 75.0,
        q_adipose: 12.0,
        q_gut: 45.0,
        q_skin: 10.0,
        q_bone: 5.0,
        q_spleen: 15.0,
        q_pancreas: 5.0,
        q_other: 20.0,

        // Partition coefficients (default = 1.0)
        kp_liver: 1.0,
        kp_kidney: 1.0,
        kp_brain: 0.5,   // BBB limits penetration
        kp_heart: 1.0,
        kp_lung: 1.0,
        kp_muscle: 0.8,
        kp_adipose: 0.2, // Lipophilicity dependent
        kp_gut: 1.0,
        kp_skin: 0.7,
        kp_bone: 0.3,
        kp_spleen: 1.0,
        kp_pancreas: 1.0,
        kp_other: 1.0,

        // Clearance
        cl_hepatic: 10.0,  // L/h
        cl_renal: 5.0,     // L/h

        // Blood binding
        fu_plasma: 0.5,    // 50% unbound
        rb_ratio: 1.0      // Blood:Plasma = 1 (no RBC binding)
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// PBPK ODE SYSTEM
// ============================================================================

fn pbpk_ode(st: PBPKState14, t: f64, prm: PBPKParams14) -> PBPKState14 {
    let c_blood = st.blood
    let c_plasma = c_blood / prm.rb_ratio
    let c_unbound = c_plasma * prm.fu_plasma

    // Derivatives for each compartment
    var d_blood = 0.0

    // Liver: dC/dt = (Q/V)(C_plasma - C/Kp)
    let d_liver = (prm.q_liver / prm.v_liver) * (c_plasma - st.liver / prm.kp_liver)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_liver / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.liver / prm.kp_liver)

    // Kidney
    let d_kidney = (prm.q_kidney / prm.v_kidney) * (c_plasma - st.kidney / prm.kp_kidney)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_kidney / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.kidney / prm.kp_kidney)

    // Brain
    let d_brain = (prm.q_brain / prm.v_brain) * (c_plasma - st.brain / prm.kp_brain)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_brain / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.brain / prm.kp_brain)

    // Heart
    let d_heart = (prm.q_heart / prm.v_heart) * (c_plasma - st.heart / prm.kp_heart)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_heart / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.heart / prm.kp_heart)

    // Lung
    let d_lung = (prm.q_lung / prm.v_lung) * (c_plasma - st.lung / prm.kp_lung)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_lung / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.lung / prm.kp_lung)

    // Muscle
    let d_muscle = (prm.q_muscle / prm.v_muscle) * (c_plasma - st.muscle / prm.kp_muscle)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_muscle / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.muscle / prm.kp_muscle)

    // Adipose
    let d_adipose = (prm.q_adipose / prm.v_adipose) * (c_plasma - st.adipose / prm.kp_adipose)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_adipose / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.adipose / prm.kp_adipose)

    // Gut
    let d_gut = (prm.q_gut / prm.v_gut) * (c_plasma - st.gut / prm.kp_gut)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_gut / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.gut / prm.kp_gut)

    // Skin
    let d_skin = (prm.q_skin / prm.v_skin) * (c_plasma - st.skin / prm.kp_skin)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_skin / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.skin / prm.kp_skin)

    // Bone
    let d_bone = (prm.q_bone / prm.v_bone) * (c_plasma - st.bone / prm.kp_bone)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_bone / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.bone / prm.kp_bone)

    // Spleen
    let d_spleen = (prm.q_spleen / prm.v_spleen) * (c_plasma - st.spleen / prm.kp_spleen)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_spleen / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.spleen / prm.kp_spleen)

    // Pancreas
    let d_pancreas = (prm.q_pancreas / prm.v_pancreas) * (c_plasma - st.pancreas / prm.kp_pancreas)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_pancreas / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.pancreas / prm.kp_pancreas)

    // Other
    let d_other = (prm.q_other / prm.v_other) * (c_plasma - st.other / prm.kp_other)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.q_other / prm.v_blood) * prm.rb_ratio * (c_plasma - st.other / prm.kp_other)

    // Hepatic clearance (unbound drug)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.cl_hepatic / prm.v_blood) * c_unbound * prm.rb_ratio

    // Renal clearance (unbound drug)
    d_blood = d_blood - (prm.cl_renal / prm.v_blood) * c_unbound * prm.rb_ratio

    return PBPKState14 {
        blood: d_blood, liver: d_liver, kidney: d_kidney, brain: d_brain,
        heart: d_heart, lung: d_lung, muscle: d_muscle, adipose: d_adipose,
        gut: d_gut, skin: d_skin, bone: d_bone, spleen: d_spleen,
        pancreas: d_pancreas, other: d_other
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// TSIT5 STEP FOR 14-COMPARTMENT SYSTEM
// ============================================================================

struct Tsit5StepResult14 {
    state_new: PBPKState14,
    err: PBPKState14
}

fn tsit5_step_pbpk(st_in: PBPKState14, t: f64, dt: f64, prm: PBPKParams14) -> Tsit5StepResult14 {
    // Stage 1
    let k1 = pbpk_ode(st_in, t, prm)

    // Stage 2
    let stage2_state = pbpk_state_add(st_in, pbpk_state_scale(k1, dt * tsit5_a21()))
    let k2 = pbpk_ode(stage2_state, t + tsit5_c2() * dt, prm)

    // Stage 3
    let stage3_state = pbpk_state_add(st_in,
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k1, dt * tsit5_a31()),
                       pbpk_state_scale(k2, dt * tsit5_a32())))
    let k3 = pbpk_ode(stage3_state, t + tsit5_c3() * dt, prm)

    // Stage 4
    let stage4_state = pbpk_state_add(st_in,
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k1, dt * tsit5_a41()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k2, dt * tsit5_a42()),
                       pbpk_state_scale(k3, dt * tsit5_a43()))))
    let k4 = pbpk_ode(stage4_state, t + tsit5_c4() * dt, prm)

    // Stage 5
    let stage5_state = pbpk_state_add(st_in,
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k1, dt * tsit5_a51()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k2, dt * tsit5_a52()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k3, dt * tsit5_a53()),
                       pbpk_state_scale(k4, dt * tsit5_a54())))))
    let k5 = pbpk_ode(stage5_state, t + tsit5_c5() * dt, prm)

    // Stage 6
    let stage6_state = pbpk_state_add(st_in,
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k1, dt * tsit5_a61()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k2, dt * tsit5_a62()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k3, dt * tsit5_a63()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k4, dt * tsit5_a64()),
                       pbpk_state_scale(k5, dt * tsit5_a65()))))))
    let k6 = pbpk_ode(stage6_state, t + tsit5_c6() * dt, prm)

    // Stage 7
    let stage7_state = pbpk_state_add(st_in,
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k1, dt * tsit5_a71()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k2, dt * tsit5_a72()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k3, dt * tsit5_a73()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k4, dt * tsit5_a74()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k5, dt * tsit5_a75()),
                       pbpk_state_scale(k6, dt * tsit5_a76())))))))
    let k7 = pbpk_ode(stage7_state, t + tsit5_c7() * dt, prm)

    // 5th order solution (same as stage 7 position for FSAL)
    let state_new = stage7_state

    // Error estimate
    let err = pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k1, dt * tsit5_e1()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k2, dt * tsit5_e2()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k3, dt * tsit5_e3()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k4, dt * tsit5_e4()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k5, dt * tsit5_e5()),
        pbpk_state_add(pbpk_state_scale(k6, dt * tsit5_e6()),
                       pbpk_state_scale(k7, dt * tsit5_e7())))))))

    return Tsit5StepResult14 { state_new: state_new, err: err }
}

// ============================================================================
// ERROR NORM AND STEP SIZE CONTROL
// ============================================================================

fn compute_error_norm_14(
    err: PBPKState14,
    state_old: PBPKState14,
    state_new: PBPKState14,
    rtol: f64,
    atol: f64
) -> f64 {
    // RMS error norm: sqrt(1/N * sum((err_i / scale_i)^2))
    // scale_i = atol + rtol * max(|old_i|, |new_i|)

    let s0 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.blood), abs_f64(state_new.blood))
    let s1 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.liver), abs_f64(state_new.liver))
    let s2 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.kidney), abs_f64(state_new.kidney))
    let s3 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.brain), abs_f64(state_new.brain))
    let s4 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.heart), abs_f64(state_new.heart))
    let s5 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.lung), abs_f64(state_new.lung))
    let s6 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.muscle), abs_f64(state_new.muscle))
    let s7 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.adipose), abs_f64(state_new.adipose))
    let s8 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.gut), abs_f64(state_new.gut))
    let s9 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.skin), abs_f64(state_new.skin))
    let s10 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.bone), abs_f64(state_new.bone))
    let s11 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.spleen), abs_f64(state_new.spleen))
    let s12 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.pancreas), abs_f64(state_new.pancreas))
    let s13 = atol + rtol * max_f64(abs_f64(state_old.other), abs_f64(state_new.other))

    let e0 = err.blood / s0
    let e1 = err.liver / s1
    let e2 = err.kidney / s2
    let e3 = err.brain / s3
    let e4 = err.heart / s4
    let e5 = err.lung / s5
    let e6 = err.muscle / s6
    let e7 = err.adipose / s7
    let e8 = err.gut / s8
    let e9 = err.skin / s9
    let e10 = err.bone / s10
    let e11 = err.spleen / s11
    let e12 = err.pancreas / s12
    let e13 = err.other / s13

    let sum_sq = e0*e0 + e1*e1 + e2*e2 + e3*e3 + e4*e4 + e5*e5 + e6*e6
               + e7*e7 + e8*e8 + e9*e9 + e10*e10 + e11*e11 + e12*e12 + e13*e13

    return sqrt_f64(sum_sq / 14.0)
}

fn optimal_step_14(dt: f64, err_norm: f64, safety: f64, max_growth: f64, min_shrink: f64) -> f64 {
    if err_norm <= 0.0 {
        return dt * max_growth
    }
    let factor = safety * fifth_root(1.0 / err_norm)
    let factor_limited = max_f64(min_shrink, min_f64(max_growth, factor))
    return dt * factor_limited
}

// ============================================================================
// SOLVER CONFIGURATION AND SOLUTION
// ============================================================================

struct ODEConfig14 {
    rtol: f64,
    atol: f64,
    dt_init: f64,
    dt_min: f64,
    dt_max: f64,
    max_steps: i64,
    safety: f64,
    max_growth: f64,
    min_shrink: f64
}

fn default_ode_config() -> ODEConfig14 {
    return ODEConfig14 {
        rtol: 0.01,            // 1% relative tolerance (looser for PBPK)
        atol: 0.0001,          // 1e-4
        dt_init: 0.01,         // Larger initial step
        dt_min: 0.0000001,     // 1e-7
        dt_max: 1.0,
        max_steps: 100000,
        safety: 0.9,
        max_growth: 10.0,      // Allow faster growth
        min_shrink: 0.1
    }
}

struct PBPKSolution14 {
    success: bool,
    nsteps: i64,
    nfeval: i64,
    nreject: i64,
    t_final: f64,
    state_final: PBPKState14
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN SOLVER
// ============================================================================

fn solve_pbpk14(
    dose_mg: f64,
    t_end: f64,
    prm: PBPKParams14,
    cfg: ODEConfig14
) -> PBPKSolution14 {
    // Initial condition: all drug in blood compartment
    let c0_blood = dose_mg / prm.v_blood
    var st = PBPKState14 {
        blood: c0_blood, liver: 0.0, kidney: 0.0, brain: 0.0, heart: 0.0,
        lung: 0.0, muscle: 0.0, adipose: 0.0, gut: 0.0, skin: 0.0,
        bone: 0.0, spleen: 0.0, pancreas: 0.0, other: 0.0
    }

    var t = 0.0
    var dt = cfg.dt_init
    var nsteps = 0
    var nfeval = 0
    var nreject = 0

    while t < t_end && nsteps < cfg.max_steps {
        let dt_use = if t + dt > t_end { t_end - t } else { dt }

        let result = tsit5_step_pbpk(st, t, dt_use, prm)
        nfeval = nfeval + 7

        let err_norm = compute_error_norm_14(result.err, st, result.state_new, cfg.rtol, cfg.atol)

        if err_norm <= 1.0 {
            // Accept step
            t = t + dt_use
            st = result.state_new
            nsteps = nsteps + 1
            dt = optimal_step_14(dt_use, err_norm, cfg.safety, cfg.max_growth, cfg.min_shrink)
        } else {
            // Reject step
            nreject = nreject + 1
            dt = optimal_step_14(dt_use, err_norm, cfg.safety, cfg.max_growth, cfg.min_shrink)
        }

        dt = max_f64(cfg.dt_min, min_f64(cfg.dt_max, dt))

        // Fail-safe: if too many rejections, something is wrong
        if nreject > 1000 {
            return PBPKSolution14 {
                success: false,
                nsteps: nsteps,
                nfeval: nfeval,
                nreject: nreject,
                t_final: t,
                state_final: st
            }
        }
    }

    let success = t >= t_end - cfg.dt_min

    return PBPKSolution14 {
        success: success,
        nsteps: nsteps,
        nfeval: nfeval,
        nreject: nreject,
        t_final: t,
        state_final: st
    }
}
