// === FILE: stdlib/fmri/connectivity.sio ===
// fmri::connectivity — Functional Connectivity Analysis
//
// ROI-to-ROI connectivity for resting-state fMRI.
// With uncertainty quantification via bootstrap.
//
// References:
// - Biswal et al. (1995): "Functional connectivity in the motor cortex..."
// - Power et al. (2011): "Functional network organization"

// Math helpers inlined

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var r = x
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r
}

fn fmri_exp_inner(x: f64) -> f64 {
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var i = 1
    while i < 20 {
        term = term * x / (i as f64)
        result = result + term
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

fn fmri_log_inner(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var v = x
    var scale = 0.0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.718281828; scale = scale + 1.0 }
    while v < 0.5 { v = v * 2.718281828; scale = scale - 1.0 }
    let y = (v - 1.0) / (v + 1.0)
    let y2 = y * y
    let result = 2.0 * y * (1.0 + y2 / 3.0 + y2 * y2 / 5.0 + y2 * y2 * y2 / 7.0 + y2 * y2 * y2 * y2 / 9.0)
    result + scale
}

fn fisher_z(r: f64) -> f64 {
    var rc = r
    if rc > 0.999 { rc = 0.999 }
    if rc < 0.0 - 0.999 { rc = 0.0 - 0.999 }
    0.5 * fmri_log_inner((1.0 + rc) / (1.0 - rc))
}

fn fisher_z_inv(z: f64) -> f64 {
    let e2z = fmri_exp_inner(2.0 * z)
    (e2z - 1.0) / (e2z + 1.0)
}

fn fisher_z_se(n: i64) -> f64 {
    if n < 4 { return 1.0 }
    1.0 / sqrt_f64((n - 3) as f64)
}

// ============================================================================
// CORRELATION
// ============================================================================

// Compute Pearson correlation between two vectors
fn pearson_corr(x: [f64; 100], y: [f64; 100], n: i64) -> f64 {
    var sum_x = 0.0
    var sum_y = 0.0
    var sum_xx = 0.0
    var sum_yy = 0.0
    var sum_xy = 0.0

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        sum_x = sum_x + x[i as usize]
        sum_y = sum_y + y[i as usize]
        sum_xx = sum_xx + x[i as usize] * x[i as usize]
        sum_yy = sum_yy + y[i as usize] * y[i as usize]
        sum_xy = sum_xy + x[i as usize] * y[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }

    let nf = n as f64
    let cov_xy = sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y / nf
    let var_x = sum_xx - sum_x * sum_x / nf
    let var_y = sum_yy - sum_y * sum_y / nf

    let denom = sqrt_f64(var_x * var_y)
    if denom > 1e-10 {
        return cov_xy / denom
    } else {
        return 0.0
    }
}

// fisher_z, fisher_z_inv, fisher_z_se defined in preprocess.sio

// ============================================================================
// CONNECTIVITY RESULT
// ============================================================================

// Connectivity with uncertainty
struct FCResult {
    r: f64,             // Pearson correlation
    z: f64,             // Fisher-z
    se: f64,            // Standard error of z
    ci_lower: f64,      // 95% CI lower (r)
    ci_upper: f64,      // 95% CI upper (r)
}

fn fc_result_new() -> FCResult {
    FCResult {
        r: 0.0,
        z: 0.0,
        se: 0.0,
        ci_lower: 0.0,
        ci_upper: 0.0,
    }
}

// Compute FC with confidence interval
fn compute_fc(x: [f64; 100], y: [f64; 100], n: i64) -> FCResult {
    var result = fc_result_new()

    result.r = pearson_corr(x, y, n)
    result.z = fisher_z(result.r)
    result.se = fisher_z_se(n)

    // 95% CI in z-space
    let z_crit = 1.96
    let z_lower = result.z - z_crit * result.se
    let z_upper = result.z + z_crit * result.se

    // Convert back to r
    result.ci_lower = fisher_z_inv(z_lower)
    result.ci_upper = fisher_z_inv(z_upper)

    result
}

// ============================================================================
// NETWORK METRICS
// ============================================================================

// Mean FC strength from correlation matrix
fn mean_fc_strength_3x3(corr: [[f64; 3]; 3]) -> f64 {
    // Average of upper triangle
    let sum = corr[0][1] + corr[0][2] + corr[1][2]
    sum / 3.0
}

// Node degree (number of significant connections)
fn node_degree(corr_row: [f64; 10], n_nodes: i64, threshold: f64) -> i64 {
    var degree: i64 = 0
    var j: i64 = 0
    while j < n_nodes {
        if abs_f64(corr_row[j as usize]) > threshold {
            degree = degree + 1
        }
        j = j + 1
    }
    degree
}

// ============================================================================
// TESTS


// === FILE: stdlib/fmri/helpers.sio ===
// stdlib/fmri/helpers.sio — fMRI Math Helpers
//
// Math utilities and types for fMRI preprocessing and connectivity analysis.
//
// References:
// - Fisher (1921) "On the probable error of a coefficient of correlation"
// - Power et al. (2012) "Spurious but systematic correlations..."

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn fmri_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 15 {
        y = (y + x / y) / 2.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    y
}

fn fmri_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn fmri_exp(x: f64) -> f64 {
    // Handle overflow/underflow
    if x > 700.0 { return fmri_exp(350.0) * fmri_exp(x - 350.0) }
    if x < -700.0 { return 0.0 }
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var n: i64 = 1
    while n < 30 {
        term = term * x / n as f64
        result = result + term
        n = n + 1
    }
    result
}

fn fmri_log(x: f64) -> f64 {
    // Natural logarithm via Newton's method on y where exp(y) = x
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 1000.0 }
    // Initial guess using range reduction
    var y = 0.0
    var xr = x
    // Bring x into [0.5, 2] range by factoring out powers of e
    while xr > 2.0 {
        xr = xr / 2.718281828459045
        y = y + 1.0
    }
    while xr < 0.5 {
        xr = xr * 2.718281828459045
        y = y - 1.0
    }
    // Newton: y_{n+1} = y_n + (x - exp(y_n)) / exp(y_n)
    // Start with series approximation for xr near 1
    y = y + (xr - 1.0)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 15 {
        let ey = fmri_exp(y)
        if ey > 0.0 {
            y = y + (x - ey) / ey
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    y
}

// ============================================================================
// FISHER Z TRANSFORM
// ============================================================================

// Fisher Z transform: z = 0.5 * ln((1+r)/(1-r))  (arctanh)
fn fisher_z(r: f64) -> f64 {
    let rc = if r > 0.9999 { 0.9999 } else if r < -0.9999 { -0.9999 } else { r }
    0.5 * fmri_log((1.0 + rc) / (1.0 - rc))
}

// Inverse Fisher Z: r = (exp(2z)-1)/(exp(2z)+1)  (tanh)
fn fisher_z_inv(z: f64) -> f64 {
    let e2z = fmri_exp(2.0 * z)
    (e2z - 1.0) / (e2z + 1.0)
}

// Standard error of Fisher Z: SE = 1/sqrt(n-3)
fn fisher_z_se(n: i64) -> f64 {
    if n > 3 {
        1.0 / fmri_sqrt((n - 3) as f64)
    } else {
        1.0
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// EPISTEMIC STATUS
// ============================================================================

struct EpistemicStatus {
    valid: i64,
    confidence: f64,
    n_obs: i64
}

fn epistemic_status_new(valid: i64, confidence: f64, n: i64) -> EpistemicStatus {
    EpistemicStatus {
        valid: valid,
        confidence: confidence,
        n_obs: n
    }
}

fn epistemic_is_valid(s: EpistemicStatus) -> bool {
    s.valid == 1
}

// ============================================================================
// MOTION PARAMETERS
// ============================================================================

struct MotionParams6 {
    tx: f64,
    ty: f64,
    tz: f64,
    rx: f64,
    ry: f64,
    rz: f64
}

fn motion_params_zero() -> MotionParams6 {
    MotionParams6 {
        tx: 0.0,
        ty: 0.0,
        tz: 0.0,
        rx: 0.0,
        ry: 0.0,
        rz: 0.0
    }
}

fn motion_magnitude(m: MotionParams6) -> f64 {
    fmri_sqrt(
        m.tx * m.tx + m.ty * m.ty + m.tz * m.tz +
        m.rx * m.rx + m.ry * m.ry + m.rz * m.rz
    )
}

// ============================================================================
// INLINE TESTS
// ============================================================================

// Test: fisher_z round-trip: fisher_z_inv(fisher_z(r)) ≈ r
fn test_fisher_z_roundtrip() -> bool {
    let r = 0.75
    let z = fisher_z(r)
    let r2 = fisher_z_inv(z)
    fmri_abs(r2 - r) < 0.001
}

// Test: fisher_z(0) = 0
fn test_fisher_z_zero() -> bool {
    let z = fisher_z(0.0)
    fmri_abs(z) < 0.001
}

// Test: fisher_z_inv(0) = 0
fn test_fisher_z_inv_zero() -> bool {
    let r = fisher_z_inv(0.0)
    fmri_abs(r) < 0.001
}

// Test: motion_magnitude of zero motion is 0
fn test_motion_zero() -> bool {
    let m = motion_params_zero()
    let mag = motion_magnitude(m)
    fmri_abs(mag) < 0.0001
}

// Test: motion_magnitude of unit translation
fn test_motion_unit() -> bool {
    let m = MotionParams6 {
        tx: 1.0,
        ty: 0.0,
        tz: 0.0,
        rx: 0.0,
        ry: 0.0,
        rz: 0.0
    }
    let mag = motion_magnitude(m)
    fmri_abs(mag - 1.0) < 0.0001
}

// Test: fisher_z_se decreases with sample size
fn test_fisher_z_se_decreasing() -> bool {
    let se1 = fisher_z_se(10)
    let se2 = fisher_z_se(100)
    se2 < se1
}

// Test: fmri_exp(0) = 1
fn test_fmri_exp_zero() -> bool {
    fmri_abs(fmri_exp(0.0) - 1.0) < 0.0001
}

// Test: fmri_log(e) ≈ 1
fn test_fmri_log_e() -> bool {
    let e = 2.718281828459045
    fmri_abs(fmri_log(e) - 1.0) < 0.001
}

// Test: fmri_log(exp(x)) ≈ x round-trip
fn test_log_exp_roundtrip() -> bool {
    let x = 2.5
    let r = fmri_log(fmri_exp(x))
    fmri_abs(r - x) < 0.01
}


// === FILE: stdlib/fmri/mod.sio ===
//! stdlib/fmri

module fmri


// === FILE: stdlib/fmri/nifti.sio ===
// fmri::nifti — Native NIfTI parsing for tiny real-pipeline fixtures.
//
// This implementation is intentionally strict and small-scope for reliability gates:
// - NIfTI-1 (.nii) and NIfTI-2 (.nii)
// - uint8 voxel payload only (datatype=2, bitpix=8)
// - bounded image sizes for deterministic CI/runtime behavior

// ============================================================================
// NIFTI PARSE TYPES
// ============================================================================

enum NiftiVersion {
    Nifti1,
    Nifti2,
}

enum NiftiEndian {
    Little,
    Big,
}

enum NiftiError {
    BadMagic,
    UnsupportedDatatype,
    InvalidDims,
    TruncatedFile,
    UnsupportedFeature,
}

fn nifti_error_code(err: NiftiError) -> i64 {
    if err == NiftiError::BadMagic { return 1 }
    if err == NiftiError::UnsupportedDatatype { return 2 }
    if err == NiftiError::InvalidDims { return 3 }
    if err == NiftiError::TruncatedFile { return 4 }
    5
}

fn nifti_error_from_code(code: i64) -> NiftiError {
    if code == 1 { return NiftiError::BadMagic }
    if code == 2 { return NiftiError::UnsupportedDatatype }
    if code == 3 { return NiftiError::InvalidDims }
    if code == 4 { return NiftiError::TruncatedFile }
    NiftiError::UnsupportedFeature
}

struct NiftiHeader {
    version: NiftiVersion,
    endian: NiftiEndian,
    sizeof_hdr: i64,
    datatype: i64,
    bitpix: i64,
    nx: i64,
    ny: i64,
    nz: i64,
    nt: i64,
    vox_offset: i64,
    qform_code: i64,
    sform_code: i64,
}

fn nifti_header_new() -> NiftiHeader {
    NiftiHeader {
        version: NiftiVersion::Nifti1,
        endian: NiftiEndian::Little,
        sizeof_hdr: 0,
        datatype: 0,
        bitpix: 0,
        nx: 0,
        ny: 0,
        nz: 0,
        nt: 1,
        vox_offset: 0,
        qform_code: 0,
        sform_code: 0,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// NIFTI IMAGE
// ============================================================================

// Bounded image payload for deterministic CI fixtures.
struct NiftiImage {
    nx: i64,
    ny: i64,
    nz: i64,
    nt: i64,
    nvox_3d: i64,
    nvox_total: i64,
    dx: f64,
    dy: f64,
    dz: f64,
    tr: f64,
    xform: [[f64; 4]; 4],
    data: [f64; 4096],
}

fn nifti_image_new() -> NiftiImage {
    NiftiImage {
        nx: 0,
        ny: 0,
        nz: 0,
        nt: 1,
        nvox_3d: 0,
        nvox_total: 0,
        dx: 1.0,
        dy: 1.0,
        dz: 1.0,
        tr: 1.0,
        xform: [[0.0; 4]; 4],
        data: [0.0; 4096],
    }
}

fn nifti_create(nx: i64, ny: i64, nz: i64) -> NiftiImage {
    var img = nifti_image_new()
    img.nx = nx
    img.ny = ny
    img.nz = nz
    img.nt = 1
    img.nvox_3d = nx * ny * nz
    img.nvox_total = img.nvox_3d
    img.xform[0][0] = 1.0
    img.xform[1][1] = 1.0
    img.xform[2][2] = 1.0
    img.xform[3][3] = 1.0
    img
}

// Runtime-safe file ingestion buffer. `len` tracks valid bytes in `data`.
struct NiftiFileBuffer {
    data: [u8; 65536],
    len: i64,
}

fn nifti_file_buffer_new() -> NiftiFileBuffer {
    NiftiFileBuffer {
        data: [0; 65536],
        len: 0,
    }
}

fn nifti_str_byte_u8(src: [i8; 0], idx: i64) -> i64 {
    if idx < 0 || idx >= src.len() as i64 {
        return 0
    }
    let raw = src[idx as usize] as i64
    if raw < 0 { raw + 256 } else { raw }
}

fn nifti_read_file_buffer_into(path: string, out: &!NiftiFileBuffer) -> i64 with Panic, Div, Mut, Div, Mut, Panic, IO {
    let size = file_size(path)
    if size <= 0 {
        return nifti_error_code(NiftiError::TruncatedFile)
    }
    if size > 65536 {
        return nifti_error_code(NiftiError::UnsupportedFeature)
    }

    let raw = read_file(path)
    let raw_len = raw.len() as i64
    if raw_len < size {
        return nifti_error_code(NiftiError::TruncatedFile)
    }

    out.len = size
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < size {
        out.data[i as usize] = nifti_str_byte_u8(raw, i) as u8
        i = i + 1
    }
    0
}

fn nifti_read_file_buffer(path: string) -> Result<NiftiFileBuffer, NiftiError> with Panic, Div, Mut, IO {
    var out = nifti_file_buffer_new()
    let code = nifti_read_file_buffer_into(path, &!out)
    if code == 0 {
        Ok(out)
    } else {
        Err(nifti_error_from_code(code))
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// BYTE HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn byte_u8(bytes: &[u8], idx: i64) -> i64 {
    if idx < 0 || idx >= bytes.len() as i64 {
        return 0
    }
    let raw = bytes[idx as usize] as i64
    if raw < 0 { raw + 256 } else { raw }
}

fn read_u16_le(bytes: &[u8], off: i64) -> i64 {
    let b0 = byte_u8(bytes, off)
    let b1 = byte_u8(bytes, off + 1)
    b0 | (b1 << 8)
}

fn read_u16_be(bytes: &[u8], off: i64) -> i64 {
    let b0 = byte_u8(bytes, off)
    let b1 = byte_u8(bytes, off + 1)
    (b0 << 8) | b1
}

fn read_i16(bytes: &[u8], off: i64, endian: NiftiEndian) -> i64 {
    let u = if endian == NiftiEndian::Little {
        read_u16_le(bytes, off)
    } else {
        read_u16_be(bytes, off)
    }
    if u >= 32768 { u - 65536 } else { u }
}

fn read_u32_le(bytes: &[u8], off: i64) -> i64 {
    let b0 = byte_u8(bytes, off)
    let b1 = byte_u8(bytes, off + 1)
    let b2 = byte_u8(bytes, off + 2)
    let b3 = byte_u8(bytes, off + 3)
    b0 | (b1 << 8) | (b2 << 16) | (b3 << 24)
}

fn read_u32_be(bytes: &[u8], off: i64) -> i64 {
    let b0 = byte_u8(bytes, off)
    let b1 = byte_u8(bytes, off + 1)
    let b2 = byte_u8(bytes, off + 2)
    let b3 = byte_u8(bytes, off + 3)
    (b0 << 24) | (b1 << 16) | (b2 << 8) | b3
}

fn read_i32(bytes: &[u8], off: i64, endian: NiftiEndian) -> i64 {
    let u = if endian == NiftiEndian::Little {
        read_u32_le(bytes, off)
    } else {
        read_u32_be(bytes, off)
    }
    if u >= 2147483648 { u - 4294967296 } else { u }
}

fn read_u64_le(bytes: &[u8], off: i64) -> i64 {
    let lo = read_u32_le(bytes, off)
    let hi = read_u32_le(bytes, off + 4)
    lo | (hi << 32)
}

fn read_u64_be(bytes: &[u8], off: i64) -> i64 {
    let hi = read_u32_be(bytes, off)
    let lo = read_u32_be(bytes, off + 4)
    (hi << 32) | lo
}

fn read_i64(bytes: &[u8], off: i64, endian: NiftiEndian) -> i64 {
    if endian == NiftiEndian::Little {
        read_u64_le(bytes, off)
    } else {
        read_u64_be(bytes, off)
    }
}

fn has_nifti1_magic(bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
    if bytes.len() < 348 { return false }
    let b0 = byte_u8(bytes, 344)
    let b1 = byte_u8(bytes, 345)
    let b2 = byte_u8(bytes, 346)
    // "n+1" or "ni1"
    b0 == 110 && ((b1 == 43 && b2 == 49) || (b1 == 105 && b2 == 49))
}

fn has_nifti2_magic(bytes: &[u8]) -> bool {
    if bytes.len() < 12 { return false }
    byte_u8(bytes, 4) == 110 &&
    byte_u8(bytes, 5) == 43 &&
    byte_u8(bytes, 6) == 50 &&
    byte_u8(bytes, 7) == 0
}

fn file_byte_u8(buf: &NiftiFileBuffer, idx: i64) -> i64 {
    if idx < 0 || idx >= buf.len {
        return 0
    }
    let raw = buf.data[idx as usize] as i64
    if raw < 0 { raw + 256 } else { raw }
}

fn read_u16_le_file(buf: &NiftiFileBuffer, off: i64) -> i64 {
    let b0 = file_byte_u8(buf, off)
    let b1 = file_byte_u8(buf, off + 1)
    b0 | (b1 << 8)
}

fn read_u16_be_file(buf: &NiftiFileBuffer, off: i64) -> i64 {
    let b0 = file_byte_u8(buf, off)
    let b1 = file_byte_u8(buf, off + 1)
    (b0 << 8) | b1
}

fn read_i16_file(buf: &NiftiFileBuffer, off: i64, endian: NiftiEndian) -> i64 {
    let u = if endian == NiftiEndian::Little {
        read_u16_le_file(buf, off)
    } else {
        read_u16_be_file(buf, off)
    }
    if u >= 32768 { u - 65536 } else { u }
}

fn read_u32_le_file(buf: &NiftiFileBuffer, off: i64) -> i64 {
    let b0 = file_byte_u8(buf, off)
    let b1 = file_byte_u8(buf, off + 1)
    let b2 = file_byte_u8(buf, off + 2)
    let b3 = file_byte_u8(buf, off + 3)
    b0 | (b1 << 8) | (b2 << 16) | (b3 << 24)
}

fn read_u32_be_file(buf: &NiftiFileBuffer, off: i64) -> i64 {
    let b0 = file_byte_u8(buf, off)
    let b1 = file_byte_u8(buf, off + 1)
    let b2 = file_byte_u8(buf, off + 2)
    let b3 = file_byte_u8(buf, off + 3)
    (b0 << 24) | (b1 << 16) | (b2 << 8) | b3
}

fn read_i32_file(buf: &NiftiFileBuffer, off: i64, endian: NiftiEndian) -> i64 {
    let u = if endian == NiftiEndian::Little {
        read_u32_le_file(buf, off)
    } else {
        read_u32_be_file(buf, off)
    }
    if u >= 2147483648 { u - 4294967296 } else { u }
}

fn read_u64_le_file(buf: &NiftiFileBuffer, off: i64) -> i64 {
    let lo = read_u32_le_file(buf, off)
    let hi = read_u32_le_file(buf, off + 4)
    lo | (hi << 32)
}

fn read_u64_be_file(buf: &NiftiFileBuffer, off: i64) -> i64 {
    let hi = read_u32_be_file(buf, off)
    let lo = read_u32_be_file(buf, off + 4)
    (hi << 32) | lo
}

fn read_i64_file(buf: &NiftiFileBuffer, off: i64, endian: NiftiEndian) -> i64 {
    if endian == NiftiEndian::Little {
        read_u64_le_file(buf, off)
    } else {
        read_u64_be_file(buf, off)
    }
}

fn has_nifti1_magic_file(buf: &NiftiFileBuffer) -> bool {
    if buf.len < 348 { return false }
    let b0 = file_byte_u8(buf, 344)
    let b1 = file_byte_u8(buf, 345)
    let b2 = file_byte_u8(buf, 346)
    b0 == 110 && ((b1 == 43 && b2 == 49) || (b1 == 105 && b2 == 49))
}

fn has_nifti2_magic_file(buf: &NiftiFileBuffer) -> bool {
    if buf.len < 12 { return false }
    file_byte_u8(buf, 4) == 110 &&
    file_byte_u8(buf, 5) == 43 &&
    file_byte_u8(buf, 6) == 50 &&
    file_byte_u8(buf, 7) == 0
}

// ============================================================================
// HEADER PARSE
// ============================================================================

fn nifti_parse_header(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<NiftiHeader, NiftiError> {
    if bytes.len() < 352 {
        return Err(NiftiError::TruncatedFile)
    }

    // Detect header size and endianness.
    let sz_le = read_i32(bytes, 0, NiftiEndian::Little)
    let sz_be = read_i32(bytes, 0, NiftiEndian::Big)

    var header = nifti_header_new()
    if sz_le == 348 || sz_le == 540 {
        header.endian = NiftiEndian::Little
        header.sizeof_hdr = sz_le
    } else if sz_be == 348 || sz_be == 540 {
        header.endian = NiftiEndian::Big
        header.sizeof_hdr = sz_be
    } else {
        return Err(NiftiError::BadMagic)
    }

    if header.sizeof_hdr == 348 {
        if !has_nifti1_magic(bytes) {
            return Err(NiftiError::BadMagic)
        }
        header.version = NiftiVersion::Nifti1
        header.datatype = read_i16(bytes, 70, header.endian)
        header.bitpix = read_i16(bytes, 72, header.endian)
        header.nx = read_i16(bytes, 42, header.endian)
        header.ny = read_i16(bytes, 44, header.endian)
        header.nz = read_i16(bytes, 46, header.endian)
        header.nt = read_i16(bytes, 48, header.endian)
        header.vox_offset = 352
        header.qform_code = read_i16(bytes, 252, header.endian)
        header.sform_code = read_i16(bytes, 254, header.endian)
    } else {
        if !has_nifti2_magic(bytes) {
            return Err(NiftiError::BadMagic)
        }
        header.version = NiftiVersion::Nifti2
        header.datatype = read_i16(bytes, 12, header.endian)
        header.bitpix = read_i16(bytes, 14, header.endian)
        header.nx = read_i64(bytes, 24, header.endian)
        header.ny = read_i64(bytes, 32, header.endian)
        header.nz = read_i64(bytes, 40, header.endian)
        header.nt = read_i64(bytes, 48, header.endian)
        header.vox_offset = read_i64(bytes, 168, header.endian)
        header.qform_code = read_i32(bytes, 344, header.endian)
        header.sform_code = read_i32(bytes, 348, header.endian)
    }

    if header.nx <= 0 || header.ny <= 0 || header.nz <= 0 {
        return Err(NiftiError::InvalidDims)
    }
    if header.nt <= 0 {
        header.nt = 1
    }
    if header.vox_offset <= 0 {
        return Err(NiftiError::UnsupportedFeature)
    }
    if header.datatype != 2 || header.bitpix != 8 {
        return Err(NiftiError::UnsupportedDatatype)
    }

    Ok(header)
}

fn nifti_parse_header_buffer_into(buf: &NiftiFileBuffer, out: &!NiftiHeader) -> i64 {
    if buf.len < 352 {
        return nifti_error_code(NiftiError::TruncatedFile)
    }

    let sz_le = read_i32_file(buf, 0, NiftiEndian::Little)
    let sz_be = read_i32_file(buf, 0, NiftiEndian::Big)

    var header = nifti_header_new()
    if sz_le == 348 || sz_le == 540 {
        header.endian = NiftiEndian::Little
        header.sizeof_hdr = sz_le
    } else if sz_be == 348 || sz_be == 540 {
        header.endian = NiftiEndian::Big
        header.sizeof_hdr = sz_be
    } else {
        return nifti_error_code(NiftiError::BadMagic)
    }

    if header.sizeof_hdr == 348 {
        if !has_nifti1_magic_file(buf) {
            return nifti_error_code(NiftiError::BadMagic)
        }
        header.version = NiftiVersion::Nifti1
        header.datatype = read_i16_file(buf, 70, header.endian)
        header.bitpix = read_i16_file(buf, 72, header.endian)
        header.nx = read_i16_file(buf, 42, header.endian)
        header.ny = read_i16_file(buf, 44, header.endian)
        header.nz = read_i16_file(buf, 46, header.endian)
        header.nt = read_i16_file(buf, 48, header.endian)
        header.vox_offset = 352
        header.qform_code = read_i16_file(buf, 252, header.endian)
        header.sform_code = read_i16_file(buf, 254, header.endian)
    } else {
        if buf.len < 540 {
            return nifti_error_code(NiftiError::TruncatedFile)
        }
        if !has_nifti2_magic_file(buf) {
            return nifti_error_code(NiftiError::BadMagic)
        }
        header.version = NiftiVersion::Nifti2
        header.datatype = read_i16_file(buf, 12, header.endian)
        header.bitpix = read_i16_file(buf, 14, header.endian)
        header.nx = read_i64_file(buf, 24, header.endian)
        header.ny = read_i64_file(buf, 32, header.endian)
        header.nz = read_i64_file(buf, 40, header.endian)
        header.nt = read_i64_file(buf, 48, header.endian)
        header.vox_offset = read_i64_file(buf, 168, header.endian)
        header.qform_code = read_i32_file(buf, 344, header.endian)
        header.sform_code = read_i32_file(buf, 348, header.endian)
    }

    if header.nx <= 0 || header.ny <= 0 || header.nz <= 0 {
        return nifti_error_code(NiftiError::InvalidDims)
    }
    if header.nt <= 0 {
        header.nt = 1
    }
    if header.vox_offset <= 0 {
        return nifti_error_code(NiftiError::UnsupportedFeature)
    }
    if header.datatype != 2 || header.bitpix != 8 {
        return nifti_error_code(NiftiError::UnsupportedDatatype)
    }

    out.version = header.version
    out.endian = header.endian
    out.sizeof_hdr = header.sizeof_hdr
    out.datatype = header.datatype
    out.bitpix = header.bitpix
    out.nx = header.nx
    out.ny = header.ny
    out.nz = header.nz
    out.nt = header.nt
    out.vox_offset = header.vox_offset
    out.qform_code = header.qform_code
    out.sform_code = header.sform_code
    0
}

fn nifti_parse_header_buffer(buf: &NiftiFileBuffer) -> Result<NiftiHeader, NiftiError> {
    var out = nifti_header_new()
    let code = nifti_parse_header_buffer_into(buf, &!out)
    if code == 0 {
        Ok(out)
    } else {
        Err(nifti_error_from_code(code))
    }
}

fn nifti_load_file_into(path: string, out_img: &!NiftiImage, out_header: &!NiftiHeader) -> i64 with Div, Mut, Div, Panic, IO {
    var write_buf = nifti_file_buffer_new()
    let read_code = nifti_read_file_buffer_into(path, &!write_buf)
    if read_code != 0 {
        return read_code
    }
    // Copy write_buf to buf for shared access (avoids shared+mutable borrow conflict)
    var buf = nifti_file_buffer_new()
    buf.len = write_buf.len
    var bi = 0
    while bi < 65536 { buf.data[bi] = write_buf.data[bi]; bi = bi + 1 }

    var header = nifti_header_new()
    let parse_code = nifti_parse_header_buffer_into(&buf, &!header)
    if parse_code != 0 {
        return parse_code
    }

    let nvox_3d = header.nx * header.ny * header.nz
    let nvox_total = nvox_3d * header.nt

    if nvox_3d <= 0 || nvox_total <= 0 {
        return nifti_error_code(NiftiError::InvalidDims)
    }
    if nvox_total > 4096 {
        return nifti_error_code(NiftiError::UnsupportedFeature)
    }

    let start = header.vox_offset
    let end = start + nvox_total
    if end > buf.len {
        return nifti_error_code(NiftiError::TruncatedFile)
    }

    var img = nifti_image_new()
    img.nx = header.nx
    img.ny = header.ny
    img.nz = header.nz
    img.nt = header.nt
    img.nvox_3d = nvox_3d
    img.nvox_total = nvox_total
    img.dx = 2.0
    img.dy = 2.0
    img.dz = 2.0
    img.tr = 1.0
    img.xform[0][0] = 1.0
    img.xform[1][1] = 1.0
    img.xform[2][2] = 1.0
    img.xform[3][3] = 1.0

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < nvox_total {
        img.data[i as usize] = file_byte_u8(&buf, start + i) as f64
        i = i + 1
    }

    out_img.nx = img.nx
    out_img.ny = img.ny
    out_img.nz = img.nz
    out_img.nt = img.nt
    out_img.nvox_3d = img.nvox_3d
    out_img.nvox_total = img.nvox_total
    out_img.dx = img.dx
    out_img.dy = img.dy
    out_img.dz = img.dz
    out_img.tr = img.tr
    out_img.xform = img.xform
    out_img.data = img.data

    out_header.version = header.version
    out_header.endian = header.endian
    out_header.sizeof_hdr = header.sizeof_hdr
    out_header.datatype = header.datatype
    out_header.bitpix = header.bitpix
    out_header.nx = header.nx
    out_header.ny = header.ny
    out_header.nz = header.nz
    out_header.nt = header.nt
    out_header.vox_offset = header.vox_offset
    out_header.qform_code = header.qform_code
    out_header.sform_code = header.sform_code
    0
}

fn nifti_load_file(path: string) -> Result<NiftiImage, NiftiError> with Mut, Panic, Div, IO {
    var img = nifti_image_new()
    var header = nifti_header_new()
    let code = nifti_load_file_into(path, &!img, &!header)
    if code == 0 {
        Ok(img)
    } else {
        Err(nifti_error_from_code(code))
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// ACCESS HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn voxel_idx(nx: i64, ny: i64, x: i64, y: i64, z: i64) -> i64 {
    x + y * nx + z * nx * ny
}

fn voxel_idx_4d(nx: i64, ny: i64, nz: i64, x: i64, y: i64, z: i64, t: i64) -> i64 {
    x + y * nx + z * nx * ny + t * nx * ny * nz
}

fn get_voxel(img: &NiftiImage, x: i64, y: i64, z: i64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0 || x >= img.nx || y < 0 || y >= img.ny || z < 0 || z >= img.nz {
        return 0.0
    }
    let idx = voxel_idx(img.nx, img.ny, x, y, z)
    if idx < 0 || idx >= img.nvox_total {
        return 0.0
    }
    img.data[idx as usize]
}

fn voxel_to_world(img: &NiftiImage, i: f64, j: f64, k: f64) -> (f64, f64, f64) {
    let x = img.xform[0][0] * i + img.xform[0][3]
    let y = img.xform[1][1] * j + img.xform[1][3]
    let z = img.xform[2][2] * k + img.xform[2][3]
    (x, y, z)
}

fn nifti_get_timepoint(img: &NiftiImage, t: i64) -> [f64; 4096] {
    var out = [0.0; 4096]
    if t < 0 || t >= img.nt {
        return out
    }
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < img.nvox_3d && i < 4096 {
        let idx = t * img.nvox_3d + i
        if idx >= 0 && idx < img.nvox_total {
            out[i as usize] = img.data[idx as usize]
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    out
}

fn nifti_get_voxel_ts(img: &NiftiImage, x: i64, y: i64, z: i64) -> [f64; 128] {
    var out = [0.0; 128]
    if x < 0 || x >= img.nx || y < 0 || y >= img.ny || z < 0 || z >= img.nz {
        return out
    }
    let max_t = if img.nt < 128 { img.nt } else { 128 }
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < max_t {
        let idx = voxel_idx_4d(img.nx, img.ny, img.nz, x, y, z, t)
        if idx >= 0 && idx < img.nvox_total {
            out[t as usize] = img.data[idx as usize]
        }
        t = t + 1
    }
    out
}


// === FILE: stdlib/fmri/pipeline_real.sio ===
// fmri/pipeline_real.sio — Executable tiny-fixture fMRI pipeline

fn pr_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn pr_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var r = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 15 { r = 0.5 * (r + x / r); i = i + 1 }
    r
}

    min_atlas_coverage: f64,

}

}

fn fmri_qc_metrics_new() -> FmriQcMetrics {

}

struct MotionParams6PR {
    tx: f64, ty: f64, tz: f64,
    rx: f64, ry: f64, rz: f64,
}

fn motion_params6_new_pr() -> MotionParams6PR {
    MotionParams6PR { tx: 0.0, ty: 0.0, tz: 0.0, rx: 0.0, ry: 0.0, rz: 0.0 }
}

fn framewise_displacement(prev: MotionParams6PR, curr: MotionParams6PR, head_radius: f64) -> f64 {
    pr_abs(curr.tx - prev.tx) + pr_abs(curr.ty - prev.ty) + pr_abs(curr.tz - prev.tz) +
    head_radius * (pr_abs(curr.rx - prev.rx) + pr_abs(curr.ry - prev.ry) + pr_abs(curr.rz - prev.rz))
}

// Compute FD timeseries from motion params
fn calculate_fd_timeseries(
    motion: &[MotionParams6PR; 500], n: i64, head_radius: f64,
    fd_out: &![f64; 500]
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var max_fd = 0.0
    var sum_fd = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n && i < 500 {
        let fd = framewise_displacement(motion[(i - 1) as usize], motion[i as usize], head_radius)
        fd_out[(i - 1) as usize] = fd
        sum_fd = sum_fd + fd
        if fd > max_fd { max_fd = fd }
        i = i + 1
    }
    if n > 1 { sum_fd / ((n - 1) as f64) } else { 0.0 }
}

// Pearson correlation for two arrays
fn pr_pearson(x: &[f64; 100], y: &[f64; 100], n: i64) -> f64 with Div, Panic, Mut {
    var sx = 0.0
    var sy = 0.0
    var sxx = 0.0
    var syy = 0.0
    var sxy = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        sx = sx + x[i as usize]
        sy = sy + y[i as usize]
        sxx = sxx + x[i as usize] * x[i as usize]
        syy = syy + y[i as usize] * y[i as usize]
        sxy = sxy + x[i as usize] * y[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    let nf = n as f64
    let num = nf * sxy - sx * sy
    let den = pr_sqrt((nf * sxx - sx * sx) * (nf * syy - sy * sy))
    if den < 0.0001 { 0.0 } else { num / den }
}

fn test_fd_zero_motion() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var motion: [MotionParams6PR; 500] = [motion_params6_new_pr(); 500]
    var fd_out: [f64; 500] = [0.0; 500]
    let mean_fd = calculate_fd_timeseries(&motion, 10, 50.0, &!fd_out)
    pr_abs(mean_fd) < 0.001
}

fn test_pipeline_result_init() -> bool {
    let r = fmri_pipeline_result_new()
    !r.success && r.fc_r == 0.0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/fmri/pipeline.sio ===
// fmri::pipeline — Resting-State fMRI Preprocessing Pipeline
//
// Preprocessing steps for resting-state fMRI:
// - Motion parameters and FD calculation
// - High-pass filtering (DCT-based)
// - Quality control (tSNR, DVARS)
// - Scrubbing/censoring
//
// Based on fMRIPrep best practices.

// Math helpers inlined

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var r = x
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r = 0.5 * (r + x / r)
    r
}

fn PI() -> f64 { 3.14159265358979323846 }

fn cos_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    // Taylor series: 1 - x^2/2! + x^4/4! - x^6/6! + x^8/8!
    let x2 = x * x
    let x4 = x2 * x2
    let x6 = x4 * x2
    let x8 = x6 * x2
    1.0 - x2 / 2.0 + x4 / 24.0 - x6 / 720.0 + x8 / 40320.0
}

// ============================================================================
// MOTION PARAMETERS
// ============================================================================

// Rigid body motion parameters (6 DOF) for a single volume
struct MotionParams6 {
    tx: f64,    // Translation x (mm)
    ty: f64,    // Translation y (mm)
    tz: f64,    // Translation z (mm)
    rx: f64,    // Rotation pitch (radians)
    ry: f64,    // Rotation roll (radians)
    rz: f64,    // Rotation yaw (radians)
}

fn motion_params6_new() -> MotionParams6 {
    MotionParams6 {
        tx: 0.0, ty: 0.0, tz: 0.0,
        rx: 0.0, ry: 0.0, rz: 0.0,
    }
}

// Compute framewise displacement between consecutive volumes
// FD = |Δtx| + |Δty| + |Δtz| + r*(|Δrx| + |Δry| + |Δrz|)
fn framewise_displacement6(prev: MotionParams6, curr: MotionParams6, head_radius: f64) -> f64 {
    let dtx = abs_f64(curr.tx - prev.tx)
    let dty = abs_f64(curr.ty - prev.ty)
    let dtz = abs_f64(curr.tz - prev.tz)
    let drx = abs_f64(curr.rx - prev.rx)
    let dry = abs_f64(curr.ry - prev.ry)
    let drz = abs_f64(curr.rz - prev.rz)

    dtx + dty + dtz + head_radius * (drx + dry + drz)
}

// Motion timeseries for a run
struct MotionTimeseries {
    fd: [f64; 500],         // Framewise displacement per volume
    fd_mean: f64,           // Mean FD
    fd_max: f64,            // Max FD
    n_outliers: i64,        // Volumes exceeding threshold
    n_volumes: i64,
}

fn motion_timeseries_new() -> MotionTimeseries {
    MotionTimeseries {
        fd: [0.0; 500],
        fd_mean: 0.0,
        fd_max: 0.0,
        n_outliers: 0,
        n_volumes: 0,
    }
}

// Calculate FD timeseries from motion parameters
fn calculate_fd_timeseries(
    motion: [MotionParams6; 500],
    n_volumes: i64,
    head_radius: f64,
    threshold: f64
) -> MotionTimeseries {
    var result = motion_timeseries_new()
    result.n_volumes = n_volumes

    result.fd[0] = 0.0
    var sum_fd: f64 = 0.0

    var t: i64 = 1
    while t < n_volumes {
        let fd = framewise_displacement6(motion[(t-1) as usize], motion[t as usize], head_radius)
        result.fd[t as usize] = fd
        sum_fd = sum_fd + fd

        if fd > result.fd_max {
            result.fd_max = fd
        }
        if fd > threshold {
            result.n_outliers = result.n_outliers + 1
        }

        t = t + 1
    }

    if n_volumes > 1 {
        result.fd_mean = sum_fd / (n_volumes - 1) as f64
    }

    result
}

// ============================================================================
// HIGH-PASS FILTERING
// ============================================================================

// Apply DCT-based high-pass filter to timeseries
fn highpass_dct(ts: [f64; 500], n: i64, cutoff_hz: f64, tr: f64) -> [f64; 500] {
    var result = ts

    // Number of DCT components to remove
    let n_basis = (1.0 / (2.0 * cutoff_hz * tr)) as i64 + 1

    // Compute mean
    var mean: f64 = 0.0
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < n {
        mean = mean + ts[t as usize]
        t = t + 1
    }
    mean = mean / n as f64

    // Demean
    t = 0
    while t < n {
        result[t as usize] = result[t as usize] - mean
        t = t + 1
    }

    // Project onto DCT basis and remove low-frequency components
    var k: i64 = 1  // Skip DC (k=0)
    while k < n_basis && k < 50 {
        // Generate DCT basis k
        var basis = [0.0; 500]
        var norm: f64 = 0.0
        t = 0
        while t < n {
            let arg = PI() * k as f64 * (2.0 * t as f64 + 1.0) / (2.0 * n as f64)
            basis[t as usize] = cos_f64(arg)
            norm = norm + basis[t as usize] * basis[t as usize]
            t = t + 1
        }

        // Compute coefficient
        var coef: f64 = 0.0
        t = 0
        while t < n {
            coef = coef + result[t as usize] * basis[t as usize]
            t = t + 1
        }
        if norm > 1e-10 {
            coef = coef / norm
        }

        // Remove component
        t = 0
        while t < n {
            result[t as usize] = result[t as usize] - coef * basis[t as usize]
            t = t + 1
        }

        k = k + 1
    }

    // Add mean back
    t = 0
    while t < n {
        result[t as usize] = result[t as usize] + mean
        t = t + 1
    }

    result
}

// ============================================================================
// QUALITY CONTROL
// ============================================================================

// Quality metrics for a voxel timeseries
struct VoxelQuality {
    mean: f64,
    std: f64,
    tsnr: f64,      // Temporal signal-to-noise ratio
}

fn voxel_quality_new() -> VoxelQuality {
    VoxelQuality {
        mean: 0.0,
        std: 0.0,
        tsnr: 0.0,
    }
}

// Calculate tSNR for a timeseries
fn calculate_tsnr(ts: [f64; 500], n: i64) -> VoxelQuality {
    var result = voxel_quality_new()

    // Mean
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < n {
        sum = sum + ts[t as usize]
        t = t + 1
    }
    result.mean = sum / n as f64

    // Variance
    var sum_sq: f64 = 0.0
    t = 0
    while t < n {
        let diff = ts[t as usize] - result.mean
        sum_sq = sum_sq + diff * diff
        t = t + 1
    }
    let variance = sum_sq / (n - 1) as f64

    result.std = sqrt_f64(variance)
    if result.std > 1e-10 {
        result.tsnr = result.mean / result.std
    }

    result
}

// DVARS: temporal derivative of RMS variance
fn calculate_dvars(ts1: [f64; 500], ts2: [f64; 500], n_voxels: i64) -> f64 {
    // DVARS = sqrt_f64(mean((ts2 - ts1)^2))
    var sum_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var v: i64 = 0
    while v < n_voxels {
        let diff = ts2[v as usize] - ts1[v as usize]
        sum_sq = sum_sq + diff * diff
        v = v + 1
    }
    sqrt_f64(sum_sq / n_voxels as f64)
}

// ============================================================================
// SCRUBBING
// ============================================================================

// Scrubbing result
struct ScrubResult {
    good_volumes: [bool; 500],
    n_good: i64,
    n_scrubbed: i64,
}

fn scrub_result_new() -> ScrubResult {
    ScrubResult {
        good_volumes: [true; 500],
        n_good: 0,
        n_scrubbed: 0,
    }
}

// Identify volumes to scrub based on FD and DVARS
fn identify_scrub_volumes(
    fd: [f64; 500],
    dvars: [f64; 500],
    n_volumes: i64,
    fd_threshold: f64,
    dvars_threshold: f64,
    scrub_before: i64,
    scrub_after: i64
) -> ScrubResult {
    var result = scrub_result_new()

    // Mark bad volumes
    var bad = [false; 500]
    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < n_volumes {
        if fd[t as usize] > fd_threshold || dvars[t as usize] > dvars_threshold {
            bad[t as usize] = true
        }
        t = t + 1
    }

    // Expand mask (before/after)
    t = 0
    while t < n_volumes {
        if bad[t as usize] {
            var i = t - scrub_before
            while i <= t + scrub_after {
                if i >= 0 && i < n_volumes {
                    result.good_volumes[i as usize] = false
                }
                i = i + 1
            }
        }
        t = t + 1
    }

    // Count
    t = 0
    while t < n_volumes {
        if result.good_volumes[t as usize] {
            result.n_good = result.n_good + 1
        } else {
            result.n_scrubbed = result.n_scrubbed + 1
        }
        t = t + 1
    }

    result
}

// ============================================================================
// PIPELINE CONFIGURATION
// ============================================================================

// Pipeline configuration
struct PipelineConfig {
    tr: f64,                    // Repetition time (seconds)
    high_pass_hz: f64,          // High-pass cutoff (Hz)
    fd_threshold: f64,          // FD threshold for scrubbing (mm)
    dvars_threshold: f64,       // DVARS threshold
    scrub_before: i64,          // Volumes to remove before bad
    scrub_after: i64,           // Volumes to remove after bad
    min_volumes: i64,           // Minimum volumes after scrubbing
    max_fd_mean: f64,           // Max mean FD for inclusion
    head_radius: f64,           // Head radius for FD (mm)
}

fn pipeline_config_default() -> PipelineConfig {
    PipelineConfig {
        tr: 2.0,
        high_pass_hz: 0.01,
        fd_threshold: 0.5,
        dvars_threshold: 1.5,
        scrub_before: 1,
        scrub_after: 2,
        min_volumes: 100,
        max_fd_mean: 0.3,
        head_radius: 50.0,
    }
}

fn pipeline_config_strict() -> PipelineConfig {
    var config = pipeline_config_default()
    config.fd_threshold = 0.3
    config.max_fd_mean = 0.2
    config
}

// ============================================================================
// QUALITY CHECK RESULT
// ============================================================================

// Overall quality check result
struct QualityCheck {
    passed: bool,
    fd_mean: f64,
    fd_max: f64,
    n_outliers: i64,
    n_volumes_used: i64,
    n_volumes_scrubbed: i64,
    mean_tsnr: f64,
    reason: i32,   // 0=passed, 1=too few volumes, 2=fd too high
}

fn quality_check_new() -> QualityCheck {
    QualityCheck {
        passed: true,
        fd_mean: 0.0,
        fd_max: 0.0,
        n_outliers: 0,
        n_volumes_used: 0,
        n_volumes_scrubbed: 0,
        mean_tsnr: 0.0,
        reason: 0,
    }
}

// Run quality checks on preprocessed data
fn run_quality_checks(
    motion: MotionTimeseries,
    scrub: ScrubResult,
    mean_tsnr: f64,
    config: PipelineConfig
) -> QualityCheck {
    var qc = quality_check_new()

    qc.fd_mean = motion.fd_mean
    qc.fd_max = motion.fd_max
    qc.n_outliers = motion.n_outliers
    qc.n_volumes_used = scrub.n_good
    qc.n_volumes_scrubbed = scrub.n_scrubbed
    qc.mean_tsnr = mean_tsnr

    // Check minimum volumes
    if scrub.n_good < config.min_volumes {
        qc.passed = false
        qc.reason = 1
    }

    // Check mean FD
    if motion.fd_mean > config.max_fd_mean {
        qc.passed = false
        qc.reason = 2
    }

    qc
}

//
// Core preprocessing steps for resting-state and task fMRI.
// Follows fMRIPrep best practices.
//
// References:
// - Esteban et al. (2019): "fMRIPrep: a robust preprocessing pipeline"
// - Power et al. (2012): "Spurious but systematic correlations..."

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS (inline implementations)
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    y = (y + x / y) / 2.0
    y = (y + x / y) / 2.0
    y = (y + x / y) / 2.0
    y = (y + x / y) / 2.0
    y = (y + x / y) / 2.0
    y = (y + x / y) / 2.0
    y = (y + x / y) / 2.0
    y = (y + x / y) / 2.0
    y
}

fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var n: i64 = 1
    while n < 20 {
        term = term * x / n as f64
        result = result + term
        n = n + 1
    }
    result
}

fn pi() -> f64 { 3.14159265358979323846 }

fn log_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 1000.0 }
    var y = x - 1.0
    if y > 1.0 { y = 1.0 }
    if y < -0.9 { y = -0.9 }
    var n: i64 = 0
    while n < 20 {
        let ey = exp_f64(y)
        y = y + (x - ey) / ey
        n = n + 1
    }
    y
}

fn sin_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    var result = x
    var term = x
    var n: i64 = 1
    while n < 10 {
        term = 0.0 - term * x * x / ((2 * n) as f64 * (2 * n + 1) as f64)
        result = result + term
        n = n + 1
    }
    result
}

fn cos_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var n: i64 = 1
    while n < 10 {
        term = 0.0 - term * x * x / ((2 * n - 1) as f64 * (2 * n) as f64)
        result = result + term
        n = n + 1
    }
    result
}

fn PI() -> f64 { 3.14159265358979323846 }

fn fisher_z(r: f64) -> f64 {
    let r_clamped = if r > 0.9999 { 0.9999 } else if r < -0.9999 { -0.9999 } else { r }
    0.5 * log_f64((1.0 + r_clamped) / (1.0 - r_clamped))
}

fn fisher_z_inv(z: f64) -> f64 {
    let e2z = exp_f64(2.0 * z)
    (e2z - 1.0) / (e2z + 1.0)
}

fn fisher_z_se(n: i64) -> f64 {
    if n > 3 {
        1.0 / sqrt_f64((n - 3) as f64)
    } else {
        1.0
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// MOTION PARAMETERS
// ============================================================================

// 6 DOF motion parameters for single timepoint
struct MotionParams {
    tx: f64,    // Translation x (mm)
    ty: f64,    // Translation y (mm)
    tz: f64,    // Translation z (mm)
    rx: f64,    // Rotation pitch (radians)
    ry: f64,    // Rotation roll (radians)
    rz: f64,    // Rotation yaw (radians)
}

fn motion_params_new() -> MotionParams {
    MotionParams {
        tx: 0.0,
        ty: 0.0,
        tz: 0.0,
        rx: 0.0,
        ry: 0.0,
        rz: 0.0,
    }
}

// Compute framewise displacement between two motion states
// FD = |Δtx| + |Δty| + |Δtz| + r*(|Δrx| + |Δry| + |Δrz|)
// where r = 50mm (approximate head radius)
fn framewise_displacement(prev: MotionParams, curr: MotionParams) -> f64 {
    let r = 50.0  // mm, approximate head radius

    let dx = abs_f64(curr.tx - prev.tx)
    let dy = abs_f64(curr.ty - prev.ty)
    let dz = abs_f64(curr.tz - prev.tz)

    let drx = abs_f64(curr.rx - prev.rx)
    let dry = abs_f64(curr.ry - prev.ry)
    let drz = abs_f64(curr.rz - prev.rz)

    dx + dy + dz + r * (drx + dry + drz)
}

// ============================================================================
// GAUSSIAN KERNEL
// ============================================================================

// 1D Gaussian kern for smoothing
struct SmoothKernel {
    weights: [f64; 15],
    size: i64,
    sigma: f64,
}

fn gaussian_kern_new(fwhm_mm: f64, voxel_size: f64) -> SmoothKernel {
    // FWHM = 2.355 * sigma
    let sigma_mm = fwhm_mm / 2.355
    let sigma_vox = sigma_mm / voxel_size

    // Size: 3 sigma on each side
    var size = (6.0 * sigma_vox + 1.0) as i64
    if size % 2 == 0 {
        size = size + 1
    }
    if size > 15 {
        size = 15
    }
    if size < 3 {
        size = 3
    }

    var kern = SmoothKernel {
        weights: [0.0; 15],
        size: size,
        sigma: sigma_vox,
    }

    // Generate 1D Gaussian weights
    let half = size / 2
    var sum = 0.0

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < size {
        let dx = (i - half) as f64
        let w = exp_f64(0.0 - dx * dx / (2.0 * sigma_vox * sigma_vox))
        kern.weights[i as usize] = w
        sum = sum + w
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Normalize
    i = 0
    while i < size {
        kern.weights[i as usize] = kern.weights[i as usize] / sum
        i = i + 1
    }

    kern
}

// ============================================================================
// DETRENDING
// ============================================================================

// Remove linear trend from time series (by value)
fn detrend_linear(data: [f64; 200], n: i64) -> [f64; 200] {
    var result = data

    // Fit y = a + b*t
    var sum_t = 0.0
    var sum_y = 0.0
    var sum_tt = 0.0
    var sum_ty = 0.0

    var t: i64 = 0
    while t < n {
        let tf = t as f64
        sum_t = sum_t + tf
        sum_y = sum_y + data[t as usize]
        sum_tt = sum_tt + tf * tf
        sum_ty = sum_ty + tf * data[t as usize]
        t = t + 1
    }

    let nf = n as f64
    let denom = nf * sum_tt - sum_t * sum_t

    if abs_f64(denom) > 1e-10 {
        let b = (nf * sum_ty - sum_t * sum_y) / denom
        let a = (sum_y - b * sum_t) / nf

        t = 0
        while t < n {
            result[t as usize] = result[t as usize] - (a + b * (t as f64))
            t = t + 1
        }
    }

    result
}

// Demean time series
fn demean(data: [f64; 200], n: i64) -> [f64; 200] {
    var result = data

    var sum = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + data[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    let mean = sum / (n as f64)

    i = 0
    while i < n {
        result[i as usize] = result[i as usize] - mean
        i = i + 1
    }

    result
}

// Z-score normalize time series
fn zscore(data: [f64; 200], n: i64) -> [f64; 200] {
    var result = data

    // Mean
    var sum = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + data[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    let mean = sum / (n as f64)

    // Std
    var sum_sq = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let diff = data[i as usize] - mean
        sum_sq = sum_sq + diff * diff
        i = i + 1
    }
    let std = sqrt_f64(sum_sq / ((n - 1) as f64))

    if std > 1e-10 {
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            result[i as usize] = (result[i as usize] - mean) / std
            i = i + 1
        }
    }

    result
}

// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/dimension.sio ===
//! stdlib/fractal/dimension.sio
//!
//! Fractal Dimension Estimation with Uncertainty Propagation

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    for _ in 0..10 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y) }
    y
}

const LN2: f64 = 0.6931471805599453

fn ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return -1000000.0 }
    var v = x
    var k: i64 = 0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.0; k = k + 1 }
    while v < 1.0 { v = v * 2.0; k = k - 1 }
    let y = v - 1.0
    var result = 0.0
    var power = y
    for i in 1..=15 {
        if i % 2 == 1 { result = result + power / (i as f64) }
        else { result = result - power / (i as f64) }
        power = power * y
    }
    result + (k as f64) * LN2
}

fn exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    var v = x
    if v > 700.0 { v = 700.0 }
    if v < -700.0 { return 0.0 }
    let k = (v / LN2) as i64
    let r = v - (k as f64) * LN2
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    for i in 1..=15 {
        term = term * r / (i as f64)
        result = result + term
    }
    if k >= 0 { for _ in 0..k { result = result * 2.0 } }
    else { for _ in 0..(-k) { result = result / 2.0 } }
    result
}

fn min_u32(a: u32, b: u32) -> u32 { if a < b { a } else { b } }

// ============================================================================
// RESULT TYPES
// ============================================================================

// Result of linear regression
struct RegressionResult {
    pub slope: f64,
    pub intercept: f64,
    pub r_squared: f64,
    pub var_slope: f64,
}

// Result of fractal dimension computation
pub struct FractalDimensionResult {
    pub dimension: f64,
    pub std_dev: f64,
    pub r_squared: f64,
    pub num_scales: u32,
}

// ============================================================================
// LINEAR REGRESSION
// ============================================================================

fn linear_regression(x: &Vec<f64>, y: &Vec<f64>) -> RegressionResult {
    let n = x.len()
    if n < 2 {
        return RegressionResult {
            slope: 0.0,
            intercept: 0.0,
            r_squared: 0.0,
            var_slope: 1.0,
        }
    }

    var sum_x = 0.0
    var sum_y = 0.0
    var sum_xy = 0.0
    var sum_x2 = 0.0
    var sum_y2 = 0.0

    for i in 0..n {
        sum_x = sum_x + x[i]
        sum_y = sum_y + y[i]
        sum_xy = sum_xy + x[i] * y[i]
        sum_x2 = sum_x2 + x[i] * x[i]
        sum_y2 = sum_y2 + y[i] * y[i]
    }

    let nf = n as f64
    let denom = nf * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x

    if abs_f64(denom) < 1e-10 {
        return RegressionResult {
            slope: 0.0,
            intercept: sum_y / nf,
            r_squared: 0.0,
            var_slope: 1.0,
        }
    }

    let slope = (nf * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / denom
    let intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_x) / nf

    let ss_tot = sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y / nf
    var ss_res = 0.0
    for i in 0..n {
        let pred = intercept + slope * x[i]
        let residual = y[i] - pred
        ss_res = ss_res + residual * residual
    }

    let r_squared = if ss_tot > 0.0 { 1.0 - ss_res / ss_tot } else { 0.0 }

    let mse = if n > 2 { ss_res / (nf - 2.0) } else { ss_res }
    let var_slope = if denom > 0.0 { mse * nf / denom } else { 1.0 }

    RegressionResult {
        slope: slope,
        intercept: intercept,
        r_squared: r_squared,
        var_slope: var_slope,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// BOX COUNTING DIMENSION
// ============================================================================

// Compute box-counting dimension from 3D voxel data
pub fn box_counting_dimension(
    voxels: &Vec<bool>,
    nx: u32,
    ny: u32,
    nz: u32,
    min_scale: u32,
    max_scale: u32,
) -> FractalDimensionResult {
    var scales: Vec<u32> = vec![]
    var r = min_scale
    let max_dim = min_u32(min_u32(nx, ny), nz)
    while r <= max_scale && r <= max_dim {
        scales.push(r)
        r = r * 2
    }

    if scales.len() < 2 {
        scales.push(1)
        scales.push(2)
    }

    var log_inv_scales: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    var log_counts: Vec<f64> = vec![]

    for i in 0..scales.len() {
        let scale = scales[i]
        let count = count_boxes(voxels, nx, ny, nz, scale)

        if count > 0 {
            log_inv_scales.push(ln_f64(1.0 / (scale as f64)))
            log_counts.push(ln_f64(count as f64))
        }
    }

    let reg = linear_regression(&log_inv_scales, &log_counts)

    FractalDimensionResult {
        dimension: reg.slope,
        std_dev: sqrt_f64(reg.var_slope),
        r_squared: reg.r_squared,
        num_scales: scales.len() as u32,
    }
}

fn count_boxes(voxels: &Vec<bool>, nx: u32, ny: u32, nz: u32, scale: u32) -> u64 {
    var count: u64 = 0

    let bx_max = (nx + scale - 1) / scale
    let by_max = (ny + scale - 1) / scale
    let bz_max = (nz + scale - 1) / scale

    for bx in 0..bx_max {
        for by in 0..by_max {
            for bz in 0..bz_max {
                var found = false

                for dx in 0..scale {
                    if found { break }
                    for dy in 0..scale {
                        if found { break }
                        for dz in 0..scale {
                            let x = bx * scale + dx
                            let y = by * scale + dy
                            let z = bz * scale + dz

                            if x < nx && y < ny && z < nz {
                                let idx = ((z as usize) * (ny as usize) + (y as usize)) * (nx as usize) + (x as usize)
                                if idx < voxels.len() && voxels[idx] {
                                    found = true
                                    break
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if found { count = count + 1 }
            }
        }
    }

    count
}

// ============================================================================
// HIGUCHI DIMENSION
// ============================================================================

// Compute Higuchi fractal dimension for 1D time series
pub fn higuchi_dimension(series: &Vec<f64>, k_max: u32) -> FractalDimensionResult {
    let n = series.len()

    if n < (2 * k_max) as usize {
        return FractalDimensionResult {
            dimension: 0.0,
            std_dev: 1.0,
            r_squared: 0.0,
            num_scales: 0,
        }
    }

    var log_inv_k: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    var log_lengths: Vec<f64> = vec![]

    for k in 1..=k_max {
        var l_k = 0.0

        for m in 1..=k {
            var l_m = 0.0
            let limit = ((n - (m as usize)) as f64 / (k as f64)) as usize

            for i in 1..limit {
                let idx1 = (m as usize) + i * (k as usize)
                let idx2 = (m as usize) + (i - 1) * (k as usize)
                if idx1 < n && idx2 < n {
                    l_m = l_m + abs_f64(series[idx1] - series[idx2])
                }
            }

            let norm = ((n - 1) as f64) / ((limit as f64) * (k as f64) * (k as f64))
            l_m = l_m * norm
            l_k = l_k + l_m
        }

        l_k = l_k / (k as f64)

        if l_k > 0.0 {
            log_inv_k.push(ln_f64(1.0 / (k as f64)))
            log_lengths.push(ln_f64(l_k))
        }
    }

    let reg = linear_regression(&log_inv_k, &log_lengths)

    FractalDimensionResult {
        dimension: reg.slope,
        std_dev: sqrt_f64(reg.var_slope),
        r_squared: reg.r_squared,
        num_scales: k_max,
    }
}
