// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/entropy.sio ===
//! stdlib/fractal/entropy.sio
//!
//! Entropy Measures with Uncertainty Propagation
//!
//! Provides Shannon, Rényi, sample, approximate, and permutation entropy.

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn ent_abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn ent_sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    for _ in 0..10 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y) }
    y
}

fn ent_ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return -1000000.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    var k: i64 = 0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.0; k = k + 1 }
    while v < 1.0 { v = v * 2.0; k = k - 1 }
    let y = v - 1.0
    var result = 0.0
    var power = y
    for i in 1..=15 {
        if i % 2 == 1 { result = result + power / (i as f64) }
        else { result = result - power / (i as f64) }
        power = power * y
    }
    result + (k as f64) * ln2
}

fn ent_pow_f64(x: f64, y: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    ent_exp_f64(y * ent_ln_f64(x))
}

fn ent_exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    if v > 700.0 { v = 700.0 }
    if v < -700.0 { return 0.0 }
    let k = (v / ln2) as i64
    let r = v - (k as f64) * ln2
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    for i in 1..=15 {
        term = term * r / (i as f64)
        result = result + term
    }
    if k >= 0 { for _ in 0..k { result = result * 2.0 } }
    else { for _ in 0..(-k) { result = result / 2.0 } }
    result
}

fn min_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn max_f64(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }

// ============================================================================
// RESULT TYPES
// ============================================================================

// Result of entropy computation with uncertainty
pub struct EntropyResult {
    pub value: f64,
    pub std_dev: f64,
    pub sample_size: usize,
}

// Result of histogram computation
struct HistogramResult {
    pub counts: Vec<u64>,
    pub min_val: f64,
    pub max_val: f64,
}

// ============================================================================
// HISTOGRAM COMPUTATION
// ============================================================================

fn compute_histogram(data: &Vec<f64>, bins: u32) -> HistogramResult {
    if data.len() == 0 {
        return HistogramResult {
            counts: vec![],
            min_val: 0.0,
            max_val: 0.0,
        }
    }

    // Find data range
    var min_val = data[0]
    var max_val = data[0]
    for i in 1..data.len() {
        min_val = min_f64(min_val, data[i])
        max_val = max_f64(max_val, data[i])
    }

    // Handle degenerate case
    if max_val == min_val {
        var counts: Vec<u64> = vec![]
        counts.push(data.len() as u64)
        return HistogramResult {
            counts: counts,
            min_val: min_val,
            max_val: max_val,
        }
    }

    // Initialize bins
    var counts: Vec<u64> = vec![]
    for _ in 0..bins {
        counts.push(0)
    }

    // Fill histogram
    let bin_width = (max_val - min_val) / (bins as f64)
    for i in 0..data.len() {
        var bin = ((data[i] - min_val) / bin_width) as usize
        if bin >= bins as usize {
            bin = (bins - 1) as usize
        }
        counts[bin] = counts[bin] + 1
    }

    HistogramResult {
        counts: counts,
        min_val: min_val,
        max_val: max_val,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// SHANNON ENTROPY
// ============================================================================

// Compute Shannon entropy with Miller-Madow bias correction
//
// H = -Σ pᵢ log(pᵢ)
pub fn shannon_entropy(data: &Vec<f64>, bins: u32) -> EntropyResult {
    let n = data.len()

    if n == 0 {
        return EntropyResult {
            value: 0.0,
            std_dev: 0.0,
            sample_size: 0,
        }
    }

    // Compute histogram
    let hist = compute_histogram(data, bins)
    let counts = hist.counts

    // Compute probabilities and entropy
    var entropy = 0.0
    var non_zero_bins = 0

    for i in 0..counts.len() {
        if counts[i] > 0 {
            let p = (counts[i] as f64) / (n as f64)
            entropy = entropy - p * ent_ln_f64(p)
            non_zero_bins = non_zero_bins + 1
        }
    }

    // Miller-Madow bias correction
    let bias_correction = ((non_zero_bins - 1) as f64) / (2.0 * (n as f64))
    let corrected_entropy = entropy + bias_correction

    // Uncertainty estimation
    var sum_p_log2 = 0.0
    for i in 0..counts.len() {
        if counts[i] > 0 {
            let p = (counts[i] as f64) / (n as f64)
            let log_p = ent_ln_f64(p)
            sum_p_log2 = sum_p_log2 + p * log_p * log_p
        }
    }

    let var_term = sum_p_log2 - entropy * entropy
    let sample_var = if var_term > 0.0 { var_term / (n as f64) } else { 0.0 }
    let bin_var = 1.0 / ((bins * bins) as f64)
    let total_var = sample_var + bin_var

    EntropyResult {
        value: corrected_entropy,
        std_dev: ent_sqrt_f64(total_var),
        sample_size: n,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// RÉNYI ENTROPY
// ============================================================================

// Compute Rényi entropy of order q
//
// H_q = (1/(1-q)) log(Σ pᵢ^q)
pub fn renyi_entropy(data: &Vec<f64>, q: f64, bins: u32) -> EntropyResult {
    let n = data.len()

    if n == 0 {
        return EntropyResult {
            value: 0.0,
            std_dev: 0.0,
            sample_size: 0,
        }
    }

    // Handle q = 1 case (Shannon entropy limit)
    if ent_abs_f64(q - 1.0) < 0.001 {
        return shannon_entropy(data, bins)
    }

    // Compute histogram
    let hist = compute_histogram(data, bins)
    let counts = hist.counts

    // Compute Σ pᵢ^q
    var sum_p_q = 0.0

    for i in 0..counts.len() {
        if counts[i] > 0 {
            let p = (counts[i] as f64) / (n as f64)
            sum_p_q = sum_p_q + ent_pow_f64(p, q)
        }
    }

    // Handle edge cases
    if sum_p_q <= 0.0 {
        return EntropyResult {
            value: 0.0,
            std_dev: 1.0,
            sample_size: n,
        }
    }

    // Rényi entropy
    let entropy = ent_ln_f64(sum_p_q) / (1.0 - q)

    // Uncertainty estimation (approximate)
    let sample_var = 1.0 / (n as f64)
    let q_factor = if q > 1.0 { q } else { 1.0 / (2.0 - q) }
    let total_var = sample_var * q_factor

    EntropyResult {
        value: entropy,
        std_dev: ent_sqrt_f64(total_var),
        sample_size: n,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// SAMPLE ENTROPY
// ============================================================================

// Compute Sample Entropy (SampEn) for time series
//
// Measures regularity/predictability of a time series.
pub fn sample_entropy(series: &Vec<f64>, m: u32, r: f64) -> EntropyResult {
    let n = series.len()

    if n < ((m + 2) as usize) {
        return EntropyResult {
            value: 0.0,
            std_dev: 1.0,
            sample_size: n,
        }
    }

    // Count matches for templates of length m and m+1
    var count_m: u64 = 0
    var count_m1: u64 = 0

    let n_templates = n - (m as usize)

    // For each pair of templates
    for i in 0..n_templates {
        for j in (i + 1)..n_templates {
            // Check if templates of length m match within tolerance r
            var match_m = true
            for k in 0..(m as usize) {
                if ent_abs_f64(series[i + k] - series[j + k]) > r {
                    match_m = false
                }
            }

            if match_m {
                count_m = count_m + 1

                // Check if templates of length m+1 also match
                if i + (m as usize) < n && j + (m as usize) < n {
                    if ent_abs_f64(series[i + (m as usize)] - series[j + (m as usize)]) <= r {
                        count_m1 = count_m1 + 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Compute sample entropy
    let sampen = if count_m > 0 && count_m1 > 0 {
        0.0 - ent_ln_f64((count_m1 as f64) / (count_m as f64))
    } else if count_m > 0 {
        ent_ln_f64(count_m as f64)
    } else {
        0.0
    }

    // Uncertainty estimation
    let var_term = if count_m > 0 {
        1.0 / (count_m as f64) + 1.0 / ((count_m1 + 1) as f64)
    } else {
        1.0
    }

    EntropyResult {
        value: sampen,
        std_dev: ent_sqrt_f64(var_term),
        sample_size: n,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// APPROXIMATE ENTROPY
// ============================================================================

// Compute approximate entropy (ApEn)
pub fn approximate_entropy(series: &Vec<f64>, m: u32, r: f64) -> EntropyResult {
    let n = series.len()

    if n < ((m + 1) as usize) {
        return EntropyResult {
            value: 0.0,
            std_dev: 1.0,
            sample_size: n,
        }
    }

    // Compute φ(m) and φ(m+1)
    let phi_m = compute_phi(series, m, r)
    let phi_m1 = compute_phi(series, m + 1, r)

    let apen = phi_m - phi_m1

    let sample_var = 1.0 / (n as f64)

    EntropyResult {
        value: apen,
        std_dev: ent_sqrt_f64(sample_var),
        sample_size: n,
    }
}

// Helper: compute φ for ApEn
fn compute_phi(x: &Vec<f64>, m: u32, r: f64) -> f64 {
    let n = x.len()
    if n < (m as usize) { return 0.0 }

    let n_templates = n - (m as usize) + 1
    var sum_log_c = 0.0

    for i in 0..n_templates {
        var count = 0

        for j in 0..n_templates {
            var match_flag = true
            for k in 0..(m as usize) {
                if ent_abs_f64(x[i + k] - x[j + k]) > r {
                    match_flag = false
                }
            }
            if match_flag {
                count = count + 1
            }
        }

        let c_i = (count as f64) / (n_templates as f64)
        if c_i > 0.0 {
            sum_log_c = sum_log_c + ent_ln_f64(c_i)
        }
    }

    sum_log_c / (n_templates as f64)
}

// ============================================================================
// PERMUTATION ENTROPY
// ============================================================================

// Compute permutation entropy
pub fn permutation_entropy(series: &Vec<f64>, order: u32, delay: u32) -> EntropyResult {
    let n = series.len()

    let pattern_len = order as usize
    let delay_val = delay as usize

    if n < pattern_len * delay_val {
        return EntropyResult {
            value: 0.0,
            std_dev: 1.0,
            sample_size: n,
        }
    }

    let n_patterns = n - (pattern_len - 1) * delay_val
    var pattern_counts: Vec<u64> = vec![]

    // Initialize for up to 24 permutations (order ≤ 4)
    let max_perms = 24
    for _ in 0..max_perms {
        pattern_counts.push(0)
    }

    for i in 0..n_patterns {
        // Extract pattern
        var pattern: Vec<f64> = vec![]
        for j in 0..pattern_len {
            pattern.push(series[i + j * delay_val])
        }

        // Compute ordinal pattern index
        let idx = ordinal_pattern_index(&pattern, order) % max_perms
        pattern_counts[idx] = pattern_counts[idx] + 1
    }

    // Compute entropy
    var entropy = 0.0
    for i in 0..max_perms {
        if pattern_counts[i] > 0 {
            let p = (pattern_counts[i] as f64) / (n_patterns as f64)
            entropy = entropy - p * ent_ln_f64(p)
        }
    }

    // Normalize by log(order!)
    let factorial = factorial_u32(order)
    let max_entropy = ent_ln_f64(factorial as f64)
    let normalized = if max_entropy > 0.0 { entropy / max_entropy } else { 0.0 }

    let sample_var = 1.0 / (n_patterns as f64)

    EntropyResult {
        value: normalized,
        std_dev: ent_sqrt_f64(sample_var),
        sample_size: n,
    }
}

// Helper: compute ordinal pattern index
fn ordinal_pattern_index(pattern: &Vec<f64>, order: u32) -> usize {
    var idx: usize = 0
    for i in 0..pattern.len() {
        for j in (i + 1)..pattern.len() {
            if pattern[i] > pattern[j] {
                idx = idx + 1
            }
        }
        idx = idx * (order as usize)
    }
    idx
}

// Helper: factorial
fn factorial_u32(n: u32) -> u32 {
    if n <= 1 { return 1 }
    var result: u32 = 1
    for i in 2..=n {
        result = result * i
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN


// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/fsnn.sio ===
//! stdlib/fractal/fsnn.sio - Fractal Sedenionic Neural Network Layer
//!
//! Takes a sedenionic embedding c in S, runs the Mandelbrot orbit,
//! and extracts a 16-dimensional feature vector phi(c) for downstream classification.
//!
//! Feature vector components:
//!   [0]  escape_ratio       n_esc / N_max
//!   [1]  terminal_norm      |z_N|
//!   [2]  jacobian_op_norm   sigma_1(J_N)
//!   [3]  jacobian_frob_norm ||J_N||_F
//!   [4]  jacobian_condition sigma_1 / sigma_16
//!   [5]  hessian_frob_norm  ||H_N||_F
//!   [6]  curvature_ratio    ||H||_F / ||J||_op^2
//!   [7]  distance_estimator |z_N| ln|z_N| / ||J||_op
//!   [8]  lyapunov_max       (1/n) sum_k ln sigma_1(J_k)
//!   [9]  lyapunov_min       (1/n) ln sigma_16
//!   [10] lyapunov_dim       # expanding singular values (sigma > 1)
//!   [11] zero_div_proximity Moreno analytic distance to Z
//!   [12] orbit_mean         mean(|z_n|)
//!   [13] orbit_std          std(|z_n|)
//!   [14] orbit_skewness     skewness(|z_n|)
//!   [15] orbit_kurtosis     excess kurtosis(|z_n|)

use math::sedenion64::*
use linalg::mat16::*
use linalg::tensor16::*
use fractal::mandelbrot::{OrbitConfig, OrbitResult, compute_orbit, orbit_config_default}
use fractal::zero_divisor::{zd_moreno_proximity}

// ============================================================================
// FSNN FEATURES TYPE
// ============================================================================

pub struct FSNNFeatures {
    escape_ratio: f64,
    terminal_norm: f64,
    jacobian_op_norm: f64,
    jacobian_frob_norm: f64,
    jacobian_condition: f64,
    hessian_frob_norm: f64,
    curvature_ratio: f64,
    distance_estimator: f64,
    lyapunov_max: f64,
    lyapunov_min: f64,
    lyapunov_dim: f64,
    zero_div_proximity: f64,
    orbit_mean: f64,
    orbit_std: f64,
    orbit_skewness: f64,
    orbit_kurtosis: f64,
}

// ============================================================================
// MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn fsnn_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    // Scale into [0.25, 4) before Babylonian iteration.
    // y=x starting point diverges for tiny x (first step gives y≈0.5).
    var xn = x
    var scale = 1.0
    while xn < 0.25 {
        xn = xn * 4.0
        scale = scale * 0.5
    }
    while xn >= 4.0 {
        xn = xn * 0.25
        scale = scale * 2.0
    }
    var y = 1.0
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    return y * scale
}

fn fsnn_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn fsnn_ln(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = 0.0
    var t = x
    if t > 1.0 {
        while t > 2.718281828 {
            t = t / 2.718281828
            y = y + 1.0
        }
        y = y + (t - 1.0) / t
    } else {
        while t < 0.367879441 {
            t = t * 2.718281828
            y = y - 1.0
        }
        y = y + (t - 1.0) / t
    }
    // Newton refinement
    var i = 0
    while i < 8 {
        let ey = fsnn_exp_approx(y)
        y = y + (x - ey) / ey
        i = i + 1
    }
    return y
}

fn fsnn_exp_approx(x: f64) -> f64 {
    var k = 0
    var r = x
    while r > 1.0 {
        r = r * 0.5
        k = k + 1
    }
    while r < -1.0 {
        r = r * 0.5
        k = k + 1
    }
    let r2 = r * r
    let r3 = r2 * r
    let r4 = r3 * r
    let r5 = r4 * r
    let r6 = r5 * r
    var result = 1.0 + r + r2 * 0.5 + r3 / 6.0 + r4 / 24.0 + r5 / 120.0 + r6 / 720.0
    var j = 0
    while j < k {
        result = result * result
        j = j + 1
    }
    return result
}

fn fsnn_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

// ============================================================================
// STATISTICS HELPERS
// ============================================================================

pub fn fsnn_stat_mean(arr: [f64; 256], n: i32) -> f64 {
    if n <= 0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + arr[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum / (n as f64)
}

pub fn fsnn_stat_std(arr: [f64; 256], n: i32) -> f64 {
    if n <= 1 { return 0.0 }
    let mean = fsnn_stat_mean(arr, n)
    var sum_sq = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let d = arr[i] - mean
        sum_sq = sum_sq + d * d
        i = i + 1
    }
    fsnn_sqrt(sum_sq / ((n - 1) as f64))
}

pub fn fsnn_stat_skewness(arr: [f64; 256], n: i32) -> f64 {
    if n <= 2 { return 0.0 }
    let mean = fsnn_stat_mean(arr, n)
    let std = fsnn_stat_std(arr, n)
    if std < 1e-30 { return 0.0 }
    var sum_cube = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let d = (arr[i] - mean) / std
        sum_cube = sum_cube + d * d * d
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum_cube / (n as f64)
}

pub fn fsnn_stat_kurtosis(arr: [f64; 256], n: i32) -> f64 {
    if n <= 3 { return 0.0 }
    let mean = fsnn_stat_mean(arr, n)
    let std = fsnn_stat_std(arr, n)
    if std < 1e-30 { return 0.0 }
    var sum_quad = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let d = (arr[i] - mean) / std
        sum_quad = sum_quad + d * d * d * d
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum_quad / (n as f64) - 3.0    // excess kurtosis
}

// ============================================================================
// FEATURE EXTRACTION
// ============================================================================

pub fn fsnn_extract_features(orbit: OrbitResult, config: OrbitConfig) -> FSNNFeatures {
    let eps = 1e-10
    let n = orbit.n_escape as f64
    let z_norm = sed64_norm(orbit.z_final)

    // Singular values of Jacobian
    let sv = mat16_singular_values(orbit.jacobian)
    let J_op = fsnn_max(sv[0], eps)
    let J_frob = mat16_frobenius_norm(orbit.jacobian)
    let H_frob = tensor16_frobenius_norm(orbit.hessian)

    // Count expanding directions (sigma > 1)
    var lyap_dim = 0.0
    var si = 0
    while si < 16 {
        if sv[si] > 1.0 {
            lyap_dim = lyap_dim + 1.0
        }
        si = si + 1
    }

    // Analytic Moreno proximity (O(1), replaces Monte Carlo)
    let zd_prox = zd_moreno_proximity(orbit.z_final)

    // Distance estimator: |z| ln|z| / ||J||_op
    var dist_est = 0.0
    if z_norm > eps {
        dist_est = z_norm * fsnn_ln(z_norm) / (J_op + eps)
    }

    // Oseledec (1968) Lyapunov exponent: (1/N) sum_n ln sigma_1(J_n)
    // Uses per-iteration sigma_1 approximations stored in jacobian_op_norms.
    var lya_sum = 0.0
    var lk = 0
    while lk < orbit.history_len {
        let jk = orbit.jacobian_op_norms[lk]
        if jk > eps { lya_sum = lya_sum + fsnn_ln(jk) }
        lk = lk + 1
    }
    let n_hist = fsnn_max(orbit.history_len as f64, 1.0)

    FSNNFeatures {
        escape_ratio:       n / (config.max_iter as f64),
        terminal_norm:      z_norm,
        jacobian_op_norm:   J_op,
        jacobian_frob_norm: J_frob,
        jacobian_condition: sv[0] / fsnn_max(sv[15], eps),
        hessian_frob_norm:  H_frob,
        curvature_ratio:    H_frob / (J_op * J_op + eps),
        distance_estimator: dist_est,
        lyapunov_max:       lya_sum / n_hist,
        lyapunov_min:       fsnn_ln(fsnn_max(sv[15], eps)) / fsnn_max(n, 1.0),
        lyapunov_dim:       lyap_dim,
        zero_div_proximity: zd_prox,
        orbit_mean:         fsnn_stat_mean(orbit.orbit_norms, orbit.history_len),
        orbit_std:          fsnn_stat_std(orbit.orbit_norms, orbit.history_len),
        orbit_skewness:     fsnn_stat_skewness(orbit.orbit_norms, orbit.history_len),
        orbit_kurtosis:     fsnn_stat_kurtosis(orbit.orbit_norms, orbit.history_len),
    }
}

// Full FSNN forward pass: embedding -> orbit -> features
pub fn fsnn_forward(c: Sedenion64, config: OrbitConfig) -> FSNNFeatures {
    let orbit = compute_orbit(c, config)
    fsnn_extract_features(orbit, config)
}

// Convert features to flat array for downstream ML
pub fn fsnn_features_to_array(f: FSNNFeatures) -> [f64; 16] {
    var arr = [0.0; 16]
    arr[0] = f.escape_ratio
    arr[1] = f.terminal_norm
    arr[2] = f.jacobian_op_norm
    arr[3] = f.jacobian_frob_norm
    arr[4] = f.jacobian_condition
    arr[5] = f.hessian_frob_norm
    arr[6] = f.curvature_ratio
    arr[7] = f.distance_estimator
    arr[8] = f.lyapunov_max
    arr[9] = f.lyapunov_min
    arr[10] = f.lyapunov_dim
    arr[11] = f.zero_div_proximity
    arr[12] = f.orbit_mean
    arr[13] = f.orbit_std
    arr[14] = f.orbit_skewness
    arr[15] = f.orbit_kurtosis
    return arr
}

pub fn fsnn_features_from_array(arr: [f64; 16]) -> FSNNFeatures {
    FSNNFeatures {
        escape_ratio:       arr[0],
        terminal_norm:      arr[1],
        jacobian_op_norm:   arr[2],
        jacobian_frob_norm: arr[3],
        jacobian_condition: arr[4],
        hessian_frob_norm:  arr[5],
        curvature_ratio:    arr[6],
        distance_estimator: arr[7],
        lyapunov_max:       arr[8],
        lyapunov_min:       arr[9],
        lyapunov_dim:       arr[10],
        zero_div_proximity: arr[11],
        orbit_mean:         arr[12],
        orbit_std:          arr[13],
        orbit_skewness:     arr[14],
        orbit_kurtosis:     arr[15],
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/gpu/box_counting.sio ===
//! stdlib/fractal/gpu/box_counting.sio
//!
//! GPU-Accelerated Box-Counting Dimension
//!
//! This module provides a parallel GPU implementation of the box-counting
//! algorithm for fractal dimension estimation.

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn gbc_abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn gbc_sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    for _ in 0..10 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y) }
    y
}

fn gbc_ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return -1000000.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    var k: i64 = 0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.0; k = k + 1 }
    while v < 1.0 { v = v * 2.0; k = k - 1 }
    let y = v - 1.0
    var result = 0.0
    var power = y
    for i in 1..=15 {
        if i % 2 == 1 { result = result + power / (i as f64) }
        else { result = result - power / (i as f64) }
        power = power * y
    }
    result + (k as f64) * ln2
}

fn gbc_exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    if v > 700.0 { v = 700.0 }
    if v < -700.0 { return 0.0 }
    let k = (v / ln2) as i64
    let r = v - (k as f64) * ln2
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    for i in 1..=15 {
        term = term * r / (i as f64)
        result = result + term
    }
    if k >= 0 { for _ in 0..k { result = result * 2.0 } }
    else { for _ in 0..(-k) { result = result / 2.0 } }
    result
}

fn gbc_min_u32(a: u32, b: u32) -> u32 { if a < b { a } else { b } }

// ============================================================================
// TYPES
// ============================================================================

// Result of fractal dimension analysis
pub struct GbcFractalDimensionResult {
    pub dimension: f64,
    pub dimension_std: f64,
    pub r_squared: f64,
    pub scales: Vec<u32>,
    pub counts: Vec<u64>,
    pub valid: bool,
}

// Simple voxel grid
pub struct VoxelGrid3D {
    pub data: Vec<bool>,
    pub size_x: u32,
    pub size_y: u32,
    pub size_z: u32,
}

// Regression result
struct GbcRegressionResult {
    pub slope: f64,
    pub r_squared: f64,
    pub var_slope: f64,
}

// ============================================================================
// INTERNAL FUNCTIONS (must precede callers)
// ============================================================================

// Check GPU availability
fn gbc_is_gpu_available() -> bool {
    false
}

// Count occupied boxes at a specific scale
fn count_boxes_at_scale(data: &VoxelGrid3D, scale: u32) -> u64 {
    let nx = data.size_x
    let ny = data.size_y
    let nz = data.size_z

    var count: u64 = 0

    let boxes_x = (nx + scale - 1) / scale
    let boxes_y = (ny + scale - 1) / scale
    let boxes_z = (nz + scale - 1) / scale

    for bz in 0..boxes_z {
        for by in 0..boxes_y {
            for bx in 0..boxes_x {
                var found = false

                for dz in 0..scale {
                    if found { break }
                    for dy in 0..scale {
                        if found { break }
                        for dx in 0..scale {
                            let x = bx * scale + dx
                            let y = by * scale + dy
                            let z = bz * scale + dz

                            if x < nx && y < ny && z < nz {
                                let idx = ((z as usize) * (ny as usize) + (y as usize)) * (nx as usize) + (x as usize)
                                if idx < data.data.len() && data.data[idx] {
                                    found = true
                                    break
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if found {
                    count = count + 1
                }
            }
        }
    }

    count
}

// CPU box counting fallback
fn cpu_count_boxes(data: &VoxelGrid3D, scales: &Vec<u32>) -> Vec<u64> {
    var counts: Vec<u64> = vec![]

    for i in 0..scales.len() {
        let scale = scales[i]
        let count = count_boxes_at_scale(data, scale)
        counts.push(count)
    }

    counts
}

// GPU box counting (stub - falls back to CPU)
fn gpu_count_boxes(data: &VoxelGrid3D, scales: &Vec<u32>) -> Vec<u64> {
    cpu_count_boxes(data, scales)
}

// Weighted linear regression
fn weighted_linear_regression(
    x: &Vec<f64>,
    y: &Vec<f64>,
    w: &Vec<f64>,
) -> GbcRegressionResult {
    let n = x.len()
    if n < 2 {
        return GbcRegressionResult { slope: 0.0, r_squared: 0.0, var_slope: 1.0 }
    }

    var sum_w = 0.0
    var sum_wx = 0.0
    var sum_wy = 0.0
    var sum_wxy = 0.0
    var sum_wx2 = 0.0
    var sum_wy2 = 0.0

    for i in 0..n {
        sum_w = sum_w + w[i]
        sum_wx = sum_wx + w[i] * x[i]
        sum_wy = sum_wy + w[i] * y[i]
        sum_wxy = sum_wxy + w[i] * x[i] * y[i]
        sum_wx2 = sum_wx2 + w[i] * x[i] * x[i]
        sum_wy2 = sum_wy2 + w[i] * y[i] * y[i]
    }

    let denom = sum_w * sum_wx2 - sum_wx * sum_wx

    if gbc_abs_f64(denom) < 1e-10 {
        return GbcRegressionResult { slope: 0.0, r_squared: 0.0, var_slope: 1.0 }
    }

    let slope = (sum_w * sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy) / denom
    let intercept = (sum_wy - slope * sum_wx) / sum_w

    // Weighted R²
    let y_mean = sum_wy / sum_w
    var ss_tot = 0.0
    var ss_res = 0.0

    for i in 0..n {
        let pred = intercept + slope * x[i]
        ss_tot = ss_tot + w[i] * (y[i] - y_mean) * (y[i] - y_mean)
        ss_res = ss_res + w[i] * (y[i] - pred) * (y[i] - pred)
    }

    let r_sq = if ss_tot > 0.0 { 1.0 - ss_res / ss_tot } else { 0.0 }

    // Variance of slope
    let mse = if n > 2 { ss_res / (sum_w * (1.0 - 2.0 / (n as f64))) } else { ss_res / sum_w }
    let var_slope = if denom > 0.0 { mse * sum_w / denom } else { 1.0 }

    GbcRegressionResult {
        slope: slope,
        r_squared: r_sq,
        var_slope: var_slope,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// GPU BOX COUNTING DIMENSION (public entry point)
// ============================================================================

// Compute box-counting dimension with GPU acceleration (or CPU fallback)
pub fn gpu_box_counting_dimension(
    data: &VoxelGrid3D,
    min_scale: u32,
    max_scale: u32,
    num_scales: u32,
) -> GbcFractalDimensionResult {
    // Validate inputs
    if min_scale >= max_scale {
        return GbcFractalDimensionResult {
            dimension: 0.0, dimension_std: 1.0, r_squared: 0.0,
            scales: vec![], counts: vec![], valid: false,
        }
    }

    let nx = data.size_x
    let ny = data.size_y
    let nz = data.size_z
    let min_dim = gbc_min_u32(gbc_min_u32(nx, ny), nz)

    // Generate logarithmically spaced scales
    var scales: Vec<u32> = vec![]
    let log_min = gbc_ln_f64(min_scale as f64)
    let log_max = gbc_ln_f64(gbc_min_u32(max_scale, min_dim) as f64)
    let log_step = (log_max - log_min) / ((num_scales - 1) as f64)

    for i in 0..num_scales {
        let log_scale = log_min + (i as f64) * log_step
        let scale = gbc_exp_f64(log_scale) as u32
        if scale >= 1 {
            var is_duplicate = false
            if scales.len() > 0 && scale == scales[scales.len() - 1] {
                is_duplicate = true
            }
            if !is_duplicate {
                scales.push(scale)
            }
        }
    }

    if scales.len() < 2 {
        return GbcFractalDimensionResult {
            dimension: 0.0, dimension_std: 1.0, r_squared: 0.0,
            scales: scales, counts: vec![], valid: false,
        }
    }

    // Check GPU availability and dispatch
    let use_gpu = gbc_is_gpu_available() && data.data.len() > 100000

    var counts: Vec<u64> = vec![]

    if use_gpu {
        counts = gpu_count_boxes(data, &scales)
    } else {
        counts = cpu_count_boxes(data, &scales)
    }

    // Prepare for log-log regression
    var log_inv_scales: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    var log_counts: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    var weights: Vec<f64> = vec![]

    for i in 0..scales.len() {
        if i < counts.len() && counts[i] > 0 {
            log_inv_scales.push(gbc_ln_f64(1.0 / (scales[i] as f64)))
            log_counts.push(gbc_ln_f64(counts[i] as f64))
            let rel_err = gbc_sqrt_f64(counts[i] as f64) / (counts[i] as f64)
            weights.push(1.0 / (rel_err * rel_err + 0.01))
        }
    }

    if log_inv_scales.len() < 2 {
        return GbcFractalDimensionResult {
            dimension: 0.0, dimension_std: 1.0, r_squared: 0.0,
            scales: scales, counts: counts, valid: false,
        }
    }

    // Weighted linear regression
    let reg = weighted_linear_regression(&log_inv_scales, &log_counts, &weights)

    GbcFractalDimensionResult {
        dimension: reg.slope,
        dimension_std: gbc_sqrt_f64(reg.var_slope),
        r_squared: reg.r_squared,
        scales: scales,
        counts: counts,
        valid: reg.r_squared >= 0.90,
    }
}

// GPU memory buffer for voxel data
pub struct GpuVoxelBuffer {
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
    pub dim_x: u32,
    pub dim_y: u32,
    pub dim_z: u32,
    pub on_device: bool,
}

// Create GPU buffer from voxels
pub fn gpu_buffer_from_voxels(voxels: &Vec<bool>, nx: u32, ny: u32, nz: u32) -> GpuVoxelBuffer {
    var data: Vec<u8> = vec![]
    for i in 0..voxels.len() {
        if voxels[i] {
            data.push(1)
        } else {
            data.push(0)
        }
    }

    GpuVoxelBuffer {
        data: data,
        dim_x: nx,
        dim_y: ny,
        dim_z: nz,
        on_device: false,
    }
}

// Transfer buffer to device
pub fn gpu_buffer_to_device(buffer: &GpuVoxelBuffer) -> GpuVoxelBuffer {
    var data: Vec<u8> = vec![]
    for i in 0..buffer.data.len() {
        data.push(buffer.data[i])
    }

    GpuVoxelBuffer {
        data: data,
        dim_x: buffer.dim_x,
        dim_y: buffer.dim_y,
        dim_z: buffer.dim_z,
        on_device: is_gpu_available(),
    }
}

// Transfer buffer back to host as bool vec
pub fn gpu_buffer_to_host(buffer: &GpuVoxelBuffer) -> Vec<bool> {
    var result: Vec<bool> = vec![]
    for i in 0..buffer.data.len() {
        result.push(buffer.data[i] > 0)
    }
    result
}

// GPU buffer for scalar results
pub struct GpuScalarBuffer {
    pub data: Vec<u64>,
    pub on_device: bool,
}

// Create zeros scalar buffer
pub fn gpu_scalar_buffer_zeros(size: usize) -> GpuScalarBuffer {
    var data: Vec<u64> = vec![]
    for _ in 0..size {
        data.push(0)
    }
    GpuScalarBuffer { data: data, on_device: false }
}

// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/lacunarity.sio ===
//! stdlib/fractal/lacunarity.sio
//!
//! Lacunarity Analysis with Uncertainty Propagation
//!
//! Lacunarity measures the "gappiness" or texture heterogeneity of a pattern.

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn lac_abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn lac_sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    for _ in 0..10 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y) }
    y
}

fn lac_ln_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return -1000000.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    var k: i64 = 0
    while v > 2.0 { v = v / 2.0; k = k + 1 }
    while v < 1.0 { v = v * 2.0; k = k - 1 }
    let y = v - 1.0
    var result = 0.0
    var power = y
    for i in 1..=15 {
        if i % 2 == 1 { result = result + power / (i as f64) }
        else { result = result - power / (i as f64) }
        power = power * y
    }
    result + (k as f64) * ln2
}

fn lac_pow_f64(x: f64, y: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    lac_exp_f64(y * lac_ln_f64(x))
}

fn lac_exp_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var v = x
    if v > 700.0 { v = 700.0 }
    if v < -700.0 { return 0.0 }
    let k = (v / ln2) as i64
    let r = v - (k as f64) * ln2
    var result = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    for i in 1..=15 {
        term = term * r / (i as f64)
        result = result + term
    }
    if k >= 0 { for _ in 0..k { result = result * 2.0 } }
    else { for _ in 0..(-k) { result = result / 2.0 } }
    result
}

fn min_i64(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }
fn max_i64(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }

// ============================================================================
// RESULT TYPES
// ============================================================================

// Single lacunarity value with uncertainty
pub struct LacunarityValue {
    pub value: f64,
    pub std_dev: f64,
}

// Result of lacunarity analysis
pub struct LacunarityResult {
    pub lacunarity: Vec<f64>,
    pub lacunarity_std: Vec<f64>,
    pub scales: Vec<u32>,
    pub prefactor: f64,
    pub exponent: f64,
    pub r_squared: f64,
    pub exponent_std: f64,
}

// Linear regression result
struct LacRegressionResult {
    pub intercept: f64,
    pub slope: f64,
    pub r_squared: f64,
    pub var_intercept: f64,
    pub var_slope: f64,
}

// 3D binary voxel grid
pub struct VoxelGrid {
    pub data: Vec<bool>,
    pub size_x: u32,
    pub size_y: u32,
    pub size_z: u32,
}

// ============================================================================
// LACUNARITY COMPUTATION
// ============================================================================

// Compute lacunarity for a voxel grid
pub fn lacunarity(
    grid: &VoxelGrid,
    min_scale: u32,
    max_scale: u32,
) -> LacunarityResult {
    let nx = grid.size_x
    let ny = grid.size_y
    let nz = grid.size_z

    // Determine scales (powers of 2)
    var scales: Vec<u32> = vec![]
    var r = min_scale
    let min_dim = min_i64(min_i64(nx as i64, ny as i64), nz as i64) as u32
    while r <= max_scale && r <= min_dim {
        scales.push(r)
        r = r * 2
    }

    if scales.len() == 0 {
        scales.push(1)
    }

    // Compute lacunarity at each scale
    var lacunarity_values: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    var lacunarity_stds: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    var log_scales: Vec<f64> = vec![]
    var log_lac: Vec<f64> = vec![]

    for i in 0..scales.len() {
        let scale = scales[i]
        let lac = compute_lacunarity_at_scale(grid, scale)
        lacunarity_values.push(lac.value)
        lacunarity_stds.push(lac.std_dev)

        if lac.value > 0.0 {
            log_scales.push(lac_ln_f64(scale as f64))
            log_lac.push(lac_ln_f64(lac.value))
        }
    }

    // Power-law fit: log(Λ) = log(A) + β * log(r)
    let reg = if log_scales.len() >= 2 {
        lac_linear_regression(&log_scales, &log_lac)
    } else {
        LacRegressionResult {
            intercept: 0.0,
            slope: 0.0,
            r_squared: 0.0,
            var_intercept: 1.0,
            var_slope: 1.0,
        }
    }

    let prefactor = lac_exp_f64(reg.intercept)

    LacunarityResult {
        lacunarity: lacunarity_values,
        lacunarity_std: lacunarity_stds,
        scales: scales,
        prefactor: prefactor,
        exponent: reg.slope,
        r_squared: reg.r_squared,
        exponent_std: lac_sqrt_f64(reg.var_slope),
    }
}

// Compute lacunarity at a specific scale
fn compute_lacunarity_at_scale(grid: &VoxelGrid, box_size: u32) -> LacunarityValue {
    let nx = grid.size_x
    let ny = grid.size_y
    let nz = grid.size_z
    let r = box_size

    if r > nx || r > ny || r > nz {
        return LacunarityValue { value: 0.0, std_dev: 1.0 }
    }

    // Gliding box positions
    let n_x = (nx - r + 1) as usize
    let n_y = (ny - r + 1) as usize
    let n_z = (nz - r + 1) as usize
    let n_boxes = n_x * n_y * n_z

    if n_boxes == 0 {
        return LacunarityValue { value: 0.0, std_dev: 1.0 }
    }

    // Compute mass statistics
    var sum_m: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_m2: f64 = 0.0

    for bx in 0..n_x {
        for by in 0..n_y {
            for bz in 0..n_z {
                // Count occupied voxels in this box
                var mass: u64 = 0
                for dx in 0..r {
                    for dy in 0..r {
                        for dz in 0..r {
                            let x = (bx as u32) + dx
                            let y = (by as u32) + dy
                            let z = (bz as u32) + dz
                            if x < nx && y < ny && z < nz {
                                let idx = ((z as usize) * (ny as usize) + (y as usize)) * (nx as usize) + (x as usize)
                                if idx < grid.data.len() && grid.data[idx] {
                                    mass = mass + 1
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                sum_m = sum_m + (mass as f64)
                sum_m2 = sum_m2 + ((mass * mass) as f64)
            }
        }
    }

    // Compute lacunarity: Λ = <M²> / <M>² - 1
    let mean_m = sum_m / (n_boxes as f64)
    let mean_m2 = sum_m2 / (n_boxes as f64)

    let lac = if mean_m > 0.0 {
        mean_m2 / (mean_m * mean_m) - 1.0
    } else {
        0.0
    }

    // Uncertainty estimation
    let var_m = (mean_m2 - mean_m * mean_m) / (n_boxes as f64)
    let relative_var = if mean_m > 0.0 { 4.0 * var_m / (mean_m * mean_m) } else { 1.0 }
    let total_var = relative_var * lac * lac

    LacunarityValue {
        value: lac,
        std_dev: lac_sqrt_f64(total_var),
    }
}

// Linear regression
fn lac_linear_regression(x: &Vec<f64>, y: &Vec<f64>) -> LacRegressionResult {
    let n = x.len()
    if n < 2 {
        return LacRegressionResult {
            intercept: 0.0,
            slope: 0.0,
            r_squared: 0.0,
            var_intercept: 1.0,
            var_slope: 1.0,
        }
    }

    var sum_x = 0.0
    var sum_y = 0.0
    var sum_xy = 0.0
    var sum_x2 = 0.0
    var sum_y2 = 0.0

    for i in 0..n {
        sum_x = sum_x + x[i]
        sum_y = sum_y + y[i]
        sum_xy = sum_xy + x[i] * y[i]
        sum_x2 = sum_x2 + x[i] * x[i]
        sum_y2 = sum_y2 + y[i] * y[i]
    }

    let nf = n as f64
    let denom = nf * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x

    if lac_abs_f64(denom) < 1e-10 {
        return LacRegressionResult {
            intercept: sum_y / nf,
            slope: 0.0,
            r_squared: 0.0,
            var_intercept: 1.0,
            var_slope: 1.0,
        }
    }

    let slope = (nf * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / denom
    let intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_x) / nf

    // R² computation
    let ss_tot = sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y / nf
    var ss_res = 0.0
    for i in 0..n {
        let pred = intercept + slope * x[i]
        let residual = y[i] - pred
        ss_res = ss_res + residual * residual
    }

    let r_squared = if ss_tot > 0.0 { 1.0 - ss_res / ss_tot } else { 0.0 }

    // Variance estimates
    let mse = if n > 2 { ss_res / (nf - 2.0) } else { ss_res }
    let var_slope = if denom > 0.0 { mse * nf / denom } else { 1.0 }
    let var_intercept = mse * sum_x2 / denom

    LacRegressionResult {
        intercept: intercept,
        slope: slope,
        r_squared: r_squared,
        var_intercept: var_intercept,
        var_slope: var_slope,
    }
}

// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/mandelbrot.sio ===
//! stdlib/fractal/mandelbrot.sio - Mandelbrot Orbit in Sedenionic Space (f64)
//!
//! Computes z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c in S with first-order Jacobian J_n and
//! second-order Hessian H_n recursions.
//!
//! Mathematical kernel for the FSNN architecture.
//!
//! Recursions (Chiuratto Agourakis, "Generalised Wirtinger Calculus on Sedenions", 2026):
//!   Orbit:     z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c
//!   Jacobian:  J_{n+1} = J_{z_n} * J_n + I_16     (Theorem 4.2)
//!   Hessian:   H_{n+1}[d1,d2] = Jordan(J_n[d1], J_n[d2]) + J_{z_n}(H_n[d1,d2])  (Theorem 4.4)
//!
//! where J_{z_n} = L_{z_n} + R_{z_n} is the Jordan operator matrix.

use math::sedenion64::*
use linalg::mat16::*
use linalg::tensor16::*

// ============================================================================
// CONFIGURATION AND RESULT TYPES
// ============================================================================

pub struct OrbitConfig {
    max_iter: i32,
    escape_radius: f64,
    compute_hessian: i32,    // 0=no, 1=yes
}

pub fn orbit_config_default() -> OrbitConfig {
    OrbitConfig { max_iter: 50, escape_radius: 4.0, compute_hessian: 1 }
}

pub struct OrbitResult {
    z_final: Sedenion64,
    jacobian: Mat16,
    hessian: Tensor16,
    n_escape: i32,
    escaped: i32,
    orbit_norms: [f64; 256],
    jacobian_op_norms: [f64; 256],
    hessian_frob_norms: [f64; 256],
    history_len: i32,
}

// ============================================================================
// ORBIT COMPUTATION
// ============================================================================

// Compute the Mandelbrot orbit for parameter c in S.
// Returns an OrbitResult containing the terminal state and all derivative
// information needed for FSNN feature extraction.
pub fn compute_orbit(c: Sedenion64, config: OrbitConfig) -> OrbitResult {
    var z = sed64_zero()
    var J = mat16_zeros()
    var H = tensor16_zeros()
    let I16 = mat16_identity()

    var orbit_norms = [0.0; 256]
    var j_norms = [0.0; 256]
    var h_norms = [0.0; 256]
    orbit_norms[0] = 0.0
    j_norms[0] = 0.0
    h_norms[0] = 0.0

    var escaped = 0
    var n_escape = config.max_iter
    var history_len = 1

    var n = 0
    while n < config.max_iter {
        // ---- Orbit step: z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c ----
        let z_new = sed64_add(sed64_mul(z, z), c)

        // ---- Jacobian recursion: J_{n+1} = J_{z_n} * J_n + I_16 ----
        // J_{z_n} = L_{z_n} + R_{z_n} (Jordan operator matrix)
        let Jz_data = sed64_jordan_matrix(z)
        let Jz = mat16_from_array(Jz_data)
        let J_new = mat16_add(mat16_mul(Jz, J), I16)

        // ---- Hessian recursion (if enabled) ----
        if config.compute_hessian == 1 {
            // Transport: J_{z_n}(H_n) — apply Jz to each fibre H[:,j,k]
            var H_new = tensor16_jordan_transport(Jz, H)

            // Curvature source: for each (j,k), Jordan product of J_n*e_j and J_n*e_k
            // Jordan(u, v) = u*v + v*u as sedenions
            var j = 0
            while j < 16 {
                // J_n * e_j: column j of J_n, interpreted as sedenion
                let col_j = mat16_column(J, j)
                let Jj = sed64_from_array(col_j)

                var k = j
                while k < 16 {
                    let col_k = mat16_column(J, k)
                    let Jk = sed64_from_array(col_k)

                    // Jordan product of Jj and Jk
                    let jp = sed64_jordan(Jj, Jk)

                    // Add to H_new
                    var i = 0
                    while i < 16 {
                        let val = sed64_get(jp, i)
                        let old_jk = tensor16_get(H_new, i, j, k)
                        H_new = tensor16_set(H_new, i, j, k, old_jk + val)
                        if k != j {
                            let old_kj = tensor16_get(H_new, i, k, j)
                            H_new = tensor16_set(H_new, i, k, j, old_kj + val)
                        }
                        i = i + 1
                    }
                    k = k + 1
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
            H = H_new
        }

        z = z_new
        J = J_new

        // Record norms
        let z_norm = sed64_norm(z)
        if history_len < 256 {
            orbit_norms[history_len] = z_norm
            j_norms[history_len] = mat16_operator_norm_approx(J)
            if config.compute_hessian == 1 {
                h_norms[history_len] = tensor16_frobenius_norm(H)
            }
            history_len = history_len + 1
        }

        // Escape check
        if z_norm > config.escape_radius {
            escaped = 1
            n_escape = n + 1
            n = config.max_iter
        }
        n = n + 1
    }

    OrbitResult {
        z_final: z,
        jacobian: J,
        hessian: H,
        n_escape: n_escape,
        escaped: escaped,
        orbit_norms: orbit_norms,
        jacobian_op_norms: j_norms,
        hessian_frob_norms: h_norms,
        history_len: history_len,
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/mod.sio ===
//! stdlib/fractal

module fractal


// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/multifractal.sio ===
//! multifractal (disabled)


// === FILE: stdlib/fractal/zero_divisor.sio ===
//! stdlib/fractal/zero_divisor.sio - Zero-Divisor Infrastructure in S
//!
//! S has zero divisors: non-zero a,b with a*b = 0.
//! A sedenion z = alpha + beta*l is a zero divisor iff |alpha| = |beta| and
//! alpha * conj(beta) satisfies the Moreno constraint (1998).
//!
//! This module provides:
//! - Monte Carlo proximity estimation to the zero-divisor variety Z in S
//! - Deterministic sampling of zero divisors for testing
//! - Basis zero-divisor pair enumeration
//!
//! Reference: Moreno, "The zero divisors of the Cayley-Dickson algebras..." (1998)

use math::sedenion64::*
use math::cayley_dickson::{oct64_norm_sq_components}

// ============================================================================
// PRNG (Linear Congruential Generator)
// ============================================================================
// Simple deterministic PRNG for reproducible Monte Carlo sampling.
// Parameters from Numerical Recipes: a=6364136223846793005, c=1442695040888963407

fn zd_lcg_next(state: i64) -> i64 {
    // Avoid overflow: use the modular arithmetic naturally
    let a = 6364136223846793005
    let c = 1442695040888963407
    return state * a + c
}

// Convert LCG state to f64 in [-1, 1]
fn zd_lcg_to_f64(state: i64) -> f64 {
    // Use upper bits for better quality
    let shifted = state / 4294967296   // >> 32 equivalent
    let f = shifted
    // Normalize to roughly [-1, 1]
    return (f as f64) / 2147483648.0
}

// ============================================================================
// ZERO-DIVISOR SAMPLING
// ============================================================================
// Construct a zero divisor z = alpha + beta*l where:
// - alpha is a purely imaginary octonion (e0 component = 0)
// - beta is a purely imaginary octonion orthogonal to alpha
// - |alpha| = |beta|
// This satisfies the necessary condition for zero divisors.

fn zd_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    // Scale into [0.25, 4) so Babylonian starts near the answer.
    // Without this, y=x diverges for tiny x: first step gives y≈0.5,
    // then only halves 10 times, landing ≈1e-3 instead of ≈1e-7.
    var xn = x
    var scale = 1.0
    while xn < 0.25 {
        xn = xn * 4.0
        scale = scale * 0.5
    }
    while xn >= 4.0 {
        xn = xn * 0.25
        scale = scale * 2.0
    }
    // 8 Babylonian iterations converge to machine epsilon for xn in [0.25, 4)
    var y = 1.0
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + xn / y)
    return y * scale
}

fn zd_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

pub fn zd_sample(seed: i64) -> Sedenion64 {
    // Generate random purely imaginary octonion alpha (7 components)
    var s = seed
    var a1 = 0.0
    var a2 = 0.0
    var a3 = 0.0
    var a4 = 0.0
    var a5 = 0.0
    var a6 = 0.0
    var a7 = 0.0

    s = zd_lcg_next(s)
    a1 = zd_lcg_to_f64(s)
    s = zd_lcg_next(s)
    a2 = zd_lcg_to_f64(s)
    s = zd_lcg_next(s)
    a3 = zd_lcg_to_f64(s)
    s = zd_lcg_next(s)
    a4 = zd_lcg_to_f64(s)
    s = zd_lcg_next(s)
    a5 = zd_lcg_to_f64(s)
    s = zd_lcg_next(s)
    a6 = zd_lcg_to_f64(s)
    s = zd_lcg_next(s)
    a7 = zd_lcg_to_f64(s)

    // Normalize alpha to unit norm
    let a_nsq = a1*a1 + a2*a2 + a3*a3 + a4*a4 + a5*a5 + a6*a6 + a7*a7
    let a_norm = zd_sqrt(a_nsq)
    if a_norm < 1e-15 {
        // Fallback: use a known zero divisor
        return sed64_add(sed64_basis(3), sed64_basis(10))
    }
    let inv_a = 1.0 / a_norm
    a1 = a1 * inv_a
    a2 = a2 * inv_a
    a3 = a3 * inv_a
    a4 = a4 * inv_a
    a5 = a5 * inv_a
    a6 = a6 * inv_a
    a7 = a7 * inv_a

    // Generate random beta, then Gram-Schmidt orthogonalize against alpha
    var b1 = 0.0
    var b2 = 0.0
    var b3 = 0.0
    var b4 = 0.0
    var b5 = 0.0
    var b6 = 0.0
    var b7 = 0.0

    s = zd_lcg_next(s)
    b1 = zd_lcg_to_f64(s)
    s = zd_lcg_next(s)
    b2 = zd_lcg_to_f64(s)
    s = zd_lcg_next(s)
    b3 = zd_lcg_to_f64(s)
    s = zd_lcg_next(s)
    b4 = zd_lcg_to_f64(s)
    s = zd_lcg_next(s)
    b5 = zd_lcg_to_f64(s)
    s = zd_lcg_next(s)
    b6 = zd_lcg_to_f64(s)
    s = zd_lcg_next(s)
    b7 = zd_lcg_to_f64(s)

    // Gram-Schmidt: b = b - (b . a) * a
    let dot = b1*a1 + b2*a2 + b3*a3 + b4*a4 + b5*a5 + b6*a6 + b7*a7
    b1 = b1 - dot * a1
    b2 = b2 - dot * a2
    b3 = b3 - dot * a3
    b4 = b4 - dot * a4
    b5 = b5 - dot * a5
    b6 = b6 - dot * a6
    b7 = b7 - dot * a7

    // Normalize beta to unit norm (same as alpha)
    let b_nsq = b1*b1 + b2*b2 + b3*b3 + b4*b4 + b5*b5 + b6*b6 + b7*b7
    let b_norm = zd_sqrt(b_nsq)
    if b_norm < 1e-15 {
        return sed64_add(sed64_basis(3), sed64_basis(10))
    }
    let inv_b = 1.0 / b_norm
    b1 = b1 * inv_b
    b2 = b2 * inv_b
    b3 = b3 * inv_b
    b4 = b4 * inv_b
    b5 = b5 * inv_b
    b6 = b6 * inv_b
    b7 = b7 * inv_b

    // Construct z = (0, a1..a7, 0, b1..b7) with |alpha|=|beta|=1
    // alpha = (0, a1..a7), beta = (0, b1..b7) — purely imaginary
    sed64(0.0, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7,
          0.0, b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6, b7)
}

// ============================================================================
// PROXIMITY ESTIMATION
// ============================================================================
// Estimate minimum distance from z to the zero-divisor variety Z via
// Monte Carlo sampling. Returns the smallest ||z - zd|| found.

pub fn zd_proximity(z: Sedenion64, n_samples: i32) -> f64 {
    let z_norm = sed64_norm(z)
    if z_norm < 1e-15 { return 0.0 }

    var min_dist = 1e30
    var seed = 42 as i64
    var i = 0
    while i < n_samples {
        let zd = zd_sample(seed)
        // Scale to match norm of z
        let scaled_zd = sed64_scale(zd, z_norm)
        let dist = sed64_norm(sed64_sub(z, scaled_zd))
        if dist < min_dist {
            min_dist = dist
        }
        seed = zd_lcg_next(seed)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return min_dist
}

// ============================================================================
// ANALYTIC MORENO PROXIMITY
// ============================================================================
// Analytic distance from z to the zero-divisor variety Z in S, based on the
// full Moreno (1998) characterization: z=(alpha,beta) is a zero divisor iff
//   (1) |alpha| = |beta|         — norm equality
//   (2) <alpha, beta> = 0        — orthogonality of the two halves
//
// Returns a combined relative distance in [0, sqrt(2)]:
//   0   => z is exactly on the zero-divisor variety
//   >0  => distance proportional to violation of Moreno constraints
//
// O(1) cost; replaces Monte Carlo zd_proximity for feature extraction.

pub fn zd_moreno_proximity(z: Sedenion64) -> f64 {
    let alpha_nsq = z.e0*z.e0 + z.e1*z.e1 + z.e2*z.e2 + z.e3*z.e3 +
                    z.e4*z.e4 + z.e5*z.e5 + z.e6*z.e6 + z.e7*z.e7
    let beta_nsq  = z.e8*z.e8 + z.e9*z.e9 + z.e10*z.e10 + z.e11*z.e11 +
                    z.e12*z.e12 + z.e13*z.e13 + z.e14*z.e14 + z.e15*z.e15
    let a_norm = zd_sqrt(alpha_nsq)
    let b_norm = zd_sqrt(beta_nsq)
    // Condition 1: relative norm imbalance — 0 when |alpha|=|beta|
    let norm_sum = a_norm + b_norm + 1e-30
    let norm_imb = zd_abs(a_norm - b_norm) / norm_sum
    // Condition 2: relative orthogonality violation — 0 when <alpha,beta>=0
    let inner = z.e0*z.e8 + z.e1*z.e9 + z.e2*z.e10 + z.e3*z.e11 +
                z.e4*z.e12 + z.e5*z.e13 + z.e6*z.e14 + z.e7*z.e15
    let orth_viol = zd_abs(inner) / (a_norm * b_norm + 1e-30)
    // Combined: 0 iff both conditions satisfied
    zd_sqrt(norm_imb * norm_imb + orth_viol * orth_viol)
}

// ============================================================================
// BASIS ZERO-DIVISOR ENUMERATION
// ============================================================================
// Count zero-divisor pairs among basis element combinations (e_i +/- e_j)
// where i in {1..7} and j in {8..15}.
// Returns the number of pairs found.

pub fn zd_enumerate_basis_pairs_count() -> i32 {
    var count = 0
    var i = 1
    while i <= 7 {
        var j = 8
        while j <= 15 {
            // Test a = e_i + e_j, search for annihilator b = e_k +/- e_l
            let a_plus = sed64_add(sed64_basis(i), sed64_basis(j))

            var k = 1
            while k <= 7 {
                var l = 8
                while l <= 15 {
                    // b = e_k + e_l
                    let b_plus = sed64_add(sed64_basis(k), sed64_basis(l))
                    let prod_pp = sed64_mul(a_plus, b_plus)
                    if sed64_norm(prod_pp) < 1e-10 {
                        count = count + 1
                    }
                    // b = e_k - e_l
                    let b_minus = sed64_sub(sed64_basis(k), sed64_basis(l))
                    let prod_pm = sed64_mul(a_plus, b_minus)
                    if sed64_norm(prod_pm) < 1e-10 {
                        count = count + 1
                    }
                    l = l + 1
                }
                k = k + 1
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return count
}


// === FILE: stdlib/functional/calculus.sio ===
// stdlib/functional/calculus.sio — Higher-Order Numerical Calculus
//
// Sprint 230: Every algorithm takes fn(f64) -> f64 as argument.
// Differentiate, integrate, find roots of, and optimize ANY function.
// Pure Sounio — no extern "C", no libc, no runtime.
//
// Usage:
//   use functional::calculus::{deriv, newton, bisect, integrate, minimize}
//
//   fn my_sin(x: f64) -> f64 { ... }
//   let slope = deriv(my_sin, 0.0)        // ≈ cos(0) = 1.0
//   let root  = newton(my_sin, 3.0)       // ≈ π
//   let area  = integrate(my_sin, 0.0, root) // ≈ 2.0

module functional::calculus

// ============================================================================
// Math primitives (pure Sounio, no extern C)
// ============================================================================

pub fn fc_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

pub fn fc_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var guess = x
    if x > 1.0 { guess = x * 0.5 }
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 60 {
        guess = 0.5 * (guess + x / guess)
        i = i + 1
    }
    guess
}

// ============================================================================
// Numerical Differentiation
// ============================================================================

// Central difference: f'(x) ≈ (f(x+h) - f(x-h)) / 2h
// Default step h = 1e-8 (optimal for f64 machine epsilon ~1e-16)
pub fn deriv(f: fn(f64) -> f64, x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let h = 0.00000001
    let fph = f(x + h)
    let fmh = f(x - h)
    (fph - fmh) / (2.0 * h)
}

// Central difference with explicit step size
pub fn deriv_h(f: fn(f64) -> f64, x: f64, h: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    (f(x + h) - f(x - h)) / (2.0 * h)
}

// Second derivative: f''(x) ≈ (f(x+h) - 2f(x) + f(x-h)) / h²
pub fn deriv2(f: fn(f64) -> f64, x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let h = 0.0001
    (f(x + h) - 2.0 * f(x) + f(x - h)) / (h * h)
}

// Fourth-order accurate first derivative (5-point stencil)
pub fn deriv4(f: fn(f64) -> f64, x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let h = 0.0001
    let fm2 = f(x - 2.0 * h)
    let fm1 = f(x - h)
    let fp1 = f(x + h)
    let fp2 = f(x + 2.0 * h)
    (fm2 - 8.0 * fm1 + 8.0 * fp1 - fp2) / (12.0 * h)
}

// ============================================================================
// Root Finding
// ============================================================================

// Newton-Raphson: find x where f(x) = 0
// Uses numerical derivative. Max 100 iterations, tol 1e-12.
pub fn newton(f: fn(f64) -> f64, x0: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var x = x0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 100 {
        let fx = f(x)
        if fc_abs(fx) < 0.000000000001 { return x }
        let dfx = deriv(f, x)
        if fc_abs(dfx) < 0.0000000000000001 { return x }
        let step = fx / dfx
        // Trust region: limit step to ±1.0
        if step > 1.0 { x = x - 1.0 }
        else if step < 0.0 - 1.0 { x = x + 1.0 }
        else { x = x - step }
        i = i + 1
    }
    x
}

// Bisection: find root in [a, b] where f(a) and f(b) have opposite signs.
// Guaranteed convergence. Max 100 iterations, tol 1e-12.
pub fn bisect(f: fn(f64) -> f64, a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var lo = a
    var hi = b
    var flo = f(lo)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 100 {
        let mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if (hi - lo) < 0.000000000001 { return mid }
        let fmid = f(mid)
        if fc_abs(fmid) < 0.000000000001 { return mid }
        // If flo and fmid have same sign, root is in [mid, hi]
        if (flo > 0.0 && fmid > 0.0) || (flo < 0.0 && fmid < 0.0) {
            lo = mid
            flo = fmid
        } else {
            hi = mid
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    0.5 * (lo + hi)
}

// Secant method: like Newton but avoids explicit derivative evaluation.
// Superlinear convergence (order ≈ 1.618).
pub fn secant(f: fn(f64) -> f64, x0: f64, x1: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var xp = x0
    var xc = x1
    var fp = f(xp)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 100 {
        let fc = f(xc)
        if fc_abs(fc) < 0.000000000001 { return xc }
        let denom = fc - fp
        if fc_abs(denom) < 0.0000000000000001 { return xc }
        let x_new = xc - fc * (xc - xp) / denom
        xp = xc
        fp = fc
        xc = x_new
        i = i + 1
    }
    xc
}

// ============================================================================
// Integration
// ============================================================================

// Composite Simpson's 1/3 rule: ∫[a,b] f(x) dx ≈ (h/3)[f(a) + 4f(x1) + 2f(x2) + ... + f(b)]
// n = number of subintervals (must be even; forced even if odd)
pub fn integrate_n(f: fn(f64) -> f64, a: f64, b: f64, n: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var nn = n
    if nn < 2 { nn = 2 }
    if nn % 2 != 0 { nn = nn + 1 }
    let h = (b - a) / (nn as f64)
    var sum = f(a) + f(b)
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < nn {
        let x = a + (i as f64) * h
        if i % 2 == 0 {
            sum = sum + 2.0 * f(x)
        } else {
            sum = sum + 4.0 * f(x)
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum * h / 3.0
}

// Composite Simpson with 1000 subintervals (good default for smooth functions)
pub fn integrate(f: fn(f64) -> f64, a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    integrate_n(f, a, b, 1000)
}

// Trapezoidal rule (simpler, lower order)
pub fn trapezoid(f: fn(f64) -> f64, a: f64, b: f64, n: i64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let h = (b - a) / (n as f64)
    var sum = 0.5 * (f(a) + f(b))
    var i: i64 = 1
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + f(a + (i as f64) * h)
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum * h
}

// ============================================================================
// Optimization
// ============================================================================

// Golden-section search: find x ∈ [a,b] that minimizes f(x).
// Requires f unimodal on [a,b]. Max 100 iterations, tol 1e-10.
pub fn minimize(f: fn(f64) -> f64, a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let phi = 1.6180339887  // golden ratio
    let resphi = 2.0 - phi  // = 1 - 1/phi ≈ 0.382
    var lo = a
    var hi = b
    var x1 = lo + resphi * (hi - lo)
    var x2 = hi - resphi * (hi - lo)
    var f1 = f(x1)
    var f2 = f(x2)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 100 {
        if fc_abs(hi - lo) < 0.0000000001 { return 0.5 * (lo + hi) }
        if f1 < f2 {
            hi = x2
            x2 = x1
            f2 = f1
            x1 = lo + resphi * (hi - lo)
            f1 = f(x1)
        } else {
            lo = x1
            x1 = x2
            f1 = f2
            x2 = hi - resphi * (hi - lo)
            f2 = f(x2)
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    0.5 * (lo + hi)
}

// Maximize f on [a,b] — negate and minimize
pub fn maximize(f: fn(f64) -> f64, a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Can't negate f directly without closures, so inline the logic
    let phi = 1.6180339887
    let resphi = 2.0 - phi
    var lo = a
    var hi = b
    var x1 = lo + resphi * (hi - lo)
    var x2 = hi - resphi * (hi - lo)
    var f1 = 0.0 - f(x1)
    var f2 = 0.0 - f(x2)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 100 {
        if fc_abs(hi - lo) < 0.0000000001 { return 0.5 * (lo + hi) }
        if f1 < f2 {
            hi = x2
            x2 = x1
            f2 = f1
            x1 = lo + resphi * (hi - lo)
            f1 = 0.0 - f(x1)
        } else {
            lo = x1
            x1 = x2
            f1 = f2
            x2 = hi - resphi * (hi - lo)
            f2 = 0.0 - f(x2)
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    0.5 * (lo + hi)
}

// ============================================================================
// Fixed-point iteration
// ============================================================================

// Find x = g(x) by iterating x_{n+1} = g(x_n)
pub fn fixed_point(g: fn(f64) -> f64, x0: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var x = x0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 200 {
        let x_new = g(x)
        if fc_abs(x_new - x) < 0.000000000001 { return x_new }
        x = x_new
        i = i + 1
    }
    x
}

// Filter result: filtered array + count of elements kept.
// Predicate returns i64: nonzero = keep, zero = discard.
pub struct FilterResult6_i64 {
    data: [i64; 6],
    count: i64,
}

pub fn filter6_i64(arr: [i64; 6], pred: fn(i64) -> i64) -> FilterResult6_i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var result = FilterResult6_i64 { data: [0; 6], count: 0 }
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 6 {
        if pred(arr[i]) != 0 {
            result.data[result.count] = arr[i]
            result.count = result.count + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

    count: i64,
}

    }

}

// ============================================================================
// sort_by — in-place sort with comparison function
// ============================================================================

// Comparison function returns: negative = a < b, 0 = equal, positive = a > b
// Bubble sort (simple, works for small fixed arrays)
pub fn sort6_f64(arr: [f64; 6], cmp: fn(f64, f64) -> i64) -> [f64; 6] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var out = arr
    var swapped: i64 = 1
    while swapped != 0 {
        swapped = 0
        var i: i64 = 0
        while i < 5 {
            if cmp(out[i], out[i + 1]) > 0 {
                let tmp = out[i]
                out[i] = out[i + 1]
                out[i + 1] = tmp
                swapped = 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
    }
    out
}

pub fn sort6_i64(arr: [i64; 6], cmp: fn(i64, i64) -> i64) -> [i64; 6] with Mut, Panic, Div {

                out[i] = out[i + 1]
                out[i + 1] = tmp
                swapped = 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
    }
    out
}


// === FILE: stdlib/fusion/eeg_fmri.sio ===
// fusion::eeg_fmri — EEG-fMRI Multimodal Integration
//
// Combines EEG's temporal precision with fMRI's spatial resolution.
// Essential for computational psychiatry: network dynamics in disorders.
//
// Methods:
// - EEG-informed fMRI: Use EEG features as fMRI regressors
// - fMRI-informed EEG: Use fMRI activation as source priors
// - Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA)
//
// References:
// - Debener et al. (2006): "Trial-by-trial coupling of EEG and fMRI"
// - Cichy et al. (2016): "Similarity-based fusion of MEG and fMRI"

extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn sin(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn cos(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn exp(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn log(x: f64) -> f64;
    fn pow(x: f64, y: f64) -> f64;
    fn fabs(x: f64) -> f64;
}

fn pi() -> f64 { 3.14159265358979323846 }

// ============================================================================
// HEMODYNAMIC RESPONSE FUNCTION (HRF)
// ============================================================================

// HRF parameters (Canonical double-gamma)
struct HRFParams {
    peak_delay: f64,        // Time to peak (seconds), ~6
    undershoot_delay: f64,  // Undershoot time (seconds), ~16
    peak_undershoot_ratio: f64, // Amplitude ratio, ~6
}

fn hrf_params_canonical() -> HRFParams {
    HRFParams {
        peak_delay: 6.0,
        undershoot_delay: 16.0,
        peak_undershoot_ratio: 6.0,
    }
}

// Gamma PDF approximation
fn gamma_pdf(t: f64, shape: f64, scale: f64) -> f64 {
    if t <= 0.0 {
        return 0.0
    }
    let x = t / scale
    // Simplified gamma: x^(shape-1) * exp(-x)
    pow(x, shape - 1.0) * exp(-x)
}

// Compute HRF value at time t
fn hrf_value(t: f64, params: HRFParams) -> f64 {
    let peak = gamma_pdf(t, params.peak_delay, 1.0)
    let undershoot = gamma_pdf(t, params.undershoot_delay, 1.0)
    peak - undershoot / params.peak_undershoot_ratio
}

// ============================================================================
// REPRESENTATIONAL DISSIMILARITY MATRIX (RDM)
// ============================================================================

// Compute dissimilarity (1 - correlation) between two patterns
fn pattern_dissim(p1: [f64; 10], p2: [f64; 10], n: i64) -> f64 {
    // Pearson correlation
    var sum_x = 0.0
    var sum_y = 0.0
    var sum_xx = 0.0
    var sum_yy = 0.0
    var sum_xy = 0.0

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        sum_x = sum_x + p1[i as usize]
        sum_y = sum_y + p2[i as usize]
        sum_xx = sum_xx + p1[i as usize] * p1[i as usize]
        sum_yy = sum_yy + p2[i as usize] * p2[i as usize]
        sum_xy = sum_xy + p1[i as usize] * p2[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }

    let nf = n as f64
    let cov = sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y / nf
    let var_x = sum_xx - sum_x * sum_x / nf
    let var_y = sum_yy - sum_y * sum_y / nf

    let denom = sqrt(var_x * var_y)
    let r = if denom > 1e-10 { cov / denom } else { 0.0 }

    1.0 - r  // Dissimilarity
}

// Compare two RDMs (correlation)
fn compare_rdms(rdm1: [[f64; 4]; 4], rdm2: [[f64; 4]; 4]) -> f64 {
    // Extract upper triangle and correlate
    var v1: [f64; 10] = [0.0; 10]
    var v2: [f64; 10] = [0.0; 10]
    var n: i64 = 0

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 4 {
        var j = i + 1
        while j < 4 {
            v1[n as usize] = rdm1[i as usize][j as usize]
            v2[n as usize] = rdm2[i as usize][j as usize]
            n = n + 1
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Pearson correlation
    var sum_x = 0.0
    var sum_y = 0.0
    var sum_xx = 0.0
    var sum_yy = 0.0
    var sum_xy = 0.0

    i = 0
    while i < n {
        sum_x = sum_x + v1[i as usize]
        sum_y = sum_y + v2[i as usize]
        sum_xx = sum_xx + v1[i as usize] * v1[i as usize]
        sum_yy = sum_yy + v2[i as usize] * v2[i as usize]
        sum_xy = sum_xy + v1[i as usize] * v2[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }

    let nf = n as f64
    let cov = sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y / nf
    let var_x = sum_xx - sum_x * sum_x / nf
    let var_y = sum_yy - sum_y * sum_y / nf

    let denom = sqrt(var_x * var_y)
    if denom > 1e-10 { cov / denom } else { 0.0 }
}

// ============================================================================
// SOURCE PRIOR
// ============================================================================

// fMRI-based source prior for EEG localization
struct SourcePrior {
    weights: [f64; 100],
    n_sources: i64,
    threshold: f64,
}

fn source_prior_new() -> SourcePrior {
    SourcePrior {
        weights: [0.0; 100],
        n_sources: 0,
        threshold: 0.0,
    }
}

// Create source prior from t-map values (soft thresholding)
fn create_prior_soft(tmap: [f64; 100], n: i64, threshold: f64) -> SourcePrior {
    var prior = source_prior_new()
    prior.n_sources = n
    prior.threshold = threshold

    var sum = 0.0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        // Sigmoid transform
        prior.weights[i as usize] = 1.0 / (1.0 + exp(-(tmap[i as usize] - threshold)))
        sum = sum + prior.weights[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Normalize
    if sum > 0.0 {
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            prior.weights[i as usize] = prior.weights[i as usize] / sum
            i = i + 1
        }
    }

    prior
}
