// =============================================================================
// Matrix Norms (with uncertainty)
// =============================================================================

/// Scalar with epistemic information.
pub struct EpistemicScalar {
    pub value: f64,
    pub uncertainty: f64,
    pub confidence: f64,
}

// Frobenius norm: ||A||_F = sqrt(sum(a_ij^2))
pub fn ematrix_frobenius(m: &EpistemicMatrix) -> EpistemicScalar with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_unc_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var min_conf: f64 = 1.0

    var i = 0
    while i < m.rows * m.cols {
        let v = m.values[i]
        let u = m.uncertainties[i]
        sum_sq = sum_sq + v * v
        // d(||A||_F^2)/d(a_ij) = 2*a_ij, so u(sum)^2 += (2*a_ij)^2 * u_ij^2
        sum_unc_sq = sum_unc_sq + 4.0 * v * v * u * u
        min_conf = min_em(min_conf, m.confidences[i])
        i = i + 1
    }

    let norm = sqrt_em(sum_sq)
    // u(sqrt(x)) = u(x) / (2*sqrt(x))
    let norm_unc = if norm > 1.0e-30 { sqrt_em(sum_unc_sq) / (2.0 * norm) } else { 0.0 }

    EpistemicScalar {
        value: norm,
        uncertainty: norm_unc,
        confidence: min_conf,
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Trace (with uncertainty)
// =============================================================================

pub fn ematrix_trace(m: &EpistemicMatrix) -> EpistemicScalar with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_unc_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var min_conf: f64 = 1.0

    let n = if m.rows < m.cols { m.rows } else { m.cols }
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let idx = i * m.cols + i
        sum = sum + m.values[idx]
        let u = m.uncertainties[idx]
        sum_unc_sq = sum_unc_sq + u * u
        min_conf = min_em(min_conf, m.confidences[idx])
        i = i + 1
    }

    EpistemicScalar {
        value: sum,
        uncertainty: sqrt_em(sum_unc_sq),
        confidence: min_conf,
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Confidence Summary
// =============================================================================

pub struct MatrixConfidenceSummary {
    pub min_confidence: f64,
    pub max_confidence: f64,
    pub mean_confidence: f64,
    pub max_relative_uncertainty: f64,  // max(u/|v|) across all elements
}

fn ematrix_confidence_summary(m: &EpistemicMatrix) -> MatrixConfidenceSummary with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var min_c: f64 = 1.0
    var max_c: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_c: f64 = 0.0
    var max_rel: f64 = 0.0
    let n = m.rows * m.cols

    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let c = m.confidences[i]
        if c < min_c { min_c = c }
        if c > max_c { max_c = c }
        sum_c = sum_c + c

        let v = abs_em(m.values[i])
        if v > 1.0e-30 {
            let rel = m.uncertainties[i] / v
            if rel > max_rel { max_rel = rel }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    MatrixConfidenceSummary {
        min_confidence: min_c,
        max_confidence: max_c,
        mean_confidence: sum_c / (n as f64),
        max_relative_uncertainty: max_rel,
    }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/linalg/epistemic_tensor.sio ===
// stdlib/linalg/epistemic_tensor.sio — Epistemic Tensors (Rank-3)
//
// Generalizes EpistemicMatrix to batched tensors (batch x rows x cols).
// Max size: batch*rows*cols <= 256 elements.
// GUM-compliant uncertainty propagation through all tensor operations.
//
// When you multiply two epistemic tensors, the uncertainty PROPAGATES
// according to the law of propagation of uncertainty (GUM Section 5.1).
// Confidence DEGRADES monotonically through compositions.
//
// This is the tensor algebra that scientific ML SHOULD have:
// every result knows how uncertain it is.
//
// References:
//   JCGM 100:2008: "Evaluation of measurement data" (GUM)
//   Golub & Van Loan (2013) "Matrix Computations" 4th ed.
//
// # Exemplo
// ```sio
// let a = etensor_constant(1, 2, 2, 1.0);  // 1x2x2 tensor of 1.0
// let b = etensor_measured(1, 2, 2, data, unc, conf);
// let c = etensor_matmul(&a, &b);
// let summary = etensor_confidence_summary(&c);
// assert(summary.min_confidence <= 1.0);
// ```

// =============================================================================
// Math helpers
// =============================================================================

fn sqrt_et(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn abs_et(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn min_et(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { a } else { b }
}

fn max_et(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

// =============================================================================
// Core Type
// =============================================================================

/// EpistemicTensor - Rank-3 tensor with per-element uncertainty and confidence.
///
/// Each element carries:
/// - value: the point estimate
/// - uncertainty: standard uncertainty (u)
/// - confidence: confidence level [0, 1]
///
/// Storage: flat array of size batch * rows * cols <= 256
/// Index: element (b, i, j) at index b * rows * cols + i * cols + j
pub struct EpistemicTensor {
    values: [f64; 256],
    uncertainties: [f64; 256],
    confidences: [f64; 256],
    batch: i32,
    rows: i32,
    cols: i32,
}

// =============================================================================
// Epistemic Scalar (for reductions)
// =============================================================================

pub struct EpistemicScalar {
    value: f64,
    uncertainty: f64,
    confidence: f64,
}

// =============================================================================
// Constructors
// =============================================================================

/// Create zero tensor with given shape.
pub fn etensor_zeros(batch: i32, rows: i32, cols: i32) -> EpistemicTensor with Panic {
    let total = batch * rows * cols
    if total > 256 { panic("EpistemicTensor: size exceeds 256 elements") }
    EpistemicTensor {
        values: [0.0; 256],
        uncertainties: [0.0; 256],
        confidences: [1.0; 256],
        batch: batch,
        rows: rows,
        cols: cols,
    }
}

/// Create batched identity matrices.
pub fn etensor_identity(batch: i32, n: i32) -> EpistemicTensor with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var m = etensor_zeros(batch, n, n)
    var b = 0
    while b < batch {
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            let idx = b * n * n + i * n + i
            m.values[idx] = 1.0
            m.uncertainties[idx] = 0.0
            m.confidences[idx] = 1.0
            i = i + 1
        }
        b = b + 1
    }
    m
}

/// Create tensor filled with constant value.
pub fn etensor_constant(batch: i32, rows: i32, cols: i32, val: f64) -> EpistemicTensor with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var m = etensor_zeros(batch, rows, cols)
    let total = batch * rows * cols
    var i = 0
    while i < total {
        m.values[i] = val
        m.uncertainties[i] = 0.0
        m.confidences[i] = 1.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    m
}

// =============================================================================
// Element Access
// =============================================================================

/// Compute flat index from (batch, row, col).
fn etensor_idx(t: &EpistemicTensor, b: i32, r: i32, c: i32) -> i32 {
    b * t.rows * t.cols + r * t.cols + c
}

/// Get value at (b, r, c).
pub fn etensor_get_val(t: &EpistemicTensor, b: i32, r: i32, c: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
    let idx = etensor_idx(t, b, r, c)
    t.values[idx]
}

/// Get uncertainty at (b, r, c).
pub fn etensor_get_unc(t: &EpistemicTensor, b: i32, r: i32, c: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
    let idx = etensor_idx(t, b, r, c)
    t.uncertainties[idx]
}

/// Get confidence at (b, r, c).
pub fn etensor_get_conf(t: &EpistemicTensor, b: i32, r: i32, c: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
    let idx = etensor_idx(t, b, r, c)
    t.confidences[idx]
}

/// Set element with full epistemic metadata.
pub fn etensor_set(
    m: &!EpistemicTensor,
    b: i32, r: i32, c: i32,
    val: f64, unc: f64, conf: f64,
) with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = etensor_idx(m, b, r, c)
    m.values[idx] = val
    m.uncertainties[idx] = unc
    m.confidences[idx] = conf
}

// =============================================================================
// Elementwise Addition — GUM propagation
// =============================================================================

pub fn etensor_add(a: &EpistemicTensor, b: &EpistemicTensor) -> EpistemicTensor with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if a.batch != b.batch || a.rows != b.rows || a.cols != b.cols {
        panic("etensor_add: shape mismatch")
    }
    var c = etensor_zeros(a.batch, a.rows, a.cols)
    var bb = 0
    while bb < a.batch {
        var i = 0
        while i < a.rows {
            var j = 0
            while j < a.cols {
                let idx = etensor_idx(&c, bb, i, j)
                let va = etensor_get_val(a, bb, i, j)
                let vb = etensor_get_val(b, bb, i, j)
                let ua = etensor_get_unc(a, bb, i, j)
                let ub = etensor_get_unc(b, bb, i, j)
                let ca = etensor_get_conf(a, bb, i, j)
                let cb = etensor_get_conf(b, bb, i, j)
                
                c.values[idx] = va + vb
                c.uncertainties[idx] = sqrt_et(ua * ua + ub * ub)
                c.confidences[idx] = min_et(ca, cb)
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        bb = bb + 1
    }
    c
}

// =============================================================================
// Elementwise Subtraction
// =============================================================================

pub fn etensor_sub(a: &EpistemicTensor, b: &EpistemicTensor) -> EpistemicTensor with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if a.batch != b.batch || a.rows != b.rows || a.cols != b.cols {
        panic("etensor_sub: shape mismatch")
    }
    var c = etensor_zeros(a.batch, a.rows, a.cols)
    var bb = 0
    while bb < a.batch {
        var i = 0
        while i < a.rows {
            var j = 0
            while j < a.cols {
                let idx = etensor_idx(&c, bb, i, j)
                let va = etensor_get_val(a, bb, i, j)
                let vb = etensor_get_val(b, bb, i, j)
                let ua = etensor_get_unc(a, bb, i, j)
                let ub = etensor_get_unc(b, bb, i, j)
                let ca = etensor_get_conf(a, bb, i, j)
                let cb = etensor_get_conf(b, bb, i, j)
                
                c.values[idx] = va - vb
                c.uncertainties[idx] = sqrt_et(ua * ua + ub * ub)
                c.confidences[idx] = min_et(ca, cb)
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        bb = bb + 1
    }
    c
}

// =============================================================================
// Scalar Operations
// =============================================================================

/// Scale by constant: u(c*A) = |c| * u(A), conf unchanged.
pub fn etensor_scale(m: &EpistemicTensor, scalar: f64) -> EpistemicTensor with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var result = etensor_zeros(m.batch, m.rows, m.cols)
    let as_val = abs_et(scalar)
    let total = m.batch * m.rows * m.cols
    var i = 0
    while i < total {
        result.values[i] = scalar * m.values[i]
        result.uncertainties[i] = as_val * m.uncertainties[i]
        result.confidences[i] = m.confidences[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// =============================================================================
// Batch Matrix Multiplication — GUM quadrature propagation
// =============================================================================

pub fn etensor_matmul(a: &EpistemicTensor, b: &EpistemicTensor) -> EpistemicTensor with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if a.batch != b.batch {
        panic("etensor_matmul: batch dimension mismatch")
    }
    if a.cols != b.rows {
        panic("etensor_matmul: inner dimension mismatch")
    }
    
    var c = etensor_zeros(a.batch, a.rows, b.cols)
    let k_inner = a.cols
    
    var bb = 0
    while bb < a.batch {
        var i = 0
        while i < a.rows {
            var j = 0
            while j < b.cols {
                var sum_val: f64 = 0.0
                var sum_unc_sq: f64 = 0.0
                var min_conf: f64 = 1.0
                
                var l = 0
                while l < k_inner {
                    let a_val = etensor_get_val(a, bb, i, l)
                    let b_val = etensor_get_val(b, bb, l, j)
                    let ua = etensor_get_unc(a, bb, i, l)
                    let ub = etensor_get_unc(b, bb, l, j)
                    let ca = etensor_get_conf(a, bb, i, l)
                    let cb = etensor_get_conf(b, bb, l, j)
                    
                    sum_val = sum_val + a_val * b_val
                    sum_unc_sq = sum_unc_sq + ua * ua * b_val * b_val + a_val * a_val * ub * ub
                    min_conf = min_et(min_conf, min_et(ca, cb))
                    
                    l = l + 1
                }
                
                let idx = etensor_idx(&c, bb, i, j)
                c.values[idx] = sum_val
                c.uncertainties[idx] = sqrt_et(sum_unc_sq)
                c.confidences[idx] = min_conf
                
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        bb = bb + 1
    }
    c
}

// =============================================================================
// Transpose (per batch slice)
// =============================================================================

pub fn etensor_transpose(m: &EpistemicTensor) -> EpistemicTensor with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var result = etensor_zeros(m.batch, m.cols, m.rows)
    var bb = 0
    while bb < m.batch {
        var i = 0
        while i < m.rows {
            var j = 0
            while j < m.cols {
                let src = etensor_idx(m, bb, i, j)
                let dst = etensor_idx(&result, bb, j, i)
                result.values[dst] = m.values[src]
                result.uncertainties[dst] = m.uncertainties[src]
                result.confidences[dst] = m.confidences[src]
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        bb = bb + 1
    }
    result
}

// =============================================================================
// Frobenius Norm (with uncertainty)
// =============================================================================

pub fn etensor_frobenius(m: &EpistemicTensor) -> EpistemicScalar with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_unc_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var min_conf: f64 = 1.0
    
    let total = m.batch * m.rows * m.cols
    var i = 0
    while i < total {
        let v = m.values[i]
        let u = m.uncertainties[i]
        sum_sq = sum_sq + v * v
        sum_unc_sq = sum_unc_sq + 4.0 * v * v * u * u
        min_conf = min_et(min_conf, m.confidences[i])
        i = i + 1
    }
    
    let norm = sqrt_et(sum_sq)
    let norm_unc = if norm > 1.0e-30 { sqrt_et(sum_unc_sq) / (2.0 * norm) } else { 0.0 }
    
    EpistemicScalar {
        value: norm,
        uncertainty: norm_unc,
        confidence: min_conf,
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Confidence Summary
// =============================================================================

pub struct TensorConfidenceSummary {
    min_confidence: f64,
    max_confidence: f64,
    mean_confidence: f64,
    max_relative_uncertainty: f64,
}

pub fn etensor_confidence_summary(m: &EpistemicTensor) -> TensorConfidenceSummary with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var min_c: f64 = 1.0
    var max_c: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_c: f64 = 0.0
    var max_rel: f64 = 0.0
    let n = m.batch * m.rows * m.cols
    
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let c = m.confidences[i]
        if c < min_c { min_c = c }
        if c > max_c { max_c = c }
        sum_c = sum_c + c
        
        let v = abs_et(m.values[i])
        if v > 1.0e-30 {
            let rel = m.uncertainties[i] / v
            if rel > max_rel { max_rel = rel }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    
    TensorConfidenceSummary {
        min_confidence: min_c,
        max_confidence: max_c,
        mean_confidence: sum_c / (n as f64),
        max_relative_uncertainty: max_rel,
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// SVD Approximation with GUM propagation
// =============================================================================

pub fn etensor_svd_approx(m: &EpistemicTensor, batch_idx: i32) -> [EpistemicScalar; 16] with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if batch_idx < 0 || batch_idx >= m.batch {
        panic("etensor_svd_approx: invalid batch index")
    }
    
    var sigmas: [EpistemicScalar; 16] = [
        EpistemicScalar { value: 0.0, uncertainty: 0.0, confidence: 0.0 }; 16
    ]
    
    // Compute Frobenius norm of slice for energy estimate
    var sum_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_unc_sq: f64 = 0.0
    var min_conf: f64 = 1.0
    
    var i = 0
    while i < m.rows {
        var j = 0
        while j < m.cols {
            let idx = etensor_idx(m, batch_idx, i, j)
            let v = m.values[idx]
            let u = m.uncertainties[idx]
            sum_sq = sum_sq + v * v
            sum_unc_sq = sum_unc_sq + 4.0 * v * v * u * u
            min_conf = min_et(min_conf, m.confidences[idx])
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    
    let frob = sqrt_et(sum_sq)
    let frob_unc = if frob > 1.0e-30 { sqrt_et(sum_unc_sq) / (2.0 * frob) } else { 0.0 }
    
    let n = min_et(m.rows, m.cols)
    let n_f = n as f64
    
    var k = 0
    while k < n {
        let decay = 1.0 - (k as f64) / (n_f + 1.0) * 0.3
        sigmas[k as usize] = EpistemicScalar {
            value: frob / sqrt_et(n_f) * decay,
            uncertainty: frob_unc / sqrt_et(n_f) * (2.0 - decay),
            confidence: min_conf,
        }
        k = k + 1
    }
    
    sigmas
}

// =============================================================================
// Tests
// =============================================================================

fn test_etensor_add_gum() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var a = etensor_zeros(1, 2, 2)
    var b = etensor_zeros(1, 2, 2)
    
    etensor_set(&a, 0, 0, 0, 1.0, 0.1, 0.95)
    etensor_set(&b, 0, 0, 0, 2.0, 0.2, 0.90)
    
    let c = etensor_add(&a, &b)
    
    let val = etensor_get_val(&c, 0, 0, 0)
    let unc = etensor_get_unc(&c, 0, 0, 0)
    let conf = etensor_get_conf(&c, 0, 0, 0)
    
    assert(val > 2.99 && val < 3.01)
    
    let expected_unc = sqrt_et(0.01 + 0.04)
    assert(unc > expected_unc - 0.01 && unc < expected_unc + 0.01)
    
    assert(conf > 0.89 && conf < 0.91)
}

fn test_etensor_matmul_gum() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var a = etensor_zeros(1, 2, 2)
    var b = etensor_zeros(1, 2, 2)
    
    etensor_set(&a, 0, 0, 0, 1.0, 0.1, 0.95)
    etensor_set(&a, 0, 0, 1, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    etensor_set(&a, 0, 1, 0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    etensor_set(&a, 0, 1, 1, 1.0, 0.1, 0.95)
    
    etensor_set(&b, 0, 0, 0, 2.0, 0.2, 0.90)
    etensor_set(&b, 0, 0, 1, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    etensor_set(&b, 0, 1, 0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    etensor_set(&b, 0, 1, 1, 2.0, 0.2, 0.90)
    
    let c = etensor_matmul(&a, &b)
    
    let val = etensor_get_val(&c, 0, 0, 0)
    let unc = etensor_get_unc(&c, 0, 0, 0)
    
    assert(val > 1.99 && val < 2.01)
    let expected_unc = sqrt_et(0.08)
    assert(unc > expected_unc - 0.01 && unc < expected_unc + 0.01)
}

fn test_etensor_chain_degradation() with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var a = etensor_constant(1, 2, 2, 1.0)
    etensor_set(&a, 0, 0, 0, 1.0, 0.1, 0.95)
    etensor_set(&a, 0, 0, 1, 1.0, 0.1, 0.90)
    etensor_set(&a, 0, 1, 0, 1.0, 0.1, 0.85)
    etensor_set(&a, 0, 1, 1, 1.0, 0.1, 0.80)
    
    var b = etensor_constant(1, 2, 2, 1.0)
    
    let ab = etensor_matmul(&a, &b)
    let abc = etensor_matmul(&ab, &b)
    
    let summary_a = etensor_confidence_summary(&a)
    let summary_abc = etensor_confidence_summary(&abc)
    
    assert(summary_abc.min_confidence <= summary_a.min_confidence)
}

pub fn main() {
    test_etensor_add_gum()
    test_etensor_matmul_gum()
    test_etensor_chain_degradation()
}


// === FILE: stdlib/linalg/factorize.sio ===
// factorize.sio - Matrix Factorizations for Sounio Linear Algebra
//
// Fixed-size LU, Cholesky, and LDL factorizations for matrices up to 8x8.
// Uses flat array representation [f64; 64] for 8x8 row-major storage.
// Element at (i, j) = data[i * n + j].
//
// Algorithms:
//   LU:       Doolittle with partial pivoting (PA = LU)
//   Cholesky: A = LL^T for symmetric positive definite matrices
//   LDL:      A = LDL^T, avoids square roots

// ============================================================================
// HELPERS (must precede callers)
// ============================================================================

fn fac_abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 {
        return 0.0 - x
    }
    return x
}

fn fac_sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    // Range reduction: scale x into [1, 4) by multiplying by powers of 4
    // then scale the result back by dividing by the power of 2
    var scaled = x
    var scale_back = 1.0
    // Scale up small numbers
    while scaled < 1.0 {
        scaled = scaled * 4.0
        scale_back = scale_back * 2.0
    }
    // Scale down large numbers
    while scaled > 4.0 {
        scaled = scaled * 0.25
        scale_back = scale_back * 0.5
    }
    // Newton-Raphson on scaled value (now in [1, 4))
    var y = 1.5
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + scaled / y)
    return y / scale_back
}

fn mat_get(A: [f64; 64], n: i32, i: i32, j: i32) -> f64 with Panic {
    let idx = i * n + j
    return A[idx]
}

fn mat_set(A: [f64; 64], n: i32, i: i32, j: i32, val: f64) -> [f64; 64] with Mut, Panic {
    var result = A
    let idx = i * n + j
    result[idx] = val
    return result
}

fn zeros64() -> [f64; 64] {
    let z: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    return z
}

fn zeros8() -> [f64; 8] {
    let z: [f64; 8] = [0.0; 8]
    return z
}

fn izeros8() -> [i32; 8] {
    let z: [i32; 8] = [0; 8]
    return z
}

// Build an n x n identity matrix in flat [f64; 64]
fn mat_identity(n: i32) -> [f64; 64] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var m = zeros64()
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        m = mat_set(m, n, i, i, 1.0)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return m
}

// ============================================================================
// DATA STRUCTURES
// ============================================================================

struct LUResult {
    L: [f64; 64],
    U: [f64; 64],
    perm: [i32; 8],
    n: i32,
    sign: i32,
    singular: bool
}

struct CholeskyResult {
    L: [f64; 64],
    n: i32,
    success: bool
}

struct LDLResult {
    L: [f64; 64],
    D: [f64; 8],
    n: i32,
    success: bool
}

// ============================================================================
// LU FACTORIZATION (Doolittle with partial pivoting)
// ============================================================================
// For A (n x n), compute P, L, U such that PA = LU.
// L is unit lower triangular, U is upper triangular.
// perm[i] = row index in original A that maps to row i after pivoting.
// sign tracks determinant sign from row swaps.

fn lu_factorize(A: [f64; 64], n: i32) -> LUResult with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Work on a copy that will become U
    var work = A
    // Initialize permutation to identity
    var perm = izeros8()
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        perm[i] = i
        i = i + 1
    }

    // L starts as identity (unit lower triangular)
    var L = mat_identity(n)
    var sign = 1
    var singular = false

    // For each column k
    var k = 0
    while k < n {
        // Find pivot: row with max |work[i, k]| for i >= k
        var max_val = fac_abs_f64(mat_get(work, n, k, k))
        var max_row = k
        i = k + 1
        while i < n {
            let val = fac_abs_f64(mat_get(work, n, i, k))
            if val > max_val {
                max_val = val
                max_row = i
            }
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Check for singularity
        if max_val < 1e-15 {
            singular = true
        }

        // Swap rows k and max_row in work matrix
        if max_row != k {
            var j = 0
            while j < n {
                let tmp_w = mat_get(work, n, k, j)
                work = mat_set(work, n, k, j, mat_get(work, n, max_row, j))
                work = mat_set(work, n, max_row, j, tmp_w)
                j = j + 1
            }

            // Swap in permutation vector
            let tmp_p = perm[k]
            perm[k] = perm[max_row]
            perm[max_row] = tmp_p

            // Swap previously computed L entries (columns 0..k)
            j = 0
            while j < k {
                let tmp_l = mat_get(L, n, k, j)
                L = mat_set(L, n, k, j, mat_get(L, n, max_row, j))
                L = mat_set(L, n, max_row, j, tmp_l)
                j = j + 1
            }

            sign = 0 - sign
        }

        // Compute multipliers and eliminate
        let pivot = mat_get(work, n, k, k)
        if fac_abs_f64(pivot) > 1e-15 {
            i = k + 1
            while i < n {
                let mult = mat_get(work, n, i, k) / pivot
                L = mat_set(L, n, i, k, mult)

                // Eliminate: work[i, j] -= mult * work[k, j] for j >= k
                var j = k
                while j < n {
                    let old_val = mat_get(work, n, i, j)
                    let sub_val = mult * mat_get(work, n, k, j)
                    work = mat_set(work, n, i, j, old_val - sub_val)
                    j = j + 1
                }
                i = i + 1
            }
        }

        k = k + 1
    }

    return LUResult {
        L: L,
        U: work,
        perm: perm,
        n: n,
        sign: sign,
        singular: singular
    }
}

// Solve Ax = b using LU factorization.
// First apply permutation: Pb
// Forward substitution: Ly = Pb
// Back substitution: Ux = y
fn lu_solve(lu: LUResult, b: [f64; 8]) -> [f64; 8] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n = lu.n

    // Apply permutation to b: pb[i] = b[perm[i]]
    var pb = zeros8()
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        pb[i] = b[lu.perm[i]]
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Forward substitution: Ly = pb
    // L is unit lower triangular (L[i,i] = 1)
    var y = zeros8()
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < i {
            sum = sum + mat_get(lu.L, n, i, j) * y[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        y[i] = pb[i] - sum
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Back substitution: Ux = y
    var x = zeros8()
    i = n - 1
    while i >= 0 {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = i + 1
        while j < n {
            sum = sum + mat_get(lu.U, n, i, j) * x[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        let diag = mat_get(lu.U, n, i, i)
        if fac_abs_f64(diag) > 1e-15 {
            x[i] = (y[i] - sum) / diag
        } else {
            x[i] = 0.0
        }
        i = i - 1
    }

    return x
}

// Compute determinant from LU: det(A) = sign * product of U[i,i]
fn lu_determinant(lu: LUResult) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n = lu.n
    var det = 1.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        det = det * mat_get(lu.U, n, i, i)
        i = i + 1
    }
    if lu.sign < 0 {
        det = 0.0 - det
    }
    return det
}

// Compute inverse by solving LU * X_col = e_col for each column
fn lu_inverse(lu: LUResult) -> [f64; 64] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n = lu.n
    var inv = zeros64()

    var col = 0
    while col < n {
        // Build unit vector e_col
        var e = zeros8()
        e[col] = 1.0

        // Solve for this column of the inverse
        let x = lu_solve(lu, e)

        // Store in result
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            inv = mat_set(inv, n, i, col, x[i])
            i = i + 1
        }
        col = col + 1
    }

    return inv
}

// ============================================================================
// CHOLESKY FACTORIZATION (A = LL^T)
// ============================================================================
// For symmetric positive definite A, compute lower triangular L such that
// A = L * L^T.

fn cholesky_factorize(A: [f64; 64], n: i32) -> CholeskyResult with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var L = zeros64()
    var success = true

    var j = 0
    while j < n {
        // Compute L[j, j] = sqrt(A[j,j] - sum_{k<j} L[j,k]^2)
        var sum_sq = 0.0
        var k = 0
        while k < j {
            let ljk = mat_get(L, n, j, k)
            sum_sq = sum_sq + ljk * ljk
            k = k + 1
        }
        let diag_val = mat_get(A, n, j, j) - sum_sq
        if diag_val <= 0.0 {
            // Matrix is not positive definite
            success = false
            // Set remaining to zero and return
            return CholeskyResult { L: L, n: n, success: false }
        }
        let ljj = fac_sqrt_f64(diag_val)
        L = mat_set(L, n, j, j, ljj)

        // Compute L[i, j] for i > j
        var i = j + 1
        while i < n {
            var sum = 0.0
            k = 0
            while k < j {
                sum = sum + mat_get(L, n, i, k) * mat_get(L, n, j, k)
                k = k + 1
            }
            let lij = (mat_get(A, n, i, j) - sum) / ljj
            L = mat_set(L, n, i, j, lij)
            i = i + 1
        }

        j = j + 1
    }

    return CholeskyResult { L: L, n: n, success: success }
}

// Solve Ax = b using Cholesky: Ly = b, L^T x = y
fn cholesky_solve(ch: CholeskyResult, b: [f64; 8]) -> [f64; 8] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n = ch.n

    // Forward substitution: Ly = b
    var y = zeros8()
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < i {
            sum = sum + mat_get(ch.L, n, i, j) * y[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        let diag = mat_get(ch.L, n, i, i)
        if fac_abs_f64(diag) > 1e-15 {
            y[i] = (b[i] - sum) / diag
        } else {
            y[i] = 0.0
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Back substitution: L^T x = y
    // L^T is upper triangular: L^T[i,j] = L[j,i]
    var x = zeros8()
    i = n - 1
    while i >= 0 {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = i + 1
        while j < n {
            // L^T[i,j] = L[j,i]
            sum = sum + mat_get(ch.L, n, j, i) * x[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        let diag = mat_get(ch.L, n, i, i)
        if fac_abs_f64(diag) > 1e-15 {
            x[i] = (y[i] - sum) / diag
        } else {
            x[i] = 0.0
        }
        i = i - 1
    }

    return x
}

// Determinant via Cholesky: det(A) = (product of L[i,i])^2
fn cholesky_determinant(ch: CholeskyResult) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n = ch.n
    var prod = 1.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        prod = prod * mat_get(ch.L, n, i, i)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return prod * prod
}

// Inverse via Cholesky: solve A * X_col = e_col for each column
fn cholesky_inverse(ch: CholeskyResult) -> [f64; 64] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n = ch.n
    var inv = zeros64()

    var col = 0
    while col < n {
        var e = zeros8()
        e[col] = 1.0

        let x = cholesky_solve(ch, e)

        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            inv = mat_set(inv, n, i, col, x[i])
            i = i + 1
        }
        col = col + 1
    }

    return inv
}

// ============================================================================
// LDL FACTORIZATION (A = LDL^T)
// ============================================================================
// For symmetric positive definite A, compute unit lower triangular L and
// diagonal D such that A = L * D * L^T. Avoids square roots.

fn ldl_factorize(A: [f64; 64], n: i32) -> LDLResult with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var L = mat_identity(n)
    var D = zeros8()
    var success = true

    var j = 0
    while j < n {
        // D[j] = A[j,j] - sum_{k<j} L[j,k]^2 * D[k]
        var sum = 0.0
        var k = 0
        while k < j {
            let ljk = mat_get(L, n, j, k)
            sum = sum + ljk * ljk * D[k]
            k = k + 1
        }
        D[j] = mat_get(A, n, j, j) - sum

        if fac_abs_f64(D[j]) < 1e-15 {
            success = false
            return LDLResult { L: L, D: D, n: n, success: false }
        }

        // L[i,j] = (A[i,j] - sum_{k<j} L[i,k] * L[j,k] * D[k]) / D[j]
        var i = j + 1
        while i < n {
            var sum_ij = 0.0
            k = 0
            while k < j {
                sum_ij = sum_ij + mat_get(L, n, i, k) * mat_get(L, n, j, k) * D[k]
                k = k + 1
            }
            let lij = (mat_get(A, n, i, j) - sum_ij) / D[j]
            L = mat_set(L, n, i, j, lij)
            i = i + 1
        }

        j = j + 1
    }

    return LDLResult { L: L, D: D, n: n, success: success }
}

// Solve Ax = b using LDL: Lz = b, Dy = z, L^T x = y
fn ldl_solve(ldl: LDLResult, b: [f64; 8]) -> [f64; 8] with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let n = ldl.n

    // Forward substitution: Lz = b (L is unit lower triangular)
    var z = zeros8()
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < i {
            sum = sum + mat_get(ldl.L, n, i, j) * z[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        z[i] = b[i] - sum
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Diagonal solve: Dy = z
    var y = zeros8()
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        if fac_abs_f64(ldl.D[i]) > 1e-15 {
            y[i] = z[i] / ldl.D[i]
        } else {
            y[i] = 0.0
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Back substitution: L^T x = y (L^T is unit upper triangular)
    var x = zeros8()
    i = n - 1
    while i >= 0 {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = i + 1
        while j < n {
            // L^T[i,j] = L[j,i]
            sum = sum + mat_get(ldl.L, n, j, i) * x[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        x[i] = y[i] - sum
        i = i - 1
    }

    return x
}

// ============================================================================
// VALIDATION UTILITIES
// ============================================================================

// Compute ||PA - LU||_F (Frobenius norm of reconstruction error)
fn lu_reconstruction_error(lu: LUResult, A: [f64; 64], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Compute L * U
    var LU = zeros64()
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            var sum = 0.0
            var k = 0
            while k < n {
                sum = sum + mat_get(lu.L, n, i, k) * mat_get(lu.U, n, k, j)
                k = k + 1
            }
            LU = mat_set(LU, n, i, j, sum)
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Compute PA (apply permutation to rows of A)
    var PA = zeros64()
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            PA = mat_set(PA, n, i, j, mat_get(A, n, lu.perm[i], j))
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Compute ||PA - LU||_F
    var sum_sq = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            let diff = mat_get(PA, n, i, j) - mat_get(LU, n, i, j)
            sum_sq = sum_sq + diff * diff
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return fac_sqrt_f64(sum_sq)
}

// Compute ||A - LL^T||_F
fn cholesky_reconstruction_error(ch: CholeskyResult, A: [f64; 64], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Compute L * L^T
    var LLt = zeros64()
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            var sum = 0.0
            var k = 0
            while k < n {
                sum = sum + mat_get(ch.L, n, i, k) * mat_get(ch.L, n, j, k)
                k = k + 1
            }
            LLt = mat_set(LLt, n, i, j, sum)
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Compute ||A - LL^T||_F
    var sum_sq = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            let diff = mat_get(A, n, i, j) - mat_get(LLt, n, i, j)
            sum_sq = sum_sq + diff * diff
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return fac_sqrt_f64(sum_sq)
}

// Check if matrix is symmetric within tolerance
fn matrix_is_symmetric(A: [f64; 64], n: i32, tol: f64) -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = i + 1
        while j < n {
            let diff = fac_abs_f64(mat_get(A, n, i, j) - mat_get(A, n, j, i))
            if diff > tol {
                return false
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return true
}

// Check positive definiteness by attempting Cholesky
fn matrix_is_positive_definite(A: [f64; 64], n: i32) -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let ch = cholesky_factorize(A, n)
    return ch.success
}

module linalg


// === FILE: stdlib/linalg/mat16.sio ===
//! stdlib/linalg/mat16.sio - 16x16 Matrix Type (f64)
//!
//! Dense 16x16 matrix for the FSNN Jacobian recursion J_{n+1} = J_{z_n} * J_n + I.
//! Row-major storage in [f64; 256]: element (i,j) at index i*16+j.
//!
//! Key operations for the orbit engine:
//! - mat16_mul: 16x16 matrix product (4096 FMA, hot path)
//! - mat16_vec_mul: matrix-vector product (256 FMA)
//! - mat16_singular_values: Jacobi SVD for Lyapunov exponents
//! - mat16_frobenius_norm, mat16_operator_norm_approx

// ============================================================================
// HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn m16_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn m16_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    return y
}

// ============================================================================
// MAT16 TYPE
// ============================================================================

pub struct Mat16 {
    data: [f64; 256],
}

// ============================================================================
// CONSTRUCTORS
// ============================================================================

pub fn mat16_zeros() -> Mat16 {
    Mat16 { data: [0.0; 256] }
}

pub fn mat16_identity() -> Mat16 {
    var d = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        d[i * 16 + i] = 1.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    Mat16 { data: d }
}

// ============================================================================
// ELEMENT ACCESS
// ============================================================================

pub fn mat16_get(m: Mat16, row: i32, col: i32) -> f64 {
    m.data[row * 16 + col]
}

pub fn mat16_set(m: Mat16, row: i32, col: i32, val: f64) -> Mat16 {
    var result = m
    result.data[row * 16 + col] = val
    return result
}

// Extract column j as [f64; 16]
pub fn mat16_column(m: Mat16, j: i32) -> [f64; 16] {
    var col = [0.0; 16]
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        col[i] = m.data[i * 16 + j]
        i = i + 1
    }
    return col
}

// ============================================================================
// ARITHMETIC
// ============================================================================

pub fn mat16_add(a: Mat16, b: Mat16) -> Mat16 {
    var d = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < 256 {
        d[i] = a.data[i] + b.data[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    Mat16 { data: d }
}

pub fn mat16_sub(a: Mat16, b: Mat16) -> Mat16 {
    var d = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < 256 {
        d[i] = a.data[i] - b.data[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    Mat16 { data: d }
}

pub fn mat16_scale(m: Mat16, s: f64) -> Mat16 {
    var d = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < 256 {
        d[i] = m.data[i] * s
        i = i + 1
    }
    Mat16 { data: d }
}

// 16x16 matrix multiplication: C = A * B
// C[i][j] = sum_k A[i][k] * B[k][j]
// 16^3 = 4096 multiply-add operations
pub fn mat16_mul(a: Mat16, b: Mat16) -> Mat16 {
    var d = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        var j = 0
        while j < 16 {
            var sum = 0.0
            var k = 0
            while k < 16 {
                sum = sum + a.data[i * 16 + k] * b.data[k * 16 + j]
                k = k + 1
            }
            d[i * 16 + j] = sum
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    Mat16 { data: d }
}

// Matrix-vector product: y = M * v
pub fn mat16_vec_mul(m: Mat16, v: [f64; 16]) -> [f64; 16] {
    var result = [0.0; 16]
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < 16 {
            sum = sum + m.data[i * 16 + j] * v[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        result[i] = sum
        i = i + 1
    }
    return result
}

// ============================================================================
// NORMS
// ============================================================================

// Frobenius norm: ||M||_F = sqrt(sum of squares of all elements)
pub fn mat16_frobenius_norm(m: Mat16) -> f64 {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 256 {
        sum = sum + m.data[i] * m.data[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    m16_sqrt(sum)
}

// Operator norm approximation via power iteration (largest singular value sigma_1)
// Computes ||M||_2 = max singular value using 20 iterations of power method on M^T M
pub fn mat16_operator_norm_approx(m: Mat16) -> f64 {
    // Start with random-ish unit vector
    var v = [0.0; 16]
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        v[i] = 1.0 / 4.0
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Power iteration on M^T * M
    var iter = 0
    while iter < 30 {
        // w = M * v
        let w = mat16_vec_mul(m, v)
        // u = M^T * w  (= M^T M v)
        var u = [0.0; 16]
        var ii = 0
        while ii < 16 {
            var sum = 0.0
            var jj = 0
            while jj < 16 {
                sum = sum + m.data[jj * 16 + ii] * w[jj]
                jj = jj + 1
            }
            u[ii] = sum
            ii = ii + 1
        }
        // Normalize u -> v
        var norm_sq = 0.0
        var k = 0
        while k < 16 {
            norm_sq = norm_sq + u[k] * u[k]
            k = k + 1
        }
        let norm = m16_sqrt(norm_sq)
        if norm < 1e-30 { return 0.0 }
        var kk = 0
        while kk < 16 {
            v[kk] = u[kk] / norm
            kk = kk + 1
        }
        iter = iter + 1
    }

    // Compute ||M * v|| as the approximate operator norm
    let mv = mat16_vec_mul(m, v)
    var nsq = 0.0
    var j = 0
    while j < 16 {
        nsq = nsq + mv[j] * mv[j]
        j = j + 1
    }
    m16_sqrt(nsq)
}

// ============================================================================
// SVD (SINGULAR VALUES ONLY)
// ============================================================================
// One-sided Jacobi SVD: computes singular values of M via eigenvalues of M^T * M.
// Returns 16 singular values in descending order.
// Used for: Lyapunov exponents, condition number, Lyapunov dimension.

pub fn mat16_singular_values(m: Mat16) -> [f64; 16] {
    // Compute G = M^T * M (symmetric positive semi-definite)
    var G = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        var j = i
        while j < 16 {
            var sum = 0.0
            var k = 0
            while k < 16 {
                sum = sum + m.data[k * 16 + i] * m.data[k * 16 + j]
                k = k + 1
            }
            G[i * 16 + j] = sum
            G[j * 16 + i] = sum
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Jacobi eigenvalue iteration on G (symmetric)
    // Sweep off-diagonal elements to zero via Givens rotations
    var sweep = 0
    while sweep < 50 {
        var max_off = 0.0
        var p = 0
        while p < 16 {
            var q = p + 1
            while q < 16 {
                let v = m16_abs(G[p * 16 + q])
                if v > max_off { max_off = v }
                q = q + 1
            }
            p = p + 1
        }
        // Convergence check
        if max_off < 1e-14 {
            sweep = 100
        } else {
            // One Jacobi sweep: rotate each off-diagonal pair
            var pp = 0
            while pp < 16 {
                var qq = pp + 1
                while qq < 16 {
                    let apq = G[pp * 16 + qq]
                    if m16_abs(apq) > 1e-20 {
                        let app = G[pp * 16 + pp]
                        let aqq = G[qq * 16 + qq]
                        let tau = (aqq - app) / (2.0 * apq)
                        var t = 0.0
                        if tau >= 0.0 {
                            t = 1.0 / (tau + m16_sqrt(1.0 + tau * tau))
                        } else {
                            t = 0.0 - 1.0 / (m16_sqrt(1.0 + tau * tau) - tau)
                        }
                        let c = 1.0 / m16_sqrt(1.0 + t * t)
                        let s = t * c

                        // Apply rotation to G
                        G[pp * 16 + pp] = app - t * apq
                        G[qq * 16 + qq] = aqq + t * apq
                        G[pp * 16 + qq] = 0.0
                        G[qq * 16 + pp] = 0.0

                        var r = 0
                        while r < 16 {
                            if r != pp {
                                if r != qq {
                                    let grp = G[r * 16 + pp]
                                    let grq = G[r * 16 + qq]
                                    G[r * 16 + pp] = c * grp - s * grq
                                    G[pp * 16 + r] = c * grp - s * grq
                                    G[r * 16 + qq] = s * grp + c * grq
                                    G[qq * 16 + r] = s * grp + c * grq
                                }
                            }
                            r = r + 1
                        }
                    }
                    qq = qq + 1
                }
                pp = pp + 1
            }
            sweep = sweep + 1
        }
    }

    // Extract eigenvalues (diagonal of G) and take sqrt for singular values
    var sv = [0.0; 16]
    var ii = 0
    while ii < 16 {
        let eigval = G[ii * 16 + ii]
        if eigval > 0.0 {
            sv[ii] = m16_sqrt(eigval)
        } else {
            sv[ii] = 0.0
        }
        ii = ii + 1
    }

    // Sort descending (bubble sort, 16 elements)
    var pass = 0
    while pass < 16 {
        var idx = 0
        while idx < 15 {
            if sv[idx] < sv[idx + 1] {
                let tmp = sv[idx]
                sv[idx] = sv[idx + 1]
                sv[idx + 1] = tmp
            }
            idx = idx + 1
        }
        pass = pass + 1
    }

    return sv
}

// ============================================================================
// CONSTRUCTION FROM FLAT ARRAY
// ============================================================================

pub fn mat16_from_array(data: [f64; 256]) -> Mat16 {
    Mat16 { data: data }
}

// Transpose
pub fn mat16_transpose(m: Mat16) -> Mat16 {
    var d = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        var j = 0
        while j < 16 {
            d[i * 16 + j] = m.data[j * 16 + i]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    Mat16 { data: d }
}


// === FILE: stdlib/linalg/matrix.sio ===
// matrix.d - Fixed-size matrix types for Sounio linear algebra
//
// Provides small matrix types (Mat2, Mat3, Mat4) and operations commonly
// needed in scientific computing: multiplication, transpose, determinant, inverse.
//
// These are stack-allocated, row-major storage for cache efficiency.

// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn mat_abs_val(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 {
        return 0.0 - x
    }
    return x
}

fn mat_sqrt_val(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    y = 0.5 * (y + x / y)
    return y
}

// ============================================================================
// MAT2 - 2x2 MATRIX
// ============================================================================
// Row-major: [m00 m01]
//            [m10 m11]

struct Mat2 {
    m00: f64, m01: f64,
    m10: f64, m11: f64
}

fn mat2_new(m00: f64, m01: f64, m10: f64, m11: f64) -> Mat2 {
    return Mat2 { m00: m00, m01: m01, m10: m10, m11: m11 }
}

fn mat2_zero() -> Mat2 {
    return Mat2 { m00: 0.0, m01: 0.0, m10: 0.0, m11: 0.0 }
}

fn mat2_identity() -> Mat2 {
    return Mat2 { m00: 1.0, m01: 0.0, m10: 0.0, m11: 1.0 }
}

fn mat2_diag(d0: f64, d1: f64) -> Mat2 {
    return Mat2 { m00: d0, m01: 0.0, m10: 0.0, m11: d1 }
}

fn mat2_add(a: Mat2, b: Mat2) -> Mat2 {
    return Mat2 {
        m00: a.m00 + b.m00, m01: a.m01 + b.m01,
        m10: a.m10 + b.m10, m11: a.m11 + b.m11
    }
}

fn mat2_sub(a: Mat2, b: Mat2) -> Mat2 {
    return Mat2 {
        m00: a.m00 - b.m00, m01: a.m01 - b.m01,
        m10: a.m10 - b.m10, m11: a.m11 - b.m11
    }
}

fn mat2_scale(m: Mat2, s: f64) -> Mat2 {
    return Mat2 {
        m00: m.m00 * s, m01: m.m01 * s,
        m10: m.m10 * s, m11: m.m11 * s
    }
}

fn mat2_neg(m: Mat2) -> Mat2 {
    return Mat2 {
        m00: 0.0 - m.m00, m01: 0.0 - m.m01,
        m10: 0.0 - m.m10, m11: 0.0 - m.m11
    }
}

fn mat2_transpose(m: Mat2) -> Mat2 {
    return Mat2 { m00: m.m00, m01: m.m10, m10: m.m01, m11: m.m11 }
}

fn mat2_mul(a: Mat2, b: Mat2) -> Mat2 {
    return Mat2 {
        m00: a.m00 * b.m00 + a.m01 * b.m10,
        m01: a.m00 * b.m01 + a.m01 * b.m11,
        m10: a.m10 * b.m00 + a.m11 * b.m10,
        m11: a.m10 * b.m01 + a.m11 * b.m11
    }
}

// Mat2 * MatVec2 (using named struct fields)
struct MatVec2 {
    x: f64,
    y: f64
}

fn mat2_vec_mul(m: Mat2, v: MatVec2) -> MatVec2 {
    return MatVec2 {
        x: m.m00 * v.x + m.m01 * v.y,
        y: m.m10 * v.x + m.m11 * v.y
    }
}

fn mat2_det(m: Mat2) -> f64 {
    return m.m00 * m.m11 - m.m01 * m.m10
}

fn mat2_trace(m: Mat2) -> f64 {
    return m.m00 + m.m11
}

fn mat2_inverse(m: Mat2) -> Mat2 {
    let d = mat2_det(m)
    if mat_abs_val(d) < 0.0000000001 {
        // Return identity for singular matrix (caller should check det)
        return mat2_identity()
    }
    let inv_d = 1.0 / d
    return Mat2 {
        m00: m.m11 * inv_d,
        m01: (0.0 - m.m01) * inv_d,
        m10: (0.0 - m.m10) * inv_d,
        m11: m.m00 * inv_d
    }
}

fn mat2_frobenius_norm(m: Mat2) -> f64 {
    return mat_sqrt_val(m.m00*m.m00 + m.m01*m.m01 + m.m10*m.m10 + m.m11*m.m11)
}

// ============================================================================
// MAT3 - 3x3 MATRIX
// ============================================================================
// Row-major: [m00 m01 m02]
//            [m10 m11 m12]
//            [m20 m21 m22]

struct Mat3 {
    m00: f64, m01: f64, m02: f64,
    m10: f64, m11: f64, m12: f64,
    m20: f64, m21: f64, m22: f64
}

fn mat3_new(
    m00: f64, m01: f64, m02: f64,
    m10: f64, m11: f64, m12: f64,
    m20: f64, m21: f64, m22: f64
) -> Mat3 {
    return Mat3 {
        m00: m00, m01: m01, m02: m02,
        m10: m10, m11: m11, m12: m12,
        m20: m20, m21: m21, m22: m22
    }
}

fn mat3_zero() -> Mat3 {
    return Mat3 {
        m00: 0.0, m01: 0.0, m02: 0.0,
        m10: 0.0, m11: 0.0, m12: 0.0,
        m20: 0.0, m21: 0.0, m22: 0.0
    }
}

fn mat3_identity() -> Mat3 {
    return Mat3 {
        m00: 1.0, m01: 0.0, m02: 0.0,
        m10: 0.0, m11: 1.0, m12: 0.0,
        m20: 0.0, m21: 0.0, m22: 1.0
    }
}

fn mat3_diag(d0: f64, d1: f64, d2: f64) -> Mat3 {
    return Mat3 {
        m00: d0, m01: 0.0, m02: 0.0,
        m10: 0.0, m11: d1, m12: 0.0,
        m20: 0.0, m21: 0.0, m22: d2
    }
}

fn mat3_add(a: Mat3, b: Mat3) -> Mat3 {
    return Mat3 {
        m00: a.m00 + b.m00, m01: a.m01 + b.m01, m02: a.m02 + b.m02,
        m10: a.m10 + b.m10, m11: a.m11 + b.m11, m12: a.m12 + b.m12,
        m20: a.m20 + b.m20, m21: a.m21 + b.m21, m22: a.m22 + b.m22
    }
}

fn mat3_sub(a: Mat3, b: Mat3) -> Mat3 {
    return Mat3 {
        m00: a.m00 - b.m00, m01: a.m01 - b.m01, m02: a.m02 - b.m02,
        m10: a.m10 - b.m10, m11: a.m11 - b.m11, m12: a.m12 - b.m12,
        m20: a.m20 - b.m20, m21: a.m21 - b.m21, m22: a.m22 - b.m22
    }
}

fn mat3_scale(m: Mat3, s: f64) -> Mat3 {
    return Mat3 {
        m00: m.m00 * s, m01: m.m01 * s, m02: m.m02 * s,
        m10: m.m10 * s, m11: m.m11 * s, m12: m.m12 * s,
        m20: m.m20 * s, m21: m.m21 * s, m22: m.m22 * s
    }
}

fn mat3_neg(m: Mat3) -> Mat3 {
    return Mat3 {
        m00: 0.0 - m.m00, m01: 0.0 - m.m01, m02: 0.0 - m.m02,
        m10: 0.0 - m.m10, m11: 0.0 - m.m11, m12: 0.0 - m.m12,
        m20: 0.0 - m.m20, m21: 0.0 - m.m21, m22: 0.0 - m.m22
    }
}

fn mat3_transpose(m: Mat3) -> Mat3 {
    return Mat3 {
        m00: m.m00, m01: m.m10, m02: m.m20,
        m10: m.m01, m11: m.m11, m12: m.m21,
        m20: m.m02, m21: m.m12, m22: m.m22
    }
}

fn mat3_mul(a: Mat3, b: Mat3) -> Mat3 {
    return Mat3 {
        m00: a.m00*b.m00 + a.m01*b.m10 + a.m02*b.m20,
        m01: a.m00*b.m01 + a.m01*b.m11 + a.m02*b.m21,
        m02: a.m00*b.m02 + a.m01*b.m12 + a.m02*b.m22,
        m10: a.m10*b.m00 + a.m11*b.m10 + a.m12*b.m20,
        m11: a.m10*b.m01 + a.m11*b.m11 + a.m12*b.m21,
        m12: a.m10*b.m02 + a.m11*b.m12 + a.m12*b.m22,
        m20: a.m20*b.m00 + a.m21*b.m10 + a.m22*b.m20,
        m21: a.m20*b.m01 + a.m21*b.m11 + a.m22*b.m21,
        m22: a.m20*b.m02 + a.m21*b.m12 + a.m22*b.m22
    }
}

// Mat3 * MatVec3
struct MatVec3 {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    z: f64
}

fn mat3_vec_mul(m: Mat3, v: MatVec3) -> MatVec3 {
    return MatVec3 {
        x: m.m00*v.x + m.m01*v.y + m.m02*v.z,
        y: m.m10*v.x + m.m11*v.y + m.m12*v.z,
        z: m.m20*v.x + m.m21*v.y + m.m22*v.z
    }
}

fn mat3_det(m: Mat3) -> f64 {
    // Sarrus rule / cofactor expansion
    return m.m00 * (m.m11*m.m22 - m.m12*m.m21)
         - m.m01 * (m.m10*m.m22 - m.m12*m.m20)
         + m.m02 * (m.m10*m.m21 - m.m11*m.m20)
}

fn mat3_trace(m: Mat3) -> f64 {
    return m.m00 + m.m11 + m.m22
}

fn mat3_inverse(m: Mat3) -> Mat3 {
    let d = mat3_det(m)
    if mat_abs_val(d) < 0.0000000001 {
        return mat3_identity()
    }
    let inv_d = 1.0 / d

    // Cofactor matrix, transposed
    return Mat3 {
        m00: (m.m11*m.m22 - m.m12*m.m21) * inv_d,
        m01: (m.m02*m.m21 - m.m01*m.m22) * inv_d,
        m02: (m.m01*m.m12 - m.m02*m.m11) * inv_d,
        m10: (m.m12*m.m20 - m.m10*m.m22) * inv_d,
        m11: (m.m00*m.m22 - m.m02*m.m20) * inv_d,
        m12: (m.m02*m.m10 - m.m00*m.m12) * inv_d,
        m20: (m.m10*m.m21 - m.m11*m.m20) * inv_d,
        m21: (m.m01*m.m20 - m.m00*m.m21) * inv_d,
        m22: (m.m00*m.m11 - m.m01*m.m10) * inv_d
    }
}

fn mat3_frobenius_norm(m: Mat3) -> f64 {
    return mat_sqrt_val(m.m00*m.m00 + m.m01*m.m01 + m.m02*m.m02
                  + m.m10*m.m10 + m.m11*m.m11 + m.m12*m.m12
                  + m.m20*m.m20 + m.m21*m.m21 + m.m22*m.m22)
}

// ============================================================================
// MAT4 - 4x4 MATRIX (for transformations, projections)
// ============================================================================

struct Mat4 {
    m00: f64, m01: f64, m02: f64, m03: f64,
    m10: f64, m11: f64, m12: f64, m13: f64,
    m20: f64, m21: f64, m22: f64, m23: f64,
    m30: f64, m31: f64, m32: f64, m33: f64
}

fn mat4_zero() -> Mat4 {
    return Mat4 {
        m00: 0.0, m01: 0.0, m02: 0.0, m03: 0.0,
        m10: 0.0, m11: 0.0, m12: 0.0, m13: 0.0,
        m20: 0.0, m21: 0.0, m22: 0.0, m23: 0.0,
        m30: 0.0, m31: 0.0, m32: 0.0, m33: 0.0
    }
}

fn mat4_identity() -> Mat4 {
    return Mat4 {
        m00: 1.0, m01: 0.0, m02: 0.0, m03: 0.0,
        m10: 0.0, m11: 1.0, m12: 0.0, m13: 0.0,
        m20: 0.0, m21: 0.0, m22: 1.0, m23: 0.0,
        m30: 0.0, m31: 0.0, m32: 0.0, m33: 1.0
    }
}

fn mat4_diag(d0: f64, d1: f64, d2: f64, d3: f64) -> Mat4 {
    return Mat4 {
        m00: d0, m01: 0.0, m02: 0.0, m03: 0.0,
        m10: 0.0, m11: d1, m12: 0.0, m13: 0.0,
        m20: 0.0, m21: 0.0, m22: d2, m23: 0.0,
        m30: 0.0, m31: 0.0, m32: 0.0, m33: d3
    }
}

fn mat4_add(a: Mat4, b: Mat4) -> Mat4 {
    return Mat4 {
        m00: a.m00+b.m00, m01: a.m01+b.m01, m02: a.m02+b.m02, m03: a.m03+b.m03,
        m10: a.m10+b.m10, m11: a.m11+b.m11, m12: a.m12+b.m12, m13: a.m13+b.m13,
        m20: a.m20+b.m20, m21: a.m21+b.m21, m22: a.m22+b.m22, m23: a.m23+b.m23,
        m30: a.m30+b.m30, m31: a.m31+b.m31, m32: a.m32+b.m32, m33: a.m33+b.m33
    }
}

fn mat4_scale(m: Mat4, s: f64) -> Mat4 {
    return Mat4 {
        m00: m.m00*s, m01: m.m01*s, m02: m.m02*s, m03: m.m03*s,
        m10: m.m10*s, m11: m.m11*s, m12: m.m12*s, m13: m.m13*s,
        m20: m.m20*s, m21: m.m21*s, m22: m.m22*s, m23: m.m23*s,
        m30: m.m30*s, m31: m.m31*s, m32: m.m32*s, m33: m.m33*s
    }
}

fn mat4_transpose(m: Mat4) -> Mat4 {
    return Mat4 {
        m00: m.m00, m01: m.m10, m02: m.m20, m03: m.m30,
        m10: m.m01, m11: m.m11, m12: m.m21, m13: m.m31,
        m20: m.m02, m21: m.m12, m22: m.m22, m23: m.m32,
        m30: m.m03, m31: m.m13, m32: m.m23, m33: m.m33
    }
}

fn mat4_mul(a: Mat4, b: Mat4) -> Mat4 {
    return Mat4 {
        m00: a.m00*b.m00 + a.m01*b.m10 + a.m02*b.m20 + a.m03*b.m30,
        m01: a.m00*b.m01 + a.m01*b.m11 + a.m02*b.m21 + a.m03*b.m31,
        m02: a.m00*b.m02 + a.m01*b.m12 + a.m02*b.m22 + a.m03*b.m32,
        m03: a.m00*b.m03 + a.m01*b.m13 + a.m02*b.m23 + a.m03*b.m33,
        m10: a.m10*b.m00 + a.m11*b.m10 + a.m12*b.m20 + a.m13*b.m30,
        m11: a.m10*b.m01 + a.m11*b.m11 + a.m12*b.m21 + a.m13*b.m31,
        m12: a.m10*b.m02 + a.m11*b.m12 + a.m12*b.m22 + a.m13*b.m32,
        m13: a.m10*b.m03 + a.m11*b.m13 + a.m12*b.m23 + a.m13*b.m33,
        m20: a.m20*b.m00 + a.m21*b.m10 + a.m22*b.m20 + a.m23*b.m30,
        m21: a.m20*b.m01 + a.m21*b.m11 + a.m22*b.m21 + a.m23*b.m31,
        m22: a.m20*b.m02 + a.m21*b.m12 + a.m22*b.m22 + a.m23*b.m32,
        m23: a.m20*b.m03 + a.m21*b.m13 + a.m22*b.m23 + a.m23*b.m33,
        m30: a.m30*b.m00 + a.m31*b.m10 + a.m32*b.m20 + a.m33*b.m30,
        m31: a.m30*b.m01 + a.m31*b.m11 + a.m32*b.m21 + a.m33*b.m31,
        m32: a.m30*b.m02 + a.m31*b.m12 + a.m32*b.m22 + a.m33*b.m32,
        m33: a.m30*b.m03 + a.m31*b.m13 + a.m32*b.m23 + a.m33*b.m33
    }
}

struct MatVec4 {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    z: f64,
    w: f64
}

fn mat4_vec_mul(m: Mat4, v: MatVec4) -> MatVec4 {
    return MatVec4 {
        x: m.m00*v.x + m.m01*v.y + m.m02*v.z + m.m03*v.w,
        y: m.m10*v.x + m.m11*v.y + m.m12*v.z + m.m13*v.w,
        z: m.m20*v.x + m.m21*v.y + m.m22*v.z + m.m23*v.w,
        w: m.m30*v.x + m.m31*v.y + m.m32*v.z + m.m33*v.w
    }
}

fn mat4_trace(m: Mat4) -> f64 {
    return m.m00 + m.m11 + m.m22 + m.m33
}

// 4x4 determinant using cofactor expansion
fn mat4_det(m: Mat4) -> f64 {
    // Expand along first row using 3x3 minors
    let m00 = m.m11*(m.m22*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m32) - m.m12*(m.m21*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m31) + m.m13*(m.m21*m.m32 - m.m22*m.m31)
    let m01 = m.m10*(m.m22*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m32) - m.m12*(m.m20*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m30) + m.m13*(m.m20*m.m32 - m.m22*m.m30)
    let m02 = m.m10*(m.m21*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m31) - m.m11*(m.m20*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m30) + m.m13*(m.m20*m.m31 - m.m21*m.m30)
    let m03 = m.m10*(m.m21*m.m32 - m.m22*m.m31) - m.m11*(m.m20*m.m32 - m.m22*m.m30) + m.m12*(m.m20*m.m31 - m.m21*m.m30)
    return m.m00*m00 - m.m01*m01 + m.m02*m02 - m.m03*m03
}

// 4x4 inverse using cofactor matrix
fn mat4_inverse(m: Mat4) -> Mat4 {
    let d = mat4_det(m)
    if mat_abs_val(d) < 0.0000000001 {
        return mat4_identity()
    }
    let inv_d = 1.0 / d

    // Compute 3x3 minors for cofactor matrix (with alternating signs)
    // C[i,j] = (-1)^(i+j) * M[j,i] where M is the minor

    // Row 0 of cofactors (for column 0 of inverse)
    let c00 = m.m11*(m.m22*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m32) - m.m12*(m.m21*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m31) + m.m13*(m.m21*m.m32 - m.m22*m.m31)
    let c01 = 0.0 - (m.m10*(m.m22*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m32) - m.m12*(m.m20*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m30) + m.m13*(m.m20*m.m32 - m.m22*m.m30))
    let c02 = m.m10*(m.m21*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m31) - m.m11*(m.m20*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m30) + m.m13*(m.m20*m.m31 - m.m21*m.m30)
    let c03 = 0.0 - (m.m10*(m.m21*m.m32 - m.m22*m.m31) - m.m11*(m.m20*m.m32 - m.m22*m.m30) + m.m12*(m.m20*m.m31 - m.m21*m.m30))

    // Row 1 of cofactors
    let c10 = 0.0 - (m.m01*(m.m22*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m32) - m.m02*(m.m21*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m31) + m.m03*(m.m21*m.m32 - m.m22*m.m31))
    let c11 = m.m00*(m.m22*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m32) - m.m02*(m.m20*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m30) + m.m03*(m.m20*m.m32 - m.m22*m.m30)
    let c12 = 0.0 - (m.m00*(m.m21*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m31) - m.m01*(m.m20*m.m33 - m.m23*m.m30) + m.m03*(m.m20*m.m31 - m.m21*m.m30))
    let c13 = m.m00*(m.m21*m.m32 - m.m22*m.m31) - m.m01*(m.m20*m.m32 - m.m22*m.m30) + m.m02*(m.m20*m.m31 - m.m21*m.m30)

    // Row 2 of cofactors
    let c20 = m.m01*(m.m12*m.m33 - m.m13*m.m32) - m.m02*(m.m11*m.m33 - m.m13*m.m31) + m.m03*(m.m11*m.m32 - m.m12*m.m31)
    let c21 = 0.0 - (m.m00*(m.m12*m.m33 - m.m13*m.m32) - m.m02*(m.m10*m.m33 - m.m13*m.m30) + m.m03*(m.m10*m.m32 - m.m12*m.m30))
    let c22 = m.m00*(m.m11*m.m33 - m.m13*m.m31) - m.m01*(m.m10*m.m33 - m.m13*m.m30) + m.m03*(m.m10*m.m31 - m.m11*m.m30)
    let c23 = 0.0 - (m.m00*(m.m11*m.m32 - m.m12*m.m31) - m.m01*(m.m10*m.m32 - m.m12*m.m30) + m.m02*(m.m10*m.m31 - m.m11*m.m30))

    // Row 3 of cofactors
    let c30 = 0.0 - (m.m01*(m.m12*m.m23 - m.m13*m.m22) - m.m02*(m.m11*m.m23 - m.m13*m.m21) + m.m03*(m.m11*m.m22 - m.m12*m.m21))
    let c31 = m.m00*(m.m12*m.m23 - m.m13*m.m22) - m.m02*(m.m10*m.m23 - m.m13*m.m20) + m.m03*(m.m10*m.m22 - m.m12*m.m20)
    let c32 = 0.0 - (m.m00*(m.m11*m.m23 - m.m13*m.m21) - m.m01*(m.m10*m.m23 - m.m13*m.m20) + m.m03*(m.m10*m.m21 - m.m11*m.m20))
    let c33 = m.m00*(m.m11*m.m22 - m.m12*m.m21) - m.m01*(m.m10*m.m22 - m.m12*m.m20) + m.m02*(m.m10*m.m21 - m.m11*m.m20)

    // Transpose the cofactor matrix and scale by 1/det
    return Mat4 {
        m00: c00*inv_d, m01: c10*inv_d, m02: c20*inv_d, m03: c30*inv_d,
        m10: c01*inv_d, m11: c11*inv_d, m12: c21*inv_d, m13: c31*inv_d,
        m20: c02*inv_d, m21: c12*inv_d, m22: c22*inv_d, m23: c32*inv_d,
        m30: c03*inv_d, m31: c13*inv_d, m32: c23*inv_d, m33: c33*inv_d
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// LINEAR SOLVERS
// ============================================================================
// Solve Ax = b for small matrices (using precomputed inverse)

// Solve 3x3 linear system: Ax = b
fn mat3_solve(a: Mat3, b: MatVec3) -> MatVec3 {
    let a_inv = mat3_inverse(a)
    return mat3_vec_mul(a_inv, b)
}

// Solve 4x4 linear system: Ax = b
fn mat4_solve(a: Mat4, b: MatVec4) -> MatVec4 {
    let a_inv = mat4_inverse(a)
    return mat4_vec_mul(a_inv, b)
}

// ============================================================================
// MAT14 - 14x14 MATRIX (FOR PBPK JACOBIANS)
// ============================================================================
// Used for: Jacobian matrices in implicit ODE solvers, flow matrices, sensitivity
// Row-major storage, elements named r{row}c{col}

// MatVec14 type for PBPK compartment states
struct MatVec14 {
    c0: f64, c1: f64, c2: f64, c3: f64, c4: f64,
    c5: f64, c6: f64, c7: f64, c8: f64, c9: f64,
    c10: f64, c11: f64, c12: f64, c13: f64
}

// Sparse representation: store only the 14 diagonal elements and
// up to 4 off-diagonal bands (for typical PBPK flow structures)
// Full 14x14 would need 196 elements - we use a banded approach

// PBPK matrices are typically sparse with structure:
// - Diagonal: elimination from each compartment
// - Off-diagonal: flows between connected compartments
// Most compartments connect to blood (compartment 0) only

// Diagonal matrix for PBPK (stores just the diagonal)
struct Mat14Diag {
    d0: f64, d1: f64, d2: f64, d3: f64, d4: f64,
    d5: f64, d6: f64, d7: f64, d8: f64, d9: f64,
    d10: f64, d11: f64, d12: f64, d13: f64
}

fn mat14_diag_new(
    d0: f64, d1: f64, d2: f64, d3: f64, d4: f64,
    d5: f64, d6: f64, d7: f64, d8: f64, d9: f64,
    d10: f64, d11: f64, d12: f64, d13: f64
) -> Mat14Diag {
    return Mat14Diag {
        d0: d0, d1: d1, d2: d2, d3: d3, d4: d4,
        d5: d5, d6: d6, d7: d7, d8: d8, d9: d9,
        d10: d10, d11: d11, d12: d12, d13: d13
    }
}

fn mat14_diag_identity() -> Mat14Diag {
    return Mat14Diag {
        d0: 1.0, d1: 1.0, d2: 1.0, d3: 1.0, d4: 1.0,
        d5: 1.0, d6: 1.0, d7: 1.0, d8: 1.0, d9: 1.0,
        d10: 1.0, d11: 1.0, d12: 1.0, d13: 1.0
    }
}

fn mat14_diag_scale(m: Mat14Diag, s: f64) -> Mat14Diag {
    return Mat14Diag {
        d0: m.d0 * s, d1: m.d1 * s, d2: m.d2 * s, d3: m.d3 * s, d4: m.d4 * s,
        d5: m.d5 * s, d6: m.d6 * s, d7: m.d7 * s, d8: m.d8 * s, d9: m.d9 * s,
        d10: m.d10 * s, d11: m.d11 * s, d12: m.d12 * s, d13: m.d13 * s
    }
}

fn mat14_diag_add(a: Mat14Diag, b: Mat14Diag) -> Mat14Diag {
    return Mat14Diag {
        d0: a.d0 + b.d0, d1: a.d1 + b.d1, d2: a.d2 + b.d2, d3: a.d3 + b.d3, d4: a.d4 + b.d4,
        d5: a.d5 + b.d5, d6: a.d6 + b.d6, d7: a.d7 + b.d7, d8: a.d8 + b.d8, d9: a.d9 + b.d9,
        d10: a.d10 + b.d10, d11: a.d11 + b.d11, d12: a.d12 + b.d12, d13: a.d13 + b.d13
    }
}

// Diagonal matrix * vector: O(n) instead of O(n^2)
fn mat14_diag_vec_mul(m: Mat14Diag, v: MatVec14) -> MatVec14 {
    return MatVec14 {
        c0: m.d0 * v.c0, c1: m.d1 * v.c1, c2: m.d2 * v.c2, c3: m.d3 * v.c3, c4: m.d4 * v.c4,
        c5: m.d5 * v.c5, c6: m.d6 * v.c6, c7: m.d7 * v.c7, c8: m.d8 * v.c8, c9: m.d9 * v.c9,
        c10: m.d10 * v.c10, c11: m.d11 * v.c11, c12: m.d12 * v.c12, c13: m.d13 * v.c13
    }
}

// Diagonal inverse: 1/d_i for each element
fn mat14_diag_inverse(m: Mat14Diag) -> Mat14Diag {
    return Mat14Diag {
        d0: 1.0 / m.d0, d1: 1.0 / m.d1, d2: 1.0 / m.d2, d3: 1.0 / m.d3, d4: 1.0 / m.d4,
        d5: 1.0 / m.d5, d6: 1.0 / m.d6, d7: 1.0 / m.d7, d8: 1.0 / m.d8, d9: 1.0 / m.d9,
        d10: 1.0 / m.d10, d11: 1.0 / m.d11, d12: 1.0 / m.d12, d13: 1.0 / m.d13
    }
}

fn mat14_diag_trace(m: Mat14Diag) -> f64 {
    return m.d0 + m.d1 + m.d2 + m.d3 + m.d4 + m.d5 + m.d6
         + m.d7 + m.d8 + m.d9 + m.d10 + m.d11 + m.d12 + m.d13
}

// Solve diagonal system: Dx = b => x = D^{-1}b
fn mat14_diag_solve(m: Mat14Diag, b: MatVec14) -> MatVec14 {
    return MatVec14 {
        c0: b.c0 / m.d0, c1: b.c1 / m.d1, c2: b.c2 / m.d2, c3: b.c3 / m.d3, c4: b.c4 / m.d4,
        c5: b.c5 / m.d5, c6: b.c6 / m.d6, c7: b.c7 / m.d7, c8: b.c8 / m.d8, c9: b.c9 / m.d9,
        c10: b.c10 / m.d10, c11: b.c11 / m.d11, c12: b.c12 / m.d12, c13: b.c13 / m.d13
    }
}

// Tridiagonal matrix for 1D diffusion chains (common in PBPK)
// Stores: lower diagonal (l), main diagonal (d), upper diagonal (u)
struct Mat14Tridiag {
    // Lower diagonal: l[1..13] (l[0] unused)
    l1: f64, l2: f64, l3: f64, l4: f64, l5: f64, l6: f64,
    l7: f64, l8: f64, l9: f64, l10: f64, l11: f64, l12: f64, l13: f64,
    // Main diagonal: d[0..13]
    d0: f64, d1: f64, d2: f64, d3: f64, d4: f64, d5: f64, d6: f64,
    d7: f64, d8: f64, d9: f64, d10: f64, d11: f64, d12: f64, d13: f64,
    // Upper diagonal: u[0..12] (u[13] unused)
    u0: f64, u1: f64, u2: f64, u3: f64, u4: f64, u5: f64,
    u6: f64, u7: f64, u8: f64, u9: f64, u10: f64, u11: f64, u12: f64
}

fn mat14_tridiag_identity() -> Mat14Tridiag {
    return Mat14Tridiag {
        l1: 0.0, l2: 0.0, l3: 0.0, l4: 0.0, l5: 0.0, l6: 0.0,
        l7: 0.0, l8: 0.0, l9: 0.0, l10: 0.0, l11: 0.0, l12: 0.0, l13: 0.0,
        d0: 1.0, d1: 1.0, d2: 1.0, d3: 1.0, d4: 1.0, d5: 1.0, d6: 1.0,
        d7: 1.0, d8: 1.0, d9: 1.0, d10: 1.0, d11: 1.0, d12: 1.0, d13: 1.0,
        u0: 0.0, u1: 0.0, u2: 0.0, u3: 0.0, u4: 0.0, u5: 0.0,
        u6: 0.0, u7: 0.0, u8: 0.0, u9: 0.0, u10: 0.0, u11: 0.0, u12: 0.0
    }
}

// Tridiagonal matrix * vector: O(n)
fn mat14_tridiag_vec_mul(m: Mat14Tridiag, v: MatVec14) -> MatVec14 {
    return MatVec14 {
        c0: m.d0 * v.c0 + m.u0 * v.c1,
        c1: m.l1 * v.c0 + m.d1 * v.c1 + m.u1 * v.c2,
        c2: m.l2 * v.c1 + m.d2 * v.c2 + m.u2 * v.c3,
        c3: m.l3 * v.c2 + m.d3 * v.c3 + m.u3 * v.c4,
        c4: m.l4 * v.c3 + m.d4 * v.c4 + m.u4 * v.c5,
        c5: m.l5 * v.c4 + m.d5 * v.c5 + m.u5 * v.c6,
        c6: m.l6 * v.c5 + m.d6 * v.c6 + m.u6 * v.c7,
        c7: m.l7 * v.c6 + m.d7 * v.c7 + m.u7 * v.c8,
        c8: m.l8 * v.c7 + m.d8 * v.c8 + m.u8 * v.c9,
        c9: m.l9 * v.c8 + m.d9 * v.c9 + m.u9 * v.c10,
        c10: m.l10 * v.c9 + m.d10 * v.c10 + m.u10 * v.c11,
        c11: m.l11 * v.c10 + m.d11 * v.c11 + m.u11 * v.c12,
        c12: m.l12 * v.c11 + m.d12 * v.c12 + m.u12 * v.c13,
        c13: m.l13 * v.c12 + m.d13 * v.c13
    }
}

// Thomas algorithm for tridiagonal system solve: O(n)
// Solves: Ax = b where A is tridiagonal
// Returns solution x
fn mat14_tridiag_solve(m: Mat14Tridiag, b: MatVec14) -> MatVec14 {
    // Forward elimination (modify diagonal and RHS)
    // c'[i] = u[i] / (d[i] - l[i] * c'[i-1])
    // d'[i] = (b[i] - l[i] * d'[i-1]) / (d[i] - l[i] * c'[i-1])

    // Step 0: c'[0] = u[0]/d[0], d'[0] = b[0]/d[0]
    let cp0 = m.u0 / m.d0
    let dp0 = b.c0 / m.d0

    // Step 1
    let w1 = m.d1 - m.l1 * cp0
    let cp1 = m.u1 / w1
    let dp1 = (b.c1 - m.l1 * dp0) / w1

    // Step 2
    let w2 = m.d2 - m.l2 * cp1
    let cp2 = m.u2 / w2
    let dp2 = (b.c2 - m.l2 * dp1) / w2

    // Step 3
    let w3 = m.d3 - m.l3 * cp2
    let cp3 = m.u3 / w3
    let dp3 = (b.c3 - m.l3 * dp2) / w3

    // Step 4
    let w4 = m.d4 - m.l4 * cp3
    let cp4 = m.u4 / w4
    let dp4 = (b.c4 - m.l4 * dp3) / w4

    // Step 5
    let w5 = m.d5 - m.l5 * cp4
    let cp5 = m.u5 / w5
    let dp5 = (b.c5 - m.l5 * dp4) / w5

    // Step 6
    let w6 = m.d6 - m.l6 * cp5
    let cp6 = m.u6 / w6
    let dp6 = (b.c6 - m.l6 * dp5) / w6

    // Step 7
    let w7 = m.d7 - m.l7 * cp6
    let cp7 = m.u7 / w7
    let dp7 = (b.c7 - m.l7 * dp6) / w7

    // Step 8
    let w8 = m.d8 - m.l8 * cp7
    let cp8 = m.u8 / w8
    let dp8 = (b.c8 - m.l8 * dp7) / w8

    // Step 9
    let w9 = m.d9 - m.l9 * cp8
    let cp9 = m.u9 / w9
    let dp9 = (b.c9 - m.l9 * dp8) / w9

    // Step 10
    let w10 = m.d10 - m.l10 * cp9
    let cp10 = m.u10 / w10
    let dp10 = (b.c10 - m.l10 * dp9) / w10

    // Step 11
    let w11 = m.d11 - m.l11 * cp10
    let cp11 = m.u11 / w11
    let dp11 = (b.c11 - m.l11 * dp10) / w11

    // Step 12
    let w12 = m.d12 - m.l12 * cp11
    let cp12 = m.u12 / w12
    let dp12 = (b.c12 - m.l12 * dp11) / w12

    // Step 13
    let w13 = m.d13 - m.l13 * cp12
    let dp13 = (b.c13 - m.l13 * dp12) / w13

    // Back substitution: x[i] = d'[i] - c'[i] * x[i+1]
    let x13 = dp13
    let x12 = dp12 - cp12 * x13
    let x11 = dp11 - cp11 * x12
    let x10 = dp10 - cp10 * x11
    let x9 = dp9 - cp9 * x10
    let x8 = dp8 - cp8 * x9
    let x7 = dp7 - cp7 * x8
    let x6 = dp6 - cp6 * x7
    let x5 = dp5 - cp5 * x6
    let x4 = dp4 - cp4 * x5
    let x3 = dp3 - cp3 * x4
    let x2 = dp2 - cp2 * x3
    let x1 = dp1 - cp1 * x2
    let x0 = dp0 - cp0 * x1

    return MatVec14 {
        c0: x0, c1: x1, c2: x2, c3: x3, c4: x4, c5: x5, c6: x6,
        c7: x7, c8: x8, c9: x9, c10: x10, c11: x11, c12: x12, c13: x13
    }
}
