// =============================================================================
// Vector helpers (fixed-size [f64; 64])
// =============================================================================

fn co_dot(a: &[f64; 64], b: &[f64; 64], n: i32) -> f64 with Div, Panic, Mut {
    var s = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n { s = s + a[i] * b[i]; i = i + 1 }
    s
}

fn co_norm2(a: &[f64; 64], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n { s = s + a[i] * a[i]; i = i + 1 }
    co_sqrt(s)
}

fn co_norminf(a: &[f64; 64], n: i32) -> f64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var mx = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let v = co_abs(a[i])
        if v > mx { mx = v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    mx
}

fn co_copy(src: &[f64; 64], dst: &![f64; 64], n: i32) with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < n { dst[i] = src[i]; i = i + 1 }
}

fn co_axpy(alpha: f64, x: &[f64; 64], dst: &![f64; 64], n: i32) with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < n { dst[i] = dst[i] + alpha * x[i]; i = i + 1 }
}

fn co_scale(dst: &![f64; 64], alpha: f64, n: i32) with Div, Panic, Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < n { dst[i] = dst[i] * alpha; i = i + 1 }
}

fn co_zero(dst: &![f64; 64], n: i32) with Div, Panic, Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < n { dst[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
}

// =============================================================================
// Structs
// =============================================================================

struct ConstrainedConfig {
    max_iter: i32,
    tol_opt: f64,
    tol_feas: f64,
    mu_init: f64,
    mu_max: f64,
    rho: f64
}

struct ConstrainedResult {
    x: [f64; 64],
    obj_val: f64,
    constraint_viol: f64,
    iterations: i32,
    converged: bool,
    n_dim: i32
}

struct LBFGSState {
    s_store: [f64; 4096],
    y_store: [f64; 4096],
    rho_store: [f64; 64],
    m: i32,
    n: i32,
    count: i32
}

// =============================================================================
// Numerical gradient (central differences)
// =============================================================================

fn co_numerical_grad(f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                     x: &[f64; 64], n: i32,
                     grad: &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var xp: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var xm: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    let cbrt_eps = 6.0554544523933429e-6
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = 0
        while j < n { xp[j] = x[j]; xm[j] = x[j]; j = j + 1 }
        let h = cbrt_eps * co_max(co_abs(x[i]), 1.0)
        xp[i] = x[i] + h
        xm[i] = x[i] - h
        grad[i] = (f(&xp, n) - f(&xm, n)) / (2.0 * h)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Armijo backtracking line search
// =============================================================================

// f(x + alpha*dir) <= f(x) + c1*alpha*grad'*dir, c1=1e-4, shrink by 0.5
fn co_armijo_search(f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                    x: &[f64; 64], dir: &[f64; 64], grad: &[f64; 64],
                    n: i32, alpha_init: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c1 = 1.0e-4
    let min_alpha = 1.0e-16
    let f0 = f(x, n)
    let dg = co_dot(grad, dir, n)
    if dg >= 0.0 { return min_alpha }
    var alpha = alpha_init
    var trial: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var iter = 0
    while iter < 40 {
        var i = 0
        while i < n { trial[i] = x[i] + alpha * dir[i]; i = i + 1 }
        let f_trial = f(&trial, n)
        if f_trial <= f0 + c1 * alpha * dg { return alpha }
        alpha = alpha * 0.5
        if alpha < min_alpha { return min_alpha }
        iter = iter + 1
    }
    alpha
}

// =============================================================================
// L-BFGS: Limited-memory BFGS (inner solver)
// =============================================================================

fn lbfgs_init(state: &!LBFGSState, n: i32, m: i32) with Div, Panic, Mut {
    state.n = n
    state.m = m
    state.count = 0
    var i = 0
    while i < 4096 { state.s_store[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 4096 { state.y_store[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 64 { state.rho_store[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
}

// Store curvature pair s = x_{k+1} - x_k, y = g_{k+1} - g_k (circular buffer)
fn lbfgs_update(state: &!LBFGSState, s: &[f64; 64], y: &[f64; 64]) with Panic, Mut, Div {
    let n = state.n
    let m = state.m
    let slot = state.count - (state.count / m) * m
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        state.s_store[slot * n + i] = s[i]
        state.y_store[slot * n + i] = y[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    var ys = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n { ys = ys + y[i] * s[i]; i = i + 1 }
    if co_abs(ys) < 1.0e-30 { ys = 1.0e-30 }
    state.rho_store[slot] = 1.0 / ys
    state.count = state.count + 1
}

// Two-loop recursion (Nocedal Algorithm 7.4): dir = -H_k * grad
fn lbfgs_direction(state: &LBFGSState, grad: &[f64; 64], dir: &![f64; 64]) with Panic, Mut, Div {
    let n = state.n
    let m = state.m
    let k = state.count
    var bound = k
    if bound > m { bound = m }

    var q: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var i = 0
    while i < n { q[i] = grad[i]; i = i + 1 }

    var alpha: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

    // First loop: most recent to oldest
    var idx = 0
    while idx < bound {
        let raw = k - 1 - idx
        var slot = raw - (raw / m) * m
        if slot < 0 { slot = slot + m }
        var stq = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n { stq = stq + state.s_store[slot * n + i] * q[i]; i = i + 1 }
        alpha[idx] = state.rho_store[slot] * stq
        i = 0
        while i < n { q[i] = q[i] - alpha[idx] * state.y_store[slot * n + i]; i = i + 1 }
        idx = idx + 1
    }

    // Initial Hessian scaling: gamma = s_{k-1}^T y_{k-1} / y_{k-1}^T y_{k-1}
    var gamma = 1.0
    if bound > 0 {
        let nraw = k - 1
        var nslot = nraw - (nraw / m) * m
        if nslot < 0 { nslot = nslot + m }
        var sy = 0.0
        var yy = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            sy = sy + state.s_store[nslot * n + i] * state.y_store[nslot * n + i]
            yy = yy + state.y_store[nslot * n + i] * state.y_store[nslot * n + i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        if co_abs(yy) > 1.0e-30 { gamma = sy / yy }
    }

    var r: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    i = 0
    while i < n { r[i] = gamma * q[i]; i = i + 1 }

    // Second loop: oldest to most recent
    idx = bound - 1
    while idx >= 0 {
        let raw2 = k - 1 - idx
        var slot2 = raw2 - (raw2 / m) * m
        if slot2 < 0 { slot2 = slot2 + m }
        var ytr = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n { ytr = ytr + state.y_store[slot2 * n + i] * r[i]; i = i + 1 }
        let beta = state.rho_store[slot2] * ytr
        i = 0
        while i < n { r[i] = r[i] + (alpha[idx] - beta) * state.s_store[slot2 * n + i]; i = i + 1 }
        idx = idx - 1
    }

    i = 0
    while i < n { dir[i] = 0.0 - r[i]; i = i + 1 }
}

// Full L-BFGS minimization. Memory depth m=7, convergence on ||grad||_inf < tol.
fn lbfgs_minimize(f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                  grad_f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                  x0: &[f64; 64], n: i32, max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
                  result: &!ConstrainedResult) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var state: LBFGSState = LBFGSState {
        s_store: [0.0; 4096], y_store: [0.0; 4096],
        rho_store: [0.0; 64], m: 0, n: 0, count: 0
    }
    lbfgs_init(&!state, n, 7)

    var x: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    co_copy(x0, &!x, n)
    var grad: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var grad_prev: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var dir: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var x_prev: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var s_vec: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var y_vec: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

    grad_f(&x, n, &!grad)
    var iter = 0

    while iter < max_iter {
        // Copy grad to avoid shared+mutable borrow conflict in loop body
        var grad_tmp: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var gi = 0
        while gi < n { grad_tmp[gi] = grad[gi]; gi = gi + 1 }
        let gnorm = co_norminf(&grad_tmp, n)
        if gnorm < tol {
            co_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = f(&x, n)
            result.constraint_viol = 0.0
            result.iterations = iter
            result.converged = true
            result.n_dim = n
            return
        }
        co_copy(&x, &!x_prev, n)
        co_copy(&grad, &!grad_prev, n)

        if iter == 0 {
            var i = 0
            while i < n { dir[i] = 0.0 - grad[i]; i = i + 1 }
        } else {
            lbfgs_direction(&state, &grad_tmp, &!dir)
        }

        let alpha = co_armijo_search(f, &x, &dir, &grad_tmp, n, 1.0)
        var i = 0
        while i < n { x[i] = x[i] + alpha * dir[i]; i = i + 1 }
        grad_f(&x, n, &!grad)

        i = 0
        while i < n {
            s_vec[i] = x[i] - x_prev[i]
            y_vec[i] = grad[i] - grad_prev[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        let sy = co_dot(&s_vec, &y_vec, n)
        if sy > 1.0e-16 { lbfgs_update(&!state, &s_vec, &y_vec) }
        iter = iter + 1
    }

    co_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = f(&x, n)
    result.constraint_viol = 0.0
    result.iterations = iter
    result.converged = false
    result.n_dim = n
}

// =============================================================================
// Box-constrained optimization
// =============================================================================

// Project x[i] = clamp(x[i], lower[i], upper[i])
fn box_project(x: &![f64; 64], lower: &[f64; 64], upper: &[f64; 64], n: i32) with Div, Panic, Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        if x[i] < lower[i] { x[i] = lower[i] }
        if x[i] > upper[i] { x[i] = upper[i] }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Projected gradient descent with Div, Mut, Panic, Armijo line search on projected iterates.
// Converges when ||project(x - grad) - x||_inf < tol.
fn projected_gradient(f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                      grad_f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                      x0: &[f64; 64], lower: &[f64; 64], upper: &[f64; 64],
                      n: i32, max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
                      result: &!ConstrainedResult) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    co_copy(x0, &!x, n)
    box_project(&!x, lower, upper, n)

    var grad: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var x_trial: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var proj_test: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var iter = 0

    while iter < max_iter {
        grad_f(&x, n, &!grad)

        // Optimality: ||project(x - grad) - x||_inf
        var i = 0
        while i < n { proj_test[i] = x[i] - grad[i]; i = i + 1 }
        box_project(&!proj_test, lower, upper, n)
        var opt_viol = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let diff = co_abs(proj_test[i] - x[i])
            if diff > opt_viol { opt_viol = diff }
            i = i + 1
        }
        if opt_viol < tol {
            co_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = f(&x, n)
            result.constraint_viol = 0.0
            result.iterations = iter
            result.converged = true
            result.n_dim = n
            return
        }

        // Projected Armijo backtracking
        // Copy x for f evaluation to avoid shared+mutable borrow conflict
        var x_for_f: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        i = 0
        while i < n { x_for_f[i] = x[i]; i = i + 1 }
        let f0 = f(&x_for_f, n)
        var alpha = 1.0
        let c1 = 1.0e-4
        var ls_iter = 0
        while ls_iter < 30 {
            i = 0
            while i < n { x_trial[i] = x[i] - alpha * grad[i]; i = i + 1 }
            box_project(&!x_trial, lower, upper, n)
            let f_trial = f(&x_trial, n)
            var descent = 0.0
            i = 0
            while i < n { descent = descent + grad[i] * (x_trial[i] - x[i]); i = i + 1 }
            if f_trial <= f0 + c1 * descent {
                // Manual copy x_trial -> x to avoid co_copy borrow conflict
                var ci = 0
                while ci < n { x[ci] = x_trial[ci]; ci = ci + 1 }
                ls_iter = 30
            } else {
                alpha = alpha * 0.5
                if alpha < 1.0e-16 {
                    var ci = 0
                    while ci < n { x[ci] = x_trial[ci]; ci = ci + 1 }
                    ls_iter = 30
                } else {
                    ls_iter = ls_iter + 1
                }
            }
        }
        iter = iter + 1
    }

    co_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = f(&x, n)
    result.constraint_viol = 0.0
    result.iterations = iter
    result.converged = false
    result.n_dim = n
}

// =============================================================================
// Augmented Lagrangian: helper functions (MUST precede auglag_minimize)
// =============================================================================

// Evaluate augmented Lagrangian objective:
//   L_A = f(x) + sum_i (lambda_eq_i * ceq_i + (mu/2) * ceq_i^2)
//       + sum_j (1/(2*mu)) * (max(0, lambda_ineq_j + mu*cineq_j)^2 - lambda_ineq_j^2)
fn auglag_eval_obj(f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                   c_eq: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64], i32) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                   n_eq: i32,
                   c_ineq: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64], i32) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                   n_ineq: i32,
                   x: &[f64; 64], n: i32,
                   lambda_eq: &[f64; 64], lambda_ineq: &[f64; 64],
                   mu: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var val = f(x, n)
    if n_eq > 0 {
        var ceq: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        c_eq(x, n, &!ceq, n_eq)
        var i = 0
        while i < n_eq {
            val = val + lambda_eq[i] * ceq[i] + 0.5 * mu * ceq[i] * ceq[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
    }
    // Inequality: Powell-Hestenes-Rockafellar formulation
    if n_ineq > 0 {
        var cineq: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        c_ineq(x, n, &!cineq, n_ineq)
        var j = 0
        while j < n_ineq {
            let shifted = lambda_ineq[j] + mu * cineq[j]
            if shifted > 0.0 {
                val = val + (shifted * shifted - lambda_ineq[j] * lambda_ineq[j]) / (2.0 * mu)
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
    }
    val
}

// Backtracking line search on augmented Lagrangian objective.
fn auglag_line_search(f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                      c_eq: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64], i32) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                      n_eq: i32,
                      c_ineq: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64], i32) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                      n_ineq: i32,
                      x: &[f64; 64], dir: &[f64; 64], grad: &[f64; 64],
                      n: i32,
                      lambda_eq: &[f64; 64], lambda_ineq: &[f64; 64],
                      mu: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c1 = 1.0e-4
    let min_alpha = 1.0e-16
    let f0 = auglag_eval_obj(f, c_eq, n_eq, c_ineq, n_ineq, x, n,
                             lambda_eq, lambda_ineq, mu)
    let dg = co_dot(grad, dir, n)
    if dg >= 0.0 { return min_alpha }
    var alpha = 1.0
    var trial: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var iter = 0
    while iter < 30 {
        var i = 0
        while i < n { trial[i] = x[i] + alpha * dir[i]; i = i + 1 }
        let f_trial = auglag_eval_obj(f, c_eq, n_eq, c_ineq, n_ineq, &trial, n,
                                      lambda_eq, lambda_ineq, mu)
        if f_trial <= f0 + c1 * alpha * dg { return alpha }
        alpha = alpha * 0.5
        if alpha < min_alpha { return min_alpha }
        iter = iter + 1
    }
    alpha
}

// =============================================================================
// Augmented Lagrangian method
// =============================================================================

// Solves: min f(x) s.t. c_eq(x)=0, c_ineq(x)<=0
// Outer loop: update multipliers lambda, increase penalty mu.
// Inner loop: L-BFGS on augmented Lagrangian with Div, Mut, Panic, numerical gradients.
fn auglag_minimize(f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                   grad_f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                   c_eq: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64], i32) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                   n_eq: i32,
                   c_ineq: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64], i32) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                   n_ineq: i32,
                   x0: &[f64; 64], n: i32,
                   config: &ConstrainedConfig,
                   result: &!ConstrainedResult) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    co_copy(x0, &!x, n)
    var lambda_eq: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var lambda_ineq: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var mu = config.mu_init
    var ceq_val: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var cineq_val: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

    var outer = 0
    while outer < config.max_iter {
        // Evaluate constraints and check feasibility
        if n_eq > 0 { c_eq(&x, n, &!ceq_val, n_eq) }
        if n_ineq > 0 { c_ineq(&x, n, &!cineq_val, n_ineq) }
        var feas_viol = 0.0
        var i = 0
        while i < n_eq {
            let v = co_abs(ceq_val[i])
            if v > feas_viol { feas_viol = v }
            i = i + 1
        }
        i = 0
        while i < n_ineq {
            if cineq_val[i] > 0.0 {
                if cineq_val[i] > feas_viol { feas_viol = cineq_val[i] }
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        if feas_viol < config.tol_feas {
            var grad_L: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
            grad_f(&x, n, &!grad_L)
            let gnorm = co_norminf(&grad_L, n)
            if gnorm < config.tol_opt {
                co_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
                result.obj_val = f(&x, n)
                result.constraint_viol = feas_viol
                result.iterations = outer
                result.converged = true
                result.n_dim = n
                return
            }
        }

        // Inner L-BFGS solve on augmented Lagrangian
        var istate: LBFGSState = LBFGSState {
            s_store: [0.0; 4096], y_store: [0.0; 4096],
            rho_store: [0.0; 64], m: 0, n: 0, count: 0
        }
        lbfgs_init(&!istate, n, 7)
        var grad_aug: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var grad_aug_prev: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var dir_aug: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var x_prev: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var s_in: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var y_in: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var xp: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var xm: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        let cbrt_eps = 6.0554544523933429e-6

        var inner = 0
        while inner < 50 {
            // Numerical gradient of augmented Lagrangian
            var gi = 0
            while gi < n {
                var j = 0
                while j < n { xp[j] = x[j]; xm[j] = x[j]; j = j + 1 }
                let h = cbrt_eps * co_max(co_abs(x[gi]), 1.0)
                xp[gi] = x[gi] + h
                xm[gi] = x[gi] - h
                let fp = auglag_eval_obj(f, c_eq, n_eq, c_ineq, n_ineq,
                                         &xp, n, &lambda_eq, &lambda_ineq, mu)
                let fm = auglag_eval_obj(f, c_eq, n_eq, c_ineq, n_ineq,
                                         &xm, n, &lambda_eq, &lambda_ineq, mu)
                grad_aug[gi] = (fp - fm) / (2.0 * h)
                gi = gi + 1
            }
            let gnorm_in = co_norminf(&grad_aug, n)
            if gnorm_in < config.tol_opt * 10.0 {
                inner = 50
            } else {
                co_copy(&x, &!x_prev, n)
                co_copy(&grad_aug, &!grad_aug_prev, n)
                if inner == 0 {
                    var di = 0
                    while di < n { dir_aug[di] = 0.0 - grad_aug[di]; di = di + 1 }
                } else {
                    lbfgs_direction(&istate, &grad_aug, &!dir_aug)
                }
                let a_aug = auglag_line_search(f, c_eq, n_eq, c_ineq, n_ineq,
                                               &x, &dir_aug, &grad_aug,
                                               n, &lambda_eq, &lambda_ineq, mu)
                var ui = 0
                while ui < n { x[ui] = x[ui] + a_aug * dir_aug[ui]; ui = ui + 1 }

                // Recompute gradient for L-BFGS update
                gi = 0
                while gi < n {
                    var j = 0
                    while j < n { xp[j] = x[j]; xm[j] = x[j]; j = j + 1 }
                    let h = cbrt_eps * co_max(co_abs(x[gi]), 1.0)
                    xp[gi] = x[gi] + h
                    xm[gi] = x[gi] - h
                    let fp2 = auglag_eval_obj(f, c_eq, n_eq, c_ineq, n_ineq,
                                              &xp, n, &lambda_eq, &lambda_ineq, mu)
                    let fm2 = auglag_eval_obj(f, c_eq, n_eq, c_ineq, n_ineq,
                                              &xm, n, &lambda_eq, &lambda_ineq, mu)
                    grad_aug[gi] = (fp2 - fm2) / (2.0 * h)
                    gi = gi + 1
                }
                var si = 0
                while si < n {
                    s_in[si] = x[si] - x_prev[si]
                    y_in[si] = grad_aug[si] - grad_aug_prev[si]
                    si = si + 1
                }
                let sy_in = co_dot(&s_in, &y_in, n)
                if sy_in > 1.0e-16 { lbfgs_update(&!istate, &s_in, &y_in) }
                inner = inner + 1
            }
        }

        // Update multipliers
        if n_eq > 0 { c_eq(&x, n, &!ceq_val, n_eq) }
        if n_ineq > 0 { c_ineq(&x, n, &!cineq_val, n_ineq) }
        i = 0
        while i < n_eq { lambda_eq[i] = lambda_eq[i] + mu * ceq_val[i]; i = i + 1 }
        i = 0
        while i < n_ineq {
            let cand = lambda_ineq[i] + mu * cineq_val[i]
            if cand > 0.0 { lambda_ineq[i] = cand } else { lambda_ineq[i] = 0.0 }
            i = i + 1
        }
        mu = mu * config.rho
        if mu > config.mu_max { mu = config.mu_max }
        outer = outer + 1
    }

    // Did not converge
    if n_eq > 0 { c_eq(&x, n, &!ceq_val, n_eq) }
    if n_ineq > 0 { c_ineq(&x, n, &!cineq_val, n_ineq) }
    var fv = 0.0
    var vi = 0
    while vi < n_eq {
        let v = co_abs(ceq_val[vi])
        if v > fv { fv = v }
        vi = vi + 1
    }
    vi = 0
    while vi < n_ineq {
        if cineq_val[vi] > 0.0 { if cineq_val[vi] > fv { fv = cineq_val[vi] } }
        vi = vi + 1
    }
    co_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = f(&x, n)
    result.constraint_viol = fv
    result.iterations = outer
    result.converged = false
    result.n_dim = n
}

// =============================================================================
// Penalty method: helper functions (MUST precede penalty_minimize)
// =============================================================================

// Evaluate penalized objective: f(x) + (mu/2) * ||c(x)||^2
fn penalty_eval_obj(f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                    c: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64], i32) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                    n_c: i32,
                    x: &[f64; 64], n: i32,
                    mu: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var val = f(x, n)
    var c_val: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    c(x, n, &!c_val, n_c)
    var penalty = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n_c { penalty = penalty + c_val[i] * c_val[i]; i = i + 1 }
    val + 0.5 * mu * penalty
}

// Backtracking line search on penalized objective
fn penalty_line_search(f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                       c: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64], i32) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                       n_c: i32,
                       x: &[f64; 64], dir: &[f64; 64], grad: &[f64; 64],
                       n: i32, mu: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c1 = 1.0e-4
    let min_alpha = 1.0e-16
    let f0 = penalty_eval_obj(f, c, n_c, x, n, mu)
    let dg = co_dot(grad, dir, n)
    if dg >= 0.0 { return min_alpha }
    var alpha = 1.0
    var trial: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var iter = 0
    while iter < 30 {
        var i = 0
        while i < n { trial[i] = x[i] + alpha * dir[i]; i = i + 1 }
        let f_trial = penalty_eval_obj(f, c, n_c, &trial, n, mu)
        if f_trial <= f0 + c1 * alpha * dg { return alpha }
        alpha = alpha * 0.5
        if alpha < min_alpha { return min_alpha }
        iter = iter + 1
    }
    alpha
}

// =============================================================================
// Quadratic penalty method
// =============================================================================

// Quadratic penalty: min f(x) + (mu/2)*||c(x)||^2, increase mu by rho each outer iter.
fn penalty_minimize(f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                    grad_f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                    c: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64], i32) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                    n_c: i32,
                    x0: &[f64; 64], n: i32,
                    config: &ConstrainedConfig,
                    result: &!ConstrainedResult) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    co_copy(x0, &!x, n)
    var mu = config.mu_init
    var c_val: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

    var outer = 0
    while outer < config.max_iter {
        // Inner L-BFGS on penalized objective
        var istate: LBFGSState = LBFGSState {
            s_store: [0.0; 4096], y_store: [0.0; 4096],
            rho_store: [0.0; 64], m: 0, n: 0, count: 0
        }
        lbfgs_init(&!istate, n, 7)
        var gp: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var gp_prev: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var dp: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var xprev: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var sp: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var yp: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var xpp: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var xmm: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        let cbrt_eps = 6.0554544523933429e-6

        var inner = 0
        while inner < 50 {
            var gi = 0
            while gi < n {
                var j = 0
                while j < n { xpp[j] = x[j]; xmm[j] = x[j]; j = j + 1 }
                let h = cbrt_eps * co_max(co_abs(x[gi]), 1.0)
                xpp[gi] = x[gi] + h
                xmm[gi] = x[gi] - h
                let fp = penalty_eval_obj(f, c, n_c, &xpp, n, mu)
                let fm = penalty_eval_obj(f, c, n_c, &xmm, n, mu)
                gp[gi] = (fp - fm) / (2.0 * h)
                gi = gi + 1
            }
            let gnorm = co_norminf(&gp, n)
            if gnorm < config.tol_opt * 10.0 {
                inner = 50
            } else {
                co_copy(&x, &!xprev, n)
                co_copy(&gp, &!gp_prev, n)
                if inner == 0 {
                    var di = 0
                    while di < n { dp[di] = 0.0 - gp[di]; di = di + 1 }
                } else {
                    lbfgs_direction(&istate, &gp, &!dp)
                }
                let ap = penalty_line_search(f, c, n_c, &x, &dp, &gp, n, mu)
                var ui = 0
                while ui < n { x[ui] = x[ui] + ap * dp[ui]; ui = ui + 1 }

                // Recompute gradient for L-BFGS
                gi = 0
                while gi < n {
                    var j = 0
                    while j < n { xpp[j] = x[j]; xmm[j] = x[j]; j = j + 1 }
                    let h = cbrt_eps * co_max(co_abs(x[gi]), 1.0)
                    xpp[gi] = x[gi] + h
                    xmm[gi] = x[gi] - h
                    let fp2 = penalty_eval_obj(f, c, n_c, &xpp, n, mu)
                    let fm2 = penalty_eval_obj(f, c, n_c, &xmm, n, mu)
                    gp[gi] = (fp2 - fm2) / (2.0 * h)
                    gi = gi + 1
                }
                var si = 0
                while si < n {
                    sp[si] = x[si] - xprev[si]
                    yp[si] = gp[si] - gp_prev[si]
                    si = si + 1
                }
                let syp = co_dot(&sp, &yp, n)
                if syp > 1.0e-16 { lbfgs_update(&!istate, &sp, &yp) }
                inner = inner + 1
            }
        }

        // Check feasibility
        c(&x, n, &!c_val, n_c)
        var fv = 0.0
        var vi = 0
        while vi < n_c {
            let v = co_abs(c_val[vi])
            if v > fv { fv = v }
            vi = vi + 1
        }
        if fv < config.tol_feas {
            co_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = f(&x, n)
            result.constraint_viol = fv
            result.iterations = outer
            result.converged = true
            result.n_dim = n
            return
        }
        mu = mu * config.rho
        if mu > config.mu_max { mu = config.mu_max }
        outer = outer + 1
    }

    c(&x, n, &!c_val, n_c)
    var fv = 0.0
    var vi = 0
    while vi < n_c {
        let v = co_abs(c_val[vi])
        if v > fv { fv = v }
        vi = vi + 1
    }
    co_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = f(&x, n)
    result.constraint_viol = fv
    result.iterations = outer
    result.converged = false
    result.n_dim = n
}

// =============================================================================
// Barrier method: helper functions (MUST precede barrier_minimize)
// =============================================================================

// Evaluate barrier objective: f(x) - (1/t) * sum_j ln(-c_ineq_j(x))
// Returns 1e308 if any constraint is non-negative (infeasible).
fn barrier_eval_obj(f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                    c_ineq: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64], i32) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                    n_ineq: i32,
                    x: &[f64; 64], n: i32,
                    t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var val = f(x, n)
    var cineq: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    c_ineq(x, n, &!cineq, n_ineq)
    var j = 0
    while j < n_ineq {
        if cineq[j] >= 0.0 { return 1.0e308 }
        val = val - co_ln(0.0 - cineq[j]) / t
        j = j + 1
    }
    val
}

// Backtracking line search for barrier method with Div, Mut, Panic, feasibility enforcement.
fn barrier_line_search(f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                       c_ineq: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64], i32) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                       n_ineq: i32,
                       x: &[f64; 64], dir: &[f64; 64], grad: &[f64; 64],
                       n: i32, t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let c1 = 1.0e-4
    let min_alpha = 1.0e-16
    let f0 = barrier_eval_obj(f, c_ineq, n_ineq, x, n, t)
    let dg = co_dot(grad, dir, n)
    if dg >= 0.0 { return min_alpha }
    var alpha = 1.0
    var trial: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var ct: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var iter = 0
    while iter < 40 {
        var i = 0
        while i < n { trial[i] = x[i] + alpha * dir[i]; i = i + 1 }
        // Check feasibility
        c_ineq(&trial, n, &!ct, n_ineq)
        var feasible = true
        i = 0
        while i < n_ineq {
            if ct[i] >= 0.0 { feasible = false }
            i = i + 1
        }
        if feasible {
            let f_trial = barrier_eval_obj(f, c_ineq, n_ineq, &trial, n, t)
            if f_trial <= f0 + c1 * alpha * dg { return alpha }
        }
        alpha = alpha * 0.5
        if alpha < min_alpha { return min_alpha }
        iter = iter + 1
    }
    alpha
}

// =============================================================================
// Log-barrier interior point method
// =============================================================================

// Interior point: min f(x) - (1/t)*sum_j ln(-c_ineq_j(x))
// Requires strictly feasible x0 (all c_ineq_j(x0) < 0).
// Increases t by rho each outer iteration.
fn barrier_minimize(f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                    grad_f: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                    c_ineq: fn(&[f64; 64], i32, &![f64; 64], i32) with Mut, Div, Panic,
                    n_ineq: i32,
                    x0: &[f64; 64], n: i32,
                    config: &ConstrainedConfig,
                    result: &!ConstrainedResult) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    co_copy(x0, &!x, n)
    var t = 1.0
    var cv: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

    // Verify initial strict feasibility
    c_ineq(&x, n, &!cv, n_ineq)
    var i = 0
    while i < n_ineq {
        if cv[i] >= 0.0 {
            co_copy(x0, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = f(x0, n)
            result.constraint_viol = 1.0e30
            result.iterations = 0
            result.converged = false
            result.n_dim = n
            return
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var outer = 0
    while outer < config.max_iter {
        // Inner L-BFGS on barrier objective
        var istate: LBFGSState = LBFGSState {
            s_store: [0.0; 4096], y_store: [0.0; 4096],
            rho_store: [0.0; 64], m: 0, n: 0, count: 0
        }
        lbfgs_init(&!istate, n, 7)
        var gb: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var gb_prev: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var db: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var xprev: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var sb: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var yb: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var xpp: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        var xmm: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        let cbrt_eps = 6.0554544523933429e-6

        var inner = 0
        while inner < 80 {
            // Gradient via central differences
            var gi = 0
            while gi < n {
                var j = 0
                while j < n { xpp[j] = x[j]; xmm[j] = x[j]; j = j + 1 }
                let h = cbrt_eps * co_max(co_abs(x[gi]), 1.0)
                xpp[gi] = x[gi] + h
                xmm[gi] = x[gi] - h
                let fp = barrier_eval_obj(f, c_ineq, n_ineq, &xpp, n, t)
                let fm = barrier_eval_obj(f, c_ineq, n_ineq, &xmm, n, t)
                let diff = fp - fm
                if co_abs(diff) < 1.0e300 {
                    gb[gi] = diff / (2.0 * h)
                } else {
                    gb[gi] = 0.0
                }
                gi = gi + 1
            }
            let gnorm = co_norminf(&gb, n)
            if gnorm < config.tol_opt {
                inner = 80
            } else {
                co_copy(&x, &!xprev, n)
                co_copy(&gb, &!gb_prev, n)
                if inner == 0 {
                    var di = 0
                    while di < n { db[di] = 0.0 - gb[di]; di = di + 1 }
                } else {
                    lbfgs_direction(&istate, &gb, &!db)
                }
                let ab = barrier_line_search(f, c_ineq, n_ineq,
                                             &x, &db, &gb, n, t)
                var ui = 0
                while ui < n { x[ui] = x[ui] + ab * db[ui]; ui = ui + 1 }

                // Recompute gradient for L-BFGS
                gi = 0
                while gi < n {
                    var j = 0
                    while j < n { xpp[j] = x[j]; xmm[j] = x[j]; j = j + 1 }
                    let h = cbrt_eps * co_max(co_abs(x[gi]), 1.0)
                    xpp[gi] = x[gi] + h
                    xmm[gi] = x[gi] - h
                    let fp2 = barrier_eval_obj(f, c_ineq, n_ineq, &xpp, n, t)
                    let fm2 = barrier_eval_obj(f, c_ineq, n_ineq, &xmm, n, t)
                    let diff2 = fp2 - fm2
                    if co_abs(diff2) < 1.0e300 {
                        gb[gi] = diff2 / (2.0 * h)
                    } else {
                        gb[gi] = 0.0
                    }
                    gi = gi + 1
                }
                var si = 0
                while si < n {
                    sb[si] = x[si] - xprev[si]
                    yb[si] = gb[si] - gb_prev[si]
                    si = si + 1
                }
                let syb = co_dot(&sb, &yb, n)
                if syb > 1.0e-16 { lbfgs_update(&!istate, &sb, &yb) }
                inner = inner + 1
            }
        }

        // Check duality gap: m/t
        let gap = (n_ineq as f64) / t
        if gap < config.tol_opt {
            c_ineq(&x, n, &!cv, n_ineq)
            var mv = 0.0
            i = 0
            while i < n_ineq {
                if cv[i] > 0.0 { if cv[i] > mv { mv = cv[i] } }
                i = i + 1
            }
            co_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = f(&x, n)
            result.constraint_viol = mv
            result.iterations = outer
            result.converged = true
            result.n_dim = n
            return
        }
        t = t * config.rho
        outer = outer + 1
    }

    c_ineq(&x, n, &!cv, n_ineq)
    var mv = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n_ineq {
        if cv[i] > 0.0 { if cv[i] > mv { mv = cv[i] } }
        i = i + 1
    }
    co_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = f(&x, n)
    result.constraint_viol = mv
    result.iterations = outer
    result.converged = false
    result.n_dim = n
}

// =============================================================================
// KKT violation analysis
// =============================================================================

// Compute max KKT violation for a constrained optimization solution.
// Checks: stationarity, primal feasibility (eq+ineq), dual feasibility, complementarity.
// jac_eq: n_eq x n row-major, jac_ineq: n_ineq x n row-major.
fn kkt_violation(grad_f_x: &[f64; 64],
                 jac_eq: &[f64; 4096], n_eq: i32,
                 jac_ineq: &[f64; 4096], n_ineq: i32,
                 lambda_eq: &[f64; 64], lambda_ineq: &[f64; 64],
                 c_eq_x: &[f64; 64], c_ineq_x: &[f64; 64],
                 n: i32) -> f64 with Panic, Mut, Div {
    // Stationarity: ||grad_f + J_eq^T*lam_eq + J_ineq^T*lam_ineq||_inf
    var stat: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var i = 0
    while i < n { stat[i] = grad_f_x[i]; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < n_eq {
        var j = 0
        while j < n { stat[j] = stat[j] + jac_eq[i * n + j] * lambda_eq[i]; j = j + 1 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    i = 0
    while i < n_ineq {
        var j = 0
        while j < n { stat[j] = stat[j] + jac_ineq[i * n + j] * lambda_ineq[i]; j = j + 1 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    var sv = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n { let v = co_abs(stat[i]); if v > sv { sv = v }; i = i + 1 }

    // Primal feasibility (equality): ||c_eq||_inf
    var ev = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n_eq { let v = co_abs(c_eq_x[i]); if v > ev { ev = v }; i = i + 1 }

    // Primal feasibility (inequality): max(0, c_ineq_j)
    var iv = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n_ineq {
        if c_ineq_x[i] > 0.0 { if c_ineq_x[i] > iv { iv = c_ineq_x[i] } }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Dual feasibility: lambda_ineq >= 0
    var dv = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n_ineq {
        if lambda_ineq[i] < 0.0 { let v = co_abs(lambda_ineq[i]); if v > dv { dv = v } }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Complementarity: |lambda_ineq_j * c_ineq_j|
    var cv = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n_ineq {
        let v = co_abs(lambda_ineq[i] * c_ineq_x[i])
        if v > cv { cv = v }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var mx = sv
    if ev > mx { mx = ev }
    if iv > mx { mx = iv }
    if dv > mx { mx = dv }
    if cv > mx { mx = cv }
    mx
}

// =============================================================================
// Default configuration and initialization
// =============================================================================

// Default: max_iter=100, tol_opt=1e-8, tol_feas=1e-8, mu_init=1.0, mu_max=1e8, rho=10.0
fn constrained_default_config(cfg: &!ConstrainedConfig) with Div, Panic, Mut {
    cfg.max_iter = 100
    cfg.tol_opt = 1.0e-8
    cfg.tol_feas = 1.0e-8
    cfg.mu_init = 1.0
    cfg.mu_max = 1.0e8
    cfg.rho = 10.0
}

fn constrained_init_result(res: &!ConstrainedResult) with Div, Panic, Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 64 { res.x[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    res.obj_val = 0.0
    res.constraint_viol = 0.0
    res.iterations = 0
    res.converged = false
    res.n_dim = 0
}


// === FILE: stdlib/math/convex.sio ===
// stdlib/math/convex.sio — Convex optimization and proximal methods
//
// Pure Sounio implementations:
//   Proximal operators (L1 soft-threshold, L2-ball, nonneg, box, simplex)
//   Forward-backward splitting (proximal gradient)
//   FISTA (Nesterov-accelerated O(1/k^2) convergence)
//   ADMM (consensus splitting)
//   LASSO (L1-regularized least squares)
//   Moreau envelope, adaptive backtracking
//
// References:
//   Boyd et al. (2011): "Distributed Optimization via ADMM"
//   Beck & Teboulle (2009): "A Fast Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding Algorithm"
//   Parikh & Boyd (2014): "Proximal Algorithms"

// =============================================================================
// Scalar helpers (cv_ prefix, self-contained)
// =============================================================================

fn cv_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }

fn cv_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }

fn cv_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }

fn cv_sign(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x > 0.0 { 1.0 }
    else if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - 1.0 }
    else { 0.0 }
}

fn cv_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 30 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

// =============================================================================
// Vector helpers (fixed-size [f64; 128])
// =============================================================================

// Dot product: sum a[i]*b[i] for i in 0..n
fn cv_dot(a: &[f64; 128], b: &[f64; 128], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var s = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n { s = s + a[i] * b[i]; i = i + 1 }
    s
}

// Euclidean norm: ||a||_2
fn cv_norm2(a: &[f64; 128], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n { s = s + a[i] * a[i]; i = i + 1 }
    cv_sqrt(s)
}

// AXPY: y[i] = y[i] + alpha * x[i]
fn cv_axpy(alpha: f64, x: &[f64; 128], y: &![f64; 128], n: i32) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < n { y[i] = y[i] + alpha * x[i]; i = i + 1 }
}

// Copy: dst[i] = src[i]
fn cv_copy(src: &[f64; 128], dst: &![f64; 128], n: i32) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < n { dst[i] = src[i]; i = i + 1 }
}

// Scale: x[i] = alpha * x[i]
fn cv_scale(alpha: f64, x: &![f64; 128], n: i32) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < n { x[i] = alpha * x[i]; i = i + 1 }
}

// Zero: dst[i] = 0
fn cv_zero(dst: &![f64; 128], n: i32) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < n { dst[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
}

// Infinity norm: max |a[i]|
fn cv_norminf(a: &[f64; 128], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var mx = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let v = cv_abs(a[i])
        if v > mx { mx = v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    mx
}

// =============================================================================
// Matrix-vector helpers (row-major flat arrays [f64; 16384])
// =============================================================================

// Matrix-vector product: y = A * x, where A is m-by-n row-major
// A stored as A[i*n + j], x is n-vector, y is m-vector
fn cv_matvec(A: &[f64; 16384], x: &[f64; 128], y: &![f64; 128],
             m: i32, n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        var s = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            s = s + A[i * n + j] * x[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        y[i] = s
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Transpose matrix-vector product: y = A^T * x, where A is m-by-n row-major
// A^T is n-by-m, so y is n-vector, x is m-vector
fn cv_mat_t_vec(A: &[f64; 16384], x: &[f64; 128], y: &![f64; 128],
                m: i32, n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var j = 0
    while j < n { y[j] = 0.0; j = j + 1 }
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        j = 0
        while j < n {
            y[j] = y[j] + A[i * n + j] * x[i]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Structs
// =============================================================================

struct ProxResult {
    x: [f64; 128],
    obj_val: f64,
    iterations: i32,
    converged: bool
}

struct ADMMResult {
    x: [f64; 128],
    z: [f64; 128],
    obj_val: f64,
    iterations: i32,
    converged: bool
}

struct LassoResult {
    x: [f64; 128],
    obj_val: f64,
    n_nonzero: i32,
    iterations: i32,
    converged: bool
}

// =============================================================================
// Initialization helpers
// =============================================================================

fn cv_init_prox_result(res: &!ProxResult) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 128 { res.x[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    res.obj_val = 0.0
    res.iterations = 0
    res.converged = false
}

fn cv_init_admm_result(res: &!ADMMResult) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 128 { res.x[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < 128 { res.z[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    res.obj_val = 0.0
    res.iterations = 0
    res.converged = false
}

fn cv_init_lasso_result(res: &!LassoResult) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < 128 { res.x[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    res.obj_val = 0.0
    res.n_nonzero = 0
    res.iterations = 0
    res.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// Proximal operators
// =============================================================================

// Proximal operator for L1 norm: prox_{lambda * ||.||_1}(x)
// Soft thresholding: out[i] = sign(x[i]) * max(|x[i]| - lambda, 0)
//
// This is the fundamental building block for sparse optimization.
// Reference: Parikh & Boyd (2014), Section 6.5.2
fn prox_l1(x: &[f64; 128], lambda: f64, n: i32,
           out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let ax = cv_abs(x[i])
        let shrunk = ax - lambda
        if shrunk > 0.0 {
            out[i] = cv_sign(x[i]) * shrunk
        } else {
            out[i] = 0.0
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Proximal operator for L2 ball constraint: projection onto {z: ||z||_2 <= radius}
// If ||x||_2 <= radius, out = x; otherwise out = x * (radius / ||x||_2)
//
// Reference: Parikh & Boyd (2014), Section 6.3.1
fn prox_l2_ball(x: &[f64; 128], radius: f64, n: i32,
                out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nrm = cv_norm2(x, n)
    if nrm <= radius {
        // Already inside the ball
        var i = 0
        while i < n { out[i] = x[i]; i = i + 1 }
    } else {
        // Project onto the ball boundary
        let scale = radius / nrm
        var i = 0
        while i < n { out[i] = x[i] * scale; i = i + 1 }
    }
}

// Proximal operator for nonnegative orthant: projection onto R+^n
// out[i] = max(x[i], 0)
//
// Reference: Parikh & Boyd (2014), Section 6.3
fn prox_nonneg(x: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
               out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        if x[i] > 0.0 {
            out[i] = x[i]
        } else {
            out[i] = 0.0
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Proximal operator for box constraints: projection onto [lower, upper]^n
// out[i] = clamp(x[i], lower[i], upper[i])
//
// Reference: Parikh & Boyd (2014), Section 6.3
fn prox_box(x: &[f64; 128], lower: &[f64; 128], upper: &[f64; 128],
            n: i32, out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        var v = x[i]
        if v < lower[i] { v = lower[i] }
        if v > upper[i] { v = upper[i] }
        out[i] = v
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Proximal operator for probability simplex: projection onto Delta_n
// {z: z >= 0, sum(z) = 1}
//
// Algorithm: Duchi et al. (2008) / Condat (2016) sort-based projection.
// Uses insertion sort since Sounio has no built-in sort.
//
// Steps:
//   1. Sort x in descending order into mu
//   2. Find rho = max{j : mu[j] - (1/j)(sum_{i=1}^j mu[i] - 1) > 0}
//   3. theta = (1/rho)(sum_{i=1}^rho mu[i] - 1)
//   4. out[i] = max(x[i] - theta, 0)
//
// Reference: Duchi et al. (2008): "Efficient Projections onto the l1-Ball"
fn prox_simplex(x: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
                out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Copy into working array for sorting
    var mu: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var i = 0
    while i < n { mu[i] = x[i]; i = i + 1 }

    // Insertion sort descending
    var k = 1
    while k < n {
        let key = mu[k]
        var j = k - 1
        while j >= 0 {
            if mu[j] < key {
                mu[j + 1] = mu[j]
                j = j - 1
            } else {
                j = 0 - 1  // break
            }
        }
        mu[j + 1] = key
        k = k + 1
    }

    // Find rho and compute theta
    var cumsum = 0.0
    var rho = 0
    var theta = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        cumsum = cumsum + mu[i]
        let t_cand = (cumsum - 1.0) / ((i + 1) as f64)
        if mu[i] - t_cand > 0.0 {
            rho = i + 1
            theta = t_cand
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Project
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let v = x[i] - theta
        if v > 0.0 {
            out[i] = v
        } else {
            out[i] = 0.0
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Proximal gradient method (forward-backward splitting)
// =============================================================================

// Proximal gradient descent: minimize f(x) + g(x)
//
// where f is smooth (we have grad_f) and g is non-smooth (we have prox_g).
//
// Iteration:
//   x_{k+1} = prox_{step * g}(x_k - step * grad_f(x_k))
//
// Convergence: O(1/k) for convex f + g.
//
// Parameters:
//   grad_f  — gradient of smooth part f
//   f_val   — evaluate f(x)
//   prox_g  — proximal operator of step*g (takes x, step, n, out)
//   g_val   — evaluate g(x)
//   x0      — initial point
//   n       — dimension
//   step_size — step size (should be <= 1/L where L = Lipschitz constant of grad_f)
//   max_iter — maximum iterations
//   tol     — convergence tolerance on ||x_{k+1} - x_k||_inf
//   result  — output
//
// Reference: Parikh & Boyd (2014), Section 4.2
fn proximal_gradient(
    grad_f: fn(&[f64; 128], i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    f_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    prox_g: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    g_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
    step_size: f64, max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
    result: &!ProxResult
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    cv_copy(x0, &!x, n)

    var grad: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_new: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad_step: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    var iter = 0
    while iter < max_iter {
        // Gradient step: grad_step = x - step * grad_f(x)
        grad_f(&x, n, &!grad)
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            grad_step[i] = x[i] - step_size * grad[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Proximal step: x_new = prox_{step*g}(grad_step)
        prox_g(&grad_step, step_size, n, &!x_new)

        // Check convergence: ||x_new - x||_inf < tol
        var diff_norm = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = cv_abs(x_new[i] - x[i])
            if d > diff_norm { diff_norm = d }
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Update x
        cv_copy(&x_new, &!x, n)

        if diff_norm < tol {
            cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
            result.iterations = iter + 1
            result.converged = true
            return
        }

        iter = iter + 1
    }

    // Did not converge
    cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
    result.iterations = max_iter
    result.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// FISTA (Fast Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding Algorithm)
// =============================================================================

// FISTA: accelerated proximal gradient with Nesterov momentum.
//
// Achieves O(1/k^2) convergence rate vs O(1/k) for vanilla proximal gradient.
//
// Iteration:
//   y_k = x_k + ((t_{k-1} - 1) / t_k) * (x_k - x_{k-1})
//   x_{k+1} = prox_{step * g}(y_k - step * grad_f(y_k))
//   t_{k+1} = (1 + sqrt(1 + 4*t_k^2)) / 2
//
// Reference: Beck & Teboulle (2009), "A Fast Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding
//   Algorithm for Linear Inverse Problems"
fn fista(
    grad_f: fn(&[f64; 128], i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    f_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    prox_g: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    g_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
    step_size: f64, max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
    result: &!ProxResult
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_prev: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var y: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_new: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad_step: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    cv_copy(x0, &!x, n)
    cv_copy(x0, &!x_prev, n)
    cv_copy(x0, &!y, n)

    var t = 1.0
    var iter = 0

    while iter < max_iter {
        // Gradient at y
        grad_f(&y, n, &!grad)

        // Gradient step: grad_step = y - step * grad_f(y)
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            grad_step[i] = y[i] - step_size * grad[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Proximal step: x_new = prox_{step*g}(grad_step)
        prox_g(&grad_step, step_size, n, &!x_new)

        // Check convergence: ||x_new - x||_inf < tol
        var diff_norm = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = cv_abs(x_new[i] - x[i])
            if d > diff_norm { diff_norm = d }
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Save x_prev = x, x = x_new
        cv_copy(&x, &!x_prev, n)
        cv_copy(&x_new, &!x, n)

        if diff_norm < tol {
            cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
            result.iterations = iter + 1
            result.converged = true
            return
        }

        // Nesterov momentum update
        let t_new = (1.0 + cv_sqrt(1.0 + 4.0 * t * t)) / 2.0
        let momentum = (t - 1.0) / t_new

        // y = x + momentum * (x - x_prev)
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            y[i] = x[i] + momentum * (x[i] - x_prev[i])
            i = i + 1
        }

        t = t_new
        iter = iter + 1
    }

    // Did not converge
    cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
    result.iterations = max_iter
    result.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// ADMM (Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers)
// =============================================================================

// ADMM for consensus splitting: minimize f(x) + g(z) subject to x = z
//
// Scaled form iterations:
//   x_{k+1} = prox_f(z_k - u_k)
//   z_{k+1} = prox_g(x_{k+1} + u_k)
//   u_{k+1} = u_k + x_{k+1} - z_{k+1}
//
// Convergence checked via primal and dual residuals:
//   r_k = ||x_{k+1} - z_{k+1}||_2  (primal)
//   s_k = rho * ||z_{k+1} - z_k||_2  (dual)
//
// Reference: Boyd et al. (2011), Section 3.1
fn admm(
    prox_f: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    prox_g: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
    rho: f64, max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
    result: &!ADMMResult
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var z: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var z_prev: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var u: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_hat: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var z_hat: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    cv_copy(x0, &!x, n)
    cv_copy(x0, &!z, n)
    cv_zero(&!u, n)

    let inv_rho = 1.0 / rho

    var iter = 0
    while iter < max_iter {
        cv_copy(&z, &!z_prev, n)

        // x-update: x = prox_{(1/rho)*f}(z - u)
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            x_hat[i] = z[i] - u[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        prox_f(&x_hat, inv_rho, n, &!x)

        // z-update: z = prox_{(1/rho)*g}(x + u)
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            z_hat[i] = x[i] + u[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        prox_g(&z_hat, inv_rho, n, &!z)

        // u-update (dual variable): u = u + x - z
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            u[i] = u[i] + x[i] - z[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Convergence check: primal and dual residuals
        // Primal residual: ||x - z||_2
        var primal_resid = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = x[i] - z[i]
            primal_resid = primal_resid + d * d
            i = i + 1
        }
        primal_resid = cv_sqrt(primal_resid)

        // Dual residual: rho * ||z - z_prev||_2
        var dual_resid = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = z[i] - z_prev[i]
            dual_resid = dual_resid + d * d
            i = i + 1
        }
        dual_resid = rho * cv_sqrt(dual_resid)

        if primal_resid < tol {
            if dual_resid < tol {
                cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
                cv_copy(&z, &!result.z, n)
                result.obj_val = 0.0
                result.iterations = iter + 1
                result.converged = true
                return
            }
        }

        iter = iter + 1
    }

    // Did not converge
    cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    cv_copy(&z, &!result.z, n)
    result.obj_val = 0.0
    result.iterations = max_iter
    result.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// LASSO helper: gradient of (1/2)||Ax - b||_2^2
// =============================================================================

// Compute gradient of the smooth part of LASSO: grad = A^T(Ax - b)
// Uses auxiliary workspace. A is m-by-n row-major in [f64; 16384].
fn cv_lasso_grad(A: &[f64; 16384], b: &[f64; 128],
                 x: &[f64; 128], m: i32, n: i32,
                 grad: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // residual = Ax - b
    var residual: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    cv_matvec(A, x, &!residual, m, n)
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        residual[i] = residual[i] - b[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    // grad = A^T * residual
    cv_mat_t_vec(A, &residual, grad, m, n)
}

// =============================================================================
// LASSO objective helpers
// =============================================================================

// Compute LASSO objective: (1/2)||Ax - b||_2^2 + lambda * ||x||_1
fn cv_objective_lasso(A: &[f64; 16384], b: &[f64; 128],
                      x: &[f64; 128], lambda: f64,
                      m: i32, n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // (1/2)||Ax - b||_2^2
    var residual: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    cv_matvec(A, x, &!residual, m, n)
    var sq_err = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        let r = residual[i] - b[i]
        sq_err = sq_err + r * r
        i = i + 1
    }

    // lambda * ||x||_1
    var l1 = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        l1 = l1 + cv_abs(x[i])
        i = i + 1
    }

    0.5 * sq_err + lambda * l1
}

// Count nonzero entries: |{i : |x[i]| > tol}|
fn cv_count_nonzero(x: &[f64; 128], n: i32, tol: f64) -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var count = 0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        if cv_abs(x[i]) > tol { count = count + 1 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    count
}

// =============================================================================
// Lipschitz constant estimation via power iteration
// =============================================================================

// Estimate the largest eigenvalue of A^T A via power iteration.
// This gives the Lipschitz constant L of grad f(x) = A^T(Ax - b).
// step_size = 1/L guarantees convergence of proximal gradient methods.
//
// Algorithm: start with random-ish vector v, iterate v <- A^T A v / ||A^T A v||
// and estimate lambda = v^T (A^T A v).
//
// Reference: Golub & Van Loan (2013), "Matrix Computations" Section 7.3
fn cv_lipschitz_estimate(A: &[f64; 16384], m: i32, n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Initialize v with a deterministic non-degenerate vector
    var v: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        // Use a simple sequence to avoid degeneracy
        v[i] = 1.0 / ((i + 1) as f64)
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Normalize v
    var nrm0 = 0.0
    {
        var ii = 0
        while ii < n { nrm0 = nrm0 + v[ii] * v[ii]; ii = ii + 1 }
    }
    // sqrt via Newton
    if nrm0 > 0.0 {
        var sq = nrm0
        var it = 0
        while it < 30 { sq = 0.5 * (sq + nrm0 / sq); it = it + 1 }
        nrm0 = sq
        cv_scale(1.0 / nrm0, &!v, n)
    }

    var Av: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var AtAv: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var lambda = 1.0

    // Power iteration: 50 iterations is more than enough for convergence
    var iter = 0
    while iter < 50 {
        // Av = A * v
        cv_matvec(A, &v, &!Av, m, n)

        // AtAv = A^T * Av
        cv_mat_t_vec(A, &Av, &!AtAv, m, n)

        // Estimate eigenvalue: lambda = v^T * (A^T A v)
        lambda = cv_dot(&v, &AtAv, n)

        // Normalize: v = AtAv / ||AtAv||
        let nrm = cv_norm2(&AtAv, n)
        if nrm < 1.0e-30 { return lambda }
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            v[i] = AtAv[i] / nrm
            i = i + 1
        }

        iter = iter + 1
    }

    lambda
}

// =============================================================================
// LASSO solver via FISTA
// =============================================================================

// LASSO: minimize (1/2)||Ax - b||_2^2 + lambda * ||x||_1
//
// Solved via FISTA (accelerated proximal gradient):
//   - Smooth part: f(x) = (1/2)||Ax - b||_2^2, grad_f(x) = A^T(Ax - b)
//   - Non-smooth part: g(x) = lambda * ||x||_1, prox = soft thresholding
//   - Step size: 1/L where L = ||A^T A|| (Lipschitz constant)
//
// Parameters:
//   A       — m-by-n design matrix (row-major, flat [f64; 16384])
//   b       — m-vector of observations
//   lambda  — regularization parameter (>0)
//   m, n    — matrix dimensions (m observations, n features)
//   max_iter — maximum FISTA iterations
//   tol     — convergence tolerance on ||x_{k+1} - x_k||_inf
//   result  — output (solution, objective, sparsity, iteration count)
//
// Reference: Beck & Teboulle (2009)
fn lasso(
    A: &[f64; 16384], b: &[f64; 128],
    lambda: f64, m: i32, n: i32,
    max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
    result: &!LassoResult
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Estimate Lipschitz constant for step size selection
    let L = cv_lipschitz_estimate(A, m, n)
    var step = 1.0 / L
    if step > 1.0 { step = 1.0 }
    if step < 1.0e-16 { step = 1.0e-4 }

    // Initialize iterates
    var x: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_prev: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var y: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad_step: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_new: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    var t = 1.0
    var iter = 0

    while iter < max_iter {
        // Gradient at y: grad = A^T(Ay - b)
        cv_lasso_grad(A, b, &y, m, n, &!grad)

        // Gradient step: grad_step = y - step * grad
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            grad_step[i] = y[i] - step * grad[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Proximal step: soft thresholding at step * lambda
        let threshold = step * lambda
        prox_l1(&grad_step, threshold, n, &!x_new)

        // Check convergence
        var diff_norm = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = cv_abs(x_new[i] - x[i])
            if d > diff_norm { diff_norm = d }
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Save x_prev = x, x = x_new
        cv_copy(&x, &!x_prev, n)
        cv_copy(&x_new, &!x, n)

        if diff_norm < tol {
            cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = cv_objective_lasso(A, b, &x, lambda, m, n)
            result.n_nonzero = cv_count_nonzero(&x, n, 1.0e-10)
            result.iterations = iter + 1
            result.converged = true
            return
        }

        // Nesterov momentum update
        let t_new = (1.0 + cv_sqrt(1.0 + 4.0 * t * t)) / 2.0
        let momentum = (t - 1.0) / t_new

        // y = x + momentum * (x - x_prev)
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            y[i] = x[i] + momentum * (x[i] - x_prev[i])
            i = i + 1
        }

        t = t_new
        iter = iter + 1
    }

    // Did not converge
    cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = cv_objective_lasso(A, b, &x, lambda, m, n)
    result.n_nonzero = cv_count_nonzero(&x, n, 1.0e-10)
    result.iterations = max_iter
    result.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// Moreau envelope
// =============================================================================

// Moreau envelope of f at x with parameter gamma:
//   M_gamma(f)(x) = min_y { f(y) + (1/(2*gamma)) * ||y - x||_2^2 }
//
// Computed as: M_gamma(f)(x) = f(prox_{gamma*f}(x)) + (1/(2*gamma)) * ||prox_{gamma*f}(x) - x||_2^2
//
// The Moreau envelope is a smooth approximation of f (even when f is non-smooth).
// It has the same minimizers as f, and its gradient is (1/gamma)(x - prox_{gamma*f}(x)).
//
// Reference: Parikh & Boyd (2014), Section 2.2
fn moreau_envelope(
    prox_f: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    f_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x: &[f64; 128], gamma: f64, n: i32
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Compute proximal point
    var p: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    prox_f(x, gamma, n, &!p)

    // f(prox(x))
    let fval = f_val(&p, n)

    // (1/(2*gamma)) * ||prox(x) - x||_2^2
    var dist_sq = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let d = p[i] - x[i]
        dist_sq = dist_sq + d * d
        i = i + 1
    }

    fval + dist_sq / (2.0 * gamma)
}

// =============================================================================
// Backtracking line search for proximal gradient
// =============================================================================

// Adaptive backtracking for proximal gradient step size selection.
//
// Finds the largest step s in {step * beta^k : k=0,1,...} such that
//   f(prox_step) <= f(x) + grad^T(prox_step - x) + (1/(2*s))||prox_step - x||^2
//
// This is the sufficient decrease condition for proximal gradient methods.
//
// Reference: Beck & Teboulle (2009), Algorithm with backtracking (FISTA-BT)
fn cv_backtrack_proxgrad(
    grad_f: fn(&[f64; 128], i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    f_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    prox_g: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
    step_init: f64, beta: f64
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var grad: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    grad_f(x, n, &!grad)
    let fx = f_val(x, n)

    var step = step_init
    var grad_step: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var p: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    var k = 0
    while k < 40 {
        // grad_step = x - step * grad
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            grad_step[i] = x[i] - step * grad[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // p = prox_{step*g}(grad_step)
        prox_g(&grad_step, step, n, &!p)

        // Check sufficient decrease
        let fp = f_val(&p, n)

        // Q_step(p, x) = f(x) + grad^T(p - x) + (1/(2*step))||p - x||^2
        var grad_inner = 0.0
        var dist_sq = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = p[i] - x[i]
            grad_inner = grad_inner + grad[i] * d
            dist_sq = dist_sq + d * d
            i = i + 1
        }
        let quad_upper = fx + grad_inner + dist_sq / (2.0 * step)

        if fp <= quad_upper + 1.0e-14 {
            return step
        }

        step = step * beta
        if step < 1.0e-20 { return 1.0e-20 }

        k = k + 1
    }

    step
}

// =============================================================================
// FISTA with backtracking (FISTA-BT)
// =============================================================================

// FISTA with adaptive backtracking line search.
//
// Same as fista() but automatically selects the step size at each iteration
// using the sufficient decrease condition. No need to know the Lipschitz
// constant in advance.
//
// Reference: Beck & Teboulle (2009), Algorithm 2 (FISTA with backtracking)
fn fista_backtrack(
    grad_f: fn(&[f64; 128], i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    f_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    prox_g: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    g_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
    step_init: f64, beta: f64,
    max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
    result: &!ProxResult
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_prev: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var y: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad_step: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_new: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    cv_copy(x0, &!x, n)
    cv_copy(x0, &!x_prev, n)
    cv_copy(x0, &!y, n)

    var t = 1.0
    var step = step_init

    var iter = 0
    while iter < max_iter {
        // Backtracking: find step size at y
        step = cv_backtrack_proxgrad(grad_f, f_val, prox_g, &y, n, step, beta)

        // Gradient at y
        grad_f(&y, n, &!grad)

        // Gradient step
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            grad_step[i] = y[i] - step * grad[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Proximal step
        prox_g(&grad_step, step, n, &!x_new)

        // Check convergence
        var diff_norm = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = cv_abs(x_new[i] - x[i])
            if d > diff_norm { diff_norm = d }
            i = i + 1
        }

        cv_copy(&x, &!x_prev, n)
        cv_copy(&x_new, &!x, n)

        if diff_norm < tol {
            cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
            result.iterations = iter + 1
            result.converged = true
            return
        }

        // Nesterov momentum
        let t_new = (1.0 + cv_sqrt(1.0 + 4.0 * t * t)) / 2.0
        let momentum = (t - 1.0) / t_new

        i = 0
        while i < n {
            y[i] = x[i] + momentum * (x[i] - x_prev[i])
            i = i + 1
        }

        t = t_new
        // Allow step to grow slightly for next iteration
        step = step / beta
        iter = iter + 1
    }

    cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
    result.iterations = max_iter
    result.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// Proximal gradient with adaptive restart
// =============================================================================

// FISTA with gradient-based restart (O'Donoghue & Candes, 2015).
//
// Restarts the Nesterov sequence when the gradient-momentum angle criterion
// detects that momentum is not helping:
//   restart when grad_f(x_k)^T (x_k - x_{k-1}) > 0
//
// This prevents oscillation and can dramatically speed up convergence near
// the optimum.
//
// Reference: O'Donoghue & Candes (2015): "Adaptive Restart for Accelerated
//   Gradient Schemes"
fn fista_restart(
    grad_f: fn(&[f64; 128], i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    f_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    prox_g: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    g_val: fn(&[f64; 128], i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
    step_size: f64, max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
    result: &!ProxResult
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var x: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_prev: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var y: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var grad_step: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_new: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var diff_vec: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    cv_copy(x0, &!x, n)
    cv_copy(x0, &!x_prev, n)
    cv_copy(x0, &!y, n)

    var t = 1.0
    var iter = 0

    while iter < max_iter {
        // Gradient at y
        grad_f(&y, n, &!grad)

        // Gradient step
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            grad_step[i] = y[i] - step_size * grad[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Proximal step
        prox_g(&grad_step, step_size, n, &!x_new)

        // Check convergence
        var diff_norm = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let d = cv_abs(x_new[i] - x[i])
            if d > diff_norm { diff_norm = d }
            i = i + 1
        }

        cv_copy(&x, &!x_prev, n)
        cv_copy(&x_new, &!x, n)

        if diff_norm < tol {
            cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
            result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
            result.iterations = iter + 1
            result.converged = true
            return
        }

        // Restart criterion: grad_f(x)^T (x - x_prev) > 0
        grad_f(&x, n, &!grad)
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            diff_vec[i] = x[i] - x_prev[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        let restart_crit = cv_dot(&grad, &diff_vec, n)

        if restart_crit > 0.0 {
            // Restart: reset momentum
            t = 1.0
            cv_copy(&x, &!y, n)
        } else {
            // Nesterov momentum
            let t_new = (1.0 + cv_sqrt(1.0 + 4.0 * t * t)) / 2.0
            let momentum = (t - 1.0) / t_new
            i = 0
            while i < n {
                y[i] = x[i] + momentum * (x[i] - x_prev[i])
                i = i + 1
            }
            t = t_new
        }

        iter = iter + 1
    }

    cv_copy(&x, &!result.x, n)
    result.obj_val = f_val(&x, n) + g_val(&x, n)
    result.iterations = max_iter
    result.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// Douglas-Rachford splitting
// =============================================================================

// Douglas-Rachford splitting: find x in fix(R_g R_f) where R_f = 2*prox_f - I
//
// Iteration:
//   x_hat = prox_f(z_k)
//   z_{k+1} = z_k + prox_g(2*x_hat - z_k) - x_hat
//
// Converges for any two closed proper convex functions f, g.
// The fixed point z* gives x* = prox_f(z*).
//
// Reference: Eckstein & Bertsekas (1992); Parikh & Boyd (2014) Section 4.3
fn douglas_rachford(
    prox_f: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    prox_g: fn(&[f64; 128], f64, i32, &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    z0: &[f64; 128], n: i32,
    gamma: f64, max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
    result: &!ProxResult
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var z: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var x_hat: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var reflect: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var g_prox: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]

    cv_copy(z0, &!z, n)

    var iter = 0
    while iter < max_iter {
        // x_hat = prox_{gamma*f}(z)
        prox_f(&z, gamma, n, &!x_hat)

        // reflect = 2*x_hat - z
        var i = 0
        while i < n {
            reflect[i] = 2.0 * x_hat[i] - z[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        // g_prox = prox_{gamma*g}(reflect)
        prox_g(&reflect, gamma, n, &!g_prox)

        // z_new = z + g_prox - x_hat
        var diff_norm = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            let z_new = z[i] + g_prox[i] - x_hat[i]
            let d = cv_abs(z_new - z[i])
            if d > diff_norm { diff_norm = d }
            z[i] = z_new
            i = i + 1
        }

        if diff_norm < tol {
            // Return x_hat = prox_f(z) as the solution
            prox_f(&z, gamma, n, &!result.x)
            result.obj_val = 0.0
            result.iterations = iter + 1
            result.converged = true
            return
        }

        iter = iter + 1
    }

    // Return best x = prox_f(z)
    prox_f(&z, gamma, n, &!result.x)
    result.obj_val = 0.0
    result.iterations = max_iter
    result.converged = false
}

// =============================================================================
// Elastic net (L1 + L2 regularization)
// =============================================================================

// Elastic net proximal operator: prox_{lambda1 * ||.||_1 + lambda2 * ||.||_2^2}(x)
// = soft_threshold(x, lambda1) / (1 + 2*lambda2)
//
// Combines L1 sparsity with L2 grouping effect.
// Reference: Zou & Hastie (2005): "Regularization and Variable Selection via
//   the Elastic Net"
fn prox_elastic_net(x: &[f64; 128], lambda1: f64, lambda2: f64,
                    n: i32, out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let denom = 1.0 + 2.0 * lambda2
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let ax = cv_abs(x[i])
        let shrunk = ax - lambda1
        if shrunk > 0.0 {
            out[i] = cv_sign(x[i]) * shrunk / denom
        } else {
            out[i] = 0.0
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Proximal operator for group LASSO (L1/L2 norm)
// =============================================================================

// Group LASSO proximal: prox_{lambda * ||.||_2}(x)
// Block soft-thresholding: if ||x|| > lambda, out = (1 - lambda/||x||) * x, else 0
//
// Reference: Yuan & Lin (2006): "Model selection and estimation in regression
//   with grouped variables"
fn prox_group_l1l2(x: &[f64; 128], lambda: f64, n: i32,
                   out: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nrm = cv_norm2(x, n)
    if nrm <= lambda {
        var i = 0
        while i < n { out[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    } else {
        let scale = 1.0 - lambda / nrm
        var i = 0
        while i < n { out[i] = scale * x[i]; i = i + 1 }
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Duality gap computation for LASSO
// =============================================================================

// Compute the duality gap for LASSO: gap = primal_obj - dual_obj.
//
// Primal: (1/2)||Ax-b||^2 + lambda*||x||_1
// Dual:   -(1/2)||b||^2 + (1/2)||b - nu||^2  where nu = b - Ax, scaled
//
// The duality gap provides a certificate of epsilon-optimality.
// Reference: Boyd et al. (2011), Section 3.3.1
fn cv_lasso_duality_gap(A: &[f64; 16384], b: &[f64; 128],
                        x: &[f64; 128], lambda: f64,
                        m: i32, n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Compute residual: r = Ax - b
    var r: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    cv_matvec(A, x, &!r, m, n)
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        r[i] = r[i] - b[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Primal objective
    var r_sq = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < m { r_sq = r_sq + r[i] * r[i]; i = i + 1 }
    var l1_norm = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n { l1_norm = l1_norm + cv_abs(x[i]); i = i + 1 }
    let primal = 0.5 * r_sq + lambda * l1_norm

    // Dual feasible point: nu = -r / max(lambda, ||A^T r||_inf)
    var Atr: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    cv_mat_t_vec(A, &r, &!Atr, m, n)
    var Atr_inf = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let v = cv_abs(Atr[i])
        if v > Atr_inf { Atr_inf = v }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var scale_factor = 1.0
    if Atr_inf > lambda {
        scale_factor = lambda / Atr_inf
    }

    // Dual objective: -(1/2)||scale*r||^2 + scale*r^T b
    var dual = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < m {
        let sr = scale_factor * r[i]
        dual = dual - 0.5 * sr * sr + sr * b[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Correct dual: dual = (1/2)||b||^2 - (1/2)||b + scale*r||^2
    // Simplified: gap = primal - dual
    let gap = primal - dual
    if gap < 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    gap
}
