// == ga/base preamble inlined ==
// stdlib::math::ga::base — Self-contained Geometric Algebra foundation
//
// Implements Clifford algebras Cl(p,q,r) up to 5 dimensions (2^5 = 32 blades).
// Reference: Dorst, Fontijne, Mann — "Geometric Algebra for Computer Science"
//
// Basis blades are indexed by bitmap:
//   0 = scalar, 1 = e1, 2 = e2, 3 = e12, 4 = e3, 5 = e13, 6 = e23, 7 = e123, ...
// The coefficient of blade i is stored at coeffs[i].

// ============================================================================
// Algebra signature
// ============================================================================

struct AlgebraSignature {
    p: i64,       // positive basis vectors (e_i^2 = +1)
    q: i64,       // negative basis vectors (e_j^2 = -1)
    r: i64        // degenerate basis vectors (e_k^2 = 0)
}

// ============================================================================
// Multivector
// ============================================================================

struct Multivector {
    coeffs: [f64; 32],
    n_coeffs: i64
}

// ============================================================================
// Bit manipulation helpers (must precede callers)
// ============================================================================

fn ga_popcount(x: i64) -> i64 {
    var count: i64 = 0
    var v: i64 = x
    while v > 0 {
        count = count + (v % 2)
        v = v / 2
    }
    count
}

fn ga_grade(blade: i64) -> i64 {
    ga_popcount(blade)
}

fn ga_bit(n: i64) -> i64 {
    var result: i64 = 1
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        result = result * 2
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

fn ga_has_bit(mask: i64, bit: i64) -> bool {
    (mask / ga_bit(bit)) % 2 == 1
}

// ============================================================================
// Metric helpers
// ============================================================================

fn ga_dim(sig: AlgebraSignature) -> i64 {
    sig.p + sig.q + sig.r
}

fn ga_algebra_dim(sig: AlgebraSignature) -> i64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result: i64 = 1
    var i: i64 = 0
    let d = ga_dim(sig)
    while i < d {
        result = result * 2
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// Metric factor for basis vector e_i squaring with itself.
// In Cl(p,q,r): first p vectors square to +1, next q to -1, next r to 0.
fn ga_metric_factor(sig: AlgebraSignature, vector_index: i64) -> i64 {
    if vector_index < sig.p {
        1
    } else if vector_index < sig.p + sig.q {
        0 - 1
    } else {
        0
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Common signatures
// ============================================================================

fn ga_sig_euclidean3d() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 3, q: 0, r: 0 }
}

fn ga_sig_pga3d() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 3, q: 0, r: 1 }
}

fn ga_sig_cga() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 4, q: 1, r: 0 }
}

fn ga_sig_quaternion() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 0, q: 2, r: 0 }
}

// ============================================================================
// Constructors
// ============================================================================

fn ga_zero() -> Multivector {
    Multivector { coeffs: [0.0; 32], n_coeffs: 32 }
}

fn ga_scalar(v: f64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var mv = ga_zero()
    mv.coeffs[0 as usize] = v
    mv
}

fn ga_basis(i: i64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var mv = ga_zero()
    if i >= 0 && i < 32 {
        mv.coeffs[i as usize] = 1.0
    }
    mv
}

// ============================================================================
// Component access
// ============================================================================

fn ga_get(mv: Multivector, index: i64) -> f64 {
    if index >= 0 && index < 32 {
        mv.coeffs[index as usize]
    } else {
        0.0
    }
}

fn ga_set(mv: &! Multivector, index: i64, value: f64) with Panic, Div, Mut {
    if index >= 0 && index < 32 {
        mv.coeffs[index as usize] = value
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// THE CORE: Blade product sign computation
// ============================================================================

// Count transpositions needed to sort the combined blade a*b into canonical order.
// Uses the standard algorithm: for each set bit j in b, count how many set bits
// in a are at positions above j. This gives the number of anticommutation swaps.
fn ga_canonical_reorder_sign(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var sum: i64 = 0
    // For each bit position j in b, count bits in a above position j.
    // Equivalent: shift a right, AND with b, popcount — summed over shifts.
    var i: i64 = a / 2   // a >> 1
    while i > 0 {
        sum = sum + ga_popcount(i & b)
        i = i / 2
    }
    if sum % 2 == 0 { 1 } else { 0 - 1 }
}

// Full blade product sign including metric.
// Algorithm:
//   1. Compute anticommutation sign from reordering
//   2. For each shared basis vector (in a AND b):
//      - If that vector has degenerate metric (r-type), return 0
//      - If that vector has negative metric (q-type), flip sign
//   3. Return final sign: +1, -1, or 0
fn ga_blade_product_sign(a: i64, b: i64, sig: AlgebraSignature) -> i64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var sign = ga_canonical_reorder_sign(a, b)

    let shared = a & b
    let dim = ga_dim(sig)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < dim {
        if ga_has_bit(shared, i) {
            let mf = ga_metric_factor(sig, i)
            if mf == 0 {
                return 0
            }
            sign = sign * mf
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    sign
}

// ============================================================================
// Geometric product — the fundamental operation
// ============================================================================
// For each pair of basis blades (i, j):
//   result[i XOR j] += coeffs[i] * coeffs[j] * blade_product_sign(i, j, sig)

fn ga_geometric_product(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        if a.coeffs[i as usize] != 0.0 {
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n {
                if b.coeffs[j as usize] != 0.0 {
                    let sign = ga_blade_product_sign(i, j, sig)
                    if sign != 0 {
                        let result_blade = i ^ j
                        let coeff = a.coeffs[i as usize] * b.coeffs[j as usize] * (sign as f64)
                        result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] = result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] + coeff
                    }
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Outer (wedge) product
// ============================================================================
// Keep only terms where grade(result_blade) == grade(a_blade) + grade(b_blade)

fn ga_outer_product(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        if a.coeffs[i as usize] != 0.0 {
            let ga = ga_grade(i)
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n {
                if b.coeffs[j as usize] != 0.0 {
                    let gb = ga_grade(j)
                    let result_blade = i ^ j
                    let gr = ga_grade(result_blade)
                    if gr == ga + gb {
                        let sign = ga_canonical_reorder_sign(i, j)
                        let coeff = a.coeffs[i as usize] * b.coeffs[j as usize] * (sign as f64)
                        result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] = result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] + coeff
                    }
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Inner product (left contraction)
// ============================================================================
// Keep only terms where grade(result_blade) == |grade(a_blade) - grade(b_blade)|

fn ga_inner_product(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        if a.coeffs[i as usize] != 0.0 {
            let ga = ga_grade(i)
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n {
                if b.coeffs[j as usize] != 0.0 {
                    let gb = ga_grade(j)
                    let result_blade = i ^ j
                    let gr = ga_grade(result_blade)
                    let target = if ga > gb { ga - gb } else { gb - ga }
                    if gr == target && (ga > 0 || gb > 0) {
                        let sign = ga_blade_product_sign(i, j, sig)
                        if sign != 0 {
                            let coeff = a.coeffs[i as usize] * b.coeffs[j as usize] * (sign as f64)
                            result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] = result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] + coeff
                        }
                    }
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Reverse: reverses order of basis vectors in each blade
// ============================================================================
// For a grade-k blade: sign = (-1)^(k*(k-1)/2)
// grade 0: +1, grade 1: +1, grade 2: -1, grade 3: -1, grade 4: +1, ...

fn ga_reverse(a: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        let k = ga_grade(i)
        let exp = (k * (k - 1)) / 2
        let sign = if exp % 2 == 0 { 1.0 } else { 0.0 - 1.0 }
        result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize] * sign
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Grade selection
// ============================================================================

fn ga_grade_select(a: Multivector, grade: i64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        if ga_grade(i) == grade {
            result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize]
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Arithmetic
// ============================================================================

fn ga_add(a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize] + b.coeffs[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

fn ga_sub(a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize] - b.coeffs[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

fn ga_scale(a: Multivector, s: f64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize] * s
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Norm squared: scalar part of a * reverse(a)
// ============================================================================

fn ga_norm_squared(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector) -> f64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let rev_a = ga_reverse(a)
    let product = ga_geometric_product(sig, a, rev_a)
    product.coeffs[0 as usize]
}

// ============================================================================
// Dual: multiply by pseudoscalar
// ============================================================================

fn ga_dual(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)
    // Pseudoscalar index = 2^dim - 1 (all bits set)
    let ps_idx = n - 1
    let ps = ga_basis(ps_idx)
    let ps_rev = ga_reverse(ps)
    ga_geometric_product(sig, a, ps_rev)
}

// ============================================================================
// Helper: approximate equality for tests
// ============================================================================

fn ga_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn ga_approx_eq(a: f64, b: f64) -> bool {
    ga_abs(a - b) < 0.000001
}

// ============================================================================
// Inline tests
// ============================================================================

// Test 1: Geometric product of two vectors in R^3 gives scalar + bivector
// e1 * e2 = e12 (bivector), so product should have coeffs[3] = 1.0
fn test_vector_product_r3() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)   // e1 = bitmap 0b01
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)   // e2 = bitmap 0b10
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, e1, e2)
    // e1 * e2 = e12 (blade index 3 = 0b11), coefficient should be +1
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[3 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 2: e1*e1 = +1 in Euclidean 3D
fn test_e1_squared_euclidean() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, e1, e1)
    // e1^2 = +1 (scalar), so coeffs[0] = 1.0
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 3: Quaternion algebra Cl(0,2): e1*e2 product
// In Cl(0,2): e1^2 = -1, e2^2 = -1
// e1*e2 = e12 (blade 3)
fn test_quaternion_e1e2() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_quaternion()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, e1, e2)
    // e1*e2 = e12
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[3 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 4: Quaternion i*j=k, j*k=i, k*i=j
// In Cl(0,2): i=e1, j=e2, k=e12
// i*j = e1*e2 = e12 = k  => coeffs[3] = 1.0
fn test_quaternion_ijk() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_quaternion()
    let i_q = ga_basis(1)   // e1
    let j_q = ga_basis(2)   // e2
    let k_q = ga_basis(3)   // e12

    // i*j = k
    let ij = ga_geometric_product(sig, i_q, j_q)
    let ij_ok = ga_approx_eq(ij.coeffs[3 as usize], 1.0)

    // j*k = e2*e12
    // canonical_reorder_sign(2, 3): a=2=0b10, b=3=0b11
    //   i = a/2 = 1 = 0b01, popcount(1 & 3) = popcount(1) = 1, sum=1
    //   i = 1/2 = 0, stop. sign = -1
    // shared = 2 & 3 = 2 = 0b10, bit 1 set => metric_factor(sig, 1) = -1
    // total sign = (-1)*(-1) = +1
    // result blade = 2 ^ 3 = 1 (e1)
    // So j*k = +e1 = i
    let jk = ga_geometric_product(sig, j_q, k_q)
    let jk_ok = ga_approx_eq(jk.coeffs[1 as usize], 1.0)

    // k*i = e12*e1
    // canonical_reorder_sign(3, 1): a=3=0b11, b=1=0b01
    //   i = 3/2 = 1 = 0b01, popcount(1 & 1) = 1, sum=1
    //   i = 1/2 = 0, stop. sign = -1
    // shared = 3 & 1 = 1 = 0b01, bit 0 set => metric_factor(sig, 0) = -1
    // total sign = (-1)*(-1) = +1
    // result blade = 3 ^ 1 = 2 (e2)
    // So k*i = +e2 = j
    let ki = ga_geometric_product(sig, k_q, i_q)
    let ki_ok = ga_approx_eq(ki.coeffs[2 as usize], 1.0)

    ij_ok && jk_ok && ki_ok
}

// Test 5: Reverse of a bivector negates it
// reverse(e12) = e21 = -e12
fn test_reverse_bivector() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let bv = ga_basis(3)   // e12
    let rev = ga_reverse(bv)
    // grade 2: sign = (-1)^(2*1/2) = (-1)^1 = -1
    ga_approx_eq(rev.coeffs[3 as usize], 0.0 - 1.0)
}

// Test 6: Reverse of a vector leaves it unchanged
fn test_reverse_vector() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let v = ga_basis(1)   // e1
    let rev = ga_reverse(v)
    // grade 1: sign = (-1)^(1*0/2) = (-1)^0 = +1
    ga_approx_eq(rev.coeffs[1 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 7: Norm squared of unit vector e1 in Euclidean 3D = +1
fn test_norm_squared_euclidean() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let ns = ga_norm_squared(sig, e1)
    ga_approx_eq(ns, 1.0)
}

// Test 8: Norm squared of e1 in Cl(0,2) (quaternion) = -1
// e1^2 = -1, reverse(e1) = e1, so e1 * reverse(e1) = e1*e1 = -1
fn test_norm_squared_negative() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_quaternion()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let ns = ga_norm_squared(sig, e1)
    ga_approx_eq(ns, 0.0 - 1.0)
}

// Test 9: Outer product of e1 and e2 gives e12
fn test_outer_product() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)
    let result = ga_outer_product(sig, e1, e2)
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[3 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 10: Outer product of e1 with itself is zero (e1 ^ e1 = 0)
fn test_outer_product_self_zero() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let result = ga_outer_product(sig, e1, e1)
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0) && ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[1 as usize], 0.0)
}

// Test 11: Inner product of two orthogonal vectors is zero
fn test_inner_product_orthogonal() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)
    let result = ga_inner_product(sig, e1, e2)
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0)
}

// Test 12: Inner product e1 . e1 = 1 in Euclidean space
fn test_inner_product_same() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let result = ga_inner_product(sig, e1, e1)
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 13: Grade selection extracts correct grade
fn test_grade_select() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)
    // v = e1 + e2 (pure grade-1)
    let v = ga_add(e1, e2)
    // Add a scalar part: mv = 3.0 + e1 + e2
    let s = ga_scalar(3.0)
    let mv = ga_add(s, v)
    // Extract grade 0
    let g0 = ga_grade_select(mv, 0)
    let g0_ok = ga_approx_eq(g0.coeffs[0 as usize], 3.0)
    // Extract grade 1
    let g1 = ga_grade_select(mv, 1)
    let g1_ok = ga_approx_eq(g1.coeffs[1 as usize], 1.0) && ga_approx_eq(g1.coeffs[2 as usize], 1.0)
    g0_ok && g1_ok
}

// Test 14: Geometric product of vectors gives scalar + bivector
// (ae1 + be2) * (ce1 + de2) = ac*e1e1 + ad*e1e2 + bc*e2e1 + bd*e2e2
//                            = (ac + bd)*1 + (ad - bc)*e12
fn test_vector_product_components() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    // v1 = 2*e1 + 3*e2
    var v1 = ga_zero()
    v1.coeffs[1 as usize] = 2.0
    v1.coeffs[2 as usize] = 3.0
    // v2 = 4*e1 + 5*e2
    var v2 = ga_zero()
    v2.coeffs[1 as usize] = 4.0
    v2.coeffs[2 as usize] = 5.0
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, v1, v2)
    // scalar part = 2*4 + 3*5 = 8 + 15 = 23
    let scalar_ok = ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 23.0)
    // bivector e12 part = 2*5 - 3*4 = 10 - 12 = -2
    let bv_ok = ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[3 as usize], 0.0 - 2.0)
    scalar_ok && bv_ok
}

// Test 15: Degenerate metric — e0^2 = 0 in PGA
fn test_degenerate_pga() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_pga3d()  // Cl(3,0,1): e1^2=1, e2^2=1, e3^2=1, e4^2=0
    // e4 is the degenerate basis vector (index 3, bitmap 8 = 2^3)
    let e4 = ga_basis(8)   // bitmap 0b1000
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, e4, e4)
    // e4^2 = 0
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0)
}

// Test 16: Popcount correctness
fn test_popcount() -> bool {
    ga_popcount(0) == 0 &&
    ga_popcount(1) == 1 &&
    ga_popcount(3) == 2 &&
    ga_popcount(7) == 3 &&
    ga_popcount(15) == 4 &&
    ga_popcount(31) == 5
}

// Test 17: Algebra dimensions
fn test_algebra_dim() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig3 = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let sig4 = ga_sig_pga3d()
    let sig5 = ga_sig_cga()
    ga_dim(sig3) == 3 && ga_algebra_dim(sig3) == 8 &&
    ga_dim(sig4) == 4 && ga_algebra_dim(sig4) == 16 &&
    ga_dim(sig5) == 5 && ga_algebra_dim(sig5) == 32
}

// Test 18: Add and subtract
fn test_add_sub() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let a = ga_scalar(5.0)
    let b = ga_scalar(3.0)
    let sum = ga_add(a, b)
    let diff = ga_sub(a, b)
    ga_approx_eq(sum.coeffs[0 as usize], 8.0) && ga_approx_eq(diff.coeffs[0 as usize], 2.0)
}

// Test 19: Scale
fn test_scale() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let scaled = ga_scale(e1, 7.0)
    ga_approx_eq(scaled.coeffs[1 as usize], 7.0)
}

// Test 20: Quaternion i^2 = j^2 = k^2 = -1
fn test_quaternion_squares() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_quaternion()
    let i_q = ga_basis(1)
    let j_q = ga_basis(2)
    let k_q = ga_basis(3)

    let i2 = ga_geometric_product(sig, i_q, i_q)
    let j2 = ga_geometric_product(sig, j_q, j_q)
    let k2 = ga_geometric_product(sig, k_q, k_q)

    // i^2 = e1^2 = -1
    let i2_ok = ga_approx_eq(i2.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0 - 1.0)
    // j^2 = e2^2 = -1
    let j2_ok = ga_approx_eq(j2.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0 - 1.0)
    // k^2 = e12^2 = e1*e2*e1*e2 = -e1*e1*e2*e2 = -(-1)(-1) = -1
    let k2_ok = ga_approx_eq(k2.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0 - 1.0)

    i2_ok && j2_ok && k2_ok
}


// == PGA module: Projective Geometric Algebra Cl(3,0,1) ==
// Uses base.sio Multivector (coeffs[32], n_coeffs)

fn pga_point(x: f64, y: f64, z: f64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var mv = ga_zero()
    mv.coeffs[13 as usize] = x       // e032
    mv.coeffs[11 as usize] = y       // e013
    mv.coeffs[7 as usize] = z        // e021
    mv.coeffs[14 as usize] = 1.0     // e123
    mv
}

fn pga_plane(a: f64, b: f64, c: f64, d: f64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var mv = ga_zero()
    mv.coeffs[1 as usize] = d       // e0
    mv.coeffs[2 as usize] = a       // e1
    mv.coeffs[4 as usize] = b       // e2
    mv.coeffs[8 as usize] = c       // e3
    mv
}

fn pga_identity_motor() -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var mv = ga_zero()
    mv.coeffs[0 as usize] = 1.0
    mv
}

fn pga_line(e01: f64, e02: f64, e03: f64, e12: f64, e13: f64, e23: f64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var mv = ga_zero()
    mv.coeffs[3 as usize] = e01
    mv.coeffs[5 as usize] = e02
    mv.coeffs[9 as usize] = e03
    mv.coeffs[6 as usize] = e12
    mv.coeffs[10 as usize] = e13
    mv.coeffs[12 as usize] = e23
    mv
}

fn pga_join(a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_pga3d()
    ga_outer_product(sig, a, b)
}

fn pga_meet(a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_pga3d()
    let da = ga_dual(sig, a)
    let db = ga_dual(sig, b)
    let outer = ga_outer_product(sig, da, db)
    ga_dual(sig, outer)
}

fn pga_sandwich(motor: Multivector, x: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_pga3d()
    let rev = ga_reverse(motor)
    let mx = ga_geometric_product(sig, motor, x)
    ga_geometric_product(sig, mx, rev)
}

fn pga_normalize_point(p: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let w = p.coeffs[14 as usize]
    var result = ga_zero()
    if w == 0.0 {
        result.coeffs[13 as usize] = p.coeffs[13 as usize]
        result.coeffs[11 as usize] = p.coeffs[11 as usize]
        result.coeffs[7 as usize] = p.coeffs[7 as usize]
        result.coeffs[14 as usize] = 0.0
    } else {
        result.coeffs[13 as usize] = p.coeffs[13 as usize] / w
        result.coeffs[11 as usize] = p.coeffs[11 as usize] / w
        result.coeffs[7 as usize] = p.coeffs[7 as usize] / w
        result.coeffs[14 as usize] = 1.0
    }
    result
}

fn pga_point_to_xyz(p: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let norm = pga_normalize_point(p)
    var result = ga_zero()
    result.coeffs[0 as usize] = norm.coeffs[13 as usize]
    result.coeffs[1 as usize] = norm.coeffs[11 as usize]
    result.coeffs[2 as usize] = norm.coeffs[7 as usize]
    result
}

fn pga_motor_from_axis_angle(lx: f64, ly: f64, lz: f64, angle: f64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let half = angle * 0.5
    var mv = ga_zero()
    let h2 = half * half
    let c = 1.0 - h2 * 0.5 + h2 * h2 / 24.0
    let s = half - half * h2 / 6.0 + half * h2 * h2 / 120.0
    mv.coeffs[0 as usize] = c
    mv.coeffs[12 as usize] = s * lx
    mv.coeffs[10 as usize] = s * ly
    mv.coeffs[6 as usize] = s * lz
    mv
}


// === FILE: stdlib/math/ga/product.sio ===
// == ga/base preamble inlined ==
// stdlib::math::ga::base — Self-contained Geometric Algebra foundation
//
// Implements Clifford algebras Cl(p,q,r) up to 5 dimensions (2^5 = 32 blades).
// Reference: Dorst, Fontijne, Mann — "Geometric Algebra for Computer Science"
//
// Basis blades are indexed by bitmap:
//   0 = scalar, 1 = e1, 2 = e2, 3 = e12, 4 = e3, 5 = e13, 6 = e23, 7 = e123, ...
// The coefficient of blade i is stored at coeffs[i].

// ============================================================================
// Algebra signature
// ============================================================================

struct AlgebraSignature {
    p: i64,       // positive basis vectors (e_i^2 = +1)
    q: i64,       // negative basis vectors (e_j^2 = -1)
    r: i64        // degenerate basis vectors (e_k^2 = 0)
}

// ============================================================================
// Multivector
// ============================================================================

struct Multivector {
    coeffs: [f64; 32],
    n_coeffs: i64
}

// ============================================================================
// Bit manipulation helpers (must precede callers)
// ============================================================================

fn ga_popcount(x: i64) -> i64 {
    var count: i64 = 0
    var v: i64 = x
    while v > 0 {
        count = count + (v % 2)
        v = v / 2
    }
    count
}

fn ga_grade(blade: i64) -> i64 {
    ga_popcount(blade)
}

fn ga_bit(n: i64) -> i64 {
    var result: i64 = 1
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        result = result * 2
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

fn ga_has_bit(mask: i64, bit: i64) -> bool {
    (mask / ga_bit(bit)) % 2 == 1
}

// ============================================================================
// Metric helpers
// ============================================================================

fn ga_dim(sig: AlgebraSignature) -> i64 {
    sig.p + sig.q + sig.r
}

fn ga_algebra_dim(sig: AlgebraSignature) -> i64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result: i64 = 1
    var i: i64 = 0
    let d = ga_dim(sig)
    while i < d {
        result = result * 2
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// Metric factor for basis vector e_i squaring with itself.
// In Cl(p,q,r): first p vectors square to +1, next q to -1, next r to 0.
fn ga_metric_factor(sig: AlgebraSignature, vector_index: i64) -> i64 {
    if vector_index < sig.p {
        1
    } else if vector_index < sig.p + sig.q {
        0 - 1
    } else {
        0
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Common signatures
// ============================================================================

fn ga_sig_euclidean3d() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 3, q: 0, r: 0 }
}

fn ga_sig_pga3d() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 3, q: 0, r: 1 }
}

fn ga_sig_cga() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 4, q: 1, r: 0 }
}

fn ga_sig_quaternion() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 0, q: 2, r: 0 }
}

// ============================================================================
// Constructors
// ============================================================================

fn ga_zero() -> Multivector {
    Multivector { coeffs: [0.0; 32], n_coeffs: 32 }
}

fn ga_scalar(v: f64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var mv = ga_zero()
    mv.coeffs[0 as usize] = v
    mv
}

fn ga_basis(i: i64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var mv = ga_zero()
    if i >= 0 && i < 32 {
        mv.coeffs[i as usize] = 1.0
    }
    mv
}

// ============================================================================
// Component access
// ============================================================================

fn ga_get(mv: Multivector, index: i64) -> f64 {
    if index >= 0 && index < 32 {
        mv.coeffs[index as usize]
    } else {
        0.0
    }
}

fn ga_set(mv: &! Multivector, index: i64, value: f64) with Panic, Div, Mut {
    if index >= 0 && index < 32 {
        mv.coeffs[index as usize] = value
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// THE CORE: Blade product sign computation
// ============================================================================

// Count transpositions needed to sort the combined blade a*b into canonical order.
// Uses the standard algorithm: for each set bit j in b, count how many set bits
// in a are at positions above j. This gives the number of anticommutation swaps.
fn ga_canonical_reorder_sign(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var sum: i64 = 0
    // For each bit position j in b, count bits in a above position j.
    // Equivalent: shift a right, AND with b, popcount — summed over shifts.
    var i: i64 = a / 2   // a >> 1
    while i > 0 {
        sum = sum + ga_popcount(i & b)
        i = i / 2
    }
    if sum % 2 == 0 { 1 } else { 0 - 1 }
}

// Full blade product sign including metric.
// Algorithm:
//   1. Compute anticommutation sign from reordering
//   2. For each shared basis vector (in a AND b):
//      - If that vector has degenerate metric (r-type), return 0
//      - If that vector has negative metric (q-type), flip sign
//   3. Return final sign: +1, -1, or 0
fn ga_blade_product_sign(a: i64, b: i64, sig: AlgebraSignature) -> i64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var sign = ga_canonical_reorder_sign(a, b)

    let shared = a & b
    let dim = ga_dim(sig)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < dim {
        if ga_has_bit(shared, i) {
            let mf = ga_metric_factor(sig, i)
            if mf == 0 {
                return 0
            }
            sign = sign * mf
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    sign
}

// ============================================================================
// Geometric product — the fundamental operation
// ============================================================================
// For each pair of basis blades (i, j):
//   result[i XOR j] += coeffs[i] * coeffs[j] * blade_product_sign(i, j, sig)

fn ga_geometric_product(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        if a.coeffs[i as usize] != 0.0 {
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n {
                if b.coeffs[j as usize] != 0.0 {
                    let sign = ga_blade_product_sign(i, j, sig)
                    if sign != 0 {
                        let result_blade = i ^ j
                        let coeff = a.coeffs[i as usize] * b.coeffs[j as usize] * (sign as f64)
                        result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] = result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] + coeff
                    }
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Outer (wedge) product
// ============================================================================
// Keep only terms where grade(result_blade) == grade(a_blade) + grade(b_blade)

fn ga_outer_product(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        if a.coeffs[i as usize] != 0.0 {
            let ga = ga_grade(i)
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n {
                if b.coeffs[j as usize] != 0.0 {
                    let gb = ga_grade(j)
                    let result_blade = i ^ j
                    let gr = ga_grade(result_blade)
                    if gr == ga + gb {
                        let sign = ga_canonical_reorder_sign(i, j)
                        let coeff = a.coeffs[i as usize] * b.coeffs[j as usize] * (sign as f64)
                        result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] = result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] + coeff
                    }
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Inner product (left contraction)
// ============================================================================
// Keep only terms where grade(result_blade) == |grade(a_blade) - grade(b_blade)|

fn ga_inner_product(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        if a.coeffs[i as usize] != 0.0 {
            let ga = ga_grade(i)
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n {
                if b.coeffs[j as usize] != 0.0 {
                    let gb = ga_grade(j)
                    let result_blade = i ^ j
                    let gr = ga_grade(result_blade)
                    let target = if ga > gb { ga - gb } else { gb - ga }
                    if gr == target && (ga > 0 || gb > 0) {
                        let sign = ga_blade_product_sign(i, j, sig)
                        if sign != 0 {
                            let coeff = a.coeffs[i as usize] * b.coeffs[j as usize] * (sign as f64)
                            result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] = result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] + coeff
                        }
                    }
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Reverse: reverses order of basis vectors in each blade
// ============================================================================
// For a grade-k blade: sign = (-1)^(k*(k-1)/2)
// grade 0: +1, grade 1: +1, grade 2: -1, grade 3: -1, grade 4: +1, ...

fn ga_reverse(a: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        let k = ga_grade(i)
        let exp = (k * (k - 1)) / 2
        let sign = if exp % 2 == 0 { 1.0 } else { 0.0 - 1.0 }
        result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize] * sign
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Grade selection
// ============================================================================

fn ga_grade_select(a: Multivector, grade: i64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        if ga_grade(i) == grade {
            result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize]
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Arithmetic
// ============================================================================

fn ga_add(a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize] + b.coeffs[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

fn ga_sub(a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize] - b.coeffs[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

fn ga_scale(a: Multivector, s: f64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize] * s
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Norm squared: scalar part of a * reverse(a)
// ============================================================================

fn ga_norm_squared(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector) -> f64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let rev_a = ga_reverse(a)
    let product = ga_geometric_product(sig, a, rev_a)
    product.coeffs[0 as usize]
}

// ============================================================================
// Dual: multiply by pseudoscalar
// ============================================================================

fn ga_dual(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)
    // Pseudoscalar index = 2^dim - 1 (all bits set)
    let ps_idx = n - 1
    let ps = ga_basis(ps_idx)
    let ps_rev = ga_reverse(ps)
    ga_geometric_product(sig, a, ps_rev)
}

// ============================================================================
// Helper: approximate equality for tests
// ============================================================================

fn ga_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn ga_approx_eq(a: f64, b: f64) -> bool {
    ga_abs(a - b) < 0.000001
}

// ============================================================================
// Inline tests
// ============================================================================

// Test 1: Geometric product of two vectors in R^3 gives scalar + bivector
// e1 * e2 = e12 (bivector), so product should have coeffs[3] = 1.0
fn test_vector_product_r3() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)   // e1 = bitmap 0b01
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)   // e2 = bitmap 0b10
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, e1, e2)
    // e1 * e2 = e12 (blade index 3 = 0b11), coefficient should be +1
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[3 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 2: e1*e1 = +1 in Euclidean 3D
fn test_e1_squared_euclidean() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, e1, e1)
    // e1^2 = +1 (scalar), so coeffs[0] = 1.0
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 3: Quaternion algebra Cl(0,2): e1*e2 product
// In Cl(0,2): e1^2 = -1, e2^2 = -1
// e1*e2 = e12 (blade 3)
fn test_quaternion_e1e2() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_quaternion()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, e1, e2)
    // e1*e2 = e12
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[3 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 4: Quaternion i*j=k, j*k=i, k*i=j
// In Cl(0,2): i=e1, j=e2, k=e12
// i*j = e1*e2 = e12 = k  => coeffs[3] = 1.0
fn test_quaternion_ijk() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_quaternion()
    let i_q = ga_basis(1)   // e1
    let j_q = ga_basis(2)   // e2
    let k_q = ga_basis(3)   // e12

    // i*j = k
    let ij = ga_geometric_product(sig, i_q, j_q)
    let ij_ok = ga_approx_eq(ij.coeffs[3 as usize], 1.0)

    // j*k = e2*e12
    // canonical_reorder_sign(2, 3): a=2=0b10, b=3=0b11
    //   i = a/2 = 1 = 0b01, popcount(1 & 3) = popcount(1) = 1, sum=1
    //   i = 1/2 = 0, stop. sign = -1
    // shared = 2 & 3 = 2 = 0b10, bit 1 set => metric_factor(sig, 1) = -1
    // total sign = (-1)*(-1) = +1
    // result blade = 2 ^ 3 = 1 (e1)
    // So j*k = +e1 = i
    let jk = ga_geometric_product(sig, j_q, k_q)
    let jk_ok = ga_approx_eq(jk.coeffs[1 as usize], 1.0)

    // k*i = e12*e1
    // canonical_reorder_sign(3, 1): a=3=0b11, b=1=0b01
    //   i = 3/2 = 1 = 0b01, popcount(1 & 1) = 1, sum=1
    //   i = 1/2 = 0, stop. sign = -1
    // shared = 3 & 1 = 1 = 0b01, bit 0 set => metric_factor(sig, 0) = -1
    // total sign = (-1)*(-1) = +1
    // result blade = 3 ^ 1 = 2 (e2)
    // So k*i = +e2 = j
    let ki = ga_geometric_product(sig, k_q, i_q)
    let ki_ok = ga_approx_eq(ki.coeffs[2 as usize], 1.0)

    ij_ok && jk_ok && ki_ok
}

// Test 5: Reverse of a bivector negates it
// reverse(e12) = e21 = -e12
fn test_reverse_bivector() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let bv = ga_basis(3)   // e12
    let rev = ga_reverse(bv)
    // grade 2: sign = (-1)^(2*1/2) = (-1)^1 = -1
    ga_approx_eq(rev.coeffs[3 as usize], 0.0 - 1.0)
}

// Test 6: Reverse of a vector leaves it unchanged
fn test_reverse_vector() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let v = ga_basis(1)   // e1
    let rev = ga_reverse(v)
    // grade 1: sign = (-1)^(1*0/2) = (-1)^0 = +1
    ga_approx_eq(rev.coeffs[1 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 7: Norm squared of unit vector e1 in Euclidean 3D = +1
fn test_norm_squared_euclidean() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let ns = ga_norm_squared(sig, e1)
    ga_approx_eq(ns, 1.0)
}

// Test 8: Norm squared of e1 in Cl(0,2) (quaternion) = -1
// e1^2 = -1, reverse(e1) = e1, so e1 * reverse(e1) = e1*e1 = -1
fn test_norm_squared_negative() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_quaternion()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let ns = ga_norm_squared(sig, e1)
    ga_approx_eq(ns, 0.0 - 1.0)
}

// Test 9: Outer product of e1 and e2 gives e12
fn test_outer_product() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)
    let result = ga_outer_product(sig, e1, e2)
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[3 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 10: Outer product of e1 with itself is zero (e1 ^ e1 = 0)
fn test_outer_product_self_zero() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let result = ga_outer_product(sig, e1, e1)
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0) && ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[1 as usize], 0.0)
}

// Test 11: Inner product of two orthogonal vectors is zero
fn test_inner_product_orthogonal() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)
    let result = ga_inner_product(sig, e1, e2)
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0)
}

// Test 12: Inner product e1 . e1 = 1 in Euclidean space
fn test_inner_product_same() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let result = ga_inner_product(sig, e1, e1)
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 13: Grade selection extracts correct grade
fn test_grade_select() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)
    // v = e1 + e2 (pure grade-1)
    let v = ga_add(e1, e2)
    // Add a scalar part: mv = 3.0 + e1 + e2
    let s = ga_scalar(3.0)
    let mv = ga_add(s, v)
    // Extract grade 0
    let g0 = ga_grade_select(mv, 0)
    let g0_ok = ga_approx_eq(g0.coeffs[0 as usize], 3.0)
    // Extract grade 1
    let g1 = ga_grade_select(mv, 1)
    let g1_ok = ga_approx_eq(g1.coeffs[1 as usize], 1.0) && ga_approx_eq(g1.coeffs[2 as usize], 1.0)
    g0_ok && g1_ok
}

// Test 14: Geometric product of vectors gives scalar + bivector
// (ae1 + be2) * (ce1 + de2) = ac*e1e1 + ad*e1e2 + bc*e2e1 + bd*e2e2
//                            = (ac + bd)*1 + (ad - bc)*e12
fn test_vector_product_components() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    // v1 = 2*e1 + 3*e2
    var v1 = ga_zero()
    v1.coeffs[1 as usize] = 2.0
    v1.coeffs[2 as usize] = 3.0
    // v2 = 4*e1 + 5*e2
    var v2 = ga_zero()
    v2.coeffs[1 as usize] = 4.0
    v2.coeffs[2 as usize] = 5.0
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, v1, v2)
    // scalar part = 2*4 + 3*5 = 8 + 15 = 23
    let scalar_ok = ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 23.0)
    // bivector e12 part = 2*5 - 3*4 = 10 - 12 = -2
    let bv_ok = ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[3 as usize], 0.0 - 2.0)
    scalar_ok && bv_ok
}

// Test 15: Degenerate metric — e0^2 = 0 in PGA
fn test_degenerate_pga() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_pga3d()  // Cl(3,0,1): e1^2=1, e2^2=1, e3^2=1, e4^2=0
    // e4 is the degenerate basis vector (index 3, bitmap 8 = 2^3)
    let e4 = ga_basis(8)   // bitmap 0b1000
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, e4, e4)
    // e4^2 = 0
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0)
}

// Test 16: Popcount correctness
fn test_popcount() -> bool {
    ga_popcount(0) == 0 &&
    ga_popcount(1) == 1 &&
    ga_popcount(3) == 2 &&
    ga_popcount(7) == 3 &&
    ga_popcount(15) == 4 &&
    ga_popcount(31) == 5
}

// Test 17: Algebra dimensions
fn test_algebra_dim() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig3 = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let sig4 = ga_sig_pga3d()
    let sig5 = ga_sig_cga()
    ga_dim(sig3) == 3 && ga_algebra_dim(sig3) == 8 &&
    ga_dim(sig4) == 4 && ga_algebra_dim(sig4) == 16 &&
    ga_dim(sig5) == 5 && ga_algebra_dim(sig5) == 32
}

// Test 18: Add and subtract
fn test_add_sub() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let a = ga_scalar(5.0)
    let b = ga_scalar(3.0)
    let sum = ga_add(a, b)
    let diff = ga_sub(a, b)
    ga_approx_eq(sum.coeffs[0 as usize], 8.0) && ga_approx_eq(diff.coeffs[0 as usize], 2.0)
}

// Test 19: Scale
fn test_scale() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let scaled = ga_scale(e1, 7.0)
    ga_approx_eq(scaled.coeffs[1 as usize], 7.0)
}

// Test 20: Quaternion i^2 = j^2 = k^2 = -1
fn test_quaternion_squares() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_quaternion()
    let i_q = ga_basis(1)
    let j_q = ga_basis(2)
    let k_q = ga_basis(3)

    let i2 = ga_geometric_product(sig, i_q, i_q)
    let j2 = ga_geometric_product(sig, j_q, j_q)
    let k2 = ga_geometric_product(sig, k_q, k_q)

    // i^2 = e1^2 = -1
    let i2_ok = ga_approx_eq(i2.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0 - 1.0)
    // j^2 = e2^2 = -1
    let j2_ok = ga_approx_eq(j2.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0 - 1.0)
    // k^2 = e12^2 = e1*e2*e1*e2 = -e1*e1*e2*e2 = -(-1)(-1) = -1
    let k2_ok = ga_approx_eq(k2.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0 - 1.0)

    i2_ok && j2_ok && k2_ok
}


// == product module (all operations provided by ga/base preamble) ==
// Additional aliases for alternate naming conventions

fn ga_blade_grade(blade: i64) -> i64 {
    ga_grade(blade)
}

fn ga_blade_count(sig: AlgebraSignature) -> i64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    ga_algebra_dim(sig)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/math/ga/quaternion.sio ===
// == ga/base preamble inlined ==
// stdlib::math::ga::base — Self-contained Geometric Algebra foundation
//
// Implements Clifford algebras Cl(p,q,r) up to 5 dimensions (2^5 = 32 blades).
// Reference: Dorst, Fontijne, Mann — "Geometric Algebra for Computer Science"
//
// Basis blades are indexed by bitmap:
//   0 = scalar, 1 = e1, 2 = e2, 3 = e12, 4 = e3, 5 = e13, 6 = e23, 7 = e123, ...
// The coefficient of blade i is stored at coeffs[i].

// ============================================================================
// Algebra signature
// ============================================================================

struct AlgebraSignature {
    p: i64,       // positive basis vectors (e_i^2 = +1)
    q: i64,       // negative basis vectors (e_j^2 = -1)
    r: i64        // degenerate basis vectors (e_k^2 = 0)
}

// ============================================================================
// Multivector
// ============================================================================

struct Multivector {
    coeffs: [f64; 32],
    n_coeffs: i64
}

// ============================================================================
// Bit manipulation helpers (must precede callers)
// ============================================================================

fn ga_popcount(x: i64) -> i64 {
    var count: i64 = 0
    var v: i64 = x
    while v > 0 {
        count = count + (v % 2)
        v = v / 2
    }
    count
}

fn ga_grade(blade: i64) -> i64 {
    ga_popcount(blade)
}

fn ga_bit(n: i64) -> i64 {
    var result: i64 = 1
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        result = result * 2
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

fn ga_has_bit(mask: i64, bit: i64) -> bool {
    (mask / ga_bit(bit)) % 2 == 1
}

// ============================================================================
// Metric helpers
// ============================================================================

fn ga_dim(sig: AlgebraSignature) -> i64 {
    sig.p + sig.q + sig.r
}

fn ga_algebra_dim(sig: AlgebraSignature) -> i64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result: i64 = 1
    var i: i64 = 0
    let d = ga_dim(sig)
    while i < d {
        result = result * 2
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// Metric factor for basis vector e_i squaring with itself.
// In Cl(p,q,r): first p vectors square to +1, next q to -1, next r to 0.
fn ga_metric_factor(sig: AlgebraSignature, vector_index: i64) -> i64 {
    if vector_index < sig.p {
        1
    } else if vector_index < sig.p + sig.q {
        0 - 1
    } else {
        0
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Common signatures
// ============================================================================

fn ga_sig_euclidean3d() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 3, q: 0, r: 0 }
}

fn ga_sig_pga3d() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 3, q: 0, r: 1 }
}

fn ga_sig_cga() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 4, q: 1, r: 0 }
}

fn ga_sig_quaternion() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 0, q: 2, r: 0 }
}

// ============================================================================
// Constructors
// ============================================================================

fn ga_zero() -> Multivector {
    Multivector { coeffs: [0.0; 32], n_coeffs: 32 }
}

fn ga_scalar(v: f64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var mv = ga_zero()
    mv.coeffs[0 as usize] = v
    mv
}

fn ga_basis(i: i64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var mv = ga_zero()
    if i >= 0 && i < 32 {
        mv.coeffs[i as usize] = 1.0
    }
    mv
}

// ============================================================================
// Component access
// ============================================================================

fn ga_get(mv: Multivector, index: i64) -> f64 {
    if index >= 0 && index < 32 {
        mv.coeffs[index as usize]
    } else {
        0.0
    }
}

fn ga_set(mv: &! Multivector, index: i64, value: f64) with Panic, Div, Mut {
    if index >= 0 && index < 32 {
        mv.coeffs[index as usize] = value
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// THE CORE: Blade product sign computation
// ============================================================================

// Count transpositions needed to sort the combined blade a*b into canonical order.
// Uses the standard algorithm: for each set bit j in b, count how many set bits
// in a are at positions above j. This gives the number of anticommutation swaps.
fn ga_canonical_reorder_sign(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var sum: i64 = 0
    // For each bit position j in b, count bits in a above position j.
    // Equivalent: shift a right, AND with b, popcount — summed over shifts.
    var i: i64 = a / 2   // a >> 1
    while i > 0 {
        sum = sum + ga_popcount(i & b)
        i = i / 2
    }
    if sum % 2 == 0 { 1 } else { 0 - 1 }
}

// Full blade product sign including metric.
// Algorithm:
//   1. Compute anticommutation sign from reordering
//   2. For each shared basis vector (in a AND b):
//      - If that vector has degenerate metric (r-type), return 0
//      - If that vector has negative metric (q-type), flip sign
//   3. Return final sign: +1, -1, or 0
fn ga_blade_product_sign(a: i64, b: i64, sig: AlgebraSignature) -> i64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var sign = ga_canonical_reorder_sign(a, b)

    let shared = a & b
    let dim = ga_dim(sig)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < dim {
        if ga_has_bit(shared, i) {
            let mf = ga_metric_factor(sig, i)
            if mf == 0 {
                return 0
            }
            sign = sign * mf
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    sign
}

// ============================================================================
// Geometric product — the fundamental operation
// ============================================================================
// For each pair of basis blades (i, j):
//   result[i XOR j] += coeffs[i] * coeffs[j] * blade_product_sign(i, j, sig)

fn ga_geometric_product(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        if a.coeffs[i as usize] != 0.0 {
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n {
                if b.coeffs[j as usize] != 0.0 {
                    let sign = ga_blade_product_sign(i, j, sig)
                    if sign != 0 {
                        let result_blade = i ^ j
                        let coeff = a.coeffs[i as usize] * b.coeffs[j as usize] * (sign as f64)
                        result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] = result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] + coeff
                    }
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Outer (wedge) product
// ============================================================================
// Keep only terms where grade(result_blade) == grade(a_blade) + grade(b_blade)

fn ga_outer_product(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        if a.coeffs[i as usize] != 0.0 {
            let ga = ga_grade(i)
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n {
                if b.coeffs[j as usize] != 0.0 {
                    let gb = ga_grade(j)
                    let result_blade = i ^ j
                    let gr = ga_grade(result_blade)
                    if gr == ga + gb {
                        let sign = ga_canonical_reorder_sign(i, j)
                        let coeff = a.coeffs[i as usize] * b.coeffs[j as usize] * (sign as f64)
                        result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] = result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] + coeff
                    }
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Inner product (left contraction)
// ============================================================================
// Keep only terms where grade(result_blade) == |grade(a_blade) - grade(b_blade)|

fn ga_inner_product(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        if a.coeffs[i as usize] != 0.0 {
            let ga = ga_grade(i)
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n {
                if b.coeffs[j as usize] != 0.0 {
                    let gb = ga_grade(j)
                    let result_blade = i ^ j
                    let gr = ga_grade(result_blade)
                    let target = if ga > gb { ga - gb } else { gb - ga }
                    if gr == target && (ga > 0 || gb > 0) {
                        let sign = ga_blade_product_sign(i, j, sig)
                        if sign != 0 {
                            let coeff = a.coeffs[i as usize] * b.coeffs[j as usize] * (sign as f64)
                            result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] = result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] + coeff
                        }
                    }
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Reverse: reverses order of basis vectors in each blade
// ============================================================================
// For a grade-k blade: sign = (-1)^(k*(k-1)/2)
// grade 0: +1, grade 1: +1, grade 2: -1, grade 3: -1, grade 4: +1, ...

fn ga_reverse(a: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        let k = ga_grade(i)
        let exp = (k * (k - 1)) / 2
        let sign = if exp % 2 == 0 { 1.0 } else { 0.0 - 1.0 }
        result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize] * sign
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Grade selection
// ============================================================================

fn ga_grade_select(a: Multivector, grade: i64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        if ga_grade(i) == grade {
            result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize]
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Arithmetic
// ============================================================================

fn ga_add(a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize] + b.coeffs[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

fn ga_sub(a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize] - b.coeffs[i as usize]
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

fn ga_scale(a: Multivector, s: f64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        result.coeffs[i as usize] = a.coeffs[i as usize] * s
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Norm squared: scalar part of a * reverse(a)
// ============================================================================

fn ga_norm_squared(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector) -> f64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let rev_a = ga_reverse(a)
    let product = ga_geometric_product(sig, a, rev_a)
    product.coeffs[0 as usize]
}

// ============================================================================
// Dual: multiply by pseudoscalar
// ============================================================================

fn ga_dual(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)
    // Pseudoscalar index = 2^dim - 1 (all bits set)
    let ps_idx = n - 1
    let ps = ga_basis(ps_idx)
    let ps_rev = ga_reverse(ps)
    ga_geometric_product(sig, a, ps_rev)
}

// ============================================================================
// Helper: approximate equality for tests
// ============================================================================

fn ga_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn ga_approx_eq(a: f64, b: f64) -> bool {
    ga_abs(a - b) < 0.000001
}

// ============================================================================
// Inline tests
// ============================================================================

// Test 1: Geometric product of two vectors in R^3 gives scalar + bivector
// e1 * e2 = e12 (bivector), so product should have coeffs[3] = 1.0
fn test_vector_product_r3() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)   // e1 = bitmap 0b01
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)   // e2 = bitmap 0b10
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, e1, e2)
    // e1 * e2 = e12 (blade index 3 = 0b11), coefficient should be +1
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[3 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 2: e1*e1 = +1 in Euclidean 3D
fn test_e1_squared_euclidean() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, e1, e1)
    // e1^2 = +1 (scalar), so coeffs[0] = 1.0
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 3: Quaternion algebra Cl(0,2): e1*e2 product
// In Cl(0,2): e1^2 = -1, e2^2 = -1
// e1*e2 = e12 (blade 3)
fn test_quaternion_e1e2() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_quaternion()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, e1, e2)
    // e1*e2 = e12
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[3 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 4: Quaternion i*j=k, j*k=i, k*i=j
// In Cl(0,2): i=e1, j=e2, k=e12
// i*j = e1*e2 = e12 = k  => coeffs[3] = 1.0
fn test_quaternion_ijk() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_quaternion()
    let i_q = ga_basis(1)   // e1
    let j_q = ga_basis(2)   // e2
    let k_q = ga_basis(3)   // e12

    // i*j = k
    let ij = ga_geometric_product(sig, i_q, j_q)
    let ij_ok = ga_approx_eq(ij.coeffs[3 as usize], 1.0)

    // j*k = e2*e12
    // canonical_reorder_sign(2, 3): a=2=0b10, b=3=0b11
    //   i = a/2 = 1 = 0b01, popcount(1 & 3) = popcount(1) = 1, sum=1
    //   i = 1/2 = 0, stop. sign = -1
    // shared = 2 & 3 = 2 = 0b10, bit 1 set => metric_factor(sig, 1) = -1
    // total sign = (-1)*(-1) = +1
    // result blade = 2 ^ 3 = 1 (e1)
    // So j*k = +e1 = i
    let jk = ga_geometric_product(sig, j_q, k_q)
    let jk_ok = ga_approx_eq(jk.coeffs[1 as usize], 1.0)

    // k*i = e12*e1
    // canonical_reorder_sign(3, 1): a=3=0b11, b=1=0b01
    //   i = 3/2 = 1 = 0b01, popcount(1 & 1) = 1, sum=1
    //   i = 1/2 = 0, stop. sign = -1
    // shared = 3 & 1 = 1 = 0b01, bit 0 set => metric_factor(sig, 0) = -1
    // total sign = (-1)*(-1) = +1
    // result blade = 3 ^ 1 = 2 (e2)
    // So k*i = +e2 = j
    let ki = ga_geometric_product(sig, k_q, i_q)
    let ki_ok = ga_approx_eq(ki.coeffs[2 as usize], 1.0)

    ij_ok && jk_ok && ki_ok
}

// Test 5: Reverse of a bivector negates it
// reverse(e12) = e21 = -e12
fn test_reverse_bivector() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let bv = ga_basis(3)   // e12
    let rev = ga_reverse(bv)
    // grade 2: sign = (-1)^(2*1/2) = (-1)^1 = -1
    ga_approx_eq(rev.coeffs[3 as usize], 0.0 - 1.0)
}

// Test 6: Reverse of a vector leaves it unchanged
fn test_reverse_vector() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let v = ga_basis(1)   // e1
    let rev = ga_reverse(v)
    // grade 1: sign = (-1)^(1*0/2) = (-1)^0 = +1
    ga_approx_eq(rev.coeffs[1 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 7: Norm squared of unit vector e1 in Euclidean 3D = +1
fn test_norm_squared_euclidean() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let ns = ga_norm_squared(sig, e1)
    ga_approx_eq(ns, 1.0)
}

// Test 8: Norm squared of e1 in Cl(0,2) (quaternion) = -1
// e1^2 = -1, reverse(e1) = e1, so e1 * reverse(e1) = e1*e1 = -1
fn test_norm_squared_negative() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_quaternion()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let ns = ga_norm_squared(sig, e1)
    ga_approx_eq(ns, 0.0 - 1.0)
}

// Test 9: Outer product of e1 and e2 gives e12
fn test_outer_product() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)
    let result = ga_outer_product(sig, e1, e2)
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[3 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 10: Outer product of e1 with itself is zero (e1 ^ e1 = 0)
fn test_outer_product_self_zero() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let result = ga_outer_product(sig, e1, e1)
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0) && ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[1 as usize], 0.0)
}

// Test 11: Inner product of two orthogonal vectors is zero
fn test_inner_product_orthogonal() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)
    let result = ga_inner_product(sig, e1, e2)
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0)
}

// Test 12: Inner product e1 . e1 = 1 in Euclidean space
fn test_inner_product_same() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let result = ga_inner_product(sig, e1, e1)
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 1.0)
}

// Test 13: Grade selection extracts correct grade
fn test_grade_select() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let e2 = ga_basis(2)
    // v = e1 + e2 (pure grade-1)
    let v = ga_add(e1, e2)
    // Add a scalar part: mv = 3.0 + e1 + e2
    let s = ga_scalar(3.0)
    let mv = ga_add(s, v)
    // Extract grade 0
    let g0 = ga_grade_select(mv, 0)
    let g0_ok = ga_approx_eq(g0.coeffs[0 as usize], 3.0)
    // Extract grade 1
    let g1 = ga_grade_select(mv, 1)
    let g1_ok = ga_approx_eq(g1.coeffs[1 as usize], 1.0) && ga_approx_eq(g1.coeffs[2 as usize], 1.0)
    g0_ok && g1_ok
}

// Test 14: Geometric product of vectors gives scalar + bivector
// (ae1 + be2) * (ce1 + de2) = ac*e1e1 + ad*e1e2 + bc*e2e1 + bd*e2e2
//                            = (ac + bd)*1 + (ad - bc)*e12
fn test_vector_product_components() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    // v1 = 2*e1 + 3*e2
    var v1 = ga_zero()
    v1.coeffs[1 as usize] = 2.0
    v1.coeffs[2 as usize] = 3.0
    // v2 = 4*e1 + 5*e2
    var v2 = ga_zero()
    v2.coeffs[1 as usize] = 4.0
    v2.coeffs[2 as usize] = 5.0
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, v1, v2)
    // scalar part = 2*4 + 3*5 = 8 + 15 = 23
    let scalar_ok = ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 23.0)
    // bivector e12 part = 2*5 - 3*4 = 10 - 12 = -2
    let bv_ok = ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[3 as usize], 0.0 - 2.0)
    scalar_ok && bv_ok
}

// Test 15: Degenerate metric — e0^2 = 0 in PGA
fn test_degenerate_pga() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_pga3d()  // Cl(3,0,1): e1^2=1, e2^2=1, e3^2=1, e4^2=0
    // e4 is the degenerate basis vector (index 3, bitmap 8 = 2^3)
    let e4 = ga_basis(8)   // bitmap 0b1000
    let result = ga_geometric_product(sig, e4, e4)
    // e4^2 = 0
    ga_approx_eq(result.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0)
}

// Test 16: Popcount correctness
fn test_popcount() -> bool {
    ga_popcount(0) == 0 &&
    ga_popcount(1) == 1 &&
    ga_popcount(3) == 2 &&
    ga_popcount(7) == 3 &&
    ga_popcount(15) == 4 &&
    ga_popcount(31) == 5
}

// Test 17: Algebra dimensions
fn test_algebra_dim() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig3 = ga_sig_euclidean3d()
    let sig4 = ga_sig_pga3d()
    let sig5 = ga_sig_cga()
    ga_dim(sig3) == 3 && ga_algebra_dim(sig3) == 8 &&
    ga_dim(sig4) == 4 && ga_algebra_dim(sig4) == 16 &&
    ga_dim(sig5) == 5 && ga_algebra_dim(sig5) == 32
}

// Test 18: Add and subtract
fn test_add_sub() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let a = ga_scalar(5.0)
    let b = ga_scalar(3.0)
    let sum = ga_add(a, b)
    let diff = ga_sub(a, b)
    ga_approx_eq(sum.coeffs[0 as usize], 8.0) && ga_approx_eq(diff.coeffs[0 as usize], 2.0)
}

// Test 19: Scale
fn test_scale() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let e1 = ga_basis(1)
    let scaled = ga_scale(e1, 7.0)
    ga_approx_eq(scaled.coeffs[1 as usize], 7.0)
}

// Test 20: Quaternion i^2 = j^2 = k^2 = -1
fn test_quaternion_squares() -> bool with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = ga_sig_quaternion()
    let i_q = ga_basis(1)
    let j_q = ga_basis(2)
    let k_q = ga_basis(3)

    let i2 = ga_geometric_product(sig, i_q, i_q)
    let j2 = ga_geometric_product(sig, j_q, j_q)
    let k2 = ga_geometric_product(sig, k_q, k_q)

    // i^2 = e1^2 = -1
    let i2_ok = ga_approx_eq(i2.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0 - 1.0)
    // j^2 = e2^2 = -1
    let j2_ok = ga_approx_eq(j2.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0 - 1.0)
    // k^2 = e12^2 = e1*e2*e1*e2 = -e1*e1*e2*e2 = -(-1)(-1) = -1
    let k2_ok = ga_approx_eq(k2.coeffs[0 as usize], 0.0 - 1.0)

    i2_ok && j2_ok && k2_ok
}


// == Quaternion module: Cl(0,2) specialization ==

fn quat_sig() -> AlgebraSignature {
    ga_sig_quaternion()
}

fn quat_new(w: f64, x: f64, y: f64, z: f64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var mv = ga_zero()
    mv.coeffs[0 as usize] = w
    mv.coeffs[1 as usize] = x
    mv.coeffs[2 as usize] = y
    mv.coeffs[3 as usize] = z
    mv
}

fn quat_w(q: Multivector) -> f64 { ga_get(q, 0) }
fn quat_x(q: Multivector) -> f64 { ga_get(q, 1) }
fn quat_y(q: Multivector) -> f64 { ga_get(q, 2) }
fn quat_z(q: Multivector) -> f64 { ga_get(q, 3) }

fn quat_mul(a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let sig = quat_sig()
    ga_geometric_product(sig, a, b)
}

fn quat_conjugate(q: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    result.coeffs[0 as usize] = quat_w(q)
    result.coeffs[1 as usize] = 0.0 - quat_x(q)
    result.coeffs[2 as usize] = 0.0 - quat_y(q)
    result.coeffs[3 as usize] = 0.0 - quat_z(q)
    result
}

fn quat_norm_sq(q: Multivector) -> f64 {
    let w = quat_w(q)
    let x = quat_x(q)
    let y = quat_y(q)
    let z = quat_z(q)
    w * w + x * x + y * y + z * z
}

fn quat_identity() -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    quat_new(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
}

fn quat_rotate_vec3(q: Multivector, vx: f64, vy: f64, vz: f64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    let v = quat_new(0.0, vx, vy, vz)
    let q_conj = quat_conjugate(q)
    let tmp = quat_mul(q, v)
    quat_mul(tmp, q_conj)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/math/ga/simd.sio ===
// == ga/base preamble inlined ==
// stdlib::math::ga::base — Self-contained Geometric Algebra foundation
//
// Implements Clifford algebras Cl(p,q,r) up to 5 dimensions (2^5 = 32 blades).
// Reference: Dorst, Fontijne, Mann — "Geometric Algebra for Computer Science"
//
// Basis blades are indexed by bitmap:
//   0 = scalar, 1 = e1, 2 = e2, 3 = e12, 4 = e3, 5 = e13, 6 = e23, 7 = e123, ...
// The coefficient of blade i is stored at coeffs[i].

// ============================================================================
// Algebra signature
// ============================================================================

struct AlgebraSignature {
    p: i64,       // positive basis vectors (e_i^2 = +1)
    q: i64,       // negative basis vectors (e_j^2 = -1)
    r: i64        // degenerate basis vectors (e_k^2 = 0)
}

// ============================================================================
// Multivector
// ============================================================================

struct Multivector {
    coeffs: [f64; 32],
    n_coeffs: i64
}

// ============================================================================
// Bit manipulation helpers (must precede callers)
// ============================================================================

fn ga_popcount(x: i64) -> i64 {
    var count: i64 = 0
    var v: i64 = x
    while v > 0 {
        count = count + (v % 2)
        v = v / 2
    }
    count
}

fn ga_grade(blade: i64) -> i64 {
    ga_popcount(blade)
}

fn ga_bit(n: i64) -> i64 {
    var result: i64 = 1
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        result = result * 2
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

fn ga_has_bit(mask: i64, bit: i64) -> bool {
    (mask / ga_bit(bit)) % 2 == 1
}

// ============================================================================
// Metric helpers
// ============================================================================

fn ga_dim(sig: AlgebraSignature) -> i64 {
    sig.p + sig.q + sig.r
}

fn ga_algebra_dim(sig: AlgebraSignature) -> i64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result: i64 = 1
    var i: i64 = 0
    let d = ga_dim(sig)
    while i < d {
        result = result * 2
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// Metric factor for basis vector e_i squaring with itself.
// In Cl(p,q,r): first p vectors square to +1, next q to -1, next r to 0.
fn ga_metric_factor(sig: AlgebraSignature, vector_index: i64) -> i64 {
    if vector_index < sig.p {
        1
    } else if vector_index < sig.p + sig.q {
        0 - 1
    } else {
        0
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Common signatures
// ============================================================================

fn ga_sig_euclidean3d() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 3, q: 0, r: 0 }
}

fn ga_sig_pga3d() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 3, q: 0, r: 1 }
}

fn ga_sig_cga() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 4, q: 1, r: 0 }
}

fn ga_sig_quaternion() -> AlgebraSignature {
    AlgebraSignature { p: 0, q: 2, r: 0 }
}

// ============================================================================
// Constructors
// ============================================================================

fn ga_zero() -> Multivector {
    Multivector { coeffs: [0.0; 32], n_coeffs: 32 }
}

fn ga_scalar(v: f64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var mv = ga_zero()
    mv.coeffs[0 as usize] = v
    mv
}

fn ga_basis(i: i64) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var mv = ga_zero()
    if i >= 0 && i < 32 {
        mv.coeffs[i as usize] = 1.0
    }
    mv
}

// ============================================================================
// Component access
// ============================================================================

fn ga_get(mv: Multivector, index: i64) -> f64 {
    if index >= 0 && index < 32 {
        mv.coeffs[index as usize]
    } else {
        0.0
    }
}

fn ga_set(mv: &! Multivector, index: i64, value: f64) with Panic, Div, Mut {
    if index >= 0 && index < 32 {
        mv.coeffs[index as usize] = value
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// THE CORE: Blade product sign computation
// ============================================================================

// Count transpositions needed to sort the combined blade a*b into canonical order.
// Uses the standard algorithm: for each set bit j in b, count how many set bits
// in a are at positions above j. This gives the number of anticommutation swaps.
fn ga_canonical_reorder_sign(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var sum: i64 = 0
    // For each bit position j in b, count bits in a above position j.
    // Equivalent: shift a right, AND with b, popcount — summed over shifts.
    var i: i64 = a / 2   // a >> 1
    while i > 0 {
        sum = sum + ga_popcount(i & b)
        i = i / 2
    }
    if sum % 2 == 0 { 1 } else { 0 - 1 }
}

// Full blade product sign including metric.
// Algorithm:
//   1. Compute anticommutation sign from reordering
//   2. For each shared basis vector (in a AND b):
//      - If that vector has degenerate metric (r-type), return 0
//      - If that vector has negative metric (q-type), flip sign
//   3. Return final sign: +1, -1, or 0
fn ga_blade_product_sign(a: i64, b: i64, sig: AlgebraSignature) -> i64 with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var sign = ga_canonical_reorder_sign(a, b)

    let shared = a & b
    let dim = ga_dim(sig)
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < dim {
        if ga_has_bit(shared, i) {
            let mf = ga_metric_factor(sig, i)
            if mf == 0 {
                return 0
            }
            sign = sign * mf
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    sign
}

// ============================================================================
// Geometric product — the fundamental operation
// ============================================================================
// For each pair of basis blades (i, j):
//   result[i XOR j] += coeffs[i] * coeffs[j] * blade_product_sign(i, j, sig)

fn ga_geometric_product(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        if a.coeffs[i as usize] != 0.0 {
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n {
                if b.coeffs[j as usize] != 0.0 {
                    let sign = ga_blade_product_sign(i, j, sig)
                    if sign != 0 {
                        let result_blade = i ^ j
                        let coeff = a.coeffs[i as usize] * b.coeffs[j as usize] * (sign as f64)
                        result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] = result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] + coeff
                    }
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Outer (wedge) product
// ============================================================================
// Keep only terms where grade(result_blade) == grade(a_blade) + grade(b_blade)

fn ga_outer_product(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        if a.coeffs[i as usize] != 0.0 {
            let ga = ga_grade(i)
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n {
                if b.coeffs[j as usize] != 0.0 {
                    let gb = ga_grade(j)
                    let result_blade = i ^ j
                    let gr = ga_grade(result_blade)
                    if gr == ga + gb {
                        let sign = ga_canonical_reorder_sign(i, j)
                        let coeff = a.coeffs[i as usize] * b.coeffs[j as usize] * (sign as f64)
                        result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] = result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] + coeff
                    }
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Inner product (left contraction)
// ============================================================================
// Keep only terms where grade(result_blade) == |grade(a_blade) - grade(b_blade)|

fn ga_inner_product(sig: AlgebraSignature, a: Multivector, b: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    let n = ga_algebra_dim(sig)

    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        if a.coeffs[i as usize] != 0.0 {
            let ga = ga_grade(i)
            var j: i64 = 0
            while j < n {
                if b.coeffs[j as usize] != 0.0 {
                    let gb = ga_grade(j)
                    let result_blade = i ^ j
                    let gr = ga_grade(result_blade)
                    let target = if ga > gb { ga - gb } else { gb - ga }
                    if gr == target && (ga > 0 || gb > 0) {
                        let sign = ga_blade_product_sign(i, j, sig)
                        if sign != 0 {
                            let coeff = a.coeffs[i as usize] * b.coeffs[j as usize] * (sign as f64)
                            result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] = result.coeffs[result_blade as usize] + coeff
                        }
                    }
                }
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result
}

// ============================================================================
// Reverse: reverses order of basis vectors in each blade
// ============================================================================
// For a grade-k blade: sign = (-1)^(k*(k-1)/2)
// grade 0: +1, grade 1: +1, grade 2: -1, grade 3: -1, grade 4: +1, ...

fn ga_reverse(a: Multivector) -> Multivector with Panic, Div, Mut {
    var result = ga_zero()
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < 32 {
        let k = ga_grade(i)
