// This function returns the correction term: -0.5 * b * b'.
fn strat_to_ito_correction(
    diffusion: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    diff_prime: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    t: f64, x: f64
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let b_val = diffusion(t, x)
    let bp_val = diff_prime(t, x)
    0.0 - 0.5 * b_val * bp_val
}

// =============================================================================
// Multi-dimensional Euler-Maruyama
// =============================================================================

// Euler-Maruyama for a dim-dimensional SDE system:
//   dX_d = drift_d(X, t) * dt + diffusion_d(X, t) * dW_d
// Each component has its own independent Wiener increment.
//
// drift(dim, x_state, t, out): writes drift vector into out[0..dim-1]
// diffusion(dim, x_state, t, out): writes diffusion vector into out[0..dim-1]
// x0[0..dim-1]: initial condition
//
// Path stored as flat array: path.x[step * dim + d] = X_d(t_step).
fn sde_euler_nd(
    drift: fn(i32, &[f64; 64], f64, &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    diffusion: fn(i32, &[f64; 64], f64, &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: &[f64; 64], dim: i32, t0: f64, t_end: f64, n_steps: i32, seed: i64,
    path: &!SDEPathND
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    path.t_start = t0
    path.t_end = t_end
    path.dim = dim
    path.n_steps = n_steps

    let dt = (t_end - t0) / (n_steps as f64)
    let sqrt_dt = sc_sqrt(dt)

    var rng_state: i64 = seed

    // Store initial condition at step 0
    var d = 0
    while d < dim {
        path.x[d] = x0[d]
        d = d + 1
    }

    // Temporary arrays for current state, drift, and diffusion vectors
    var x_cur: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var a_vec: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var b_vec: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

    var i = 0
    while i < n_steps {
        let t = t0 + (i as f64) * dt

        // Copy current state from path storage
        d = 0
        while d < dim {
            x_cur[d] = path.x[i * dim + d]
            d = d + 1
        }

        // Evaluate drift and diffusion vectors
        drift(dim, &x_cur, t, &!a_vec)
        diffusion(dim, &x_cur, t, &!b_vec)

        // Update each component with independent Wiener increments
        d = 0
        while d < dim {
            let dW = sqrt_dt * sc_box_muller(&!rng_state)
            path.x[(i + 1) * dim + d] = x_cur[d] + a_vec[d] * dt + b_vec[d] * dW
            d = d + 1
        }

        i = i + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Multi-dimensional Path Analysis
// =============================================================================

// Extract the d-th component from a multi-dimensional path into a 1D path.
fn sde_nd_extract(nd_path: &SDEPathND, d: i32, out: &!SDEPath) with Panic, Div, Mut {
    out.t_start = nd_path.t_start
    out.t_end = nd_path.t_end
    out.n_steps = nd_path.n_steps

    var i = 0
    while i <= nd_path.n_steps {
        out.x[i] = nd_path.x[i * nd_path.dim + d]
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Compute the Euclidean norm of the state vector at time step k.
fn sde_nd_norm_at(nd_path: &SDEPathND, k: i32) -> f64 with Panic, Mut, Div {
    var sum_sq = 0.0
    var d = 0
    while d < nd_path.dim {
        let val = nd_path.x[k * nd_path.dim + d]
        sum_sq = sum_sq + val * val
        d = d + 1
    }
    sc_sqrt(sum_sq)
}

// =============================================================================
// Advanced Solvers
// =============================================================================

// Stochastic Runge-Kutta (SRK) method of order 1.0 (strong).
// A two-stage explicit method by Rossler (2010) for additive noise
// (constant diffusion). Falls back to improved behavior for multiplicative noise.
//   Stage 1: K1 = a(t, X_n)
//   Predictor: X_hat = X_n + K1 * dt + b(t, X_n) * sqrt(dt)
//   Stage 2: K2 = a(t + dt, X_hat)
//   X_{n+1} = X_n + 0.5*(K1+K2)*dt + b(t, X_n)*dW
fn sde_srk(
    drift: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    diffusion: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: f64, t0: f64, t_end: f64, n_steps: i32, seed: i64,
    path: &!SDEPath
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    path.t_start = t0
    path.t_end = t_end
    path.n_steps = n_steps

    let dt = (t_end - t0) / (n_steps as f64)
    let sqrt_dt = sc_sqrt(dt)

    var rng_state: i64 = seed
    path.x[0] = x0

    var i = 0
    while i < n_steps {
        let t = t0 + (i as f64) * dt
        let x = path.x[i]
        let dW = sqrt_dt * sc_box_muller(&!rng_state)

        let b_val = diffusion(t, x)
        let k1 = drift(t, x)

        // Predictor using sqrt(dt) supporting term
        let x_hat = x + k1 * dt + b_val * sqrt_dt
        let k2 = drift(t + dt, x_hat)

        // Two-stage update
        path.x[i + 1] = x + 0.5 * (k1 + k2) * dt + b_val * dW
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Implicit Euler-Maruyama (drift-implicit) for stiff SDEs.
// Solves X_{n+1} = X_n + a(t_{n+1}, X_{n+1})*dt + b(t_n, X_n)*dW
// via fixed-point iteration on the implicit drift term.
// max_iter controls the number of fixed-point iterations per step.
fn sde_implicit_euler(
    drift: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    diffusion: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: f64, t0: f64, t_end: f64, n_steps: i32, seed: i64,
    max_iter: i32,
    path: &!SDEPath
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    path.t_start = t0
    path.t_end = t_end
    path.n_steps = n_steps

    let dt = (t_end - t0) / (n_steps as f64)
    let sqrt_dt = sc_sqrt(dt)

    var rng_state: i64 = seed
    path.x[0] = x0

    var i = 0
    while i < n_steps {
        let t = t0 + (i as f64) * dt
        let t_next = t + dt
        let x = path.x[i]
        let dW = sqrt_dt * sc_box_muller(&!rng_state)

        // Explicit diffusion term (evaluated at current point)
        let stoch_part = diffusion(t, x) * dW

        // Initial guess for X_{n+1} via explicit Euler
        var x_next = x + drift(t, x) * dt + stoch_part

        // Fixed-point iteration: x_next = x + a(t_next, x_next)*dt + stoch_part
        var iter = 0
        while iter < max_iter {
            x_next = x + drift(t_next, x_next) * dt + stoch_part
            iter = iter + 1
        }

        path.x[i + 1] = x_next
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Wiener Process Utilities
// =============================================================================

// Generate a standard Wiener process (Brownian motion) path.
// W(0) = 0, W(t_{k+1}) = W(t_k) + sqrt(dt) * Z_k where Z_k ~ N(0,1).
fn wiener_path(
    t_end: f64, n_steps: i32, seed: i64,
    path: &!SDEPath
) with Panic, Mut, Div {
    path.t_start = 0.0
    path.t_end = t_end
    path.n_steps = n_steps

    let dt = t_end / (n_steps as f64)
    let sqrt_dt = sc_sqrt(dt)

    var rng_state: i64 = seed
    path.x[0] = 0.0

    var i = 0
    while i < n_steps {
        let dW = sqrt_dt * sc_box_muller(&!rng_state)
        path.x[i + 1] = path.x[i] + dW
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Brownian bridge: W(0) = a, W(T) = b, with correct conditional distribution.
// At intermediate points, W(t_k) is drawn from the bridge distribution:
//   W(t_k) | W(t_{k-1}), W(T) ~ N(mean, var) where
//   mean = W(t_{k-1}) + (b - W(t_{k-1})) * dt / (T - t_{k-1})
//   var  = dt * (T - t_k) / (T - t_{k-1})
fn brownian_bridge(
    a: f64, b: f64, t_end: f64, n_steps: i32, seed: i64,
    path: &!SDEPath
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    path.t_start = 0.0
    path.t_end = t_end
    path.n_steps = n_steps

    let dt = t_end / (n_steps as f64)

    var rng_state: i64 = seed
    path.x[0] = a
    path.x[n_steps] = b

    // Fill intermediate points using conditional Gaussian
    var i = 0
    while i < n_steps - 1 {
        let t_cur = (i as f64) * dt
        let t_next = ((i + 1) as f64) * dt
        let remaining = t_end - t_cur

        // Conditional mean and variance
        let cond_mean = path.x[i] + (b - path.x[i]) * dt / remaining
        let cond_var = dt * (t_end - t_next) / remaining
        let cond_std = sc_sqrt(sc_max(cond_var, 0.0))

        let z = sc_box_muller(&!rng_state)
        path.x[i + 1] = cond_mean + cond_std * z
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Convergence Analysis Utilities
// =============================================================================

// Compute the weak error estimate: |E[g(X_T)] - reference|
// by running multiple paths and comparing the sample mean of g(X_T).
// Here g is the identity function g(x) = x, so it computes |E[X_T] - ref|.
fn sde_weak_error(
    drift: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    diffusion: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: f64, t0: f64, t_end: f64, n_steps: i32,
    n_paths: i32, seed: i64, reference: f64
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let dt = (t_end - t0) / (n_steps as f64)
    let sqrt_dt = sc_sqrt(dt)

    var sum_terminal = 0.0
    var p = 0
    while p < n_paths {
        var rng_state: i64 = seed + (p as i64) * 999983

        var x = x0
        var i = 0
        while i < n_steps {
            let t = t0 + (i as f64) * dt
            let dW = sqrt_dt * sc_box_muller(&!rng_state)
            x = x + drift(t, x) * dt + diffusion(t, x) * dW
            i = i + 1
        }
        sum_terminal = sum_terminal + x
        p = p + 1
    }

    let mean_terminal = sum_terminal / (n_paths as f64)
    sc_abs(mean_terminal - reference)
}

// Compute the path increment covariance estimate between two consecutive
// time steps. For Brownian motion increments, this should be near zero
// (independent increments property).
fn sde_increment_covariance(path: &SDEPath) -> f64 with Panic, Mut, Div {
    let n = path.n_steps
    if n < 2 { return 0.0 }

    // Compute mean of increments
    var sum_inc = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        sum_inc = sum_inc + (path.x[i + 1] - path.x[i])
        i = i + 1
    }
    let mean_inc = sum_inc / (n as f64)

    // Compute covariance of consecutive increments
    var sum_cov = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n - 1 {
        let inc1 = path.x[i + 1] - path.x[i] - mean_inc
        let inc2 = path.x[i + 2] - path.x[i + 1] - mean_inc
        sum_cov = sum_cov + inc1 * inc2
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum_cov / ((n - 1) as f64)
}

// =============================================================================
// Moment Estimation
// =============================================================================

// Compute the k-th moment of the terminal value from Monte Carlo paths.
// E[X_T^k] estimated by (1/n) * sum X_T(i)^k.
fn sde_terminal_moment(
    drift: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    diffusion: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: f64, t0: f64, t_end: f64, n_steps: i32,
    n_paths: i32, seed: i64, k: i32
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let dt = (t_end - t0) / (n_steps as f64)
    let sqrt_dt = sc_sqrt(dt)

    var sum_moment = 0.0
    var p = 0
    while p < n_paths {
        var rng_state: i64 = seed + (p as i64) * 1000033

        var x = x0
        var i = 0
        while i < n_steps {
            let t = t0 + (i as f64) * dt
            let dW = sqrt_dt * sc_box_muller(&!rng_state)
            x = x + drift(t, x) * dt + diffusion(t, x) * dW
            i = i + 1
        }

        // Compute x^k via repeated multiplication
        var x_pow = 1.0
        var j = 0
        while j < k { x_pow = x_pow * x; j = j + 1 }
        sum_moment = sum_moment + x_pow
        p = p + 1
    }

    sum_moment / (n_paths as f64)
}

// =============================================================================
// Absorbed / Reflected Boundary Conditions
// =============================================================================

// Euler-Maruyama with absorbing boundary at x = barrier.
// Once X hits the barrier (from above if barrier < x0, or below if barrier > x0),
// X stays there for all subsequent steps.
fn sde_euler_absorbed(
    drift: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    diffusion: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: f64, t0: f64, t_end: f64, n_steps: i32, seed: i64,
    barrier: f64,
    path: &!SDEPath
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    path.t_start = t0
    path.t_end = t_end
    path.n_steps = n_steps

    let dt = (t_end - t0) / (n_steps as f64)
    let sqrt_dt = sc_sqrt(dt)
    let above = x0 > barrier

    var rng_state: i64 = seed
    path.x[0] = x0
    var absorbed = false

    var i = 0
    while i < n_steps {
        if absorbed {
            path.x[i + 1] = barrier
        } else {
            let t = t0 + (i as f64) * dt
            let x = path.x[i]
            let dW = sqrt_dt * sc_box_muller(&!rng_state)
            let x_new = x + drift(t, x) * dt + diffusion(t, x) * dW

            // Check if path crossed barrier
            if above {
                if x_new <= barrier { absorbed = true; path.x[i + 1] = barrier }
                else { path.x[i + 1] = x_new }
            } else {
                if x_new >= barrier { absorbed = true; path.x[i + 1] = barrier }
                else { path.x[i + 1] = x_new }
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Euler-Maruyama with reflecting boundary at x = barrier.
// If X crosses barrier, it is reflected back: X = 2*barrier - X.
fn sde_euler_reflected(
    drift: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    diffusion: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: f64, t0: f64, t_end: f64, n_steps: i32, seed: i64,
    barrier: f64, reflect_above: bool,
    path: &!SDEPath
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    path.t_start = t0
    path.t_end = t_end
    path.n_steps = n_steps

    let dt = (t_end - t0) / (n_steps as f64)
    let sqrt_dt = sc_sqrt(dt)

    var rng_state: i64 = seed
    path.x[0] = x0

    var i = 0
    while i < n_steps {
        let t = t0 + (i as f64) * dt
        let x = path.x[i]
        let dW = sqrt_dt * sc_box_muller(&!rng_state)
        var x_new = x + drift(t, x) * dt + diffusion(t, x) * dW

        // Reflect if crossing barrier
        if reflect_above {
            // Reflect from above: if x_new > barrier, fold back
            if x_new > barrier { x_new = 2.0 * barrier - x_new }
        } else {
            // Reflect from below: if x_new < barrier, fold back
            if x_new < barrier { x_new = 2.0 * barrier - x_new }
        }

        path.x[i + 1] = x_new
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// First Passage Time Estimation
// =============================================================================

// Estimate the first passage time (FPT) to a level 'barrier' via Monte Carlo.
// Returns the mean first passage time across n_paths simulations.
// If a path never hits the barrier within [t0, t_end], it contributes t_end.
fn sde_first_passage_time(
    drift: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    diffusion: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
    x0: f64, t0: f64, t_end: f64, n_steps: i32,
    barrier: f64, n_paths: i32, seed: i64
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let dt = (t_end - t0) / (n_steps as f64)
    let sqrt_dt = sc_sqrt(dt)
    let above = x0 > barrier

    var sum_fpt = 0.0
    var p = 0
    while p < n_paths {
        var rng_state: i64 = seed + (p as i64) * 1000037
        var x = x0
        var fpt = t_end    // Default: never hit

        var i = 0
        var hit = false
        while i < n_steps {
            if hit == false {
                let t = t0 + (i as f64) * dt
                let dW = sqrt_dt * sc_box_muller(&!rng_state)
                x = x + drift(t, x) * dt + diffusion(t, x) * dW

                // Check crossing
                if above {
                    if x <= barrier { fpt = t + dt; hit = true }
                } else {
                    if x >= barrier { fpt = t + dt; hit = true }
                }
            }
            i = i + 1
        }

        sum_fpt = sum_fpt + fpt
        p = p + 1
    }

    sum_fpt / (n_paths as f64)
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medical/clinical_orc.sio ===
// Clinical Ollivier-Ricci Curvature Pipeline
//
// Unified pipeline for computing epistemic ORC on psychiatric and
// neurological networks: brain connectomes (fMRI/DTI), symptom networks,
// protein-protein interaction networks, and semantic networks.
//
// NOVELTY CLAIMS (all first-of-kind):
//   1. Uncertainty-quantified ORC (every kappa carries sigma)
//   2. GCI (Geometric Certainty Index) as clinical biomarker
//   3. d* (critical embedding dimension) as Cayley-Dickson biomarker
//   4. Phase boundary distance (delta_eta) for treatment response prediction
//   5. Cross-disorder curvature spectrum in unified framework
//
// Depends on: graph::epistemic_curvature, epistemic::core, causal::core

module medical::clinical_orc

// External math
extern "C" {
    fn sqrt(x: f64) -> f64;
}

fn sqrt_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    sqrt(x)
}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

// =============================================================================
// Clinical Network Types
// =============================================================================

pub enum NetworkDomain {
    BrainConnectome,     // fMRI/DTI functional/structural connectivity
    SymptomNetwork,      // psychiatric symptom co-occurrence
    SemanticNetwork,     // word association / knowledge graph
    ProteinInteraction,  // PPI from STRING/BioGRID
}

pub enum ClinicalGroup {
    HealthyControl,
    Depression,          // MDD, includes severity levels
    ADHD,
    Autism,              // ASD
    Schizophrenia,
    Alzheimers,
    Parkinsons,
    Epilepsy,
    Other,
}

pub enum DepressionSeverity {
    Minimum,
    Mild,
    Moderate,
    Severe,
}

// Subject-level clinical metadata
pub struct SubjectMetadata {
    pub subject_id: i64,
    pub group: ClinicalGroup,
    pub age: f64,
    pub sex: i64,            // 0=female, 1=male, 2=other
    pub severity_score: f64, // PHQ-9, GAD-7, ADOS, etc.
    pub medication: bool,
    pub mean_fd: f64,        // mean framewise displacement (motion)
}

// =============================================================================
// Clinical Curvature Profile — Per-Subject Result
// =============================================================================

pub struct ClinicalCurvatureProfile {
    // Subject info
    pub subject_id: i64,
    pub group: ClinicalGroup,
    pub domain: NetworkDomain,

    // Network topology
    pub n_nodes: usize,
    pub n_edges: usize,
    pub mean_degree: f64,
    pub clustering: f64,
    pub eta: f64,               // k^2/N

    // Epistemic ORC results
    pub mean_kappa: f64,
    pub sigma_mean_kappa: f64,  // SE of mean
    pub std_kappa: f64,         // edge-level SD
    pub min_kappa: f64,
    pub max_kappa: f64,

    // Novel biomarkers
    pub gci: f64,               // Geometric Certainty Index [0,1]
    pub eta_c_predicted: f64,   // analytical phase boundary
    pub delta_eta: f64,         // distance from boundary (treatment predictor)
    pub d_star: f64,            // critical embedding dimension (0 if no crossing)
    pub d_star_found: bool,

    // Per-edge curvature distribution
    pub frac_hyperbolic: f64,
    pub frac_euclidean: f64,
    pub frac_spherical: f64,
    pub frac_uncertain: f64,    // edges where CI crosses geometry boundary

    // Confidence
    pub mean_confidence: f64,
    pub dominant_geometry: i64,  // 0=hyp, 1=euc, 2=sph, 3=uncertain
}

// =============================================================================
// Cross-Disorder Comparison — Multi-Subject Result
// =============================================================================

pub struct CrossDisorderResult {
    pub n_subjects: usize,

    // Per-group summaries
    pub group_labels: [i64],         // ClinicalGroup codes
    pub group_sizes: [usize],
    pub group_mean_kappa: [f64],
    pub group_std_kappa: [f64],
    pub group_mean_gci: [f64],
    pub group_mean_delta_eta: [f64],
    pub group_mean_d_star: [f64],

    // Statistical tests (t-test between pairs)
    pub pairwise_t_stats: [f64],     // flattened upper-triangle
    pub pairwise_p_values: [f64],

    // Effect sizes (Cohen's d)
    pub pairwise_cohens_d: [f64],

    // Curvature spectrum ordering (sorted by mean kappa)
    pub spectrum_order: [i64],       // group indices sorted ascending by kappa
}

// =============================================================================
// Treatment Response Prediction
// =============================================================================

pub struct TreatmentPrediction {
    pub subject_id: i64,
    pub delta_eta_baseline: f64,   // distance from phase boundary at baseline
    pub kappa_baseline: f64,
    pub gci_baseline: f64,
    pub predicted_response: f64,   // probability of response [0,1]
    pub confidence: f64,           // epistemic confidence in prediction
}

// Predict treatment response from curvature features
// Hypothesis: patients near phase boundary (small |delta_eta|) are more responsive
pub fn predict_treatment_response(
    profile: &ClinicalCurvatureProfile,
    population_mean_delta_eta: f64,
    population_std_delta_eta: f64
) -> TreatmentPrediction {
    // Normalize delta_eta to z-score
    let z_delta = if population_std_delta_eta > 1e-10 {
        (profile.delta_eta - population_mean_delta_eta) / population_std_delta_eta
    } else { 0.0 }

    // Patients near boundary (z ≈ 0) predicted more responsive
    // Using a sigmoid centered at boundary: P(response) = 1 / (1 + exp(|z| - 1))
    let abs_z = abs_f64(z_delta)
    let logit = abs_z - 1.0
    let exp_neg_logit = if logit > 20.0 { 0.0 }
        else if logit < -20.0 { 1.0 }
        else {
            // exp(-logit) approximation
            var scaled = (0.0 - logit) / 16.0
            let x2 = scaled * scaled
            let x3 = x2 * scaled
            let x4 = x3 * scaled
            var r = 1.0 + scaled + x2/2.0 + x3/6.0 + x4/24.0
            var i: usize = 0
            while i < 16 { r = r * r; i = i + 1 }
            r
        }

    let predicted_response = 1.0 / (1.0 + exp_neg_logit)

    // Confidence: higher when GCI is high and delta_eta is precise
    let conf = profile.gci * profile.mean_confidence

    TreatmentPrediction {
        subject_id: profile.subject_id,
        delta_eta_baseline: profile.delta_eta,
        kappa_baseline: profile.mean_kappa,
        gci_baseline: profile.gci,
        predicted_response,
        confidence: conf,
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Curvature Trajectory (Severity Progression)
// =============================================================================

// Track curvature across severity levels or time points
pub struct CurvatureTrajectory {
    pub labels: [i64],           // severity codes or time indices
    pub kappas: [f64],           // mean kappa at each point
    pub sigma_kappas: [f64],     // uncertainty at each point
    pub gcis: [f64],             // GCI at each point
    pub delta_etas: [f64],       // phase boundary distance at each point
    pub trend_slope: f64,        // linear trend (positive = toward spherical)
    pub trend_p_value: f64,      // significance of trend
}

// Compute linear trend from trajectory
pub fn compute_trajectory_trend(
    x: &[f64],      // severity scores or time points
    y: &[f64],      // kappa values
    sigma: &[f64]   // uncertainties (for weighted regression)
) -> CurvatureTrajectory {
    let n = x.len()
    if n < 2 {
        return CurvatureTrajectory {
            labels: [], kappas: [], sigma_kappas: [],
            gcis: [], delta_etas: [],
            trend_slope: 0.0, trend_p_value: 1.0,
        }
    }

    // Weighted least squares: y = a + b*x
    // w_i = 1/sigma_i^2 (inverse-variance weighting)
    var sum_w: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_wx: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_wy: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_wxx: f64 = 0.0
    var sum_wxy: f64 = 0.0
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < n {
        let w = if sigma[i] > 1e-10 { 1.0 / (sigma[i] * sigma[i]) } else { 1.0 }
        sum_w = sum_w + w
        sum_wx = sum_wx + w * x[i]
        sum_wy = sum_wy + w * y[i]
        sum_wxx = sum_wxx + w * x[i] * x[i]
        sum_wxy = sum_wxy + w * x[i] * y[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    let denom = sum_w * sum_wxx - sum_wx * sum_wx
    let slope = if abs_f64(denom) > 1e-15 {
        (sum_w * sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy) / denom
    } else { 0.0 }

    // p-value approximation: use t-test on slope
    // sigma_slope^2 = sum_w / denom (simplified)
    let sigma_slope = if abs_f64(denom) > 1e-15 {
        sqrt_f64(sum_w / abs_f64(denom))
    } else { 1e10 }

    let t_stat = if sigma_slope > 1e-10 { slope / sigma_slope } else { 0.0 }
    // p ≈ 2 * exp(-t^2/2) (very rough normal approximation)
    let t2 = t_stat * t_stat
    var p_approx = 1.0
    if t2 > 0.0 {
        // exp(-t^2/2) approximation
        var scaled = (0.0 - t2 / 2.0) / 16.0
        let x2 = scaled * scaled
        let x3 = x2 * scaled
        var r = 1.0 + scaled + x2/2.0 + x3/6.0
        var k: usize = 0
        while k < 16 { r = r * r; k = k + 1 }
        p_approx = 2.0 * r
        if p_approx > 1.0 { p_approx = 1.0 }
    }

    // Copy inputs
    var ks: [f64] = []
    var sigs: [f64] = []
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        ks.push(y[i])
        sigs.push(sigma[i])
        i = i + 1
    }

    CurvatureTrajectory {
        labels: [],
        kappas: ks,
        sigma_kappas: sigs,
        gcis: [],
        delta_etas: [],
        trend_slope: slope,
        trend_p_value: p_approx,
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// PPI Network Analysis (RQ5: Neurodegeneration)
// =============================================================================

// Build PPI graph at a confidence threshold
// STRING scores are in [0, 1000], we normalize to [0, 1]
pub struct PPIEdge {
    pub protein_a: usize,
    pub protein_b: usize,
    pub confidence: f64,     // STRING combined_score / 1000
}

// Sweep confidence thresholds to find curvature phase transition
pub struct PPIPhaseTrajectory {
    pub thresholds: [f64],
    pub etas: [f64],
    pub kappas: [f64],
    pub sigma_kappas: [f64],
    pub n_edges_at_threshold: [usize],
    pub eta_c_crossing: f64,  // threshold where eta crosses eta_c
    pub has_sign_change: bool,
}

pub fn sweep_ppi_thresholds(
    edges: &[PPIEdge],
    n_proteins: usize,
    thresholds: &[f64]
) -> PPIPhaseTrajectory {
    let n_thresholds = thresholds.len()
    var etas: [f64] = []
    var kappas: [f64] = []
    var sigma_kappas: [f64] = []
    var n_edges_list: [usize] = []

    var t_idx: usize = 0
    while t_idx < n_thresholds {
        let threshold = thresholds[t_idx]

        // Build adjacency at this threshold
        var adj: [[usize]] = []
        var i: usize = 0
        while i < n_proteins {
            adj.push([])
            i = i + 1
        }

        var n_edges: usize = 0
        var e_idx: usize = 0
        while e_idx < edges.len() {
            if edges[e_idx].confidence >= threshold {
                let a = edges[e_idx].protein_a
                let b = edges[e_idx].protein_b
                adj[a].push(b)
                adj[b].push(a)
                n_edges = n_edges + 1
            }
            e_idx = e_idx + 1
        }

        // Compute eta = k^2/N
        var total_deg: usize = 0
        i = 0
        while i < n_proteins {
            total_deg = total_deg + adj[i].len()
            i = i + 1
        }
        let mean_k = (total_deg as f64) / (n_proteins as f64)
        let eta = mean_k * mean_k / (n_proteins as f64)

        etas.push(eta)
        n_edges_list.push(n_edges)

        // For PPI, cost uncertainty comes from STRING confidence scores
        // sigma_d ≈ (1 - confidence) for each edge on the path
        // Simplified: use mean (1-confidence) as uniform cost uncertainty
        // Skip full ORC for empty graphs
        if n_edges < 2 {
            kappas.push(0.0)
            sigma_kappas.push(0.0)
        } else {
            // Use Hehl analytical approximation for speed
            // Full Sinkhorn ORC is too slow for threshold sweeps
            var clustering: f64 = 0.0  // approximate
            let kappa_approx = hehl_kappa_internal(mean_k, eta, clustering, n_proteins as f64, 0.5)
            kappas.push(kappa_approx)
            // Uncertainty from threshold sensitivity: delta_kappa/delta_threshold
            sigma_kappas.push(0.05)  // placeholder — refine with bootstrap
        }

        t_idx = t_idx + 1
    }

    // Find sign change
    var has_sign_change = false
    var eta_c_crossing: f64 = 0.0
    var idx: usize = 0
    while idx < n_thresholds - 1 {
        if (kappas[idx] < 0.0 && kappas[idx + 1] >= 0.0) ||
           (kappas[idx] >= 0.0 && kappas[idx + 1] < 0.0) {
            has_sign_change = true
            // Linear interpolation
            let f = abs_f64(kappas[idx]) / (abs_f64(kappas[idx]) + abs_f64(kappas[idx + 1]))
            eta_c_crossing = thresholds[idx] + f * (thresholds[idx + 1] - thresholds[idx])
        }
        idx = idx + 1
    }

    // Copy thresholds
    var ts: [f64] = []
    idx = 0
    while idx < n_thresholds {
        ts.push(thresholds[idx])
        idx = idx + 1
    }

    PPIPhaseTrajectory {
        thresholds: ts, etas, kappas, sigma_kappas,
        n_edges_at_threshold: n_edges_list,
        eta_c_crossing, has_sign_change,
    }
}

// Internal Hehl kappa (to avoid circular dependency)
fn hehl_kappa_internal(k: f64, eta: f64, clustering: f64, n_nodes: f64, alpha: f64) -> f64 {
    if k < 2.0 { return 0.0 }
    let t_clust = clustering * (k - 1.0)
    let t_rand = (k - 1.0) * (k - 1.0) / (n_nodes - 1.0)
    var t = if t_clust > t_rand { t_clust } else { t_rand }
    if t < 0.0 { t = 0.0 }
    if t > k - 1.0 { t = k - 1.0 }
    let n_exc = k - 1.0 - t
    if n_exc < 1e-10 { return 1.0 - alpha }

    let p_edge = eta / k
    // exp approximation
    var val = 0.0 - p_edge * n_exc
    if val < -20.0 { val = -20.0 }
    var scaled = val / 16.0
    let x2 = scaled * scaled
    let x3 = x2 * scaled
    let x4 = x3 * scaled
    var exp_val = 1.0 + scaled + x2/2.0 + x3/6.0 + x4/24.0
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < 16 { exp_val = exp_val * exp_val; i = i + 1 }

    let expected_matching = n_exc * (1.0 - exp_val)
    let f_m = expected_matching / n_exc
    let mass_exc = (1.0 - alpha) * n_exc / k
    let w1 = alpha + mass_exc * (f_m + 3.0 * (1.0 - f_m))
    1.0 - w1
}

// =============================================================================
// Causal Curvature Framework (RQ4)
// =============================================================================

// Causal effect of treatment on curvature change
pub struct CausalCurvatureEffect {
    pub ate_delta_kappa: f64,       // average treatment effect on kappa change
    pub sigma_ate: f64,             // uncertainty on ATE
    pub ci_lower: f64,
    pub ci_upper: f64,
    pub e_value: f64,               // sensitivity to unmeasured confounding
    pub mediated_through_clustering: f64,  // proportion mediated via delta_C
    pub is_significant: bool,       // p < 0.05
}

// Compute E-value for sensitivity analysis
// E = effect + sqrt(effect * (effect - 1))
// Minimum unmeasured confounder strength to explain away the effect
pub fn compute_e_value(effect_rr: f64) -> f64 {
    if effect_rr <= 1.0 { return 1.0 }
    effect_rr + sqrt_f64(effect_rr * (effect_rr - 1.0))
}

// =============================================================================
// 7-Dimensional Feature Vector for Cross-Disorder Classification
// =============================================================================
//
// Maps naturally to quaternion pairs for hypercomplex classification:
//   q1 = (kappa_mean, kappa_std, GCI, eta)
//   q2 = (clustering, d_star, delta_eta, 0)

pub struct CurvatureFeatureVector {
    pub kappa_mean: f64,
    pub kappa_std: f64,
    pub gci: f64,
    pub eta: f64,
    pub clustering: f64,
    pub d_star: f64,
    pub delta_eta: f64,
}

pub fn extract_features(profile: &ClinicalCurvatureProfile) -> CurvatureFeatureVector {
    CurvatureFeatureVector {
        kappa_mean: profile.mean_kappa,
        kappa_std: profile.std_kappa,
        gci: profile.gci,
        eta: profile.eta,
        clustering: profile.clustering,
        d_star: profile.d_star,
        delta_eta: profile.delta_eta,
    }
}

// Normalize features to [0, 1] range using population statistics
pub fn normalize_features(
    features: &CurvatureFeatureVector,
    pop_min: &CurvatureFeatureVector,
    pop_max: &CurvatureFeatureVector
) -> CurvatureFeatureVector {
    let range = |val: f64, lo: f64, hi: f64| -> f64 {
        if abs_f64(hi - lo) < 1e-10 { 0.5 }
        else { (val - lo) / (hi - lo) }
    }

    CurvatureFeatureVector {
        kappa_mean: range(features.kappa_mean, pop_min.kappa_mean, pop_max.kappa_mean),
        kappa_std: range(features.kappa_std, pop_min.kappa_std, pop_max.kappa_std),
        gci: range(features.gci, pop_min.gci, pop_max.gci),
        eta: range(features.eta, pop_min.eta, pop_max.eta),
        clustering: range(features.clustering, pop_min.clustering, pop_max.clustering),
        d_star: range(features.d_star, pop_min.d_star, pop_max.d_star),
        delta_eta: range(features.delta_eta, pop_min.delta_eta, pop_max.delta_eta),
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Tests
// =============================================================================

pub fn test_treatment_prediction() -> bool {
    let profile = ClinicalCurvatureProfile {
        subject_id: 1, group: ClinicalGroup::Depression,
        domain: NetworkDomain::BrainConnectome,
        n_nodes: 200, n_edges: 4000, mean_degree: 40.0,
        clustering: 0.15, eta: 8.0,
        mean_kappa: -0.05, sigma_mean_kappa: 0.01, std_kappa: 0.2,
        min_kappa: -0.5, max_kappa: 0.3,
        gci: 0.6, eta_c_predicted: 3.0, delta_eta: 5.0,
        d_star: 6.5, d_star_found: true,
        frac_hyperbolic: 0.4, frac_euclidean: 0.2,
        frac_spherical: 0.3, frac_uncertain: 0.1,
        mean_confidence: 0.8, dominant_geometry: 0,
    }

    let pred = predict_treatment_response(&profile, 3.0, 2.0)
    // Should produce a valid prediction
    pred.predicted_response >= 0.0 && pred.predicted_response <= 1.0
}

pub fn test_e_value() -> bool {
    // E-value of 1.0 means no confounding needed (null effect)
    let e1 = compute_e_value(1.0)
    // E-value > 1 for positive effect
    let e2 = compute_e_value(2.0)

    e1 == 1.0 && e2 > 2.0
}

pub fn test_feature_extraction() -> bool {
    let profile = ClinicalCurvatureProfile {
        subject_id: 1, group: ClinicalGroup::HealthyControl,
        domain: NetworkDomain::BrainConnectome,
        n_nodes: 100, n_edges: 2000, mean_degree: 40.0,
        clustering: 0.12, eta: 16.0,
        mean_kappa: 0.1, sigma_mean_kappa: 0.005, std_kappa: 0.15,
        min_kappa: -0.3, max_kappa: 0.5,
        gci: 0.85, eta_c_predicted: 3.2, delta_eta: 12.8,
        d_star: 4.0, d_star_found: true,
        frac_hyperbolic: 0.1, frac_euclidean: 0.2,
        frac_spherical: 0.6, frac_uncertain: 0.1,
        mean_confidence: 0.9, dominant_geometry: 2,
    }

    let features = extract_features(&profile)
    features.kappa_mean == 0.1 && features.gci == 0.85 && features.d_star == 4.0
}

pub fn test_trajectory_trend() -> bool {
    // Severity scores: 0 (min), 1 (mild), 2 (moderate), 3 (severe)
    let x: [f64] = [0.0, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0]
    // Kappa values: depression gets less hyperbolic with severity
    let y: [f64] = [-0.13, -0.07, -0.065, -0.074]
    let sigma: [f64] = [0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01]

    let traj = compute_trajectory_trend(&x, &y, &sigma)
    // Slope should be positive (toward less negative = less hyperbolic)
    traj.trend_slope > 0.0
}

pub fn run_clinical_orc_tests() -> bool {
    test_treatment_prediction() &&
    test_e_value() &&
    test_feature_extraction() &&
    test_trajectory_trend()
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medical/docking.sio ===
// stdlib/medical/docking.sio — Molecular Scoring Functions
//
// Protein-ligand interaction energy scoring in SE(3).
// Implements Lennard-Jones van der Waals, Coulomb electrostatics,
// hydrogen bond geometry, desolvation penalty, and a weighted
// composite score with epistemic uncertainty.
//
// Rigid-body docking model: the ligand is decomposed into rigid
// fragments connected by rotatable bonds.  Each fragment undergoes
// SE(3) transformation (rotation + translation) before scoring
// against the binding-site pocket atoms.
//
// SOTA references:
//   SigmaDock  (Qu+ 2025): diffusion on SE(3), 79.9% success < 2 A RMSD
//   DiffDock   (Corso+ 2022): generative diffusion docking, arXiv:2210.01776
//   Matcha     (Hua+ 2025): geometry-aware transformer scoring
//   AutoDock4  (Morris+ 2009): empirical free-energy scoring function
//   Vina       (Trott & Olson 2010): improved AutoDock scoring
//
// Scoring model (AutoDock4-style):
//   E_total = w_vdw * E_vdw + w_elec * E_elec + w_hb * E_hb + w_desolv * E_desolv
//   E_vdw   = sum_ij 4*eps*((sigma/r)^12 - (sigma/r)^6)
//   E_elec  = sum_ij 332.0637 * q_i*q_j / (eps_r * r_ij)
//   E_hb    = geometry-dependent (distance + angle)
//   E_desolv= sum_ij S_i * V_j * exp(-r^2 / (2*sigma_s^2))

// ============================================================================
// Math Helpers (inline; no libm dependency)
// ============================================================================

fn dock_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn dock_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 30 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn dock_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 500.0 { return 1.0e200 }
    if x < -500.0 { return 0.0 }
    let ln2 = 0.6931471805599453
    var k_f = x / ln2
    var k: i32 = 0
    if k_f >= 0.0 { k = k_f as i32 } else { k = (k_f as i32) - 1 }
    let r = x - (k as f64) * ln2
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var n = 1
    while n < 25 { term = term * r / (n as f64); sum = sum + term; n = n + 1 }
    var result = sum
    if k >= 0 {
        var i = 0
        while i < k { result = result * 2.0; i = i + 1 }
    } else {
        var i = 0
        while i < (0 - k) { result = result / 2.0; i = i + 1 }
    }
    result
}

// x^6 via repeated squaring: x^2, x^4, x^6 = x^4 * x^2
fn dock_pow6(x: f64) -> f64 {
    let x2 = x * x
    let x4 = x2 * x2
    x4 * x2
}

fn dock_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { a } else { b }
}

fn dock_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

fn dock_clamp(x: f64, lo: f64, hi: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < lo { lo }
    else if x > hi { hi }
    else { x }
}

// ============================================================================
// Core Types
// ============================================================================

// A single atom with 3D coordinates, partial charge, and vdW parameters
struct Atom3D {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    z: f64,
    charge: f64,        // partial charge (e)
    element: i32,       // 1=H, 6=C, 7=N, 8=O, 16=S, etc.
    vdw_radius: f64,    // Lennard-Jones sigma (A)
    vdw_well: f64,      // Lennard-Jones epsilon (kcal/mol)
}

// A rigid fragment of the ligand (torsion-free subunit)
struct RigidFragment {
    atoms: [Atom3D; 64],
    n_atoms: i32,
    centroid_x: f64,
    centroid_y: f64,
    centroid_z: f64,
}

// Full ligand pose: collection of rigid fragments + global SE(3) transform
struct LigandPose {
    fragments: [RigidFragment; 8],
    n_fragments: i32,
    rotation: [f64; 9],     // 3x3 rotation matrix (row-major)
    translation: [f64; 3],  // translation vector (A)
}

// Binding site (protein pocket atoms)
struct BindingSite {
    pocket_atoms: [Atom3D; 256],
    n_atoms: i32,
    center: [f64; 3],       // geometric center of pocket
}

// Composite docking score with uncertainty
struct DockingScore {
    vdw_energy: f64,        // van der Waals (kcal/mol)
    electrostatic: f64,     // Coulomb (kcal/mol)
    hbond: f64,             // hydrogen bond (kcal/mol)
    desolvation: f64,       // desolvation penalty (kcal/mol)
    total: f64,             // weighted sum
    u_total: f64,           // uncertainty on total (GUM propagation)
    confidence: f64,        // [0,1] confidence based on scoring breakdown
}

// ============================================================================
// Distance & Geometry
// ============================================================================

fn atom3d_distance(a: &Atom3D, b: &Atom3D) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let dx = a.x - b.x
    let dy = a.y - b.y
    let dz = a.z - b.z
    dock_sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
}

fn atom3d_distance_sq(a: &Atom3D, b: &Atom3D) -> f64 {
    let dx = a.x - b.x
    let dy = a.y - b.y
    let dz = a.z - b.z
    dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
}

// Angle at atom B in the triple A-B-C (returns cosine of angle)
fn atom3d_cos_angle(a: &Atom3D, b: &Atom3D, c: &Atom3D) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let bax = a.x - b.x
    let bay = a.y - b.y
    let baz = a.z - b.z
    let bcx = c.x - b.x
    let bcy = c.y - b.y
    let bcz = c.z - b.z
    let dot = bax * bcx + bay * bcy + baz * bcz
    let mag_ba = dock_sqrt(bax * bax + bay * bay + baz * baz)
    let mag_bc = dock_sqrt(bcx * bcx + bcy * bcy + bcz * bcz)
    let denom = mag_ba * mag_bc
    if denom < 1.0e-15 { return 0.0 }
    dock_clamp(dot / denom, 0.0 - 1.0, 1.0)
}

// ============================================================================
// Lennard-Jones Potential (pure — no effects)
// ============================================================================
// V_LJ = 4 * epsilon * ((sigma/r)^12 - (sigma/r)^6)

fn lennard_jones(r: f64, epsilon: f64, sigma: f64) -> f64 {
    if r < 0.01 { return 1.0e10 }   // prevent singularity
    let sr = sigma / r
    let sr6 = dock_pow6(sr)
    let sr12 = sr6 * sr6
    4.0 * epsilon * (sr12 - sr6)
}

// ============================================================================
// Coulomb Electrostatic Score
// ============================================================================
// E = 332.0637 * q1 * q2 / (dielectric * r)
// 332.0637 converts (e^2 / A) to kcal/mol

fn coulomb_score(q1: f64, q2: f64, r: f64, dielectric: f64) -> f64 with Panic {
    if r < 0.1 { return 332.0637 * q1 * q2 / (dielectric * 0.1) }
    332.0637 * q1 * q2 / (dielectric * r)
}

// ============================================================================
// Hydrogen Bond Score
// ============================================================================
// Geometry-dependent HB: E_hb = E_opt * f(r) * g(angle)
// f(r) = (r_opt / r)^12 - 2*(r_opt / r)^6  (10-12 is classic, simplified to 6-12 here)
// g(angle) = cos^2(theta)  where theta = D-H...A angle
// E_opt = -5.0 kcal/mol (typical strong HB)

fn hbond_score(
    donor: &Atom3D,
    acceptor: &Atom3D,
    h_atom: &Atom3D
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let r = atom3d_distance(h_atom, acceptor)
    if r < 0.01 { return 0.0 }
    if r > 3.5 { return 0.0 }   // beyond HB cutoff

    // Distance term: 12-6 potential centered at r_opt = 1.9 A
    let r_opt = 1.9
    let sr = r_opt / r
    let sr6 = dock_pow6(sr)
    let sr12 = sr6 * sr6
    let f_r = sr12 - 2.0 * sr6

    // Angle term: cos^2(D-H...A angle)
    let cos_theta = atom3d_cos_angle(donor, h_atom, acceptor)
    // Only count if angle > 120 degrees (cos < -0.5 in supplementary)
    // Actually D-H...A should be roughly linear, so cos_theta should be near -1
    // Convention: angle at H, vectors H->D and H->A
    // For a good HB, the D-H...A angle ~ 180 deg -> cos ~ -1
    let g_angle = cos_theta * cos_theta

    let e_opt = 0.0 - 5.0
    e_opt * f_r * g_angle
}

// ============================================================================
// Aggregate Scoring Functions
// ============================================================================

// Sum LJ over all ligand-atom / pocket-atom pairs
fn score_vdw(pose: &LigandPose, site: &BindingSite) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var total = 0.0
    var fi = 0
    while fi < pose.n_fragments {
        var lai = 0
        while lai < pose.fragments[fi].n_atoms {
            var pai = 0
            while pai < site.n_atoms {
                let r = atom3d_distance(&pose.fragments[fi].atoms[lai], &site.pocket_atoms[pai])
                // Combining rules (Lorentz-Berthelot)
                let eps = dock_sqrt(pose.fragments[fi].atoms[lai].vdw_well * site.pocket_atoms[pai].vdw_well)
                let sig = 0.5 * (pose.fragments[fi].atoms[lai].vdw_radius + site.pocket_atoms[pai].vdw_radius)
                // Cutoff at 8 A
                if r < 8.0 {
                    total = total + lennard_jones(r, eps, sig)
                }
                pai = pai + 1
            }
            lai = lai + 1
        }
        fi = fi + 1
    }
    total
}

// Sum Coulomb over all ligand-atom / pocket-atom pairs
fn score_electrostatic(pose: &LigandPose, site: &BindingSite) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let dielectric = 4.0   // distance-dependent dielectric ~ 4r simplified to const
    var total = 0.0
    var fi = 0
    while fi < pose.n_fragments {
        var lai = 0
        while lai < pose.fragments[fi].n_atoms {
            var pai = 0
            while pai < site.n_atoms {
                let r = atom3d_distance(&pose.fragments[fi].atoms[lai], &site.pocket_atoms[pai])
                if r < 12.0 {
                    total = total + coulomb_score(
                        pose.fragments[fi].atoms[lai].charge,
                        site.pocket_atoms[pai].charge,
                        r,
                        dielectric
                    )
                }
                pai = pai + 1
            }
            lai = lai + 1
        }
        fi = fi + 1
    }
    total
}

// Desolvation penalty (Gaussian burial model from AutoDock4)
// E_desolv = sum_ij S_i * V_j * exp(-r_ij^2 / (2 * sigma_s^2))
// S_i = atomic solvation parameter, V_j = fragmental volume
// Simplified: S ~ charge^2 * 0.01, V ~ vdw_radius^3
fn score_desolvation(pose: &LigandPose, site: &BindingSite) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let sigma_s_sq = 3.5 * 3.5   // sigma_s = 3.5 A
    let two_sigma_sq = 2.0 * sigma_s_sq
    var total = 0.0
    var fi = 0
    while fi < pose.n_fragments {
        var lai = 0
        while lai < pose.fragments[fi].n_atoms {
            let s_i = pose.fragments[fi].atoms[lai].charge * pose.fragments[fi].atoms[lai].charge * 0.01
            var pai = 0
            while pai < site.n_atoms {
                let r_sq = atom3d_distance_sq(&pose.fragments[fi].atoms[lai], &site.pocket_atoms[pai])
                if r_sq < 64.0 {   // cutoff at 8 A
                    let v_j = site.pocket_atoms[pai].vdw_radius * site.pocket_atoms[pai].vdw_radius * site.pocket_atoms[pai].vdw_radius
                    total = total + s_i * v_j * dock_exp(0.0 - r_sq / two_sigma_sq)
                }
                pai = pai + 1
            }
            lai = lai + 1
        }
        fi = fi + 1
    }
    total
}

// ============================================================================
// Composite Pose Scoring — Weighted Sum with Uncertainty
// ============================================================================
// Weights from AutoDock4 calibration (Huey+ 2007):
//   w_vdw = 0.1662, w_elec = 0.1209, w_hb = 0.1406, w_desolv = 0.1322
// Uncertainty: propagated from individual score uncertainties (GUM)

fn score_pose(pose: &LigandPose, site: &BindingSite) -> DockingScore with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let e_vdw = score_vdw(pose, site)
    let e_elec = score_electrostatic(pose, site)
    let e_desolv = score_desolvation(pose, site)

    // Hydrogen bond score: check all N/O ligand atoms vs N/O pocket atoms
    // with H atoms as intermediaries (simplified: skip explicit H search,
    // use donor-acceptor distance directly with distance-only HB model)
    var e_hb = 0.0
    var fi = 0
    while fi < pose.n_fragments {
        var lai = 0
        while lai < pose.fragments[fi].n_atoms {
            let l_elem = pose.fragments[fi].atoms[lai].element
            // Check if ligand atom is N(7) or O(8) — potential donor/acceptor
            if l_elem == 7 {
                var pai = 0
                while pai < site.n_atoms {
                    let p_elem = site.pocket_atoms[pai].element
                    if p_elem == 7 {
                        // N...N: use simplified distance-only HB
                        let r = atom3d_distance(&pose.fragments[fi].atoms[lai], &site.pocket_atoms[pai])
                        if r > 1.5 {
                            if r < 3.2 {
                                let r_opt = 2.9
                                let sr = r_opt / r
                                let sr6 = dock_pow6(sr)
                                let sr12 = sr6 * sr6
                                e_hb = e_hb + (0.0 - 3.0) * (sr12 - 2.0 * sr6)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if p_elem == 8 {
                        let r = atom3d_distance(&pose.fragments[fi].atoms[lai], &site.pocket_atoms[pai])
                        if r > 1.5 {
                            if r < 3.2 {
                                let r_opt = 2.8
                                let sr = r_opt / r
                                let sr6 = dock_pow6(sr)
                                let sr12 = sr6 * sr6
                                e_hb = e_hb + (0.0 - 4.0) * (sr12 - 2.0 * sr6)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    pai = pai + 1
                }
            }
            if l_elem == 8 {
                var pai2 = 0
                while pai2 < site.n_atoms {
                    let p_elem2 = site.pocket_atoms[pai2].element
                    if p_elem2 == 7 {
                        let r = atom3d_distance(&pose.fragments[fi].atoms[lai], &site.pocket_atoms[pai2])
                        if r > 1.5 {
                            if r < 3.2 {
                                let r_opt = 2.8
                                let sr = r_opt / r
                                let sr6 = dock_pow6(sr)
                                let sr12 = sr6 * sr6
                                e_hb = e_hb + (0.0 - 4.0) * (sr12 - 2.0 * sr6)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if p_elem2 == 8 {
                        let r = atom3d_distance(&pose.fragments[fi].atoms[lai], &site.pocket_atoms[pai2])
                        if r > 1.5 {
                            if r < 3.2 {
                                let r_opt = 2.7
                                let sr = r_opt / r
                                let sr6 = dock_pow6(sr)
                                let sr12 = sr6 * sr6
                                e_hb = e_hb + (0.0 - 5.0) * (sr12 - 2.0 * sr6)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    pai2 = pai2 + 1
                }
            }
            lai = lai + 1
        }
        fi = fi + 1
    }

    // Weighted sum
    let w_vdw = 0.1662
    let w_elec = 0.1209
    let w_hb = 0.1406
    let w_desolv = 0.1322

    let total = w_vdw * e_vdw + w_elec * e_elec + w_hb * e_hb + w_desolv * e_desolv

    // Uncertainty propagation (GUM): u_total = sqrt(sum(w_i^2 * u_i^2))
    // Estimate component uncertainties as fraction of magnitude
    let u_vdw = dock_abs(e_vdw) * 0.15      // 15% relative uncertainty
    let u_elec = dock_abs(e_elec) * 0.20     // 20% (charge model is approximate)
    let u_hb = dock_abs(e_hb) * 0.25         // 25% (geometry-sensitive)
    let u_desolv = dock_abs(e_desolv) * 0.30 // 30% (empirical)

    let u_total = dock_sqrt(
        w_vdw * w_vdw * u_vdw * u_vdw
        + w_elec * w_elec * u_elec * u_elec
        + w_hb * w_hb * u_hb * u_hb
        + w_desolv * w_desolv * u_desolv * u_desolv
    )

    // Confidence: penalize if any single term dominates (balanced is more reliable)
    let abs_total = dock_abs(total) + 1.0e-10
    let frac_vdw = dock_abs(w_vdw * e_vdw) / abs_total
    let frac_elec = dock_abs(w_elec * e_elec) / abs_total
    let max_frac = dock_max(frac_vdw, frac_elec)
    let confidence = dock_clamp(1.0 - max_frac, 0.1, 0.95)

    DockingScore {
        vdw_energy: e_vdw,
        electrostatic: e_elec,
        hbond: e_hb,
        desolvation: e_desolv,
        total: total,
        u_total: u_total,
        confidence: confidence,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// SE(3) Rigid-Body Transforms
// ============================================================================

// Apply 3x3 rotation matrix to all atoms in a fragment (in-place)
// rot is row-major: rot[0..2] = row 0, rot[3..5] = row 1, rot[6..8] = row 2
fn rotate_fragment(frag: &!RigidFragment, rot: &[f64; 9]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < frag.n_atoms {
        let ox = frag.atoms[i].x
        let oy = frag.atoms[i].y
        let oz = frag.atoms[i].z
        frag.atoms[i].x = rot[0] * ox + rot[1] * oy + rot[2] * oz
        frag.atoms[i].y = rot[3] * ox + rot[4] * oy + rot[5] * oz
        frag.atoms[i].z = rot[6] * ox + rot[7] * oy + rot[8] * oz
        i = i + 1
    }
    // Recompute centroid after rotation
    compute_centroid(frag)
}

// Translate all atoms in a fragment by (dx, dy, dz)
fn translate_fragment(frag: &!RigidFragment, dx: f64, dy: f64, dz: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < frag.n_atoms {
        frag.atoms[i].x = frag.atoms[i].x + dx
        frag.atoms[i].y = frag.atoms[i].y + dy
        frag.atoms[i].z = frag.atoms[i].z + dz
        i = i + 1
    }
    frag.centroid_x = frag.centroid_x + dx
    frag.centroid_y = frag.centroid_y + dy
    frag.centroid_z = frag.centroid_z + dz
}

// Recompute centroid from current atom positions
fn compute_centroid(frag: &!RigidFragment) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if frag.n_atoms == 0 {
        frag.centroid_x = 0.0
        frag.centroid_y = 0.0
        frag.centroid_z = 0.0
        return
    }
    var sx = 0.0
    var sy = 0.0
    var sz = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < frag.n_atoms {
        sx = sx + frag.atoms[i].x
        sy = sy + frag.atoms[i].y
        sz = sz + frag.atoms[i].z
        i = i + 1
    }
    let n = frag.n_atoms as f64
    frag.centroid_x = sx / n
    frag.centroid_y = sy / n
    frag.centroid_z = sz / n
}

// ============================================================================
// RMSD Between Two Fragments (same atom count assumed)
// ============================================================================
// RMSD = sqrt( (1/N) * sum_i ||a_i - b_i||^2 )

fn fragment_rmsd(a: &RigidFragment, b: &RigidFragment) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = if a.n_atoms < b.n_atoms { a.n_atoms } else { b.n_atoms }
    if n == 0 { return 0.0 }
    var sum_sq = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let dx = a.atoms[i].x - b.atoms[i].x
        let dy = a.atoms[i].y - b.atoms[i].y
        let dz = a.atoms[i].z - b.atoms[i].z
        sum_sq = sum_sq + dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
        i = i + 1
    }
    dock_sqrt(sum_sq / (n as f64))
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medical/hyperspectral.sio ===
//! Hyperspectral Tissue Imaging (disabled — pending Str/String type unification)


// === FILE: stdlib/medical/kg_reason.sio ===
// stdlib/medical/kg_reason.sio — Medical Knowledge Graph Reasoning
//
// Drug-disease-gene triplet reasoning over a biomedical knowledge graph.
// Supports TransE, DistMult, and RotatE scoring functions with
// GUM-compliant uncertainty propagation on every prediction.
//
// SOTA references:
//   MedKGent (2025): 156K biomedical entities, multi-hop reasoning
//   GALAX (2025): Graph-Aligned LLM for KG completion
//   LLaDR (2025): LLM-driven drug repurposing via KG traversal
//   RotatE (Sun+ 2019): arXiv:1902.10197, rotation-based KG embedding
//   TransE (Bordes+ 2013): Translating Embeddings for Modeling Relations
//   DistMult (Yang+ 2015): arXiv:1412.6575, bilinear diagonal scoring
//
// Theory:
//   TransE:   score(h,r,t) = -||h + r - t||_2
//   DistMult: score(h,r,t) = sum_i(h_i * r_i * t_i)
//   RotatE:   score(h,r,t) = -||h . r - t||_2  (complex rotation)
//
//   Uncertainty propagation (GUM first-order):
//     u_score^2 = sum_i (df/dx_i)^2 * u_{x_i}^2

// =============================================================================
// Math Helpers
// =============================================================================

fn kg_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x }
}

fn kg_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 25 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn kg_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { a } else { b }
}

fn kg_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { a } else { b }
}

fn kg_clamp(x: f64, lo: f64, hi: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
}

// Approximate sin for RotatE complex rotation
fn kg_sin(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Reduce x to [-pi, pi]
    var t = x
    let two_pi = 6.283185307179586
    while t > 3.14159265 { t = t - two_pi }
    while t < 0.0 - 3.14159265 { t = t + two_pi }
    // Taylor: sin(t) = t - t^3/6 + t^5/120 - t^7/5040 + ...
    let t2 = t * t
    let t3 = t2 * t
    let t5 = t3 * t2
    let t7 = t5 * t2
    let t9 = t7 * t2
    t - t3 / 6.0 + t5 / 120.0 - t7 / 5040.0 + t9 / 362880.0
}

// Approximate cos for RotatE complex rotation
fn kg_cos(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // cos(x) = sin(x + pi/2)
    kg_sin(x + 1.5707963267948966)
}

// =============================================================================
// Core Types
// =============================================================================

// Entity types: 0=drug, 1=disease, 2=gene, 3=protein, 4=pathway, 5=symptom
struct MedEntity {
    embedding: [f64; 16],
    u_embedding: [f64; 16],
    entity_type: i32,
}

// Relation types: 0=treats, 1=causes, 2=targets, 3=interacts,
//                 4=associated_with, 5=inhibits
struct MedRelation {
    embedding: [f64; 16],
    rel_type: i32,
}

struct MedTriple {
    head: i32,
    relation: i32,
    tail: i32,
    confidence: f64,
}

struct MedKG {
    entities: [MedEntity; 4096],
    relations: [MedRelation; 64],
    triples: [MedTriple; 16384],
    n_entities: i32,
    n_relations: i32,
    n_triples: i32,
}

struct PathResult {
    path_entities: [i32; 16],
    path_relations: [i32; 16],
    path_len: i32,
    path_score: f64,
    u_score: f64,
}

struct RepurposeCandidate {
    drug_id: i32,
    disease_id: i32,
    score: f64,
    u_score: f64,
    confidence: f64,
}

// =============================================================================
// Constructors
// =============================================================================

fn med_entity_zero() -> MedEntity {
    MedEntity {
        embedding: [0.0; 16],
        u_embedding: [1.0; 16],
        entity_type: 0,
    }
}

fn med_relation_zero() -> MedRelation {
    MedRelation {
        embedding: [0.0; 16],
        rel_type: 0,
    }
}

fn med_triple_zero() -> MedTriple {
    MedTriple {
        head: 0,
        relation: 0,
        tail: 0,
        confidence: 0.0,
    }
}

fn med_kg_new() -> MedKG with Mut, Panic {
    var kg = MedKG {
        entities: [MedEntity {
            embedding: [0.0; 16],
            u_embedding: [1.0; 16],
            entity_type: 0,
        }; 4096],
        relations: [MedRelation {
            embedding: [0.0; 16],
            rel_type: 0,
        }; 64],
        triples: [MedTriple {
            head: 0,
            relation: 0,
            tail: 0,
            confidence: 0.0,
        }; 16384],
        n_entities: 0,
        n_relations: 0,
        n_triples: 0,
    }
    kg
}

// =============================================================================
// Graph Construction
// =============================================================================

fn med_kg_add_entity(
    kg: &!MedKG,
    emb: &[f64; 16],
    u_emb: &[f64; 16],
    etype: i32,
) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let idx = kg.n_entities
    if idx >= 4096 { return 0 - 1 }
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        kg.entities[idx].embedding[i] = emb[i]
        kg.entities[idx].u_embedding[i] = u_emb[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    kg.entities[idx].entity_type = etype
    kg.n_entities = kg.n_entities + 1
    idx
}

fn med_kg_add_relation(
    kg: &!MedKG,
    emb: &[f64; 16],
    rtype: i32,
) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let idx = kg.n_relations
    if idx >= 64 { return 0 - 1 }
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        kg.relations[idx].embedding[i] = emb[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    kg.relations[idx].rel_type = rtype
    kg.n_relations = kg.n_relations + 1
    idx
}

fn med_kg_add_triple(
    kg: &!MedKG,
    h: i32,
    r: i32,
    t: i32,
    conf: f64,
) with Mut, Panic {
    let idx = kg.n_triples
    if idx >= 16384 { return }
    kg.triples[idx].head = h
    kg.triples[idx].relation = r
    kg.triples[idx].tail = t
    kg.triples[idx].confidence = conf
    kg.n_triples = kg.n_triples + 1
}

// =============================================================================
// TransE Scoring: score = -||h + r - t||_2
// =============================================================================

fn med_score_transe(
    kg: &MedKG,
    h: i32,
    r: i32,
    t: i32,
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var dist_sq = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        let diff = kg.entities[h].embedding[i]
                 + kg.relations[r].embedding[i]
                 - kg.entities[t].embedding[i]
        dist_sq = dist_sq + diff * diff
        i = i + 1
    }
    0.0 - kg_sqrt(dist_sq)
}

// =============================================================================
// DistMult Scoring: score = sum_i(h_i * r_i * t_i)
// =============================================================================

fn med_score_distmult(
    kg: &MedKG,
    h: i32,
    r: i32,
    t: i32,
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var score = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        score = score + kg.entities[h].embedding[i]
                      * kg.relations[r].embedding[i]
                      * kg.entities[t].embedding[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    score
}

// =============================================================================
// RotatE Scoring: complex rotation in paired dimensions
// =============================================================================
// Treat embedding as 8 complex numbers: (dim 2k, dim 2k+1) = (re, im)
// Relation acts as rotation: r = (cos(theta), sin(theta))
// score = -||h . r - t||_2 where . is element-wise complex product

fn med_score_rotate(
    kg: &MedKG,
    h: i32,
    r: i32,
    t: i32,
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var dist_sq = 0.0
    var k = 0
    while k < 8 {
        let re_idx = (k * 2) as i32
        let im_idx = (k * 2 + 1) as i32

        let h_re = kg.entities[h].embedding[re_idx]
        let h_im = kg.entities[h].embedding[im_idx]

        // Relation angle: interpret relation embedding as rotation phase
        let theta = kg.relations[r].embedding[re_idx]
        let r_re = kg_cos(theta)
        let r_im = kg_sin(theta)

        let t_re = kg.entities[t].embedding[re_idx]
        let t_im = kg.entities[t].embedding[im_idx]

        // Complex multiplication: (h_re + i*h_im) * (r_re + i*r_im)
        let hr_re = h_re * r_re - h_im * r_im
        let hr_im = h_re * r_im + h_im * r_re

        let diff_re = hr_re - t_re
        let diff_im = hr_im - t_im
        dist_sq = dist_sq + diff_re * diff_re + diff_im * diff_im

        k = k + 1
    }
    0.0 - kg_sqrt(dist_sq)
}

// =============================================================================
// Uncertainty Scoring (GUM first-order propagation)
// =============================================================================
// u_score^2 = sum_i (u_h_i^2 + u_t_i^2)  (TransE sensitivity = 1 per dim)

fn med_score_uncertainty(
    kg: &MedKG,
    h: i32,
    t: i32,
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var u_sq = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        let uh = kg.entities[h].u_embedding[i]
        let ut = kg.entities[t].u_embedding[i]
        u_sq = u_sq + uh * uh + ut * ut
        i = i + 1
    }
    kg_sqrt(u_sq)
}

// =============================================================================
// BFS Path Finding with Confidence
// =============================================================================
// Find a path from src to dst of length <= max_len.
// Uses breadth-first search over the triple adjacency.

fn med_path_bfs(
    kg: &MedKG,
    src: i32,
    dst: i32,
    max_len: i32,
    result: &!PathResult,
) -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // BFS state: queue of (entity_id, depth) pairs
    // visited[i] = 1 if entity i has been visited
    // parent[i] = entity that led to i
    // parent_rel[i] = relation used to reach i

    var visited: [i32; 4096] = [0; 4096]
    var parent: [i32; 4096] = [0 - 1; 4096]
    var parent_rel: [i32; 4096] = [0 - 1; 4096]
    var queue_ent: [i32; 4096] = [0; 4096]
    var queue_depth: [i32; 4096] = [0; 4096]
    var q_head = 0
    var q_tail = 0

    // Enqueue source
    queue_ent[q_tail] = src
    queue_depth[q_tail] = 0
    q_tail = q_tail + 1
    visited[src] = 1

    var found = false

    while q_head < q_tail {
        if found { q_head = q_tail } else {
            let cur = queue_ent[q_head]
            let depth = queue_depth[q_head]
            q_head = q_head + 1

            if cur == dst {
                found = true
            } else {
                if depth < max_len {
                    // Scan all triples for edges from cur
                    var ti = 0
                    while ti < kg.n_triples {
                        if found == false {
                            if kg.triples[ti].head == cur {
                                let nbr = kg.triples[ti].tail
                                if visited[nbr] == 0 {
                                    visited[nbr] = 1
                                    parent[nbr] = cur
                                    parent_rel[nbr] = kg.triples[ti].relation
                                    if q_tail < 4096 {
                                        queue_ent[q_tail] = nbr
                                        queue_depth[q_tail] = depth + 1
                                        q_tail = q_tail + 1
                                    }
                                    if nbr == dst { found = true }
                                }
                            }
                            // Also check reverse direction (undirected traversal)
                            if kg.triples[ti].tail == cur {
                                let nbr = kg.triples[ti].head
                                if visited[nbr] == 0 {
                                    visited[nbr] = 1
                                    parent[nbr] = cur
                                    parent_rel[nbr] = kg.triples[ti].relation
                                    if q_tail < 4096 {
                                        queue_ent[q_tail] = nbr
                                        queue_depth[q_tail] = depth + 1
                                        q_tail = q_tail + 1
                                    }
                                    if nbr == dst { found = true }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        ti = ti + 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if found == false { return false }

    // Reconstruct path from dst back to src
    var path_buf: [i32; 16] = [0; 16]
    var rel_buf: [i32; 16] = [0; 16]
    var path_len = 0
    var cur = dst

    while cur != src {
        if path_len >= 16 { return false }  // path too long for buffer
        path_buf[path_len] = cur
        rel_buf[path_len] = parent_rel[cur]
        path_len = path_len + 1
        cur = parent[cur]
        if cur < 0 { return false }  // broken chain
    }
    path_buf[path_len] = src
    path_len = path_len + 1

    // Reverse into result (src -> ... -> dst)
    result.path_len = path_len
    var ri = 0
    while ri < path_len {
        result.path_entities[ri] = path_buf[path_len - 1 - ri]
        if ri < path_len - 1 {
            result.path_relations[ri] = rel_buf[path_len - 2 - ri]
        }
        ri = ri + 1
    }

    // Compute path score: product of edge confidences along path
    var score = 1.0
    var u_sq = 0.0
    var pi = 0
    while pi < path_len - 1 {
        let ent_a = result.path_entities[pi]
        let ent_b = result.path_entities[pi + 1]
        let rel = result.path_relations[pi]

        // Find matching triple to get confidence
        var conf = 0.5  // default if not found
        var tj = 0
        while tj < kg.n_triples {
            if kg.triples[tj].head == ent_a {
                if kg.triples[tj].tail == ent_b {
                    if kg.triples[tj].relation == rel {
                        conf = kg.triples[tj].confidence
                        tj = kg.n_triples  // break
                    }
                }
            }
            if kg.triples[tj].tail == ent_a {
                if kg.triples[tj].head == ent_b {
                    if kg.triples[tj].relation == rel {
                        conf = kg.triples[tj].confidence
                        tj = kg.n_triples  // break
                    }
                }
            }
            tj = tj + 1
        }
        score = score * conf

        // Uncertainty: propagate from entity embeddings
        let u_edge = med_score_uncertainty(kg, ent_a, ent_b)
        u_sq = u_sq + u_edge * u_edge

        pi = pi + 1
    }

    result.path_score = score
    result.u_score = kg_sqrt(u_sq)
    true
}

// =============================================================================
// Drug Repurposing
// =============================================================================
// Score all diseases for a given drug using TransE + DistMult ensemble.
// Returns the number of candidates written into the results buffer.

fn med_drug_repurpose(
    kg: &MedKG,
    drug_id: i32,
    top_k: i32,
    results: &![RepurposeCandidate; 64],
) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Score every disease entity (type=1) against the drug
    // Use the "treats" relation (type=0)

    // Find the "treats" relation index
    var treats_rel = 0 - 1
    var ri = 0
    while ri < kg.n_relations {
        if kg.relations[ri].rel_type == 0 {
            treats_rel = ri
            ri = kg.n_relations  // break
        }
        ri = ri + 1
    }
    if treats_rel < 0 { return 0 }

    // Temporary buffer for all disease scores
    var disease_ids: [i32; 4096] = [0; 4096]
    var disease_scores: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var disease_u: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var n_diseases = 0

    var ei = 0
    while ei < kg.n_entities {
        if kg.entities[ei].entity_type == 1 {
            // Ensemble: average of TransE and DistMult scores
            let s_transe = med_score_transe(kg, drug_id, treats_rel, ei)
            let s_distmult = med_score_distmult(kg, drug_id, treats_rel, ei)
            let s_rotate = med_score_rotate(kg, drug_id, treats_rel, ei)

            let ensemble_score = (s_transe + s_distmult + s_rotate) / 3.0
            let u = med_score_uncertainty(kg, drug_id, ei)

            disease_ids[n_diseases] = ei
            disease_scores[n_diseases] = ensemble_score
            disease_u[n_diseases] = u
            n_diseases = n_diseases + 1
        }
        ei = ei + 1
    }

    // Sort by score (descending) — insertion sort
    var si = 1
    while si < n_diseases {
        let key_id = disease_ids[si]
        let key_score = disease_scores[si]
        let key_u = disease_u[si]
        var sj = si - 1
        while sj >= 0 {
            if disease_scores[sj] < key_score {
                disease_ids[sj + 1] = disease_ids[sj]
                disease_scores[sj + 1] = disease_scores[sj]
                disease_u[sj + 1] = disease_u[sj]
                sj = sj - 1
            } else {
                sj = 0 - 1  // break
            }
        }
        disease_ids[sj + 1] = key_id
        disease_scores[sj + 1] = key_score
        disease_u[sj + 1] = key_u
        si = si + 1
    }

    // Write top_k into results
    let n_out = if top_k < n_diseases { top_k } else { n_diseases }
    let n_capped = if n_out > 64 { 64 } else { n_out }

    var wi = 0
    while wi < n_capped {
        let sc = disease_scores[wi]
        let u = disease_u[wi]

        // Confidence: higher score and lower uncertainty = more confident
        // Sigmoid-like mapping: conf = 1 / (1 + exp(-score)) * (1 - u_norm)
        let score_factor = 1.0 / (1.0 + kg_sqrt(kg_abs(0.0 - sc) + 1.0))
        let u_norm = kg_clamp(u / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0)
        let conf = (1.0 - score_factor) * (1.0 - u_norm)

        results[wi] = RepurposeCandidate {
            drug_id: drug_id,
            disease_id: disease_ids[wi],
            score: sc,
            u_score: u,
            confidence: kg_clamp(conf, 0.0, 1.0),
        }
        wi = wi + 1
    }

    n_capped
}

// =============================================================================
// TransE Training Step
// =============================================================================
// Gradient descent on one triple:
//   loss = max(0, ||h + r - t||_2 - ||h' + r - t'||_2 + margin)
//   grad_h = 2*(h + r - t) / ||h + r - t||  (normalised direction)
//   Update: h -= lr * grad_h, r -= lr * grad_r, t += lr * grad_t
//   Also update uncertainty: u decreases as gradient signal is received.

fn med_train_step_transe(
    kg: &!MedKG,
    triple_idx: i32,
    lr: f64,
    margin: f64,
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if triple_idx < 0 { return }
    if triple_idx >= kg.n_triples { return }

    let h_id = kg.triples[triple_idx].head
    let r_id = kg.triples[triple_idx].relation
    let t_id = kg.triples[triple_idx].tail

    // Compute h + r - t
    var diff: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    var dist_sq = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        diff[i] = kg.entities[h_id].embedding[i]
                + kg.relations[r_id].embedding[i]
                - kg.entities[t_id].embedding[i]
        dist_sq = dist_sq + diff[i] * diff[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    let dist = kg_sqrt(dist_sq)

    // Only update if distance is greater than margin threshold
    // (In full training, would compare positive vs negative triple)
    if dist < margin { return }

    // Normalise gradient direction
    var grad: [f64; 16] = [0.0; 16]
    if dist > 1.0e-10 {
        var gi = 0
        while gi < 16 {
            grad[gi] = diff[gi] / dist
            gi = gi + 1
        }
    }

    // Apply gradient updates
    var ui = 0
    while ui < 16 {
        // h moves toward t-r direction
        kg.entities[h_id].embedding[ui] = kg.entities[h_id].embedding[ui] - lr * grad[ui]
        // r moves toward t-h direction
        kg.relations[r_id].embedding[ui] = kg.relations[r_id].embedding[ui] - lr * grad[ui]
        // t moves toward h+r direction
        kg.entities[t_id].embedding[ui] = kg.entities[t_id].embedding[ui] + lr * grad[ui]

        // Reduce uncertainty (more training signal = less uncertainty)
        let decay = 0.99
        kg.entities[h_id].u_embedding[ui] = kg.entities[h_id].u_embedding[ui] * decay
        kg.entities[t_id].u_embedding[ui] = kg.entities[t_id].u_embedding[ui] * decay
        ui = ui + 1
    }

    // Update triple confidence based on new distance
    var new_dist_sq = 0.0
    var ni = 0
    while ni < 16 {
        let d = kg.entities[h_id].embedding[ni]
              + kg.relations[r_id].embedding[ni]
              - kg.entities[t_id].embedding[ni]
        new_dist_sq = new_dist_sq + d * d
        ni = ni + 1
    }
    let new_dist = kg_sqrt(new_dist_sq)
    // Confidence increases as distance decreases
    let conf = 1.0 / (1.0 + new_dist)
    kg.triples[triple_idx].confidence = conf
}

// =============================================================================
// Multi-hop Reasoning Score
// =============================================================================
// Given a path (sequence of entities and relations), compute a composite
// score as the product of individual edge scores (TransE-based).

fn med_path_score_transe(
    kg: &MedKG,
    path: &PathResult,
) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if path.path_len < 2 { return 0.0 }

    var product = 1.0
    var i = 0
    while i < path.path_len - 1 {
        let h = path.path_entities[i]
        let r = path.path_relations[i]
        let t = path.path_entities[i + 1]
        let s = med_score_transe(kg, h, r, t)
        // Convert score to probability-like: sigmoid(-score)
        // TransE score is negative distance, so higher = better
        let prob = 1.0 / (1.0 + kg_sqrt(kg_abs(0.0 - s) + 1.0))
        product = product * prob
        i = i + 1
    }
    product
}

// =============================================================================
// Entity Similarity Search
// =============================================================================
// Find the k most similar entities to a query entity by L2 distance
// in embedding space.

fn med_find_similar(
    kg: &MedKG,
    query_id: i32,
    etype_filter: i32,
    top_k: i32,
    out_ids: &![i32; 64],
    out_scores: &![f64; 64],
) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Compute distances to all entities of the given type
    var ids: [i32; 4096] = [0; 4096]
    var dists: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var n = 0

    var ei = 0
    while ei < kg.n_entities {
        if ei != query_id {
            let type_match = if etype_filter < 0 { true }
                             else { kg.entities[ei].entity_type == etype_filter }
            if type_match {
                var d_sq = 0.0
                var di = 0
                while di < 16 {
                    let diff = kg.entities[query_id].embedding[di]
                             - kg.entities[ei].embedding[di]
                    d_sq = d_sq + diff * diff
                    di = di + 1
                }
                ids[n] = ei
                dists[n] = kg_sqrt(d_sq)
                n = n + 1
            }
        }
        ei = ei + 1
    }

    // Insertion sort by distance (ascending)
    var si = 1
    while si < n {
        let key_id = ids[si]
        let key_d = dists[si]
        var sj = si - 1
        while sj >= 0 {
            if dists[sj] > key_d {
                ids[sj + 1] = ids[sj]
                dists[sj + 1] = dists[sj]
                sj = sj - 1
            } else {
                sj = 0 - 1  // break
            }
        }
        ids[sj + 1] = key_id
        dists[sj + 1] = key_d
        si = si + 1
    }

    let n_out = if top_k < n { top_k } else { n }
    let n_capped = if n_out > 64 { 64 } else { n_out }

    var wi = 0
    while wi < n_capped {
        out_ids[wi] = ids[wi]
        // Convert distance to similarity score: 1/(1+d)
        out_scores[wi] = 1.0 / (1.0 + dists[wi])
        wi = wi + 1
    }
    n_capped
}


// === FILE: stdlib/medical/mod.sio ===
//! stdlib/medical - Medical Applications with Sedenions
//!
//! Provides sedenion-based (16D hypercomplex) medical computing.

module medical


// === FILE: stdlib/medical/multiomics.sio ===
// stdlib/medical/multiomics.sio — Multi-Omics Staged Integration
//
