// ============================================================================
// SHA-256 STATE
// ============================================================================

struct Sha256State {
    h0: i64,
    h1: i64,
    h2: i64,
    h3: i64,
    h4: i64,
    h5: i64,
    h6: i64,
    h7: i64,
}

fn sha256_init() -> Sha256State with Mut, Panic {
    Sha256State {
        h0: 1779033703,   // 0x6a09e667
        h1: 3144134277,   // 0xbb67ae85
        h2: 1013904242,   // 0x3c6ef372
        h3: 2773480762,   // 0xa54ff53a
        h4: 1359893119,   // 0x510e527f
        h5: 2600822924,   // 0x9b05688c
        h6: 528734635,    // 0x1f83d9ab
        h7: 1541459225,   // 0x5be0cd19
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// SHA-256 BLOCK COMPRESSION
// ============================================================================

// Process a single 512-bit (64-byte) block stored as 16 i64 words (big-endian 32-bit)
fn sha256_compress(state: Sha256State, block: [i64; 64]) -> Sha256State with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let mask = 4294967295  // 0xFFFFFFFF

    // Prepare message schedule W[0..63]
    var w: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        w[i] = block[i] & mask
        i = i + 1
    }
    while i < 64 {
        w[i] = add32(add32(small_sigma1(w[i - 2]), w[i - 7]),
                      add32(small_sigma0(w[i - 15]), w[i - 16]))
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Working variables
    var a = state.h0
    var b = state.h1
    var c = state.h2
    var d = state.h3
    var e = state.h4
    var f = state.h5
    var g = state.h6
    var h = state.h7

    // 64 rounds
    i = 0
    while i < 64 {
        let t1 = add32(add32(h, big_sigma1(e)),
                       add32(ch(e, f, g), add32(sha256_k(i), w[i])))
        let t2 = add32(big_sigma0(a), maj(a, b, c))

        h = g
        g = f
        f = e
        e = add32(d, t1)
        d = c
        c = b
        b = a
        a = add32(t1, t2)

        i = i + 1
    }

    // Add compressed chunk to hash state
    Sha256State {
        h0: add32(state.h0, a),
        h1: add32(state.h1, b),
        h2: add32(state.h2, c),
        h3: add32(state.h3, d),
        h4: add32(state.h4, e),
        h5: add32(state.h5, f),
        h6: add32(state.h6, g),
        h7: add32(state.h7, h),
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// SHA-256 ON SHORT MESSAGES (up to 55 bytes fits in a single block)
// ============================================================================

// Hash an array of bytes (given as i64 values 0..255) of length `len` (max 55).
// Returns the 8-word hash state.
fn sha256_short(data: [i64; 64], len: i32) -> Sha256State with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Build padded block: data || 0x80 || zeros || big-endian 64-bit length
    // For messages up to 55 bytes, padding fits in a single 64-byte block.
    var padded: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]

    // Copy data bytes into padded
    var i = 0
    while i < len {
        padded[i] = data[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Append the 0x80 byte
    padded[len] = 128

    // Append length in bits as big-endian 64-bit integer at bytes 56..63
    let bit_len = (len * 8) as i64
    // For messages up to 55 bytes, the high 4 bytes of the 64-bit length are 0.
    padded[60] = (bit_len >> 24) & 255
    padded[61] = (bit_len >> 16) & 255
    padded[62] = (bit_len >> 8) & 255
    padded[63] = bit_len & 255

    // Convert 64 bytes to 16 big-endian 32-bit words
    var block: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    i = 0
    while i < 16 {
        let base = i * 4
        block[i] = (padded[base] << 24) | (padded[base + 1] << 16) |
                   (padded[base + 2] << 8) | padded[base + 3]
        i = i + 1
    }

    let state = sha256_init()
    return sha256_compress(state, block)
}

// ============================================================================
// HEX OUTPUT HELPERS
// ============================================================================

// Convert a 4-bit nibble (0..15) to its hex character code
fn nibble_to_hex_char(n: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if n < 10 {
        return 48 + n  // '0' = 48
    }
    return 87 + n  // 'a' = 97, so 97-10 = 87
}

// Extract byte at position `pos` (0=MSB, 3=LSB) from a 32-bit word
fn extract_byte(word: i64, pos: i32) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let shift = (3 - pos) * 8
    return (word >> shift) & 255
}

// Compare a 32-bit hash word against 8 expected hex characters in a reference array
// starting at `offset`. Returns true if they match.
fn word_matches_hex(word: i64, expected: [i64; 64], offset: i32) -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var byte_idx = 0
    while byte_idx < 4 {
        let b = extract_byte(word, byte_idx)
        let hi = nibble_to_hex_char((b >> 4) & 15)
        let lo = nibble_to_hex_char(b & 15)
        let char_idx = offset + byte_idx * 2
        if hi != expected[char_idx] { return false }
        if lo != expected[char_idx + 1] { return false }
        byte_idx = byte_idx + 1
    }
    return true
}

// Check full 256-bit hash (8 words) against a 64-character hex string stored as char codes
fn hash_matches(state: Sha256State, expected: [i64; 64]) -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if word_matches_hex(state.h0, expected, 0) == false { return false }
    if word_matches_hex(state.h1, expected, 8) == false { return false }
    if word_matches_hex(state.h2, expected, 16) == false { return false }
    if word_matches_hex(state.h3, expected, 24) == false { return false }
    if word_matches_hex(state.h4, expected, 32) == false { return false }
    if word_matches_hex(state.h5, expected, 40) == false { return false }
    if word_matches_hex(state.h6, expected, 48) == false { return false }
    if word_matches_hex(state.h7, expected, 56) == false { return false }
    return true
}

// ============================================================================
// CONSTANT-TIME COMPARISON
// ============================================================================

// Compare two byte arrays of length `len` in constant time.
// Returns true if all bytes match.
fn hash_equals_ct(a: [i64; 64], b: [i64; 64], len: i32) -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var diff = 0 as i64
    var i = 0
    while i < len {
        diff = diff | (a[i] ^ b[i])
        i = i + 1
    }
    return diff == 0
}

// ============================================================================
// HELPER: Build hex string as char code array
// ============================================================================

// Store a hex string's ASCII codes into an array.
// "e3b0c442..." becomes [101, 51, 98, 48, 99, 52, 52, 50, ...]
fn hex_char_code(c: i32) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    // '0'-'9' = 48-57, 'a'-'f' = 97-102
    if c == 0 { return 48 }
    if c == 1 { return 49 }
    if c == 2 { return 50 }
    if c == 3 { return 51 }
    if c == 4 { return 52 }
    if c == 5 { return 53 }
    if c == 6 { return 54 }
    if c == 7 { return 55 }
    if c == 8 { return 56 }
    if c == 9 { return 57 }
    if c == 10 { return 97 }   // 'a'
    if c == 11 { return 98 }   // 'b'
    if c == 12 { return 99 }   // 'c'
    if c == 13 { return 100 }  // 'd'
    if c == 14 { return 101 }  // 'e'
    if c == 15 { return 102 }  // 'f'
    return 0
}

// Test 4: Determinism -- hashing the same input twice produces the same result
fn test_determinism() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var data1: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    data1[0] = 120  // 'x'
    data1[1] = 121  // 'y'
    data1[2] = 122  // 'z'
    let s1 = sha256_short(data1, 3)

    var data2: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    data2[0] = 120
    data2[1] = 121
    data2[2] = 122
    let s2 = sha256_short(data2, 3)

    return s1.h0 == s2.h0 && s1.h1 == s2.h1 && s1.h2 == s2.h2 && s1.h3 == s2.h3 &&
           s1.h4 == s2.h4 && s1.h5 == s2.h5 && s1.h6 == s2.h6 && s1.h7 == s2.h7
}

// Test 5: Avalanche -- changing one bit in input changes at least 25% of output bits
fn test_avalanche() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var data1: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    data1[0] = 0
    let s1 = sha256_short(data1, 1)

    var data2: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    data2[0] = 1  // differ by one bit
    let s2 = sha256_short(data2, 1)

    // Count differing bits in XOR of hash words
    var diff_bits = 0
    var xor_val = s1.h0 ^ s2.h0
    var j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        if (xor_val & 1) != 0 { diff_bits = diff_bits + 1 }
        xor_val = xor_val >> 1
        j = j + 1
    }
    xor_val = s1.h1 ^ s2.h1
    j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        if (xor_val & 1) != 0 { diff_bits = diff_bits + 1 }
        xor_val = xor_val >> 1
        j = j + 1
    }
    xor_val = s1.h2 ^ s2.h2
    j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        if (xor_val & 1) != 0 { diff_bits = diff_bits + 1 }
        xor_val = xor_val >> 1
        j = j + 1
    }
    xor_val = s1.h3 ^ s2.h3
    j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        if (xor_val & 1) != 0 { diff_bits = diff_bits + 1 }
        xor_val = xor_val >> 1
        j = j + 1
    }
    xor_val = s1.h4 ^ s2.h4
    j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        if (xor_val & 1) != 0 { diff_bits = diff_bits + 1 }
        xor_val = xor_val >> 1
        j = j + 1
    }
    xor_val = s1.h5 ^ s2.h5
    j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        if (xor_val & 1) != 0 { diff_bits = diff_bits + 1 }
        xor_val = xor_val >> 1
        j = j + 1
    }
    xor_val = s1.h6 ^ s2.h6
    j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        if (xor_val & 1) != 0 { diff_bits = diff_bits + 1 }
        xor_val = xor_val >> 1
        j = j + 1
    }
    xor_val = s1.h7 ^ s2.h7
    j = 0
    while j < 32 {
        if (xor_val & 1) != 0 { diff_bits = diff_bits + 1 }
        xor_val = xor_val >> 1
        j = j + 1
    }

    // At least 64 of 256 bits should differ (25%)
    // In practice SHA-256 flips ~128 bits on average
    return diff_bits >= 64
}

// Test 6: Constant-time comparison works correctly
fn test_ct_equal() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var b: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var c: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]

    var i = 0
    while i < 32 {
        a[i] = (i * 17 + 3) as i64
        b[i] = (i * 17 + 3) as i64
        c[i] = (i * 17 + 4) as i64   // differ by 1 in every byte
        i = i + 1
    }

    let eq_ok = hash_equals_ct(a, b, 32)
    let neq_ok = hash_equals_ct(a, c, 32) == false

    return eq_ok && neq_ok
}

// Test 7: Constant-time comparison catches single-byte difference
fn test_ct_single_diff() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    var b: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]

    var i = 0
    while i < 32 {
        a[i] = 42
        b[i] = 42
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Identical should match
    let ok1 = hash_equals_ct(a, b, 32)

    // Change just the last byte
    b[31] = 43
    let ok2 = hash_equals_ct(a, b, 32) == false

    return ok1 && ok2
}

// Test 8: Different messages produce different hashes
fn test_collision_resistance() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var d1: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    d1[0] = 97  // "a"
    let s1 = sha256_short(d1, 1)

    var d2: [i64; 64] = [0; 64]
    d2[0] = 98  // "b"
    let s2 = sha256_short(d2, 1)

    // Hashes must differ in at least one word
    let any_diff = (s1.h0 != s2.h0) || (s1.h1 != s2.h1) || (s1.h2 != s2.h2) || (s1.h3 != s2.h3) ||
                   (s1.h4 != s2.h4) || (s1.h5 != s2.h5) || (s1.h6 != s2.h6) || (s1.h7 != s2.h7)
    return any_diff
}

// Test 9: Bit manipulation primitives -- rotr32 correctness
fn test_rotr32() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let mask = 4294967295

    // rotr32(1, 1) = 0x80000000 = 2147483648
    let ok1 = rotr32(1, 1) == 2147483648

    // rotr32(0x80000000, 1) = 0x40000000 = 1073741824
    let ok2 = rotr32(2147483648, 1) == 1073741824

    // rotr32(0xFF, 4) = 0x0F00000F
    // 0xFF = 255, rotated right 4: low 4 bits (0xF) go to high, rest shift right
    // 0x0F00000F = 251658255
    let ok3 = rotr32(255, 4) == 251658255

    return ok1 && ok2 && ok3
}

// Test 10: SHA-256 initial hash values match FIPS 180-4
fn test_init_values() -> bool with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    let s = sha256_init()
    let ok1 = s.h0 == 1779033703
    let ok2 = s.h1 == 3144134277
    let ok3 = s.h2 == 1013904242
    let ok4 = s.h3 == 2773480762
    let ok5 = s.h4 == 1359893119
    let ok6 = s.h5 == 2600822924
    let ok7 = s.h6 == 528734635
    let ok8 = s.h7 == 1541459225
    return ok1 && ok2 && ok3 && ok4 && ok5 && ok6 && ok7 && ok8
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    println("=== SHA-256 Crypto Hash Tests ===")
    println("")

    var passed = 0
    var failed = 0

    // Test 1
    print("Test  1: SHA-256(\"\")............... ")
    if test_empty_string() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // Test 2
    print("Test  2: SHA-256(\"abc\")............ ")
    if test_abc() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // Test 3
    print("Test  3: SHA-256(\"hello\").......... ")
    if test_hello() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // Test 4
    print("Test  4: determinism............... ")
    if test_determinism() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // Test 5
    print("Test  5: avalanche (>25%% bits).... ")
    if test_avalanche() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // Test 6
    print("Test  6: constant-time equal....... ")
    if test_ct_equal() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // Test 7
    print("Test  7: constant-time single diff. ")
    if test_ct_single_diff() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // Test 8
    print("Test  8: collision resistance....... ")
    if test_collision_resistance() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // Test 9
    print("Test  9: rotr32 primitives......... ")
    if test_rotr32() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    // Test 10
    print("Test 10: init hash values.......... ")
    if test_init_values() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    println("")
    print("Passed: ")
    println(passed)
    print("Failed: ")
    println(failed)

    if failed > 0 {
        println("SOME TESTS FAILED")
        return 1
    }
    println("ALL 10 TESTS PASSED")
    return 0
}

// === FILE: tests/run-pass/effects.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// Algebraic effects test

fn pure_computation(x: i32) -> i32 {
    x * 2
}

fn effectful_computation() -> i32 with IO {
    print("computing...\n")
    42
}

fn main() with IO {
    let result = pure_computation(21)
    // Check result is 42
    if result == 42 {
        print("pure_computation: PASS\n")
    } else {
        print("pure_computation: FAIL\n")
    }

    let data = effectful_computation()
    if data == 42 {
        print("effectful_computation: PASS\n")
    } else {
        print("effectful_computation: FAIL\n")
    }
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/effect_superset_ok.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: effect superset: PASS

// Caller declares more effects than callee needs — should pass
fn pure_add(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64 {
    a + b
}

fn needs_io() with IO {
    print("io\n")
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div {
    // Calling pure function from effectful context is fine
    let x = pure_add(2, 3)
    // Calling IO function from IO+Mut+Div context is fine
    needs_io()
    if x == 5 {
        print("effect superset: PASS\n")
    }
    return 0
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/epistemic_arena_h2o.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL 10 TESTS PASSED
//@ expect-stdout: Failed: 0

// Self-contained run-pass test for the epistemic arena allocator.
//
// Verifies:
//   1. Empty arena: len=0
//   2. Single alloc: id=0, len=1, correct value
//   3. Multiple alloc: sequential ids, correct count
//   4. Set/get: update a slot, read it back
//   5. Provenance seeded on alloc (non-zero, variance=0, confidence=1)
//   6. Set merges provenance (provenance changes, variance/confidence bump)
//   7. Free marks slot not-live, reduces len
//   8. Free + realloc: reuses slot, carries lineage (variance > 0)
//   9. delta_32 < 96 bound holds for all slots
//  10. H2O chemical self-check: alloc/free/realloc with full validation

// ============================================================================
// MERKLE INFRASTRUCTURE (inlined from epistemic_arena.sio)
// ============================================================================

let EPI_ARENA_CAP: i64 = 512
let EPI_ARENA_MERKLE_SALT_A: i64 = 0x4F4D4547
let EPI_ARENA_MERKLE_SALT_B: i64 = 0x4147454E
let EPI_ARENA_MERKLE_SALT_C: i64 = 0x45534953
let EPI_ARENA_MERKLE_SALT_D: i64 = 0x76312E30

fn epi_arena_merkle_mix(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64, salt: i64) -> i64 {
    ((a ^ b) + c + salt) ^ (a << 5) ^ (b >> 7)
}

fn epi_arena_merkle_root_lane_l64(
    p0: i64, p1: i64, p2: i64, p3: i64, p4: i64
) -> i64 {
    let h0 = epi_arena_merkle_mix(p0, p1, p2, EPI_ARENA_MERKLE_SALT_A)
    let h1 = epi_arena_merkle_mix(p3, p4, h0, EPI_ARENA_MERKLE_SALT_B)
    let h2 = epi_arena_merkle_mix(h0, h1, p0 ^ p3, EPI_ARENA_MERKLE_SALT_C)
    epi_arena_merkle_mix(h1, h2, p1 ^ p2, EPI_ARENA_MERKLE_SALT_D)
}

fn epi_arena_hash_slot(slot_id: i64, value: i64) -> i64 {
    var hash: i64 = 5381
    hash = hash * 33 + slot_id
    hash = hash * 33 + value
    hash & 9223372036854775807
}

fn epi_arena_provenance_seed(item_hash: i64) -> i64 {
    epi_arena_merkle_root_lane_l64(0, item_hash, 0, 0, 1)
}

fn epi_arena_provenance_merge(
    existing_root: i64,
    item_hash: i64,
    variance: i64,
    confidence: i64
) -> i64 {
    epi_arena_merkle_root_lane_l64(
        existing_root,
        item_hash,
        variance,
        confidence,
        existing_root ^ item_hash
    )
}

fn epi_arena_delta_32(fidelity: i64, provenance: i64, quantum: i64) -> i64 {
    let frac_f = fidelity - (fidelity / 8) * 8
    let frac_p = provenance - (provenance / 16) * 16
    let frac_q = quantum - (quantum / 32) * 32
    frac_f * 4 + frac_p * 2 + frac_q
}

// ============================================================================
// STRUCT + CONSTRUCTOR
// ============================================================================

struct EpistemicArena {
    data: [i64; 512],
    variance_q32_32: [i64; 512],
    provenance_root_l64: [i64; 512],
    confidence_beta: [i64; 512],
    occupied: [i64; 512],
    free_stack: [i64; 512],
    free_top: i64,
    bump: i64,
    live: i64,
}

fn epi_arena_new() -> EpistemicArena {
    EpistemicArena {
        data: [0; 512],
        variance_q32_32: [0; 512],
        provenance_root_l64: [0; 512],
        confidence_beta: [0; 512],
        occupied: [0; 512],
        free_stack: [0; 512],
        free_top: 0,
        bump: 0,
        live: 0,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// CORE OPERATIONS
// ============================================================================

fn epi_arena_is_live(a: EpistemicArena, id: i64) -> bool with Panic, Div {
    if id < 0 || id >= a.bump {
        return false
    }
    a.occupied[id] == 1
}

fn epi_arena_alloc(a: EpistemicArena, value: i64) -> (EpistemicArena, i64) with Mut, Panic {
    var arena = a

    if arena.free_top > 0 {
        arena.free_top = arena.free_top - 1
        let slot = arena.free_stack[arena.free_top]
        arena.free_stack[arena.free_top] = 0

        arena.data[slot] = value
        arena.occupied[slot] = 1

        let hash = epi_arena_hash_slot(slot, value)
        let new_seed = epi_arena_provenance_seed(hash)
        arena.provenance_root_l64[slot] = epi_arena_provenance_merge(
            arena.provenance_root_l64[slot],
            new_seed,
            arena.variance_q32_32[slot] + 1,
            arena.confidence_beta[slot] + 1
        )
        arena.variance_q32_32[slot] = arena.variance_q32_32[slot] + 1
        arena.confidence_beta[slot] = arena.confidence_beta[slot] + 1
        arena.live = arena.live + 1

        return (arena, slot)
    }

    if arena.bump < EPI_ARENA_CAP {
        let slot = arena.bump
        arena.bump = arena.bump + 1

        arena.data[slot] = value
        arena.occupied[slot] = 1

        let hash = epi_arena_hash_slot(slot, value)
        arena.provenance_root_l64[slot] = epi_arena_provenance_seed(hash)
        arena.variance_q32_32[slot] = 0
        arena.confidence_beta[slot] = 1
        arena.live = arena.live + 1

        return (arena, slot)
    }

    (arena, 0 - 1)
}

fn epi_arena_free(a: EpistemicArena, id: i64) -> EpistemicArena with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var arena = a
    if !epi_arena_is_live(arena, id) {
        return arena
    }

    let free_hash = epi_arena_hash_slot(id, arena.data[id])
    arena.provenance_root_l64[id] = epi_arena_provenance_merge(
        arena.provenance_root_l64[id],
        free_hash,
        arena.variance_q32_32[id] + 1,
        arena.confidence_beta[id] + 1
    )
    arena.variance_q32_32[id] = arena.variance_q32_32[id] + 1
    arena.confidence_beta[id] = arena.confidence_beta[id] + 1

    arena.occupied[id] = 0
    arena.free_stack[arena.free_top] = id
    arena.free_top = arena.free_top + 1
    arena.live = arena.live - 1

    arena
}

fn epi_arena_get(a: EpistemicArena, id: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div {
    if !epi_arena_is_live(a, id) {
        return 0
    }
    a.data[id]
}

fn epi_arena_set(a: EpistemicArena, id: i64, value: i64) -> EpistemicArena with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var arena = a
    if !epi_arena_is_live(arena, id) {
        return arena
    }

    arena.data[id] = value

    let hash = epi_arena_hash_slot(id, value)
    arena.provenance_root_l64[id] = epi_arena_provenance_merge(
        arena.provenance_root_l64[id],
        hash,
        arena.variance_q32_32[id] + 1,
        arena.confidence_beta[id] + 1
    )
    arena.variance_q32_32[id] = arena.variance_q32_32[id] + 1
    arena.confidence_beta[id] = arena.confidence_beta[id] + 1

    arena
}

fn epi_arena_get_provenance(a: EpistemicArena, id: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div {
    if !epi_arena_is_live(a, id) {
        return 0
    }
    a.provenance_root_l64[id]
}

fn epi_arena_get_variance(a: EpistemicArena, id: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div {
    if !epi_arena_is_live(a, id) {
        return 0
    }
    a.variance_q32_32[id]
}

fn epi_arena_get_confidence(a: EpistemicArena, id: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div {
    if !epi_arena_is_live(a, id) {
        return 0
    }
    a.confidence_beta[id]
}

fn epi_arena_len(a: EpistemicArena) -> i64 {
    a.live
}

fn epi_arena_check_bound(a: EpistemicArena, id: i64) -> bool with Panic, Div {
    if !epi_arena_is_live(a, id) {
        return false
    }
    let d = epi_arena_delta_32(
        a.variance_q32_32[id],
        0,
        a.confidence_beta[id]
    )
    d >= 0 && d < 96
}

// ============================================================================
// CHEMICAL SELF-CHECK
// ============================================================================

fn epi_arena_chemical_self_check() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var arena = epi_arena_new()

    let r0 = epi_arena_alloc(arena, 1)
    arena = r0.0
    let id_h1 = r0.1

    let r1 = epi_arena_alloc(arena, 8)
    arena = r1.0
    let id_o = r1.1

    let r2 = epi_arena_alloc(arena, 1)
    arena = r2.0
    let id_h2 = r2.1

    let count_ok = epi_arena_len(arena) == 3

    let live_ok = epi_arena_is_live(arena, id_h1)
        && epi_arena_is_live(arena, id_o)
        && epi_arena_is_live(arena, id_h2)

    let val_ok = epi_arena_get(arena, id_h1) == 1
        && epi_arena_get(arena, id_o) == 8
        && epi_arena_get(arena, id_h2) == 1

    let prov_ok = epi_arena_get_provenance(arena, id_h1) != 0
        && epi_arena_get_provenance(arena, id_o) != 0
        && epi_arena_get_provenance(arena, id_h2) != 0

    let diff_prov = epi_arena_get_provenance(arena, id_h1)
        != epi_arena_get_provenance(arena, id_h2)

    let bound_ok = epi_arena_check_bound(arena, id_h1)
        && epi_arena_check_bound(arena, id_o)
        && epi_arena_check_bound(arena, id_h2)

    arena = epi_arena_free(arena, id_h2)
    let free_ok = epi_arena_len(arena) == 2
        && !epi_arena_is_live(arena, id_h2)

    let r3 = epi_arena_alloc(arena, 1)
    arena = r3.0
    let id_h3 = r3.1

    let reuse_ok = id_h3 == id_h2
    let lineage_ok = epi_arena_get_provenance(arena, id_h3) != 0
    let var_ok = epi_arena_get_variance(arena, id_h3) > 0
    let conf_ok = epi_arena_get_confidence(arena, id_h3) > 1

    count_ok && live_ok && val_ok && prov_ok && diff_prov
        && bound_ok && free_ok && reuse_ok && lineage_ok
        && var_ok && conf_ok
}

// ============================================================================
// TESTS
// ============================================================================

fn test_01_empty() -> bool {
    let a = epi_arena_new()
    epi_arena_len(a) == 0
}

fn test_02_alloc_single() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a = epi_arena_new()
    let result = epi_arena_alloc(a, 42)
    a = result.0
    let id = result.1
    id == 0 && epi_arena_len(a) == 1 && epi_arena_get(a, id) == 42
}

fn test_03_alloc_multiple() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a = epi_arena_new()

    let r0 = epi_arena_alloc(a, 10)
    a = r0.0
    let id0 = r0.1

    let r1 = epi_arena_alloc(a, 20)
    a = r1.0
    let id1 = r1.1

    let r2 = epi_arena_alloc(a, 30)
    a = r2.0
    let id2 = r2.1

    id0 == 0 && id1 == 1 && id2 == 2 && epi_arena_len(a) == 3
}

fn test_04_set_get() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a = epi_arena_new()
    let r0 = epi_arena_alloc(a, 0)
    a = r0.0
    let id = r0.1
    a = epi_arena_set(a, id, 77)
    epi_arena_get(a, id) == 77
}

fn test_05_provenance_seeded() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a = epi_arena_new()
    let r0 = epi_arena_alloc(a, 99)
    a = r0.0
    let id = r0.1
    epi_arena_get_provenance(a, id) != 0
        && epi_arena_get_variance(a, id) == 0
        && epi_arena_get_confidence(a, id) == 1
}

fn test_06_set_merges() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a = epi_arena_new()
    let r0 = epi_arena_alloc(a, 10)
    a = r0.0
    let id = r0.1

    let prov_before = epi_arena_get_provenance(a, id)
    a = epi_arena_set(a, id, 20)
    let prov_after = epi_arena_get_provenance(a, id)

    prov_after != prov_before
        && epi_arena_get_variance(a, id) == 1
        && epi_arena_get_confidence(a, id) == 2
}

fn test_07_free() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a = epi_arena_new()
    let r0 = epi_arena_alloc(a, 42)
    a = r0.0
    let id = r0.1

    a = epi_arena_free(a, id)
    epi_arena_len(a) == 0 && !epi_arena_is_live(a, id)
}

fn test_08_free_realloc() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a = epi_arena_new()
    let r0 = epi_arena_alloc(a, 42)
    a = r0.0
    let id0 = r0.1

    a = epi_arena_free(a, id0)

    let r1 = epi_arena_alloc(a, 99)
    a = r1.0
    let id1 = r1.1

    id1 == id0 && epi_arena_get(a, id1) == 99
        && epi_arena_get_variance(a, id1) > 0
        && epi_arena_get_confidence(a, id1) > 1
}

fn test_09_delta_32_bound() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var a = epi_arena_new()
    let r0 = epi_arena_alloc(a, 1)
    a = r0.0
    let r1 = epi_arena_alloc(a, 8)
    a = r1.0
    let r2 = epi_arena_alloc(a, 1)
    a = r2.0
    epi_arena_check_bound(a, 0) && epi_arena_check_bound(a, 1)
        && epi_arena_check_bound(a, 2)
}

fn test_10_chemical_self_check() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    epi_arena_chemical_self_check()
}

// === FILE: tests/run-pass/epistemic_bmi.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// Epistemic BMI example with first-order uncertainty propagation.

struct KnowledgeF64 {
    value: f64,
    uncertainty: f64
}

fn abs_f64(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 {
        return -x
    }
    return x
}

fn bmi(weight_kg: f64, height_m: f64) -> f64 {
    return weight_kg / (height_m * height_m)
}

fn propagate_bmi(weight: KnowledgeF64, height: KnowledgeF64) -> KnowledgeF64 {
    let nominal = bmi(weight.value, height.value)

    // First-order sensitivities:
    // dBMI/dw = 1 / h^2
    // dBMI/dh = -2w / h^3
    let d_dw = 1.0 / (height.value * height.value)
    let d_dh = -2.0 * weight.value / (height.value * height.value * height.value)

    // Conservative linear uncertainty bound.
    let propagated = abs_f64(d_dw) * weight.uncertainty + abs_f64(d_dh) * height.uncertainty

    return KnowledgeF64 {
        value: nominal,
        uncertainty: propagated
    }
}

fn main() with IO {
    let weight = KnowledgeF64 {
        value: 72.0,
        uncertainty: 0.6
    }

    let height = KnowledgeF64 {
        value: 1.78,
        uncertainty: 0.01
    }

    let result = propagate_bmi(weight, height)

    println("example: epistemic_bmi")
    println("BMI value")
    println(result.value)
    println("BMI uncertainty (first-order bound)")
    println(result.uncertainty)
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/epistemic_kernel_shadow.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// Epistemic kernel with Knowledge<f64> parameter triggers is_epistemic_kernel
// detection in the self-hosted checker. The --epistemic GPU pipeline generates
// shadow registers for uncertainty propagation.

kernel fn epistemic_add(n: i64, eps: Knowledge<f64>) with GPU, Mut, Div {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let x = 1.0 + 2.0
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO {
    0
}

//@ run-pass
// Epistemic kernel exercising unary ops (abs, neg via subtraction).
// The --epistemic GPU pipeline generates shadow passthrough for these ops.

kernel fn epistemic_unary(n: i64, eps: Knowledge<f64>) with GPU, Mut, Div {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < n {
        let x = 3.0 + 1.0
        i = i + 1
    }
}

    0

// === FILE: tests/run-pass/epistemic_molecule_h2o.sio ===
//@ run-pass
//@ expect-stdout: ALL 10 TESTS PASSED
//@ expect-stdout: Failed: 0
// Epistemic Molecule H2O Test Suite
//
// Self-contained tests for the epistemic chemical molecule graph.
// Every bond carries Merkle provenance, variance, and confidence.
// The hardware accumulator bound (delta_32 < 96) is verified.
//
// All functions inlined (tests cannot import stdlib).

// ============================================================================
// MERKLE INFRASTRUCTURE (inlined from hardware/rtl/kaxi/merkle_root_lane.sio)
// ============================================================================

let MOL_MERKLE_SALT_A: i64 = 0x4F4D4547
let MOL_MERKLE_SALT_B: i64 = 0x4147454E
let MOL_MERKLE_SALT_C: i64 = 0x45534953
let MOL_MERKLE_SALT_D: i64 = 0x76312E30

let MOL_MAX_ATOMS: i64 = 256
let MOL_MAX_BONDS: i64 = 512
let MOL_BOND_SINGLE: i64 = 1

fn mol_merkle_mix(a: i64, b: i64, c: i64, salt: i64) -> i64 {
    ((a ^ b) + c + salt) ^ (a << 5) ^ (b >> 7)
}

fn mol_merkle_root_lane_l64(
    p0: i64, p1: i64, p2: i64, p3: i64, p4: i64
) -> i64 {
    let h0 = mol_merkle_mix(p0, p1, p2, MOL_MERKLE_SALT_A)
    let h1 = mol_merkle_mix(p3, p4, h0, MOL_MERKLE_SALT_B)
    let h2 = mol_merkle_mix(h0, h1, p0 ^ p3, MOL_MERKLE_SALT_C)
    mol_merkle_mix(h1, h2, p1 ^ p2, MOL_MERKLE_SALT_D)
}

fn mol_atom_hash(atomic_number: i64, mass_q16_16: i64) -> i64 {
    var hash: i64 = 5381
    hash = hash * 33 + atomic_number
    hash = hash * 33 + mass_q16_16
    hash & 9223372036854775807
}

fn mol_bond_hash(src: i64, dst: i64, bond_type: i64) -> i64 {
    var hash: i64 = 5381
    hash = hash * 33 + src
    hash = hash * 33 + dst
    hash = hash * 33 + bond_type
    hash & 9223372036854775807
}

fn mol_provenance_seed(item_hash: i64) -> i64 {
    mol_merkle_root_lane_l64(0, item_hash, 0, 0, 1)
}

fn mol_provenance_merge(
    existing_root_l64: i64,
    item_hash: i64,
    variance_q32_32: i64,
    confidence_beta: i64
) -> i64 {
    mol_merkle_root_lane_l64(
        existing_root_l64,
        item_hash,
        variance_q32_32,
        confidence_beta,
        existing_root_l64 ^ item_hash
    )
}

fn mol_delta_32(fidelity: i64, provenance: i64, quantum: i64) -> i64 {
    let frac_f = fidelity - (fidelity / 8) * 8
    let frac_p = provenance - (provenance / 16) * 16
    let frac_q = quantum - (quantum / 32) * 32
    frac_f * 4 + frac_p * 2 + frac_q
}

// ============================================================================
// EPISTEMIC MOLECULE STRUCT (inlined)
// ============================================================================

struct EpistemicMolecule {
    atom_atomic_number: [i64; 256],
    atom_mass_q16_16: [i64; 256],
    atom_provenance_l64: [i64; 256],
    atom_count: i64,

    bond_src: [i64; 512],
    bond_dst: [i64; 512],
    bond_type: [i64; 512],
    bond_provenance_l64: [i64; 512],
    bond_variance_q32_32: [i64; 512],
    bond_confidence_beta: [i64; 512],
    bond_count: i64,

    mol_provenance_l64: i64,
}

fn mol_new() -> EpistemicMolecule {
    EpistemicMolecule {
        atom_atomic_number: [0; 256],
        atom_mass_q16_16: [0; 256],
        atom_provenance_l64: [0; 256],
        atom_count: 0,

        bond_src: [0; 512],
        bond_dst: [0; 512],
        bond_type: [0; 512],
        bond_provenance_l64: [0; 512],
        bond_variance_q32_32: [0; 512],
        bond_confidence_beta: [0; 512],
        bond_count: 0,

        mol_provenance_l64: 0,
    }
}

fn mol_add_atom(
    m: EpistemicMolecule,
    atomic_number: i64,
    mass_q16_16: i64
) -> (EpistemicMolecule, i64) with Mut, Panic {
    var mol = m
    if mol.atom_count >= MOL_MAX_ATOMS {
        return (mol, 0 - 1)
    }
    let id = mol.atom_count
    mol.atom_atomic_number[id] = atomic_number
    mol.atom_mass_q16_16[id] = mass_q16_16
    let ah = mol_atom_hash(atomic_number, mass_q16_16)
    mol.atom_provenance_l64[id] = mol_provenance_seed(ah)
    mol.atom_count = mol.atom_count + 1
    (mol, id)
}

fn mol_atom_count(m: EpistemicMolecule) -> i64 {
    m.atom_count
}

fn mol_atom_provenance_at(m: EpistemicMolecule, atom_id: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div {
    if atom_id < 0 || atom_id >= m.atom_count {
        return 0
    }
    m.atom_provenance_l64[atom_id]
}

fn mol_valid_atom(m: EpistemicMolecule, atom_id: i64) -> bool {
    atom_id >= 0 && atom_id < m.atom_count
}

fn mol_add_bond(
    m: EpistemicMolecule,
    src: i64,
    dst: i64,
    btype: i64
) -> EpistemicMolecule with Mut, Panic {
    var mol = m
    if !mol_valid_atom(mol, src) {
        return mol
    }
    if !mol_valid_atom(mol, dst) {
        return mol
    }
    if mol.bond_count >= MOL_MAX_BONDS {
        return mol
    }
    let id = mol.bond_count
    mol.bond_src[id] = src
    mol.bond_dst[id] = dst
    mol.bond_type[id] = btype
    let bh = mol_bond_hash(src, dst, btype)
    mol.bond_provenance_l64[id] = mol_provenance_seed(bh)
    mol.bond_variance_q32_32[id] = 0
    mol.bond_confidence_beta[id] = 1
    mol.bond_count = mol.bond_count + 1
    mol
}

fn mol_bond_count(m: EpistemicMolecule) -> i64 {
    m.bond_count
}

fn mol_degree(m: EpistemicMolecule, atom_id: i64) -> i64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var count: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < m.bond_count {
        if m.bond_src[i] == atom_id || m.bond_dst[i] == atom_id {
            count = count + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    count
}

fn mol_has_bond(m: EpistemicMolecule, src: i64, dst: i64) -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < m.bond_count {
        if m.bond_src[i] == src && m.bond_dst[i] == dst {
            return true
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    false
}

fn mol_bond_provenance(m: EpistemicMolecule, bond_id: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div {
    if bond_id < 0 || bond_id >= m.bond_count {
        return 0
    }
    m.bond_provenance_l64[bond_id]
}

fn mol_bond_variance(m: EpistemicMolecule, bond_id: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div {
    if bond_id < 0 || bond_id >= m.bond_count {
        return 0
    }
    m.bond_variance_q32_32[bond_id]
}

fn mol_bond_confidence(m: EpistemicMolecule, bond_id: i64) -> i64 with Panic, Div {
    if bond_id < 0 || bond_id >= m.bond_count {
        return 0
    }
    m.bond_confidence_beta[bond_id]
}

fn mol_update_provenance(m: EpistemicMolecule) -> EpistemicMolecule with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var mol = m
    var root: i64 = 0
    var i: i64 = 0
    while i < mol.bond_count {
        root = mol_merkle_mix(
            root,
            mol.bond_provenance_l64[i],
            mol.bond_variance_q32_32[i],
            MOL_MERKLE_SALT_A
        )
        i = i + 1
    }
    mol.mol_provenance_l64 = root
    mol
}

fn mol_molecule_provenance(m: EpistemicMolecule) -> i64 {
    m.mol_provenance_l64
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

fn test_empty_molecule() -> bool {
    let mol = mol_new()
    mol_atom_count(mol) == 0 && mol_bond_count(mol) == 0
        && mol_molecule_provenance(mol) == 0
}

fn test_add_atoms() -> bool with Mut, Panic {
    var mol = mol_new()
    // H(Z=1, mass=1.008 as Q16.16 ~= 66060)
    let p1 = mol_add_atom(mol, 1, 66060)
    mol = p1.0
    // O(Z=8, mass=15.999 as Q16.16 ~= 1048510)
    let p2 = mol_add_atom(mol, 8, 1048510)
    mol = p2.0
    // H(Z=1)
    let p3 = mol_add_atom(mol, 1, 66060)
    mol = p3.0
    mol_atom_count(mol) == 3 && p1.1 == 0 && p2.1 == 1 && p3.1 == 2
}

fn test_add_bonds() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var mol = mol_new()
    let p0 = mol_add_atom(mol, 1, 66060)
    mol = p0.0
    let p1 = mol_add_atom(mol, 8, 1048510)
    mol = p1.0
    let p2 = mol_add_atom(mol, 1, 66060)
    mol = p2.0
    mol = mol_add_bond(mol, 0, 1, MOL_BOND_SINGLE)
    mol = mol_add_bond(mol, 1, 2, MOL_BOND_SINGLE)
    let ok1 = mol_bond_count(mol) == 2
    let ok2 = mol_has_bond(mol, 0, 1)
    let ok3 = mol_has_bond(mol, 1, 2)
    let ok4 = !mol_has_bond(mol, 0, 2)
    ok1 && ok2 && ok3 && ok4
}

fn test_degree_check() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var mol = mol_new()
    let p0 = mol_add_atom(mol, 1, 66060)
    mol = p0.0
    let p1 = mol_add_atom(mol, 8, 1048510)
    mol = p1.0
    let p2 = mol_add_atom(mol, 1, 66060)
    mol = p2.0
    mol = mol_add_bond(mol, 0, 1, MOL_BOND_SINGLE)
    mol = mol_add_bond(mol, 1, 2, MOL_BOND_SINGLE)
    let deg_o = mol_degree(mol, 1)
    let deg_h1 = mol_degree(mol, 0)
    let deg_h2 = mol_degree(mol, 2)
    deg_o == 2 && deg_h1 == 1 && deg_h2 == 1
}

fn test_bond_provenance_seeded() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var mol = mol_new()
    let p0 = mol_add_atom(mol, 8, 1048510)
    mol = p0.0
    let p1 = mol_add_atom(mol, 1, 66060)
    mol = p1.0
    mol = mol_add_bond(mol, 0, 1, MOL_BOND_SINGLE)
    let prov = mol_bond_provenance(mol, 0)
    let var_v = mol_bond_variance(mol, 0)
    let conf = mol_bond_confidence(mol, 0)
    prov != 0 && var_v == 0 && conf == 1
}

fn test_molecule_provenance() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var mol = mol_new()
    let p0 = mol_add_atom(mol, 1, 66060)
    mol = p0.0
    let p1 = mol_add_atom(mol, 8, 1048510)
    mol = p1.0
    let p2 = mol_add_atom(mol, 1, 66060)
    mol = p2.0
    mol = mol_add_bond(mol, 0, 1, MOL_BOND_SINGLE)
    mol = mol_add_bond(mol, 1, 2, MOL_BOND_SINGLE)
    mol = mol_update_provenance(mol)
    mol_molecule_provenance(mol) != 0
}

fn test_different_bonds_different_provenance() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var mol = mol_new()
    let p0 = mol_add_atom(mol, 1, 66060)
    mol = p0.0
    let p1 = mol_add_atom(mol, 8, 1048510)
    mol = p1.0
    let p2 = mol_add_atom(mol, 1, 66060)
    mol = p2.0
    mol = mol_add_bond(mol, 0, 1, MOL_BOND_SINGLE)
    mol = mol_add_bond(mol, 1, 2, MOL_BOND_SINGLE)
    let prov_b0 = mol_bond_provenance(mol, 0)
    let prov_b1 = mol_bond_provenance(mol, 1)
    // Different endpoints produce different provenance roots
    prov_b0 != 0 && prov_b1 != 0 && prov_b0 != prov_b1
}

fn test_delta_32_bound() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var mol = mol_new()
    let p0 = mol_add_atom(mol, 8, 1048510)
    mol = p0.0
    let p1 = mol_add_atom(mol, 1, 66060)
    mol = p1.0
    mol = mol_add_bond(mol, 0, 1, MOL_BOND_SINGLE)
    let var_v = mol_bond_variance(mol, 0)
    let conf = mol_bond_confidence(mol, 0)
    let delta = mol_delta_32(0, var_v, conf)
    delta >= 0 && delta < 96
}

fn test_atom_provenance_nonzero() -> bool with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var mol = mol_new()
    let p0 = mol_add_atom(mol, 1, 66060)
    mol = p0.0
    let p1 = mol_add_atom(mol, 8, 1048510)
    mol = p1.0
    let prov_h = mol_atom_provenance_at(mol, 0)
    let prov_o = mol_atom_provenance_at(mol, 1)
    prov_h != 0 && prov_o != 0 && prov_h != prov_o
}

fn test_bond_invalid_atoms_noop() -> bool with Mut, Panic {
    var mol = mol_new()
    // No atoms added — bond should be no-op
    mol = mol_add_bond(mol, 0, 1, MOL_BOND_SINGLE)
    mol_bond_count(mol) == 0
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    println("=== Epistemic Molecule H2O Tests ===")
    println("")

    var passed = 0
    var failed = 0

    print("Test  1: Empty molecule.................. ")
    if test_empty_molecule() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("Test  2: Add atoms (H, O, H)............ ")
    if test_add_atoms() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("Test  3: Add bonds (H-O, O-H)........... ")
    if test_add_bonds() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("Test  4: Degree check (O=2, H=1)........ ")
    if test_degree_check() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("Test  5: Bond provenance seeded.......... ")
    if test_bond_provenance_seeded() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("Test  6: Molecule provenance non-zero.... ")
    if test_molecule_provenance() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("Test  7: Different bonds diff prov....... ")
    if test_different_bonds_different_provenance() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("Test  8: delta_32 bound [0, 96).......... ")
    if test_delta_32_bound() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("Test  9: Atom provenance non-zero........ ")
    if test_atom_provenance_nonzero() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    print("Test 10: Bond invalid atoms no-op........ ")
    if test_bond_invalid_atoms_noop() {
        println("PASS")
        passed = passed + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        failed = failed + 1
    }

    println("")
    print("Passed: ")
    println(passed)
    print("Failed: ")
    println(failed)

    if failed > 0 {
        println("SOME TESTS FAILED")
        return 1
    }
    println("ALL 10 TESTS PASSED")
    return 0
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/epistemic_nuclear_decay.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// ============================================================================
// SOUNIO EPISTEMIC NUCLEAR DECAY — Mo-99/Tc-99m Generator
// ============================================================================
// The world's most important medical isotope system:
// >30 million SPECT diagnostic scans/year depend on this physics.
//
// Bateman equations + NUBASE2020 half-life uncertainties + GUM propagation
// Compiled to bare-metal x86-64 ELF — NO runtime, NO libc, NO JIT.
//
// References:
//   Bateman 1910: "Solution of a System of Differential Equations"
//   NUBASE2020: Kondev et al., Chinese Physics C 45, 030001 (2021)
//   JCGM 100:2008 (GUM): Guide to Uncertainty in Measurement
// ============================================================================

var act_mo: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
var act_tc: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
var sig_mo: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
var sig_tc: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
var times:  [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
var rk4_out: [f64; 4] = [0.0; 4]

fn abs_f(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }; return x }
fn sqrt_f(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 25 { y = (y + x / y) * 0.5; i = i + 1 }
    return y
}
fn ln2() -> f64 { return 0.693147180559945 }

fn print_f64_3(v: f64) -> i64 {
    if v < 0.0 { print("-"); return print_f64_3(0.0 - v) }
    let ip = v as i64
    var frac = ((v - (ip as f64)) * 1000.0 + 0.5) as i64
    if frac >= 1000 { frac = 999 }
    print_int(ip); print(".")
    if frac < 100 { print("0") }
    if frac < 10 { print("0") }
    print_int(frac); return 0
}
fn print_f64_1(v: f64) -> i64 {
    if v < 0.0 { print("-"); return print_f64_1(0.0 - v) }
    let ip = v as i64
    let frac = ((v - (ip as f64)) * 10.0 + 0.5) as i64
    print_int(ip); print("."); print_int(frac); return 0
}
fn print_sci(v: f64) -> i64 {
    if v < 0.0 { print("-"); return print_sci(0.0 - v) }
    if v == 0.0 { print("0.00e+00"); return 0 }
    var e = 0
    var m = v
    while m >= 10.0 { m = m / 10.0; e = e + 1 }
    while m < 1.0 { m = m * 10.0; e = e - 1 }
    let ip = m as i64
    let frac = ((m - (ip as f64)) * 100.0 + 0.5) as i64
    print_int(ip); print(".")
    if frac < 10 { print("0") }
    print_int(frac)
    if e >= 0 { print("e+") } else { print("e-"); e = 0 - e }
    if e < 10 { print("0") }
    print_int(e); return 0
}

// Bateman: Mo-99 -> Tc-99m -> Tc-99(stable)
// dN_Mo/dt = -lam_Mo * N_Mo
// dN_Tc/dt = lam_Mo * N_Mo * BR - lam_Tc * N_Tc

fn rk4_step(nm: f64, nt: f64, lm: f64, lt: f64, br: f64, dt: f64) -> i64 {
    let k1m = 0.0 - lm * nm
    let k1t = lm * nm * br - lt * nt
    let m2 = nm + 0.5 * dt * k1m
    let t2 = nt + 0.5 * dt * k1t
    let k2m = 0.0 - lm * m2
    let k2t = lm * m2 * br - lt * t2
    let m3 = nm + 0.5 * dt * k2m
    let t3 = nt + 0.5 * dt * k2t
    let k3m = 0.0 - lm * m3
    let k3t = lm * m3 * br - lt * t3
    let m4 = nm + dt * k3m
    let t4 = nt + dt * k3t
    let k4m = 0.0 - lm * m4
    let k4t = lm * m4 * br - lt * t4
    rk4_out[0 as usize] = nm + dt / 6.0 * (k1m + 2.0 * k2m + 2.0 * k3m + k4m)
    rk4_out[1 as usize] = nt + dt / 6.0 * (k1t + 2.0 * k2t + 2.0 * k3t + k4t)
    return 0
}

fn run_sim(thm: f64, tht: f64, br: f64, ns: i64, dt: f64) -> i64 {
    let lm = ln2() / thm
    let lt = ln2() / tht
    var nm = 1000000.0
    var nt = 0.0
    var s = 0
    while s < ns {
        act_mo[s as usize] = lm * nm
        act_tc[s as usize] = lt * nt
        times[s as usize] = (s as f64) * dt
        rk4_step(nm, nt, lm, lt, br, dt)
        nm = rk4_out[0 as usize]
        nt = rk4_out[1 as usize]
        if nm < 0.0 { nm = 0.0 }
        if nt < 0.0 { nt = 0.0 }
        s = s + 1
    }
    return ns
}

fn propagate_unc(thm: f64, stm: f64, tht: f64, stt: f64, br: f64, ns: i64, dt: f64) -> i64 {
    let delta = 0.001
    run_sim(thm * (1.0 + delta), tht, br, ns, dt)
    var s = 0
    while s < ns { sig_mo[s as usize] = act_mo[s as usize]; sig_tc[s as usize] = act_tc[s as usize]; s = s + 1 }
    run_sim(thm, tht, br, ns, dt)
    s = 0
    while s < ns {
        let dAm = (sig_mo[s as usize] - act_mo[s as usize]) / (thm * delta)
        let dAt_mo = (sig_tc[s as usize] - act_tc[s as usize]) / (thm * delta)
        let lt = ln2() / tht
        let lt_hi = ln2() / (tht * (1.0 + delta))
        let dAt_tc = act_tc[s as usize] * (lt_hi - lt) / lt / (tht * delta)
        sig_mo[s as usize] = sqrt_f(dAm * dAm * stm * stm)
        sig_tc[s as usize] = sqrt_f(dAt_mo * dAt_mo * stm * stm + dAt_tc * dAt_tc * stt * stt)
        s = s + 1
    }
    return 0
}

fn main() -> i64 {
    print("==========================================================\n")
    print("  EPISTEMIC NUCLEAR DECAY: Mo-99/Tc-99m Generator\n")
    print("  Bateman eqs + GUM uncertainty | NUBASE2020\n")
    print("==========================================================\n\n")
    let thm = 65.924
    let stm = 0.006
    let tht = 6.0058
    let stt = 0.0012
    let br = 0.876
    let dt = 0.5
    let ns = 240
    print("  Mo-99  t1/2 = "); print_f64_3(thm); print(" +/- "); print_f64_3(stm); print(" h\n")
    print("  Tc-99m t1/2 = "); print_f64_3(tht); print(" +/- "); print_f64_3(stt); print(" h\n")
    print("  BR = "); print_f64_3(br); print("\n\n")
    propagate_unc(thm, stm, tht, stt, br, ns, dt)
    print("  Time  A(Mo-99)      sigma       A(Tc-99m)     sigma       Tc/Mo\n")
    print("  ----  --------      -----       ---------     -----       -----\n")
    var max_tc = 0.0
    var max_t = 0.0
    var eq_t = 0.0
    var eq_found = 0
    var tp = 0
    var i = 0
    while i < ns {
        let t = times[i as usize]
        let am = act_mo[i as usize]
        let at = act_tc[i as usize]
        if at > max_tc { max_tc = at; max_t = t }
        if am > 0.0 && at > 0.0 && eq_found == 0 && t > 30.0 && i > 1 {
            let r = at / am
            let rp = act_tc[((i - 1) as usize)] / act_mo[((i - 1) as usize)]
            if abs_f(r - rp) / r < 0.0001 { eq_t = t; eq_found = 1 }
        }
        let h = t as i64
        if h == 0 || h == 6 || h == 12 || h == 24 || h == 48 || h == 72 || h == 96 {
            if abs_f(t - (h as f64)) < 0.01 {
                print("  ")
                if h < 10 { print(" ") }
                print_int(h); print("h   ")
                print_sci(am); print("  "); print_sci(sig_mo[i as usize])
                print("  "); print_sci(at); print("  "); print_sci(sig_tc[i as usize])
                if am > 0.0 { print("  "); print_f64_3(at / am) }
                print("\n")
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    print("\n  Activity (M=Mo-99, T=Tc-99m):\n")
    let cmax = act_mo[0 as usize]
    i = 0
    while i < ns {
        let h = (times[i as usize]) as i64
        if h == 0 || h == 12 || h == 24 || h == 48 || h == 72 || h == 96 {
            if abs_f(times[i as usize] - (h as f64)) < 0.01 {
                print("  ")
                if h < 10 { print(" ") }
                print_int(h); print("h |")
                let wm = (act_mo[i as usize] / cmax * 40.0) as i64
                let wt = (act_tc[i as usize] / cmax * 40.0) as i64
                var j = 0
                while j < 40 {
                    if j < wm && j < wt { print("X") }
                    else if j < wm { print("M") }
                    else if j < wt { print("T") }
                    else { print(" ") }
                    j = j + 1
                }
                print("|\n")
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    print("\n  === RESULTS ===\n")
    print("  Tc-99m peak at t="); print_f64_1(max_t); print("h\n")
    if eq_found == 1 {
        let ei = (eq_t / dt) as i64
        print("  Transient equilibrium at t="); print_f64_1(eq_t); print("h\n")
        print("  Eq ratio = "); print_f64_3(act_tc[ei as usize] / act_mo[ei as usize])
        print(" +/- "); print_f64_3(sig_tc[ei as usize] / act_mo[ei as usize]); print("\n")
    }
    print("\n  === VALIDATION ===\n")
    let mo0 = act_mo[0 as usize]
    let moF = act_mo[((ns - 1) as usize)]
    if moF < mo0 { print("  PASS: Mo-99 decays\n"); tp = tp + 1 } else { print("  FAIL\n") }
    if max_tc > 0.0 && max_t > 5.0 && max_t < 30.0 { print("  PASS: Tc-99m peak at "); print_f64_1(max_t); print("h\n"); tp = tp + 1 } else { print("  FAIL\n") }
    if eq_found == 1 { print("  PASS: Transient equilibrium\n"); tp = tp + 1 } else { print("  FAIL\n") }
    let hi = (thm / dt) as i64
    let moh = act_mo[hi as usize]
    if abs_f(moh / mo0 - 0.5) < 0.01 { print("  PASS: Mo at t1/2 = "); print_f64_1(moh / mo0 * 100.0); print("%\n"); tp = tp + 1 } else { print("  FAIL\n") }
    if sig_tc[((ns - 10) as usize)] > 0.0 { print("  PASS: GUM uncertainty propagating\n"); tp = tp + 1 } else { print("  FAIL\n") }
    let lm = ln2() / thm
    let lt = ln2() / tht
    let th_r = br * lt / (lt - lm)
    if eq_found == 1 {
        let ei2 = (eq_t / dt) as i64
        let mr = act_tc[ei2 as usize] / act_mo[ei2 as usize]
        if abs_f(mr - th_r) / th_r < 0.05 { print("  PASS: Eq ratio "); print_f64_3(mr); print(" vs theory "); print_f64_3(th_r); print("\n"); tp = tp + 1 } else { print("  FAIL: "); print_f64_3(mr); print(" vs "); print_f64_3(th_r); print("\n") }
    } else { print("  SKIP\n") }
    print("\n  "); print_int(tp); print("/6 PASS\n")
    if tp >= 5 { return 0 } else { return 1 }
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/epistemic_pbpk_multidrug.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// ============================================================================
// SOUNIO MULTI-DRUG EPISTEMIC PBPK — Native ELF Demo
// ============================================================================
// 3 drugs × GUM uncertainty × ASCII concentration curves × 10 validations
// Compiles to native ELF via lean driver — NO runtime, NO libc, NO JIT.
//
// Drugs:
//   R = Rapamycin (Sirolimus) — 5mg IV, 3-compartment, CYP3A4/P-gp
//   C = Caffeine — 200mg oral, 1-compartment, CYP1A2
//   M = Metformin — 500mg oral, 1-compartment, renal clearance
//
// JCGM 100:2008 (GUM) via finite differences
// SOTA: Ferron 1997, Lampen 1998, Schreiber 1991, Lelo 1986, Graham 2011
// ============================================================================

// ---- Global concentration arrays (48 timepoints each) ----
var conc_r: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_c: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_m: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_r_hi: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_c_hi: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_m_hi: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_r_lo: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_c_lo: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
var conc_m_lo: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 0: MATH HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn ep_abs(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.0 { return 0.0 - x }
    return x
}

fn ep_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 {
        y = (y + x / y) * 0.5
        i = i + 1
    }
    return y
}

fn ep_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a > b { return a }
    return b
}

fn ep_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 {
    if a < b { return a }
    return b
}

fn ep_ln2() -> f64 { return 0.693147180559945 }

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 1: PRINT HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn print_f64_3(v: f64) -> i64 {
    if v < 0.0 {
        print("-")
        let nv = 0.0 - v
        let ip = nv as i64
        let frac = ((nv - (ip as f64)) * 1000.0) as i64
        print_int(ip)
        print(".")
        if frac < 100 { print("0") }
        if frac < 10 { print("0") }
        print_int(frac)
        return 0
    }
    let ip = v as i64
    let frac = ((v - (ip as f64)) * 1000.0) as i64
    print_int(ip)
    print(".")
    if frac < 100 { print("0") }
    if frac < 10 { print("0") }
    print_int(frac)
    return 0
}

fn print_f64_1(v: f64) -> i64 {
    if v < 0.0 {
        print("-")
        let nv = 0.0 - v
        let ip = nv as i64
        let frac = ((nv - (ip as f64)) * 10.0) as i64
        print_int(ip)
        print(".")
        print_int(frac)
        return 0
    }
    let ip = v as i64
    let frac = ((v - (ip as f64)) * 10.0) as i64
    print_int(ip)
    print(".")
    print_int(frac)
    return 0
}

fn print_spaces(n: i64) -> i64 {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        print(" ")
        i = i + 1
    }
    return 0
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 2: RAPAMYCIN 3-COMPARTMENT MODEL
// ============================================================================

struct Rp3St {
    blood: f64,
    brain: f64,
    periph: f64,
}

struct Rp3Prm {
    v_blood: f64,
    v_brain: f64,
    v_periph: f64,
    q_brain: f64,
    q_periph: f64,
    kp_brain: f64,
    kp_periph: f64,
    cl_hepatic: f64,
    fu_plasma: f64,
}

fn rp3_zero() -> Rp3St {
    return Rp3St { blood: 0.0, brain: 0.0, periph: 0.0 }
}

fn rp3_add(a: Rp3St, b: Rp3St) -> Rp3St {
    return Rp3St { blood: a.blood + b.blood, brain: a.brain + b.brain, periph: a.periph + b.periph }
}

fn rp3_scale(s: Rp3St, f: f64) -> Rp3St {
    return Rp3St { blood: s.blood * f, brain: s.brain * f, periph: s.periph * f }
}

fn rp3_ode(st: Rp3St, p: Rp3Prm) -> Rp3St {
    let cl_eff = p.cl_hepatic * p.fu_plasma
    let inflow_br = p.q_brain / p.v_blood * st.brain / p.kp_brain
    let inflow_pr = p.q_periph / p.v_blood * st.periph / p.kp_periph
    let outflow = (p.q_brain + p.q_periph) / p.v_blood * st.blood
    let clear = cl_eff / p.v_blood * st.blood
    let d_blood = inflow_br + inflow_pr - outflow - clear
    let d_brain = (p.q_brain / p.v_brain) * (st.blood - st.brain / p.kp_brain)
    let d_periph = (p.q_periph / p.v_periph) * (st.blood - st.periph / p.kp_periph)
    return Rp3St { blood: d_blood, brain: d_brain, periph: d_periph }
}

fn rk4_rp3(st: Rp3St, p: Rp3Prm, dt: f64) -> Rp3St {
    let k1 = rp3_ode(st, p)
    let s2 = rp3_add(st, rp3_scale(k1, dt * 0.5))
    let k2 = rp3_ode(s2, p)
    let s3 = rp3_add(st, rp3_scale(k2, dt * 0.5))
    let k3 = rp3_ode(s3, p)
    let s4 = rp3_add(st, rp3_scale(k3, dt))
    let k4 = rp3_ode(s4, p)
    let w = rp3_add(k1, rp3_add(rp3_scale(k2, 2.0), rp3_add(rp3_scale(k3, 2.0), k4)))
    return rp3_add(st, rp3_scale(w, dt / 6.0))
}

fn rp3_mean_params() -> Rp3Prm {
    return Rp3Prm {
        v_blood: 5.0, v_brain: 1.4, v_periph: 50.0,
        q_brain: 0.05, q_periph: 87.0,
        kp_brain: 0.08, kp_periph: 0.5,
        cl_hepatic: 12.4, fu_plasma: 0.08,
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 3: CAFFEINE 1-COMPARTMENT MODEL
// ============================================================================

struct Oc1St {
    gut: f64,
    plasma: f64,
}

struct CafPrm {
    ka: f64,
    cl: f64,
    v: f64,
    f_oral: f64,
}

fn oc1_ode_caf(st: Oc1St, p: CafPrm) -> Oc1St {
    let ke = p.cl / p.v
    let d_gut = (0.0 - p.ka) * st.gut
    let d_plasma = p.ka * st.gut / p.v - ke * st.plasma
    return Oc1St { gut: d_gut, plasma: d_plasma }
}

fn rk4_caf(st: Oc1St, p: CafPrm, dt: f64) -> Oc1St {
    let k1 = oc1_ode_caf(st, p)
    let s2 = Oc1St { gut: st.gut + k1.gut * dt * 0.5, plasma: st.plasma + k1.plasma * dt * 0.5 }
    let k2 = oc1_ode_caf(s2, p)
    let s3 = Oc1St { gut: st.gut + k2.gut * dt * 0.5, plasma: st.plasma + k2.plasma * dt * 0.5 }
    let k3 = oc1_ode_caf(s3, p)
    let s4 = Oc1St { gut: st.gut + k3.gut * dt, plasma: st.plasma + k3.plasma * dt }
    let k4 = oc1_ode_caf(s4, p)
    let dg = (k1.gut + 2.0 * k2.gut + 2.0 * k3.gut + k4.gut) / 6.0
    let dp = (k1.plasma + 2.0 * k2.plasma + 2.0 * k3.plasma + k4.plasma) / 6.0
    return Oc1St { gut: st.gut + dg * dt, plasma: st.plasma + dp * dt }
}

fn caf_mean_params() -> CafPrm {
    return CafPrm { ka: 4.4, cl: 5.46, v: 42.0, f_oral: 0.99 }
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 4: METFORMIN 1-COMPARTMENT MODEL
// ============================================================================

struct MetPrm {
    ka: f64,
    cl: f64,
    v: f64,
    f_oral: f64,
}

fn oc1_ode_met(st: Oc1St, p: MetPrm) -> Oc1St {
    let ke = p.cl / p.v
    let d_gut = (0.0 - p.ka) * st.gut
    let d_plasma = p.ka * st.gut / p.v - ke * st.plasma
    return Oc1St { gut: d_gut, plasma: d_plasma }
}

fn rk4_met(st: Oc1St, p: MetPrm, dt: f64) -> Oc1St {
    let k1 = oc1_ode_met(st, p)
    let s2 = Oc1St { gut: st.gut + k1.gut * dt * 0.5, plasma: st.plasma + k1.plasma * dt * 0.5 }
    let k2 = oc1_ode_met(s2, p)
    let s3 = Oc1St { gut: st.gut + k2.gut * dt * 0.5, plasma: st.plasma + k2.plasma * dt * 0.5 }
    let k3 = oc1_ode_met(s3, p)
    let s4 = Oc1St { gut: st.gut + k3.gut * dt, plasma: st.plasma + k3.plasma * dt }
    let k4 = oc1_ode_met(s4, p)
    let dg = (k1.gut + 2.0 * k2.gut + 2.0 * k3.gut + k4.gut) / 6.0
    let dp = (k1.plasma + 2.0 * k2.plasma + 2.0 * k3.plasma + k4.plasma) / 6.0
    return Oc1St { gut: st.gut + dg * dt, plasma: st.plasma + dp * dt }
}

fn met_mean_params() -> MetPrm {
    return MetPrm { ka: 0.9, cl: 21.0, v: 400.0, f_oral: 0.5 }
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 5: SIMULATION COLLECTORS (store hourly into global arrays)
// ============================================================================

struct DrugResult {
    cmax: f64,
    auc: f64,
    bpr: f64,
    thalf: f64,
}

fn sim_rp3(prm: Rp3Prm, dose: f64) -> DrugResult {
    let c0 = dose / prm.v_blood
    var st = Rp3St { blood: c0, brain: 0.0, periph: 0.0 }
    var t = 0.0
    let dt = 0.1
    var cmax = c0
    var auc = 0.0
    var c_prev = c0
    var hour = 0

    conc_r[0 as usize] = c0

    while t < 48.0 {
        var dt_use = dt
        if t + dt > 48.0 { dt_use = 48.0 - t }
        st = rk4_rp3(st, prm, dt_use)
        if st.blood > cmax { cmax = st.blood }
        auc = auc + (c_prev + st.blood) * 0.5 * dt_use
        c_prev = st.blood
        t = t + dt_use
        // Store hourly snapshots
        let next_hour = (t as i64)
        if next_hour > hour {
            hour = next_hour
            if hour < 48 {
                conc_r[hour as usize] = st.blood
            }
        }
    }

    var bpr = 0.0
    if st.blood > 0.000000000001 { bpr = st.brain / st.blood }

    // Estimate t1/2 from concentration decay
    var thalf = 0.0
    let half_c = cmax * 0.5
    var hi = 1
    while hi < 48 {
        if conc_r[hi as usize] < half_c {
            thalf = hi as f64
            hi = 48
        }
        hi = hi + 1
    }

    return DrugResult { cmax: cmax, auc: auc, bpr: bpr, thalf: thalf }
}

fn sim_caf(prm: CafPrm, dose: f64) -> DrugResult {
    var st = Oc1St { gut: prm.f_oral * dose, plasma: 0.0 }
    var t = 0.0
    let dt = 0.05
    var cmax = 0.0
    var auc = 0.0
    var c_prev = 0.0
    var hour = 0

    conc_c[0 as usize] = 0.0

    while t < 48.0 {
        var dt_use = dt
        if t + dt > 48.0 { dt_use = 48.0 - t }
        st = rk4_caf(st, prm, dt_use)
        if st.plasma > cmax { cmax = st.plasma }
        auc = auc + (c_prev + st.plasma) * 0.5 * dt_use
        c_prev = st.plasma
        t = t + dt_use
        let next_hour = (t as i64)
        if next_hour > hour {
            hour = next_hour
            if hour < 48 {
                conc_c[hour as usize] = st.plasma
            }
        }
    }

    let ke = prm.cl / prm.v
    let thalf = ep_ln2() / ke

    return DrugResult { cmax: cmax, auc: auc, bpr: 0.0, thalf: thalf }
}

fn sim_met(prm: MetPrm, dose: f64) -> DrugResult {
    var st = Oc1St { gut: prm.f_oral * dose, plasma: 0.0 }
    var t = 0.0
    let dt = 0.05
    var cmax = 0.0
    var auc = 0.0
    var c_prev = 0.0
    var hour = 0

    conc_m[0 as usize] = 0.0

    while t < 48.0 {
        var dt_use = dt
        if t + dt > 48.0 { dt_use = 48.0 - t }
        st = rk4_met(st, prm, dt_use)
        if st.plasma > cmax { cmax = st.plasma }
        auc = auc + (c_prev + st.plasma) * 0.5 * dt_use
        c_prev = st.plasma
        t = t + dt_use
        let next_hour = (t as i64)
        if next_hour > hour {
            hour = next_hour
            if hour < 48 {
                conc_m[hour as usize] = st.plasma
            }
        }
    }

    let ke = prm.cl / prm.v
    let thalf = ep_ln2() / ke

    return DrugResult { cmax: cmax, auc: auc, bpr: 0.0, thalf: thalf }
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 6: GUM EPISTEMIC PROPAGATION
// ============================================================================

fn fdiff_h(mean: f64, variance: f64) -> f64 {
    let h_rel = 0.000001 * ep_abs(mean)
    let h_abs = 0.01 * ep_sqrt(variance)
    return ep_max(h_rel, h_abs)
}

struct EpDrug {
    cmax: f64,
    auc: f64,
    auc_var: f64,
    cv_auc: f64,
    bpr: f64,
    thalf: f64,
    conf: f64,
    s_p1: f64,
    s_p2: f64,
    s_p3: f64,
}

fn ep_rapamycin() -> EpDrug {
    let prm = rp3_mean_params()
    let ref_m = sim_rp3(prm, 5.0)

    // CL perturbation
    let h_cl = fdiff_h(12.4, 54.76)
    var prm_cl = rp3_mean_params()
    prm_cl.cl_hepatic = 12.4 + h_cl
    let m_cl = sim_rp3(prm_cl, 5.0)
    let da_cl = (m_cl.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_cl

    // kp_brain perturbation
    let h_kp = fdiff_h(0.08, 0.000625)
    var prm_kp = rp3_mean_params()
    prm_kp.kp_brain = 0.08 + h_kp
    let m_kp = sim_rp3(prm_kp, 5.0)
    let da_kp = (m_kp.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_kp

    // fu perturbation
    let h_fu = fdiff_h(0.08, 0.0004)
    var prm_fu = rp3_mean_params()
    prm_fu.fu_plasma = 0.08 + h_fu
    let m_fu = sim_rp3(prm_fu, 5.0)
    let da_fu = (m_fu.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_fu

    let var_auc = da_cl * da_cl * 54.76 + da_kp * da_kp * 0.000625 + da_fu * da_fu * 0.0004
    let sd_auc = ep_sqrt(var_auc)
    var cv = 0.0
    if ref_m.auc > 0.0 { cv = sd_auc / ref_m.auc }

    var s1 = 0.0
    var s2 = 0.0
    var s3 = 0.0
    if var_auc > 0.0 {
        s1 = da_cl * da_cl * 54.76 / var_auc
        s2 = da_kp * da_kp * 0.000625 / var_auc
        s3 = da_fu * da_fu * 0.0004 / var_auc
    }
    let conf = 0.65 * s1 + 0.55 * s2 + 0.72 * s3

    // Fill confidence bands using CV scaling
    var bi = 0
    while bi < 48 {
        let cv_scale = cv * conc_r[bi as usize]
        conc_r_hi[bi as usize] = conc_r[bi as usize] + cv_scale
        conc_r_lo[bi as usize] = conc_r[bi as usize] - cv_scale
        if conc_r_lo[bi as usize] < 0.0 { conc_r_lo[bi as usize] = 0.0 }
        bi = bi + 1
    }

    return EpDrug { cmax: ref_m.cmax, auc: ref_m.auc, auc_var: var_auc, cv_auc: cv,
                    bpr: ref_m.bpr, thalf: ref_m.thalf, conf: conf,
                    s_p1: s1, s_p2: s2, s_p3: s3 }
}

fn ep_caffeine() -> EpDrug {
    let prm = caf_mean_params()
    let ref_m = sim_caf(prm, 200.0)

    let h_ka = fdiff_h(4.4, 0.7744)
    var prm_ka = caf_mean_params()
    prm_ka.ka = 4.4 + h_ka
    let m_ka = sim_caf(prm_ka, 200.0)
    let da_ka = (m_ka.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_ka

    let h_cl = fdiff_h(5.46, 3.651)
    var prm_cl = caf_mean_params()
    prm_cl.cl = 5.46 + h_cl
    let m_cl = sim_caf(prm_cl, 200.0)
    let da_cl = (m_cl.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_cl

    let h_v = fdiff_h(42.0, 39.69)
    var prm_v = caf_mean_params()
    prm_v.v = 42.0 + h_v
    let m_v = sim_caf(prm_v, 200.0)
    let da_v = (m_v.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_v

    let var_auc = da_ka * da_ka * 0.7744 + da_cl * da_cl * 3.651 + da_v * da_v * 39.69
    let sd = ep_sqrt(var_auc)
    var cv = 0.0
    if ref_m.auc > 0.0 { cv = sd / ref_m.auc }

    var s1 = 0.0
    var s2 = 0.0
    var s3 = 0.0
    if var_auc > 0.0 {
        s1 = da_ka * da_ka * 0.7744 / var_auc
        s2 = da_cl * da_cl * 3.651 / var_auc
        s3 = da_v * da_v * 39.69 / var_auc
    }
    let conf = 0.70 * s1 + 0.75 * s2 + 0.68 * s3

    var bi = 0
    while bi < 48 {
        let cv_s = cv * conc_c[bi as usize]
        conc_c_hi[bi as usize] = conc_c[bi as usize] + cv_s
        conc_c_lo[bi as usize] = conc_c[bi as usize] - cv_s
        if conc_c_lo[bi as usize] < 0.0 { conc_c_lo[bi as usize] = 0.0 }
        bi = bi + 1
    }

    return EpDrug { cmax: ref_m.cmax, auc: ref_m.auc, auc_var: var_auc, cv_auc: cv,
                    bpr: 0.0, thalf: ref_m.thalf, conf: conf,
                    s_p1: s1, s_p2: s2, s_p3: s3 }
}

fn ep_metformin() -> EpDrug {
    let prm = met_mean_params()
    let ref_m = sim_met(prm, 500.0)

    let h_ka = fdiff_h(0.9, 0.050625)
    var prm_ka = met_mean_params()
    prm_ka.ka = 0.9 + h_ka
    let m_ka = sim_met(prm_ka, 500.0)
    let da_ka = (m_ka.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_ka

    let h_cl = fdiff_h(21.0, 39.69)
    var prm_cl = met_mean_params()
    prm_cl.cl = 21.0 + h_cl
    let m_cl = sim_met(prm_cl, 500.0)
    let da_cl = (m_cl.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_cl

    let h_v = fdiff_h(400.0, 6400.0)
    var prm_v = met_mean_params()
    prm_v.v = 400.0 + h_v
    let m_v = sim_met(prm_v, 500.0)
    let da_v = (m_v.auc - ref_m.auc) / h_v

    let var_auc = da_ka * da_ka * 0.050625 + da_cl * da_cl * 39.69 + da_v * da_v * 6400.0
    let sd = ep_sqrt(var_auc)
    var cv = 0.0
    if ref_m.auc > 0.0 { cv = sd / ref_m.auc }

    var s1 = 0.0
    var s2 = 0.0
    var s3 = 0.0
    if var_auc > 0.0 {
        s1 = da_ka * da_ka * 0.050625 / var_auc
        s2 = da_cl * da_cl * 39.69 / var_auc
        s3 = da_v * da_v * 6400.0 / var_auc
    }
    let conf = 0.60 * s1 + 0.70 * s2 + 0.65 * s3

    var bi = 0
    while bi < 48 {
        let cv_s = cv * conc_m[bi as usize]
        conc_m_hi[bi as usize] = conc_m[bi as usize] + cv_s
        conc_m_lo[bi as usize] = conc_m[bi as usize] - cv_s
        if conc_m_lo[bi as usize] < 0.0 { conc_m_lo[bi as usize] = 0.0 }
        bi = bi + 1
    }

    return EpDrug { cmax: ref_m.cmax, auc: ref_m.auc, auc_var: var_auc, cv_auc: cv,
                    bpr: 0.0, thalf: ref_m.thalf, conf: conf,
                    s_p1: s1, s_p2: s2, s_p3: s3 }
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 7: ASCII PLOT
// ============================================================================

fn plot_find_max() -> f64 {
    var mx = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < 48 {
        if conc_r_hi[i as usize] > mx { mx = conc_r_hi[i as usize] }
        if conc_c_hi[i as usize] > mx { mx = conc_c_hi[i as usize] }
        if conc_m_hi[i as usize] > mx { mx = conc_m_hi[i as usize] }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return mx
}

fn plot_render(y_max: f64) -> i64 {
    let rows = 20
    var row = rows
    while row >= 0 {
        // Y-axis label
        let y_val = y_max * (row as f64) / 20.0
        if y_val < 10.0 { print(" ") }
        print_f64_1(y_val)
        print("|")

        var col = 0
        while col < 48 {
            let threshold = y_max * (row as f64) / 20.0
            let rv = conc_r[col as usize]
            let cv = conc_c[col as usize]
            let mv = conc_m[col as usize]
            let rh = conc_r_hi[col as usize]
            let ch = conc_c_hi[col as usize]
            let mh = conc_m_hi[col as usize]

            var printed = 0
            // Mean curves (uppercase)
            if cv >= threshold { if printed == 0 { print("C"); printed = 1 } }
            if rv >= threshold { if printed == 0 { print("R"); printed = 1 } }
            if mv >= threshold { if printed == 0 { print("M"); printed = 1 } }
            // Confidence bands (lowercase)
            if printed == 0 {
                if ch >= threshold { if conc_c_lo[col as usize] < threshold { print("c"); printed = 1 } }
            }
            if printed == 0 {
                if rh >= threshold { if conc_r_lo[col as usize] < threshold { print("r"); printed = 1 } }
            }
            if printed == 0 {
                if mh >= threshold { if conc_m_lo[col as usize] < threshold { print("m"); printed = 1 } }
            }
            if printed == 0 { print(" ") }
            col = col + 1
        }
        print("\n")
        row = row - 1
    }
    // X-axis
    print("     +")
    var xi = 0
    while xi < 48 { print("-"); xi = xi + 1 }
    print("\n")
    print("      0    6   12   18   24   30   36   42  48h\n")
    print("      R=Rapamycin  C=Caffeine  M=Metformin  (lower=+/-1s)\n")
    return 0
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 8: COMPARISON TABLE
// ============================================================================

fn print_drug_summary(name_tag: i64, d: EpDrug) -> i64 {
    if name_tag == 0 {
        print("  Rapamycin  5mg IV   ")
    }
    if name_tag == 1 {
        print("  Caffeine   200mg PO ")
    }
    if name_tag == 2 {
        print("  Metformin  500mg PO ")
    }
    print_f64_3(d.cmax)
    print("     ")
    print_f64_3(d.auc)
    print("+/-")
    print_f64_3(ep_sqrt(d.auc_var))
    print("  ")
    print_f64_1(d.thalf)
    print("h  ")
    print_f64_3(d.cv_auc * 100.0)
    print("%  ")
    print_f64_3(d.conf)
    print("\n")
    return 0
}

// ============================================================================
// LAYER 9: VALIDATION
// ============================================================================

fn run_tests(r: EpDrug, c: EpDrug, m: EpDrug) -> i64 {
    var passed = 0
    var failed = 0

    // T1: Rapamycin brain/plasma < 0.15
    if r.bpr > 0.0 { if r.bpr < 0.15 {
        print("  PASS T1: brain/plasma < 0.15 (P-gp)\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T1\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T1: bpr=0\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T2: Rapamycin CV(AUC) > 30%
    if r.cv_auc > 0.30 {
        print("  PASS T2: rapa CV(AUC) > 30%\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T2\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T3: Caffeine Cmax reasonable (3-6 mg/L for 200mg oral)
    if c.cmax > 2.0 { if c.cmax < 8.0 {
        print("  PASS T3: caffeine Cmax in [2,8] mg/L\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T3: Cmax too high\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T3: Cmax too low\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T4: Caffeine t1/2 within 20% of 5.33h
    let t_err = ep_abs(c.thalf - 5.33) / 5.33
    if t_err < 0.20 {
        print("  PASS T4: caffeine t1/2 ~ 5.3h\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T4: t1/2 error > 20%\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T5: Metformin Cmax < Caffeine Cmax (V=400L >> 42L)
    if m.cmax < c.cmax {
        print("  PASS T5: met Cmax < caf Cmax (V=400 >> 42)\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T5\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T6: All AUC variances > 0
    if r.auc_var > 0.0 { if c.auc_var > 0.0 { if m.auc_var > 0.0 {
        print("  PASS T6: all AUC variances > 0\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T6\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T6\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T6\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T7: CL dominates rapamycin AUC uncertainty
    if r.s_p1 > 0.5 {
        print("  PASS T7: CL dominates rapa AUC (s_cl > 0.5)\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T7\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T8: Causal monotonicity — caffeine AUC(CL/2) > AUC(CL)
    var prm_lo = caf_mean_params()
    prm_lo.cl = 2.73
    let m_lo = sim_caf(prm_lo, 200.0)
    if m_lo.auc > c.auc {
        print("  PASS T8: caf AUC(CL/2) > AUC(CL)\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T8\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T9: All confidences in (0,1)
    if r.conf > 0.0 { if r.conf < 1.0 { if c.conf > 0.0 { if c.conf < 1.0 { if m.conf > 0.0 { if m.conf < 1.0 {
        print("  PASS T9: all confidences in (0,1)\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T9\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T9\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T9\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T9\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T9\n"); failed = failed + 1 }
    } else { print("  FAIL T9\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    // T10: Metformin AUC > Rapamycin AUC (500mg vs 5mg, similar ke)
    if m.auc > r.auc {
        print("  PASS T10: met AUC > rapa AUC\n"); passed = passed + 1
    } else { print("  FAIL T10\n"); failed = failed + 1 }

    print("\n  RESULT: ")
    print_int(passed)
    print("/10 PASS, ")
    print_int(failed)
    print(" FAIL\n")

    return failed
}
