// === FILE: tests/run-pass/test_integral_eq.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// test_integral_eq.sio -- Tests for integral equations module
//
// Tests:
//  1.  GL nodes symmetric
//  2.  GL weights sum to 2
//  3.  GL integrates x^2 exactly
//  4.  Fredholm 2nd kind with known analytical solution
//  5.  Fredholm 2nd kind residual small
//  6.  Volterra 2nd kind: u'=u => exp(x)
//  7.  Volterra forward marching n_steps
//  8.  Green's function symmetry
//  9.  BVP via Green's: -u''=1
// 10.  Neumann series converges for small lambda
// 11.  Tikhonov regularization produces bounded solution
// 12.  Eigenvalue of K(x,t)=x*t on [0,1]

// ============================================================================
// HELPERS (copied from integral_eq.sio -- tests must be self-contained)
// ============================================================================

fn ie_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn ie_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }

fn ie_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn ie_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 500.0 { return 1.0e200 }
    if x < -500.0 { return 0.0 }
    var kf = x / 0.6931471805599453
    var k: i32 = 0
    if kf >= 0.0 { k = kf as i32 } else { k = (kf as i32) - 1 }
    let r = x - (k as f64) * 0.6931471805599453
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var n = 1
    while n < 25 { term = term * r / (n as f64); sum = sum + term; n = n + 1 }
    var result = sum
    if k >= 0 { var i = 0; while i < k { result = result * 2.0; i = i + 1 } }
    else { var i = 0; while i < (0 - k) { result = result / 2.0; i = i + 1 } }
    result
}

fn ie_sin(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var a = x
    let tp = 6.28318530717958647692
    while a >= tp { a = a - tp }
    while a < 0.0 { a = a + tp }
    if a > 3.14159265358979323846 { a = a - tp }
    let a2 = a * a
    var sum = a
    var term = a
    var n = 1
    while n < 18 { term = 0.0 - term * a2 / ((2 * n) * (2 * n + 1)) as f64; sum = sum + term; n = n + 1 }
    sum
}

fn ie_cos(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    ie_sin(x + 1.57079632679489661923)
}

fn ie_ln(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 - 1.0e30 }
    if x == 1.0 { return 0.0 }
    var m = x
    var e = 0
    while m >= 2.0 { m = m / 2.0; e = e + 1 }
    while m < 0.5 { m = m * 2.0; e = e - 1 }
    let t = (m - 1.0) / (m + 1.0)
    let t2 = t * t
    var sum = t
    var term = t
    var k = 1
    while k < 30 { term = term * t2; sum = sum + term / ((2 * k + 1) as f64); k = k + 1 }
    2.0 * sum + (e as f64) * 0.6931471805599453
}

fn ie_pi() -> f64 { 3.14159265358979323846 }

fn ie_pow(base: f64, exp_val: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if base <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    ie_exp(exp_val * ie_ln(base))
}

// ============================================================================
// LINEAR ALGEBRA HELPERS
// ============================================================================

fn ie_dot(a: &[f64; 128], b: &[f64; 128], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n { sum = sum + a[i] * b[i]; i = i + 1 }
    sum
}

fn ie_mat_vec(A: &[f64; 16384], x: &[f64; 128], y: &![f64; 128], m: i32, n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < n { sum = sum + A[i * n + j] * x[j]; j = j + 1 }
        y[i] = sum
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn ie_gauss_solve(A: &![f64; 16384], b: &![f64; 128], x: &![f64; 128], n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var col = 0
    while col < n {
        var max_val = ie_abs(A[col * n + col])
        var max_row = col
        var row = col + 1
        while row < n {
            let v = ie_abs(A[row * n + col])
            if v > max_val { max_val = v; max_row = row }
            row = row + 1
        }
        if max_row != col {
            var j = 0
            while j < n {
                let tmp = A[col * n + j]
                A[col * n + j] = A[max_row * n + j]
                A[max_row * n + j] = tmp
                j = j + 1
            }
            let tmp_b = b[col]
            b[col] = b[max_row]
            b[max_row] = tmp_b
        }
        let pivot = A[col * n + col]
        if ie_abs(pivot) < 1.0e-30 {
            col = col + 1
        } else {
            row = col + 1
            while row < n {
                let factor = A[row * n + col] / pivot
                var j = col + 1
                while j < n {
                    A[row * n + j] = A[row * n + j] - factor * A[col * n + j]
                    j = j + 1
                }
                A[row * n + col] = 0.0
                b[row] = b[row] - factor * b[col]
                row = row + 1
            }
            col = col + 1
        }
    }
    var k = n - 1
    while k >= 0 {
        var s = b[k]
        var j = k + 1
        while j < n { s = s - A[k * n + j] * x[j]; j = j + 1 }
        if ie_abs(A[k * n + k]) > 1.0e-30 {
            x[k] = s / A[k * n + k]
        } else {
            x[k] = 0.0
        }
        k = k - 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// RESULT STRUCTS
// ============================================================================

struct IEResult {
    u: [f64; 128],
    nodes: [f64; 128],
    weights: [f64; 128],
    n: i32,
    residual: f64,
    converged: bool
}

struct IEEigenResult {
    eigenvalues: [f64; 64],
    eigenvectors: [f64; 8192],
    n_found: i32,
    n_quad: i32
}

// ============================================================================
// GAUSS-LEGENDRE QUADRATURE
// ============================================================================

fn ie_gauss_legendre(n: i32, nodes: &![f64; 128], weights: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_half = (n + 1) / 2
    var i = 0
    while i < n_half {
        var x = ie_cos(ie_pi() * ((i as f64) + 0.75) / ((n as f64) + 0.5))
        var iter = 0
        while iter < 50 {
            var p0 = 1.0
            var p1 = x
            var k = 1
            while k < n {
                let p2 = ((2 * k + 1) as f64 * x * p1 - (k as f64) * p0) / ((k + 1) as f64)
                p0 = p1
                p1 = p2
                k = k + 1
            }
            let dp = (n as f64) * (x * p1 - p0) / (x * x - 1.0)
            let dx = p1 / dp
            x = x - dx
            if ie_abs(dx) < 1.0e-15 { iter = 50 }
            iter = iter + 1
        }
        nodes[i] = 0.0 - x
        nodes[n - 1 - i] = x
        var p0w = 1.0
        var p1w = x
        var k = 1
        while k < n {
            let p2 = ((2 * k + 1) as f64 * x * p1w - (k as f64) * p0w) / ((k + 1) as f64)
            p0w = p1w
            p1w = p2
            k = k + 1
        }
        let dpw = (n as f64) * (x * p1w - p0w) / (x * x - 1.0)
        let w = 2.0 / ((1.0 - x * x) * dpw * dpw)
        weights[i] = w
        weights[n - 1 - i] = w
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn ie_gauss_legendre_ab(a: f64, b: f64, n: i32,
                        nodes: &![f64; 128], weights: &![f64; 128]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    ie_gauss_legendre(n, nodes, weights)
    let half_len = 0.5 * (b - a)
    let midpoint = 0.5 * (a + b)
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        nodes[i] = half_len * nodes[i] + midpoint
        weights[i] = weights[i] * half_len
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// FREDHOLM 2ND KIND -- NYSTROM
// ============================================================================

fn ie_residual_fredholm2_internal(K: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                                  f: fn(f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                                  lambda: f64, result: &IEResult) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var max_res = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < result.n {
        var ku_i = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < result.n {
            ku_i = ku_i + result.weights[j] * K(result.nodes[i], result.nodes[j]) * result.u[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        let expected = f(result.nodes[i]) + lambda * ku_i
        let res_i = ie_abs(result.u[i] - expected)
        if res_i > max_res { max_res = res_i }
        i = i + 1
    }
    max_res
}

fn fredholm2_nystrom(K: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                     f: fn(f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                     a: f64, b: f64, lambda: f64, n: i32,
                     result: &!IEResult) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    ie_gauss_legendre_ab(a, b, n, &!result.nodes, &!result.weights)
    result.n = n
    var mat: [f64; 16384] = [0.0; 16384]
    var rhs: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        rhs[i] = f(result.nodes[i])
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            let kval = K(result.nodes[i], result.nodes[j])
            mat[i * n + j] = 0.0 - lambda * result.weights[j] * kval
            if i == j {
                mat[i * n + j] = mat[i * n + j] + 1.0
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    var sol: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    ie_gauss_solve(&!mat, &!rhs, &!sol, n)
    i = 0
    while i < n { result.u[i] = sol[i]; i = i + 1 }
    result.residual = ie_residual_fredholm2_internal(K, f, lambda, result)
    result.converged = result.residual < 1.0e-10
}

fn fredholm2_eval(K: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                  f: fn(f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                  lambda: f64, result: &IEResult, x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum = 0.0
    var j = 0
    while j < result.n {
        sum = sum + result.weights[j] * K(x, result.nodes[j]) * result.u[j]
        j = j + 1
    }
    f(x) + lambda * sum
}

// ============================================================================
// FREDHOLM 1ST KIND -- TIKHONOV
// ============================================================================

fn fredholm1_tikhonov(K: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                      f: fn(f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                      a: f64, b: f64, alpha: f64, n: i32,
                      result: &!IEResult) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    ie_gauss_legendre_ab(a, b, n, &!result.nodes, &!result.weights)
    result.n = n
    var kmat: [f64; 16384] = [0.0; 16384]
    var fvec: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        fvec[i] = f(result.nodes[i])
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            kmat[i * n + j] = result.weights[j] * K(result.nodes[i], result.nodes[j])
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    var ata: [f64; 16384] = [0.0; 16384]
    var atf: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var j = 0
    while j < n {
        var k = 0
        while k < n {
            var sum = 0.0
            i = 0
            while i < n {
                sum = sum + kmat[i * n + j] * kmat[i * n + k] * result.weights[i]
                i = i + 1
            }
            ata[j * n + k] = sum
            k = k + 1
        }
        var sumf = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            sumf = sumf + kmat[i * n + j] * fvec[i] * result.weights[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        atf[j] = sumf
        j = j + 1
    }
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        ata[i * n + i] = ata[i * n + i] + alpha
        i = i + 1
    }
    var sol: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    ie_gauss_solve(&!ata, &!atf, &!sol, n)
    i = 0
    while i < n { result.u[i] = sol[i]; i = i + 1 }
    var max_res = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        var ku_i = 0.0
        j = 0
        while j < n {
            ku_i = ku_i + kmat[i * n + j] * sol[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        let res_i = ie_abs(ku_i - fvec[i])
        if res_i > max_res { max_res = res_i }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result.residual = max_res
    result.converged = max_res < 1.0e-6
}

// ============================================================================
// VOLTERRA 2ND KIND
// ============================================================================

fn volterra2_solve(K: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                   f: fn(f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                   a: f64, b: f64, n: i32,
                   result: &!IEResult) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    result.n = n
    let h = (b - a) / ((n - 1) as f64)
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        result.nodes[i] = a + (i as f64) * h
        result.weights[i] = h
        i = i + 1
    }
    result.u[0] = f(a)
    i = 1
    while i < n {
        let xi = result.nodes[i]
        var sum = 0.5 * K(xi, result.nodes[0]) * result.u[0]
        var j = 1
        while j < i {
            sum = sum + K(xi, result.nodes[j]) * result.u[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        let kii = K(xi, xi)
        let denom = 1.0 - 0.5 * h * kii
        let numer = f(xi) + h * sum
        if ie_abs(denom) < 1.0e-30 {
            result.u[i] = numer
        } else {
            result.u[i] = numer / denom
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    var max_res = 0.0
    i = 1
    while i < n {
        let xi = result.nodes[i]
        var integral = 0.5 * K(xi, result.nodes[0]) * result.u[0]
        var j = 1
        while j < i {
            integral = integral + K(xi, result.nodes[j]) * result.u[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        integral = integral + 0.5 * K(xi, result.nodes[i]) * result.u[i]
        integral = integral * h
        let res_i = ie_abs(result.u[i] - f(xi) - integral)
        if res_i > max_res { max_res = res_i }
        i = i + 1
    }
    result.residual = max_res
    result.converged = max_res < 1.0e-8
}

// ============================================================================
// GREEN'S FUNCTION
// ============================================================================

fn greens_poisson_1d(x: f64, t: f64, a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let l = b - a
    if x <= t {
        (b - t) * (x - a) / l
    } else {
        (b - x) * (t - a) / l
    }
}

fn bvp_via_greens(G: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                  f: fn(f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                  a: f64, b: f64, n: i32,
                  result: &!IEResult) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    ie_gauss_legendre_ab(a, b, n, &!result.nodes, &!result.weights)
    result.n = n
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let xi = result.nodes[i]
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            sum = sum + result.weights[j] * G(xi, result.nodes[j]) * f(result.nodes[j])
            j = j + 1
        }
        result.u[i] = sum
        i = i + 1
    }
    result.residual = 0.0
    result.converged = true
}

// ============================================================================
// EIGENVALUE PROBLEMS
// ============================================================================

fn ie_eigenvalues(K: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                  a: f64, b: f64, n_quad: i32, n_eig: i32,
                  result: &!IEEigenResult) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    result.n_quad = n_quad
    result.n_found = 0
    var nodes: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var weights: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    ie_gauss_legendre_ab(a, b, n_quad, &!nodes, &!weights)
    var bmat: [f64; 16384] = [0.0; 16384]
    var sqrt_w: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var i = 0
    while i < n_quad {
        sqrt_w[i] = ie_sqrt(weights[i])
        i = i + 1
    }
    i = 0
    while i < n_quad {
        var j = 0
        while j < n_quad {
            bmat[i * n_quad + j] = sqrt_w[i] * K(nodes[i], nodes[j]) * sqrt_w[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    var eig_idx = 0
    while eig_idx < n_eig {
        if eig_idx >= n_quad { eig_idx = n_eig }
        else {
            var v: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
            i = 0
            while i < n_quad {
                let seed_val = (i as f64) * 0.618033988749895 + (eig_idx as f64) * 1.324717957244746
                v[i] = ie_sin(seed_val * 17.0 + 3.7)
                i = i + 1
            }
            var norm = 0.0
            i = 0
            while i < n_quad { norm = norm + v[i] * v[i]; i = i + 1 }
            norm = ie_sqrt(norm)
            if norm > 1.0e-30 {
                i = 0
                while i < n_quad { v[i] = v[i] / norm; i = i + 1 }
            }
            var lambda_est = 0.0
            var iter = 0
            while iter < 500 {
                var w: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
                i = 0
                while i < n_quad {
                    var s = 0.0
                    var j = 0
                    while j < n_quad { s = s + bmat[i * n_quad + j] * v[j]; j = j + 1 }
                    w[i] = s
                    i = i + 1
                }
                var d = 0
                while d < eig_idx {
                    var proj = 0.0
                    i = 0
                    while i < n_quad {
                        proj = proj + w[i] * result.eigenvectors[d * n_quad + i]
                        i = i + 1
                    }
                    i = 0
                    while i < n_quad {
                        w[i] = w[i] - proj * result.eigenvectors[d * n_quad + i]
                        i = i + 1
                    }
                    d = d + 1
                }
                var lambda_new = 0.0
                i = 0
                while i < n_quad { lambda_new = lambda_new + v[i] * w[i]; i = i + 1 }
                norm = 0.0
                i = 0
                while i < n_quad { norm = norm + w[i] * w[i]; i = i + 1 }
                norm = ie_sqrt(norm)
                if norm < 1.0e-30 {
                    iter = 500
                } else {
                    i = 0
                    while i < n_quad { v[i] = w[i] / norm; i = i + 1 }
                }
                if ie_abs(lambda_new - lambda_est) < 1.0e-12 * ie_max(ie_abs(lambda_new), 1.0) {
                    lambda_est = lambda_new
                    iter = 500
                }
                lambda_est = lambda_new
                iter = iter + 1
            }
            result.eigenvalues[eig_idx] = lambda_est
            i = 0
            while i < n_quad {
                result.eigenvectors[eig_idx * n_quad + i] = v[i]
                i = i + 1
            }
            result.n_found = eig_idx + 1
            eig_idx = eig_idx + 1
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// NEUMANN SERIES
// ============================================================================

fn fredholm2_neumann(K: fn(f64, f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                     f: fn(f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                     a: f64, b: f64, lambda: f64, n: i32,
                     max_iter: i32, tol: f64,
                     result: &!IEResult) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    ie_gauss_legendre_ab(a, b, n, &!result.nodes, &!result.weights)
    result.n = n
    var i = 0
    while i < n { result.u[i] = f(result.nodes[i]); i = i + 1 }
    var prev: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    i = 0
    while i < n { prev[i] = result.u[i]; i = i + 1 }
    var iter = 0
    result.converged = false
    while iter < max_iter {
        var max_diff = 0.0
        i = 0
        while i < n {
            var sum = 0.0
            var j = 0
            while j < n {
                sum = sum + result.weights[j] * K(result.nodes[i], result.nodes[j]) * prev[j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            result.u[i] = f(result.nodes[i]) + lambda * sum
            let diff = ie_abs(result.u[i] - prev[i])
            if diff > max_diff { max_diff = diff }
            i = i + 1
        }
        i = 0
        while i < n { prev[i] = result.u[i]; i = i + 1 }
        if max_diff < tol {
            result.converged = true
            result.residual = max_diff
            return
        }
        iter = iter + 1
    }
    result.residual = ie_residual_fredholm2_internal(K, f, lambda, result)
}

// ============================================================================
// KERNEL / RHS FUNCTIONS FOR TESTS
// ============================================================================

// K(x,t) = x * t  (separable kernel)
fn kernel_xt(x: f64, t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic { x * t }

// f(x) = 1  (constant RHS)
fn rhs_one(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic { 1.0 }

// K(x,t) = 1 (constant kernel for Volterra: u'=u)
fn kernel_one(x: f64, t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic { 1.0 }

// f(x) = 1 (initial condition for Volterra exp test)
fn rhs_volterra_one(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic { 1.0 }

// Green's function wrapper for [0,1] Poisson BVP
fn greens_01(x: f64, t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    greens_poisson_1d(x, t, 0.0, 1.0)
}

// Source term f(x) = 1 for the BVP -u'' = 1
fn source_one(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic { 1.0 }

// K(x,t) = exp(x*t) for Tikhonov test
fn kernel_exp_xt(x: f64, t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    ie_exp(x * t)
}

// RHS for Tikhonov: integral_0^1 exp(x*t) * 1 dt = (exp(x) - 1) / x for x != 0
// For x near 0, use Taylor: 1 + x/2 + x^2/6 + ...
fn rhs_tikhonov(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if ie_abs(x) < 1.0e-10 { return 1.0 }
    (ie_exp(x) - 1.0) / x
}

// Small-lambda kernel for Neumann convergence test
fn kernel_small(x: f64, t: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic { x * t }

// ============================================================================
// TESTS
// ============================================================================

// Test 1: GL nodes symmetric -- nodes[i] = -nodes[n-1-i]
fn test_gl_nodes_symmetric() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 8
    var nodes: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var weights: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    ie_gauss_legendre(n, &!nodes, &!weights)
    var ok = true
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let diff = ie_abs(nodes[i] + nodes[n - 1 - i])
        if diff > 1.0e-12 { ok = false }
        i = i + 1
    }
    ok
}

// Test 2: GL weights sum to 2 on [-1,1]
fn test_gl_weights_sum() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 12
    var nodes: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var weights: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    ie_gauss_legendre(n, &!nodes, &!weights)
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n { sum = sum + weights[i]; i = i + 1 }
    ie_abs(sum - 2.0) < 1.0e-12
}

// Test 3: GL integrates x^2 exactly: integral_{-1}^{1} x^2 dx = 2/3
fn test_gl_integrates_x2() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 4
    var nodes: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    var weights: [f64; 128] = [0.0; 128]
    ie_gauss_legendre(n, &!nodes, &!weights)
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + weights[i] * nodes[i] * nodes[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    // 2-point GL is exact for polynomials up to degree 2n-1=3, so 4-point is exact for degree 7
    ie_abs(sum - 2.0 / 3.0) < 1.0e-12
}

// Test 4: Fredholm 2nd kind with known analytical solution
// u(x) = 1 + lambda * integral_0^1 x*t*u(t) dt
// With K(x,t)=x*t and f(x)=1, the solution is u(x) = 1 + lambda*x*C
// where C = integral_0^1 t * u(t) dt = integral_0^1 t*(1 + lambda*t*C) dt
//         = 1/2 + lambda*C/3
// So C(1 - lambda/3) = 1/2, i.e. C = 1 / (2*(1 - lambda/3)) = 3 / (2*(3 - lambda))
// Hence u(x) = 1 + 3*lambda*x / (2*(3 - lambda))
fn test_fredholm2_known_solution() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let lambda = 0.5
    let n = 16
    var result = IEResult {
        u: [0.0; 128], nodes: [0.0; 128], weights: [0.0; 128],
        n: 0, residual: 0.0, converged: false
    }
    fredholm2_nystrom(kernel_xt, rhs_one, 0.0, 1.0, lambda, n, &!result)

    // Analytical: u(x) = 1 + 3*0.5*x / (2*(3-0.5)) = 1 + 1.5*x / 5.0 = 1 + 0.3*x
    var max_err = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let x = result.nodes[i]
        let analytical = 1.0 + 0.3 * x
        let err = ie_abs(result.u[i] - analytical)
        if err > max_err { max_err = err }
        i = i + 1
    }
    max_err < 1.0e-10
}

// Test 5: Fredholm 2nd kind residual is small
fn test_fredholm2_residual_small() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let lambda = 0.5
    let n = 16
    var result = IEResult {
        u: [0.0; 128], nodes: [0.0; 128], weights: [0.0; 128],
        n: 0, residual: 0.0, converged: false
    }
    fredholm2_nystrom(kernel_xt, rhs_one, 0.0, 1.0, lambda, n, &!result)
    result.residual < 1.0e-6
}

// Test 6: Volterra 2nd kind: u(x) = 1 + integral_0^x u(t) dt => u(x) = exp(x)
fn test_volterra2_exp() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 64
    var result = IEResult {
        u: [0.0; 128], nodes: [0.0; 128], weights: [0.0; 128],
        n: 0, residual: 0.0, converged: false
    }
    volterra2_solve(kernel_one, rhs_volterra_one, 0.0, 1.0, n, &!result)

    // Check at several interior nodes
    var max_err = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let x = result.nodes[i]
        let exact = ie_exp(x)
        let err = ie_abs(result.u[i] - exact) / exact
        if err > max_err { max_err = err }
        i = i + 1
    }
    // Trapezoidal rule is O(h^2) so with 64 points on [0,1], h ~ 0.016, error ~ 2.5e-4
    max_err < 1.0e-2
}

// Test 7: Volterra forward marching -- result.n equals the number of steps passed in
fn test_volterra_n_steps() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 32
    var result = IEResult {
        u: [0.0; 128], nodes: [0.0; 128], weights: [0.0; 128],
        n: 0, residual: 0.0, converged: false
    }
    volterra2_solve(kernel_one, rhs_volterra_one, 0.0, 1.0, n, &!result)
    result.n == 32
}

// Test 8: Green's function symmetry: G(x,t) = G(t,x) for Poisson 1D on [0,1]
fn test_greens_symmetry() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var ok = true
    // Test several pairs (x,t)
    var i = 1
    while i < 10 {
        let x = (i as f64) * 0.1
        var j = 1
        while j < 10 {
            let t = (j as f64) * 0.1
            let gxt = greens_poisson_1d(x, t, 0.0, 1.0)
            let gtx = greens_poisson_1d(t, x, 0.0, 1.0)
            if ie_abs(gxt - gtx) > 1.0e-14 { ok = false }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    ok
}

// Test 9: BVP via Green's: -u'' = 1 on [0,1], u(0)=u(1)=0
// Exact solution: u(x) = x*(1-x)/2
fn test_bvp_greens() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 20
    var result = IEResult {
        u: [0.0; 128], nodes: [0.0; 128], weights: [0.0; 128],
        n: 0, residual: 0.0, converged: false
    }
    bvp_via_greens(greens_01, source_one, 0.0, 1.0, n, &!result)

    var max_err = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let x = result.nodes[i]
        let exact = x * (1.0 - x) / 2.0
        let err = ie_abs(result.u[i] - exact)
        if err > max_err { max_err = err }
        i = i + 1
    }
    max_err < 1.0e-10
}

// Test 10: Neumann series converges for small lambda
// For K(x,t)=x*t on [0,1], ||K|| ~ 1/3, so |lambda|*||K|| < 1 when |lambda| < 3.
// Use lambda = 0.5, which gives |lambda|*||K|| ~ 0.167 < 1.
fn test_neumann_convergence() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let lambda = 0.5
    let n = 16
    var result = IEResult {
        u: [0.0; 128], nodes: [0.0; 128], weights: [0.0; 128],
        n: 0, residual: 0.0, converged: false
    }
    fredholm2_neumann(kernel_small, rhs_one, 0.0, 1.0, lambda, n, 200, 1.0e-10, &!result)
    result.converged
}

// Test 11: Tikhonov regularization produces bounded solution
// Solve integral_0^1 exp(x*t)*u(t) dt = (exp(x)-1)/x with true solution u(t) = 1.
// The regularized solution should be close to 1 at all nodes.
fn test_tikhonov_bounded() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 12
    let alpha = 1.0e-6
    var result = IEResult {
        u: [0.0; 128], nodes: [0.0; 128], weights: [0.0; 128],
        n: 0, residual: 0.0, converged: false
    }
    fredholm1_tikhonov(kernel_exp_xt, rhs_tikhonov, 0.0, 1.0, alpha, n, &!result)

    // The solution should be bounded and roughly close to 1.0
    var max_val = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let v = ie_abs(result.u[i])
        if v > max_val { max_val = v }
        i = i + 1
    }
    // The solution values should not blow up; they should remain bounded
    max_val < 100.0
}

// Test 12: Eigenvalue of K(x,t) = x*t on [0,1]
// This rank-1 kernel has exactly one nonzero eigenvalue.
// integral_0^1 x*t * phi(t) dt = lambda * phi(x)
// The eigenfunction is phi(t) = t, and lambda = integral_0^1 t^2 dt = 1/3.
fn test_eigenvalue_xt() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var result = IEEigenResult {
        eigenvalues: [0.0; 64],
        eigenvectors: [0.0; 8192],
        n_found: 0,
        n_quad: 0
    }
    ie_eigenvalues(kernel_xt, 0.0, 1.0, 20, 1, &!result)

    if result.n_found < 1 { return false }
    let lambda1 = result.eigenvalues[0]
    // The dominant eigenvalue should be 1/3
    ie_abs(lambda1 - 1.0 / 3.0) < 1.0e-4
}

// ============================================================================
// MAIN
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    println("=== Integral Equations Tests ===")
    println("")

    // Test 1
    print("Test  1: GL nodes symmetric .................. ")
    if test_gl_nodes_symmetric() { println("PASS"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { println("FAIL"); fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 2
    print("Test  2: GL weights sum to 2 ................. ")
    if test_gl_weights_sum() { println("PASS"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { println("FAIL"); fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 3
    print("Test  3: GL integrates x^2 exactly ........... ")
    if test_gl_integrates_x2() { println("PASS"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { println("FAIL"); fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 4
    print("Test  4: Fredholm 2nd kind known solution ..... ")
    if test_fredholm2_known_solution() { println("PASS"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { println("FAIL"); fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 5
    print("Test  5: Fredholm 2nd kind residual small ..... ")
    if test_fredholm2_residual_small() { println("PASS"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { println("FAIL"); fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 6
    print("Test  6: Volterra 2nd kind exp(x) ............ ")
    if test_volterra2_exp() { println("PASS"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { println("FAIL"); fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 7
    print("Test  7: Volterra forward marching n_steps .... ")
    if test_volterra_n_steps() { println("PASS"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { println("FAIL"); fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 8
    print("Test  8: Green's function symmetry ........... ")
    if test_greens_symmetry() { println("PASS"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { println("FAIL"); fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 9
    print("Test  9: BVP via Green's -u''=1 .............. ")
    if test_bvp_greens() { println("PASS"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { println("FAIL"); fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 10
    print("Test 10: Neumann series converges ............. ")
    if test_neumann_convergence() { println("PASS"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { println("FAIL"); fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 11
    print("Test 11: Tikhonov bounded solution ............ ")
    if test_tikhonov_bounded() { println("PASS"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { println("FAIL"); fail = fail + 1 }

    // Test 12
    print("Test 12: Eigenvalue of K(x,t)=x*t ............ ")
    if test_eigenvalue_xt() { println("PASS"); pass = pass + 1 }
    else { println("FAIL"); fail = fail + 1 }

    println("")
    print("Results: ")
    println("")
    print("  Passed: ")
    println("")
    print("  Failed: ")
    println("")

    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/test_lie.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// test_lie.sio — Tests for Lie algebras module
//
// Tests:
//  1.  su(2) structure constants: [e1, e2] = e3
//  2.  so(3) structure constants: same as su(2) — isomorphism
//  3.  su(3) dimension: dim=8, matrix_dim=3
//  4.  Lie bracket antisymmetry: [X,Y] = -[Y,X]
//  5.  Jacobi identity: [X,[Y,Z]] + [Y,[Z,X]] + [Z,[X,Y]] = 0
//  6.  Killing form of su(2): B(e_i,e_j) = -2*delta_ij
//  7.  SO(3) exp/log roundtrip: exp(log(R)) = R
//  8.  SO(3) exp of zero: exp(0) = I
//  9.  Rodrigues small angle: exp(omega) ~ I + [omega]_x
// 10.  BCH order 1: BCH(X,Y,1) = X + Y
// 11.  BCH order 2: BCH(X,Y,2) = X + Y + 0.5*[X,Y]
// 12.  Wigner d-matrix: d^{1/2}_{1/2,1/2}(0) = 1
// 13.  Matrix exp of zero: exp(0) = I

// =============================================================================
// Scalar helpers (copied from stdlib/math/lie.sio)
// =============================================================================

fn lie_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn lie_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }

fn lie_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 24 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn lie_sin(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var a = x
    let tp = 6.28318530717958647692
    while a >= tp { a = a - tp }
    while a < 0.0 { a = a + tp }
    if a > 3.14159265358979323846 { a = a - tp }
    let a2 = a * a
    var sum = a
    var term = a
    var n = 1
    while n < 20 { term = 0.0 - term * a2 / ((2 * n) * (2 * n + 1)) as f64; sum = sum + term; n = n + 1 }
    sum
}

fn lie_cos(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    lie_sin(x + 1.57079632679489661923)
}

fn lie_exp(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x > 500.0 { return 1.0e200 }
    if x < -500.0 { return 0.0 }
    var kf = x / 0.6931471805599453
    var k: i32 = 0
    if kf >= 0.0 { k = kf as i32 } else { k = (kf as i32) - 1 }
    let r = x - (k as f64) * 0.6931471805599453
    var sum = 1.0
    var term = 1.0
    var n = 1
    while n < 25 { term = term * r / (n as f64); sum = sum + term; n = n + 1 }
    var result = sum
    if k >= 0 { var i = 0; while i < k { result = result * 2.0; i = i + 1 } }
    else { var i = 0; while i < (0 - k) { result = result / 2.0; i = i + 1 } }
    result
}

fn lie_factorial(n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    var result = 1.0
    var i = 2
    while i <= n { result = result * (i as f64); i = i + 1 }
    result
}

fn lie_acos(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let pi2 = 1.57079632679489661923
    var cx = x
    if cx > 1.0 { cx = 1.0 }
    if cx < -1.0 { cx = -1.0 }
    if lie_abs(cx) < 1.0e-15 { return pi2 }
    let s = lie_sqrt(1.0 - cx * cx)
    pi2 - lie_atan2(cx, s)
}

fn lie_atan_core(z: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let pi2 = 1.57079632679489661923
    if z > 1.0 { return pi2 - lie_atan_core(1.0 / z) }
    let z2 = z * z
    var sum = z
    var term = z
    var k = 1
    while k < 40 { term = 0.0 - term * z2; sum = sum + term / ((2 * k + 1) as f64); k = k + 1 }
    sum
}

fn lie_atan2(y: f64, x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let pi = 3.14159265358979323846
    let pi2 = 1.57079632679489661923
    if lie_abs(x) < 1.0e-30 {
        if y > 0.0 { return pi2 }
        if y < 0.0 { return 0.0 - pi2 }
        return 0.0
    }
    var at = lie_atan_core(lie_abs(y / x))
    if x < 0.0 { at = pi - at }
    if y < 0.0 { at = 0.0 - at }
    at
}

// =============================================================================
// Matrix helpers (flat row-major, max 8x8 = 64 elements)
// =============================================================================

fn lie_mat_zero(m: &![f64; 64], dim: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < dim * dim { m[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn lie_mat_eye(m: &![f64; 64], dim: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < dim * dim { m[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < dim { m[i * dim + i] = 1.0; i = i + 1 }
}

fn lie_mat_copy(dst: &![f64; 64], src: &[f64; 64], dim: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < dim * dim { dst[i] = src[i]; i = i + 1 }
}

fn lie_mat_add(a: &[f64; 64], b: &[f64; 64], c: &![f64; 64], dim: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < dim * dim { c[i] = a[i] + b[i]; i = i + 1 }
}

fn lie_mat_sub(a: &[f64; 64], b: &[f64; 64], c: &![f64; 64], dim: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < dim * dim { c[i] = a[i] - b[i]; i = i + 1 }
}

fn lie_mat_mul(a: &[f64; 64], b: &[f64; 64], c: &![f64; 64], dim: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < dim * dim { c[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    i = 0
    while i < dim {
        var j = 0
        while j < dim {
            var s = 0.0
            var k = 0
            while k < dim { s = s + a[i * dim + k] * b[k * dim + j]; k = k + 1 }
            c[i * dim + j] = s
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn lie_mat_scale(m: &![f64; 64], s: f64, dim: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < dim * dim { m[i] = m[i] * s; i = i + 1 }
}

fn lie_mat_trace(m: &[f64; 64], dim: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < dim { s = s + m[i * dim + i]; i = i + 1 }
    s
}

fn lie_mat_norm(m: &[f64; 64], dim: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var s = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < dim * dim { s = s + m[i] * m[i]; i = i + 1 }
    lie_sqrt(s)
}

fn lie_mat_norm_inf(m: &[f64; 64], dim: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var mx = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < dim {
        var rs = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < dim { rs = rs + lie_abs(m[i * dim + j]); j = j + 1 }
        if rs > mx { mx = rs }
        i = i + 1
    }
    mx
}

fn lie_mat_solve(D: [f64; 64], N: [f64; 64], X: &![f64; 64], dim: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var A: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var inv: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var i = 0
    while i < dim * dim { A[i] = D[i]; i = i + 1 }
    lie_mat_eye(&!inv, dim)

    var col = 0
    while col < dim {
        var max_val = lie_abs(A[col * dim + col])
        var max_row = col
        var row = col + 1
        while row < dim {
            let v = lie_abs(A[row * dim + col])
            if v > max_val { max_val = v; max_row = row }
            row = row + 1
        }
        if max_row != col {
            var j = 0
            while j < dim {
                let tmp = A[col * dim + j]
                A[col * dim + j] = A[max_row * dim + j]
                A[max_row * dim + j] = tmp
                let tmp2 = inv[col * dim + j]
                inv[col * dim + j] = inv[max_row * dim + j]
                inv[max_row * dim + j] = tmp2
                j = j + 1
            }
        }
        let pivot = A[col * dim + col]
        if lie_abs(pivot) < 1.0e-30 { lie_mat_eye(X, dim); return }
        let inv_pivot = 1.0 / pivot
        var j = 0
        while j < dim {
            A[col * dim + j] = A[col * dim + j] * inv_pivot
            inv[col * dim + j] = inv[col * dim + j] * inv_pivot
            j = j + 1
        }
        row = 0
        while row < dim {
            if row != col {
                let factor = A[row * dim + col]
                j = 0
                while j < dim {
                    A[row * dim + j] = A[row * dim + j] - factor * A[col * dim + j]
                    inv[row * dim + j] = inv[row * dim + j] - factor * inv[col * dim + j]
                    j = j + 1
                }
            }
            row = row + 1
        }
        col = col + 1
    }
    lie_mat_mul(&inv, &N, X, dim)
}

// =============================================================================
// Structs
// =============================================================================

struct LieElement {
    coeffs: [f64; 16],
    dim: i32
}

struct LieAlgebra {
    structure_constants: [f64; 4096],
    dim: i32,
    matrix_dim: i32
}

// =============================================================================
// Algebra constructors
// =============================================================================

fn lie_su2(alg: &!LieAlgebra) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    alg.dim = 3
    alg.matrix_dim = 2
    var i = 0
    while i < 4096 { alg.structure_constants[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    alg.structure_constants[0 * 9 + 1 * 3 + 2] = 1.0
    alg.structure_constants[1 * 9 + 0 * 3 + 2] = -1.0
    alg.structure_constants[1 * 9 + 2 * 3 + 0] = 1.0
    alg.structure_constants[2 * 9 + 1 * 3 + 0] = -1.0
    alg.structure_constants[2 * 9 + 0 * 3 + 1] = 1.0
    alg.structure_constants[0 * 9 + 2 * 3 + 1] = -1.0
}

fn lie_so3(alg: &!LieAlgebra) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    alg.dim = 3
    alg.matrix_dim = 3
    var i = 0
    while i < 4096 { alg.structure_constants[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    alg.structure_constants[0 * 9 + 1 * 3 + 2] = 1.0
    alg.structure_constants[1 * 9 + 0 * 3 + 2] = -1.0
    alg.structure_constants[1 * 9 + 2 * 3 + 0] = 1.0
    alg.structure_constants[2 * 9 + 1 * 3 + 0] = -1.0
    alg.structure_constants[2 * 9 + 0 * 3 + 1] = 1.0
    alg.structure_constants[0 * 9 + 2 * 3 + 1] = -1.0
}

fn lie_su3_set_f(alg: &!LieAlgebra, a: i32, b: i32, c: i32, val: f64) with Mut, Panic {
    let d = alg.dim
    alg.structure_constants[a * d * d + b * d + c] = val
    alg.structure_constants[b * d * d + a * d + c] = 0.0 - val
    alg.structure_constants[b * d * d + c * d + a] = val
    alg.structure_constants[c * d * d + b * d + a] = 0.0 - val
    alg.structure_constants[c * d * d + a * d + b] = val
    alg.structure_constants[a * d * d + c * d + b] = 0.0 - val
}

fn lie_su3(alg: &!LieAlgebra) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    alg.dim = 8
    alg.matrix_dim = 3
    var i = 0
    while i < 4096 { alg.structure_constants[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    let s32 = lie_sqrt(3.0) / 2.0
    lie_su3_set_f(alg, 0, 1, 2, 1.0)
    lie_su3_set_f(alg, 0, 3, 6, 0.5)
    lie_su3_set_f(alg, 0, 4, 5, -0.5)
    lie_su3_set_f(alg, 1, 3, 5, 0.5)
    lie_su3_set_f(alg, 1, 4, 6, 0.5)
    lie_su3_set_f(alg, 2, 3, 4, 0.5)
    lie_su3_set_f(alg, 2, 5, 6, -0.5)
    lie_su3_set_f(alg, 3, 4, 7, s32)
    lie_su3_set_f(alg, 5, 6, 7, s32)
}

// =============================================================================
// Lie bracket
// =============================================================================

fn lie_bracket(alg: &LieAlgebra, X: &LieElement, Y: &LieElement, result: &!LieElement) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let d = alg.dim
    result.dim = d
    var k = 0
    while k < d {
        var s = 0.0
        var i = 0
        while i < d {
            var j = 0
            while j < d {
                s = s + alg.structure_constants[i * d * d + j * d + k] * X.coeffs[i] * Y.coeffs[j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        result.coeffs[k] = s
        k = k + 1
    }
    while k < 16 { result.coeffs[k] = 0.0; k = k + 1 }
}

// =============================================================================
// Adjoint representation
// =============================================================================

fn lie_adjoint(alg: &LieAlgebra, X: &LieElement, ad_X: &![f64; 256]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let d = alg.dim
    var k = 0
    while k < d {
        var i = 0
        while i < d {
            var s = 0.0
            var j = 0
            while j < d {
                s = s + alg.structure_constants[j * d * d + i * d + k] * X.coeffs[j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            ad_X[k * d + i] = s
            i = i + 1
        }
        k = k + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Killing form
// =============================================================================

fn lie_killing(alg: &LieAlgebra, X: &LieElement, Y: &LieElement) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let d = alg.dim
    var adx: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var ady: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    lie_adjoint(alg, X, &!adx)
    lie_adjoint(alg, Y, &!ady)
    var trace = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < d {
        var j = 0
        while j < d { trace = trace + adx[i * d + j] * ady[j * d + i]; j = j + 1 }
        i = i + 1
    }
    trace
}

// =============================================================================
// SO(3) hat, exp, log
// =============================================================================

fn so3_hat(omega: &[f64; 3], mat: &![f64; 9]) with Mut, Panic {
    mat[0] = 0.0;              mat[1] = 0.0 - omega[2]; mat[2] = omega[1]
    mat[3] = omega[2];         mat[4] = 0.0;             mat[5] = 0.0 - omega[0]
    mat[6] = 0.0 - omega[1];  mat[7] = omega[0];        mat[8] = 0.0
}

fn so3_exp(omega: &[f64; 3], R: &![f64; 9]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let wx = omega[0]
    let wy = omega[1]
    let wz = omega[2]
    let t2 = wx * wx + wy * wy + wz * wz
    let t = lie_sqrt(t2)
    if t < 1.0e-10 {
        R[0] = 1.0;  R[1] = 0.0 - wz; R[2] = wy
        R[3] = wz;   R[4] = 1.0;       R[5] = 0.0 - wx
        R[6] = 0.0 - wy; R[7] = wx;    R[8] = 1.0
        return
    }
    let sc = lie_sin(t) / t
    let cc = (1.0 - lie_cos(t)) / t2
    var K: [f64; 9] = [0.0; 9]
    so3_hat(omega, &!K)
    var K2: [f64; 9] = [0.0; 9]
    var ri = 0
    while ri < 3 {
        var ci = 0
        while ci < 3 {
            var s = 0.0
            var p = 0
            while p < 3 { s = s + K[ri * 3 + p] * K[p * 3 + ci]; p = p + 1 }
            K2[ri * 3 + ci] = s
            ci = ci + 1
        }
        ri = ri + 1
    }
    R[0] = 1.0 + sc * K[0] + cc * K2[0]
    R[1] = sc * K[1] + cc * K2[1]
    R[2] = sc * K[2] + cc * K2[2]
    R[3] = sc * K[3] + cc * K2[3]
    R[4] = 1.0 + sc * K[4] + cc * K2[4]
    R[5] = sc * K[5] + cc * K2[5]
    R[6] = sc * K[6] + cc * K2[6]
    R[7] = sc * K[7] + cc * K2[7]
    R[8] = 1.0 + sc * K[8] + cc * K2[8]
}

fn so3_log(R: &[f64; 9], omega: &![f64; 3]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let tr = R[0] + R[4] + R[8]
    var ct = (tr - 1.0) / 2.0
    if ct > 1.0 { ct = 1.0 }
    if ct < -1.0 { ct = -1.0 }
    let theta = lie_acos(ct)
    if theta < 1.0e-10 {
        omega[0] = (R[7] - R[5]) / 2.0
        omega[1] = (R[2] - R[6]) / 2.0
        omega[2] = (R[3] - R[1]) / 2.0
        return
    }
    let st = lie_sin(theta)
    if lie_abs(st) < 1.0e-10 {
        omega[0] = lie_sqrt(lie_max((R[0] + 1.0) / 2.0, 0.0)) * theta
        omega[1] = lie_sqrt(lie_max((R[4] + 1.0) / 2.0, 0.0)) * theta
        omega[2] = lie_sqrt(lie_max((R[8] + 1.0) / 2.0, 0.0)) * theta
        if R[1] + R[3] < 0.0 { omega[1] = 0.0 - omega[1] }
        if R[2] + R[6] < 0.0 { omega[2] = 0.0 - omega[2] }
        return
    }
    let f = theta / (2.0 * st)
    omega[0] = f * (R[7] - R[5])
    omega[1] = f * (R[2] - R[6])
    omega[2] = f * (R[3] - R[1])
}

// =============================================================================
// BCH formula
// =============================================================================

fn lie_bch(alg: &LieAlgebra, X: &LieElement, Y: &LieElement, order: i32, result: &!LieElement) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let d = alg.dim
    result.dim = d
    var i = 0
    while i < d { result.coeffs[i] = X.coeffs[i] + Y.coeffs[i]; i = i + 1 }
    while i < 16 { result.coeffs[i] = 0.0; i = i + 1 }
    if order < 2 { return }

    var xy: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: d }
    lie_bracket(alg, X, Y, &!xy)
    i = 0
    while i < d { result.coeffs[i] = result.coeffs[i] + 0.5 * xy.coeffs[i]; i = i + 1 }
    if order < 3 { return }

    var xxy: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: d }
    lie_bracket(alg, X, &xy, &!xxy)
    var yxy: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: d }
    lie_bracket(alg, Y, &xy, &!yxy)
    i = 0
    while i < d { result.coeffs[i] = result.coeffs[i] + (xxy.coeffs[i] - yxy.coeffs[i]) / 12.0; i = i + 1 }
    if order < 4 { return }

    var yxxy: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: d }
    lie_bracket(alg, Y, &xxy, &!yxxy)
    i = 0
    while i < d { result.coeffs[i] = result.coeffs[i] - yxxy.coeffs[i] / 24.0; i = i + 1 }
}

// =============================================================================
// Matrix exponential (Pade [6/6] with scaling and squaring)
// =============================================================================

fn lie_exp_pade(mat: &[f64; 64], dim: i32, result: &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var b: [f64; 7] = [0.0; 7]
    b[0] = 1.0
    b[1] = 0.5
    b[2] = 0.11363636363636363636
    b[3] = 0.01515151515151515152
    b[4] = 0.00126262626262626263
    b[5] = 0.00006313131313131313
    b[6] = 0.00000150300150300150

    let norm_a = lie_mat_norm_inf(mat, dim)
    var s = 0
    var scale = norm_a
    while scale > 0.5 { scale = scale / 2.0; s = s + 1 }

    var As: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var i = 0
    while i < dim * dim { As[i] = mat[i]; i = i + 1 }
    var si = 0
    while si < s { i = 0; while i < dim * dim { As[i] = As[i] / 2.0; i = i + 1 }; si = si + 1 }

    var A2: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var A4: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var A6: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    lie_mat_mul(&As, &As, &!A2, dim)
    lie_mat_mul(&A2, &A2, &!A4, dim)
    lie_mat_mul(&A4, &A2, &!A6, dim)

    var U: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    lie_mat_eye(&!U, dim)
    i = 0
    while i < dim * dim { U[i] = b[0] * U[i] + b[2] * A2[i] + b[4] * A4[i] + b[6] * A6[i]; i = i + 1 }

    var Vi: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    lie_mat_eye(&!Vi, dim)
    i = 0
    while i < dim * dim { Vi[i] = b[1] * Vi[i] + b[3] * A2[i] + b[5] * A4[i]; i = i + 1 }
    var V: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    lie_mat_mul(&As, &Vi, &!V, dim)

    var N: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var D: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    lie_mat_add(&U, &V, &!N, dim)
    lie_mat_sub(&U, &V, &!D, dim)

    lie_mat_solve(D, N, result, dim)

    var temp: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    si = 0
    while si < s {
        lie_mat_mul(result, result, &!temp, dim)
        lie_mat_copy(result, &temp, dim)
        si = si + 1
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// Wigner d-matrix
// =============================================================================

fn su2_wigner_d(j2: i32, m1_2: i32, m2_2: i32, beta: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let cb = lie_cos(beta / 2.0)
    let sb = lie_sin(beta / 2.0)
    let jpm = (j2 + m2_2) / 2
    let jmm = (j2 - m2_2) / 2
    let jpmp = (j2 + m1_2) / 2
    let jmmp = (j2 - m1_2) / 2
    let mpm = (m1_2 - m2_2) / 2

    var s_min = 0
    if mpm < 0 { s_min = 0 - mpm }
    var s_max = jpm
    if jmmp < s_max { s_max = jmmp }

    let pf = lie_sqrt(lie_factorial(jpmp) * lie_factorial(jmmp) *
                      lie_factorial(jpm) * lie_factorial(jmm))
    var result = 0.0
    var s = s_min
    while s <= s_max {
        let denom = lie_factorial(jpm - s) * lie_factorial(s) *
                    lie_factorial(mpm + s) * lie_factorial(jmmp - s)
        let ce = jpm - s + jmmp - s
        let se = mpm + 2 * s
        var ct = 1.0
        var ci = 0
        while ci < ce { ct = ct * cb; ci = ci + 1 }
        var st = 1.0
        var si_c = 0
        while si_c < se { st = st * sb; si_c = si_c + 1 }
        let sign_exp = mpm + s
        var sign_abs = sign_exp
        if sign_abs < 0 { sign_abs = 0 - sign_abs }
        var sign = 1.0
        if sign_abs - 2 * (sign_abs / 2) != 0 { sign = -1.0 }
        result = result + sign * ct * st / denom
        s = s + 1
    }
    pf * result
}

// =============================================================================
// Main
// =============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    let tol = 1.0e-8

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 1: su(2) structure constants — [e1, e2] = e3
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    var su2: LieAlgebra = LieAlgebra { structure_constants: [0.0; 4096], dim: 0, matrix_dim: 0 }
    lie_su2(&!su2)

    var e1: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    e1.coeffs[0] = 1.0
    var e2: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    e2.coeffs[1] = 1.0
    var e3: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    e3.coeffs[2] = 1.0

    var bracket12: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    lie_bracket(&su2, &e1, &e2, &!bracket12)

    // [e1, e2] should be e3: coeffs = (0, 0, 1)
    let t1_ok = lie_abs(bracket12.coeffs[0]) < tol &&
                lie_abs(bracket12.coeffs[1]) < tol &&
                lie_abs(bracket12.coeffs[2] - 1.0) < tol
    if t1_ok { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 2: so(3) structure constants — same as su(2)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    var so3: LieAlgebra = LieAlgebra { structure_constants: [0.0; 4096], dim: 0, matrix_dim: 0 }
    lie_so3(&!so3)

    var bracket12_so3: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    lie_bracket(&so3, &e1, &e2, &!bracket12_so3)

    let t2_ok = lie_abs(bracket12_so3.coeffs[0]) < tol &&
                lie_abs(bracket12_so3.coeffs[1]) < tol &&
                lie_abs(bracket12_so3.coeffs[2] - 1.0) < tol
    if t2_ok { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 3: su(3) dimension — dim=8, matrix_dim=3
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    var su3: LieAlgebra = LieAlgebra { structure_constants: [0.0; 4096], dim: 0, matrix_dim: 0 }
    lie_su3(&!su3)

    let t3_ok = su3.dim == 8 && su3.matrix_dim == 3
    if t3_ok { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 4: Lie bracket antisymmetry — [X,Y] = -[Y,X]
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    var X4: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    X4.coeffs[0] = 1.0
    X4.coeffs[1] = 0.5
    X4.coeffs[2] = 0.3
    var Y4: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    Y4.coeffs[0] = 0.2
    Y4.coeffs[1] = 0.7
    Y4.coeffs[2] = 0.4

    var xy4: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    lie_bracket(&su2, &X4, &Y4, &!xy4)
    var yx4: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    lie_bracket(&su2, &Y4, &X4, &!yx4)

    // xy4[k] + yx4[k] should be 0 for all k
    var t4_err = 0.0
    var t4i = 0
    while t4i < 3 {
        t4_err = t4_err + lie_abs(xy4.coeffs[t4i] + yx4.coeffs[t4i])
        t4i = t4i + 1
    }
    let t4_ok = t4_err < tol
    if t4_ok { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 5: Jacobi identity — [X,[Y,Z]] + [Y,[Z,X]] + [Z,[X,Y]] = 0
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    var X5: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    X5.coeffs[0] = 1.0
    X5.coeffs[1] = 0.0
    X5.coeffs[2] = 0.5
    var Y5: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    Y5.coeffs[0] = 0.0
    Y5.coeffs[1] = 1.0
    Y5.coeffs[2] = 0.3
    var Z5: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    Z5.coeffs[0] = 0.7
    Z5.coeffs[1] = 0.2
    Z5.coeffs[2] = 1.0

    var yz5: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    lie_bracket(&su2, &Y5, &Z5, &!yz5)
    var x_yz5: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    lie_bracket(&su2, &X5, &yz5, &!x_yz5)

    var zx5: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    lie_bracket(&su2, &Z5, &X5, &!zx5)
    var y_zx5: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    lie_bracket(&su2, &Y5, &zx5, &!y_zx5)

    var xy5: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    lie_bracket(&su2, &X5, &Y5, &!xy5)
    var z_xy5: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    lie_bracket(&su2, &Z5, &xy5, &!z_xy5)

    var t5_err = 0.0
    var t5i = 0
    while t5i < 3 {
        t5_err = t5_err + lie_abs(x_yz5.coeffs[t5i] + y_zx5.coeffs[t5i] + z_xy5.coeffs[t5i])
        t5i = t5i + 1
    }
    let t5_ok = t5_err < tol
    if t5_ok { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 6: Killing form of su(2) — B(e_i, e_j) = -2*delta_ij
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    let k11 = lie_killing(&su2, &e1, &e1)
    let k22 = lie_killing(&su2, &e2, &e2)
    let k33 = lie_killing(&su2, &e3, &e3)
    let k12 = lie_killing(&su2, &e1, &e2)
    let k13 = lie_killing(&su2, &e1, &e3)
    let k23 = lie_killing(&su2, &e2, &e3)

    let t6_ok = lie_abs(k11 - (0.0 - 2.0)) < tol &&
                lie_abs(k22 - (0.0 - 2.0)) < tol &&
                lie_abs(k33 - (0.0 - 2.0)) < tol &&
                lie_abs(k12) < tol &&
                lie_abs(k13) < tol &&
                lie_abs(k23) < tol
    if t6_ok { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 7: SO(3) exp/log roundtrip — exp(log(R)) = R
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Build a rotation from omega = (0.3, 0.5, 0.7)
    var omega7: [f64; 3] = [0.0; 3]
    omega7[0] = 0.3
    omega7[1] = 0.5
    omega7[2] = 0.7
    var R7: [f64; 9] = [0.0; 9]
    so3_exp(&omega7, &!R7)

    var omega7_back: [f64; 3] = [0.0; 3]
    so3_log(&R7, &!omega7_back)

    var R7_back: [f64; 9] = [0.0; 9]
    so3_exp(&omega7_back, &!R7_back)

    var t7_err = 0.0
    var t7i = 0
    while t7i < 9 {
        t7_err = t7_err + lie_abs(R7[t7i] - R7_back[t7i])
        t7i = t7i + 1
    }
    let t7_ok = t7_err < tol
    if t7_ok { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 8: SO(3) exp of zero — exp(0) = I
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    var omega8: [f64; 3] = [0.0; 3]
    var R8: [f64; 9] = [0.0; 9]
    so3_exp(&omega8, &!R8)

    let t8_ok = lie_abs(R8[0] - 1.0) < tol && lie_abs(R8[1]) < tol && lie_abs(R8[2]) < tol &&
                lie_abs(R8[3]) < tol && lie_abs(R8[4] - 1.0) < tol && lie_abs(R8[5]) < tol &&
                lie_abs(R8[6]) < tol && lie_abs(R8[7]) < tol && lie_abs(R8[8] - 1.0) < tol
    if t8_ok { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 9: Rodrigues small angle — exp(omega) ~ I + [omega]_x
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    var omega9: [f64; 3] = [0.0; 3]
    omega9[0] = 1.0e-12
    omega9[1] = 2.0e-12
    omega9[2] = 3.0e-12
    var R9: [f64; 9] = [0.0; 9]
    so3_exp(&omega9, &!R9)

    // Expected: I + [omega]_x
    var hat9: [f64; 9] = [0.0; 9]
    so3_hat(&omega9, &!hat9)

    var t9_err = 0.0
    var t9i = 0
    while t9i < 9 {
        var eye_val = 0.0
        if t9i == 0 || t9i == 4 || t9i == 8 { eye_val = 1.0 }
        let expected = eye_val + hat9[t9i]
        t9_err = t9_err + lie_abs(R9[t9i] - expected)
        t9i = t9i + 1
    }
    let t9_ok = t9_err < 1.0e-6
    if t9_ok { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 10: BCH order 1 — BCH(X, Y, 1) = X + Y
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    var Xb: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    Xb.coeffs[0] = 0.1
    Xb.coeffs[1] = 0.2
    Xb.coeffs[2] = 0.3
    var Yb: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    Yb.coeffs[0] = 0.4
    Yb.coeffs[1] = 0.5
    Yb.coeffs[2] = 0.6

    var bch1: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    lie_bch(&su2, &Xb, &Yb, 1, &!bch1)

    let t10_ok = lie_abs(bch1.coeffs[0] - 0.5) < tol &&
                 lie_abs(bch1.coeffs[1] - 0.7) < tol &&
                 lie_abs(bch1.coeffs[2] - 0.9) < tol
    if t10_ok { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 11: BCH order 2 — BCH(X, Y, 2) = X + Y + 0.5*[X,Y]
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    var bch2: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    lie_bch(&su2, &Xb, &Yb, 2, &!bch2)

    var xy_b: LieElement = LieElement { coeffs: [0.0; 16], dim: 3 }
    lie_bracket(&su2, &Xb, &Yb, &!xy_b)

    var t11_err = 0.0
    var t11i = 0
    while t11i < 3 {
        let expected = Xb.coeffs[t11i] + Yb.coeffs[t11i] + 0.5 * xy_b.coeffs[t11i]
        t11_err = t11_err + lie_abs(bch2.coeffs[t11i] - expected)
        t11i = t11i + 1
    }
    let t11_ok = t11_err < tol
    if t11_ok { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 12: Wigner d-matrix — d^{1/2}_{1/2,1/2}(0) = 1 (j2=1, m1_2=1, m2_2=1)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    let d_val = su2_wigner_d(1, 1, 1, 0.0)
    let t12_ok = lie_abs(d_val - 1.0) < tol
    if t12_ok { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Test 13: Matrix exp of zero — exp(0) = I
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    var zero3: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var exp_zero3: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    lie_exp_pade(&zero3, 3, &!exp_zero3)

    var t13_err = 0.0
    var t13r = 0
    while t13r < 3 {
        var t13c = 0
        while t13c < 3 {
            var expected = 0.0
            if t13r == t13c { expected = 1.0 }
            t13_err = t13_err + lie_abs(exp_zero3[t13r * 3 + t13c] - expected)
            t13c = t13c + 1
        }
        t13r = t13r + 1
    }
    let t13_ok = t13_err < tol
    if t13_ok { pass = pass + 1 } else { fail = fail + 1 }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Summary
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if fail > 0 { return 1 }
    return 0
}

// test_mor.sio -- Tests for model order reduction module
//
// Self-contained test suite for one-sided Jacobi SVD, POD energy-based rank
// selection, Galerkin projection, reduced system solve, error estimation,
// Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization, and DEIM interpolation.
// All structs, helpers, and algorithms are inlined since tests cannot import.
//
// References:
//   Quarteroni, Manzoni & Negri (2016): "Reduced Basis Methods for PDEs"
//   Hesthaven, Rozza & Stamm (2016): "Certified Reduced Basis Methods"
//   Chaturantabut & Sorensen (2010): "Nonlinear Model Reduction via DEIM"
//   Golub & Van Loan (2013): "Matrix Computations" (SVD)
//
// Tests:
//  1.  SVD of diagonal matrix: singular values = 3,2,1
//  2.  SVD roundtrip: U*S*Vt approx A
//  3.  POD energy capture: threshold 0.99 selects enough basis vectors
//  4.  POD rank selection: pod_rank_for_energy with known singular values
//  5.  Galerkin projection VtAV: for identity basis V=I, A_r = A
//  6.  Projection/reconstruction roundtrip: V*Vt*u approx u for u in span(V)
//  7.  Reduced solve accuracy: solve A_r*x_r = b_r vs direct solve
//  8.  MOR error estimate bounded: error estimate is non-negative
//  9.  MOR true error small: for well-captured problem, true error < threshold
// 10.  Gram-Schmidt orthogonality: Vt*V = I
// 11.  DEIM indices are valid: indices in range [0, n_dof-1]
// 12.  DEIM approximation accurate: for vector in span, approximation is exact

// ============================================================================
// PURE MATH HELPERS (copied from mor.sio -- tests must be self-contained)
// ============================================================================

fn mr_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn mr_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }
fn mr_min(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a < b { a } else { b } }

fn mr_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 25 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn approx_eq(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    mr_abs(a - b) < tol
}

// ============================================================================

fn mr_dot(a: &[f64; 4096], a_off: i32, b: &[f64; 4096], b_off: i32, n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + a[a_off + i] * b[b_off + i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum
}

fn mr_dot256(a: &[f64; 256], b: &[f64; 256], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + a[i] * b[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum
}

fn mr_dot64(a: &[f64; 64], b: &[f64; 64], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + a[i] * b[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    sum
}

fn mr_norm2(a: &[f64; 4096], off: i32, n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + a[off + i] * a[off + i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    mr_sqrt(sum)
}

fn mr_norm2_256(a: &[f64; 256], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + a[i] * a[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    mr_sqrt(sum)
}

fn mr_norm2_64(a: &[f64; 64], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + a[i] * a[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    mr_sqrt(sum)
}

fn mr_copy(src: &[f64; 4096], s_off: i32, dst: &![f64; 4096], d_off: i32, n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        dst[d_off + i] = src[s_off + i]
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mr_axpy(alpha: f64, x: &[f64; 4096], x_off: i32, y: &![f64; 4096], y_off: i32, n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        y[y_off + i] = y[y_off + i] + alpha * x[x_off + i]
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mr_scale(a: &![f64; 4096], off: i32, n: i32, alpha: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        a[off + i] = a[off + i] * alpha
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mr_zero(a: &![f64; 4096], off: i32, n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        a[off + i] = 0.0
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mr_zero_256(a: &![f64; 256], n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        a[i] = 0.0
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mr_zero_64(a: &![f64; 64], n: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        a[i] = 0.0
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mr_matvec(A: &[f64; 4096], x: &[f64; 4096], x_off: i32,
             m: i32, n: i32,
             y: &![f64; 4096], y_off: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            sum = sum + A[i * n + j] * x[x_off + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        y[y_off + i] = sum
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mr_matvec_mixed(A: &[f64; 4096], x: &[f64; 64],
                   m: i32, n: i32,
                   y: &![f64; 256]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            sum = sum + A[i * n + j] * x[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        y[i] = sum
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mr_mat_mul(A: &[f64; 4096], B: &[f64; 4096],
              m: i32, k: i32, n: i32,
              C: &![f64; 4096]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            var sum = 0.0
            var p = 0
            while p < k {
                sum = sum + A[i * k + p] * B[p * n + j]
                p = p + 1
            }
            C[i * n + j] = sum
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mr_transpose(A: &[f64; 4096], m: i32, n: i32, At: &![f64; 4096]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            At[j * m + i] = A[i * n + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mr_argmax_abs_col(A: &[f64; 4096], m: i32, n: i32, col: i32, start_row: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var best_idx = start_row
    var best_val = mr_abs(A[start_row * n + col])
    var i = start_row + 1
    while i < m {
        let v = mr_abs(A[i * n + col])
        if v > best_val {
            best_val = v
            best_idx = i
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    best_idx
}

fn mr_argmax_abs_256(v: &[f64; 256], n: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var best_idx = 0
    var best_val = mr_abs(v[0])
    var i = 1
    while i < n {
        let a = mr_abs(v[i])
        if a > best_val {
            best_val = a
            best_idx = i
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    best_idx
}
