// ============================================================================
// ONE-SIDED JACOBI SVD (copied from mor.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mr_svd(A: &[f64; 4096], m: i32, n: i32,
          U: &![f64; 4096], S: &![f64; 64], Vt: &![f64; 4096]) with Mut, Div, Panic {

    var B: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            var sum = 0.0
            var k = 0
            while k < m {
                sum = sum + A[k * n + i] * A[k * n + j]
                k = k + 1
            }
            B[i * n + j] = sum
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var V: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        V[i * n + i] = 1.0
        i = i + 1
    }

    let max_sweeps = 100
    let tol = 1.0e-12
    var sweep = 0
    while sweep < max_sweeps {
        var off_norm = 0.0
        var p = 0
        while p < n {
            var q = p + 1
            while q < n {
                off_norm = off_norm + B[p * n + q] * B[p * n + q]
                q = q + 1
            }
            p = p + 1
        }
        if off_norm < tol * tol {
            sweep = max_sweeps
        } else {
            p = 0
            while p < n {
                var q = p + 1
                while q < n {
                    let bpq = B[p * n + q]
                    if mr_abs(bpq) > 1.0e-15 {
                        let bpp = B[p * n + p]
                        let bqq = B[q * n + q]
                        let tau = (bqq - bpp) / (2.0 * bpq)
                        var t = 0.0
                        if mr_abs(tau) > 1.0e30 {
                            t = 1.0 / (2.0 * tau)
                        } else {
                            let sign_tau = if tau >= 0.0 { 1.0 } else { 0.0 - 1.0 }
                            t = sign_tau / (mr_abs(tau) + mr_sqrt(1.0 + tau * tau))
                        }
                        let c = 1.0 / mr_sqrt(1.0 + t * t)
                        let s = t * c

                        var k = 0
                        while k < n {
                            let bp = B[k * n + p]
                            let bq = B[k * n + q]
                            B[k * n + p] = c * bp - s * bq
                            B[k * n + q] = s * bp + c * bq
                            k = k + 1
                        }
                        k = 0
                        while k < n {
                            let bp = B[p * n + k]
                            let bq = B[q * n + k]
                            B[p * n + k] = c * bp - s * bq
                            B[q * n + k] = s * bp + c * bq
                            k = k + 1
                        }
                        B[p * n + q] = 0.0
                        B[q * n + p] = 0.0

                        k = 0
                        while k < n {
                            let vp = V[k * n + p]
                            let vq = V[k * n + q]
                            V[k * n + p] = c * vp - s * vq
                            V[k * n + q] = s * vp + c * vq
                            k = k + 1
                        }
                    }
                    q = q + 1
                }
                p = p + 1
            }
            sweep = sweep + 1
        }
    }

    var eig: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var order: [i32; 64] = [0; 64]
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        eig[i] = B[i * n + i]
        if eig[i] < 0.0 { eig[i] = 0.0 }
        order[i] = i
        i = i + 1
    }

    i = 1
    while i < n {
        let key_val = eig[i]
        let key_idx = order[i]
        var j = i - 1
        var done = false
        while j >= 0 && done == false {
            if eig[j] < key_val {
                eig[j + 1] = eig[j]
                order[j + 1] = order[j]
                j = j - 1
            } else {
                done = true
            }
        }
        eig[j + 1] = key_val
        order[j + 1] = key_idx
        i = i + 1
    }

    i = 0
    while i < n {
        S[i] = mr_sqrt(eig[i])
        i = i + 1
    }

    i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            Vt[i * n + j] = V[j * n + order[i]]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var Vs: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            Vs[j * n + i] = Vt[i * n + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    i = 0
    while i < n {
        if S[i] > 1.0e-14 {
            let inv_s = 1.0 / S[i]
            var r = 0
            while r < m {
                var sum = 0.0
                var c = 0
                while c < n {
                    sum = sum + A[r * n + c] * Vs[c * n + i]
                    c = c + 1
                }
                U[r * n + i] = sum * inv_s
                r = r + 1
            }
        } else {
            var r = 0
            while r < m {
                U[r * n + i] = 0.0
                r = r + 1
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// POD (copied from mor.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn pod_rank_for_energy(sv: &[f64; 64], n: i32, energy_frac: f64) -> i32 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var total = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        total = total + sv[i] * sv[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    if total < 1.0e-30 { return 1 }

    var cumul = 0.0
    var r = 0
    while r < n {
        cumul = cumul + sv[r] * sv[r]
        if cumul / total >= energy_frac { return r + 1 }
        r = r + 1
    }
    n
}

fn pod_compute(snapshots: &SnapshotMatrix, energy_thresh: f64,
               basis: &!ReducedBasis) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nd = snapshots.n_dof
    let ns = snapshots.n_snap

    var U_svd: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var S_svd: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var Vt_svd: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]

    mr_svd(&snapshots.data, nd, ns, &!U_svd, &!S_svd, &!Vt_svd)

    let r = pod_rank_for_energy(&S_svd, ns, energy_thresh)

    var i = 0
    while i < nd {
        var j = 0
        while j < r {
            basis.V[i * r + j] = U_svd[i * ns + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    basis.n_dof = nd
    basis.n_basis = r

    i = 0
    while i < ns {
        basis.singular_values[i] = S_svd[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// GALERKIN PROJECTION (copied from mor.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mor_project_matrix(V: &[f64; 4096], A: &[f64; 4096],
                      n_dof: i32, n_basis: i32,
                      A_r: &![f64; 4096]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var AV: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        var j = 0
        while j < n_basis {
            var sum = 0.0
            var k = 0
            while k < n_dof {
                sum = sum + A[i * n_dof + k] * V[k * n_basis + j]
                k = k + 1
            }
            AV[i * n_basis + j] = sum
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    i = 0
    while i < n_basis {
        var j = 0
        while j < n_basis {
            var sum = 0.0
            var k = 0
            while k < n_dof {
                sum = sum + V[k * n_basis + i] * AV[k * n_basis + j]
                k = k + 1
            }
            A_r[i * n_basis + j] = sum
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mor_project_vector(V: &[f64; 4096], b: &[f64; 256],
                      n_dof: i32, n_basis: i32,
                      b_r: &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n_basis {
        var sum = 0.0
        var k = 0
        while k < n_dof {
            sum = sum + V[k * n_basis + i] * b[k]
            k = k + 1
        }
        b_r[i] = sum
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mor_project_rhs(V: &[f64; 4096], f: &[f64; 256],
                   n_dof: i32, n_basis: i32,
                   f_r: &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    mor_project_vector(V, f, n_dof, n_basis, f_r)
}

// ============================================================================
// RECONSTRUCTION (copied from mor.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mor_reconstruct(V: &[f64; 4096], u_red: &[f64; 64],
                   n_dof: i32, n_basis: i32,
                   u_full: &![f64; 256]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < n_basis {
            sum = sum + V[i * n_basis + j] * u_red[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        u_full[i] = sum
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// REDUCED SYSTEM SOLVE (copied from mor.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mor_solve_reduced(A_r: &[f64; 4096], b_r: &[f64; 64], n_basis: i32,
                     u_r: &![f64; 64]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nb = n_basis

    var M: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var rhs: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var i = 0
    while i < nb {
        var j = 0
        while j < nb {
            M[i * nb + j] = A_r[i * nb + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        rhs[i] = b_r[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    var col = 0
    while col < nb {
        var pivot_row = col
        var pivot_val = mr_abs(M[col * nb + col])
        var row = col + 1
        while row < nb {
            let v = mr_abs(M[row * nb + col])
            if v > pivot_val {
                pivot_val = v
                pivot_row = row
            }
            row = row + 1
        }

        if pivot_row != col {
            var k = 0
            while k < nb {
                let tmp = M[col * nb + k]
                M[col * nb + k] = M[pivot_row * nb + k]
                M[pivot_row * nb + k] = tmp
                k = k + 1
            }
            let tmp_r = rhs[col]
            rhs[col] = rhs[pivot_row]
            rhs[pivot_row] = tmp_r
        }

        let diag = M[col * nb + col]
        if mr_abs(diag) < 1.0e-30 {
            col = col + 1
        } else {
            row = col + 1
            while row < nb {
                let factor = M[row * nb + col] / diag
                var k = col + 1
                while k < nb {
                    M[row * nb + k] = M[row * nb + k] - factor * M[col * nb + k]
                    k = k + 1
                }
                M[row * nb + col] = 0.0
                rhs[row] = rhs[row] - factor * rhs[col]
                row = row + 1
            }
            col = col + 1
        }
    }

    i = nb - 1
    var done_back = false
    while i >= 0 && done_back == false {
        var sum = rhs[i]
        var j = i + 1
        while j < nb {
            sum = sum - M[i * nb + j] * u_r[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        let diag = M[i * nb + i]
        if mr_abs(diag) < 1.0e-30 {
            u_r[i] = 0.0
        } else {
            u_r[i] = sum / diag
        }
        if i == 0 { done_back = true } else { i = i - 1 }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// ERROR ESTIMATION (copied from mor.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mor_error_estimate(A: &[f64; 4096], b: &[f64; 256], V: &[f64; 4096],
                      u_red: &[f64; 64],
                      n_dof: i32, n_basis: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var u_full: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    mor_reconstruct(V, u_red, n_dof, n_basis, &!u_full)

    var res: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < n_dof {
            sum = sum + A[i * n_dof + j] * u_full[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        res[i] = b[i] - sum
        i = i + 1
    }

    let res_norm = mr_norm2_256(&res, n_dof)
    let b_norm = mr_norm2_256(b, n_dof)

    if b_norm < 1.0e-30 { return res_norm }
    res_norm / b_norm
}

fn mor_true_error(u_full_exact: &[f64; 256], u_full_approx: &[f64; 256],
                  n_dof: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var diff_sq = 0.0
    var exact_sq = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        let d = u_full_exact[i] - u_full_approx[i]
        diff_sq = diff_sq + d * d
        exact_sq = exact_sq + u_full_exact[i] * u_full_exact[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    if exact_sq < 1.0e-30 { return mr_sqrt(diff_sq) }
    mr_sqrt(diff_sq) / mr_sqrt(exact_sq)
}

// ============================================================================
// FULL MOR PIPELINE (copied from mor.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mor_solve(A: &[f64; 4096], b: &[f64; 256], n_dof: i32,
             basis: &ReducedBasis,
             result: &!MORResult) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nb = basis.n_basis

    var A_r: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mor_project_matrix(&basis.V, A, n_dof, nb, &!A_r)

    var b_r: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    mor_project_rhs(&basis.V, b, n_dof, nb, &!b_r)

    var u_r: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    mor_solve_reduced(&A_r, &b_r, nb, &!u_r)

    var i = 0
    while i < nb {
        result.u_reduced[i] = u_r[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    mor_reconstruct(&basis.V, &u_r, n_dof, nb, &!result.u_full)

    let err = mor_error_estimate(A, b, &basis.V, &u_r, n_dof, nb)

    result.n_basis = nb
    result.error_est = err
    result.converged = err < 1.0e-6
}

// ============================================================================
// GRAM-SCHMIDT (copied from mor.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mr_gram_schmidt(V: &![f64; 4096], n_dof: i32, n_basis: i32,
                   v_new: &[f64; 256]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var w: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        w[i] = v_new[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    var pass = 0
    while pass < 2 {
        var j = 0
        while j < n_basis {
            var proj = 0.0
            i = 0
            while i < n_dof {
                proj = proj + w[i] * V[i * n_basis + j]
                i = i + 1
            }
            i = 0
            while i < n_dof {
                w[i] = w[i] - proj * V[i * n_basis + j]
                i = i + 1
            }
            j = j + 1
        }
        pass = pass + 1
    }

    let nrm = mr_norm2_256(&w, n_dof)
    if nrm < 1.0e-14 {
        i = 0
        while i < n_dof {
            V[i * (n_basis + 1) + n_basis] = 0.0
            i = i + 1
        }
        return
    }

    let inv_nrm = 1.0 / nrm

    i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        V[i * (n_basis + 1) + n_basis] = w[i] * inv_nrm
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// DEIM (copied from mor.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn deim_compute(basis: &ReducedBasis, deim: &!DEIMBasis) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nd = basis.n_dof
    var m = basis.n_basis
    if m > 64 { m = 64 }

    var i = 0
    while i < nd {
        var j = 0
        while j < m {
            deim.U[i * m + j] = basis.V[i * basis.n_basis + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    deim.n_dof = nd
    deim.n_deim = m

    var u_col: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    i = 0
    while i < nd {
        u_col[i] = deim.U[i * m + 0]
        i = i + 1
    }
    deim.P[0] = mr_argmax_abs_256(&u_col, nd)

    var l = 1
    while l < m {
        i = 0
        while i < nd {
            u_col[i] = deim.U[i * m + l]
            i = i + 1
        }

        var PtU: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
        var Ptu: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        i = 0
        while i < l {
            let pi = deim.P[i]
            var j = 0
            while j < l {
                PtU[i * l + j] = deim.U[pi * m + j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            Ptu[i] = u_col[pi]
            i = i + 1
        }

        var c_vec: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

        var M_d: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
        var rhs_d: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
        i = 0
        while i < l {
            var j = 0
            while j < l {
                M_d[i * l + j] = PtU[i * l + j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            rhs_d[i] = Ptu[i]
            i = i + 1
        }

        var col = 0
        while col < l {
            var pivot_row = col
            var pivot_val = mr_abs(M_d[col * l + col])
            var row = col + 1
            while row < l {
                let v = mr_abs(M_d[row * l + col])
                if v > pivot_val { pivot_val = v; pivot_row = row }
                row = row + 1
            }
            if pivot_row != col {
                var k = 0
                while k < l {
                    let tmp = M_d[col * l + k]
                    M_d[col * l + k] = M_d[pivot_row * l + k]
                    M_d[pivot_row * l + k] = tmp
                    k = k + 1
                }
                let tmp_r = rhs_d[col]
                rhs_d[col] = rhs_d[pivot_row]
                rhs_d[pivot_row] = tmp_r
            }

            let diag = M_d[col * l + col]
            if mr_abs(diag) > 1.0e-30 {
                row = col + 1
                while row < l {
                    let factor = M_d[row * l + col] / diag
                    var k = col + 1
                    while k < l {
                        M_d[row * l + k] = M_d[row * l + k] - factor * M_d[col * l + k]
                        k = k + 1
                    }
                    rhs_d[row] = rhs_d[row] - factor * rhs_d[col]
                    row = row + 1
                }
            }
            col = col + 1
        }

        i = l - 1
        var done_bs = false
        while i >= 0 && done_bs == false {
            var sum = rhs_d[i]
            var j = i + 1
            while j < l {
                sum = sum - M_d[i * l + j] * c_vec[j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            let diag = M_d[i * l + i]
            if mr_abs(diag) > 1.0e-30 {
                c_vec[i] = sum / diag
            } else {
                c_vec[i] = 0.0
            }
            if i == 0 { done_bs = true } else { i = i - 1 }
        }

        var res: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
        i = 0
        while i < nd {
            var val = u_col[i]
            var j = 0
            while j < l {
                val = val - deim.U[i * m + j] * c_vec[j]
                j = j + 1
            }
            res[i] = val
            i = i + 1
        }

        deim.P[l] = mr_argmax_abs_256(&res, nd)

        l = l + 1
    }
}

fn deim_approximate(deim: &DEIMBasis, f_full: &[f64; 256],
                    f_approx: &![f64; 256]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nd = deim.n_dof
    let m = deim.n_deim

    var f_P: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        f_P[i] = f_full[deim.P[i]]
        i = i + 1
    }

    var PtU: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    i = 0
    while i < m {
        let pi = deim.P[i]
        var j = 0
        while j < m {
            PtU[i * m + j] = deim.U[pi * m + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var c_vec: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]

    var M_d: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var rhs_d: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    i = 0
    while i < m {
        var j = 0
        while j < m {
            M_d[i * m + j] = PtU[i * m + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        rhs_d[i] = f_P[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    var col = 0
    while col < m {
        var pivot_row = col
        var pivot_val = mr_abs(M_d[col * m + col])
        var row = col + 1
        while row < m {
            let v = mr_abs(M_d[row * m + col])
            if v > pivot_val { pivot_val = v; pivot_row = row }
            row = row + 1
        }
        if pivot_row != col {
            var k = 0
            while k < m {
                let tmp = M_d[col * m + k]
                M_d[col * m + k] = M_d[pivot_row * m + k]
                M_d[pivot_row * m + k] = tmp
                k = k + 1
            }
            let tmp_r = rhs_d[col]
            rhs_d[col] = rhs_d[pivot_row]
            rhs_d[pivot_row] = tmp_r
        }

        let diag = M_d[col * m + col]
        if mr_abs(diag) > 1.0e-30 {
            row = col + 1
            while row < m {
                let factor = M_d[row * m + col] / diag
                var k = col + 1
                while k < m {
                    M_d[row * m + k] = M_d[row * m + k] - factor * M_d[col * m + k]
                    k = k + 1
                }
                rhs_d[row] = rhs_d[row] - factor * rhs_d[col]
                row = row + 1
            }
        }
        col = col + 1
    }

    i = m - 1
    var done_bs = false
    while i >= 0 && done_bs == false {
        var sum = rhs_d[i]
        var j = i + 1
        while j < m {
            sum = sum - M_d[i * m + j] * c_vec[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        let diag = M_d[i * m + i]
        if mr_abs(diag) > 1.0e-30 {
            c_vec[i] = sum / diag
        } else {
            c_vec[i] = 0.0
        }
        if i == 0 { done_bs = true } else { i = i - 1 }
    }

    i = 0
    while i < nd {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < m {
            sum = sum + deim.U[i * m + j] * c_vec[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        f_approx[i] = sum
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// DIRECT FULL-SYSTEM SOLVE (Gaussian elimination for tests)
// ============================================================================

fn direct_solve(A: &[f64; 4096], b: &[f64; 256], n: i32,
                x: &![f64; 256]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var M: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var rhs: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            M[i * n + j] = A[i * n + j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        rhs[i] = b[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    var col = 0
    while col < n {
        var pivot_row = col
        var pivot_val = mr_abs(M[col * n + col])
        var row = col + 1
        while row < n {
            let v = mr_abs(M[row * n + col])
            if v > pivot_val { pivot_val = v; pivot_row = row }
            row = row + 1
        }
        if pivot_row != col {
            var k = 0
            while k < n {
                let tmp = M[col * n + k]
                M[col * n + k] = M[pivot_row * n + k]
                M[pivot_row * n + k] = tmp
                k = k + 1
            }
            let tmp_r = rhs[col]
            rhs[col] = rhs[pivot_row]
            rhs[pivot_row] = tmp_r
        }
        let diag = M[col * n + col]
        if mr_abs(diag) > 1.0e-30 {
            row = col + 1
            while row < n {
                let factor = M[row * n + col] / diag
                var k = col + 1
                while k < n {
                    M[row * n + k] = M[row * n + k] - factor * M[col * n + k]
                    k = k + 1
                }
                M[row * n + col] = 0.0
                rhs[row] = rhs[row] - factor * rhs[col]
                row = row + 1
            }
        }
        col = col + 1
    }

    i = n - 1
    var done_back = false
    while i >= 0 && done_back == false {
        var sum = rhs[i]
        var j = i + 1
        while j < n {
            sum = sum - M[i * n + j] * x[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        let diag = M[i * n + i]
        if mr_abs(diag) < 1.0e-30 {
            x[i] = 0.0
        } else {
            x[i] = sum / diag
        }
        if i == 0 { done_back = true } else { i = i - 1 }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST HELPERS
// ============================================================================

// Build a 4x4 SPD test matrix (1D Poisson-like tridiagonal, shifted to SPD):
//   A[i,i] = 2 + shift,  A[i,i+1] = A[i+1,i] = -1
// Returns matrix in row-major 4096-array for n_dof = 4.
fn build_spd_4x4(A: &![f64; 4096], n: i32, shift: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i < n * n {
        A[i] = 0.0
        i = i + 1
    }
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        A[i * n + i] = 2.0 + shift
        if i > 0 { A[i * n + (i - 1)] = 0.0 - 1.0 }
        if i < n - 1 { A[i * n + (i + 1)] = 0.0 - 1.0 }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// Build an orthonormal basis V (n_dof x n_basis) from given vectors.
// For testing, we use columns of a known orthonormal set.
// This builds a simple 2-column basis for n_dof=4:
//   col 0 = [1/2, 1/2, 1/2, 1/2]  (constant mode)
//   col 1 = normalized [-3, -1, 1, 3]  (linear mode)
fn build_test_basis_4x2(V: &![f64; 4096]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Column 0: constant mode normalized
    V[0 * 2 + 0] = 0.5
    V[1 * 2 + 0] = 0.5
    V[2 * 2 + 0] = 0.5
    V[3 * 2 + 0] = 0.5

    // Column 1: linear mode [-3, -1, 1, 3], norm = sqrt(20) = 2*sqrt(5)
    let inv_norm = 1.0 / mr_sqrt(20.0)
    V[0 * 2 + 1] = (0.0 - 3.0) * inv_norm
    V[1 * 2 + 1] = (0.0 - 1.0) * inv_norm
    V[2 * 2 + 1] = 1.0 * inv_norm
    V[3 * 2 + 1] = 3.0 * inv_norm
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

// Test 1: SVD of diagonal matrix diag(3,2,1) -> singular values 3,2,1
fn test_svd_diagonal() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // 3x3 diagonal matrix: diag(3, 2, 1)
    var A: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    A[0 * 3 + 0] = 3.0
    A[1 * 3 + 1] = 2.0
    A[2 * 3 + 2] = 1.0

    var U: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var S: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var Vt: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]

    mr_svd(&A, 3, 3, &!U, &!S, &!Vt)

    let tol = 1.0e-4
    if mr_abs(S[0] - 3.0) > tol { return false }
    if mr_abs(S[1] - 2.0) > tol { return false }
    if mr_abs(S[2] - 1.0) > tol { return false }
    true
}

// Test 2: SVD roundtrip U*S*Vt approx A
fn test_svd_roundtrip() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // 4x3 test matrix: rank-2 with known structure
    var A: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    // Row 0: [1, 2, 0]
    A[0 * 3 + 0] = 1.0; A[0 * 3 + 1] = 2.0; A[0 * 3 + 2] = 0.0
    // Row 1: [0, 1, 1]
    A[1 * 3 + 0] = 0.0; A[1 * 3 + 1] = 1.0; A[1 * 3 + 2] = 1.0
    // Row 2: [1, 0, 1]
    A[2 * 3 + 0] = 1.0; A[2 * 3 + 1] = 0.0; A[2 * 3 + 2] = 1.0
    // Row 3: [2, 1, 0]
    A[3 * 3 + 0] = 2.0; A[3 * 3 + 1] = 1.0; A[3 * 3 + 2] = 0.0

    let m = 4
    let n = 3

    var U: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var S: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    var Vt: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]

    mr_svd(&A, m, n, &!U, &!S, &!Vt)

    // Reconstruct: A_recon = U * diag(S) * Vt
    // First compute U * diag(S): scale column i of U by S[i]
    var US: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var i = 0
    while i < m {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            US[i * n + j] = U[i * n + j] * S[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // A_recon = US * Vt  (m x n) = (m x n) * (n x n)
    var A_recon: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mr_mat_mul(&US, &Vt, m, n, n, &!A_recon)

    // Check: ||A - A_recon|| < tol
    let tol = 1.0e-4
    var max_diff = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < m {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            let d = mr_abs(A[i * n + j] - A_recon[i * n + j])
            if d > max_diff { max_diff = d }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    max_diff < tol
}

// Test 3: POD energy capture with threshold 0.99
fn test_pod_energy_capture() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Build a snapshot matrix (4 x 3): 4 DOFs, 3 snapshots
    // Snapshots are near-rank-1: s1 = [1,2,3,4], s2 = [1.1,2.1,3.1,4.1], s3 = [0.9,1.9,2.9,3.9]
    var snap: SnapshotMatrix = SnapshotMatrix {
        data: [0.0; 4096],
        n_dof: 4,
        n_snap: 3
    }
    // Column 0: [1, 2, 3, 4]
    snap.data[0 * 3 + 0] = 1.0
    snap.data[1 * 3 + 0] = 2.0
    snap.data[2 * 3 + 0] = 3.0
    snap.data[3 * 3 + 0] = 4.0
    // Column 1: [1.1, 2.1, 3.1, 4.1]
    snap.data[0 * 3 + 1] = 1.1
    snap.data[1 * 3 + 1] = 2.1
    snap.data[2 * 3 + 1] = 3.1
    snap.data[3 * 3 + 1] = 4.1
    // Column 2: [0.9, 1.9, 2.9, 3.9]
    snap.data[0 * 3 + 2] = 0.9
    snap.data[1 * 3 + 2] = 1.9
    snap.data[2 * 3 + 2] = 2.9
    snap.data[3 * 3 + 2] = 3.9

    var basis: ReducedBasis = ReducedBasis {
        V: [0.0; 4096],
        n_dof: 0,
        n_basis: 0,
        singular_values: [0.0; 64]
    }

    pod_compute(&snap, 0.99, &!basis)

    // With 99% energy threshold on a near-rank-1 matrix, should select 1 or 2 basis vectors
    // The key requirement is that basis.n_basis >= 1 and captures most energy
    if basis.n_basis < 1 { return false }
    if basis.n_basis > 3 { return false }

    // Verify that the first singular value is dominant
    let s0 = basis.singular_values[0]
    if s0 < 1.0 { return false }  // should be large for this matrix

    true
}

// Test 4: pod_rank_for_energy with known singular values
fn test_pod_rank_selection() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sv: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    // Singular values: 10, 1, 0.1, 0.01
    sv[0] = 10.0
    sv[1] = 1.0
    sv[2] = 0.1
    sv[3] = 0.01

    // Total energy = 100 + 1 + 0.01 + 0.0001 = 101.0101
    // First SV alone: 100 / 101.0101 = 0.9900...  (just under 99%)
    // First two: 101 / 101.0101 = 0.9999...  (well above 99%)

    let r_99 = pod_rank_for_energy(&sv, 4, 0.99)

    // With 99% threshold, need rank 2 (first two SVs capture > 99%)
    if r_99 < 1 { return false }
    if r_99 > 2 { return false }

    // With 50% threshold, rank 1 should suffice
    let r_50 = pod_rank_for_energy(&sv, 4, 0.50)
    if r_50 != 1 { return false }

    // With 100% threshold, need all 4
    let r_100 = pod_rank_for_energy(&sv, 4, 1.0)
    if r_100 != 4 { return false }

    true
}

// Test 5: Galerkin projection with V = I: A_r should equal A
fn test_galerkin_identity_basis() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 3

    // Build a simple 3x3 SPD matrix
    var A: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    A[0 * 3 + 0] = 4.0; A[0 * 3 + 1] = 1.0; A[0 * 3 + 2] = 0.0
    A[1 * 3 + 0] = 1.0; A[1 * 3 + 1] = 3.0; A[1 * 3 + 2] = 1.0
    A[2 * 3 + 0] = 0.0; A[2 * 3 + 1] = 1.0; A[2 * 3 + 2] = 2.0

    // V = I_3 (3x3 identity, stored as n_dof=3, n_basis=3)
    var V: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    V[0 * 3 + 0] = 1.0
    V[1 * 3 + 1] = 1.0
    V[2 * 3 + 2] = 1.0

    var A_r: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mor_project_matrix(&V, &A, n, n, &!A_r)

    // A_r should equal A
    let tol = 1.0e-4
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = 0
        while j < n {
            if mr_abs(A_r[i * n + j] - A[i * n + j]) > tol { return false }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    true
}

// Test 6: Projection/reconstruction roundtrip V*Vt*u = u for u in span(V)
fn test_projection_roundtrip() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_dof = 4
    let n_basis = 2

    var V: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    build_test_basis_4x2(&!V)

    // Build u as a linear combination of the basis columns: u = 3*v0 + 2*v1
    var u_exact: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        u_exact[i] = 3.0 * V[i * n_basis + 0] + 2.0 * V[i * n_basis + 1]
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Project: u_r = V^T * u
    var u_r: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    mor_project_vector(&V, &u_exact, n_dof, n_basis, &!u_r)

    // Reconstruct: u_recon = V * u_r
    var u_recon: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    mor_reconstruct(&V, &u_r, n_dof, n_basis, &!u_recon)

    // u_recon should equal u_exact since u is in span(V)
    let tol = 1.0e-4
    i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        if mr_abs(u_recon[i] - u_exact[i]) > tol { return false }
        i = i + 1
    }
    true
}

// Test 7: Reduced solve accuracy vs direct solve
fn test_reduced_solve_accuracy() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_dof = 4
    let n_basis = 2

    // Build 4x4 SPD matrix (shifted Poisson)
    var A: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    build_spd_4x4(&!A, n_dof, 0.5)

    // Build orthonormal basis
    var V: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    build_test_basis_4x2(&!V)

    // Choose RHS that lies in span(V): b = A * (3*v0 + 2*v1)
    // This ensures the exact solution is representable in the reduced basis
    var u_target: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        u_target[i] = 3.0 * V[i * n_basis + 0] + 2.0 * V[i * n_basis + 1]
        i = i + 1
    }

    var b: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < n_dof {
            sum = sum + A[i * n_dof + j] * u_target[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        b[i] = sum
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Project matrix and RHS
    var A_r: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mor_project_matrix(&V, &A, n_dof, n_basis, &!A_r)

    var b_r: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    mor_project_rhs(&V, &b, n_dof, n_basis, &!b_r)

    // Solve reduced system
    var u_r: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    mor_solve_reduced(&A_r, &b_r, n_basis, &!u_r)

    // Reconstruct
    var u_recon: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    mor_reconstruct(&V, &u_r, n_dof, n_basis, &!u_recon)

    // Direct solve for comparison
    var u_direct: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    direct_solve(&A, &b, n_dof, &!u_direct)

    // The reduced solution should be close to the direct solution.
    // Since b = A*u_target and u_target is in span(V), the reduced
    // solution should approximately recover u_target (up to projection error).
    let tol = 0.1  // allow some projection error
    var max_diff = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        let d = mr_abs(u_recon[i] - u_direct[i])
        if d > max_diff { max_diff = d }
        i = i + 1
    }
    max_diff < tol
}

// Test 8: MOR error estimate is non-negative
fn test_error_estimate_nonneg() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_dof = 4
    let n_basis = 2

    var A: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    build_spd_4x4(&!A, n_dof, 0.5)

    var V: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    build_test_basis_4x2(&!V)

    // Arbitrary RHS
    var b: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    b[0] = 1.0; b[1] = 2.0; b[2] = 3.0; b[3] = 4.0

    // Arbitrary reduced solution coefficients
    var u_r: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    u_r[0] = 1.0; u_r[1] = 0.5

    let err = mor_error_estimate(&A, &b, &V, &u_r, n_dof, n_basis)

    // Error estimate must be non-negative (it is a norm ratio)
    if err < 0.0 { return false }

    // Also check with a zero RHS
    var b_zero: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var u_zero: [f64; 64] = [0.0; 64]
    let err_zero = mor_error_estimate(&A, &b_zero, &V, &u_zero, n_dof, n_basis)
    if err_zero < 0.0 { return false }

    true
}

// Test 9: MOR true error is small for a well-captured problem
fn test_mor_true_error_small() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_dof = 4
    let n_basis = 2

    var A: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    build_spd_4x4(&!A, n_dof, 0.5)

    var V: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    build_test_basis_4x2(&!V)

    // Build b = A * u_target where u_target is in span(V)
    var u_target: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        u_target[i] = 2.0 * V[i * n_basis + 0] + 1.0 * V[i * n_basis + 1]
        i = i + 1
    }

    var b: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        var sum = 0.0
        var j = 0
        while j < n_dof {
            sum = sum + A[i * n_dof + j] * u_target[j]
            j = j + 1
        }
        b[i] = sum
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Use full MOR pipeline
    var basis: ReducedBasis = ReducedBasis {
        V: [0.0; 4096],
        n_dof: n_dof,
        n_basis: n_basis,
        singular_values: [0.0; 64]
    }
    // Copy V into basis
    i = 0
    while i < 4096 {
        basis.V[i] = V[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    var result: MORResult = MORResult {
        u_reduced: [0.0; 64],
        u_full: [0.0; 256],
        n_basis: 0,
        error_est: 0.0,
        converged: false
    }

    mor_solve(&A, &b, n_dof, &basis, &!result)

    // Compute direct solution for reference
    var u_direct: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    direct_solve(&A, &b, n_dof, &!u_direct)

    // True error should be small for this well-captured problem
    let true_err = mor_true_error(&u_direct, &result.u_full, n_dof)

    // For a solution in span(V), the reduced method should be quite accurate
    true_err < 0.1
}

// Test 10: Gram-Schmidt orthogonality: V^T * V = I
fn test_gram_schmidt_orthogonality() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_dof = 4

    // Start with one normalized vector: v0 = [1/2, 1/2, 1/2, 1/2]
    var V: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    // V is n_dof x 1 initially (stride 1)
    V[0 * 1 + 0] = 0.5
    V[1 * 1 + 0] = 0.5
    V[2 * 1 + 0] = 0.5
    V[3 * 1 + 0] = 0.5

    // Add a second vector via Gram-Schmidt
    var v_new: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    v_new[0] = 1.0; v_new[1] = 0.0; v_new[2] = 0.0 - 1.0; v_new[3] = 0.0

    mr_gram_schmidt(&!V, n_dof, 1, &v_new)

    // Now V is n_dof x 2 with stride 2
    let n_basis = 2

    // Check orthogonality: V^T * V should be identity
    let tol = 1.0e-4

    // Compute V^T * V (2x2)
    var vtv: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var i = 0
    while i < n_basis {
        var j = 0
        while j < n_basis {
            var sum = 0.0
            var k = 0
            while k < n_dof {
                sum = sum + V[k * n_basis + i] * V[k * n_basis + j]
                k = k + 1
            }
            vtv[i * n_basis + j] = sum
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Diagonal should be 1, off-diagonal should be 0
    i = 0
    while i < n_basis {
        var j = 0
        while j < n_basis {
            var expected = 0.0
            if i == j { expected = 1.0 }
            if mr_abs(vtv[i * n_basis + j] - expected) > tol { return false }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    true
}

// Test 11: DEIM indices are valid (in range [0, n_dof-1])
fn test_deim_indices_valid() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_dof = 4
    let n_basis = 2

    // Build a simple orthonormal basis
    var basis: ReducedBasis = ReducedBasis {
        V: [0.0; 4096],
        n_dof: n_dof,
        n_basis: n_basis,
        singular_values: [0.0; 64]
    }
    build_test_basis_4x2(&!basis.V)

    var deim: DEIMBasis = DEIMBasis {
        U: [0.0; 4096],
        P: [0; 64],
        n_dof: 0,
        n_deim: 0
    }

    deim_compute(&basis, &!deim)

    // Check that DEIM indices are in valid range
    if deim.n_deim != n_basis { return false }

    var i = 0
    while i < deim.n_deim {
        if deim.P[i] < 0 { return false }
        if deim.P[i] >= n_dof { return false }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Check that DEIM indices are distinct
    if deim.n_deim >= 2 {
        if deim.P[0] == deim.P[1] { return false }
    }

    true
}

// Test 12: DEIM approximation is exact for a vector in span of DEIM basis
fn test_deim_approximation_exact() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_dof = 4
    let n_basis = 2

    var basis: ReducedBasis = ReducedBasis {
        V: [0.0; 4096],
        n_dof: n_dof,
        n_basis: n_basis,
        singular_values: [0.0; 64]
    }
    build_test_basis_4x2(&!basis.V)

    var deim: DEIMBasis = DEIMBasis {
        U: [0.0; 4096],
        P: [0; 64],
        n_dof: 0,
        n_deim: 0
    }

    deim_compute(&basis, &!deim)

    // Build f_full as a linear combination of basis columns: f = 2*v0 + 3*v1
    var f_full: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    var i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        f_full[i] = 2.0 * basis.V[i * n_basis + 0] + 3.0 * basis.V[i * n_basis + 1]
        i = i + 1
    }

    var f_approx: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    deim_approximate(&deim, &f_full, &!f_approx)

    // For a vector in span of the DEIM basis, approximation should be exact
    let tol = 1.0e-4
    i = 0
    while i < n_dof {
        if mr_abs(f_approx[i] - f_full[i]) > tol { return false }
        i = i + 1
    }
    true
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    var pass = 0
    var fail = 0

    println("=== Model Order Reduction Tests ===")
    println("")

    // Test 1
    print("Test  1: SVD of diagonal matrix ... ")
    if test_svd_diagonal() {
        println("PASS")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 2
    print("Test  2: SVD roundtrip U*S*Vt=A ... ")
    if test_svd_roundtrip() {
        println("PASS")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 3
    print("Test  3: POD energy capture ... ")
    if test_pod_energy_capture() {
        println("PASS")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 4
    print("Test  4: POD rank selection ... ")
    if test_pod_rank_selection() {
        println("PASS")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 5
    print("Test  5: Galerkin projection V=I ... ")
    if test_galerkin_identity_basis() {
        println("PASS")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 6
    print("Test  6: Projection roundtrip ... ")
    if test_projection_roundtrip() {
        println("PASS")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 7
    print("Test  7: Reduced solve accuracy ... ")
    if test_reduced_solve_accuracy() {
        println("PASS")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 8
    print("Test  8: Error estimate non-negative ... ")
    if test_error_estimate_nonneg() {
        println("PASS")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 9
    print("Test  9: MOR true error small ... ")
    if test_mor_true_error_small() {
        println("PASS")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 10
    print("Test 10: Gram-Schmidt orthogonality ... ")
    if test_gram_schmidt_orthogonality() {
        println("PASS")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 11
    print("Test 11: DEIM indices valid ... ")
    if test_deim_indices_valid() {
        println("PASS")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    // Test 12
    print("Test 12: DEIM approximation exact ... ")
    if test_deim_approximation_exact() {
        println("PASS")
        pass = pass + 1
    } else {
        println("FAIL")
        fail = fail + 1
    }

    println("")
    print("Passed: "); println(pass as string)
    print("Failed: "); println(fail as string)
    println("")
    if fail == 0 {
        println("ALL 12 TESTS PASSED")
        return 0
    } else {
        println("SOME TESTS FAILED")
        return 1
    }
}


// === FILE: tests/run-pass/test_multigrid.sio ===
//@ run-pass
// test_multigrid.sio -- Tests for geometric multigrid solvers module
//
// Self-contained test suite for restriction, prolongation, smoothers,
// coarse solve, V-cycle, full Poisson solver, 2D operators, and
// convergence analysis. All helpers copied from stdlib/math/multigrid.sio.
//
// Tests:
//  1.  Restriction preserves constant (1D)
//  2.  Prolongation preserves constant (1D)
//  3.  Restriction/prolongation adjoint relation
//  4.  Jacobi smoother reduces residual (1D)
//  5.  Red-black GS reduces residual (1D)
//  6.  Thomas algorithm (coarse solve) exact
//  7.  V-cycle convergence: residual decreases by factor < 0.5
//  8.  Full 1D Poisson solver: -u'' = pi^2 sin(pi x)
//  9.  2D restriction preserves constant
// 10.  2D Jacobi smoother reduces residual
// 11.  Convergence factor in (0, 1)
// 12.  Default config values

// ============================================================================
// HELPERS (copied from multigrid.sio -- tests must be self-contained)
// ============================================================================

fn mg_abs(x: f64) -> f64 { if x < 0.0 { 0.0 - x } else { x } }
fn mg_max(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { if a > b { a } else { b } }

fn mg_sqrt(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var y = x
    var i = 0
    while i < 20 { y = 0.5 * (y + x / y); i = i + 1 }
    y
}

fn sp_sin(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var a = x
    let tp = 6.28318530717958647692
    while a >= tp { a = a - tp }
    while a < 0.0 { a = a + tp }
    if a > 3.14159265358979323846 { a = a - tp }
    let a2 = a * a
    var sum = a
    var term = a
    var n = 1
    while n < 18 { term = 0.0 - term * a2 / ((2 * n) * (2 * n + 1)) as f64; sum = sum + term; n = n + 1 }
    sum
}

// ============================================================================
// STRUCTS (copied from multigrid.sio)
// ============================================================================

struct MGConfig { n_levels: i32, nu1: i32, nu2: i32, max_cycles: i32, tol: f64, omega: f64 }
struct MGResult { u: [f64; 4096], iterations: i32, residual_norm: f64, converged: bool }

// ============================================================================
// UTILITY (copied from multigrid.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mg_default_config(n_levels: i32, config: &!MGConfig) with Mut, Panic {
    config.n_levels = n_levels
    config.nu1 = 2
    config.nu2 = 2
    config.max_cycles = 100
    config.tol = 1.0e-10
    config.omega = 2.0 / 3.0
}

// ============================================================================
// 1D TRANSFER OPERATORS (copied from multigrid.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mg_restrict_1d(fine: &[f64; 4096], n_fine: i32, coarse: &![f64; 4096]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_coarse = n_fine / 2
    coarse[0] = fine[0]
    coarse[n_coarse] = fine[n_fine]
    var i = 1
    while i < n_coarse {
        let fi = 2 * i
        coarse[i] = 0.25 * fine[fi - 1] + 0.5 * fine[fi] + 0.25 * fine[fi + 1]
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mg_prolongate_1d(coarse: &[f64; 4096], n_coarse: i32, fine: &![f64; 4096]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var i = 0
    while i <= n_coarse {
        fine[2 * i] = coarse[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    i = 0
    while i < n_coarse {
        fine[2 * i + 1] = 0.5 * (coarse[i] + coarse[i + 1])
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 1D SMOOTHERS (copied from multigrid.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mg_smooth_jacobi_1d(u: &![f64; 4096], f: &[f64; 4096], n: i32,
                       h: f64, omega: f64, nu: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let h2 = h * h
    var sweep = 0
    while sweep < nu {
        var u_old: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
        var k = 0
        while k <= n {
            u_old[k] = u[k]
            k = k + 1
        }
        var i = 1
        while i < n {
            let avg = (u_old[i - 1] + u_old[i + 1] + h2 * f[i]) / 2.0
            u[i] = omega * avg + (1.0 - omega) * u_old[i]
            i = i + 1
        }
        sweep = sweep + 1
    }
}

fn mg_smooth_gs_rb_1d(u: &![f64; 4096], f: &[f64; 4096], n: i32,
                      h: f64, nu: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let h2 = h * h
    var sweep = 0
    while sweep < nu {
        var i = 1
        while i < n {
            let rem = i - (i / 2) * 2
            if rem == 1 {
                u[i] = (u[i - 1] + u[i + 1] + h2 * f[i]) / 2.0
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        i = 2
        while i < n {
            let rem = i - (i / 2) * 2
            if rem == 0 {
                u[i] = (u[i - 1] + u[i + 1] + h2 * f[i]) / 2.0
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        sweep = sweep + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 1D RESIDUAL (copied from multigrid.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mg_residual_1d(u: &[f64; 4096], f: &[f64; 4096], n: i32,
                  h: f64, r: &![f64; 4096]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let h2 = h * h
    r[0] = 0.0
    r[n] = 0.0
    var i = 1
    while i < n {
        let lap = (0.0 - u[i - 1] + 2.0 * u[i] - u[i + 1]) / h2
        r[i] = f[i] - lap
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mg_residual_norm_1d(r: &[f64; 4096], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let h = 1.0 / (n as f64)
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 1
    while i < n {
        sum = sum + r[i] * r[i]
        i = i + 1
    }
    mg_sqrt(h * sum)
}

// ============================================================================
// 1D COARSE SOLVE (copied from multigrid.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mg_coarse_solve_1d(u: &![f64; 4096], f: &[f64; 4096], n: i32,
                      h: f64) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let h2 = h * h
    let m = n - 1
    if m <= 0 { return }

    var b_mod: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var d_mod: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]

    b_mod[0] = 2.0
    d_mod[0] = h2 * f[1]

    var i = 1
    while i < m {
        let w = 0.0 - 1.0 / b_mod[i - 1]
        b_mod[i] = 2.0 - (0.0 - 1.0) * w
        d_mod[i] = h2 * f[i + 1] - d_mod[i - 1] * w
        i = i + 1
    }

    u[m] = d_mod[m - 1] / b_mod[m - 1]

    i = m - 2
    while i >= 0 {
        u[i + 1] = (d_mod[i] + u[i + 2]) / b_mod[i]
        i = i - 1
    }

    u[0] = 0.0
    u[n] = 0.0
}

// ============================================================================
// 1D V-CYCLE (copied from multigrid.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mg_vcycle_1d(u: &![f64; 4096], f: &[f64; 4096], n: i32,
                h: f64, config: &MGConfig, level: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if level >= config.n_levels - 1 {
        mg_coarse_solve_1d(u, f, n, h)
        return
    }
    if n <= 2 {
        mg_coarse_solve_1d(u, f, n, h)
        return
    }

    mg_smooth_gs_rb_1d(u, f, n, h, config.nu1)

    var r_fine: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_residual_1d(u, f, n, h, &!r_fine)

    let n_coarse = n / 2
    var r_coarse: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_restrict_1d(&r_fine, n, &!r_coarse)

    var e_coarse: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    let h_coarse = 2.0 * h
    mg_vcycle_1d(&!e_coarse, &r_coarse, n_coarse, h_coarse, config, level + 1)

    var e_fine: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_prolongate_1d(&e_coarse, n_coarse, &!e_fine)

    var i = 1
    while i < n {
        u[i] = u[i] + e_fine[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    mg_smooth_gs_rb_1d(u, f, n, h, config.nu2)
}

// ============================================================================
// 1D FULL SOLVER (copied from multigrid.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mg_solve_poisson_1d(f_rhs: fn(f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic,
                       n: i32, config: &MGConfig,
                       result: &!MGResult) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let h = 1.0 / (n as f64)

    var i = 0
    while i <= n {
        result.u[i] = 0.0
        i = i + 1
    }

    var f_vals: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    i = 0
    while i <= n {
        let x = (i as f64) * h
        f_vals[i] = f_rhs(x)
        i = i + 1
    }
    f_vals[0] = 0.0
    f_vals[n] = 0.0

    result.converged = false
    result.iterations = 0

    var cycle = 0
    while cycle < config.max_cycles {
        mg_vcycle_1d(&!result.u, &f_vals, n, h, config, 0)

        var r: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
        mg_residual_1d(&result.u, &f_vals, n, h, &!r)
        let rnorm = mg_residual_norm_1d(&r, n)

        result.residual_norm = rnorm
        result.iterations = cycle + 1

        if rnorm < config.tol {
            result.converged = true
            return
        }
        cycle = cycle + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 2D INDEX HELPER (copied from multigrid.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mg_idx2d(i: i32, j: i32, nx: i32) -> i32 {
    i * (nx + 1) + j
}

// ============================================================================
// 2D TRANSFER OPERATORS (copied from multigrid.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mg_restrict_2d(fine: &[f64; 4096], nx_f: i32, ny_f: i32,
                  coarse: &![f64; 4096]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nx_c = nx_f / 2
    let ny_c = ny_f / 2

    var j = 0
    while j <= nx_c {
        coarse[mg_idx2d(0, j, nx_c)] = fine[mg_idx2d(0, 2 * j, nx_f)]
        coarse[mg_idx2d(ny_c, j, nx_c)] = fine[mg_idx2d(ny_f, 2 * j, nx_f)]
        j = j + 1
    }
    var i = 0
    while i <= ny_c {
        coarse[mg_idx2d(i, 0, nx_c)] = fine[mg_idx2d(2 * i, 0, nx_f)]
        coarse[mg_idx2d(i, nx_c, nx_c)] = fine[mg_idx2d(2 * i, nx_f, nx_f)]
        i = i + 1
    }

    i = 1
    while i < ny_c {
        j = 1
        while j < nx_c {
            let fi = 2 * i
            let fj = 2 * j

            let corners = fine[mg_idx2d(fi - 1, fj - 1, nx_f)]
                        + fine[mg_idx2d(fi - 1, fj + 1, nx_f)]
                        + fine[mg_idx2d(fi + 1, fj - 1, nx_f)]
                        + fine[mg_idx2d(fi + 1, fj + 1, nx_f)]

            let edges = fine[mg_idx2d(fi, fj - 1, nx_f)]
                      + fine[mg_idx2d(fi, fj + 1, nx_f)]
                      + fine[mg_idx2d(fi - 1, fj, nx_f)]
                      + fine[mg_idx2d(fi + 1, fj, nx_f)]

            let center = fine[mg_idx2d(fi, fj, nx_f)]

            coarse[mg_idx2d(i, j, nx_c)] = corners / 16.0 + edges / 8.0 + center / 4.0

            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mg_prolongate_2d(coarse: &[f64; 4096], nx_c: i32, ny_c: i32,
                    fine: &![f64; 4096]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nx_f = 2 * nx_c
    let ny_f = 2 * ny_c

    var i = 0
    while i <= ny_c {
        var j = 0
        while j <= nx_c {
            fine[mg_idx2d(2 * i, 2 * j, nx_f)] = coarse[mg_idx2d(i, j, nx_c)]
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    i = 0
    while i <= ny_c {
        var j = 0
        while j < nx_c {
            fine[mg_idx2d(2 * i, 2 * j + 1, nx_f)] = 0.5 * (
                coarse[mg_idx2d(i, j, nx_c)] + coarse[mg_idx2d(i, j + 1, nx_c)]
            )
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    i = 0
    while i < ny_c {
        var j = 0
        while j <= nx_f {
            fine[mg_idx2d(2 * i + 1, j, nx_f)] = 0.5 * (
                fine[mg_idx2d(2 * i, j, nx_f)] + fine[mg_idx2d(2 * i + 2, j, nx_f)]
            )
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 2D SMOOTHERS (copied from multigrid.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mg_smooth_jacobi_2d(u: &![f64; 4096], f: &[f64; 4096],
                       nx: i32, ny: i32, hx: f64, hy: f64,
                       omega: f64, nu: i32) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let hx2 = hx * hx
    let hy2 = hy * hy
    let diag = 2.0 / hx2 + 2.0 / hy2

    var sweep = 0
    while sweep < nu {
        var u_old: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
        var k = 0
        let total = (nx + 1) * (ny + 1)
        while k < total {
            u_old[k] = u[k]
            k = k + 1
        }

        var i = 1
        while i < ny {
            var j = 1
            while j < nx {
                let idx = mg_idx2d(i, j, nx)
                let u_left  = u_old[mg_idx2d(i, j - 1, nx)]
                let u_right = u_old[mg_idx2d(i, j + 1, nx)]
                let u_down  = u_old[mg_idx2d(i - 1, j, nx)]
                let u_up    = u_old[mg_idx2d(i + 1, j, nx)]

                let stencil = (u_left + u_right) / hx2 + (u_down + u_up) / hy2
                let avg = (stencil + f[idx]) / diag
                u[idx] = omega * avg + (1.0 - omega) * u_old[idx]

                j = j + 1
            }
            i = i + 1
        }
        sweep = sweep + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// 2D RESIDUAL (copied from multigrid.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mg_residual_2d(u: &[f64; 4096], f: &[f64; 4096],
                  nx: i32, ny: i32, hx: f64, hy: f64,
                  r: &![f64; 4096]) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let hx2 = hx * hx
    let hy2 = hy * hy

    var j = 0
    while j <= nx {
        r[mg_idx2d(0, j, nx)] = 0.0
        r[mg_idx2d(ny, j, nx)] = 0.0
        j = j + 1
    }
    var i = 0
    while i <= ny {
        r[mg_idx2d(i, 0, nx)] = 0.0
        r[mg_idx2d(i, nx, nx)] = 0.0
        i = i + 1
    }

    i = 1
    while i < ny {
        j = 1
        while j < nx {
            let idx = mg_idx2d(i, j, nx)
            let u_ij = u[idx]
            let lap_x = (u[mg_idx2d(i, j - 1, nx)] - 2.0 * u_ij + u[mg_idx2d(i, j + 1, nx)]) / hx2
            let lap_y = (u[mg_idx2d(i - 1, j, nx)] - 2.0 * u_ij + u[mg_idx2d(i + 1, j, nx)]) / hy2

            r[idx] = f[idx] + lap_x + lap_y
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
}

fn mg_residual_norm_2d(r: &[f64; 4096], nx: i32, ny: i32,
                       hx: f64, hy: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var sum = 0.0
    var i = 1
    while i < ny {
        var j = 1
        while j < nx {
            let val = r[mg_idx2d(i, j, nx)]
            sum = sum + val * val
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    mg_sqrt(hx * hy * sum)
}

// ============================================================================
// CONVERGENCE ANALYSIS (copied from multigrid.sio)
// ============================================================================

fn mg_convergence_factor(residuals: &[f64; 256], n: i32) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if n < 2 { return 0.0 }

    var sum_ratio = 0.0
    var count = 0
    var k = 0
    while k < n - 1 {
        if mg_abs(residuals[k]) > 1.0e-30 {
            let ratio = residuals[k + 1] / residuals[k]
            sum_ratio = sum_ratio + ratio
            count = count + 1
        }
        k = k + 1
    }

    if count == 0 { return 0.0 }
    sum_ratio / (count as f64)
}

// ============================================================================
// RHS function for Poisson test (must be defined before callers)
// ============================================================================

fn rhs_sin_pi(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let pi = 3.141592653589793
    pi * pi * sp_sin(pi * x)
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST 1: Restriction preserves constant (1D)
// A constant vector on a fine grid should restrict to the same constant
// on the coarse grid, since full-weighting stencil sums to 1.
// ============================================================================

fn test_restrict_preserves_constant() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_fine = 32
    let n_coarse = n_fine / 2
    let c = 7.5

    var fine: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var i = 0
    while i <= n_fine {
        fine[i] = c
        i = i + 1
    }

    var coarse: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_restrict_1d(&fine, n_fine, &!coarse)

    let tol = 1.0e-12
    var ok = true
    i = 0
    while i <= n_coarse {
        if mg_abs(coarse[i] - c) > tol { ok = false }
        i = i + 1
    }
    ok
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST 2: Prolongation preserves constant (1D)
// A constant on the coarse grid should prolongate to the same constant
// on the fine grid.
// ============================================================================

fn test_prolongate_preserves_constant() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_coarse = 16
    let n_fine = 2 * n_coarse
    let c = 3.25

    var coarse: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var i = 0
    while i <= n_coarse {
        coarse[i] = c
        i = i + 1
    }

    var fine: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_prolongate_1d(&coarse, n_coarse, &!fine)

    let tol = 1.0e-12
    var ok = true
    i = 0
    while i <= n_fine {
        if mg_abs(fine[i] - c) > tol { ok = false }
        i = i + 1
    }
    ok
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST 3: Restriction/prolongation adjoint relation
// <Ru, v>_c ≈ <u, Pv>_f  (up to a factor of 2 from the scaling convention)
// We check that the inner products are proportional.
// ============================================================================

fn test_adjoint_relation() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n_fine = 32
    let n_coarse = n_fine / 2

    // Create fine-grid vector u: u[i] = sin-like pattern
    var u_fine: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var i = 0
    while i <= n_fine {
        // Simple quadratic: i*(n_fine - i) / n_fine^2
        u_fine[i] = (i as f64) * ((n_fine - i) as f64) / ((n_fine * n_fine) as f64)
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Create coarse-grid vector v: v[j] = j*(n_coarse - j) / n_coarse^2
    var v_coarse: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var j = 0
    while j <= n_coarse {
        v_coarse[j] = (j as f64) * ((n_coarse - j) as f64) / ((n_coarse * n_coarse) as f64)
        j = j + 1
    }

    // Compute R*u (restrict u from fine to coarse)
    var Ru: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_restrict_1d(&u_fine, n_fine, &!Ru)

    // Compute P*v (prolongate v from coarse to fine)
    var Pv: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_prolongate_1d(&v_coarse, n_coarse, &!Pv)

    // <Ru, v>_coarse = sum Ru[j] * v[j]
    var ip_coarse = 0.0
    j = 0
    while j <= n_coarse {
        ip_coarse = ip_coarse + Ru[j] * v_coarse[j]
        j = j + 1
    }

    // <u, Pv>_fine = sum u[i] * Pv[i]
    var ip_fine = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i <= n_fine {
        ip_fine = ip_fine + u_fine[i] * Pv[i]
        i = i + 1
    }

    // For full-weighting restriction and linear prolongation:
    // R = (1/2) * P^T, so <Ru, v> = (1/2)<u, Pv>
    // Check that 2 * <Ru, v> ≈ <u, Pv>
    let ratio = ip_fine / ip_coarse
    // The ratio should be close to 2.0
    let tol = 0.1
    mg_abs(ratio - 2.0) < tol
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST 4: Jacobi smoother reduces residual (1D)
// After several Jacobi smoothing sweeps on an initial guess of zero
// with a nonzero RHS, the residual norm should decrease.
// ============================================================================

fn test_jacobi_reduces_residual() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 32
    let h = 1.0 / (n as f64)
    let omega = 2.0 / 3.0

    // Set up RHS: f[i] = 1.0 for interior points
    var f_vals: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var i = 1
    while i < n {
        f_vals[i] = 1.0
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Initial solution: zero
    var u: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]

    // Compute initial residual norm
    var r0: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_residual_1d(&u, &f_vals, n, h, &!r0)
    let norm0 = mg_residual_norm_1d(&r0, n)

    // Apply 10 Jacobi sweeps
    mg_smooth_jacobi_1d(&!u, &f_vals, n, h, omega, 10)

    // Compute new residual norm
    var r1: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_residual_1d(&u, &f_vals, n, h, &!r1)
    let norm1 = mg_residual_norm_1d(&r1, n)

    // Residual must have decreased
    norm1 < norm0
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST 5: Red-black GS reduces residual (1D)
// Same setup as Jacobi but should converge faster.
// ============================================================================

fn test_gs_rb_reduces_residual() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 32
    let h = 1.0 / (n as f64)

    var f_vals: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var i = 1
    while i < n {
        f_vals[i] = 1.0
        i = i + 1
    }

    var u: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]

    var r0: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_residual_1d(&u, &f_vals, n, h, &!r0)
    let norm0 = mg_residual_norm_1d(&r0, n)

    // Apply 10 GS-RB sweeps
    mg_smooth_gs_rb_1d(&!u, &f_vals, n, h, 10)

    var r1: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_residual_1d(&u, &f_vals, n, h, &!r1)
    let norm1 = mg_residual_norm_1d(&r1, n)

    // Residual must have decreased
    norm1 < norm0
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST 6: Thomas algorithm (coarse solve) exact
// Solve -u'' = 6x on [0,1] with u(0)=u(1)=0.
// Exact solution: u(x) = x - x^3 (since u''=-6x, u(0)=0, u(1)=0).
// ============================================================================

fn test_thomas_exact() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 16
    let h = 1.0 / (n as f64)

    // Set up RHS: f[i] = 6 * x_i
    var f_vals: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var i = 0
    while i <= n {
        let x = (i as f64) * h
        f_vals[i] = 6.0 * x
        i = i + 1
    }

    var u: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_coarse_solve_1d(&!u, &f_vals, n, h)

    // Check against exact solution u(x) = x - x^3
    let tol = 1.0e-10
    var max_err = 0.0
    i = 0
    while i <= n {
        let x = (i as f64) * h
        let exact = x - x * x * x
        let err = mg_abs(u[i] - exact)
        if err > max_err { max_err = err }
        i = i + 1
    }
    max_err < tol
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST 7: V-cycle convergence
// A single V-cycle should reduce the residual by a factor < 0.5.
// ============================================================================

fn test_vcycle_convergence() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 32
    let h = 1.0 / (n as f64)

    // RHS: f = 1 on interior
    var f_vals: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var i = 1
    while i < n {
        f_vals[i] = 1.0
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Initial guess: random-ish — use i*(n-i)/n^2 as initial "error"
    var u: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    i = 1
    while i < n {
        u[i] = (i as f64) * ((n - i) as f64) / ((n * n) as f64)
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Compute initial residual
    var r0: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_residual_1d(&u, &f_vals, n, h, &!r0)
    let norm0 = mg_residual_norm_1d(&r0, n)

    // Config: 4 levels for n=32 (32 -> 16 -> 8 -> 4)
    var config: MGConfig = MGConfig {
        n_levels: 4, nu1: 2, nu2: 2, max_cycles: 100,
        tol: 1.0e-10, omega: 2.0 / 3.0
    }

    // One V-cycle
    mg_vcycle_1d(&!u, &f_vals, n, h, &config, 0)

    // Compute new residual
    var r1: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_residual_1d(&u, &f_vals, n, h, &!r1)
    let norm1 = mg_residual_norm_1d(&r1, n)

    // Convergence factor should be < 0.5
    if norm0 < 1.0e-30 { return true }
    let factor = norm1 / norm0
    factor < 0.5
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST 8: Full 1D Poisson solver
// -u'' = pi^2 * sin(pi * x) on [0,1], u(0)=u(1)=0
// Exact solution: u(x) = sin(pi * x)
// With n=32, discretization error is O(h^2) ≈ 1e-3.
// ============================================================================

fn test_full_poisson_1d() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let n = 32
    let pi = 3.141592653589793

    // 5 levels for n=32: 32 -> 16 -> 8 -> 4 -> 2
    var config: MGConfig = MGConfig {
        n_levels: 5, nu1: 2, nu2: 2, max_cycles: 100,
        tol: 1.0e-10, omega: 2.0 / 3.0
    }

    var result: MGResult = MGResult {
        u: [0.0; 4096], iterations: 0, residual_norm: 0.0, converged: false
    }

    mg_solve_poisson_1d(rhs_sin_pi, n, &config, &!result)

    // Check pointwise error against sin(pi*x)
    let h = 1.0 / (n as f64)
    var max_err = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i <= n {
        let x = (i as f64) * h
        let exact = sp_sin(pi * x)
        let err = mg_abs(result.u[i] - exact)
        if err > max_err { max_err = err }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Discretization error is O(h^2) ≈ (1/32)^2 ≈ 1e-3
    let tol = 1.0e-3
    max_err < tol
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST 9: 2D restriction preserves constant
// A constant on a fine 2D grid should restrict to the same constant
// on the coarse grid.
// ============================================================================

fn test_restrict_2d_preserves_constant() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nx_f = 8
    let ny_f = 8
    let nx_c = nx_f / 2
    let ny_c = ny_f / 2
    let c = 4.0

    var fine: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var i = 0
    while i <= ny_f {
        var j = 0
        while j <= nx_f {
            fine[mg_idx2d(i, j, nx_f)] = c
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    var coarse: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_restrict_2d(&fine, nx_f, ny_f, &!coarse)

    let tol = 1.0e-12
    var ok = true
    i = 0
    while i <= ny_c {
        var j = 0
        while j <= nx_c {
            if mg_abs(coarse[mg_idx2d(i, j, nx_c)] - c) > tol { ok = false }
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    ok
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST 10: 2D Jacobi smoother reduces residual
// After several 2D Jacobi sweeps, the residual should decrease.
// ============================================================================

fn test_jacobi_2d_reduces_residual() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let nx = 8
    let ny = 8
    let hx = 1.0 / (nx as f64)
    let hy = 1.0 / (ny as f64)
    let omega = 2.0 / 3.0

    // Set up RHS: f = 1.0 on interior
    var f_vals: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    var i = 1
    while i < ny {
        var j = 1
        while j < nx {
            f_vals[mg_idx2d(i, j, nx)] = 1.0
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Initial solution: zero
    var u: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]

    // Compute initial residual norm
    var r0: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_residual_2d(&u, &f_vals, nx, ny, hx, hy, &!r0)
    let norm0 = mg_residual_norm_2d(&r0, nx, ny, hx, hy)

    // Apply 10 Jacobi sweeps
    mg_smooth_jacobi_2d(&!u, &f_vals, nx, ny, hx, hy, omega, 10)

    // Compute new residual norm
    var r1: [f64; 4096] = [0.0; 4096]
    mg_residual_2d(&u, &f_vals, nx, ny, hx, hy, &!r1)
    let norm1 = mg_residual_norm_2d(&r1, nx, ny, hx, hy)

    norm1 < norm0
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST 11: Convergence factor in (0, 1)
// Given a decreasing sequence of residuals, mg_convergence_factor should
// return a value strictly between 0 and 1.
// ============================================================================

fn test_convergence_factor() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Simulate a geometric decrease: r[k] = 10.0 * 0.3^k
    var residuals: [f64; 256] = [0.0; 256]
    residuals[0] = 10.0
    residuals[1] = 3.0
    residuals[2] = 0.9
    residuals[3] = 0.27
    residuals[4] = 0.081

    let factor = mg_convergence_factor(&residuals, 5)

    // Factor should be approximately 0.3
    // It must be in (0, 1)
    let ok_pos = factor > 0.0
    let ok_lt1 = factor < 1.0
    // Check it's close to 0.3
    let ok_val = mg_abs(factor - 0.3) < 0.05

    if ok_pos {
        if ok_lt1 {
            if ok_val { return true }
        }
    }
    false
}

// ============================================================================
// TEST 12: Default config values
// mg_default_config should set nu1=2, nu2=2, max_cycles=100, tol=1e-10.
// ============================================================================

fn test_default_config() -> bool with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var config: MGConfig = MGConfig {
        n_levels: 0, nu1: 0, nu2: 0, max_cycles: 0,
        tol: 0.0, omega: 0.0
    }

    mg_default_config(4, &!config)

    let ok_levels = config.n_levels == 4
    let ok_nu1 = config.nu1 == 2
    let ok_nu2 = config.nu2 == 2
    let ok_max = config.max_cycles == 100
    let ok_tol = mg_abs(config.tol - 1.0e-10) < 1.0e-15
    let ok_omega = mg_abs(config.omega - 2.0 / 3.0) < 1.0e-12

    if ok_levels {
        if ok_nu1 {
            if ok_nu2 {
                if ok_max {
                    if ok_tol {
                        if ok_omega { return true }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    false
}

    var pass = 0

    // Test 7
    print("Test  7: V-cycle convergence factor < 0.5 ..... ")

    // Test 8

    // Test 10

    else { println("FAIL"); fail = fail + 1 }

        return 1
    }

// test_scientific_computing.sio - Integration tests for scientific computing features
