// === FILE: examples/graphics/lib/50_phase_diagram.sio ===
// 50_phase_diagram.sio - Phase diagram visualization for scientific computing
//
// Phase diagrams show regions of different system states based on two
// control parameters (e.g., temperature vs pressure, composition vs temperature).
// Essential for materials science, thermodynamics, and dynamical systems.
//
// Features:
// - Multiple phase regions with distinct colors
// - Phase boundaries (coexistence curves)
// - Critical points and triple points
// - Tie lines for two-phase regions
// - Labeled axes with scientific units

// ============================================================================
// Phase Region Types
// ============================================================================

struct PhaseRegion {
    id: i32,              // Region identifier
    color: i32,           // ANSI color code
    marker: i32,          // Character code for filling
    name_code: i32        // First character of phase name (S=83, L=76, G=71, etc.)
}

struct PhaseBoundary {
    phase1: i32,          // ID of first phase
    phase2: i32,          // ID of second phase
    // Boundary is defined by points
    x_points: [f64; 100],
    y_points: [f64; 100],
    num_points: i32
}

struct CriticalPoint {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    marker: i32           // Character to display
}

struct TriplePoint {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    marker: i32
}

struct PhaseDiagram {
    // Viewport bounds
    x_min: f64,
    x_max: f64,
    y_min: f64,
    y_max: f64,

    // Grid dimensions for rendering
    width: i32,
    height: i32,

    // Phase regions (up to 8)
    regions: [PhaseRegion; 8],
    num_regions: i32,

    // Boundaries (up to 16)
    boundaries: [PhaseBoundary; 16],
    num_boundaries: i32,

    // Special points
    critical_points: [CriticalPoint; 4],
    num_critical: i32,
    triple_points: [TriplePoint; 4],
    num_triple: i32,

    // Phase field (stores which phase each grid cell belongs to)
    phase_field: [i32; 4096],  // Up to 64x64 grid

    // Axis labels (as character codes)
    x_label: i32,  // First char of x-axis label
    y_label: i32   // First char of y-axis label
}

// ============================================================================
// Initialization
// ============================================================================

fn phase_diagram_new(
    x_min: f64, x_max: f64,
    y_min: f64, y_max: f64,
    width: i32, height: i32
) -> PhaseDiagram {
    let empty_region = PhaseRegion {
        id: 0,
        color: 0,
        marker: 32,  // Space
        name_code: 32
    }

    let empty_boundary = PhaseBoundary {
        phase1: 0,
        phase2: 0,
        x_points: [0.0; 100],
        y_points: [0.0; 100],
        num_points: 0
    }

    let empty_critical = CriticalPoint {
        x: 0.0,
        y: 0.0,
        marker: 67  // 'C'
    }

    let empty_triple = TriplePoint {
        x: 0.0,
        y: 0.0,
        marker: 84  // 'T'
    }

    return PhaseDiagram {
        x_min: x_min,
        x_max: x_max,
        y_min: y_min,
        y_max: y_max,
        width: width,
        height: height,
        regions: [empty_region; 8],
        num_regions: 0,
        boundaries: [empty_boundary; 16],
        num_boundaries: 0,
        critical_points: [empty_critical; 4],
        num_critical: 0,
        triple_points: [empty_triple; 4],
        num_triple: 0,
        phase_field: [0; 4096],
        x_label: 84,  // 'T' for temperature
        y_label: 80   // 'P' for pressure
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Phase Region Management
// ============================================================================

fn phase_diagram_add_region(
    diagram: &!PhaseDiagram,
    id: i32,
    color: i32,
    marker: i32,
    name_code: i32
) with Mut {
    if diagram.num_regions < 8 {
        let idx = diagram.num_regions
        diagram.regions[idx] = PhaseRegion {
            id: id,
            color: color,
            marker: marker,
            name_code: name_code
        }
        diagram.num_regions = diagram.num_regions + 1
    }
}

// Standard phases for materials
fn phase_diagram_add_solid(diagram: &!PhaseDiagram) with Mut {
    phase_diagram_add_region(diagram, 1, 34, 35, 83)  // Blue, '#', 'S'
}

fn phase_diagram_add_liquid(diagram: &!PhaseDiagram) with Mut {
    phase_diagram_add_region(diagram, 2, 36, 126, 76)  // Cyan, '~', 'L'
}

fn phase_diagram_add_gas(diagram: &!PhaseDiagram) with Mut {
    phase_diagram_add_region(diagram, 3, 33, 46, 71)  // Yellow, '.', 'G'
}

fn phase_diagram_add_supercritical(diagram: &!PhaseDiagram) with Mut {
    phase_diagram_add_region(diagram, 4, 35, 42, 88)  // Magenta, '*', 'X'
}

// ============================================================================
// Phase Field Computation
// ============================================================================

// Set phase for a grid cell
fn phase_field_set(diagram: &!PhaseDiagram, x: i32, y: i32, phase: i32) with Mut {
    if x >= 0 {
        if x < diagram.width {
            if y >= 0 {
                if y < diagram.height {
                    let idx = y * diagram.width + x
                    if idx < 4096 {
                        diagram.phase_field[idx] = phase
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Get phase for a grid cell
fn phase_field_get(diagram: &PhaseDiagram, x: i32, y: i32) -> i32 {
    if x >= 0 {
        if x < diagram.width {
            if y >= 0 {
                if y < diagram.height {
                    let idx = y * diagram.width + x
                    if idx < 4096 {
                        return diagram.phase_field[idx]
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 0
}

// Convert grid coordinates to data coordinates
fn grid_to_data_x(diagram: &PhaseDiagram, gx: i32) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    let t = (gx as f64) / ((diagram.width - 1) as f64)
    return diagram.x_min + t * (diagram.x_max - diagram.x_min)
}

fn grid_to_data_y(diagram: &PhaseDiagram, gy: i32) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    let t = (gy as f64) / ((diagram.height - 1) as f64)
    return diagram.y_min + t * (diagram.y_max - diagram.y_min)
}

// Fill phase field using a classifier function
// classifier: given (x, y) returns phase id
fn phase_diagram_compute_field(
    diagram: &!PhaseDiagram,
    classifier: fn(f64, f64) -> i32
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var y = 0
    while y < diagram.height {
        var x = 0
        while x < diagram.width {
            let data_x = grid_to_data_x(diagram, x)
            let data_y = grid_to_data_y(diagram, y)
            let phase = classifier(data_x, data_y)
            phase_field_set(diagram, x, y, phase)
            x = x + 1
        }
        y = y + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Special Points
// ============================================================================

fn phase_diagram_add_critical_point(
    diagram: &!PhaseDiagram,
    x: f64,
    y: f64
) with Mut {
    if diagram.num_critical < 4 {
        let idx = diagram.num_critical
        diagram.critical_points[idx] = CriticalPoint {
            x: x,
            y: y,
            marker: 67  // 'C'
        }
        diagram.num_critical = diagram.num_critical + 1
    }
}

fn phase_diagram_add_triple_point(
    diagram: &!PhaseDiagram,
    x: f64,
    y: f64
) with Mut {
    if diagram.num_triple < 4 {
        let idx = diagram.num_triple
        diagram.triple_points[idx] = TriplePoint {
            x: x,
            y: y,
            marker: 84  // 'T'
        }
        diagram.num_triple = diagram.num_triple + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Rendering Helpers
// ============================================================================

fn print_char_code(code: i32) with IO {
    if code == 32 { print(" ") }
    else { if code == 35 { print("#") }
    else { if code == 42 { print("*") }
    else { if code == 46 { print(".") }
    else { if code == 67 { print("C") }
    else { if code == 71 { print("G") }
    else { if code == 76 { print("L") }
    else { if code == 80 { print("P") }
    else { if code == 83 { print("S") }
    else { if code == 84 { print("T") }
    else { if code == 88 { print("X") }
    else { if code == 124 { print("|") }
    else { if code == 126 { print("~") }
    else { print("?") }
    }}}}}}}}}}}}}
}

fn get_region_by_id(diagram: &PhaseDiagram, id: i32) -> PhaseRegion {
    var i = 0
    while i < diagram.num_regions {
        if diagram.regions[i].id == id {
            return diagram.regions[i]
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    // Return default
    return PhaseRegion {
        id: 0,
        color: 37,  // White
        marker: 32,
        name_code: 32
    }
}

// Check if a cell is on a phase boundary
fn is_boundary_cell(diagram: &PhaseDiagram, x: i32, y: i32) -> i32 {
    let phase = phase_field_get(diagram, x, y)

    // Check neighbors
    if x > 0 {
        if phase_field_get(diagram, x - 1, y) != phase {
            return 1
        }
    }
    if x < diagram.width - 1 {
        if phase_field_get(diagram, x + 1, y) != phase {
            return 1
        }
    }
    if y > 0 {
        if phase_field_get(diagram, x, y - 1) != phase {
            return 1
        }
    }
    if y < diagram.height - 1 {
        if phase_field_get(diagram, x, y + 1) != phase {
            return 1
        }
    }

    return 0
}

// ============================================================================
// Main Rendering
// ============================================================================

fn phase_diagram_render(diagram: &PhaseDiagram) with IO, Div, Panic {
    // Clear screen and position cursor
    print("\x1b[2J\x1b[H")

    // Title
    print("\x1b[1m=== Phase Diagram ===\x1b[0m\n\n")

    // Y-axis label
    print("  ")
    print_char_code(diagram.y_label)
    print("\n")
    print("  ^\n")

    // Render from top to bottom (high y first)
    var y = diagram.height - 1
    while y >= 0 {
        // Y-axis
        print("  |")

        var x = 0
        while x < diagram.width {
            let phase = phase_field_get(diagram, x, y)
            let region = get_region_by_id(diagram, phase)

            // Check for special points
            let data_x = grid_to_data_x(diagram, x)
            let data_y = grid_to_data_y(diagram, y)
            var is_special = 0
            var special_marker = 0

            // Check critical points
            var ci = 0
            while ci < diagram.num_critical {
                let cp = diagram.critical_points[ci]
                let dx = data_x - cp.x
                let dy = data_y - cp.y
                if dx < 0.0 { let dx = 0.0 - dx }
                if dy < 0.0 { let dy = 0.0 - dy }
                let range_x = (diagram.x_max - diagram.x_min) / (diagram.width as f64)
                let range_y = (diagram.y_max - diagram.y_min) / (diagram.height as f64)
                if dx < range_x {
                    if dy < range_y {
                        is_special = 1
                        special_marker = cp.marker
                    }
                }
                ci = ci + 1
            }

            // Check triple points
            var ti = 0
            while ti < diagram.num_triple {
                let tp = diagram.triple_points[ti]
                let dx = data_x - tp.x
                let dy = data_y - tp.y
                if dx < 0.0 { let dx = 0.0 - dx }
                if dy < 0.0 { let dy = 0.0 - dy }
                let range_x = (diagram.x_max - diagram.x_min) / (diagram.width as f64)
                let range_y = (diagram.y_max - diagram.y_min) / (diagram.height as f64)
                if dx < range_x {
                    if dy < range_y {
                        is_special = 1
                        special_marker = tp.marker
                    }
                }
                ti = ti + 1
            }

            // Render cell
            if is_special == 1 {
                print("\x1b[1;31m")  // Bold red for special points
                print_char_code(special_marker)
                print("\x1b[0m")
            } else { if is_boundary_cell(diagram, x, y) == 1 {
                print("\x1b[1;37m")  // Bold white for boundaries
                print("|")
                print("\x1b[0m")
            } else {
                // Normal phase cell
                print("\x1b[")
                print_i32(region.color)
                print("m")
                print_char_code(region.marker)
                print("\x1b[0m")
            }}

            x = x + 1
        }

        print("\n")
        y = y - 1
    }

    // X-axis
    print("  +")
    var xi = 0
    while xi < diagram.width {
        print("-")
        xi = xi + 1
    }
    print("> ")
    print_char_code(diagram.x_label)
    print("\n\n")

    // Legend
    print("Legend: ")
    var ri = 0
    while ri < diagram.num_regions {
        let region = diagram.regions[ri]
        print("\x1b[")
        print_i32(region.color)
        print("m")
        print_char_code(region.marker)
        print("\x1b[0m=")
        print_char_code(region.name_code)
        print(" ")
        ri = ri + 1
    }

    if diagram.num_critical > 0 {
        print(" \x1b[1;31mC\x1b[0m=Critical")
    }
    if diagram.num_triple > 0 {
        print(" \x1b[1;31mT\x1b[0m=Triple")
    }
    print("\n")
}

// ============================================================================
// Helper: Print integer
// ============================================================================

fn print_i32(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x == 0 {
        print("0")
        return
    }

    if x < 0 {
        print("-")
        print_i32_unsigned(0 - x)
    } else {
        print_i32_unsigned(x)
    }
}

fn print_i32_unsigned(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x == 0 {
        return
    }

    let digit = x % 10
    let rest = x / 10

    if rest > 0 {
        print_i32_unsigned(rest)
    }

    print_digit(digit)
}

fn print_digit(d: i32) with IO {
    if d == 0 { print("0") }
    else { if d == 1 { print("1") }
    else { if d == 2 { print("2") }
    else { if d == 3 { print("3") }
    else { if d == 4 { print("4") }
    else { if d == 5 { print("5") }
    else { if d == 6 { print("6") }
    else { if d == 7 { print("7") }
    else { if d == 8 { print("8") }
    else { if d == 9 { print("9") }
    }}}}}}}}}}
}

// ============================================================================
// Example: Water Phase Diagram Classifier
// ============================================================================

// Simple water phase classifier (T in Kelvin, P in kPa)
fn water_phase_classifier(t: f64, p: f64) -> i32 {
    // Very simplified model
    // Triple point: ~273.16 K, 0.611 kPa
    // Critical point: ~647 K, 22064 kPa

    // Below triple point pressure: sublimation
    if p < 0.611 {
        if t < 273.16 {
            return 1  // Solid (ice)
        } else {
            return 3  // Gas (vapor)
        }
    }

    // Above critical point: supercritical
    if t > 647.0 {
        if p > 22064.0 {
            return 4  // Supercritical
        }
    }

    // Melting curve (solid-liquid boundary)
    // Simplified: nearly vertical at 273 K
    if t < 273.15 {
        return 1  // Solid
    }

    // Vapor pressure curve (liquid-gas boundary)
    // Clausius-Clapeyron approximation
    // ln(P/P0) = -L/R * (1/T - 1/T0)
    // Simplified exponential fit
    let vapor_pressure = 0.611 * exp_approx((t - 273.15) * 0.05)

    if p < vapor_pressure {
        return 3  // Gas
    } else {
        return 2  // Liquid
    }
}

// Simple exponential approximation
fn exp_approx(x: f64) -> f64 {
    // Taylor series: 1 + x + x^2/2 + x^3/6 + x^4/24
    if x > 10.0 {
        return 22000.0  // Cap for large values
    }
    if x < -10.0 {
        return 0.00001
    }

    let x2 = x * x
    let x3 = x2 * x
    let x4 = x3 * x

    return 1.0 + x + x2 * 0.5 + x3 * 0.1667 + x4 * 0.0417
}

// ============================================================================
// Main Demo
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Create a water phase diagram
    // T: 200-700 K, P: 0.1-25000 kPa (log scale would be better but simplified here)
    var diagram = phase_diagram_new(200.0, 700.0, 0.0, 25000.0, 50, 25)

    // Add phases
    phase_diagram_add_solid(&!diagram)
    phase_diagram_add_liquid(&!diagram)
    phase_diagram_add_gas(&!diagram)
    phase_diagram_add_supercritical(&!diagram)

    // Add special points
    phase_diagram_add_triple_point(&!diagram, 273.16, 0.611)
    phase_diagram_add_critical_point(&!diagram, 647.0, 22064.0)

    // Compute phase field
    phase_diagram_compute_field(&!diagram, water_phase_classifier)

    // Render
    phase_diagram_render(&diagram)

    return 0
}


// === FILE: examples/graphics/lib/51_bifurcation.sio ===
// 51_bifurcation.sio - Bifurcation diagram visualization
//
// Bifurcation diagrams show how the long-term behavior of a dynamical system
// changes as a control parameter is varied. Key for understanding:
// - Period-doubling cascades
// - Routes to chaos
// - Stability analysis
// - Attractors and their basins
//
// Classic example: Logistic map x_{n+1} = r * x_n * (1 - x_n)

// ============================================================================
// Bifurcation Diagram Structure
// ============================================================================

struct BifurcationDiagram {
    // Parameter range (horizontal axis)
    param_min: f64,
    param_max: f64,

    // State variable range (vertical axis)
    state_min: f64,
    state_max: f64,

    // Grid dimensions
    width: i32,
    height: i32,

    // Density field (counts hits per pixel)
    // Higher values = more frequently visited states
    density: [i32; 8192],  // Up to 128x64

    // Iteration parameters
    transient_iters: i32,   // Iterations to skip (reach attractor)
    sample_iters: i32,      // Iterations to plot

    // Maximum density for normalization
    max_density: i32
}

// ============================================================================
// Initialization
// ============================================================================

fn bifurcation_new(
    param_min: f64, param_max: f64,
    state_min: f64, state_max: f64,
    width: i32, height: i32
) -> BifurcationDiagram {
    return BifurcationDiagram {
        param_min: param_min,
        param_max: param_max,
        state_min: state_min,
        state_max: state_max,
        width: width,
        height: height,
        density: [0; 8192],
        transient_iters: 200,
        sample_iters: 100,
        max_density: 1
    }
}

fn bifurcation_set_iterations(
    diagram: &!BifurcationDiagram,
    transient: i32,
    sample: i32
) with Mut {
    diagram.transient_iters = transient
    diagram.sample_iters = sample
}

// ============================================================================
// Density Field Operations
// ============================================================================

fn density_index(diagram: &BifurcationDiagram, x: i32, y: i32) -> i32 {
    return y * diagram.width + x
}

fn density_get(diagram: &BifurcationDiagram, x: i32, y: i32) -> i32 {
    if x >= 0 {
        if x < diagram.width {
            if y >= 0 {
                if y < diagram.height {
                    let idx = density_index(diagram, x, y)
                    if idx < 8192 {
                        return diagram.density[idx]
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 0
}

fn density_increment(diagram: &!BifurcationDiagram, x: i32, y: i32) with Mut {
    if x >= 0 {
        if x < diagram.width {
            if y >= 0 {
                if y < diagram.height {
                    let idx = density_index(diagram, x, y)
                    if idx < 8192 {
                        diagram.density[idx] = diagram.density[idx] + 1
                        if diagram.density[idx] > diagram.max_density {
                            diagram.max_density = diagram.density[idx]
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn density_clear(diagram: &!BifurcationDiagram) with Mut {
    var i = 0
    while i < 8192 {
        diagram.density[i] = 0
        i = i + 1
    }
    diagram.max_density = 1
}

// ============================================================================
// Coordinate Conversion
// ============================================================================

fn param_to_grid(diagram: &BifurcationDiagram, param: f64) -> i32 with Div, Panic {
    let range = diagram.param_max - diagram.param_min
    if range <= 0.0 {
        return 0
    }
    let t = (param - diagram.param_min) / range
    let x = (t * ((diagram.width - 1) as f64)) as i32
    return x
}

fn state_to_grid(diagram: &BifurcationDiagram, state: f64) -> i32 with Div, Panic {
    let range = diagram.state_max - diagram.state_min
    if range <= 0.0 {
        return 0
    }
    let t = (state - diagram.state_min) / range
    let y = (t * ((diagram.height - 1) as f64)) as i32
    return y
}

fn grid_to_param(diagram: &BifurcationDiagram, x: i32) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    let t = (x as f64) / ((diagram.width - 1) as f64)
    return diagram.param_min + t * (diagram.param_max - diagram.param_min)
}

// ============================================================================
// Map Functions
// ============================================================================

// Logistic map: x_{n+1} = r * x_n * (1 - x_n)
fn logistic_map(x: f64, r: f64) -> f64 {
    return r * x * (1.0 - x)
}

// Sine map: x_{n+1} = r * sin(pi * x)
fn sine_map(x: f64, r: f64) -> f64 {
    // Approximate sin(pi * x) using Taylor series
    let pi_x = 3.14159265 * x
    return r * sin_approx(pi_x)
}

// Tent map: x_{n+1} = r * min(x, 1-x)
fn tent_map(x: f64, r: f64) -> f64 {
    if x < 0.5 {
        return r * x * 2.0
    } else {
        return r * (1.0 - x) * 2.0
    }
}

// Cubic map: x_{n+1} = r * x - x^3
fn cubic_map(x: f64, r: f64) -> f64 {
    return r * x - x * x * x
}

// Helper: sin approximation
fn sin_approx(x: f64) -> f64 {
    // Reduce to [0, 2*pi]
    var xx = x
    while xx > 6.28318 {
        xx = xx - 6.28318
    }
    while xx < 0.0 {
        xx = xx + 6.28318
    }

    // Taylor series around 0
    let x2 = xx * xx
    let x3 = x2 * xx
    let x5 = x3 * x2
    let x7 = x5 * x2

    return xx - x3 * 0.16667 + x5 * 0.00833 - x7 * 0.0001984
}

// ============================================================================
// Bifurcation Computation
// ============================================================================

// Compute bifurcation diagram for a generic 1D map
fn bifurcation_compute(
    diagram: &!BifurcationDiagram,
    map_fn: fn(f64, f64) -> f64,
    initial_state: f64
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    density_clear(diagram)

    // For each parameter value (column)
    var px = 0
    while px < diagram.width {
        let param = grid_to_param(diagram, px)

        // Start from initial condition
        var state = initial_state

        // Skip transient
        var t = 0
        while t < diagram.transient_iters {
            state = map_fn(state, param)

            // Bound check
            if state < -1000.0 {
                state = 0.5
            }
            if state > 1000.0 {
                state = 0.5
            }

            t = t + 1
        }

        // Sample the attractor
        var s = 0
        while s < diagram.sample_iters {
            state = map_fn(state, param)

            // Bound check
            if state < -1000.0 {
                state = 0.5
            }
            if state > 1000.0 {
                state = 0.5
            }

            // Map to grid and increment
            let gy = state_to_grid(diagram, state)
            density_increment(diagram, px, gy)

            s = s + 1
        }

        px = px + 1
    }
}

// Convenience function for logistic map
fn bifurcation_compute_logistic(diagram: &!BifurcationDiagram) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    bifurcation_compute(diagram, logistic_map, 0.5)
}

// ============================================================================
// Rendering
// ============================================================================

fn density_to_char(density: i32, max_density: i32) -> i32 with Div, Panic {
    if density == 0 {
        return 32  // Space
    }

    // Normalize to 0-7 scale
    let ratio = (density * 8) / (max_density + 1)

    if ratio == 0 { return 46 }       // '.'
    else { if ratio == 1 { return 58 }  // ':'
    else { if ratio == 2 { return 43 }  // '+'
    else { if ratio == 3 { return 42 }  // '*'
    else { if ratio == 4 { return 35 }  // '#'
    else { if ratio == 5 { return 37 }  // '%'
    else { if ratio == 6 { return 64 }  // '@'
    else { return 64 }  // '@'
    }}}}}}}
}

fn density_to_color(density: i32, max_density: i32) -> i32 with Div, Panic {
    if density == 0 {
        return 30  // Black
    }

    let ratio = (density * 6) / (max_density + 1)

    if ratio == 0 { return 34 }       // Blue
    else { if ratio == 1 { return 36 }  // Cyan
    else { if ratio == 2 { return 32 }  // Green
    else { if ratio == 3 { return 33 }  // Yellow
    else { if ratio == 4 { return 31 }  // Red
    else { return 35 }  // Magenta
    }}}}}
}

fn bifurcation_render(diagram: &BifurcationDiagram) with IO, Div, Panic {
    print("\x1b[2J\x1b[H")

    print("\x1b[1m=== Bifurcation Diagram ===\x1b[0m\n\n")

    // State axis label
    print("  x\n")
    print("  ^\n")

    // Render from top to bottom
    var y = diagram.height - 1
    while y >= 0 {
        print("  |")

        var x = 0
        while x < diagram.width {
            let d = density_get(diagram, x, y)
            let ch = density_to_char(d, diagram.max_density)
            let color = density_to_color(d, diagram.max_density)

            print("\x1b[")
            print_i32(color)
            print("m")
            print_char_code(ch)
            print("\x1b[0m")

            x = x + 1
        }

        print("\n")
        y = y - 1
    }

    // X-axis
    print("  +")
    var xi = 0
    while xi < diagram.width {
        print("-")
        xi = xi + 1
    }
    print("> r\n\n")

    // Parameter range
    print("  r: ")
    print_f64(diagram.param_min)
    print(" to ")
    print_f64(diagram.param_max)
    print("\n")

    // State range
    print("  x: ")
    print_f64(diagram.state_min)
    print(" to ")
    print_f64(diagram.state_max)
    print("\n")
}

// ============================================================================
// Helper Functions

fn print_char_code(code: i32) with IO {
    if code == 32 { print(" ") }
    else { if code == 35 { print("#") }
    else { if code == 37 { print("%") }
    else { if code == 42 { print("*") }
    else { if code == 43 { print("+") }
    else { if code == 46 { print(".") }
    else { if code == 58 { print(":") }
    else { if code == 64 { print("@") }
    else { print("?") }
    }}}}}}}}
}

fn print_i32(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x == 0 {
        print("0")
        return
    }
    if x < 0 {
        print("-")
        print_i32_unsigned(0 - x)
    } else {
        print_i32_unsigned(x)
    }
}

fn print_i32_unsigned(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x == 0 { return }
    let digit = x % 10
    let rest = x / 10
    if rest > 0 {
        print_i32_unsigned(rest)
    }
    print_digit(digit)
}

fn print_digit(d: i32) with IO {
    if d == 0 { print("0") }
    else { if d == 1 { print("1") }
    else { if d == 2 { print("2") }
    else { if d == 3 { print("3") }
    else { if d == 4 { print("4") }
    else { if d == 5 { print("5") }
    else { if d == 6 { print("6") }
    else { if d == 7 { print("7") }
    else { if d == 8 { print("8") }
    else { if d == 9 { print("9") }
    }}}}}}}}}}
}

fn print_f64(x: f64) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x < 0.0 {
        print("-")
        let x = 0.0 - x
    }

    let int_part = x as i32
    print_i32(int_part)
    print(".")

    let frac = x - (int_part as f64)
    let frac_scaled = (frac * 100.0) as i32
    if frac_scaled < 10 {
        print("0")
    }
    print_i32_unsigned(frac_scaled)
}

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Create bifurcation diagram for logistic map
    // r ranges from 2.5 to 4.0 (period-doubling region)
    // x ranges from 0 to 1
    var diagram = bifurcation_new(2.5, 4.0, 0.0, 1.0, 80, 30)

    // Set iteration parameters
    bifurcation_set_iterations(&!diagram, 500, 200)

    // Compute the diagram
    print("Computing bifurcation diagram...\n")
    bifurcation_compute_logistic(&!diagram)

    // Render
    bifurcation_render(&diagram)

    print("\nLogistic map: x_{n+1} = r * x_n * (1 - x_n)\n")
    print("Shows period-doubling route to chaos as r increases\n")

    return 0
}


// === FILE: examples/graphics/lib/52_poincare.sio ===
// 52_poincare.sio - Poincaré section visualization
//
// A Poincaré section reduces a continuous-time dynamical system to a discrete
// map by recording where trajectories cross a chosen surface (section).
// Essential for analyzing:
// - Periodic orbits (appear as fixed points)
// - Quasiperiodic motion (appears as curves)
// - Chaos (appears as scattered points with structure)
//
// This module supports 3D systems with a z=const section plane.

// ============================================================================
// Poincaré Section Structure
// ============================================================================

struct PoincareSection {
    // Section plane: z = section_z (crossing from below)
    section_z: f64,
    crossing_direction: i32,  // 1 = upward, -1 = downward, 0 = both

    // View bounds (x, y coordinates on the section)
    x_min: f64,
    x_max: f64,
    y_min: f64,
    y_max: f64,

    // Display grid
    width: i32,
    height: i32,

    // Points storage (up to 2000 crossing points)
    points_x: [f64; 2000],
    points_y: [f64; 2000],
    num_points: i32,

    // Density grid for visualization
    density: [i32; 4096],
    max_density: i32,

    // Integration parameters
    dt: f64,
    max_time: f64
}

// ============================================================================
// State Vector for 3D Systems
// ============================================================================

struct State3D {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
    z: f64
}

fn state3d_new(x: f64, y: f64, z: f64) -> State3D {
    return State3D { x: x, y: y, z: z }
}

// ============================================================================
// Initialization
// ============================================================================

fn poincare_new(
    section_z: f64,
    x_min: f64, x_max: f64,
    y_min: f64, y_max: f64,
    width: i32, height: i32
) -> PoincareSection {
    return PoincareSection {
        section_z: section_z,
        crossing_direction: 1,  // Default: upward crossings
        x_min: x_min,
        x_max: x_max,
        y_min: y_min,
        y_max: y_max,
        width: width,
        height: height,
        points_x: [0.0; 2000],
        points_y: [0.0; 2000],
        num_points: 0,
        density: [0; 4096],
        max_density: 1,
        dt: 0.01,
        max_time: 1000.0
    }
}

fn poincare_set_integration(
    section: &!PoincareSection,
    dt: f64,
    max_time: f64
) with Mut {
    section.dt = dt
    section.max_time = max_time
}

fn poincare_set_direction(section: &!PoincareSection, direction: i32) with Mut {
    section.crossing_direction = direction
}

fn poincare_clear(section: &!PoincareSection) with Mut {
    section.num_points = 0
    var i = 0
    while i < 4096 {
        section.density[i] = 0
        i = i + 1
    }
    section.max_density = 1
}

// ============================================================================
// Coordinate Mapping
// ============================================================================

fn x_to_grid(section: &PoincareSection, x: f64) -> i32 with Div, Panic {
    let range = section.x_max - section.x_min
    if range <= 0.0 { return 0 }
    let t = (x - section.x_min) / range
    return (t * ((section.width - 1) as f64)) as i32
}

fn y_to_grid(section: &PoincareSection, y: f64) -> i32 with Div, Panic {
    let range = section.y_max - section.y_min
    if range <= 0.0 { return 0 }
    let t = (y - section.y_min) / range
    return (t * ((section.height - 1) as f64)) as i32
}

// ============================================================================
// Point Recording
// ============================================================================

fn record_crossing(
    section: &!PoincareSection,
    x: f64,
    y: f64
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Store point
    if section.num_points < 2000 {
        section.points_x[section.num_points] = x
        section.points_y[section.num_points] = y
        section.num_points = section.num_points + 1
    }

    // Update density grid
    let gx = x_to_grid(section, x)
    let gy = y_to_grid(section, y)

    if gx >= 0 {
        if gx < section.width {
            if gy >= 0 {
                if gy < section.height {
                    let idx = gy * section.width + gx
                    if idx < 4096 {
                        section.density[idx] = section.density[idx] + 1
                        if section.density[idx] > section.max_density {
                            section.max_density = section.density[idx]
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// ODE Integration (RK4)
// ============================================================================

fn rk4_step(
    state: State3D,
    dt: f64,
    deriv_fn: fn(State3D) -> State3D
) -> State3D {
    let k1 = deriv_fn(state)

    let s2 = State3D {
        x: state.x + k1.x * dt * 0.5,
        y: state.y + k1.y * dt * 0.5,
        z: state.z + k1.z * dt * 0.5
    }
    let k2 = deriv_fn(s2)

    let s3 = State3D {
        x: state.x + k2.x * dt * 0.5,
        y: state.y + k2.y * dt * 0.5,
        z: state.z + k2.z * dt * 0.5
    }
    let k3 = deriv_fn(s3)

    let s4 = State3D {
        x: state.x + k3.x * dt,
        y: state.y + k3.y * dt,
        z: state.z + k3.z * dt
    }
    let k4 = deriv_fn(s4)

    return State3D {
        x: state.x + (k1.x + 2.0 * k2.x + 2.0 * k3.x + k4.x) * dt / 6.0,
        y: state.y + (k1.y + 2.0 * k2.y + 2.0 * k3.y + k4.y) * dt / 6.0,
        z: state.z + (k1.z + 2.0 * k2.z + 2.0 * k3.z + k4.z) * dt / 6.0
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Section Computation
// ============================================================================

fn poincare_compute(
    section: &!PoincareSection,
    initial: State3D,
    deriv_fn: fn(State3D) -> State3D
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var state = initial
    var prev_state = state
    var t = 0.0
    let dt = section.dt
    let max_t = section.max_time

    // Skip initial transient (first 10% of time)
    let transient_time = max_t * 0.1
    while t < transient_time {
        prev_state = state
        state = rk4_step(state, dt, deriv_fn)
        t = t + dt
    }

    // Record crossings
    while t < max_t {
        prev_state = state
        state = rk4_step(state, dt, deriv_fn)

        // Check for crossing
        let crossed = check_crossing(section, prev_state.z, state.z)

        if crossed == 1 {
            // Linear interpolation to find crossing point
            let dz = state.z - prev_state.z
            if dz != 0.0 {
                let alpha = (section.section_z - prev_state.z) / dz
                let cross_x = prev_state.x + alpha * (state.x - prev_state.x)
                let cross_y = prev_state.y + alpha * (state.y - prev_state.y)
                record_crossing(section, cross_x, cross_y)
            }
        }

        t = t + dt
    }
}

fn check_crossing(section: &PoincareSection, z_prev: f64, z_curr: f64) -> i32 {
    let z_sec = section.section_z
    let dir = section.crossing_direction

    // Upward crossing
    if dir >= 0 {
        if z_prev < z_sec {
            if z_curr >= z_sec {
                return 1
            }
        }
    }

    // Downward crossing
    if dir <= 0 {
        if z_prev > z_sec {
            if z_curr <= z_sec {
                return 1
            }
        }
    }

    return 0
}

// ============================================================================
// Example Systems
// ============================================================================

// Lorenz system: classic chaotic attractor
// Parameters: sigma=10, rho=28, beta=8/3
fn lorenz_deriv(s: State3D) -> State3D {
    let sigma = 10.0
    let rho = 28.0
    let beta = 2.667

    return State3D {
        x: sigma * (s.y - s.x),
        y: s.x * (rho - s.z) - s.y,
        z: s.x * s.y - beta * s.z
    }
}

// Rössler system: simpler chaotic attractor
// Parameters: a=0.2, b=0.2, c=5.7
fn rossler_deriv(s: State3D) -> State3D {
    let a = 0.2
    let b = 0.2
    let c = 5.7

    return State3D {
        x: 0.0 - s.y - s.z,
        y: s.x + a * s.y,
        z: b + s.z * (s.x - c)
    }
}

// Driven damped pendulum (in 3D: theta, omega, time)
// theta' = omega
// omega' = -gamma*omega - sin(theta) + A*cos(omega_d * t)
fn driven_pendulum_deriv(s: State3D) -> State3D {
    let gamma = 0.1    // Damping
    let A = 1.5        // Driving amplitude
    let omega_d = 0.67 // Driving frequency

    let theta = s.x
    let omega = s.y
    let t = s.z

    return State3D {
        x: omega,
        y: 0.0 - gamma * omega - sin_approx(theta) + A * cos_approx(omega_d * t),
        z: 1.0  // dt/dt = 1
    }
}

fn sin_approx(x: f64) -> f64 {
    var xx = x
    while xx > 3.14159 { xx = xx - 6.28318 }
    while xx < -3.14159 { xx = xx + 6.28318 }
    let x2 = xx * xx
    let x3 = x2 * xx
    let x5 = x3 * x2
    return xx - x3 * 0.16667 + x5 * 0.00833
}

fn cos_approx(x: f64) -> f64 {
    return sin_approx(x + 1.5708)
}

// ============================================================================
// Rendering

fn density_to_char(d: i32, max_d: i32) -> i32 with Div, Panic {
    if d == 0 { return 32 }
    let ratio = (d * 5) / (max_d + 1)
    if ratio == 0 { return 46 }      // '.'
    else { if ratio == 1 { return 43 }  // '+'
    else { if ratio == 2 { return 42 }  // '*'
    else { if ratio == 3 { return 35 }  // '#'
    else { return 64 }}}}}               // '@'
}

fn density_to_color(d: i32, max_d: i32) -> i32 with Div, Panic {
    if d == 0 { return 30 }
    let ratio = (d * 5) / (max_d + 1)
    if ratio == 0 { return 34 }      // Blue
    else { if ratio == 1 { return 36 }  // Cyan
    else { if ratio == 2 { return 32 }  // Green
    else { if ratio == 3 { return 33 }  // Yellow
    else { return 31 }}}}}               // Red
}

fn poincare_render(section: &PoincareSection) with IO, Div, Panic {
    print("\x1b[2J\x1b[H")

    print("\x1b[1m=== Poincare Section ===\x1b[0m\n")
    print("z = ")
    print_f64(section.section_z)
    print(", points: ")
    print_i32(section.num_points)
    print("\n\n")

    // Y-axis label
    print("  y\n")
    print("  ^\n")

    // Render from top to bottom
    var y = section.height - 1
    while y >= 0 {
        print("  |")

        var x = 0
        while x < section.width {
            let idx = y * section.width + x
            var d = 0
            if idx < 4096 {
                d = section.density[idx]
            }

            let ch = density_to_char(d, section.max_density)
            let color = density_to_color(d, section.max_density)

            print("\x1b[")
            print_i32(color)
            print("m")
            print_char_code(ch)
            print("\x1b[0m")

            x = x + 1
        }

        print("\n")
        y = y - 1
    }

    // X-axis
    print("  +")
    var xi = 0
    while xi < section.width {
        print("-")
        xi = xi + 1
    }
    print("> x\n\n")

    // Bounds info
    print("  x: [")
    print_f64(section.x_min)
    print(", ")
    print_f64(section.x_max)
    print("]  y: [")
    print_f64(section.y_min)
    print(", ")
    print_f64(section.y_max)
    print("]\n")
}

    else { if code == 42 { print("*") }
    else { if code == 43 { print("+") }
    else { if code == 46 { print(".") }
    else { if code == 64 { print("@") }
    else { print("?") }
    }}}}}
}

fn print_i32(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {

    if x < 0 { print("-"); print_i32_unsigned(0 - x) }
    else { print_i32_unsigned(x) }
}

fn print_i32_unsigned(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {

    let digit = x % 10

    if rest > 0 { print_i32_unsigned(rest) }

}

fn print_digit(d: i32) with IO {

    else { if d == 1 { print("1") }
    else { if d == 2 { print("2") }
    else { if d == 3 { print("3") }
    else { if d == 4 { print("4") }
    else { if d == 5 { print("5") }
    else { if d == 6 { print("6") }
    else { if d == 7 { print("7") }
    else { if d == 8 { print("8") }
    else { if d == 9 { print("9") }
    }}}}}}}}}}
}

// Main Demo
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("Computing Poincare section for Lorenz system...\n")

    // Create section at z = 27 (near the attractor's saddle point)
    var section = poincare_new(27.0, -25.0, 25.0, -35.0, 35.0, 60, 30)
    poincare_set_integration(&!section, 0.005, 2000.0)

    // Initial condition on the attractor
    let init = state3d_new(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)

    // Compute the section
    poincare_compute(&!section, init, lorenz_deriv)

    // Render
    poincare_render(&section)

    print("\nLorenz attractor Poincare section\n")
    print("Shows the fractal structure of the strange attractor\n")

    return 0
}


// === FILE: examples/graphics/lib/53_streamlines.sio ===
// 53_streamlines.sio - Streamline visualization for vector fields
//
// Streamlines show the paths particles would follow in a steady vector field.
// Essential for visualizing:
// - Fluid flow patterns
// - Electric and magnetic field lines
// - Gradient descent paths
// - Phase portraits of 2D dynamical systems
//
// Features:
// - Multiple seeding strategies
// - Adaptive step size integration
// - Direction arrows
// - Line Integral Convolution (simplified)

// ============================================================================
// Vector Field Types
// ============================================================================

struct Vec2 {
    x: f64,
    y: f64
}

fn vec2_new(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec2 {
    return Vec2 { x: x, y: y }
}

fn vec2_add(a: Vec2, b: Vec2) -> Vec2 {
    return Vec2 { x: a.x + b.x, y: a.y + b.y }
}

fn vec2_scale(v: Vec2, s: f64) -> Vec2 {
    return Vec2 { x: v.x * s, y: v.y * s }
}

fn vec2_length(v: Vec2) -> f64 {
    let len_sq = v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y
    return sqrt_approx(len_sq)
}

fn vec2_normalize(v: Vec2) -> Vec2 with Div, Panic {
    let len = vec2_length(v)
    if len < 0.0001 {
        return vec2_new(0.0, 0.0)
    }
    return Vec2 { x: v.x / len, y: v.y / len }
}

fn sqrt_approx(x: f64) -> f64 {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }

    // Newton-Raphson iteration
    var guess = x * 0.5
    if guess < 1.0 { guess = 1.0 }

    var i = 0
    while i < 10 {
        guess = 0.5 * (guess + x / guess)
        i = i + 1
    }
    return guess
}

// ============================================================================
// Streamline Structure
// ============================================================================

struct Streamline {
    // Points along the streamline
    points_x: [f64; 500],
    points_y: [f64; 500],
    num_points: i32,

    // Direction at each point (for arrows)
    dirs_x: [f64; 500],
    dirs_y: [f64; 500]
}

struct StreamlineField {
    // Domain bounds
    x_min: f64,
    x_max: f64,
    y_min: f64,
    y_max: f64,

    // Display dimensions
    width: i32,
    height: i32,

    // Streamlines (up to 50)
    streamlines: [Streamline; 50],
    num_streamlines: i32,

    // Integration parameters
    step_size: f64,
    max_steps: i32,

    // Display buffer
    display: [i32; 4096]  // Character codes
}

// ============================================================================
// Initialization
// ============================================================================

fn empty_streamline() -> Streamline {
    return Streamline {
        points_x: [0.0; 500],
        points_y: [0.0; 500],
        num_points: 0,
        dirs_x: [0.0; 500],
        dirs_y: [0.0; 500]
    }
}

fn streamline_field_new(
    x_min: f64, x_max: f64,
    y_min: f64, y_max: f64,
    width: i32, height: i32
) -> StreamlineField {
    return StreamlineField {
        x_min: x_min,
        x_max: x_max,
        y_min: y_min,
        y_max: y_max,
        width: width,
        height: height,
        streamlines: [empty_streamline(); 50],
        num_streamlines: 0,
        step_size: 0.1,
        max_steps: 200,
        display: [32; 4096]  // Initialize with spaces
    }
}

fn streamline_field_set_params(
    field: &!StreamlineField,
    step_size: f64,
    max_steps: i32
) with Mut {
    field.step_size = step_size
    field.max_steps = max_steps
}

fn streamline_field_clear(field: &!StreamlineField) with Mut {
    field.num_streamlines = 0
    var i = 0
    while i < 4096 {
        field.display[i] = 32
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Streamline Integration
// ============================================================================

fn integrate_streamline(
    field: &!StreamlineField,
    seed_x: f64,
    seed_y: f64,
    vector_fn: fn(f64, f64) -> Vec2
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if field.num_streamlines >= 50 {
        return
    }

    let idx = field.num_streamlines
    field.num_streamlines = field.num_streamlines + 1

    var x = seed_x
    var y = seed_y
    var step = 0
    let dt = field.step_size

    while step < field.max_steps {
        // Check bounds
        if x < field.x_min { return }
        if x > field.x_max { return }
        if y < field.y_min { return }
        if y > field.y_max { return }

        // Store point
        if step < 500 {
            field.streamlines[idx].points_x[step] = x
            field.streamlines[idx].points_y[step] = y

            let v = vector_fn(x, y)
            let vnorm = vec2_normalize(v)
            field.streamlines[idx].dirs_x[step] = vnorm.x
            field.streamlines[idx].dirs_y[step] = vnorm.y
            field.streamlines[idx].num_points = step + 1
        }

        // RK4 integration
        let k1 = vector_fn(x, y)
        let k2 = vector_fn(x + k1.x * dt * 0.5, y + k1.y * dt * 0.5)
        let k3 = vector_fn(x + k2.x * dt * 0.5, y + k2.y * dt * 0.5)
        let k4 = vector_fn(x + k3.x * dt, y + k3.y * dt)

        let dx = (k1.x + 2.0 * k2.x + 2.0 * k3.x + k4.x) * dt / 6.0
        let dy = (k1.y + 2.0 * k2.y + 2.0 * k3.y + k4.y) * dt / 6.0

        // Check for stagnation
        let move_dist = sqrt_approx(dx * dx + dy * dy)
        if move_dist < 0.0001 {
            return
        }

        x = x + dx
        y = y + dy
        step = step + 1
    }
}

// Integrate both forward and backward from seed
fn integrate_streamline_bidirectional(
    field: &!StreamlineField,
    seed_x: f64,
    seed_y: f64,
    vector_fn: fn(f64, f64) -> Vec2
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Forward
    integrate_streamline(field, seed_x, seed_y, vector_fn)

    // Backward (negate vector field)
    // Note: Sounio doesn't support closures, so we'd need a separate function
    // For now, just do forward integration
}

// ============================================================================
// Seeding Strategies
// ============================================================================

// Grid seeding
fn seed_grid(
    field: &!StreamlineField,
    nx: i32,
    ny: i32,
    vector_fn: fn(f64, f64) -> Vec2
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    let dx = (field.x_max - field.x_min) / ((nx + 1) as f64)
    let dy = (field.y_max - field.y_min) / ((ny + 1) as f64)

    var iy = 0
    while iy < ny {
        var ix = 0
        while ix < nx {
            let x = field.x_min + (ix + 1) as f64 * dx
            let y = field.y_min + (iy + 1) as f64 * dy
            integrate_streamline(field, x, y, vector_fn)
            ix = ix + 1
        }
        iy = iy + 1
    }
}

// Random seeding (using simple LCG)
fn seed_random(
    field: &!StreamlineField,
    count: i32,
    seed: i32,
    vector_fn: fn(f64, f64) -> Vec2
) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    var rng = seed

    var i = 0
    while i < count {
        // LCG: next = (a * current + c) mod m
        rng = (rng * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483647
        let rx = (rng as f64) / 2147483647.0

        rng = (rng * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483647
        let ry = (rng as f64) / 2147483647.0

        let x = field.x_min + rx * (field.x_max - field.x_min)
        let y = field.y_min + ry * (field.y_max - field.y_min)

        integrate_streamline(field, x, y, vector_fn)
        i = i + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Rendering to Display Buffer
// ============================================================================

fn x_to_grid(field: &StreamlineField, x: f64) -> i32 with Div, Panic {
    let t = (x - field.x_min) / (field.x_max - field.x_min)
    return (t * ((field.width - 1) as f64)) as i32
}

fn y_to_grid(field: &StreamlineField, y: f64) -> i32 with Div, Panic {
    let t = (y - field.y_min) / (field.y_max - field.y_min)
    return (t * ((field.height - 1) as f64)) as i32
}

fn display_set(field: &!StreamlineField, x: i32, y: i32, ch: i32) with Mut {
    if x >= 0 {
        if x < field.width {
            if y >= 0 {
                if y < field.height {
                    let idx = y * field.width + x
                    if idx < 4096 {
                        field.display[idx] = ch
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn display_get(field: &StreamlineField, x: i32, y: i32) -> i32 {
    if x >= 0 {
        if x < field.width {
            if y >= 0 {
                if y < field.height {
                    let idx = y * field.width + x
                    if idx < 4096 {
                        return field.display[idx]
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return 32
}

// Get direction character based on angle
fn direction_char(dx: f64, dy: f64) -> i32 {
    // 8 directions: - | / \ arrows
    let angle = atan2_approx(dy, dx)  // Returns [-pi, pi]

    // Normalize to [0, 8)
    var sector = ((angle + 3.14159) / 0.7854) as i32  // 0.7854 = pi/4
    if sector < 0 { sector = 0 }
    if sector > 7 { sector = 7 }

    // Character codes for each direction
    if sector == 0 { return 45 }       // '-' left
    else { if sector == 1 { return 47 }   // '/' up-left
    else { if sector == 2 { return 124 }  // '|' up
    else { if sector == 3 { return 92 }   // '\' up-right
    else { if sector == 4 { return 45 }   // '-' right
    else { if sector == 5 { return 47 }   // '/' down-right
    else { if sector == 6 { return 124 }  // '|' down
    else { return 92 }}}}}}}               // '\' down-left
}

fn atan2_approx(y: f64, x: f64) -> f64 with Div, Panic {
    // Approximate atan2 using polynomial
    if x == 0.0 {
        if y > 0.0 { return 1.5708 }
        else { if y < 0.0 { return -1.5708 }
        else { return 0.0 }}
    }

    let ratio = y / x
    var atan_val = atan_approx(ratio)

    if x < 0.0 {
        if y >= 0.0 {
            atan_val = atan_val + 3.14159
        } else {
            atan_val = atan_val - 3.14159
        }
    }

    return atan_val
}

fn atan_approx(x: f64) -> f64 {
    // For small x, atan(x) ≈ x - x³/3 + x⁵/5
    if x > 1.0 {
        return 1.5708 - atan_approx(1.0 / x)
    }
    if x < -1.0 {
        return -1.5708 - atan_approx(1.0 / x)
    }

    let x2 = x * x
    let x3 = x2 * x
    let x5 = x3 * x2

    return x - x3 * 0.333 + x5 * 0.2
}

fn streamline_field_render_to_buffer(field: &!StreamlineField) with Mut, Div, Panic {
    // Clear display
    var i = 0
    while i < 4096 {
        field.display[i] = 32
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Draw each streamline
    var si = 0
    while si < field.num_streamlines {
        let sl = &field.streamlines[si]
        var pi = 0
        while pi < sl.num_points {
            let x = sl.points_x[pi]
            let y = sl.points_y[pi]
            let dx = sl.dirs_x[pi]
            let dy = sl.dirs_y[pi]

            let gx = x_to_grid(field, x)
            let gy = y_to_grid(field, y)

            let ch = direction_char(dx, dy)
            display_set(field, gx, gy, ch)

            pi = pi + 1
        }
        si = si + 1
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Display Rendering
// ============================================================================

fn streamline_field_render(field: &StreamlineField) with IO, Div, Panic {
    print("\x1b[2J\x1b[H")

    print("\x1b[1m=== Streamline Visualization ===\x1b[0m\n")
    print("Streamlines: ")
    print_i32(field.num_streamlines)
    print("\n\n")

    // Y-axis
    print("  y\n")
    print("  ^\n")

    // Render from top to bottom
    var y = field.height - 1
    while y >= 0 {
        print("  |")

        var x = 0
        while x < field.width {
            let ch = display_get(field, x, y)
            print("\x1b[36m")  // Cyan
            print_char_code(ch)
            print("\x1b[0m")
            x = x + 1
        }

        print("\n")
        y = y - 1
    }

    // X-axis
    print("  +")
    var xi = 0
    while xi < field.width {
        print("-")
        xi = xi + 1
    }
    print("> x\n\n")
}

// ============================================================================
// Example Vector Fields
// ============================================================================

// Simple rotation (circular flow)
fn rotation_field(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec2 {
    return vec2_new(0.0 - y, x)
}

// Saddle point
fn saddle_field(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec2 {
    return vec2_new(x, 0.0 - y)
}

// Source at origin
fn source_field(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec2 with Div, Panic {
    let r2 = x * x + y * y
    if r2 < 0.01 {
        return vec2_new(0.0, 0.0)
    }
    return vec2_new(x / r2, y / r2)
}

// Dipole field
fn dipole_field(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec2 with Div, Panic {
    // Two sources at (-1, 0) and (1, 0) with opposite signs
    let r1_x = x + 1.0
    let r1_y = y
    let r1_sq = r1_x * r1_x + r1_y * r1_y + 0.1

    let r2_x = x - 1.0
    let r2_y = y
    let r2_sq = r2_x * r2_x + r2_y * r2_y + 0.1

    let vx = r1_x / r1_sq - r2_x / r2_sq
    let vy = r1_y / r1_sq - r2_y / r2_sq

    return vec2_new(vx, vy)
}

// Vortex pair
fn vortex_pair(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec2 with Div, Panic {
    // Two vortices at (-1, 0) and (1, 0)
    let r1_x = x + 1.0
    let r1_y = y
    let r1_sq = r1_x * r1_x + r1_y * r1_y + 0.1

    let r2_x = x - 1.0
    let r2_y = y
    let r2_sq = r2_x * r2_x + r2_y * r2_y + 0.1

    // Vortex: perpendicular to radius
    let v1x = 0.0 - r1_y / r1_sq
    let v1y = r1_x / r1_sq

    let v2x = r2_y / r2_sq  // Opposite rotation
    let v2y = 0.0 - r2_x / r2_sq

    return vec2_new(v1x + v2x, v1y + v2y)
}

// Lorenz attractor (x-y projection of z derivative)
fn lorenz_xy(x: f64, y: f64) -> Vec2 {
    let sigma = 10.0
    return vec2_new(sigma * (y - x), x * 28.0 - y)
}

// ============================================================================
// Helper Functions
// ============================================================================

fn print_char_code(code: i32) with IO {
    if code == 32 { print(" ") }
    else { if code == 45 { print("-") }
    else { if code == 47 { print("/") }
    else { if code == 92 { print("\\") }
    else { if code == 124 { print("|") }
    else { print(".") }
    }}}}
}

fn print_i32(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x == 0 { print("0"); return }
    if x < 0 { print("-"); print_i32_unsigned(0 - x) }
    else { print_i32_unsigned(x) }
}

fn print_i32_unsigned(x: i32) with IO, Div, Panic {
    if x == 0 { return }
    let digit = x % 10
    let rest = x / 10
    if rest > 0 { print_i32_unsigned(rest) }
    print_digit(digit)
}

fn print_digit(d: i32) with IO {
    if d == 0 { print("0") }
    else { if d == 1 { print("1") }
    else { if d == 2 { print("2") }
    else { if d == 3 { print("3") }
    else { if d == 4 { print("4") }
    else { if d == 5 { print("5") }
    else { if d == 6 { print("6") }
    else { if d == 7 { print("7") }
    else { if d == 8 { print("8") }
    else { if d == 9 { print("9") }
    }}}}}}}}}}
}

// ============================================================================
// Main Demo
// ============================================================================

fn main() -> i32 with IO, Mut, Div, Panic {
    print("Computing streamlines for dipole field...\n")

    // Create field
    var field = streamline_field_new(-3.0, 3.0, -3.0, 3.0, 60, 30)
    streamline_field_set_params(&!field, 0.05, 300)

    // Seed with a grid
    seed_grid(&!field, 6, 6, dipole_field)

    // Render to buffer
    streamline_field_render_to_buffer(&!field)

    // Display
    streamline_field_render(&field)

    print("\nDipole field: source at (-1,0), sink at (1,0)\n")
    print("Streamlines show electric field lines between opposite charges\n")

    return 0
}


// === FILE: examples/graphics/lib/60_graph.sio ===
// 60_graph.sio - Graph data structure for network visualization
//
// Provides fundamental graph structures for network analysis and visualization:
// - Nodes with position, label, color, and size
// - Edges with weight, direction, and styling
// - Adjacency operations and graph queries
//
// This module is the foundation for force-directed layouts, tree layouts,
// and graph rendering.

// ============================================================================
// Node Structure
// ============================================================================

struct GraphNode {
    id: i32,
    x: f64,           // Position x
    y: f64,           // Position y
    z: f64,           // Position z (for 3D layouts, usually 0)
    label_code: i32,  // Character code for label (A=65, B=66, etc.)
    color: i32,       // ANSI color code
    size: i32,        // Display size (1-3)
    fixed: i32        // 0 = movable, 1 = fixed position
}

fn node_new(id: i32) -> GraphNode {
    return GraphNode {
        id: id,
        x: 0.0,
        y: 0.0,
        z: 0.0,
        label_code: 65 + id,  // A, B, C, ...
        color: 37,            // White
        size: 1,
        fixed: 0
    }
}

fn node_new_at(id: i32, x: f64, y: f64) -> GraphNode {
    return GraphNode {
        id: id,
        x: x,
        y: y,
        z: 0.0,
        label_code: 65 + id,
        color: 37,
        size: 1,
        fixed: 0
    }
}

fn node_set_position(node: &!GraphNode, x: f64, y: f64) with Mut {
    node.x = x
    node.y = y
}

fn node_set_color(node: &!GraphNode, color: i32) with Mut {
    node.color = color
}

fn node_set_size(node: &!GraphNode, size: i32) with Mut {
    node.size = size
}

fn node_set_fixed(node: &!GraphNode, fixed: i32) with Mut {
    node.fixed = fixed
}

fn node_distance(n1: &GraphNode, n2: &GraphNode) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    let dx = n2.x - n1.x
    let dy = n2.y - n1.y
    return sqrt_approx(dx * dx + dy * dy)
}

// ============================================================================
// Edge Structure
// ============================================================================

struct GraphEdge {
    from_id: i32,
    to_id: i32,
    weight: f64,
    color: i32,
    directed: i32,    // 0 = undirected, 1 = directed
    style: i32        // 0 = solid, 1 = dashed, 2 = dotted
}

fn edge_new(from_id: i32, to_id: i32) -> GraphEdge {
    return GraphEdge {
        from_id: from_id,
        to_id: to_id,
        weight: 1.0,
        color: 37,
        directed: 0,
        style: 0
    }
}

fn edge_new_weighted(from_id: i32, to_id: i32, weight: f64) -> GraphEdge {
    return GraphEdge {
        from_id: from_id,
        to_id: to_id,
        weight: weight,
        color: 37,
        directed: 0,
        style: 0
    }
}

fn edge_new_directed(from_id: i32, to_id: i32) -> GraphEdge {
    return GraphEdge {
        from_id: from_id,
        to_id: to_id,
        weight: 1.0,
        color: 37,
        directed: 1,
        style: 0
    }
}

fn edge_set_color(edge: &!GraphEdge, color: i32) with Mut {
    edge.color = color
}

fn edge_set_style(edge: &!GraphEdge, style: i32) with Mut {
    edge.style = style
}

// ============================================================================
// Graph Structure
// ============================================================================

struct Graph {
    nodes: [GraphNode; 100],
    edges: [GraphEdge; 500],
    n_nodes: i32,
    n_edges: i32,

    // Adjacency list (flat array with offsets)
    // adj_list[adj_offset[i]..adj_offset[i+1]] = neighbors of node i
    adj_list: [i32; 1000],
    adj_offset: [i32; 101],  // n_nodes + 1 offsets
    adj_built: i32           // 0 = needs rebuild, 1 = valid
}

fn graph_new() -> Graph {
    return Graph {
        nodes: [node_new(0); 100],
        edges: [edge_new(0, 0); 500],
        n_nodes: 0,
        n_edges: 0,
        adj_list: [0; 1000],
        adj_offset: [0; 101],
        adj_built: 0
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Node Operations
// ============================================================================

fn graph_add_node(graph: &!Graph, node: GraphNode) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    if graph.n_nodes >= 100 {
        return -1
    }
    let id = graph.n_nodes
    graph.nodes[id] = node
    graph.nodes[id].id = id
    graph.n_nodes = graph.n_nodes + 1
    graph.adj_built = 0
    return id
}

fn graph_add_node_at(graph: &!Graph, x: f64, y: f64) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    let node = node_new_at(graph.n_nodes, x, y)
    return graph_add_node(graph, node)
}

fn graph_get_node(graph: &Graph, id: i32) -> GraphNode with Panic {
    if id >= 0 {
        if id < graph.n_nodes {
            return graph.nodes[id]
        }
    }
    return node_new(-1)
}

fn graph_set_node_position(graph: &!Graph, id: i32, x: f64, y: f64) with Mut, Panic {
    if id >= 0 {
        if id < graph.n_nodes {
            graph.nodes[id].x = x
            graph.nodes[id].y = y
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Value-Passing Node Operations (for use in loops)
// ============================================================================

fn graph_add_node_v(graph: Graph, node: GraphNode) -> Graph with Mut, Panic {
    if graph.n_nodes >= 100 {
        return graph
    }
    var g = graph
    let id = g.n_nodes
    g.nodes[id] = node
    g.nodes[id].id = id
    g.n_nodes = g.n_nodes + 1
    g.adj_built = 0
    return g
}

fn graph_add_node_at_v(graph: Graph, x: f64, y: f64) -> Graph with Mut, Panic {
    let node = node_new_at(graph.n_nodes, x, y)
    return graph_add_node_v(graph, node)
}

// ============================================================================
// Edge Operations
// ============================================================================

fn graph_add_edge(graph: &!Graph, edge: GraphEdge) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    if graph.n_edges >= 500 {
        return -1
    }
    let id = graph.n_edges
    graph.edges[id] = edge
    graph.n_edges = graph.n_edges + 1
    graph.adj_built = 0
    return id
}

fn graph_connect(graph: &!Graph, from_id: i32, to_id: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    let edge = edge_new(from_id, to_id)
    return graph_add_edge(graph, edge)
}

fn graph_connect_weighted(graph: &!Graph, from_id: i32, to_id: i32, weight: f64) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    let edge = edge_new_weighted(from_id, to_id, weight)
    return graph_add_edge(graph, edge)
}

fn graph_connect_directed(graph: &!Graph, from_id: i32, to_id: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic {
    let edge = edge_new_directed(from_id, to_id)
    return graph_add_edge(graph, edge)
}

// ============================================================================
// Value-Passing Edge Operations (for use in loops)
// ============================================================================

fn graph_add_edge_v(graph: Graph, edge: GraphEdge) -> Graph with Mut, Panic {
    if graph.n_edges >= 500 {
        return graph
    }
    var g = graph
    let id = g.n_edges
    g.edges[id] = edge
    g.n_edges = g.n_edges + 1
    g.adj_built = 0
    return g
}

fn graph_connect_v(graph: Graph, from_id: i32, to_id: i32) -> Graph with Mut, Panic {
    let edge = edge_new(from_id, to_id)
    return graph_add_edge_v(graph, edge)
}

fn graph_connect_weighted_v(graph: Graph, from_id: i32, to_id: i32, weight: f64) -> Graph with Mut, Panic {
    let edge = edge_new_weighted(from_id, to_id, weight)
    return graph_add_edge_v(graph, edge)
}

fn graph_connect_directed_v(graph: Graph, from_id: i32, to_id: i32) -> Graph with Mut, Panic {
    let edge = edge_new_directed(from_id, to_id)
    return graph_add_edge_v(graph, edge)
}

fn graph_has_edge(graph: &Graph, from_id: i32, to_id: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var i = 0
    while i < graph.n_edges {
        let e = graph.edges[i]
        if e.from_id == from_id {
            if e.to_id == to_id {
                return 1
            }
        }
        // Check reverse for undirected
        if e.directed == 0 {
            if e.from_id == to_id {
                if e.to_id == from_id {
                    return 1
                }
            }
        }
        i = i + 1
    }
    return 0
}

// ============================================================================
// Adjacency List
// ============================================================================

fn graph_build_adjacency(graph: &!Graph) with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if graph.adj_built == 1 {
        return
    }

    // Count neighbors for each node
    var counts: [i32; 100] = [0; 100]

    var e = 0
    while e < graph.n_edges {
        let edge = graph.edges[e]
        counts[edge.from_id] = counts[edge.from_id] + 1
        if edge.directed == 0 {
            counts[edge.to_id] = counts[edge.to_id] + 1
        }
        e = e + 1
    }

    // Build offsets
    graph.adj_offset[0] = 0
    var n = 0
    while n < graph.n_nodes {
        graph.adj_offset[n + 1] = graph.adj_offset[n] + counts[n]
        n = n + 1
    }

    // Reset counts for filling
    var c = 0
    while c < 100 {
        counts[c] = 0
        c = c + 1
    }

    // Fill adjacency list
    e = 0
    while e < graph.n_edges {
        let edge = graph.edges[e]
        let from = edge.from_id
        let to = edge.to_id

        let idx1 = graph.adj_offset[from] + counts[from]
        if idx1 < 1000 {
            graph.adj_list[idx1] = to
            counts[from] = counts[from] + 1
        }

        if edge.directed == 0 {
            let idx2 = graph.adj_offset[to] + counts[to]
            if idx2 < 1000 {
                graph.adj_list[idx2] = from
                counts[to] = counts[to] + 1
            }
        }

        e = e + 1
    }

    graph.adj_built = 1
}

// Value-passing version for use with local variables
fn graph_build_adjacency_v(graph: Graph) -> Graph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if graph.adj_built == 1 {
        return graph
    }

    var g = graph

    // Count neighbors for each node
    var counts: [i32; 100] = [0; 100]

    var e = 0
    while e < g.n_edges {
        let edge = g.edges[e]
        counts[edge.from_id] = counts[edge.from_id] + 1
        if edge.directed == 0 {
            counts[edge.to_id] = counts[edge.to_id] + 1
        }
        e = e + 1
    }

    // Build offsets
    g.adj_offset[0] = 0
    var n = 0
    while n < g.n_nodes {
        g.adj_offset[n + 1] = g.adj_offset[n] + counts[n]
        n = n + 1
    }

    // Reset counts for filling
    var c = 0
    while c < 100 {
        counts[c] = 0
        c = c + 1
    }

    // Fill adjacency list
    e = 0
    while e < g.n_edges {
        let edge = g.edges[e]
        let from = edge.from_id
        let to = edge.to_id

        let idx1 = g.adj_offset[from] + counts[from]
        if idx1 < 1000 {
            g.adj_list[idx1] = to
            counts[from] = counts[from] + 1
        }

        if edge.directed == 0 {
            let idx2 = g.adj_offset[to] + counts[to]
            if idx2 < 1000 {
                g.adj_list[idx2] = from
                counts[to] = counts[to] + 1
            }
        }

        e = e + 1
    }

    g.adj_built = 1
    return g
}

fn graph_degree(graph: &!Graph, node_id: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    graph_build_adjacency(graph)
    if node_id >= 0 {
        if node_id < graph.n_nodes {
            return graph.adj_offset[node_id + 1] - graph.adj_offset[node_id]
        }
    }
    return 0
}

fn graph_neighbor(graph: &!Graph, node_id: i32, neighbor_idx: i32) -> i32 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    graph_build_adjacency(graph)
    if node_id >= 0 {
        if node_id < graph.n_nodes {
            let start = graph.adj_offset[node_id]
            let end = graph.adj_offset[node_id + 1]
            let idx = start + neighbor_idx
            if idx >= start {
                if idx < end {
                    return graph.adj_list[idx]
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return -1
}

// ============================================================================
// Graph Queries
// ============================================================================

fn graph_center_of_mass(graph: &Graph) -> GraphNode with Mut, Div, Panic {
    if graph.n_nodes == 0 {
        return node_new(-1)
    }

    var cx = 0.0
    var cy = 0.0
    var i = 0
    while i < graph.n_nodes {
        cx = cx + graph.nodes[i].x
        cy = cy + graph.nodes[i].y
        i = i + 1
    }

    let n = graph.n_nodes as f64
    var result = node_new(-1)
    result.x = cx / n
    result.y = cy / n
    return result
}

fn graph_bounding_box(
    graph: &Graph
) -> GraphNode with Mut, Div, Panic {  // Returns (min_x, min_y) in x,y and (max_x, max_y) in z (hack)
    if graph.n_nodes == 0 {
        var empty = node_new(-1)
        empty.x = 0.0
        empty.y = 0.0
        empty.z = 0.0
        return empty
    }

    var min_x = graph.nodes[0].x
    var max_x = graph.nodes[0].x
    var min_y = graph.nodes[0].y
    var max_y = graph.nodes[0].y

    var i = 1
    while i < graph.n_nodes {
        let node = graph.nodes[i]
        if node.x < min_x { min_x = node.x }
        if node.x > max_x { max_x = node.x }
        if node.y < min_y { min_y = node.y }
        if node.y > max_y { max_y = node.y }
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Encode both corners in result
    var result = node_new(-1)
    result.x = min_x
    result.y = min_y
    result.z = max_x  // Hack: store max values
    result.label_code = max_y as i32  // Another hack
    return result
}

// ============================================================================
// Graph Builders (Common Patterns)
// ============================================================================

fn graph_create_complete(n: i32) -> Graph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var graph = graph_new()

    // Add nodes in a circle
    let angle_step = 6.28318 / (n as f64)
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let angle = (i as f64) * angle_step
        let x = cos_approx(angle) * 10.0
        let y = sin_approx(angle) * 10.0
        graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, x, y)
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Connect all pairs
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        var j = i + 1
        while j < n {
            graph = graph_connect_v(graph, i, j)
            j = j + 1
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    return graph
}

fn graph_create_cycle(n: i32) -> Graph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var graph = graph_new()

    let angle_step = 6.28318 / (n as f64)
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        let angle = (i as f64) * angle_step
        let x = cos_approx(angle) * 10.0
        let y = sin_approx(angle) * 10.0
        graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, x, y)
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Connect in cycle
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let next = (i + 1) % n
        graph = graph_connect_v(graph, i, next)
        i = i + 1
    }

    return graph
}

fn graph_create_star(n: i32) -> Graph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var graph = graph_new()

    // Center node
    graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, 0.0, 0.0)

    // Outer nodes
    let angle_step = 6.28318 / ((n - 1) as f64)
    var i = 1
    while i < n {
        let angle = ((i - 1) as f64) * angle_step
        let x = cos_approx(angle) * 10.0
        let y = sin_approx(angle) * 10.0
        graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, x, y)

        // Connect to center
        graph = graph_connect_v(graph, 0, i)
        i = i + 1
    }

    return graph
}

fn graph_create_grid(rows: i32, cols: i32) -> Graph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var graph = graph_new()

    // Add nodes
    var r = 0
    while r < rows {
        var c = 0
        while c < cols {
            let x = (c as f64) * 3.0
            let y = (r as f64) * 3.0
            graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, x, y)
            c = c + 1
        }
        r = r + 1
    }

    // Connect horizontally and vertically
    r = 0
    while r < rows {
        var c = 0
        while c < cols {
            let id = r * cols + c

            // Right neighbor
            if c + 1 < cols {
                graph = graph_connect_v(graph, id, id + 1)
            }

            // Down neighbor
            if r + 1 < rows {
                graph = graph_connect_v(graph, id, id + cols)
            }

            c = c + 1
        }
        r = r + 1
    }

    return graph
}

fn graph_create_binary_tree(depth: i32) -> Graph with Mut, Panic, Div {
    var graph = graph_new()

    // Number of nodes: 2^depth - 1
    var n = 1
    var d = 0
    while d < depth {
        n = n * 2
        d = d + 1
    }
    n = n - 1

    // Add nodes
    var i = 0
    while i < n {
        graph = graph_add_node_at_v(graph, 0.0, 0.0)  // Positions set later
        i = i + 1
    }

    // Connect parent to children
    i = 0
    while i < n {
        let left = 2 * i + 1
        let right = 2 * i + 2
        if left < n {
            graph = graph_connect_v(graph, i, left)
        }
        if right < n {
            graph = graph_connect_v(graph, i, right)
        }
        i = i + 1
    }

    return graph
}

// ============================================================================
// Math Helpers
// ============================================================================

fn sqrt_approx(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    if x <= 0.0 { return 0.0 }
    var guess = x * 0.5
    var i = 0
    while i < 10 {
        guess = (guess + x / guess) * 0.5
        i = i + 1
    }
    return guess
}

fn sin_approx(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Div {
    var xx = x
    while xx > 3.14159 { xx = xx - 6.28318 }
    while xx < -3.14159 { xx = xx + 6.28318 }
    let x2 = xx * xx
    let x3 = x2 * xx
    let x5 = x3 * x2
    return xx - x3 * 0.16667 + x5 * 0.00833
}

fn cos_approx(x: f64) -> f64 with Mut, Panic, Div {
    return sin_approx(x + 1.5708)
}
